Task 4: Performance Evaluation and Prototype System Development: Our methods will be rigorously evaluated and integrated into a prototype system. 基礎模型展示了令人印象深刻的能力，並顯著推進了多個現實世界領域的發展。例如，以醫療保健為導向的基礎模型可能會影響2024-2025年佔香港GDP約8%的產業。然而，訓練基礎模型（例如 GPT-4）非常昂貴，需要花費數百萬美元和大量時間。在這種情況下，通過整合多個從同一預訓練模型微調而來的基礎模型來進行基礎模型融合的方案提供了一種經濟高效的替代方案。在基礎模型融合流程的關鍵階段，包括模型選擇、知識矯正和參數聚合，目前的方法廣泛依賴一系列理想化假設：有限數量的候選基礎模型、源自高質量數據的模型知識和相互不衝突的模型參數。然而，這些理想化假設與現實應用場景的複雜性相衝突，從而為基礎模型融合的效率、安全性和魯棒性帶來了嚴峻的挑戰，具體表現在以下幾個方面： 挑戰1（模型選擇）：如何從大量候選模型中高效地選擇基礎模型？候選基礎模型的數量可能很大，但只有少數模型能對目標任務作出有效貢獻。然而，通常透過詳盡的性能評估來選擇基礎模型非常耗時，從而引發了基礎模型融合的效率問題。 挑戰2（知識矯正）：如何去除惡意知識並避免隱私洩露，以實現安全的基礎模型融合？候選基礎模型可能包含來自無法獲取的訓練數據中的惡意知識和有害觸發機制，從而引發基礎模型融合的安全問題。 挑戰 3（參數聚合）：如何緩解參數衝突以實現魯棒的基礎模型融合？候選基礎模型針對各種任務進行了微調。然而，不同基礎模型之間可能會出現參數衝突，例如參數重疊和偏好偏差，從而引發基礎模型融合的魯棒性問題。 在這個項目中，我們提出了一種組件感知精選驅動的模型融合（CoCu-Merging）框架，該框架可以定製化篩選模型、知識和參數，以提高基礎模型融合的效率和可信度。具體來說，我們針對上述三個挑戰提出了四項任務。 任務 1：通過模型路由進行高效基礎模型融合：這一任務旨在研發高效基礎模型的篩選策略（針對挑戰 1）。 任務 2：通過基於數據選擇的反學習來實現安全基礎模型融合：這一任務旨在研發基於合成數據選擇的反學習算法，以移除基礎模型中的惡意知識（針對挑戰 2）。 任務 3：通過解決參數衝突來實現魯棒基礎模型融合：這一任務旨在研發參數選擇算法來減輕參數衝突並增強基礎模型融合的魯棒性（針對挑戰 3）。 任務 4：性能評估和原型系統開發：我們的方法將經過嚴格評估並整合到原型系統中。

12202426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12202426.value: 面向多聯盟許可區塊鏈的安全協同圖查詢

12202426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12202426.value: Multi-consortium permissioned blockchains enable mutually distrustful organizations to maintain shared records under strict governance and access controls, driving widespread adoption in Web 3.0 applications such as supply chain, finance, and healthcare. The graph-structured nature of data in these applications necessitates cross-consortium queries to extract global insights without centralizing sensitive information. However, cross-consortium graph querying introduces significant privacy and integrity challenges: intermediate results may leak sensitive graph topology or label information, adversarial participants may manipulate inputs, and non-responsive nodes can threaten liveness. While Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), such as Intel SGX, provide isolated and encrypted computation, they remain vulnerable to side-channel attacks through observable memory-access patterns and cannot alone ensure complete privacy protection or query integrity. A secure, privacy-preserving, and integrity-assured framework for cross-consortium graph queries is critically needed. This research is intended to propose a novel framework for secure collaborative graph query processing in multi-consortium permissioned blockchains that integrates in TEEs with oblivious access, differential privacy, and Byzantine fault-tolerant mechanisms. To address the aforementioned challenges, the project encompasses four key tasks: (1) developing a TEE-based secure graph query framework that ensures data confidentiality, query integrity, and system liveness in the presence of adversarial nodes; (2) designing optimization techniques that leverage blockchain decentralization and parallelism to achieve scalable and secure graph queries; (3) exploring differentially oblivious algorithms to enhance performance with provable security guarantees; and (4) conducting theoretical analyses and empirical evaluations to assess the effectiveness, scalability, and security of the proposed techniques and algorithms. Drawing on our expertise in blockchains, query processing, and data security and privacy, this project will deliver a robust theoretical foundation and practical designs for secure, high-performance collaborative graph queries tailored to permissioned blockchains. We anticipate that the research outcomes will enable broader adoption of graph analytics in blockchain applications, facilitating global insights while safeguarding sensitive organizational data. 多聯盟許可區塊鏈使互不信任的組織能在嚴格的權限控制下共享數據，並已在供應鏈、金融和醫療等Web 3.0場景中得到廣泛應用。這些場景中的圖結構數據需要進行跨聯盟查詢，以便在不集中管理敏感資訊的前提下獲取全局洞見。然而，跨聯盟圖查詢面臨嚴峻的隱私與完整性挑戰：中間結果可能洩露敏感的圖拓撲或標籤資訊，惡意參與者可能篡改輸入數據，而無響應的節點也會威脅系統的可用性。儘管可信執行環境（TEE）能提供隔離的加密計算，但仍易受基於記憶體訪問模式的側信道攻擊，單靠TEE無法完全保障隱私與查詢完整性。因此，業界亟需一個兼顧安全、隱私保護與完整性的跨聯盟圖查詢框架。本研究旨在提出一個全新的多聯盟許可區塊鏈安全協同圖查詢框架，該框架結合了TEE、茫然訪問（oblivious access）、差分隱私與拜占庭容錯機制。為解決上述挑戰，本項目包含四大任務：（1）開發基於TEE的安全圖查詢框架：在惡意節點存在的情況下，仍能確保數據機密性、查詢完整性與系統可用性；（2）設計優化技術：利用區塊鏈的去中心化與並行性，實現具備高擴展性且安全的圖查詢；（3）探索差分茫然演算法：在提供可證明安全性的同時提升系統性能；（4）理論分析與實證評估：全面驗證所提技術與演算法的有效性、擴展性及安全性。

12202726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12202726.value: 非完美多視圖聚類：小樣本不完整數據學習

12202726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12202726.value: Multi-view clustering (MVC) has emerged as a highly effective machine learning paradigm for integrating heterogeneous data sources to improve the accuracy and reliability of sample grouping. By harnessing complementary information from multiple feature spaces, MVC supports a range of applications, e.g., image retrieval, multi-omics analysis, and user community detection. Despite these strengths, the practical impact of current MVC methods is hindered by a reliance on view completeness and large training datasets—conditions frequently unmet in real-world scenarios. For instance, rare disease studies are often constrained by extremely limited sample sizes, sometimes with only a handful of available cases. In addition, because of resource limitations, accessibility challenges, and technical barriers, essential data components such as MRI scans, genomic sequences, or clinical records may be incomplete or entirely missing. These dual challenges impose significant bottlenecks: sample scarcity fundamentally limits the ability of models to learn discriminative representations, while data incompleteness obstructs the construction of reliable consensus topologies. Together, these issues contribute to overfitting, poor generalization, and instability in clustering results. Therefore, designing MVC methods robust to both small sample sizes and incomplete data is a critical but underexplored research direction. This project aims to develop a novel MVC framework specifically tailored for small and incomplete datasets. It addresses three central challenges: (1) How can feature representations be learned with strong generalization ability under conditions of sample scarcity? (2) How can effective view associations be established to achieve precise and structure-preserving data completion? (3) How can inconsistencies within missing views be mitigated to enhance clustering reliability and robustness? To overcome these challenges, we propose an integrated framework combining shrinkage-regularized representation learning to boost generalization, graph-constrained completion for structure-preserving view imputation, and stability-weighted consensus clustering to ensure dependable outcomes. This approach will facilitate transformative MVC applications in domains such as healthcare, where patient cohorts may be small and records incomplete, and precision agriculture, where sensor data can be sparse and fragmented. Theoretically, this research will deepen understanding of cross-view representation learning under extreme sample scarcity and high missing rates, offering new insights into the integration of heterogeneous and fragmented information. Industrially, the resulting capabilities will lead to more reliable and deployable artificial intelligence (AI) systems under practical constraints, significantly broadening the applicability of MVC. Ultimately, the project’s outcomes will advance the scalability and robustness of AI in real-world, data-scarce environments, driving innovation across scientific and commercial sectors.

12202926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12202926.value: 高解析度城市空氣品質建模的物理嵌入型人工智慧方法

12202926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12202926.value: Prof Gao, Meng Dr Lyu, Xiaopu

12202926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12202926.value: Air pollution in dense cities varies dramatically—levels can differ five-fold between adjacent streets. This matters for Hong Kong's 7.5 million residents, as fine particulate matter causes cardiovascular and respiratory diseases responsible for thousands of premature deaths annually. Current tools face an impossible choice: physically rigorous atmospheric models require days of supercomputer time, useless for real-time warnings, while fast machine-learning methods sacrifice the physical understanding needed for reliable predictions under changing weather. City managers need forecasts both rapid enough for hourly updates and scientifically trustworthy enough to guide policy—capabilities no existing system delivers. This project builds a prediction framework that differs fundamentally from existing physics-informed artificial intelligence. Conventional approaches add physical equations as soft "suggestions" during training, but optimization algorithms often ignore these when they conflict with fitting data. We instead embed atmospheric transport directly into the computational architecture, making conservation laws impossible to violate—like building a puzzle where pieces only fit together in physically correct ways. We encode how pollution actually moves—spreading through turbulent mixing, carried by wind, emerging from sources, depositing on surfaces—as the intrinsic operations of a graph neural network. Every prediction automatically conserves mass and respects meteorological transport regardless of training dynamics. The system learns only what genuinely requires local knowledge: emission locations and building effects on airflow. This innovation enables physical consistency under weather conditions absent from training data, transparent predictions traceable to specific sources, and computational efficiency achieving 30-minute updates for Hong Kong's entire 1,100 km² at neighborhood scales (300-500 meters)—a combination absent in existing systems. We augment Hong Kong's 18 fixed monitoring stations with 10 mobile sensing vehicles systematically mapping pollution, providing spatial coverage impossible with fixed instruments and measuring where disadvantaged communities live but conventional monitors are scarce. The framework works across scales simultaneously—regional predictions capture weather patterns, urban predictions incorporate buildings, fine predictions resolve street hotspots. The final year transitions the system to operational deployment at Hong Kong's Environmental Protection Department, providing hour-ahead warnings for vulnerable populations, targeting emission controls where they provide greatest benefit, and revealing exposure disparities invisible in city-wide averages. Beyond Hong Kong, this offers a template for rapidly growing cities where conventional monitoring is prohibitively expensive. The methodology extends to any transport-governed environmental problem—establishing new standards for integrating physical knowledge with machine learning when both speed and scientific rigor matter. 密集城市的空氣污染差異極大——相鄰街道之間的污染水平可相差五倍。這對香港750萬居民而言至關重要，因為細懸浮微粒會引發心血管和呼吸系統疾病，每年導致數千人過早死亡。現有工具面臨一個不可能的取捨：物理上嚴謹的大氣模型需要數天的超級計算機運算時間，無法用於實時預警；而快速的機器學習方法則犧牲了在變化天氣條件下進行可靠預測所需的物理理解。城市管理者既需要足夠快速以實現每小時更新的預報，又需要科學上足夠可信以指導政策——而現有系統均無法同時滿足這兩項能力。 本項目構建一個與現有物理啟發式人工智能根本不同的預測框架。傳統方法在訓練過程中將物理方程作為軟性「建議」加入，但當優化算法與數據擬合發生衝突時，往往會忽略這些方程。我們則將大氣傳輸直接嵌入計算架構中，使守恆定律不可能被違反——就像拼圖一樣，各個碎片只能以物理正確的方式拼接在一起。 我們將污染物的實際運動方式——通過湍流混合擴散、被風力輸送、從排放源釋放、沉積於表面——編碼為圖神經網絡的內在運算操作。無論訓練動態如何，每一個預測都自動滿足質量守恆並遵循氣象傳輸規律。系統僅學習真正需要本地知識的內容：排放源位置以及建築物對氣流的影響。這一創新使其能夠在訓練數據中未出現的天氣條件下保持物理一致性，實現可追溯到特定排放源的透明預測，並具備足以在香港1,100平方公里全域實現30分鐘更新、達到社區尺度（300至500米）的計算效率——這種組合在現有系統中尚不存在。 我們在香港18個固定監測站的基礎上，增設10輛移動感測車輛，系統性地測繪污染分佈，提供固定儀器無法達成的空間覆蓋範圍，並測量弱勢社區居住但傳統監測站稀少區域的污染情況。該框架可同時跨尺度運作——區域預測捕捉天氣模式，城市預測納入建築物影響，精細預測解析街道熱點。 項目最後一年將系統過渡至香港環境保護署的業務化部署，為易感人群提供提前一小時的預警，在效益最大的地區針對性地實施排放管控，並揭示在城市整體平均值中不可見的暴露差異。 在香港之外，這為常規監測成本過高而難以負擔的快速增長城市提供了範本。該方法可推廣至任何受傳輸過程主導的環境問題——在速度與科學嚴謹性同等重要的場景下，為整合物理知識與機器學習建立新標準。

12300226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300226.value: 闡明AlkB亞家族氧化酶在tRNA修飾中的酶促活性

12300226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300226.value: The wobble base hypothesis, proposed by Francis Crick in 1966, postulates how tRNAs can decode more than one triplet codon through non-canonical base pairing between the first base of the anticodon and the third base of the codon. The first base of the anticodon is known as the wobble base. The wobble base is often hypermodified to strengthen non-canonical base pairing with the third base of the mRNA codon triplet. Dysregulation of tRNA wobble base modifications is linked to diseases including neurological disorder, metabolic diseases, and cancer. One of the chemical moieties installed on the wobble base is the hydroxyl group. Two human tRNA wobble base hydroxylases from the Fe(II) and 2OG-dependent oxygenase superfamily, TYW5 and ALKBH8, have been identified. ALKBH8 hydroxylates 5-methoxycarbonylmethyluridine (mcm5U) to (S)-5-methoxycarbonylhydroxymethyluridine ((S)-mchm5U) in tRNA(Gly/UCC). However, the enzyme responsible for producing the other diastereomer (R)-5-methoxycarbonylhydroxymethyluridine ((R)-mchm5U) found in tRNA(Arg/UCG) was not been identified. Recent report suggests that ALKBH4 is the enzyme that can produce the (R)-mchm5U as well as converting (R)-mchm5U to an unknown product. However, these suggested products were not directly identified. As some other 2OG oxygenases can catalyse sequential oxidations of substrates, we hypothesize that ALKBH4 can catalyse sequential oxidations of mcm5U to produce novel modifications. Our preliminary data showed that ALKBH4 can indeed convert mcm5U to mchm5U as well as producing a further oxidized product. We propose to (1) investigate the in vitro enzymatic activities of ALKBH4 in detail and to identify their products by QTOF-MS and LC-MS/MS, (b) obtain structural information of ALKBH4 and ALKBH8 in complex with their RNA substrates by X-ray crystallography and molecular dynamics simulation, and (3) identify the enzymatic products of ALKBH4 in cells and their roles in translation in cells. Results from this research will elucidate the roles and mechanisms of ALKBH4 and distinguishes the catalytic activities of two tRNA oxygenases from the AlkB subfamily of oxygenases. This research will provide foundation in understanding of tRNA wobble base hydroxylation and the molecular basis of codon decoding in translation. Given that ALKBH4 and ALKBH8 have links to cancer development, this research will aid inhibitor discovery efforts for potential anticancer therapy. Furthermore, basic knowledge on decoding by tRNA may also help in designing tools for codon expansion for biotechnological purposes. 弗朗西斯·克里克在1966年提出的擺動鹼基假説，解釋了tRNA如何通過反密碼子第一個鹼基與密碼子第三個鹼基之間的非經典鹼基配對，解碼多種密碼子三聯體。反密碼子的第一個鹼基被稱為擺動鹼基。擺動鹼基通常會進行高度修飾，以增強與mRNA密碼子三聯體中第三個鹼基的非經典配對。tRNA擺動鹼基修飾的失調與神經系統疾病、代謝性疾病以及癌症等疾病相關。擺動鹼基上的一種化學基團是羥基。已鑑定出兩種來自鐵(II)和2-氧戊二酸依賴氧化酶超家族的人類tRNA擺動鹼基羥化酶，即TYW5和ALKBH8。ALKBH8 將 5-甲氧羧甲基尿苷（mcm5U）羥基化為 tRNA(Gly/UCC) 中的 (S)-5-甲氧羧羥甲基尿苷（(S)-mchm5U）。然而，負責在 tRNA(Arg/UCG) 中生成另一種非對映異構體 (R)-5-甲氧羧羥甲基尿苷（(R)-mchm5U) 的酶尚未被鑑定。最近的研究表明，ALKBH4 可能是能生成 (R)-mchm5U 的酶並將其轉化成未知產物。不過，這些推測的產物尚未被直接鑑定。由於其他一些 2OG 氧化酶可以催化底物的連續氧化，我們推測 ALKBH4 也可以催化 mcm5U 的連續氧化以產生新型修飾。我們的初步數據表明，ALKBH4 可能具有生成 (R)-mchm5U 的活性，並進一步將其轉化為未知產物。基於上述結果，我們擬開展以下研究：(1) 詳細研究 ALKBH4 的體外酶活性，並通過 QTOF-MS 和 LC-MS/MS 鑑定其產物；(2) 通過 X 射線晶體學和分子動力學模擬解析ALKBH4 和 ALKBH8 與其 RNA 底物複合物的結構信息；(3) 在細胞中鑑定 ALKBH4 的酶產物及其在細胞翻譯中的作用。這項研究的結果將闡明 ALKBH4 的作用機制，並區分 AlkB 氧化酶亞家族中兩種 tRNA 氧化酶的催化活性。這項研究將為理解 tRNA 搖擺鹼基羥基化及翻譯中密碼子解碼的分子基礎提供基礎。鑑於 ALKBH4 和 ALKBH8 與癌症發展相關，這項研究也將有助於潛在抗癌治療抑制劑的發現。此外，關於 tRNA 解碼的基礎知識也可能有助於為生物技術用途設計密碼子擴展工具。

12300326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300326.value: 高維非厄米異常缺陷的研究

12300326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300326.value: Exceptional points (EPs) are spectral singularities that uniquely appear in non-Hermitian systems, a class of open systems in which energy is not conserved due to the deliberate and controllable introduction of energy exchange with external reservoirs. At an EP, the eigenvalues of modes become the same, and the corresponding eigenvectors are parallel, such that the system's Hilbert space "loses" one dimension. The successful realization of EPs across diverse physical systems, including photonics, acoustics, single spins, superconducting circuits, and cold atoms, has sparked tremendous interest in fundamental physics and inspired a wide range of novel applications. However, as the term “exceptional” suggests, EPs are degenerate points isolated in the spectrum, which may contain a large number of modes. Consequently, properties and functionalities hinged on EPs face limitations, such as an intrinsically narrow bandwidth. Recently, we have successfully generalized the concept of EPs by introducing "exceptional deficiency" (ED), a condition characterized by the coalescence of multi-dimensional Hilbert subspaces. According to our study so far, ED can be reached by the Hamiltonian with a block-triangular form when the spectra of the two diagonal blocks overlap. When this happens, two Hilbert subspaces of arbitrarily large dimensions exactly align, accompanied by the coincidence of their spectra. Consequently, the spectrum is entirely composed of EPs, and the Hilbert space is highly defective by “losing” half of its span. Unlike a higher-order EP, this happens without the energy of the involved states becoming a single value. The system's spectrum can span a range. As a newly discovered non-Hermitian condition, many properties of ED remain unexplored. This project aims to delve into two aspects of both fundamental and practical importance. The first study investigates the steady-state response of an ED using the non-Hermitian Green's function. Preliminary results already show intriguing phenomena such as the coexistence of Lorentzian/super-Lorentzian responses. The second study aims to identify more general conditions to reach ED in non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that do not have the block-triangular form. New phenomena and intriguing new systems will be experimentally demonstrated using non-Hermitian metamaterials or wave crystals. The nature of this project is a curiosity-driven fundamental research into a new frontier in physics. The success of this project will significantly deepen our understanding of ED, opening new horizons for physics research and paving the way for novel applications. 異常點（EPs）是非厄米系統所獨有的一類譜奇點。這類開放系統通過與外部庫進行刻意且可控的能量交換，導致能量不再守恒。在EP處，模式的本征值變得相同，相應的本征矢相互平行，從而使得系統的希爾伯特空間「失去」一個維度。EPs已在光子學、聲學、單自旋、超導電路和冷原子等多種物理系統中成功實現，這引發了基礎物理領域的極大興趣，並催生了一系列新穎的應用。然而，正如「異常」一詞所暗示的，EPs是譜中孤立的簡並點，而譜中可能包含大量模式。因此，依賴於EPs的屬性和功能面臨一些限製，例如固有地存在窄帶寬問題。最近，我們通過引入「異常缺陷」（ED）這一概念，成功推廣了EPs的概念。ED的特征是多維希爾伯特子空間的並合。根據我們迄今為止的研究，當哈密頓量具有塊三角形式，且兩個對角塊的譜發生重疊時，就可以達到ED。此時，兩個具有任意大維度的希爾伯特子空間精確對齊，同時其譜也完全重合。結果，整個譜由EPs構成，希爾伯特空間因「失去」其一半的張成空間而高度缺陷。與高階EP不同的是，這一過程發生時，所涉及態的能量並未變成單一值，系統的譜可以跨越一個範圍。作為一種新發現的非厄米條件，ED的許多性質仍有待探索。本項目旨在深入研究兩個兼具基礎重要性和實際應用價值的方面。第一項研究將利用非厄米格林函數考察ED的穩態響應。初步結果已顯示出諸如洛倫茲/超洛倫茲響應共存等有趣現象。第二項研究旨在找出那些不具有塊三角形式的非厄米哈密頓量中實現ED的更一般條件。並將利用非厄米超材料或波晶體，通過實驗展示新現象和引人入勝的新系統。本項目的性質是由好奇心驅動、面向物理學新前沿的基礎研究。項目的成功將極大加深我們對ED的理解，為物理學研究開啟新的視野，並為新穎的應用鋪平道路。

12300926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300926.value: EB病毒（EBV）劫持mRNA降解過程，進而促進鼻咽癌（NPC）患者出現惡病質

12300926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12300926.value: Dr Cho, Chi Shing, William Prof Kwong, Lai Wan Dora

12300926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300926.value: BACKGROUND: Cancer cachexia is a debilitating syndrome characterized by severe weight loss, significantly impacting the quality of life and survival of patients with advanced cancer. In Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-associated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), cachexia is a critical but understudied issue, affecting over 60 % of advanced patients. Currently, no effective treatments exist. CURRENT PROBLEMS: The mechanisms driving cachexia in NPC remain unclear, and the association between cachexia and the ubiquitous EBV infection in these tumors has not been explored. This lack of understanding hampers the development of effective therapies for this currently untreatable condition. SUPPORTING DATA: Our preliminary data identified interleukin-6 (IL-6) as the most upregulated cytokine in EBV-positive NPC cells. Both IL-6 and IL-6 receptor neutralizing antibodies can effectively ameliorate cachectic conditions in animal models. Our findings establish a correlation between elevated IL-6 levels and cancer cachexia in both EBV-positive xenograft models and clinical NPC patient samples. We found that inhibiting the EBV latent protein EBNA1 reduced IL-6 production, reversed weight loss, and prevented the pathological "browning" of white adipose tissue (WAT) in mouse models. Mechanistically, EBNA1 stabilizes IL-6 mRNA by sequestering a host mRNA-degrading protein, hnRNP-D, in the nucleus. The EBV non-coding EBER1/2 RNA may also play a role in regulating IL-6 production and could be associated with the formation of the EBNA1-hnRNP-D complex. HYPOTHESIS: We hypothesize that the EBV latent protein, EBNA1, post-transcriptionally upregulate IL-6, inducing WAT browning and cachexia in NPC. OBJECTIVES: This project aims to: 1. Confirm IL-6 as the key cachectic cytokine in NPC. 2. Decipher the mechanism of EBNA1-mediated IL-6 mRNA stabilization via hnRNP-D. 3. Establish EBNA1's role in driving WAT browning and hnRNP-D's role in antagonizing this process. 4. Validate the IL-6-cachexia link in two cohorts of NPC patient samples. METHODOLOGY: We will use a combination of EBV-positive and -negative cell lines, established NPC xenograft mouse models, and clinical samples. Techniques will include cytokine profiling, molecular assays to study mRNA stability and protein interactions, and histological and biochemical analyses of adipose tissue and clinical samples. EXPECTED OUTCOMES: We anticipate defining a novel pathway in which EBNA1-driven IL-6 production promotes WAT browning and cachexia, with plans to clinically validate IL-6 as a biomarker for NPC-associated cachexia. 背景： 癌症惡病質是一種使人衰弱的綜合症，特徵為嚴重的體重下降，對晚期癌症患者的生活品質及存活率造成顯著影響。在EB病毒相關之鼻咽癌中，惡病質是一個關鍵但未被充分研究的問題，影響超過60%的晚期患者。目前尚無有效治療方法。 當前問題： 鼻咽癌中驅動惡病質的機制仍不明確，且惡病質與此類腫瘤中普遍存在的EB病毒感染之間的關聯尚未被探討。這種理解的缺乏阻礙了針對此一目前無法治療之病症的有效療法的開發。 支持數據： 我們的初步數據顯示，介白素-6（IL-6）是EB病毒陽性鼻咽癌細胞中上調最顯著的細胞因子。IL-6及IL-6受體中和抗體均可有效改善動物模型中的惡病質狀況。我們的研究結果在EB病毒陽性異種移植模型及臨床鼻咽癌患者樣本中，均確立了IL-6水平升高與癌症惡病質之間的相關性。我們發現，抑制EB病毒潛伏蛋白EBNA1可降低IL-6的生成、逆轉體重下降，並防止小鼠模型中白色脂肪組織的病理性「褐變」。在機制上，EBNA1通過將宿主mRNA降解蛋白hnRNP-D隔離於細胞核中，從而穩定IL-6 mRNA。EB病毒的非編碼EBER1/2 RNA亦可能在調控IL-6生成中扮演角色，並可能與EBNA1-hnRNP-D複合體的形成有關。 假說： 我們假設EB病毒潛伏蛋白EBNA1在轉錄後層面上調IL-6，誘導白色脂肪組織褐變及鼻咽癌中的惡病質。 目標： 本計畫旨在： 1. 確認IL-6為鼻咽癌中關鍵的惡病質細胞因子。 2. 闡明EBNA1經由hnRNP-D介導IL-6 mRNA穩定化的機制。 3. 確立EBNA1在驅動白色脂肪組織褐變中的角色，以及hnRNP-D在拮抗此過程中的作用。 4. 在兩個鼻咽癌患者樣本佇列中驗證IL-6與惡病質的關聯。 方法學： 我們將採用EB病毒陽性及陰性細胞株、已建立的鼻咽癌異種移植小鼠模型以及臨床樣本。技術方法包括細胞因子譜分析、研究mRNA穩定性的分子檢測以及蛋白質交互作用分析。 預期成果： 我們預期定義一條新穎的路徑，其中EBNA1驅動的IL-6生成促進白色脂肪組織褐變及惡病質，並計劃臨床驗證IL-6作為鼻咽癌相關惡病質的生物標記。

12301426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301426.value: 基於重構 Nyström 方法的大規模核學習快速計算

12301426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301426.value: With the exponential increase in data volume and computational power, **kernel learning** has become essential for modeling complex patterns across various domains. This paradigm's effectiveness arises from its exploitation of pairwise interactions and the elevation of data dimensionality. This same principle is central to the "attention mechanism," the core component of transformer architectures that power large-scale foundation models such as GPT-5 and Sora. However, leveraging these pairwise interactions among $n$ samples requires constructing an $n$-by-$n$ matrix, leading to at least quadratic space and time complexity. This computational bottleneck makes it crucial to develop fast computation methods for large-scale kernel learning to reduce costs and improve accessibility. Nyström methods help address this computational challenge by providing efficient low-rank approximation of these large matrices through subsampling. They exhibit remarkable efficiency and achieve minimax optimal error rates in certain kernel learning tasks. However, Nyström methods have primarily been developed for a traditional model, kernel ridge regression (KRR), and remain underexplored in other important scenarios. This project is dedicated to extending Nyström methods to broader applications, aiming for significant theoretical and practical advancements. - Task 1: **Weighted kernel learning.** We will generalize classical Nyström methods for scenarios where data samples have unequal importance or weights. Our goal is to develop subsampling strategies that account for these weights, leading to higher practical performance and sharper prediction error rates. - Task 2: **Quasi-Newton Optimization.** We will explore Nyström-based quasi-Newton updating for empirical risk minimization (ERM) on reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). Previous approaches face difficulties with error analysis due to broken positive semi-definiteness and lack of weight independence. By applying finer numerical analysis, we aim to overcome those challenges and achieve faster (quadratic) convergence rates. - Task 3: **Applied research---speculative sampling for large language models (LLMs).** We will adapt Nyström methods to "speculative sampling," a technique where a small language model drafts outputs to facilitate LLMs. The shallow depth of the small model allows for Nyström approximation, but this as well requires careful configuration and new theoretical guarantees. In collaboration with researchers from the Shanghai Innovation Institute and Microsoft, we will develop numerical implementations and deploy these methods in production environments, expanding the impact of our proposed algorithms. 隨著數據量與計算能力的指數級增長，**核學習**已成為在各個領域中對複雜模式進行建模的不可或缺的工具。該範式的有效性源於其對成對交互作用的利用以及對數據維度的提升。這一原理同樣是「注意力機制」的核心，而該機制正是驅動如 GPT-5 和 Sora 等大規模基礎模型的 Transformer 架構的核心組件。然而，要利用 n 個樣本之間的這些成對交互作用，需要構建一個 n×n 的矩陣，這會導致至少二次方的空間與時間複雜度。這一計算瓶頸使得為大規模核學習開發快速計算方法變得至關重要，以藉此降低成本並提高其可用性。 Nyström 方法透過子抽樣為這些大型矩陣提供高效的低秩近似，有助於應對這一計算挑戰。它們在某些核學習任務中展現出卓越的效率，並能達到最小最大最優誤差率。然而，目前 Nyström 方法主要針對傳統的核嶺迴歸模型進行開發，在其他重要場景中的研究仍顯不足。本項目致力於將 Nyström 方法擴展至更廣泛的應用領域，旨在取得重大的理論與實踐進展。 任務一：加權核學習。 我們將把經典的 Nyström 方法推廣至數據樣本具有不同重要性或權重的場景。我們的目標是開發能夠將這些權重納入考量的子抽樣策略，從而實現更高的實際效能與更精確的預測誤差率。 任務二：擬牛頓優化。 我們將探討在再生核希爾伯特空間上，基於 Nyström 的擬牛頓更新方法應用於經驗風險最小化的問題。以往的方法由於破壞了半正定性且缺乏權重獨立性，在誤差分析上面臨困難。透過應用更精細的數值分析，我們旨在克服這些挑戰，並實現更快的收斂速度。 任務三：應用研究——針對大型語言模型的投機採樣。 我們將把 Nyström 方法應用於「投機採樣」技術中，該技術透過小型語言模型起草輸出，以輔助大型語言模型的生成。小型模型的較淺深度允許使用 Nyström 近似，但這同樣需要仔細的配置與新的理論保證。我們將與上海創智學院及微軟的研究人員合作，開發數值實現，並將這些方法部署於生產環境中，從而擴大我們所提出的算法的影響力。

12301526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301526.value: 無網格正則性檢測及其應用

12301526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301526.value: In many fields of science, engineering, and data-driven modeling, we face the challenge of reconstructing or predicting a function from scattered measurements. These functions can be smooth in some regions but may also have sharp changes, abrupt transitions, or irregular features in others. Our goal goes beyond standard edge detection and seeks to determine, solely from data, whether the underlying function is continuously differentiable up to order k≥0 (that is, C^k regular) at a given location, but fails to be differentiable at order k+1. In the first phase of the project, we design robust algorithms for such pointwise regularity detection in the noise-free setting. While many established approaches, such as those related to WENO, require structured grid data, recent samplet methods extend to scattered data by constructing polynomial-based bases with vanishing moments. This enables regularity detection via basis coefficients. In this project, we focus on developing additional alternatives within the meshfree kernel-based framework. Our approach adaptively combines two strategies: kernel ladder techniques, which assess smoothness by varying the kernel order on a fixed dataset, and nested fill approaches, which analyze a sequence of increasingly dense data subsets. The kernel ladder is suitable for general scattered data, while the nested fill method is most effective when denser nested samples are available. On the practical side, we use the detected regularity information to guide meshfree interpolation and surrogate modeling. We allow kernel parameters such as smoothness and anisotropy to vary across the domain according to detected regularity. This spatial adaptivity is rarely used in the kernel approximation community, although it is familiar in Gaussian process literature. In the next phase, we further extend our methods to handle moderate observational noise in real-world data. Theoretical connections between deterministic regularized kernel interpolation and stochastic Gaussian process regression allow us to incorporate kernel-based regularization into regularity detection. This approach allows us to assign a statistical confidence to the detection of C^k but not C^{k+1} regularity at each location based on the observed data. Finally, we address streaming or sequential data scenarios by developing memory-efficient algorithms that update regularity estimates in real time and preserve a compact summary of regions with low regularity for use by downstream models. 在科學、工程及數據驅動建模的許多領域中，我們面對從分散量測資料中重建或預測函數的挑戰。這些函數在某些區域可以是光滑的，但在其他區域也可能具有尖銳變化、突變轉換或不規則特徵。我們的目標超越標準邊緣檢測，並尋求僅從數據判斷在給定位置上，底層函數是否連續可微至 $k\geq0$ 階（即具有 $C^k$ 正則性），但在 $k+1$ 階不可微。 在項目的第一階段，我們將在無噪聲設定下設計穩健的逐點正則性檢測演算法。雖然許多既有方法，例如與 WENO 相關的方法，需要結構化網格資料，近期的 samplet 方法則透過構造具有消失矩的多項式基底，將方法延伸至分散資料。這使得可透過基底係數進行正則性檢測。在本項目中，我們集中於在無網格核方法框架下發展其他替代方法。我們的方法將自適應地結合兩種策略：光滑度階梯技術，即在固定資料集上改變核函數階數以評估光滑性；以及嵌套填充方法，即分析一系列愈來愈密集的資料子集。光滑度階梯適用於一般分散資料，而嵌套填充方法在可取得較密集的嵌套樣本時最為有效。 在實踐方面，我們將利用所檢測到的正則性資訊來指導無網格插值與代理建模。我們允許核參數，例如光滑度和各向異性，根據所檢測到的正則性在整個區域中變化。這種空間自適應在核近似領域中很少被使用，儘管它在高斯過程文獻中較為熟悉。 在下一階段，我們將進一步把方法延伸至處理真實世界資料中的中等觀測噪聲。確定性正則化核插值與隨機高斯過程迴歸之間的理論聯繫，使我們能夠將基於核的正則化納入正則性檢測。此方法使我們能夠根據觀測資料，為每一位置上$C^k$ 但非 $C^{k+1}$ 正則性的檢測賦予統計信心。最後，我們將處理串流或序列資料情境，發展記憶體高效演算法，以即時更新正則性估計，並保留低正則性區域的精簡摘要，供下游模型使用。

12301926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301926.value: 基於同位素約束的粵港澳大灣區碳質氣溶膠來源及其輻射效應模擬

12301926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12301926.value: Prof Gao, Meng Prof ZHANG, Yanlin

12301926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301926.value: Carbonaceous aerosols (CAs) are major contributors to air pollution, degrading visibility, perturbing atmospheric chemistry and dynamics, and elevating health risks. Through radiative-dynamical feedback, absorbative CAs (black carbon and brown carbon, BC/BrC) shift monsoonal precipitation, strengthen aerosol-boundary layer feedback that exacerbates extreme haze, and modulate ozone by suppressing photolysis rates and inhibiting precursor mixing. In the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), intense anthropogenic emissions and episodic open burning, interacting with a humid subtropical monsoon climate, govern BC/BrC aging, mixing, and removal, influencing radiative forcing, cloud properties, heat stress, hydrometeorology and ozone pollution. Given GBA’s severe ozone episodes and sensitivity to monsoonal variability, isolating and quantifying BC/BrC effects is a priority for air quality management and climate risk mitigation. Robust assessment of BC/BrC impacts requires integrated climate-chemistry modeling and reliable source apportionment, but current estimates remain uncertain due to large discrepancies across existing emission inventories and inadequate representation of BC/BrC optical properties in the model. Isotope-constrained retrieval has already improved observation-based quantification of BC/BrC emissions and offers a practical path to sharpen source attribution and radiative forcing estimates in the GBA. In this project, we will integrate carbon isotope constraints and develop a source-resolved modeling framework to quantify BC/BrC sources, radiative effects, and climate-air quality feedback in the GBA. We will construct a high-resolution BC/BrC emission inventory constrained by Δ14C and δ13C observations via Bayesian inversion to partition emissions among fossil fuel, biofuel, and biomass burning. The modeling system will employ a modified WRF-Chem with explicit source tagging for BC/BrC, wavelength-dependent optical properties, and an oxidant-driven aging scheme that captures BrC browning/bleaching and coating-enhanced BC absorption. Secondary organic aerosol absorption will be represented using precursor-specific tracers with differentiated complex refractive indices to more realistically treat secondary BrC optics. Based on the isotope-constrained model, targeted sensitivity experiments will quantify source contributions to total aerosol burdens and radiative effects and diagnose how BC/BrC alter regional weather and air quality in the GBA. The results will strengthen forecasting and early-warning capability for pollution and monsoon-related events, supporting emergency response and climate adaptation planning. 碳質氣溶膠（CAs）是空氣污染的主要貢獻者，可降低能見度、擾動大氣化學與動力過程，並提高健康風險。透過輻射-動力學回饋，具有吸收性的碳質氣溶膠（黑碳與褐碳，BC/BrC）會改變季風降水模式，加劇極端霾的氣溶膠-邊界層反饋，並透過抑制光解速率和阻礙前體物混合來調節臭氧。在粵港澳大灣區（GBA），強烈的人為排放與階段性的露天焚燒在濕潤的亞熱帶季風氣候背景下相互作用，主導BC/BrC的老化、混合與清除過程，進而影響輻射強迫、雲特性、熱脅迫、水文氣像以及臭氧污染。鑑於GBA嚴重的臭氧污染事件及其對季風變異的敏感性，甄別並量化BC/BrC的影響是空氣質量管理與氣候風險緩解的優先任務。 對BC/BrC影響進行穩健評估需要綜合的氣候-化學模式與可靠的源解析，但由於現有排放清單之間差異巨大以及對BC/BrC光學性質表徵不足，當前結果仍存在較大的不確定性。基於同位素約束的反演方法可以改進BC/BrC排放量化，並為提高GBA中源歸屬與輻射強迫估計的精度提供了可行路徑。本研究將整合碳同位素觀測，開發源分辨建模框架，以量化GBA中BC/BrC的來源、輻射效應及氣候-污染反饋。我們將透過貝葉斯反演，利用Δ14C與δ13C觀測約束，建構高解析度的BC/BrC排放清單，將排放分為化石燃料、生物燃料與生物質燃燒。模擬將採用經改進的WRF‑Chem，對BC/BrC實施明確來源標記，引入波長依賴的光學性質，並採用由氧化劑驅動的老化方案，以刻畫BrC的褐化/漂白以及包覆增強的BC吸收。對於二次有機氣溶膠的吸收，將使用針對不同前體物的示蹤物並賦予差異化的複折射率，從而更真實地處理一次與二次BC/BrC的光學特性。基於同位素約束模型，我們將進行有針對性的敏感性試驗，量化不同來源對總氣溶膠濃度與輻射效應的貢獻，並診斷BC/BrC如何改變GBA的區域天氣與空氣質量。研究結果將強化污染與季風相關事件的預測與預警能力，並支持緊急應變與氣候調適規劃。

12302326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302326.value: 亞甲基環丙烷的不對稱骨架重排構建手性有機膦化合物

12302326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302326.value: Skeletal rearrangement offers a precise and elegant route to molecular reconstruction, enabling the controlled cleavage and reassembly of atomic connectivity to deliver new architectures. Transition metal catalyzed asymmetric skeletal rearrangements, in particular, provide efficient and practical access to high value chiral molecules, including pharmaceutical intermediates, ligands, and catalysts, with broad relevance to pharmaceutical research and organic synthesis. Functional chiral organophosphorus compounds are central to biomedicine, asymmetric catalysis, and materials chemistry. Chiral aminophosphines frequently appear in therapeutic agents and serve as privileged ligands or small molecule catalysts. Incorporation of silyl groups into chiral phosphine frameworks allows fine tuning of electronic and steric properties, while boryl groups enable versatile late stage diversification. Moreover, chiral bidentate phosphines are among the most effective ligand classes in enantioselective catalysis. Despite this importance, direct and efficient methods to construct their core skeletons remain underdeveloped, limiting broader application. This project aims to establish a modular platform for the asymmetric skeletal rearrangement of methylenecyclopropanes (MCPs) to access diverse, functional chiral organophosphorus structures. We will develop transition metal catalyzed enantioselective skeletal rearrangements that install phosphorus functionality with high efficiency, while enabling the strategic incorporation of silyl and boryl groups as tunable and derivatizable handles. The research will focus on catalyst and ligand design, scope expansion across varied MCPs and phosphorus reagents, and optimization for scalability and functional group tolerance. Complementary mechanistic studies and and DFT calculation will elucidate stereocontrol and pathway selectivity, guiding further innovation. The anticipated outcomes include streamlined syntheses of chiral aminophosphines, silyl and boryl substituted phosphines, and bidentate phosphine ligands, collectively enriching the structural diversity of chiral organophosphorus libraries. The resulting compounds and methods will deliver academic and industrial value by accelerating the discovery and application of functional chiral phosphines in medicinal chemistry, asymmetric catalysis, and fine chemical synthesis. 骨架重排為分子重建提供了一條精準而優雅的途徑，能夠實現對原子連接性的可控斷裂與重組，從而構建全新的分子結構。特別是過渡金屬催化的不對稱骨架重排為獲得高價值手性分子（包括藥物中間體、配體和催化劑）提供了高效實用的方法，在藥物研究與有機合成領域展現出巨大潛力。 功能性手性有機膦化合物在生物醫學、不對稱催化和材料化學中佔據核心地位。手性氨基膦類化合物常見於治療劑中，並可作為優勢配體或小分子催化劑。在手性膦骨架中引入矽基基團能夠精細調節其電子效應和立體效應，而硼基基團則為手性有機磷化合物的後期多樣化修飾提供了靈活策略。此外，手性雙齒膦是對映選擇性催化中最有效的配體類別之一。儘管如此，直接高效構建其核心骨架的方法仍然匱乏，這極大限制了其更廣泛的應用。 本項目旨在建立一個基於亞甲基環丙烷（MCPs）不對稱骨架重排的模組化平臺，以獲取多樣化的功能性手性有機膦化合物。我們將開發過渡金屬催化的高立體選擇性骨架重排反應，高效引入膦官能基的同時，策略性地整合矽基和硼基作為可調控與可衍生化的"把手"。研究將聚焦於催化劑與配體設計，拓展不同MCPs與膦試劑的適用範圍，以及優化反應的規模化潛力與官能基相容性。此外，DFT計算和反應機理研究將闡明立體控制的來源與反應路徑的選擇性，從而指導進一步的反應預測與創新。 預期成果包括建立手性氨基膦、矽/硼取代膦及雙齒膦配體的簡化合成路線，共同構建結構多樣性的手性有機膦化合物。由此產生的新化合物與新方法將加速功能性手性膦在藥物化學、不對稱催化與精細化學品合成中的發現與應用，從而創造顯著的學術與工業價值。

12302826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302826.value: 非对映/对映选择性哈霍斯－帕里什－埃德爾－紹爾－維希爾特反应及其合成应用

12302826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302826.value: Natural products have long served as springboards for drug development because their distinctive molecular architecture often translate into potent and selective biological activity. Over the past three decades, roughly one‑third of new medicines approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)—including artemisinin, paclitaxel (Taxol), doxorubicin, dactinomycin, and morphine—are natural products, their structural analogues, or scaffolds inspired by them (Newman et al., J. Nat. Prod. 2020, 83, 770). The field of natural product synthesis is central to lead optimization—the phase of drug discovery focused on optimizing potency and selectivity, improving of absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) properties and metabolic stability, reducing off-target toxicity, and overcoming resistance (e.g., vancomycin redesigns that restore activity against resistant Gram-positive bacteria). Versatile and efficient synthetic strategies have enabled chemists to access natural products and their structural analogues for the structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies as well as the natural product-based molecular probes for identification of their cellular target. Our group has a long‑standing interest in developing efficient and versatile synthetic methods for the synthesis of bioactive natural products and their structural analogues to support lead optimization. Recently, we achieved an asymmetric synthesis of leptosphin C via a diastereo‑/enantioselective Hajo-Parrish-Eder-Sauer-Wiechert (HPESW) reaction (Sun et al., Org. Lett. 2025, 27, 9814-9819). In this proposal, we aim to advance the diastereo‑/enantioselective HPESW reaction into a general synthetic method for asymmetric syntheses of natural products bearing 5,6‑bicyclic ring systems with contiguous stereogenic centres, including waihoensene (1), dysiherbol A (2), and isoneoamphilectane (3). Preliminary studies show that the HPESW reaction exhibits good functional‑group tolerance, high diastereo‑ and enantioselectivity, and enables the preparation of key building blocks for the syntheses of waihoensene (1) and dysiherbol A (2). Ongoing efforts focus on expanding the substrate scope, optimizing stereoselectivities guided by mechanistic insights, and completing the syntheses of the target natural products to enable biological studies. 天然产物长期以来一直作为药物开发的跳板，因为其独特的分子架构常常转化为强效且高度选择性的生物活性。过去三十年中，美国食品药品监督管理局批准的新药中约有三分之一 —包括青蒿素、紫杉醇、阿霉素、放线菌素D以及吗啡— 是天然产物、其结构类似物，或受其启发的骨架（纽曼等，《天然产物杂志》2020年第83卷第770-803页）。天然产物合成领域在先导化合物优化的过程中居于核心地位 —这一药物发现阶段侧重于优化效力和选择性、改善吸收、分布、代谢与排泄特性与代谢稳定性、降低脱靶毒性，以及克服耐药性（例如，经重新设计的万古霉素可恢复对耐药的革兰氏阳性菌的活性）。多样且高效的合成策略使化学家能够获得天然产物及其结构类似物用于构效关系研究，以及基于天然产物的分子探针以鉴定其细胞靶点。 我们课题组长期致力于发展高效、通用的合成方法，用于生物活性天然产物及其结构类似物的合成，以支持先导化合物的优化。最近，我们通过一种具非对映/对映选择性的哈霍斯－帕里什－埃德爾－紹爾－維希爾特反应反应实现了小球菌素C 的不对称合成（孫等，《有机化学通讯》2025年第 27卷第 9814‑9819页）。在本项目中，我们旨在将该非对映/对映选择性的 对映选择性的哈霍斯－帕里什－埃德爾－紹爾－維希爾特反应发展为一种通用方法，用于含有5/6并环体系且具有连续手性中心的天然产物的不对称合成，包括怀霍烯（1）、地塞草酮 A（2）和 异奥农酰胺烷（3）。初步研究表明，该对映选择性的哈霍斯－帕里什－埃德爾－紹爾－維希爾特反应对官能团具有良好兼容性，表现出较高的非对映选择性和对映选择性，并可提供用于合成怀霍烯（1）和地塞草酮 A（2）的关键构建单元。当前工作重点在于拓展底物范围，结合机理洞见优化立体选择性，并完成目标天然产物的合成，以支撑后续的生物学研究。

12302926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302926.value: 深度神經算子的理論基礎：標度律、數據結構與分布式學習

12302926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302926.value: Operator learning, which uses deep neural operators to approximate mappings between function spaces, is a transformative area of scientific machine learning. Its real-world impact is evidenced by successful deployment in large-scale applications like geoscience, physics, and biological applications, making it one of the few tools to transition from research to practice. Architectures such as DeepONet and Fourier Neural Operators have demonstrated remarkable empirical success. In many applications, neural scaling laws are widely observed for operator learning, where errors power-law decay with model and data size. However, the theoretical understanding of these models remains preliminary. A fundamental challenge is the curse of dimensionality inherent in infinite-dimensional operators, which precludes the derivation of power scaling laws for general operators. This creates a gap between the scaling laws observed empirically and theories. While a limited number of works have begun to address the explicit relation between errors and network size and sample complexity, they do not fully incorporate the roles of data smoothness and intrinsic low-dimensionality. A promising pathway to overcome this difficulty is to exploit the low-dimensional structures that are observed in many real-world datasets. A comprehensive theory that formally connects these geometric data structures to the emergent scaling laws and provides a unified explanation is still in its early stages. This proposal aims to bridge this gap by establishing a novel theoretical foundation for deep neural operators. We will develop a new error analysis that strategically exploits both the high-order smoothness of input-output functions and the intrinsic low-dimensional structures of scientific datasets to achieve faster convergence rates. Our research contains three integrated components. First, we will derive new neural scaling laws by utilizing spectral approximations to leverage data smoothness. Second, we will improve these scaling laws by incorporating both linear and nonlinear low-dimensional structures, effectively circumventing the curse of dimensionality. Finally, we will extend our theory to provide rigorous analysis of distributed learning frameworks for multiple operators, a capability that is inherent to this paradigm. Our work will establish theoretical foundations for operator learning. By rigorously demonstrating how data smoothness and data structures impact performance, this project will derive upper bounds for approximation and generalization error, thereby partially explain the success of deep neural operators and neural scaling laws. This approach elucidates a deep connection between neural network architecture and data structures, yielding a rigorous framework to guide the development of more efficient, reliable, and interpretable scientific machine learning models. 算子學習利用深度神經算子來逼近函數空間之間的映射，是科學機器學習中的一個變革性領域。其在現實世界中的影響力，已通過在地球科學、物理學和生物學等大規模應用中的成功部署得到證明，使其成為少數能夠從研究走向實踐的工具之一。DeepONet 和傅裡葉神經算子（Fourier Neural Operators）等架構已展現出顯著的實證成功。在許多應用中，算子學習普遍觀察到神經標度律現象，即誤差隨模型規模和數據規模呈冪律衰減。然而，對這些模型的理論理解仍處於初步階段。一個根本性的挑戰在於無窮維算子固有的維度災難問題，這使得難以為一般算子推導出冪律標度律。這就在實際應用中觀察到的標度律與理論之間形成了一道鴻溝。儘管已有少量研究工作開始探討誤差與網絡規模、樣本複雜度之間的顯式關係，但它們並未充分納入數據光滑度與內在低維性所起的作用。克服這一困難的一條有前景的途徑，是利用許多現實世界數據集中所觀察到的低維結構。然而，一套能夠將這些幾何數據結構與觀察到的標度律正式聯繫起來、並提供統一解釋的綜合理論，目前仍處於早期階段。本項目旨在通過為深度神經算子建立新穎的理論基礎來彌合這一差距。我們將開展一項新的誤差分析，策略性地同時利用輸入-輸出函數的高階光滑度以及科學數據集的內在低維結構，以實現更快的收斂速率。我們的研究包含三個相互整合的部分。第一，我們將利用譜逼近方法來挖掘數據光滑度，從而推導出新的神經標度律。第二，我們將通過納入線性和非線性低維結構來改進這些標度律，從而有效規避維度災難。第三，我們將拓展該理論，為多算子的分布式學習框架提供嚴格的分析。這是該學習範式所固有的一種特徵。我們的工作將為算子學習建立理論基礎。通過嚴格論證數據光滑度和數據結構如何影響性能，本項目將推導出逼近誤差與泛化誤差的上界，從而部分解釋深度神經算子及神經標度律成功的原因。這一方法揭示了神經網絡架構與數據結構之間的深層聯繫，形成了一個嚴謹的框架，用以指導開發更高效、更可靠、更具可解釋性的科學機器學習模型。

12303126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303126.value: 奇異點流形：設計、拓撲性質與實驗表徵

12303126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303126.value: Many physics laws appearing in textbooks describe the dynamics of closed systems. Such closed systems are generically Hermitian, with dynamics obeying energy conservation, allowing steady states to be reached. For example, a moving car follows the law of Newtonian mechanics when treated as an isolated object. But in reality, the car must constantly gain kinetic energy from internal combustion and lose it to heat through friction. When such an exchange of energy is also considered, the system becomes an open system. An important recent development in physics concerns controllable open systems, giving rise to a new field called non‐Hermitian physics. One intriguing feature of non‐Hermitian systems is exceptional points (EPs), which are branch singularities in the system’s spectrum. EPs underpin topological properties exclusively found in non-Hermitian systems. The system’s behaviors near an EP also make it useful for many applications. Interestingly, under the right conditions, EPs are not just isolated points in the spectrum, they can form continuous geometric structures. Existing examples include EP lines, rings, and surfaces. These EP structures are topological manifolds, so we coin them EP manifolds (EPMs). Nevertheless, the properties of EPMs so far remain uncharted. Here, we present a comprehensive plan to theoretically and experimentally investigate EPM topology. Theoretically, we first propose an effective method for realizing regularly shaped EPM, then we outline the approaches to characterize various aspects of the topological properties of EPMs, including the study of eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and Jordan vectors. We will detail the necessary steps to take to extend the definition of topological invariants, such as eigenvalue winding number and Berry phase, for characterizing EPMs. In particular, Jordan vectors, which exclusively exist when a system is precisely on the EPM, on which the Hamiltonian is defective, give rise to an opportunity for defining novel topological properties uniquely defined on EPMs. Experimentally, we aim to characterize the EPM topology, including which emerges through Jordan vectors, using an acoustic cavity system. Simple examples are presented in the proposal to explain the theoretical framework and illustrate our ideas, but different models will be explored for novel EPM topology in the projects. We expect the outcomes to deepen our understanding of EPs and open new horizons for non-Hermitian topology. The principles uncovered may lead to novel applications of EPs across a wider array of physical systems, such as electronics, photonics, and acoustics.

12303626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303626.value: 基於多模態資料的建模與推論

12303626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303626.value: With the development of data-acquisition technologies, multimodal data commonly arise from various fields of study. One example is the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey dataset which provides extensive demographic and health information and laboratory test results for participants of all ages, including C-reactive protein (CRP) levels and physical activity (PA) trajectories. CRP is an acute-phase reactant produced by the liver in response to inflammation and is used as a biomarker to monitor disease progression and evaluate its therapeutic effects. Regular PA improves our cognitive function and lowers the risk of depression and many non-communicable diseases, including diabetes. Another example is the WU-Minn Young Adult Human Connectome Project which collected data in different brain imaging modalities including resting-state fMRI, diffusion MRI and structural MRI, along with demographics and performance measures on several cognitive tasks. To address the need to model and make inference based on multimodal data, we will study a general partially linear model for a scalar response coupled with a Euclidean covariate vector and a nonparametric covariate taking values on an unknown manifold embedded in a Hilbert space. The manifold geometry is estimated through spectral decomposition of local covariance operators. Using this structure, we construct estimators for the linear and nonparametric components that achieve the optimal rates in the oracle setting where the manifold is known. To deal with the non-negligible bias incurred in the nonparametric estimation, we introduce bias-reduced estimators that achieve a faster convergence rate. We further develop inference methods for both components: central limit theorem based tests for the linear part and a novel uniform test for the nonparametric part using the bias-reduced estimator. For the latter, we will study Gaussian approximation to the asymptotic distribution of the supremum error and use bootstrap to compute critical values. In addition, we propose a practically implementable test to make inference for the nonparametric component using in-sample points. Extensive simulation studies and applications to the motivating examples will be conducted to demonstrate the finite sample performance and efficacy of the proposed estimation and inference methods. 隨著資料採集技術的發展，多模態資料在各個研究領域中日益普遍。例如，美國國家健康與營養調查（NHANES）數據集提供了涵蓋所有年齡層參與者的大量人口統計和健康資訊以及實驗室檢測結果，包括C反應蛋白（CRP）水平和身體活動（PA）軌跡。C反應蛋白是一種由肝臟在發炎反應中產生的急性期反應物，被用作生物標記來監測疾病進展並評估其治療效果。規律的身體活動可以改善認知功能，降低憂鬱症和多種非傳染性疾病（包括糖尿病）的風險。另一個例子是WU-Minn青年成人人類連結組計劃，該計劃收集了不同腦部造影模式的數據，包括靜息態功能性磁振造影（fMRI）、擴散磁振造影（dMRI）和結構性磁振造影（sMRI），以及人口統計資訊和多項認知任務的表現指標。為了滿足基於多模態資料進行建模和推斷的需求，我們將研究一個一般的標量響應部分線性模型，該模型耦合一個歐氏協變量向量和一個取值於嵌入希爾伯特空間的未知流形上的非參數協變量。流形幾何結構透過局部協方差算子的譜分解進行估計。利用這個結構，我們建構了線性分量和非參數分量的估計量，這些估計量能夠達到在流形已知的理想情況下的最優收斂速度。為了處理非參數估計中不可忽略的偏差，我們引入了偏差修正估計量，以實現更快的收斂速度。我們進一步發展了線性和非參數兩個分量的推論方法：線性分量的推論方法是基於中心極限定理，非參數分量的推論方法則採用了一種基於偏差修正估計量的新型均勻檢定。對於後者，我們將研究最大誤差漸近分佈的高斯近似，並使用自助法計算臨界值。此外，我們提出了一種實際可行的檢定方法，利用樣本內資料對非參數分量進行推論。我們將進行大量的模擬研究，並將結果應用於實例，以驗證所提出的估計和推論方法在有限樣本下的性能和有效性。

12303826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303826.value: 針對非正態分布的穩健元分析：異常值識別、中心化功率變換及半參數方法

12303826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303826.value: Meta-analysis is a powerful statistical method that combines findings from multiple independent studies to produce more precise and reliable evidence. It is widely used in medicine and many other scientific fields. A common approach, known as the random-effects model, assumes that true differences between studies follow a normal distribution. However, growing evidence indicates that this assumption often does not hold, as effect sizes frequently exhibit skewed or irregular patterns. Such deviations can lead to inaccurate estimates, erroneous assessments of variability, and misleading conclusions. This issue is particularly pronounced in meta-analyses with only a few studies, where traditional methods tend to be less reliable. This project tackles the challenges outlined above by developing robust and reliable methods tailored to real-world meta-analysis data. The project first focuses on detecting outlying studies that can have an outsized impact on results. Existing outlier detection methods often prove inadequate when the number of studies is small or when the data deviate from typical patterns. By creating statistical tools that address the unique features of meta-analysis data, such as variations in study size and precision, this work seeks to better identify and handle unusual studies, thereby increasing the reliability of conclusions. Next, the project introduces a novel centralized power transformation enabling distinct adjustments above and below the median. Unlike traditional transformations, this approach preserves essential statistical properties and inherently accommodates zero and negative values, leading to more accurate estimates of overall effects and variability. Finally, recognizing that real data often do not fit simple assumptions, the project proposes a flexible semiparametric random-effects modeling approach that does not require specifying the exact shape of effect size variation. Instead, it assumes only basic conditions, such as a fixed average effect and spread. This allows for more robust analysis even when the data are limited or contain extreme values. All methods will be made available in easy-to-use, open-source software to help researchers worldwide apply these improvements. By tackling key limitations—including non-normal data, small sample sizes, and outliers—this project aims to enhance the robustness, clarity, and usefulness of meta-analytic evidence across many fields. 元分析是一種強而有力的統計方法，能將多項獨立研究的結果加以整合，產生更精確且可靠的證據，廣泛應用於醫學及其他多個科學領域。常用的方法之一是隨機效應模型，其假設研究間的真實效應差異服從正態分布。然而，越來越多證據顯示此一假設常常不成立，因為效應值往往呈現偏態或不規則的分布。此類偏離會導致估計結果不準確、變異性評估錯誤，甚至產生誤導性結論。在元分析中，研究數量較少時，傳統方法更容易失效，問題尤為嚴重。 本項目針對上述挑戰，研發適用於真實元分析資料的穩健可靠方法。首要任務是檢測異常值（離群研究），因其可能對分析結果造成過度影響。現行異常值偵測方法在研究數量有限或資料偏離典型分布時常不夠理想。透過設計兼顧研究規模及精度差異的統計工具，期望更準確識別與處理異常研究，提高結論的穩健性。其次，創新提出一種中心化冪次變換（centralized power transformation），允許中位數上下分別使用不同的冪次以調整資料偏態。此方法保留統計性質的核心結構，自然涵蓋零值及負值，因而能更精確估計整體效應與變異性。 最後，鑑於真實資料往往難以符合簡單的分布假設，項目提出一套靈活的半參數隨機效應模型，此模型不需明確指定效應變異的分布形態，只假設隨機效應分布平均值為零且具固定變異。該方法即使在樣本量有限或存在極端值時，依然能提供穩健且有效的分析。所有相關方法將整合開源軟體並公開發佈，方便全球研究人員使用。透過克服非正態、異常值及小樣本量等關鍵限制，本項目將大幅提升元分析證據的穩健性、解釋力與實用性，廣泛促進各領域的循證實務發展。

12303926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303926.value: 基於監督式主成分與因子分析器有限混合模型進行高維異質性數據分析建模

12303926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12303926.value: Prof Feng, zhenghui Prof Xie, Chuanlong

12303926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303926.value: Large, high-dimensional datasets have been collected across various scientific fields. Finite mixture models of principal components and factor analyzers are essential tools for investigating the heterogeneity contained in the data. Those models not only provide a reasonable interpretation of the data but also suggest stable or robust prediction approaches based on it. The primary objective of this project is to investigate the statistical properties, particularly the predictive properties, of those finite mixture models for high- or ultra-high-dimensional data. In high- or ultra-high-dimensional regression models, the predictor dimension can be much larger than the sample size, and neither PCA regression nor factor regression produces satisfactory results. One essential reason is that most redundant predictors are unassociated with the response variable; therefore, the principal components or latent factors underlying the predictors may also be unassociated with it. Firstly, we investigate different screening methods and select an appropriate one to reduce the dimension of the predictors and identify predictors with significant associations with the response variables. Then, based on those chosen predictors, we construct a finite mixture of a PCA or a factor analyzer to fit the response variable. The finite mixture model is too flexible when the number of mixture components is unknown. Based on regularization methods, variational approximation, and the EM algorithm, we propose techniques to simultaneously determine the number of mixture components and the number of principal components or factor analyzers. We investigate the consistency of these proposed methods and the predictive properties of the final model. When applying the finite mixture approach to model high-dimensional, heterogeneous data, it can lead to several statistical problems that require a deeper understanding. The finite mixture model is not identifiable when the number of components is unknown. Therefore, the statistical efficiency of finite mixture model estimation is significantly lower. For high-dimensional data, we investigate the statistical efficiency of model estimation when it can be improved by integrating partially identifiable model information. When the model is misspecified, we investigate its bias and estimated variance and seek a strategy that balances them, thereby ensuring the accuracy of its predictions. Even by the screening method, the model would still be overparameterized. By investigating properties of efficiency in model estimation and prediction, we aim to gain insight into the phenomenon of overparametrization. 各個科學領域都已經蒐集到大量、高維度的數據。主成分有限混合模型與因子分析器，是用來研究數據內部異質性很重要的工具。這類模型除了可以合理解讀數據之外，也能以此為基礎，提出穩定、抗干擾的預測方法。本研究最主要的目標，就是研究這幾套有限混合模型，在高維甚至超高維數據底下的統計特性，尤其是預測方面的表現。 在高維或超高維的迴歸模型當中，解釋變數的維度遠遠可以超過樣本數量，不管是主成分迴歸或是因子迴歸，跑出來的結果都不會太理想。其中一個關鍵原因是：大部分多餘的解釋變數，其實跟反應變數沒有關係；所以解釋變數背後的主成分或是隱藏因子，也有可能跟反應變數毫無關聯。我們首先會研究各種變數篩選方法，挑出合適的做法，降低解釋變數的維度，找出和反應變數有顯著關聯的解釋變數。接著再拿這些篩選出來的變數，建構主成分或是因子分析器的有限混合模型，去擬合反應變數。 當混合成分的數量未知時，有限混合模型彈性會過高。我們會結合正則化方法、變分近似以及 EM 演算法，提出一套可以同時決定混合成分數量、以及主成分／因子分析器數量的演算方法。接下來會驗證我們提出的這些方法是否具備一致性，也會探討最終模型的預測能力。 把有限混合的方法拿來處理高維、存在異質性的數據時，會衍生不少統計上的難題，需要更深入去探究。如果成分數未知，有限混合模型會出現無法識別的問題，導致模型估計的統計效率大幅下降。針對高維數據，我們會研究：透過納入部分可識別的模型資訊，能不能提升模型估計的統計效率。當模型設定錯誤時，我們會分析模型的偏誤與估計變異數，找出可以兩者權衡的策略，藉此確保預測結果的準確度。就算已經做過變數篩選，模型依舊會有參數過多的問題。透過研究模型估計與預測的效率特性，我們希望可以進一步搞懂參數過度膨脹這個現象。

12304126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304126.value: 生物分子凝聚體電化學性質的分子機制研究

12304126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304126.value: Biomolecular condensates are dynamic, membraneless compartments that play crucial roles in regulating a wide range of cellular processes. Many biomolecular condensates are formed by phase separation of intrinsically disordered proteins or regions (IDPs). The dysregulation of condensates is increasingly linked to severe human diseases, including neurodegeneration and cancers. Recent studies reveal that condensates are not merely passive storage hubs but are electrochemically active entities. These electrochemical properties include the establishment of an electric potential difference between the dense and the dilute phases (“interphase potential”) and selectively sorting ions to the condensates from the cellular environment. These properties can regulate the cellular electrochemical environment: the interphase potential can drive or catalyze chemical reactions, while ion partitioning modulates cytoplasmic ion distribution and pH. However, the study of condensate electrochemistry is still in its early stages, leaving key foundational questions open for exploration. A critical knowledge gap persists: the molecular principles linking protein sequence to electrochemical behavior, and the molecular mechanisms by which the cellular environment influences these properties, remain elusive. Bridging this gap is essential for advancing from a descriptive to a predictive understanding of condensate function and dysfunction, which is necessary for developing targeted therapeutic strategies. Because IDPs lack stable folded structures, their emergent properties are a direct output of their primary sequence, making them the ideal system to establish these foundational rules. Accordingly, we will focus on the biomolecular condensates formed by IDPs to decipher this sequence-to-function relationship. This proposal aims to address these challenges through a tightly integrated computational and experimental approach that combines multiscale simulations with direct experimental measurements. We will pursue three key objectives: (1) To derive the general physical principles that give rise to electrochemical activity; (2) To establish the “molecular grammar” that connects a natural IDP’s primary sequence to the emergent electrochemical properties of the formed condensates; (3) To elucidate how different ions modulate these properties. By combining multiscale simulations with direct experimental measurements, this proposal will uncover the sequence-to-function relationship underlying the electrochemical behavior of biomolecular condensates formed by disordered proteins. By transforming our understanding of condensates into active and tunable electrochemical entities, the proposed work will fundamentally reshape how we view cellular organization. Ultimately, it will establish a foundation for a novel therapeutic paradigm: targeting the electrochemical state of pathological condensates to correct disease-related dysfunction, opening new avenues for drug discovery and treatment strategies. 生物分子凝聚體是一類動態的無膜區室，在調控多種細胞活動中發揮著至關重要的作用。許多生物分子凝聚體由無序蛋白質或無序區域通過相分離形成。越來越多的研究表明，凝聚體失調與嚴重的人類疾病密切相關，包括神經退行性疾病和癌症。近期研究顯示，凝聚體並非僅僅是被動的儲存場所，而是具有電化學活性的實體。這些電化學性質包括在濃相與稀相之間建立電勢差（相間電勢差），以及選擇性地將細胞環境中的離子富集至凝聚體內。這些性質能夠調控細胞的電化學環境：相間電勢差可以驅動或催化化學反應，而離子分配則可調節細胞質中的離子分佈和pH值。然而，凝聚體電化學研究仍處於起步階段，許多關鍵的基礎性問題尚待探索。 蛋白質序列與電化學行為之間的分子層面規律，以及細胞環境影響這些性質的分子機制，至今仍不清楚。填補這一知識空白，對於理解凝聚體功能及功能障礙至關重要，也是開發靶向治療策略的必要前提。由於無序蛋白質缺乏穩定的摺疊結構，其相分離形成凝聚體表現出來的性質直接取決於其一級序列，因此是建立上述基礎規律的理想研究體系。基於此，我們將聚焦於由無序蛋白質形成的生物分子凝聚體，以解析其序列到功能之間的關係。 本項目將結合多尺度模擬與實驗測量，揭示由無序蛋白質形成的生物分子凝聚體之電化學行為背後的序列到功能關係。本研究將重塑我們對細胞組織方式的認知，通過靶向調控病理性凝聚體的電化學狀態，糾正與疾病相關的功能障礙，從而為藥物發現和治療策略開闢新的途徑。

12304326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304326.value: 偏振分辨雙體異質結有機光電探測器

12304326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304326.value: Circularly polarized light (CPL), distinguished by its inherent spin angular momentum, enables advanced information encoding for applications such as secure optical communication, quantum technologies, drug screening, bioimaging, and polarization-enhanced sensing. However, most existing photodetectors measure only light intensity and lack the ability to simultaneously determine the complete polarization state, an essential requirement for analyzing arbitrarily polarized light, including elliptical polarization. Conventional solutions rely on external polarization optics, resulting in bulky setups that hinder miniaturization and rapid detection. Existing CPL-sensitive photodetectors are limited to distinguishing between left-handed CPL (L-CPL) and right-handed CPL (R-CPL), and only when the incident light intensity is known, which restricts their use for comprehensive polarization analysis of unknown light sources. Therefore, realizing advanced photodetectors that can directly and simultaneously detect both the intensity and polarization state of light without reliance on traditional polarization optics remains an open challenge in the field. This project aims to overcome these limitations by developing a novel polarization-resolved organic photodetector (OPD) using a bias-switchable, back-to-back dual bulk heterojunction (BHJ) architecture. By selectively incorporating chiral dopants, each BHJ layer preferentially responds to either L- or R-CPL. By resolving the relative photocurrent responses to both L- and R-CPL components in unknown elliptically polarized light, the dual-BHJ polarization-sensitive OPD enables direct, all-electronic detection and quantitative analysis of the complete polarization state, including linear, circular, and elliptical polarization, without the need for additional polarization optics. This innovation opens new opportunities for compact, integrated polarization-resolved photodetectors with broad impact on secure communications, advanced imaging, and next-generation optoelectronics. 圓偏振光（CPL）具有獨特的自旋角動量，可用於高級的信息編碼，在安全光通信、量子技術、藥物篩選、生物成像及偏振增強感測等領域展現廣泛應用前景。然而，目前大多數光電探測器只能測量圓偏振光的光強，對於分析未知橢圓偏振光來說，無法同時判斷其光強和偏振態。傳統方案依賴外部偏振光學組件，不僅體積龐大，還限制了CPL檢測的小型化與快速響應。現有的CPL敏感光電探測器也僅能根據已知光強辨別左旋（L-CPL）和右旋（R-CPL）光，對未知橢圓偏振光分析能力有限。因此，如何實現可直接同步檢測CPL光強和偏振狀態，且無需依賴傳統偏振光學組件的新型光電探測器，是該領域亟需突破的難題。 基於可調偏壓的背對背雙異質結結構（Bulk Heterojunction, BHJ），本項目將研發一種全新的偏振分辨有機光電探測器（OPD）。通過選擇性引入手性摻雜劑，使每層BHJ分別對L-CPL或R-CPL有靈敏選擇。結合兩層BHJ對未知橢圓偏振光中L-與R-CPL成分的光電流響應，實現無需附加偏振光學組件的直接全電子檢測與定量分析，覆蓋線偏振、圓偏振及橢圓偏振等各種偏振狀態。此項創新有望推動小型化、一體化偏振探測器的發展，並在安全通信、高端成像及新一代光電子技術等領域帶來深遠影響。

12304426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304426.value: 結合地球同步軌道監測、化學傳輸模型與機器學習揭示亞洲逐時氮氧化物（NOx）及甲醛／乙二醛（HCHO/CHOCHO）排放

12304426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12304426.value: Prof Kim, Jhoon Dr LIU, Yang

12304426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304426.value: Nitrogen oxides (NOx) and non-methane volatile organic compounds (NMVOCs) are key precursors of tropospheric ozone (O3) and fine particulate matter (PM2.5), both of which are greatly concerned due to serious health and climate impacts. Better estimates of NOx and NMVOCs emissions would improve our understanding of their impacts on formation of O3 and PM2.5, and shed light on air pollution control. However, hourly variations of emissions remain lacking and large uncertainties were reported from previous top-down approaches due to imperfect parameterizations of physical and chemical processes, etc. Here, we propose to integrate chemical transport modeling, machine learning, and observations from the world’s first geostationary air pollution satellite to achieve highly efficient and better inversions of NOx and HCHO/CHOCHO emissions in Asia, particularly at hourly temporal resolution. We will further demonstrate how the newly inferred emissions would benefit O3 simulations in Asia and explore reasons for changes, which are of prime significance for O3 pollution control. Current bottom-up and top-down emission estimation methods face limitations. Bottom-up methods, which rely on inputs of activity data and emission factors, often suffer from large errors due to incomplete and outdated inputs, particularly for developing regions where socioeconomic activities are rapidly evolving. While top-down approaches using chemical transport models (CTMs) and observations offer more timely estimates but could also be biased due to low quality and resolution of observations and the assumptions in CTMs. Besides, top-down approaches require large computational resources, and fine-scale and diurnal emission patterns are still lacking. In this project, we will assimilate data from the world’s first geostationary air pollution and other satellites into emission inversion process, which will reveal hourly variations of NOx and HCHO/CHOCHO emissions in Asia. Additionally, we aim to leverage machine learning to model emission-concentration relationships and employ backpropagation techniques to optimize emissions. Accordingly, computational efficiency can be improved and uncertainties inherent in chemical transport models could be reduced. Then, we will explore how O3 simulations would change with updated emission inventories of NOx and HCHO/CHOCHO. This project will significantly improve the accuracy and temporal resolution of NOx and HCHO/CHOCHO emissions, while enhancing efficiency of emission inversion techniques. The results will improve our understanding of hourly and diurnal variations of NOx and HCHO/CHOCHO emissions in Asia, and provide crucial data and technical support for research on design of air pollution control strategies. 氮氧化物（NOx）和非甲烷揮發性有機物（NMVOCs）（包括異戊二烯和其他揮發性有機物物種）是產生對流層臭氧（O3）和細懸浮微粒（PM2.5）的關鍵前驅物，這兩者因對健康和氣候造成嚴重影響而備受關注。 更精確地估算 NOx 和 NMVOCs 的排放量，將有助於我們深入了解其對 O3 和 PM2.5 形成的影響，並為空氣污染控制帶來啟示。然而，目前仍缺乏排放量的逐時變化資訊，且由於物理和化學過程的參數化不夠完善等原因，以往的「由上而下」（top-down）估算方法被指出存在較大的不確定性。在此，我們提出整合化學傳輸模型、機器學習以及全球首顆地球同步軌道空氣污染衛星的觀測數據，以實現亞洲地區 NOx 和 NMVOCs 排放量的高效且更優質的反演，特別是在逐時的時間解析度上。我們將進一步展示新推導出的排放量如何有益於亞洲的 O3 模擬以及 O3 形成機制的判定，這對 O3 污染控制具有至關重要的意義。目前的「由下而上」（bottom-up）和「由上而下」（top-down）排放估算方法均面臨局限性。由下而上」（Bottom-up）方法依賴於活動數據和排放因子的輸入，但由於數據不完整或過時，往往會產生較大誤差，特別是在社會經濟活動快速發展的開發中地區。 雖然使用化學傳輸模型（CTMs）和觀測數據的「由上而下」（top-down）方法能提供更即時的估算，但也可能因為觀測數據的質量與解析度低，以及 CTMs 中的假設而產生偏差。此外，「由上而下」的方法需要耗費龐大的計算資源，且目前仍缺乏精細尺度和日夜變化的排放模式。在本專案中，我們將把全球首顆地球同步軌道空氣污染衛星的數據，同化到排放反演過程中，這將揭示亞洲地區 NOx 和 NMVOCs 排放的小時級變化。此外，我們的目標是利用機器學習來模擬「排放－濃度」的關係，並採用反向傳播（backpropagation）技術來優化排放量。因此，這不僅能提高計算效率，還能減少化學傳輸模型中固有的不確定性。接著，我們將探討在更新 NOx 和 NMVOCs 的排放清單後，O3 的模擬以及 O3 的形成機制會發生何種改變。本研究旨在結合化學傳輸模型、機器學習與地球同步衛星觀測，針對亞洲地區的氮氧化物（NOx）與非甲烷揮發性有機物（NMVOCs）進行小時級精確排放反演。此方法將解決現有方法在計算效率與日夜變化資訊上的不足，顯著提升排放量與臭氧形成機制模擬的準確性。本專案將為亞洲空氣污染控制提供關鍵的數據支援。

12304526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304526.value: 基于质谱的组学方法研究甲氧滴滴涕诱导的毒性机制

12304526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304526.value: Methoxychlor (MXC), recently listed under Annex A of the Stockholm Convention as a persistent organic pollutant, was extensively used worldwide for decades as a replacement for dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT). Despite regulatory bans, MXC residues remain detectable in soils, sediments, and agricultural products, posing ongoing risks to ecosystems and human health. Previous studies have largely attributed its toxicity to endocrine-disrupting metabolites; however, our recent findings reveal that MXC can directly form nucleoside adducts, suggesting a novel mechanism of genotoxic and metabolic interference. This project aims to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of MXC-induced toxicity beyond endocrine disruption through mass-spectrometry-based multi-omics integration. We will employ human organoid models representing key target tissues, including heart, liver, lung, kidney, and brain, to replace animal experiments and achieve higher physiological relevance. Comprehensive non-targeted and targeted metabolomics will identify perturbed metabolites and pathways under MXC exposure. Spatial metabolomics using MALDI-MS imaging will characterize the localization and intensity of MXC metabolites and the altered metabolome within organoid microstructures. Subsequently, quantitative proteomics will validate enzymatic and pathway-level disruptions associated with MXC-induced molecular damage. Integrating these datasets will provide a systems-level understanding of the cellular responses to MXC and identify early molecular signatures of its genotoxic and metabolic effects. The results are expected to uncover previously unrecognized mechanisms of POP-induced toxicity, establish a mechanistic link between nucleoside adduct formation and metabolic dysfunction, and demonstrate the potential of organoid-based multi-omics as an ethical and predictive platform for chemical safety assessment. 甲氧滴滴涕（MXC）最近被列入《斯德哥尔摩公约》附件A。作为一种持久性有机污染物，MXC在全球范围内被广泛用作二氯二苯三氯乙烷（DDT）的替代品。尽管有监管禁令，但在土壤、沉积物和农产品中仍然可以检测到MXC残留，对生态系统和人类健康构成持续风险。先前的研究主要将其毒性归因于内分泌干扰代谢物, 然而，我们最近的研究结果表明，MXC可以直接形成核苷加合物，造成新的遗传毒性和代谢干扰机制。本项目旨在通过基于质谱的多组学整合，阐明MXC诱导的内分泌干扰毒性的分子机制。我们将应用代表关键靶组织的人体类器官模型，取代动物实验并实现更高的相关性；开发和应用非靶向和靶向代谢组学将确定MXC暴露下受干扰的代谢物和途径，并使用MALDI-MS成像的空间代谢组学表征MXC代谢物的定位以及类器官微观结构中改变的代谢组。定量蛋白质组学将验证与MXC诱导的分子损伤相关的酶和途径水平的破坏。整合这些数据集将提供对MXC细胞反应的系统级理解，并确定其遗传毒性和代谢效应的早期分子特征。这些结果有望揭示以前未被认识的POP诱导毒性机制，建立核苷加合物形成与代谢功能障碍之间的机制联系，并证明基于类器官的多组学作为化学安全评估的潜力。

12500026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500026.value: 流動學習應用程式對退休者福祉之影響：混合研究方法之探討

12500026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500026.value: The global phenomenon of population aging is fundamentally reshaping societies. Demographic projections indicate that by 2030, individuals aged 60 and over will comprise one-sixth of the global population. This pattern is already manifesting with significant force in the Chinese Mainland, which anticipates a cohort of over 400 million people aged 60+ by 2035. The pressure is even more intensified in Hong Kong, with forecasts suggesting that 36% of its population will be 65 or above by 2046. This rapid demographic shift presents unprecedented pressure on the healthcare and social welfare systems, necessitating innovative and proactive approaches that both foster the well-being of older adults and harness their extensive knowledge, life experience, and capabilities. The proposed project aims to address the complex societal challenge by promoting proactive health and well-being through continuous engagement and learning. Digital technologies, particularly mobile applications, are increasingly recognized as effective tools for promoting elderly well-being, a trend accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite this adoption, our literature analysis identifies a significant research gap regarding the utility of specific app features for defined purposes. This is especially pertinent for mobile learning platforms, which have achieved widespread use among seniors in the Chinese Mainland yet remain understudied. Consequently, an opportunity exists to investigate the role of mobile learning apps that promote healthy aging, particularly among the post-60 generation, who are increasingly tech-savvy and seeking meaningful engagement during retirement. Grounded in self-determination theory and retirement literature, we propose a contextualized model to investigate how mobile learning apps enhance retiree well-being. In partnership with Jinling Era Technology, we are conducting a longitudinal study that employs a mixed methods approach. This design provides a nuanced understanding of how (a) specific, goal-oriented app features influence psychological well-being, and (b) individual characteristics moderate these effects over time. Leveraging a rich dataset of actual app usage and well-being metrics, we will apply sophisticated statistical analyses to identify significant patterns. We expect that our work will advance the literature on elderly technology use and offer courses of action for using mobile technologies to promote retirees’ well-being. 全球人口老化現象正從根本重塑社會面貌。人口統計預測顯示，到2030年，全球60歲或以上人口將佔總人口的六分之一。此趨勢已在中國內地顯現強大影響，預計到2035年，內地60歲以上人口將超過四億。香港面臨的壓力更為嚴峻，估算到2046年，65歲或以上人口將佔全港總數的36%。此一急速的人口結構轉變，對醫療及社福系統構成前所未見的壓力，急需創新且具前瞻性的應對方法，既能促進長者福祉，亦能善用其豐富知識、人生經驗及能力。本計劃旨在透過持續參與及學習，推動主動式健康與福祉，以應對這項複雜的社會挑戰。 數碼科技，尤其是流動應用程式，日益被視為促進長者福祉的有效工具，而COVID-19疫情更進一步加速此趨勢。儘管如此，經文獻回顧後，我們發現針對特定App功能在指定用途上的效用，仍存在明顯的研究空白。此情況在流動學習平台方面尤其突出——該類平台在內地長者群體中已廣泛使用，惟相關學術研究仍然不足。因此，現時正是探討流動學習App如何促進健康老齡化的良機，尤其聚焦於60後世代——該群體對科技日漸熟悉，並在退休後積極尋求有意義的參與方式。 建基於自我決定理論及退休相關文獻，我們提出一個具情境化的模型，以探討流動學習App如何提升退休人士的福祉。本研究與金齡時代科技公司合作，採用縱向研究設計，並運用混合研究方法。此設計有助深入理解：（a）特定且具目標導向的App功能如何影響心理福祉，以及（b）個體特徵如何隨時間推移調節上述效果。我們將利用豐富的實際App使用數據及福祉指標資料集，透過嚴謹的統計分析，識別出關鍵模式。我們預期本研究能推進長者科技使用的學術文獻，並為運用流動科技促進退休人士福祉提供具體行動建議。

12500126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500126.value: 如何開展副業？基於建構水平理論的員工副業與主業邊界管理研究

12500126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12500126.value: Prof Lee, Cynthia Prof Vaulont, Manuel Prof YU, Bingjie

12500126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500126.value: Many employees now work on side hustles in addition to their primary jobs, which can improve financial security and personal growth but also increase distractions and stress. This research aims to clarify how people manage the boundaries between their side hustles and primary jobs. Drawing on construal level theory and boundary management theory, we propose that how abstractly or concretely people think (construal level), their flexibility in shifting thinking styles (construal level flexibility), and how much flexibility they have in their primary job's work arrangements jointly shape the strategies (such as segmentation and aggregation) they use to separate or link their dual or multiple jobs. These strategies then affect how side hustles enrich or interfere with their primary job, influencing performance and wellbeing. Interviews with side-hustlers in the U.S. and China revealed different ways people manage these boundaries and provided some initial support for our ideas. We plan to conduct a longitudinal survey to test the full model. By mapping out the ways cognitive style and job flexibility influence the management and outcomes of employee side hustling, this project aims to offer insights for both employees and organizations on how to benefit from side hustles while managing challenges. 現今許多員工除了主業之外還會從事副業，以提升經濟保障和個人成長，但同時也可能導致工作分心和壓力等後果。本研究關注人們如何管理副業與主業之間的界線。基於建構水平理論和邊界管理理論，我們提出，人們思維建構水平的高低（抽像或具體的思維）、思維建構水平轉換的靈活性、以及主業工作安排的靈活性共同塑造了他們用來管理雙重或多重工作的策略（例如分割和整合）。這些策略令到副業豐富或乾擾主業，最終影響員工的績效和幸福感。我們對美國和中國的一批從事副業者進行了問卷訪談，定性分析的結果顯示人們確實是使用不同策略管理主、副業邊界的，並且不同的邊界管理策略產生不同的果效，為我們提出的模型提供了初步支持。我們計劃進行一項縱向調查，以用量化數據檢驗完整的模型，為員工和組織提供如何從副業中獲益並應對挑戰的洞見。

12500426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500426.value: 股票交易和非銀行機構的股債雙重持有：來自最小報價單位試點計劃的證據

12500426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500426.value: Since the 1990s, the syndicated loan market has witnessed a rapidly growing role played by nonbank institutional investors, including hedge funds, mutual funds, pension funds, insurance companies, and collateralized loan obligations. According to the 2024 review by the Shared National Credit (SNC) program, lending by nonbank institutions in the United States has reached over $1.33 trillion, representing 42% of the total outstanding loan amount. A strand of accounting and finance literature has demonstrated that nonbanks can simultaneously act as equity holders and loan lenders (i.e., “dual holders”). Building on the prior literature, the proposed study utilizes the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)’s 2016 Tick Size Pilot Program (TSPP) as a natural experiment to examine whether and how firms’ information environment influences nonbanks’ participation in syndicated loans. As a randomized tick-size experiment, TSPP has profound effects on stock trading and investors’ information acquisition. The SEC introduced the TSPP on October 3, 2016, to encourage larger trading volumes and enhance liquidity for small‐cap stocks. During the TSPP implementation, the SEC randomly selected three test groups of stocks traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), the American Stock Exchange (AMEX), and the Nasdaq and raised their minimum tick size from $0.01 to $0.05. The proposed research examines (1) whether nonbank institutional investors are more likely to participate in loans to treatment firms than to control firms during the TSPP implementation; (2) whether the impact of the TSPP on nonbank institutional investors' dual-holding of equity and debt is more pronounced for nonbanks classified as transient investors than for those classified as quasi-indexer and dedicated investors; and (3) whether the impact of the TSPP on nonbank institutional investors' dual-holding varies with loan purposes and lender reputation. The proposed research intends to make contributions in the following ways. First, my proposed project can contribute to the nonbank lending literature in general and a growing strand of studies on dual holders in particular by investigating the motivation of institutional investors to hold both equity and private debt. Second, the proposed study also contributes to the literature on stock liquidity and tick size by examining how a feature of stock market microstructure affects the participation of non-bank institutional investors in syndicated loans. 自1990年代以來，非銀行機構投資人（包括對沖基金、共同基金、退休基金、保險公司及貸款抵押證券等）在銀團貸款市場的角色迅速成長。根據美國共享國家信用計劃（SNC）2024年的報告，美國非銀行機構的貸款金額已超過1.33兆美元，佔總未償還貸款金額的42%。會計與金融領域的相關研究指出，這些非銀行機構可以同時扮演「股東」與「債權人」的雙重角色（即「雙重持有者」）。 本研究以此前文獻為基礎，利用美國證券交易委員會（SEC）於2016年推行的「最小報價單位試點計劃」（TSPP）作為研究場景，探討企業的資訊環境如何影響非銀行機構參與銀團貸款。TSPP 是一項隨機進行的最小報價單位實驗，對股票交易與投資人的資訊獲取產生了深遠影響。SEC 於2016年10月3日推出該計劃，旨在促進小型股的交易量並提升其流動性。在實施期間，SEC 隨機挑選了在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）、美國證券交易所（AMEX）及納斯達克（Nasdaq）交易的三組股票作為實驗組，將其最小報價單位從0.01美元調高至0.05美元。 本研究主要探討以下三個問題：第一，在 TSPP 實施期間，非銀行機構投資人是否更傾向參與實驗組企業的銀團貸款？ 第二，TSPP 對非銀行機構同時持有股權與債權（雙重持有）的影響，是否在「短期交易型」機構中比在「準指數型」及「長期專注型」機構中更為顯著？ 第三，TSPP 對非銀行機構股債雙重持有的影響，是否會因貸款用途及貸款方聲譽而有所不同？ 本研究藉由剖析機構投資人同時持有股票與私有債權背後的動機，為非銀行借貸相關文獻以及日益受關注的雙重持有者研究提供新觀點。 同時，透過探討股票市場的微觀結構特徵如何影響非銀行機構參與銀團貸款，本研究可以進一步豐富有關股票流動性與最小報價單位的學術研究。

12502726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12502726.value: Ultra short-term "zero days to expiration" (0DTE) options have exploded in popularity now account for roughly half of U.S. index option trading. When investors buy or sell these options, professional dealers take the other side and hedge their risk by trading the underlying. As an option nears expiration, the amount of hedging dealers need can shift quickly even if prices do not move. This time-driven shift (Charm) can force dealers to buy or sell S&P 500 futures before the market open, potentially creating a predictable gap in the underlying index between yesterday's close and today's open. This project studies whether the hedging pressure from 0DTE options trading affects the next-day opening move in the S&P 500. We focus on the "charm" channel which captures how hedging needs change simply because time has passed, distinct from the "gamma" channel that depends on price moves.
