By theorizing the "girled body" as a biopolitical instrument, the research reveals how gendered performance was central to Cold War nation-building. It ultimately traces the discursive legacy of this state-sponsored diplomacy to the contemporary Korean Wave (Hallyu), challenging market-centric narratives of Hallyu by highlighting its roots in a state-initiated tradition of deploying disciplined youth for ideological ends. The project contributes to Cold War studies, visual culture, and gender studies by uncovering the intimate linkages between cultural production, gendered politics, and neocolonial power. 本研究項目以韓國「小天使」兒童民俗芭蕾舞團（Little Angels Children's Folk Ballet）為核心案例，探討冷戰時期性別化的文化外交。該舞團於1962年在統一教與朴正熙政權的贊助下成立，其國際巡演旨在向世界展示韓國作為一個既現代又保有傳統、且不具威脅性的盟友形象。本研究主張，「小天使」的表演構成了一種「才弄外交（jaerong diplomacy）」——一種獨特的軟實力運作模式，透過動員青春期前少女的情感勞動，將威權發展美學化，並促進韓美同盟的鞏固。 透過對國家製新聞影片（《大韓新聞》）、媒體檔案及當代藝術再詮釋的批判性分析，本研究剖析了這種「天使般」少女形象的視覺與表演性建構。研究將揭示，經過精心策劃的元素——混雜的編舞、傳統服飾與純潔敘事——如何被用來抹去戰爭與殖民化的創傷，呈現出一個經過淨化的國家形象以供西方消費。與爵士歌手尹福姬（Yoon Bok-hee）的比較分析，則揭示了國家對可控制的「傳統」女性氣質的偏好，而非對越界的現代性的認可。 透過將「少女化的身體」理論化為一種生物政治工具，本研究揭示了性別表演如何成為冷戰時期國家建構的核心。最終，本研究將追溯這項國家主導的文化外交之話語遺產如何延伸至當代韓流（Hallyu），挑戰以市場為中心的韓流敘事，並突顯其在國家主導的、為意識形態目的而部署紀律化青年的傳統中的根源。 本研究將為冷戰研究、視覺文化研究與性別研究提供重要貢獻，揭示文化生產、性別政治與新殖民權力之間的密切關聯。

14623526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623526.value: 《從安全威脅到安全守衛：亞洲脈絡下黑人男性氣質的想像與建構》

14623526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14623526.value: Prof Ho , Lawrence Prof Vecchio, Francesco

14623526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623526.value: This research asks how the same black African bodies could be constructed paraodoxically as security threats and security agents in HKSAR. It goes beyond any easy diagnosis of “anti-blackness” to examine how meanings of blackness are constituted, negotiated, and remade in the Asian context. An increasing number of ex-asylum-seekers from sub-Saharan Africa in Hong Kong – labelled by the HKSAR government as “security threats” – have worked as security guards, body guards, and bouncers. What structures of difference enabled this specific binary of “threats” and “guards” to be projected onto black African bodies, and in turn, how has this paradoxical positioning shaped black Africans’ subjectivities, experiences, and aspirations? With the expansion of Africa/China and Africa/Asia exchanges, and the increase of African migrants in Asia, this research contributes to the emergence of Asia as a key site in the global debate about blackness. The interrogation of race and racialization processes beyond the Euro-American contexts would further animate the theorization of race in and through Asia. The primary focus of the research will be on the men’s experiences across the two sides of the security threshold (from “threats” to “guards”), as well as how they navigate their racialized identities as black male security personnel. How do they manage their identities on the job as agents of security and order, while negotiating with popular image of black men as physical and sexual dangers? A second dimension of the research is to understand the security industry’s deployment of black masculinity in the expansion of private security operations both in Hong Kong and in the region. The growing significance of private policing has implications on issues of accountability and basic rights protection, as well as surveillance ethics, the privatization of public space, and labor rights. The increasing number of black African security personnel reflects the multiple ways blackness and security intersect that could be profitable but also render these men exploitable. The third dimension of the project aims to contribute to the theorization of race and gender – in particular black masculinity – from an Asian perspective and understand the polyvalence of blackness in the 21st century. 本研究旨在探討：為何相同的非洲黑人身體在香港特別行政區（HKSAR）會被矛盾地建構為既是「安全威脅」，同時又是「安全執行者」。本研究不僅止於將此現象簡化為「反黑人性」（anti-blackness）的表現，而是進一步檢視在亞洲脈絡下，「黑人性」（blackness）的意義如何被建構、協商及重新塑造。 近年來，來自撒哈拉以南非洲的前尋求庇護者開始從事保安員、私人保鏢及夜店保全等安全相關工作。這些曾經被香港特區政府標籤為「安全威脅」的人, 在取得香港居留身分後，突然轉變為「「安全守衛者」。究竟是哪些差異化結構，使得「威脅」與「守衛者」這組特定的二元對立能夠同時投射到非洲黑人男性身上？進一步而言，這種矛盾的定位又如何形塑非洲黑人的主體性、生活經驗及未來抱負？ 隨著中非關係、亞非交流的不斷深化，以及非洲移民在亞洲地區持續增加，本研究有助於推動亞洲成為全球有關「黑人性」討論的重要場域。透過檢視歐美脈絡以外的種族與種族化過程，本研究亦將進一步豐富並推動從亞洲出發的種族理論建構。 本研究的主要焦點將放在男性受訪者跨越安全界線兩端的經驗，即從被視為「威脅者」到成為「守衛者」的過程，以及他們如何作為黑人男性保安人員協商其被種族化的身分認同。他們如何在工作中扮演維護安全與秩序的角色，同時面對社會普遍將黑人男性視為身體及性威脅的刻板印象？他們又如何管理自身的身分定位，並在這些相互矛盾的社會期待之間周旋？ 本研究的第二個面向，是探討保安產業如何運用黑人男性氣質（black masculinity），以推動香港及區域內私人保安業務的發展與擴張。私人保安及私人警務的重要性日益提升，這不僅涉及問責機制及基本權利保障等問題，也牽涉監控倫理、公共空間私有化及勞工權益等議題。越來越多非洲黑人從事保安工作，反映出「黑人性」與「安全」之間存在多重交會方式。這些交會既可能帶來經濟利益，也可能使這些男性更容易受到剝削。 本計劃的第三個面向，旨在從亞洲視角推進有關種族與性別的理論建構，尤其聚焦於黑人男性氣質的研究，並進一步理解二十一世紀「黑人性」所展現的多元性、流動性及複雜內涵。

14623726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623726.value: 無譜而歌：明代的曲譜、聲景與曲唱文化

14623726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623726.value: This project examines the notation of qu-arias and the vibrant singing culture in Ming China (1368–1644). Professionally trained singers, such as courtesans and music teachers, infused urban centers with singing music throughout the entire Ming dynasty. They were often joined by well-educated aria aficionados, ranging from retired officials to well-off young men. Those enthusiasts dedicated themselves to collecting, performing, and composing new arias, fostering a rich soundscape and a flourishing market for printed singable texts. Yet, despite the presence of various musical notating systems and the documented enthusiasm for aria music, not a single musical note is transcribed in any dramatic manuscripts or imprints from this period. Instead, these texts are marked by indicators of tone, pronunciation, and rhythm, suggesting the music’s performative rather than notational character. I argue that this apparent absence of musical notation should not be seen as a primitive form but rather as a reflection of an alternative historical conception of music distinct from modern understandings (Sheng 2024). To probe further into the Ming discourse of aria music and expand the scope of research, I combine technical analyses of the aria notation in dramatic manuscripts and imprints with cultural research into aria performance during the Ming dynasty. While those dramatic books have often been attributed to literati, I rather decenter the literati in my studies by synthesizing approaches from literature studies, music studies, book history, and performance studies to examine a non-literary component in those books. In so doing, I illuminate a singing culture that is both regulated and chaotic, shaped by participants from all walks of life, and challenges modern presumptions about music as well as the evolution of musical notation. The project will yield several conference presentations and two journal articles submitted to top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals. 本研究項目聚焦明代曲譜與蓬勃的曲唱文化。研究解釋了戲曲曲譜中曲唱符號的技術意涵，並將曲唱符號納入對明代曲唱文化的探討，吸收文學研究、音樂研究、書籍文化研究以及表演研究的研究方法，將討論重心從既往研究中常見的曲辭、曲情轉移至戲曲抄本、刊本中非文學文本的部分。本研究挑戰了在明代曲唱研究中普遍存在的文人中心視角，以跨學科的方法論發掘彼時其他群體對曲唱文化的參與和建構，旨在描摹一幅秩序、混亂交織，平民、菁英同場，與現代歐洲音樂理論影響下的「歌唱」、「歌曲」概念迥異的曲唱聲景。

14623926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623926.value: 方法或『枉法』：學生就學術作業使用人工智能的倫理判斷研究

14623926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14623926.value: Prof Chai, Ching Sing Prof Stephens, Jason

14623926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623926.value: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT are rapidly transforming how students complete academic work. This technology can support creativity, efficiency, and confidence, but also raises pressing questions about integrity, fairness, and learning. Surveys show that while about half of students consider AI use to be “cheating,” many of them also use it regularly. They are divided on whether “gray area” uses (e.g., paraphrasing, brainstorming, seeking feedback) are ethical, and many worry that AI may undermine critical skills such as creativity and critical thinking. Meanwhile, universities struggle to keep pace, potentially issuing policies that are unclear or inconsistent and leaving students without firm guidance. This project investigates how students make sense of these dilemmas, focusing on early undergraduates at a formative stage of academic development. We examine how motivations (such as efficiency or stress relief) and ethical reasoning might jointly guide AI use, changes in beliefs and behaviors over time, and why students might sometimes knowingly use AI in unethical ways. We introduce an innovative framework combining two established perspectives. Uses and Gratifications Theory explains why students turn to AI to meet cognitive, practical, or emotional needs. Social Domain Theory explains students’ ethical reasoning processes and how they weigh considerations of fairness (moral), rule-following (conventional), skill development (prudential), and personal choice. A third concept, Moral Disengagement, links the two by explaining how students rationalize questionable behaviors (“everyone does it,” “it doesn’t really hurt anyone”) to pursue immediate benefits. To capture these processes, we will follow 700 first- and second-year undergraduates across a full academic year. Students will complete four in-depth surveys on trait-level ethical attitudes, motivations, and behaviors, alongside bi-weekly assessments of recent, state-level experiences. This design can distinguish between-student differences (e.g., those who are generally more cautious or permissive than their peers) from within-student fluctuations (e.g., a particular student turning to AI more often during stressful weeks). Linking shorter-term changes with longer-term patterns can reveal how motivations, ethical views, and AI habits crystallize or drift in the crucial early years of university. This project comes at a critical juncture, as students’ adoption of AI is advancing far faster than the ethical norms and policies guiding it. Identifying how and when students balance benefits and integrity will provide urgently needed evidence to inform fair, sustainable educational policies and support students in developing responsible habits for the future. 人工智慧 (AI) 工具（例如 ChatGPT）正在迅速改變學生完成學業的方式。這項技術可以提升創造力、效率和自信心，但也引發了關於誠信、公平和學習等方面的迫切問題。調查顯示，雖然約有一半的學生認為使用 AI 是“作弊”，但許多學生也經常使用它。他們對「灰色地帶」的使用（例如，釋義、腦力激盪、尋求回饋）是否合乎倫理存在分歧，許多人擔心 AI 可能會削弱創造力和批判性思考等關鍵技能。同時，大學難以跟上步伐，可能會推出一些含糊不清或前後矛盾的政策，導致學生缺乏明確的指導。本計畫旨在研究學生如何理解這些困境，並專注於處於學術發展初期階段的本科低年級學生。我們研究動機（例如提高效率或緩解壓力）和倫理推理如何共同引導人工智慧的使用、信念和行為隨時間的變化，以及學生為何有時會明知故犯地以不道德的方式使用人工智慧。我們引入了一個創新框架，結合了兩種既有的視角。使用與滿足理論解釋了學生為何會轉向人工智慧來滿足認知、實踐或情感需求。社會領域理論解釋了學生的倫理推理過程，以及他們如何權衡公平（道德）、遵守規則（習俗）、技能發展（審慎）和個人選擇等因素。第三個概念，道德脫離，透過解釋學生如何為可疑行為辯解（「大家都這麼做」、「這又不會真正傷害任何人」），從而將兩者連結起來，以追求眼前的利益。為了捕捉這些過程，我們將追蹤700名大一和大二的科生，研究時間跨度為一個完整的學年。學生將完成四項深入的問卷，內容涵蓋特質層面的倫理態度、動機和行為，同時每兩週進行一次近期州級經驗評估。這種設計能夠區分學生之間的差異（例如，那些通常比同齡人更謹慎或更寬容的學生）和學生內部的波動（例如，某個學生在壓力大的幾週內更頻繁地使用人工智慧）。將短期變化與長期模式連結起來，可以揭示動機、倫理觀點和人工智慧使用習慣在大學早期關鍵階段是如何形成或變化的。本計畫正值關鍵時刻，因為學生對人工智慧的採用速度遠遠超過了指導其發展的倫理規範和政策。識別學生如何以及何時平衡利益和誠信，將提供迫切需要的證據，以製定公平、永續的教育政策，並支持學生培養面向未來的負責任的習慣。

14624026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14624026.value: 輔導前角色過渡訓練對新輔導員的成效

14624026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14624026.value: Prof Chong, Eddie Siu Kwan Dr Luk, Sau Ha

14624026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14624026.value: Counselors’ pre-session emotional states have been investigated in several studies, but their effects on counseling process and outcomes remain inconclusive. Research on pre-session exercises targeting counselors’ mood and emotion regulation also shows mixed results. Counselors’ mental preparation likely involves not only emotions but also counseling-related cognitions and behaviors. According to boundary transition theory, counselors need to exit other life roles and enter the counselor role successfully before the thoughts, feelings, and behaviors associated with the counselor role are activated. Inadequate role transition may result in spillover effects where behavioral tendencies, such as communication styles, related to other roles interfere with the execution of the desired role. In addition, external and explicit cues may facilitate role transition and role adoption, especially for individuals who are new to a role. Based on these premises, a pre-session role transition intervention will be developed and tested in this study. The pre-session intervention lasts 10 minutes and includes activities designed specifically to aid in the role transition process, as supported by the empirical and theoretical literature. A pilot study involving 26 counseling trainees showed preliminary evidence that the new intervention increased counselor role adoption, reduced trainees’ pre-session anxiety, and enhanced the working alliance with clients. Using a quasi-experimental design, trainees will be assigned to either the intervention (A) or control (B) condition according to their supervision group (random assignment is avoided to prevent intervention contamination when trainees in the same supervision group talk). Trainees in Group A will receive the pre-session role transition intervention before Sessions 2-5 with one client, and trainees in Group B will receive the intervention before Sessions 6-9 (i.e., delayed intervention). It is hypothesized that counselors’ pre-session anxiety will be lower, and their counselor role adoption and counseling self-efficacy will be higher, when counselors receive the pre-session intervention (i.e., comparing Sessions 2-5 between Group A and Group B, and comparing Sessions 2-5 and Sessions 6-9 within Group B). Ratings of counselor presence, session quality, and working alliance will also be higher when counselors have the intervention. The maintenance effect of the intervention will be examined by assessing the outcome variables in Group A after the intervention is withdrawn starting at Session 6. In addition, counselors will be invited to participate in a brief post-practicum interview to discuss their experience with the pre-session intervention, its impact on their counselor role adoption, and recommendations for improving the intervention. 過往已有數項研究探討輔導員在輔導前的心理狀態，然而其對輔導過程與成效的影響至今仍未有定論。針對輔導員情緒及情感調節的輔導前練習研究，同樣顯示出好壞參半的結果。輔導員的心理準備工作，很可能不僅涉及情緒，還包含與輔導相關的認知與行為。根據邊界過渡理論（boundary transition theory），輔導員需要成功抽離其他生活角色並進入輔導員角色，方能激活與輔導員角色相關的思想、情感和行為。角色過渡不足可能導致溢出效應（spillover effects），使與其他角色相關的行為傾向（例如溝通風格）干擾目標角色的執行。此外，外部和明顯的提示或能促進角色過渡與角色採納，對於剛接觸特定角色的人士而言尤其如此。基於上述前提，本研究將設計並測試一項輔導前角色過渡訓練。 該輔導前訓練需時10分鐘，包含根據實證與理論文獻支持、專為協助角色過渡過程而設計的活動。一項涉及26名受訓輔導員的先導研究提供了初步證據，證實新干預措施能提高輔導員的角色採納、減輕受訓者的輔導節前焦慮，並增強與受導者的工作同盟關係。 本研究將採用準實驗設計，實習生將根據其督導小組被分配至干預組（A組）或對照組（B組）（避免隨機分配是為了防止同一督導小組的受訓者在交流時造成干預污染）。A組受訓者將在與一名受導者進行第2至5節會談之前，接受輔導前角色過渡訓練，而B組受訓者則在第6至9節會談前接受訓練（即延遲干預）。本研究假設，當輔導員接受輔導前訓練時，其輔導前焦慮會較低，而其輔導員角色採納與輔導自我效能感則會較高（即比較A組與B組的第2至5節，以及比較B組的第2至5節與第6至9節）。當輔導員接受訓練時，對輔導員臨在感（presence）、輔導質素及工作同盟的評分亦會較高。本研究亦將透過在第6節起停止訓練後評估A組的效果變項，以檢視訓練的維持效應。此外，研究將邀請輔導員參與簡短的實習後訪談，以探討他們對輔導前訓練的體驗、該訓練對其輔導員角色採納的影響，以及改良該訓練的建議。

14624426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14624426.value: 香港高質素幼稚園的公平可及性：供應、質素及教育取向的地理空間分析

14624426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14624426.value: Access to high-quality early childhood education (ECE) is widely recognized as critical for children’s development and for reducing long-term inequality. Since the launch of the Kindergarten Education Scheme in 2017, Hong Kong has achieved near-universal ECE by subsidizing tuition and regulating quality. Yet questions remain about whether families in all neighborhoods have access to high-quality kindergartens. Addressing this issue is vital because ECE supports child development, prepares children for primary school, and contributes to positive long-term social and economic outcomes. The proposed project will investigate family-level inequality in Hong Kong’s kindergarten sector across three dimensions of ECE: the availability of kindergarten places, the quality of educational services, and the orientations emphasized by schools. The proposed study will integrate census data, administrative records, classroom observations, and text-based analysis to capture how the landscape of kindergarten supply is experienced by families across different neighborhoods. First, geospatial measures will be developed to map kindergarten availability. Second, schools’ structural quality will be measured through administrative indicators, while process quality will be assessed through direct classroom observations in 60 classrooms across 30 kindergartens. Third, educational orientations will be derived from the Education Bureau’s Quality Review reports using structural topic modeling. The proposed project will contribute to both academic and policy discussions. It will identify any city-wide spatial inequities in Hong Kong’s kindergarten sector, extending international research on quality disparities to a high-density Asian context. Methodologically, it will offer a novel contribution by developing an integrated, multi-method approach that combines geospatial analysis, classroom observations, and large-scale text mining. The findings will help policymakers refine the Kindergarten Education Scheme, moving beyond affordability to emphasize accessibility, quality, and diversity of educational goals. Ultimately, the proposed project will provide evidence-based recommendations for promoting equitable ECE opportunities, with implications for Hong Kong as well as other global cities facing similar challenges. 獲得高質素幼兒教育（ECE）的機會被廣泛認為對兒童發展及減少長期不平等至關重要。自2017年推行幼稚園教育計劃以來，香港透過學費資助及質素規管，已達致接近普及的幼兒教育參與。然而，不同社區的家庭是否均能獲得高質素幼稚園服務，仍有待深入研究。這一問題十分重要，因為幼兒教育不僅有助兒童發展及銜接小學，也有助促進長遠的社會和經濟成果。 本研究將從三個幼兒教育層面探討香港幼稚園界別中以家庭為單位的不平等：幼稚園學額的可及性、教育服務質素，以及學校所強調的教育取向。研究將整合人口普查資料、行政紀錄、課堂觀察及文本分析，以呈現不同社區家庭實際面對的幼稚園供應環境。首先，本研究將建立地理空間指標，繪製幼稚園學額可及性的分布。其次，研究將以行政數據衡量幼稚園的結構質素，並透過對30所幼稚園共60個課堂的直接觀察評估過程質素。第三，研究將運用結構主題模型分析教育局的質素評核報告，以識別幼稚園的教育取向。 本研究將在學術及政策層面作出貢獻。研究將識別香港幼稚園界別是否存在全港性的空間不平等，並把有關質素差異的國際研究延伸至高密度亞洲城市的情境。在方法上，本研究將發展一套整合地理空間分析、課堂觀察及大規模文本挖掘的多方法研究框架。研究結果可協助政策制定者進一步完善幼稚園教育計劃，使政策焦點由可負擔性進一步延伸至可及性、質素，以及教育目標的多樣性。最終，本研究將提出以證據為本的政策建議，以促進更公平的幼兒教育機會，並為香港及其他面對類似挑戰的全球城市提供參考。

14624726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14624726.value: 早期兒童投資的教育回報：家訪式與中心式早教項目對中國農村學生學業發展路徑的長期影響

14624726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14624726.value: Mr Lu, Mai Prof Snow, Catherine E. Prof XIE, Jian

14624726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14624726.value: This study addresses a critical gap in early childhood education research: understanding whether affordable programs targeting China's poorest rural families produce lasting educational benefits measurable through high school and college entrance examinations. While research demonstrates short-term gains from parenting support (ages 0-3) and preschool education (ages 3-6), evidence is scarce on whether these investments persist through adolescence in low-income contexts, and whether combining both programs produces amplified effects. This question has direct policy urgency as China confronts plummeting birth rates (1.09 births per woman in 2022) while debating how to allocate constrained resources between cash subsidies and educational services for its shrinking rural child population. We leverage a natural experiment in County G, Hunan Province—a nationally-designated poverty county (annual rural per capita income: $1,707) where two flagship programs were introduced six years apart. One Village One Preschool (OVOP), launched in 2012, provides center-based education for ages 3-6 across village classrooms, serving approximately 300,000 children across 1,800 villages since 2009. China REACH, introduced in 2018, delivers weekly home-visiting with parenting guidance and learning materials for ages 0-3, serving 62,000 children across 1,092 villages since 2015. This staggered rollout creates variation in program exposure: children born 2009-2015 could access only preschool; those born after 2015 received both home-visiting followed by preschool; comparison children in neighboring counties received neither program. Using administrative records from County G's centralized examination system, we track approximately 10,000 students across cohorts through three assessment points: school readiness tests at elementary school entry (ages 6-7), high school entrance examinations determining academic versus vocational tracks (age 15), and college entrance examinations (Gao Kao, age 18). County-wide standardized tests administered twice annually provide measures of literacy and mathematics development, while high-stakes examinations offer objective outcomes determining students' educational and economic futures. Approximately 2,400 children in subsample counties completed detailed cognitive assessments (Woodcock-Johnson IV) between ages 6-13, enabling analysis of specific skill trajectories underlying examination performance. Findings will provide the first rigorous evidence on whether sequential early childhood investments costing $400-600 per child annually produce benefits detectable in high-stakes academic outcomes, whether starting earlier produces better results than quality preschool alone, which children benefit most, and when effects persist versus fade. Results directly inform investment strategies for China's declining child population and early childhood policy globally as nations confront falling birth rates while seeking cost-effective interventions reducing educational inequality. 本研究旨在回應早期兒童教育研究中的一個關鍵空白：面向中國最貧困農村家庭的低成本干預項目，其教育效益能否長期延續，並在中考、高考等關鍵考試中得到檢驗。已有研究表明，0—3歲的養育支持與3—6歲的學前教育均能帶來短期發展成效，但在低收入情境下，這些早期投入能否延續至青少年階段，以及兩類項目的銜接是否會產生疊加放大效應，相關證據仍十分匱乏。這一問題具有緊迫的政策意義：在生育率持續走低、農村兒童人口不斷萎縮的背景下，中國正面臨如何在現金補貼與教育服務之間配置有限資源的現實抉擇。 本研究依託湖南省G縣的一項自然實驗。G縣是湖南省西部一個農村人口占多數、經濟發展相對滯後的縣域，是原國家扶貧開發工作重點縣，2020年脫貧摘帽，但仍然長期面臨兒童早期發展服務供給不足的問題。G縣推行兩項標誌性的教育反貧困項目，前後相隔六年。第一項是2012年啟動的「一村一園」（One Village One Preschool, OVOP）項目，依託村級教學點，為3—6歲兒童提供中心式學前教育；其二為2018年引入的「慧育中國」（China REACH）項目，透過每週入戶家訪提供養育指導與學習材料，服務0—3歲兒童。兩項項目的錯時推行形成了天然的干預暴露差異：2009—2015年出生的兒童僅可獲得學前教育；2015年之後出生的兒童則先接受家訪式養育支持、隨後進入學前教育；鄰近縣域的對照組兒童兩者皆未獲得。 研究利用G縣統一考試系統的行政管理數據，對約10,000名不同出生年齡的學生進行追蹤，涵蓋三個關鍵評估節點：小學入學時的學習準備測評（6—7歲）、決定普通高中與職業教育分流的中考（15歲），以及高考（18歲）。全縣每年兩次的標準化統一測試可提供語文讀寫與數學發展的過程性指標，而關鍵考試則提供了決定學生教育與生涯走向的客觀結果指標。此外，子樣本縣約2,400名兒童在6—13歲期間將完成系統的認知能力測評（Woodcock-Johnson IV），使我們得以進一步分析支撐考試表現的具體能力發展軌跡。 本研究將首次提供嚴謹的實證證據，回答以下問題：人均年成本僅400—600美元的連續性早期干預，其成效能否在關鍵的學業結果中被檢測到；更早介入是否優於僅提供優質學前教育；哪些兒童從中獲益最多；以及干預效應在何時得以延續、何時趨於消退。研究結果將為中國在兒童人口下降背景下的早期教育資源配置策略提供直接依據，也可為全球範圍內面臨生育率下降、亟需尋求兼具成本效益且能縮小教育不平等的干預路徑的國家提供參考。

14625326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14625326.value: 《荒謬：擁槍權倡議者如何扭曲歷史並助長壓迫》

14625326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14625326.value: Grotesque: How Gun Rights Advocates Distort History and Facilitate Oppression argues that contemporary interpretations of the Second Amendment to the United States Constitution have strayed far from its original intent. The amendment grew out of the founding generation's fear of military oppression and the need for civil control over armed forces. Contrary to current narratives that frame the Second Amendment as a guarantee of individual gun rights, it was designed to prevent the emergence of a standing army that could threaten a free society. The project pursues three main objectives: to dismantle prevalent misconceptions surrounding the Second Amendment’s history, to provide an accurate account of its inclusion in the Bill of Rights, and to emphasize its relevance today amidst concerns of a politicized military. Using a combination of intellectual history and cultural history, Grotesque also traces the evolution of the Second Amendment’s interpretation since it was written. It will especially criticize the Supreme Court's 2008 DC vs. Heller ruling, which mischaracterized the amendment as solely protecting individual gun ownership. The project also explores how gun rights advocates have successfully reframed the debate, transforming the Second Amendment into a "guns amendment," while obscuring its original civil-military relations context. That civil-military context is what the United States needs today, given that it threatened by the prospect of an increasingly politicized military acting within the United States, and especially in American cities. By reintegrating eighteenth-century debates on civil control over the military into contemporary discussions, Grotesque will highlight amendment's original goals, which remain critical in the face of rising authoritarianism and the potential for military overreach in modern America. 《荒謬：擁槍權倡議者如何扭曲歷史並助長壓迫》指出，當代對美國憲法第二修正案的解讀已嚴重偏離其初衷。該修正案源於建國一代對軍事壓迫的恐懼以及對武裝力量進行文官控制的迫切需求。與目前將第二修正案視為保障個人持槍權的敘事相反，其設立的初衷是為了防止可能威脅自由社會的常備軍的出現。本計畫旨在實現三個主要目標：消除圍繞第二修正案歷史的普遍誤解；；準確梳理其如何被納入權利法案；以及強調在當今對軍隊政治化的擔憂日益加劇的背景下，該修正案的現實意義。同時，《荒謬》結合思想史和文化史，追溯了第二修正案自製定以來解讀的演變歷程。該計畫將聚焦在最高法院2008年「哥倫比亞特區訴赫勒案」的裁決，該裁決錯誤地將第二修正案解讀為僅保護個人擁有槍支的權利。該計畫還探討了擁槍權倡導者如何成功地重新定義了這場辯論，將第二修正案轉變為“槍支修正案”，同時掩蓋了其最初的軍民關係背景。鑑於美國正面臨軍隊日益政治化並可能在美國境內，尤其是美國城市開展行動的潛在威脅，這種軍民關係背景正是當今美國所需要的。透過將十八世紀關於文官對軍隊的控制的辯論重新融入當代討論，《荒謬》將著重強調該修正案的初衷，這些初衷在當今美國日益抬頭的威權主義和潛在的軍事權力過度擴張面前仍然至關重要。

14625426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14625426.value: 以數據為本的聾人及弱聽讀者英語閱讀支援：來自中英雙語眼動語料庫的實證

14625426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14625426.value: This project seeks to reduce long-standing obstacles to higher education faced by deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) students in Hong Kong, where limited English proficiency often restricts opportunities despite sign bilingual education. Grounded in Hong Kong’s biliterate–trilingual context and the Sign Bilingualism and Co-enrollment (SLCO) model, we examine how DHH and hearing readers process English and Traditional Chinese texts in real time. Using large-scale, naturalistic eye-tracking, we will build a bilingual passage-reading corpus from DHH Hong Kong Sign Language (HKSL) signers and their hearing peers. This corpus will enable modelling of word-, phrase-, and clause-level processing and the identification of linguistic features that increase difficulty, such as low-salience morphology, connectives, and clause boundaries. These insights will inform minimally intrusive, text-embedded supports (e.g., explicit chunking, connective highlighting), which will be tested in an intervention to improve English reading efficiency and comprehension for DHH learners. Deliverables will include an open-access bilingual reading corpus, analysis tools, peer-reviewed studies, and practical resources for teachers to support inclusive literacy instruction. By developing the first bilingual eye-movement corpus with DHH readers that spans both English and Traditional Chinese scripts—and by applying these insights to targeted interventions—this project delivers a first-of-its-kind, large-scale, naturalistic account of cross-script reading processes. 本研究計劃旨在減少香港聾人及弱聽（DHH）學生長期面對的高等教育障礙。在手語雙語教育的背景下，英語能力不足往往仍限制著他們的學習及升學機會。本研究以香港「兩文三語」的語言環境，以及手語雙語共融教育（Sign Bilingualism and Co-enrollment，SLCO）模式為基礎，探討聾人、弱聽及健聽讀者如何即時處理英語及繁體中文文本。 本研究將採用大規模、自然情境下的眼動追蹤方法，收集以香港手語（HKSL）為主要溝通語言的聾人及弱聽人士，以及健聽同儕的雙語篇章閱讀數據，並建立語料庫。該語料庫將用於構建詞語、短語及小句層面的閱讀處理模型，並識別增加閱讀難度的語言特徵，例如顯著性較低的形態標記、連接詞及小句邊界等。研究所得結果將用以設計對原文干擾程度最低的文本內置輔助閱讀支援，包括清晰標示語句組塊、突出顯示連接詞，以及加入簡短的行內釋義；其後並會透過介入研究，評估有關支援能否提升聾人及弱聽讀者的英語閱讀效率及理解能力。 本研究的成果將包括一個開放取用的雙語閱讀語料庫、相關分析工具、經同行評審的學術論文，以及協助教師推行共融讀寫教學的實用資源。透過建立首個同時涵蓋英語及繁體中文兩種書寫系統、以聾人及弱聽讀者為對象的雙語眼動語料庫，並將研究發現應用於具針對性的教學介入，本研究將首次以大規模、自然情境的方式，全面闡明跨書寫系統的閱讀處理過程。

14625526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14625526.value: 我們是否達成共識？一項關於認知障礙症照顧雙方對症狀嚴重程度及照顧偏好的一致性的混合方法研究

14625526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14625526.value: Prof Chan, Helen Yue-lai Prof Fung, Helene Hoi-lam Prof Irani, Elliane Prof Kwok, Timothy Prof LI, Xiaomin Prof Lou, Vivian Weiqun

14625526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14625526.value: Dementia, the eighth leading cause of death in Hong Kong, is projected to affect over 332,700 older adults by 2039. Person-centered care (PCC), the essence of which is providing care tailored to the needs, preferences, and abilities of persons with dementia (PWDs), is the guiding principle in dementia care internationally. Ensuring that PWDs and family care partners (FCPs) are on the same page is critical for shared care planning, which is core in achieving PCC. However, FCPs’ voices are often prioritized over those of PWDs in clinical practice. This violates PCC and can cause a series of harms to individuals, families, and care outcomes. To promote PCC, this proposed project adopts a dyadic, longitudinal design to examine appraisal congruence (defined as the alignment between PWDs and FCPs in perceptions of symptom severity and care preferences/values) and associated dyadic health outcomes (individual and relational well-being) among care dyads living with early-stage dementia. Potential similarities and differences between spousal and parent–child dyads will be examined to capture diverse dementia care configurations, knowledge that is particularly salient in Chinese societies but remains understudied. The moderating role of Chinese cultural values (i.e., family harmony and interdependence orientation for all dyads and filial piety for parent–child dyads only) will also be tested. This sequential explanatory mixed-methods study has two phases. In Phase 1, we will use validated instruments to collect survey data from 320 dementia care dyads (640 respondents) to assess appraisal (in)congruence, individual and relational well-being, and Chinese cultural values at three time points: baseline [T1], 6 months [T2], and 12 months [T3]. Advanced dyadic analytic techniques, including actor–partner interdependence cross-lagged panel models, latent growth curve modeling, and actor–partner interdependence moderation analysis, will quantify reciprocal relationships between changes in appraisal congruence and individual and relational well-being over time. Phase 2 will involve in-depth qualitative interviews with a purposive subsample of 30 dyads (60 respondents) with varied directions and magnitudes of (in)congruence to gain deeper insights into their experiences. The narrative data will be analyzed using thematic analysis. Theoretically, this proposed study extends Western-dominated dyadic health theories by developing an extended sociocultural dyadic health framework. Practically, the results will inform the key ingredients of targeted dyadic interventions to promote congruence within care dyads. This research also responds to the global call to preserve personhood in dementia care by promoting shared decision-making within family care dyads. 作為香港第八大死因的認知障礙症，預計至2039年將影響超過332,700名長者。以人為本的護理(Person-centered care, PCC) 旨在提供切合認知障礙症患者需求的護理、偏好以及能力，這是國際認知障礙症照顧的核心指導原則。確保認知障礙症患者及其家庭照顧者達成共識，對於共同照護規劃至關重要，而這也是實現以人為本照護理念的核心所在。然而在臨床實務中，家庭照顧者的意見往往比認知障礙症患者的更受重視。此舉違反了以人為本的照顧原則，並可能對個人、家庭及照護結果造成負面影響。為推動以人為本的照護原則，本研究採用雙人縱向研究設計，探討早期認知障礙症照顧雙方之評估一致性（定義為認知障礙患者與家庭照顧者對於症狀嚴重程度及照顧偏好上的一致性），以及雙方的個人及人際關係福祉。本研究將探討配偶和父母與孩子雙方之間的潛在異同，以掌握多元的認知障礙症照顧結構，此知識對於華人社會尤為重要，但現時相關的研究仍然不足。此外，本研究還將檢驗華人文化價值觀（如適用於所有照顧雙方的家庭和諧與相互依存取向，以及僅適用於父子/母子雙方的孝道文化）的調節作用。這項序列性解釋性混合方法研究分為兩個階段。第一階段，我們將使用經過信效度檢驗的量表，於基線、6個月、以及12個月三個時間點，收集320組認知障礙症照護雙方（共640名受訪者）的問卷數據，以檢驗其評估一致性、個人與人際關係福祉以及華人文化價值觀指標。本研究將運用高級雙向分析技術，以量化評估一致性的動態變化與個人及人際關係福祉隨時間轉移的相互關係。第二階段，我們將針對其中30組照顧對子（共60名受訪者）進行目的抽樣，展開深度的質性訪談，以深入瞭解其日常體驗。質性敘事數據將採用主題分析法進行分析。於理論層面，本研究透過擴充社會文化雙向健康框架，豐富以西方為主導的雙向健康理論；於實際層面，研究結果為將制定具有針對性的雙向干預措施提供關鍵要素，以促進照顧雙方意見一致性。同時，本研究回應了透過促進家庭中照顧雙方的共同決策，呼應全球對維護認知障礙症照護中人格尊嚴的呼籲。

14626026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14626026.value: 基因治療的日常倫理：透過多點民族誌與政策實驗室連結生活經驗與政策

14626026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14626026.value: Prof Gu, Shen Prof Zhu, Jianfeng Prof Zhu, Wei

14626026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14626026.value: Gene therapy (GT) represents one of the most transformative frontiers of modern medicine, offering potential cures for diseases once considered untreatable. In China, the field has expanded at an extraordinary pace, driven by strong policy incentives, industrial investment, and scientific ambition. Yet this rapid growth has outpaced the development of coherent ethical and regulatory frameworks, creating uncertainty about what constitutes responsible and equitable practice. While patients and families are increasingly central to GT, participating not only in clinical trials but also in research design, funding, and advocacy, little is known about how ethical norms are formed and enacted in these everyday interactions. This project investigates how ethics is lived and practiced across China’s evolving gene therapy ecosystem. Using the theoretical framework of everyday ethics, it examines the relational and moral dilemmas that arise as GT moves from promise to practice. The study focuses on how patients, families, clinicians, scientists, developers, and regulators negotiate trust, responsibility, autonomy, and care in ordinary spaces such as clinics, laboratories, start-ups, homes, and online communities. By situating ethics in these everyday settings, the project aims to move beyond abstract principles to understand how ethical decisions are made, challenged, and sustained in practice. Methodologically, the project combines multi-sited ethnography with community-based participatory action research (CBPAR) and a two-round Policy Lab to generate empirically grounded and practice-ready ethical guidance. The ethnographic phase will map stakeholder relationships, identify everyday ethical challenges, and analyze how dilemmas are navigated in real-life settings through participant observation, interviews, and digital ethnography. Building on these findings, the Policy Lab will bring together patients, families, clinicians, researchers, industry representatives, and policymakers to co-produce context-specific ethical frameworks and practical tools for governance and implementation. The project’s main outputs will include an ethics consensus statement, role-specific codes of conduct, and a patient-facing decision-support toolkit. These deliverables will translate lived experience into actionable ethical guidance that strengthens governance, enhances transparency, and promotes a more patient-centered and socially accountable model of gene therapy in China. Beyond academia, the project will inform national policy, empower patient communities, and establish a transferable framework for ethical governance in other emerging biomedical fields. By bridging lived experience and policy formation, it aims to ensure that the future of gene therapy in China advances with both scientific integrity and moral responsibility 基因治療（gene therapy, GT）代表現代醫學最具變革性的前沿領域之一，為許多過去被視為無法治療的疾病帶來治癒的可能。在中國，受到強而有力的政策支持、產業投資與科研雄心推動，基因治療領域正以前所未有的速度發展。然而，這種快速增長已超越連貫倫理與監管框架的發展步伐，使何謂負責任且公平的實踐仍存在諸多不確定性。患者及其家庭日益成為基因治療發展中的重要參與者，他們不僅參與臨床試驗，也參與研究設計、資助及倡議；然而，我們對於倫理規範如何在這些日常互動中形成並付諸實踐，仍所知甚少。 本研究旨在探討倫理如何在中國不斷演變的基因治療生態系統中被體驗與實踐。研究以「日常倫理」（everyday ethics）為理論框架，考察基因治療在從科學願景走向實際應用的過程中所產生的關係倫理與道德困境。研究將聚焦於患者、家庭、臨床醫生、科學家、技術開發者及監管者如何在診所、實驗室、初創企業、家庭及網絡社群等日常場域中協商信任、責任、自主與照護。透過將倫理置於這些日常情境之中，本研究旨在超越抽象倫理原則，理解倫理決策如何在實踐中形成、受到挑戰，並得以維繫。 在研究方法上，本研究結合多點民族誌（multi-sited ethnography）、社區為本參與式行動研究（community-based participatory action research, CBPAR），以及兩輪政策實驗室（Policy Lab），以建立具有實證基礎且可直接應用於實踐的倫理指引。在民族誌研究階段，研究將透過參與式觀察、訪談及數位民族誌，描繪不同持份者之間的關係網絡，辨識日常實踐中的倫理挑戰，並分析相關倫理困境如何在真實情境中被理解、協商與處理。在此基礎上，政策實驗室將匯聚患者、家庭、臨床醫生、研究人員、產業代表及政策制定者，共同建構符合具體社會與制度脈絡的倫理框架，以及可用於治理與實施的實務工具。 本研究的主要成果將包括一份倫理共識聲明、針對不同角色制定的行為準則，以及面向患者的決策支援工具包。這些成果將把患者及其他持份者的生活經驗轉化為可付諸行動的倫理指引，以強化基因治療治理、提升透明度，並促進中國建立更加以患者為中心且具社會問責性的基因治療模式。除學術貢獻外，本研究亦將為國家層面的政策制定提供實證依據，賦能患者社群，並為其他新興生物醫學領域建立一套可借鑑及轉移的倫理治理框架。透過連結生活經驗與政策形成，本研究旨在確保中國基因治療的未來發展能夠兼具科學誠信與道德責任。

15100426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100426.value: 補體C3a受體的偏向別構激活促進炎症消退的結構和動態機制研究

15100426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100426.value: Prof CHEN, Geng Prof LEE, Ming-yuen Simon Dr SHEN, Shengnan Dr WANG, Junlin

15100426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100426.value: The complement system produces anaphylatoxins like C3a that bind to the G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) C3aR, a critical regulator of immune homeostasis. Recent structural biology studies on chemoattractant receptors, including C3aR and its close relative C5aR1, have revealed that they exhibit biased signaling. This involves ligand-selective activation that favors Gi/o protein coupling over β-arrestin recruitment. Within the Gi/o pathway itself, a preferential triggering of Gα signaling over Gβγ is thought to contribute to the anti-inflammatory activity, without compromising host defense mechanisms. However, the mechanisms for this fine-grained signaling discrimination remain to be elucidated. While orthosteric ligands can be designed to favor G protein engagement, developing allosteric modulators offers a more sophisticated strategy to fine-tune receptor conformation and selectively promote a single, desired downstream pathway, such as anti-inflammatory Gαi signaling. To address this challenge, our group conducted preliminary cryo-EM studies of an engineered octapeptide (E7) bound to a C3aR-Gi complex. These studies revealed key molecular interactions within the orthosteric pocket, providing a structural scaffold and a starting point for rational peptide design. This project aims to systematically elucidate the molecular basis of C3aR signaling bias and to develop novel peptide-based allosteric modulators that selectively promote anti-inflammatory Gαi signaling. We will employ a multidisciplinary approach that: 1) integrates site-directed mutagenesis, phosphorylation mapping, and high-resolution cryo-EM to characterize the conformational transitions of C3aR from Gi-coupled to β-arrestin-bound states, with special attention to structural determinants of Gα versus Gβγ bias; 2) leverages AI-assisted peptide design platforms to generate and optimize candidate peptides anchored to the E7 motif but engineered for enhanced Gαi selectivity; and 3) validates candidates through in silico screening, followed by synthesis and comprehensive functional validation in cellular assays measuring cAMP inhibition (Gα-mediated), calcium mobilization (Gβγ-mediated), β-arrestin recruitment, and anti-inflammatory activity in both microglia and mast cell models. By integrating structural, computational, and functional methodologies with a specific focus on the dimension of Gαi versus Gβγ signaling discrimination, this research will provide a comprehensive framework for the rational design of next-generation anti-inflammatory therapeutics targeting the complement system. The anticipated outcomes will advance our fundamental understanding of GPCR signaling bias, providing improved selectivity, efficacy, and safety profiles in peptide drug development for anti-inflammatory treatment without compromising host defense functions. 補體系統活化產生的片段C3a通過結合G蛋白偶聯受體（GPCR）C3aR，在調控機體免疫穩態中發揮關鍵作用。近期針對趨化受體的結構生物學研究表明，其信號轉導具有偏向性，在趨化素的作用下，相較於β-arrestin招募，受體活化偏向激活Gi/o信號。我們的前期實驗發現，相较于Gi/o通路內部的Gβγ，促炎症消散信號由Gαi信号優先觸發，其能在不破壞宿主防御機制的前提下發揮促炎症消散活性。該信號分流機制仍有待闡明。儘管設計正構配體可偏向激動Gi信號，別構調節劑可提供選擇性更高的策略，其通過調控受體構象，特異性激活抗炎通路。 我們在前期對一個octapeptide E7結合C3aR偶合Gi蛋白的複合物解析了冷凍電鏡（cryo-EM）結構。預實驗結果提示的正位口袋內關鍵分子相互作用為下游理性設計新型多肽提供了結構骨架與起點。本項目旨在系統闡明C3aR信號偏向性的分子基礎，並開發能夠選擇性促炎症消散的Gαi信號的新型多肽類別構調節劑。我們將採用多學科交叉的研究策略：1）整合定點突變、磷酸化圖譜分析和高分辨率冷凍電鏡技術，表征C3aR從偶聯Gi到招募β-arrestin的構象轉變，重點解析決定Gαi到Gβγ信號偏向性的主要結合位點；2）利用AI輔助的多肽設計平台，基於E7模體設計並優化具有更高Gαi選擇性的候選多肽；3）結合計算機虛擬篩選和化學合成，在小膠質細胞和肥大細胞模型上開展系統的功能驗證，包括cAMP抑制（Gαi介導），鈣離子動員（Gβγ介導），β-arrestin招募及抗炎活性。 本項目將结合結構生物學、計算生物學與受體藥理學方法，聚焦於Gαi和Gβγ的信號分流，為靶向補體系統的下一代促炎症消散藥物的合理設計提供理論框架。預期成果將完善GPCR偏向性信號轉導調控機制的理論，並為開發兼具高靶向性、高療效且不傷害宿主防禦功能的新型抗炎多肽提供理論基礎。

15101626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15101626.value: 角膜環曲性的機制：散光性模糊如何觸發 Rho-ROCK 介導的子午線重塑

15101626.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15101626.value: Dr Kang, Byung Soo Prof TAN, Youhua

15101626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15101626.value: Astigmatism is a common vision problem caused by uneven corneal curvature (corneal toricity). It blurs vision and, in children, is associated with faster axial elongation and worsening myopia. Our five‑year study of more than 10,000 individuals showed that certain types—especially against‑the‑rule (ATR) and higher‑magnitude astigmatism—carry increased risk. With pediatric refractive errors rising after COVID, there is an urgent need to predict which eyes will develop problematic corneal shapes and to actively guide safe, stable corneal reshaping. What is missing is a cornea‑specific chain of events: how orientation‑specific blur (with‑the‑rule, WTR, versus ATR) triggers anterior‑segment changes, alters corneal mechanics, and produces lasting toricity. Our chick studies reveal a critical early window: within 1–3 days, the anterior chamber deepens and the lens thins in ways that depend on blur orientation; over 1–2 weeks, the cornea develops unequal meridians and becomes toric. We also found that highly myopic keratocytes soften, reorganize their cytoskeleton, and adjust contractility, and that these changes reverse when normal vision is restored. Our hypothesis is that orientation‑specific astigmatic blur reconfigures lens thickness and anterior chamber depth within 24–72 hours; these changes predict and drive meridian‑specific corneal stiffness through keratocyte Rho–ROCK–myosin contractility, and targeted modulation of this pathway is necessary and sufficient to control the magnitude and axis of corneal toricity. This proposal tests, links, and translates those insights in three steps. Aim 1 will determine whether early, noninvasive measurements at 48–72 hours forecast the type and amount of astigmatism 1–2 weeks later, yielding biomarkers for corneal reshaping. Aim 2 will demonstrate that blur induces meridian‑specific keratocyte changes (softer cells, higher traction, altered cytoskeleton, denser chromatin) aligned with tissue‑level stiffness differences and corneal toricity. Aim 3 will establish causality by inhibiting ROCK to prevent anisotropy and astigmatism under blur, and by activating contractility in one corneal arc under neutral optics to induce targeted toricity, both reversible. By integrating population evidence with optical, biomechanical, and cellular readouts, this project translates biology into medicine: it delivers early predictors and precise, pathway‑based interventions to control corneal toricity. The outcome will accelerate safer, faster, and more personalized corneal reshaping (including orthokeratology) for high‑risk children and adults. 散光是一種常見的視力問題，主要由於角膜彎曲不平均所致。它會令影像模糊；在兒童身上，亦與眼球過快拉長及近視加深有關。我們一項為期五年、涵蓋逾一萬人的研究顯示，某些散光類型，特別是逆規散光及散光度數較高者，風險更高。新冠疫情後，兒童屈光問題增加，因此急需找出哪些眼睛較容易出現異常角膜形狀，並發展更安全、穩定的方法來引導角膜塑形。 目前仍未清楚的是：不同方向的模糊影像，如何一步步影響眼前段結構、改變角膜的力學特性，最終形成持久散光。我們的雞隻研究發現，這個變化在早期已有關鍵訊號：在1至3天內，前房深度和晶狀體厚度會按模糊方向出現不同改變；在1至2星期內，角膜不同方向的彎曲會變得不一致，形成散光。我們亦發現，高度近視眼中的角膜細胞會變得較軟、內部支架重新排列、收縮力改變，而當視覺恢復正常後，這些變化可以逆轉。 我們的假設是：特定方向的散光模糊，會在24至72小時內改變晶狀體厚度和前房深度；這些早期變化會預示並推動角膜不同方向的硬度改變，而這個過程與角膜細胞的收縮機制有關。若能針對這條生物路徑作調控，便有機會控制散光的程度和方向。 本研究將分三步驗證並轉化這些發現。第一，找出在48至72小時內可量度、又能預測1至2星期後散光類型和程度的早期指標。第二，證明模糊影像會引起角膜細胞及角膜組織在不同方向上的改變。第三，透過抑制或啟動相關細胞收縮機制，直接測試是否能阻止或誘導特定散光，而且效果可逆。 透過結合大規模人群研究，以及光學、力學與細胞層面的數據，本項目希望把基礎生物學轉化為實際醫療應用，提供更早預測及更精準介入的方法，以控制角膜散光。最終目標是加快發展更安全、更快速、更多個人化的角膜塑形方案，包括角膜塑形鏡，幫助高風險兒童及成人。

15101826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15101826.value: 運用可解釋性人工智能與早期脈絡膜視網膜替代生物標記指導個人化近視控制策略

15101826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15101826.value: Prof Ding, Xiaohu Prof HE, Mingguang Prof TSE, Yan Yin Dennis Prof WANG, Shujun Prof Yam, Cheuk Sing Jason

15101826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15101826.value: Myopia has reached epidemic levels worldwide, particularly affecting school-aged children. In Hong Kong, the prevalence is notably high, with a significant percentage of both children and adults affected. To address this, various myopia control therapies have been developed, such as atropine, orthokeratology, multifocal spectacles, and repeated low-level red light (RLRL), each showing varying success rates. However, individual responses to these treatments differ widely, highlighting the need for personalized management strategies. Developing prediction models for myopia treatment response is therefore essential, and AI-assisted models have shown promise in this area. But there remains a lack of reliable, generalizable early predictors and actionable tools to guide timely adjustment in therapy. Our pilot studies have identified choroidoretinal features—including fundus curvature, regional choroidal thickness (ChT), and its rate of change—as promising indicators of treatment response. These biomarkers show potential for predicting outcomes and guiding individualized myopia control strategies. Based on these findings, we propose a two-phase project. In Phase 1, we will integrate data from multiple randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to develop an interpretable AI model capable of predicting myopia control outcomes. This model will be designed for robustness and adaptability across different therapies and clinical settings. Key deliverables will include interpretable surrogate biomarker panels with actionable thresholds, decision rules with explanations for the likelihood of achieving full control, and model cards to facilitate clinical translation. Phase 2 will involve a 12-month pragmatic trial comparing AI-assisted myopia management with standard care, assessing effectiveness, clinical utility and cost-effectiveness of the AI-assisted strategy. Participants will be randomized into the standard-of-care or the AI-assisted groups. Regular assessments of refractive error, axial length, and choroidoretinal imaging will be scheduled at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months. The primary outcome will be the rate of full myopia control, and secondary outcomes will include non-response rates, changes in axial length and refractive error, time to treatment adaptation, acceptability among patients and clinicians, and the cost-effectiveness of the AI-assisted approach. Ultimately, this project aims to deliver a transparent and clinically valuable AI tool that leverages early choroidoretinal signatures to personalize myopia control. By enabling both pre-treatment risk stratification and dynamic therapy adjustment, the tool will support clinicians in making timely, evidence-based decisions for optimal patient care. 近視已在全球呈流行性趨勢，對學齡兒童的影響尤為嚴重。在香港，近視盛行率極高，受影響的兒童及成人比例均相當驚人。為應對此一公共衛生危機，醫學界已發展出多種近視控制療法，如阿托品（Atropine）、角膜塑型術（Orthokeratology）、多焦點眼鏡及重複低強度紅光（RLRL）等，各具不同程度的成效。然而，患者對這些治療的反應個體差異甚大，凸顯了個人化近視管理策略的迫切需求。因此，開發針對近視治療反應的預測模型至關重要，而人工智能（AI）輔助模型在此領域已展現出巨大潛力。但目前仍缺乏可靠且具普適性的早期預測指標，亦欠缺具可操作性的臨床工具來指導治療方案的及時調整。 我們的前期研究已證實，脈絡膜視網膜特徵包括眼底曲率、區域性脈絡膜厚度（ChT）及其變化率為極具潛力的治療反應指標。這些生物標記在預測治療結果及指導個人化近視控制策略上深具潛力。基於上述發現，本團隊提出整合多項臨床試驗的數據，開發一個具備可解釋性（Interpretable）的 AI 模型，用於預測近視控制的成效。該模型的設計將確保其在不同療法與臨床環境中均具備高度的穩健性與適應性。 隨後，將開展一項為期 12 個月的實效性試驗，比較 AI 輔助近視管理與標準臨床護理之差異，並全面評估 AI 輔助策略的有效性、臨床實用性及成本效益。參與者將被隨機分配至標準治療組或AI 輔助組。試驗期間將於第 1、3、6 及 12 個月進行定期追蹤，評估指標包括屈光度數、眼軸長度以及脈絡膜視網膜影像。主要結果指標為近視的完全控制率；次要指標則涵蓋治療無反應率、眼軸與屈光度的變化、治療方案適應所需時間、患者與臨床醫師的接受度，以及該 AI 輔助策略的成本效益。 總而言之，本項目旨在提供一款極具臨床價值的 AI 工具，利用早期脈絡膜視網膜特徵實現近視的個人化管理。透過實現治療前的風險分層與治療期間的動態調整，該工具將有力支援臨床醫師做出及時、具循證基礎的決策，從而為患者提供最佳的醫療照護。

15102126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102126.value: 調控絨毛外滋養層分化的miRNA–mRNA靶標組整合圖譜：子癇前症早期預測研究

15102126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102126.value: Prof Cheung, Ka Wang Prof Chiu, Chi Ngong Dr CHOW, Franklin Wang-Ngai Dr Yung, Hong Wa

15102126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102126.value: Establishing a maternal-fetal interface is crucial for a successful pregnancy. Placentation requires extravillous trophoblast (EVT) invasion and spiral artery remodeling in the first 12 weeks to establish low‑resistance, high‑flow uteroplacental circulation. Failure of this event due to diminished differentiation and function of EVTs results in pregnancy-associated complications such as preeclampsia (PE). PE is a leading cause of maternal and perinatal morbidity/mortality and long-term health complications, placing a substantial burden on healthcare. PE biomarkers can identify high-risk women who benefit from closer monitoring and preventive measures. This is particularly important for early-onset PE where clinical options are limited. However, the time lag between EVT defects and disease detection obscures PE etiology studies. Most existing PE biomarkers stem from the two-stage theory that implicates poor placental perfusion leading to maternal endothelial dysfunction at mid-late pregnancy, thus limiting early detection. Additionally, considering PE's clinical heterogeneity, developing a panel of early prediction biomarkers reflecting different pathophysiological processes is necessary. Integrative analysis incorporates multi-omics data to reveal biomolecular interactions and regulatory networks across different physiological scenarios, enabling the discovery of novel targets for early disease detection and therapy. “Targetome” refers to the interaction network between miRNAs and their mRNA targets. From the trophectoderm onward, differentiation and functions of distinct trophoblast lineages are tightly controlled by miRNA-mRNA pairs, although these interactions have not been systematically characterized. This study employs an integrative approach to elucidate targetome regulation in placental development and PE pathogenesis. First, we will comprehensively map miRNA-mRNA networks during EVT differentiation using CLEAR-CLIP technology and CRISPR screening libraries. Second, we will investigate the functional mechanisms of identified targets through CRISPR-engineered trophoblast models examining spiral artery remodeling processes. Third, we will conduct a clinical study validating targetome biomarkers in early pregnancy maternal serum against established PE screening algorithms. Our preliminary analysis identified miRNA-mRNA pairs involved in EVT differentiation. While SEMA6A exemplifies our biomarker discovery capability, this proposal systematically targets multiple novel markers from different EVT differentiation phases. SEMA6A is exclusively expressed in all trophoblast lineages except EVTs. hsa-miR-455-3p targeted SEMA6A down-regulation is essential for EVT differentiation. Furthermore, SEMA6A is up-regulated in early maternal serum of pregnant women who subsequently developed PE. This project aims to provide novel insights into placental targetome networks in early placental development and PE etiology. 15102826.value: ACAT1/SOAT1作为白色脂肪细胞线粒体功能的新型调节因子

15102826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102826.value: Adipose tissue dysfunction is a central mediator of obesity-related metabolic disorders, driving impaired energy homeostasis, chronic inflammation, and insulin resistance through disrupted lipid handling and inflammatory signaling. White adipose tissue (WAT) "beiging" refers to the process by which WAT gains thermogenic capacity, either through the transdifferentiation of mature white adipocytes into beige adipocytes or by recruiting progenitor cells to differentiate into thermogenic adipocytes. This process results in increased mitochondrial content and upregulation of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1). In humans, beige adipocytes have been detected within brown fat depots and WAT, especially following exposure to cold, β-adrenergic stimulation, or exercise. This adaptation boosts thermogenesis and energy expenditure, resulting in improved glucose and lipid metabolism, insulin sensitivity, and cardiovascular health. However, beiging response is inhibited by obesity, aging, and impaired regulatory pathways, reducing its therapeutic potential. Nevertheless, activation of thermogenic adipose tissue holds great potential in the management of obesity and metabolic disease. Cholesterol homeostasis within adipocytes is a vital determinant of cell and tissue function, mediated by enzymes including acyl-coenzyme A: cholesterol acyltransferase (ACAT1), which catalyzes the formation of cholesteryl ester. While ACAT1 is established in contexts such as neurodegeneration and oncogenesis, its function in obesity and adipose tissue metabolism remains underexplored. Preliminary data demonstrated that cold exposure downregulated ACAT1 in inguinal WAT (iWAT) (not in brown adipose tissue), and that adipocyte-specific ACAT1 knockout mice showed enhanced energy expenditure and increased iWAT beiging during cold challenge, without changes in brown adipose tissue morphology or thermogenic genes. This suggests a distinct regulatory axis for ACAT1 in white adipocyte beiging and energy utilization, distinct from canonical brown fat thermogenesis. The proposed research here will use transgenic mouse models lacking ACAT1 specifically in adipocytes, and primary adipocyte cultures to dissect ACAT1's contribution to mitochondrial thermogenesis, lipid mobilization, and systemic metabolic outcomes. Specific objectives include: 1) functional characterization of ACAT1 in white adipocyte mitochondrial dynamics and thermogenic activation; 2) elucidation of the molecular signaling pathways coordinating cholesterol esterification, beiging, and energy mobilization; 3) assessing whether adipocyte-specific ACAT1 knockout can restore beiging capacity in mice with impaired beiging response. Completion of these studies will advance mechanistic understanding of cholesterol metabolism, lipid mobilization, and mitochondrial thermogenesis in adipocytes, specifically addressing how ACAT1-mediated cholesterol esterification regulates white adipocyte beiging and impacts systemic energy balance. The findings may inform novel therapeutic strategies for metabolic improvement in obesity, leveraging targeted modulation of ACAT1 and the beiging process. 脂肪组织功能障碍是肥胖相关代谢紊乱的核心介导因素，通过扰乱脂质处理和炎症信号传导，驱动能量稳态受损、慢性炎症及胰岛素抵抗。白色脂肪组织（WAT）的“米色化”是指WAT获得产热能力的过程，既可以通过成熟白色脂肪细胞向米色脂肪细胞的转分化实现，也可以通过募集祖细胞分化为产热脂肪细胞来实现。这一过程导致线粒体含量增加及解偶联蛋白1（UCP1）上调。在人类中，米色脂肪细胞已在棕色脂肪库和WAT中被检测到，尤其是在暴露于寒冷、β-肾上腺素能刺激或运动之后。这种适应性变化增强产热和能量消耗，从而改善葡萄糖和脂质代谢、胰岛素敏感性及心血管健康。然而，米色化反应受到肥胖、衰老及调控通路受损的抑制，从而降低了其治疗潜力。尽管如此，激活产热脂肪组织在肥胖和代谢性疾病的管理中仍具有巨大潜力。脂肪细胞内的胆固醇稳态是细胞和组织功能的重要决定因素，由包括酰基辅酶A：胆固醇酰基转移酶（ACAT1）在内的酶介导，该酶催化胆固醇酯的形成。虽然ACAT1在神经退行性变和肿瘤发生等领域已有明确研究，但其在肥胖和脂肪组织代谢中的功能仍未被充分探索。本研究拟利用脂肪细胞特异性ACAT1缺失的转基因小鼠模型及原代脂肪细胞培养体系，深入解析ACAT1对线粒体产热、脂质动员及全身代谢结局的贡献。完成这些研究将推进对脂肪细胞中胆固醇代谢、脂质动员和线粒体产热机制的深入理解，这些发现可能为肥胖症中的代谢改善提供新的治疗策略。

15103526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15103526.value: 真菌病原體 sRNA 經由 AGO 介導之 RNAi 途徑調控人類免疫反應

15103526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15103526.value: Dr Abreu-Goodger, Cei Prof Buck, Amy H Dr Lee, Yin Lau Prof Woo, Patrick Chiu Yat

15103526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15103526.value: Invasive fungal infections cause approximately 1.6 million deaths annually, representing a significant global health concern. Among these, Candidozyma auris (formerly Candida auris) has emerged as a WHO "critical priority" pathogen due to its multi-drug resistance, high mortality, and ability to evade the immune system. The mechanisms underlying its stealth-like pathogenesis remain poorly understood. We hypothesize that C. auris employs a novel cross-kingdom RNA interference (RNAi) strategy to subvert host immunity. We propose that the fungus delivers small RNAs (sRNAs) into host cells, where they hijack the host RNAi machinery, specifically the Argonaute 2 (AGO2) protein, to silence key immune defense genes, thereby promoting fungal survival. Our preliminary data provide strong support for this hypothesis. We show that both genetic knockdown and pharmacological inhibition of host AGO2 in macrophages significantly reduces C. auris survival. Crucially, using AGO2-immunoprecipitation and an optimized AGO2-CLEAR-CLIP sequencing method, we provide the first evidence that fungal sRNAs bind to human AGO2 during infection. We have identified a specific pathogenic sRNA, CausRNA0001, which targets the human immune regulator ELK3. Functional assays confirm that a synthetic mimic of CausRNA0001 increases fungal burden, while a synthetic inhibitor (antagomir) reduces it, demonstrating a direct causal link. This project will systematically dissect this novel pathogenic axis through four primary objectives: 1. Define the essential host and fungal machinery by generating complete AGO2 knockouts (including catalytic mutants) in macrophages and sRNA-deficient (dcr-1Δ) mutants in C. auris. 2. Identify the comprehensive sRNA-target interactome across the infection time course using our optimized AGO2-CLEAR-CLIP workflow to map the host pathways manipulated by fungal sRNAs. 3. Functionally validate the pathogenic role of key sRNAs by assessing the virulence of targeted C. auris sRNA deletion mutants and confirming sRNA-target interactions with luciferase reporter assays. 4. Validate the therapeutic potential of sRNA inhibition in a murine model of systemic infection, testing the efficacy of antagomirs and directly comparing pharmacological intervention with genetic sRNA ablation. By elucidating this new immune evasion mechanism, this work will provide critical proof-of-concept for a new class of RNA-based antifungal therapies. Validating that sRNA antagomirs can reduce disease burden in vivo establishes a clear translational pathway to combat the multi-drug-resistant C. auris, offering an innovative strategy to address a major global health threat. 侵襲性真菌感染每年造成全球約 160 萬人死亡，已成為嚴重的全球公共衛生挑戰。其中，耳芽孢糖酵母（Candidozyma auris，舊稱 Candida auris）因具備多重耐藥性、高死亡率以及逃避免疫的能力，被世界衛生組織（WHO）列為「極高優先級」病原體。然而，其隱蔽的致病機制至今仍不清楚。 本研究假設該真菌利用一種新型的「跨界 RNA 干擾（RNAi）」策略來破壞宿主免疫系統。真菌能將自身的小分子 RNA（sRNA）釋放到宿主細胞內，劫持宿主 RNAi 機制的核心蛋白 AGO2，從而關閉關鍵的宿主免疫防禦基因並促進真菌存活。我們的初步數據為此假設提供了有力支持：在巨噬細胞中關閉宿主 AGO2 能顯著降低真菌存活率；利用優化的定序技術，我們首次證實真菌 sRNA 在感染過程中會直接與人類 AGO2 結合。 本項目旨在系統性地剖析這一新型致病軸心。研究將首先建立宿主 AGO2 缺失與真菌 sRNA 缺失的細胞模型以釐清分子機制，並全面繪製受真菌 sRNA 干擾的宿主免疫通路圖譜。隨後，我們將透過實驗驗證關鍵 sRNA 的致病功能，並進一步評估核酸抑制劑在感染環境下確認其阻斷感染的有效性。本研究揭示了新型的真菌免疫逃逸機制，將為開發新一代基於 RNA 的抗真菌療法提供關鍵的概念驗證（Proof-of-Concept），為應對超級真菌 C. auris 的多重耐藥危機開闢創新的治療路徑。

15104126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15104126.value: 評估塑膠污染對沿海生態系統中抗真菌耐藥性的影響

15104126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15104126.value: Prof Bank, Michael Prof JIN, Ling Nathanael Prof Rillig, Matthias

15104126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15104126.value: Plastic pollution is a rapidly intensifying environmental crisis that threatens both ecosystems and human health. Beyond their physical presence, plastics form distinct ecological niches, referred to as the plastisphere, that selectively accumulate and transport microorganisms and their functional traits. Previous studies reported that the plastisphere harbors bacterial pathogens and antibiotic resistance genes, raising One Health concerns across human, animal, and environmental domains. Our preliminary research reveals that plastics also host a high abundance of fungal pathogens. Given that antifungal resistance is now recognized as an emerging global health threat, a critical question arises: do plastics act as mobile reservoirs for antifungal-resistant fungi, accelerating their emergence and spread? This project will integrate large-scale field surveys, laboratory experiments, and genomic analyses to address this question. We will collect plastic debris and corresponding seawater, sediment, and substrate controls (e.g., wood, glass, stone) from six representative coastal habitats in Hong Kong—urban beaches, mangrove wetlands, mariculture zones, ports, estuaries, and wastewater-affected sites—across wet and dry seasons. We will use metagenomic sequencing to identify fungal taxa, pathogens, and antifungal resistance genes using curated reference databases, and will validate these results through fungal culture and susceptibility testing. Laboratory evolution experiments will expose key fungal pathogens to plastics with different polymer types and weathering levels and non-plastic surfaces (e.g., glass, wood, stone) over multiple generations to test whether the plastisphere environment promotes resistance development. In parallel, controlled microcosm trials will introduce plastic particles pre-colonized by antifungal-resistant fungi into simplified aquatic food webs, tracing the spread of resistance from the plastisphere to environmental media and organisms. This interdisciplinary approach will produce the first comprehensive map of antifungal resistomes associated with the coastal plastisphere. This approach will elucidate the mechanisms by which plastics shape resistance dynamics, determine high-risk polymers and environmental drivers, and identify vulnerable ecosystems. Findings will fill critical knowledge gaps at the interface of environmental science and medical mycology, advancing understanding of how plastics may exacerbate microbial threats. This research supports several UN Sustainable Development Goals, including SDG 3 (Good health and well-being), SDG 6 (Clean water and sanitation), SDG 12 (Responsible consumption and production), and SDG 14 (Life below water). Ultimately, this project will inform One Health–based strategies to mitigate plastic pollution and antifungal resistance risks while protecting marine ecosystems and public health. 塑膠污染已成為全球性的環境問題，對生態系統與人類健康構成日益嚴峻的威脅。塑膠除了以固體廢棄物形式存在外，亦能在水體中形成獨特的微生物棲息生態位，即所謂的「塑膠圈」（plastisphere），該生態位可選擇性富集並傳播微生物及其功能基因。既有研究指出，塑膠圈內攜帶有細菌性病原體及抗生素抗藥性基因，引發涵蓋人類、動物及環境層面的「同一健康」（One Health）隱憂。本研究團隊前期工作揭示，塑膠表面同時承載高豐度之真菌性病原體。鑒於抗真菌耐藥性已被世界衛生組織列為新興的全球健康威脅，關鍵科學問題由此衍生：塑膠是否扮演抗真菌耐藥性真菌之移動載體，進而加速其出現與擴散？ 為解答此一問題，本項目將整合大規模野外調查、控制性實驗及基因組分析等多元方法。研究將於香港六處代表性沿海棲地（包括都市海灘、紅樹林濕地、水產養殖區、港口、河口及受生活污水影響之區域），於濕季與乾季期間採集塑膠碎屑及其對應之海水、沉積物，以及天然基質對照樣本（如木材、玻璃、石材）。我們將採用宏基因組測序技術，搭配經人工校閱之參考資料庫，鑑定真菌類群、病原體及抗真菌耐藥性基因，並輔以真菌分離培養及藥敏試驗進行驗證。在演化實驗方面，將使關鍵真菌病原體暴露於不同聚合物類型與風化程度之塑膠，以及非塑膠表面（玻璃、木材、石材），歷經多世代連續培養，以檢視塑膠圈環境是否促進抗藥性之演化。同時，我們將建構微宇宙模擬系統，將預先由抗真菌耐藥性真菌定殖之塑膠顆粒引入簡化水生生態食物網，追蹤抗藥性由塑膠圈向環境介質及生物體傳播之途徑。 本跨學科研究將繪製首張與沿海塑膠圈相關之抗真菌耐藥基因組圖譜，闡明塑膠如何調控抗藥性動態之機制，辨識高風險聚合物類型及關鍵環境驅動因子，並評估脆弱生態系統之敏感度。研究成果將填補環境科學與醫學真菌學交叉領域之關鍵知識缺口，深化對塑膠如何加劇微生物健康威脅之理解。本研究亦呼應多項聯合國可持續發展目標，包括目標3（良好健康與福祉）、目標6（清潔飲水與衞生設施）、目標12（負責任消費與生產）及目標14（水下生物）。最終，本項目將為基於「同一健康」架構之塑膠污染與抗真菌耐藥性風險減緩策略提供科學依據，同時保護海洋生態系統及公共健康。

15104326.label: Project Title(Chinese)

15104326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15104326.value: Oocyte quality is fundamental to mammalian reproduction. Ca2+ mobilization is recognized as a key signaling event in oocytes, the regulatory mechanism(s) of which, however, remain largely unclear, especially during oocyte development and maturation. The epithelial Na+ channel (ENaC) encoded by human genes, SCNN1A, SCNN1B and SCNN1G, is best known for its role in Na+ and water absorption in epithelial cells. Recently, ENaC has been related to female reproduction given the noted infertility in women with loss-of-function mutation of ENaC genes. We demonstrated previously that ENaC regulates Ca2+ mobilization in uterine/ovarian somatic cells required for embryo implantation and ovarian steroidogenesis. Although in literatures Xenopus oocytes were used to study overexpressed exogenous ENaC genes, whether mammalian oocytes have endogenous expression of ENaC that could be physiologically important to oocyte function and competence has not been explored. In our preliminary analysis, we have established a mouse model with oocyte-specific knockout of ENaC (Gdf9-Cre; Scnn1a-flox), which revealed that deficiency of ENaC in oocytes resulted in significant reduction in female fertility and altered Ca2+ signaling associated genes and responses in isolated mouse developing (GV stage) oocytes. We therefore hypothesize that endogenous expression of ENaC in oocytes might be essential to oocyte competence by contributing to Ca2+ signaling during oocyte development. To test the hypothesis, we plan to use the established oocyte-specific ENaCα knockout (Gdf9-Cre; Scnn1a-flox) mouse model in combination with experimental technologies including in vitro oocyte maturation, in vitro fertilization, in vivo oocyte Ca2+ imaging, intra-ovary injection, oocyte patch-clamp and Na+ imaging, ovarian single-cell RNA sequencing to 1) determine whether the endogenous ENaC expression in oocytes is required for oocyte competence; 2) determine the role of oocyte endogenous ENaC in regulation of oocyte Ca2+ mobilization; and 3) elucidate downstream signaling of ENaC-regulated oocyte Ca2+ mobilization required for oocyte competence. The results from the proposed study will demonstrate previously undefined role(s) of oocyte endogenous ENaC in mammalian oocyte development, providing new insights into the understanding of oocyte development and maturation at a molecular level. Given the observation that human developing oocytes exhibit similar ENaC expression and Ca2+ activities, the results of the project will have clinical/human relevance to potentially facilitate the development of new treatment or diagnostic strategies for related female infertility/subfertility as well as the advancement of assisted reproductive technology. 卵母細胞品質為哺乳動物生殖之基礎。鈣動員被認為是卵母細胞中的關鍵信號事件，然而其調控機制，尤其是在卵母細胞發育與成熟過程中的調控機制，目前仍不清楚。上皮鈉通道（The Epithelial Na⁺ Channel, ENaC）由人類基因 SCNN1A、SCNN1B 及 SCNN1G 編碼，最為人熟知的功能是在上皮細胞中調控鈉離子與水分吸收。近年來，ENaC 被發現與女性生殖相關，因攜帶 ENaC 基因功能喪失性突變的女性表現出不孕症。我們前期研究已證明，ENaC 可調控子宮與卵巢體細胞中的鈣動員，而此過程對胚胎著床與卵巢類固醇生成為必需。雖然文獻中曾利用非洲爪蟾卵母細胞研究過表達的外源性 ENaC 基因，但哺乳動物卵母細胞是否具有內源性 ENaC 表達，以及該表達是否對卵母細胞功能與發育能力具有生理重要性，迄今尚未被探索。在我們的初步分析中，我們已建立卵母細胞特異性 ENaC 基因剔除小鼠模型（Gdf9-Cre; Scnn1a-flox）。該模型顯示，卵母細胞中 ENaC 缺失導致雌性生育力顯著下降，並使分離的發育中（GV 期）小鼠卵母細胞中鈣信號相關基因表現與鈣反應發生改變。因此，我們提出假說：卵母細胞中內源性 ENaC 的表現可能透過參與卵母細胞發育過程中的鈣信號調控，而對卵母細胞發育能力至關重要。 為驗證該假說，我們計畫利用已建立的卵母細胞特異性 ENaCα 基因剔除小鼠模型（Gdf9-Cre; Scnn1a-flox），結合體外卵母細胞成熟、體外受精、體內卵母細胞鈣影像分析、卵巢內注射、卵母細胞膜片鉗記錄、鈉離子影像分析及卵巢RNA 測序等實驗技術，以達成以下目標：1）確定卵母細胞內源性 ENaC 表達是否為卵母細胞發育能力所必需；2）闡明卵母細胞內源性 ENaC 在調控卵母細胞鈣動員中的作用；3）解析 ENaC 所調控之卵母細胞鈣動員的下游信號路徑，及其對卵母細胞發育能力之必要性。 本研究結果將揭示卵母細胞內源性 ENaC 在哺乳動物卵母細胞發育中此前未被認識的功能，從分子層面為理解卵母細胞發育與成熟提供新的見解。鑑於我們觀察到人類發育中卵母細胞呈現相似的 ENaC 表現與鈣活動特徵，本計畫成果將具有臨床與人類生殖醫學相關性，有望為相關女性不孕／低生育力之診療策略開發以及輔助生殖技術之進步提供新的思路。

15105026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15105026.value: 閒聊- 教育介入措施對提升老年慢性病患者家庭照顧者參與預設醫療照顧計劃之成效

15105026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15105026.value: Prof Chan, Helen Yue-lai Dr Chen, Wai Tsan Dr Chen, Weilin Ms Chui, Ling Yi Prof Leung, Doris Yin Ping Prof MAK, Yim Wah Dr Ng, Lai Han Betty Prof WANG, shanshan

15105026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105026.value: Advance care planning (ACP) empowers medically vulnerable, yet mentally capable older adults with multimorbidity to make proactive end-of-life (EOL) decisions. Despite its importance, ACP engagement remains low, especially in Chinese communities, where cultural taboos surrounding death often hinder open discussion. Currently, most ACP interventions concentrate solely on the proactive communication regarding EOL care with patients but lack sufficient engagement of family caregivers. Family caregivers play a pivotal role in the ACP process but often lack relevant information and frequently feel ill-equipped to initiate these conversations during the time triggering the ACP discussion for older adults with multimorbidity, resulting in potential conflict and delayed decision-making. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the Chit-Chat -Educational (CC-ed) intervention- a novel, culturally sensitive program designed from the perspective of Chinese family caregivers. The CC-ed comprises three core components: 1) education on chronic disease progression, 2) insights into EOL care realities, and 3) introduction to ACP and training in practical communication skills for ACP discussions. In a two-arm randomised controlled trial, 504 family caregivers of community-dwelling older adults with multimorbidity will be assigned to either the CC-ed intervention group or an active placebo-control group. The intervention group will attend two 2.5-hour, face-to-face CC-ed sessions spaced one month apart. The control group will receive general geriatric care education of equivalent duration and an ACP information leaflet. The primary outcome is the change in family caregivers’ ACP engagement, assess using the ACP Engagement Survey. Secondary outcomes include improvement in ACP knowledge and caregiver- reported ACP communication. Data will be collected at baseline (T0), immediately post-intervention (T1), and at 6-month (T2) and 12-month (T3) follow-ups. A mixed-methods process evaluation, including semi-structured interviews with a purposive sample of 20 participants, will explore the intervention’s mechanisms of impact. This study is innovative in its focus on empowering family caregivers on ACP engagement within a Chinese cultural context. Findings will offer robust evidence on the sustainability and clinical utility of the CC-ed intervention, presenting a -scalable, community-based model to enhance ACP engagement, reduce caregiver burden, and improve EOL care outcomes. 預設醫療照顧計劃對患有多種慢性疾病（多重共病）的長者至關重要。它有助於身體較為脆弱但心智能力仍然健全的長者，透過與家人及醫療服務提供者溝通，預先作出生命末期決定。儘管益處良多，長者對此的參與度仍然偏低。 研究指出，患有多重共病長者的家庭照顧者需要更多關於預設醫療照顧計劃的知識及準備。如何對話這一點尤其重要，因為這能減少生命末期決策衝突，並間接提升病人的參與度。現有的介入措施僅從病人角度關注預設醫療照顧計劃，未能讓家庭照顧者參與及投入有關死亡與生命末期的議題。雖然許多華人仍避談死亡（因常被視為不吉利），但越來越多意見認為應正視這類議題。因此，我們設計了一項嶄新且具文化敏感度的「閒聊- 教育介入措施」。此措施特別從家庭照顧者的角度出發，包含三個核心組成部分：1）慢性疾病管理軌跡教育；2）對生命末期照護實況的洞悉；以及 3）開展及引導預設醫療照顧計劃對話的實用溝通技巧訓練。 這項兩組隨機對照試驗將評估 後 介入措施的成效。我們將招募 504 名社區居住之多重共病長者的家庭照顧者。參與者將隨機分配至 閒聊- 教育 介入組（接受兩次相隔一個月、每次 2.5 小時的面對面預設醫療照顧計劃教育課程）或安慰劑對照組（接受同等時間的一般老年護理教育課程及一份預設醫療照護計劃單張）。 主要成效指標為家庭照顧者參與度的變化，以「預設醫療照護計劃參與度調查問卷」測量。次要結果指標為預設醫療照顧計劃知識的變化，以問卷進行評估。結果指標將於基線、立即完成介入措施後、6 個月及 12 個月追蹤時測量。我們將透過混合方法過程評估，對 20 名立意取樣的參與者進行半結構式訪談，以深入探討介入措施的優勢、限制及影響機制。 本研究的原創性在於聚焦於華人文化背景下，增強多重共病長者之家庭照顧者參與預設醫療照顧計劃的對話能力。研究結果將展示 「閒聊- 教育介入措施」的持續性及臨床意義，為研究人員及政策制定者提供實施實證為本的社區式預設醫療照顧計劃之策略。預期此研究能提升香港市民的預設醫療照顧計劃參與度，從而減輕照顧者對多重共病長者有關死亡與生命末期決策負擔，並改善多重共病長者的生命末期照顧成效。

15105426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15105426.value: 家長施行小兒推拿對比行為睡眠介入改善注意力不足過動症兒童睡眠障礙的效果：一項非劣效性隨機對照試驗及混合方法過程評估

15105426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15105426.value: Prof Chung, Oi Kwan Joyce Dr Lam, Chun Sing Prof Lao, Lixing Dr Lo, Kwai Ching Mr Wu, Guo Tao Prof Yeung, Wing-Fai Prof Zhang, Dexing Dr Zhang, Xuan

15105426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105426.value: Among Hong Kong children, attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) affects 5-9%, with 70-85% experiencing sleep disturbance that exacerbates symptoms and impairs treatment outcomes. Parent-administered pediatric tuina (PPT), an accessible and non-pharmacological manual therapy prevalent in China, has demonstrated promising effects for ADHD-related sleep disturbances through current evidence and our preliminary trials. However, robust evidence from large-scale trials comparing standardized PPT with conventional interventions remains lacking, impeding its integration into clinical practice guidelines for sleep disturbance in children with ADHD. This proposed randomized controlled trial, incorporating a mixed-methods process evaluation, aims to: (1) evaluate the effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of PPT compared to behavioral sleep intervention (BSI) and waitlist control in children aged 4-8 years with ADHD-related sleep disturbance, (2) identify facilitators and barriers to parent adherence, and (3) explore the specific effects of PPT on sleep disturbance and ADHD symptoms beyond shared therapeutic components. We will recruit 270 parent-child dyads, comprising children (aged 4-8 years) with an established ADHD diagnosis. Participants will be randomized (1:1:1) to receive PPT, BSI, or waitlist during a 12-week study period. In the PPT group, parents will receive a standardized 2-hour face-to-face training session on 5 evidence-based manipulations, followed by an 8-week home-based intervention protocol. In the BSI group, parents will attend 4 structured face-to-face sessions and complete 8 self-paced learning modules on sleep hygiene and behavioral management of ADHD over 8 weeks. The waitlist group will maintain routine care during the study period. The primary outcome is children’s sleep disturbance, assessed via the Sleep Disturbance Scale for Children at weeks 4, 8, and 12. Secondary outcomes include ADHD symptoms via the Swanson, Nolan, and Pelham Scale, quality of life via the Pediatric Quality of Life Inventory, parenting stress via the Parenting Stress Index, and objective sleep parameters (total sleep time, sleep efficiency, sleep onset latency) via actigraphy. A mixed-methods process evaluation will examine intervention acceptability (via standardized questionnaires), adherence (via daily logbooks), feasibility (via semi-structured focus group interviews), and safety (via adverse event monitoring). Cost-effectiveness analysis will assess intervention-related costs and healthcare utilization. This study will evaluate a standardized PPT program comprising five evidence-based manipulations. Unlike conventional pediatric tuina, which relies on individual practitioners' clinical expertise, this novel approach offers a standardized and replicable intervention protocol. The findings will provide robust evidence regarding the effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of PPT compared to BSI, potentially offering an accessible, non-pharmacological intervention for pediatric ADHD in community settings. 注意力不足／過度活躍症（ADHD）影響全球約5–7%的兒童，在香港的患病率則約為5–9%。睡眠障礙影響70–85%的ADHD兒童，會顯著加劇其核心症狀，並削弱治療成效。家長施行小兒推拿（parent-administered pediatric tuina, PPT）是一種在中國廣泛應用、具可及性且成本較低的手法治療方法；根據現有證據及我們的初步試驗結果，該方法對改善與ADHD相關的睡眠障礙顯示出良好潛力。然而，現時仍缺乏大型試驗就標準化PPT與傳統介入方法作出比較的有力證據，因而妨礙其納入ADHD兒童睡眠障礙的臨床實踐指引之中。 本研究擬進行一項隨機對照試驗，並納入混合方法的過程評估，旨在：（1）評估PPT相較於行為睡眠介入（behavioral sleep intervention, BSI）及候補名單對照在改善4至8歲ADHD相關睡眠障礙兒童方面的效果及成本效益；（2）識別影響家長依從性的促進因素與阻礙因素；以及（3）探討PPT在共同治療成分以外，對睡眠障礙及ADHD症狀所產生的特定作用。 本研究將招募270對親子組合，納入已確立ADHD診斷的4至8歲兒童及其家長。參加者將以1:1:1的比例隨機分配至PPT組、BSI組或候補名單對照組，並於12週研究期間接受相應安排。PPT組家長將接受一節兩小時的面授標準化培訓，學習5項具實證基礎的推拿手法，其後按照為期8週的居家介入方案進行操作。BSI組家長將參加4節結構化面授課程，並於8週內完成8個有關睡眠衛生及ADHD行為管理的自學單元。候補名單對照組則於首8週維持常規照護，其後接受4週隨訪。 主要結果指標為兒童的睡眠障礙，並於第4、8及12週以兒童睡眠障礙量表（Sleep Disturbance Scale for Children）作評估。次要結果指標包括：以Swanson, Nolan, and Pelham量表評估ADHD症狀；以兒童生活質素量表（Pediatric Quality of Life Inventory）評估生活質素；以親職壓力量表（Parenting Stress Index）評估家長壓力；以及透過活動記錄儀（actigraphy）測量客觀睡眠參數，包括總睡眠時間、睡眠效率及入睡潛伏期。混合方法過程評估將檢視介入的可接受性（透過標準化問卷）、依從性（透過每日紀錄冊）、可行性（透過半結構式焦點小組訪談）及安全性（透過不良事件監測）。成本效益分析則將評估與介入相關的成本及醫療服務使用情況。 本研究將評估一項由五種具實證基礎推拿手法組成、針對ADHD兒童睡眠障礙的標準化PPT方案。有別於傳統小兒推拿較依賴個別中醫師的臨床經驗，此嶄新方法提供一套標準化且可複製的介入方案。研究結果將為PPT相較於BSI的效果及成本效益提供有力證據，並有望為社區中此一常見情況提供一種具可及性的非藥物介入選擇。

15105726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15105726.value: 解析 CRYAB/BAG3/HSF1 正向回饋迴路：肝細胞癌自噬介導藥物抗性的新機制

15105726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105726.value: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the sixth most commonly diagnosed cancer and the third leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. Recent advancements in molecular-targeted therapies have transformed treatment for advanced HCC. Sorafenib, approved in 2007, was the only multi-kinase inhibitor (MKI) until lenvatinib was approved in 2018 as a first-line treatment for unresectable cases. However, the therapeutic benefits of these drugs are limited by the development of drug resistance. Understanding the mechanisms behind this resistance is crucial. Conventional proteomics often averages protein changes across heterogeneous tumor populations, potentially missing critical variations. The advent of spatial proteomics can reveal differences in protein expression between distinct tumor regions, offering insights into the complex mechanisms of drug resistance. For this purpose, we analyzed protein expression in our two established drug-resistant patient-derived tumor xenografts (PDTXs) with enhanced stemness using spatial proteomic techniques. This revealed heterogeneous protein enrichment across tumor regions, highlighting HCC's complexity. Notably, Crystallin Alpha B (CRYAB) was significantly upregulated in both xenografts, exhibiting the highest fold-change and consistent expression across different tumor regions, suggesting it as a potential therapeutic target for overcoming drug resistance. CRYAB, a small heat shock protein, acts as a molecular chaperone protecting cells from stress. Its role in tumorigenesis is gaining attention, as it is overexpressed in various cancers, including HCC. However, its specific function and molecular mechanisms in HCC remain largely uncharacterized. In our pilot study, we found that CRYAB is preferentially expressed in drug-resistant HCC cells, with elevated CRYAB mRNA levels correlating to poorer survival outcomes. Genetic knockdown experiments showed that suppressing CRYAB sensitized cells to cancer stemness-induced drug resistance. Using HitPredict and immunoprecipitation, we confirmed that CRYAB directly interacts with and stabilizes BAG3, a key protein in the autophagy pathway. Additionally, in silico predictions suggest that HSF1 may upregulate CRYAB expression, while BAG3 influences the nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of HSF1. Subsequent functional analyses underscored the essential role of CRYAB in regulating autophagy. Based on our data, we hypothesize that CRYAB is a key regulator of drug resistance in HCC, modulating the autophagic pathway through the CRYAB/BAG3/HSF1 positive feedback loop. Our proposal aims to: (1) characterize CRYAB's role in drug resistance, (2) elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, and (3) evaluate the clinical significance of CRYAB and its correlation with autophagic markers in HCC. This work reveals novel insights into CRYAB's function in drug resistance and highlights the potential of spatial proteomics to understand drug resistance mechanisms in cancer.

15106326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15106326.value: 解锁PLAC9的奥秘：维持代谢和谐与促进肝脏健康的新型关键调控因子

15106326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15106326.value: Prof Lui, Pauline Po-yee Prof ZOU, Xiang

15106326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15106326.value: Diabetes mellitus and metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) represent major global health challenges, characterized by profound disruptions in glucose and lipid metabolism. Recent bioinformatics investigations have unveiled Placenta Specific 9 (PLAC9) as a novel metabolic regulator intricately linked to obesity and metabolic dysfunction. Notably, PLAC9 expression is significantly upregulated in adipose tissue of obese individuals and demonstrably decreases following bariatric surgery, underscoring its pivotal role in metabolic homeostasis. Corroborating clinical data reveal that circulating PLAC9 levels exhibit a positive correlation with body weight and cholesterol levels, while inversely associating with key glycaemic markers, suggesting a potential compensatory and regulatory response in metabolic disease states. Our preclinical studies employing murine models demonstrate that PLAC9 overexpression substantially improves glucose tolerance, alleviates dyslipidaemia, and mitigates hepatic injury, highlighting its multifaceted protective effects. Advanced biochemical and molecular approaches, including crosslinking pull-down mass spectrometry and transcriptomic analyses, will be harnessed to delineate PLAC9’s interacting protein networks and downstream signalling pathways. This comprehensive research program is structured around three strategic objectives: (1) to delineate the cellular origins and metabolic target cells of PLAC9, with a focus on the stromal vascular fraction of adipose tissue and hepatic cells; (2) to mechanistically dissect PLAC9’s hepatoprotective functions through modulation of the transcription factor C/EBPα, enhancement of antioxidant defence systems, and regulation of cell cycle pathways; and (3) to rigorously evaluate the long-term therapeutic efficacy and safety of PLAC9 in combined diet-induced obesity and chemical liver injury models, incorporating histopathological, transcriptomic, and immunological assessments. Leveraging a multidisciplinary collaboration with expertise spanning metabolic physiology, immunology, and translational medicine, this project endeavors to establish PLAC9 as a critical metabolic hormone with transformative potential.
