First, prediction aims to include more features to improve forecasting/prediction accuracy, whereas decision-makers often focus on key features that drive their decisions. This conflict necessitates an optimized and interpretable choice of features, while creating modeling and computational complexity. Second, real-world data may not accurately characterize the underlying uncertainty, leading to non-robust and risky decisions. This matters even more when retaining a few key features; any error/drift in those features may disproportionately sway decisions. Third, many OM problems unfold over multiple stages: as dynamics evolve, the relevance of features and recommended decisions can change. Meanwhile, managers prefer a relatively stable set of key features to minimize data-acquisition and solution-implementation costs. However, when focusing on a few key features, significant swings across stages (e.g., geopolitical changes) can cause increased instability and implementation burden. To address these challenges, this project constructs a unified framework for robust and time-consistent decision-making by identifying key features that tightly couple prediction with optimization. First, we develop an integrated framework with explicit cardinality constraints based on decision-makers’ domain knowledge to identify key features aligned with decision-aware objectives. To tackle the computational difficulty, we design tailored reformulations/algorithms that enable efficient and practical implementation. Second, we develop robust counterparts of our framework with data-driven ambiguity sets to handle historical data under uncertainty. Using tractable reformulations, we provide scalable solution methods that ensure reliable performance. Third, we design multi-stage time-consistent models that adapt to gradual dynamics while limiting erratic period-to-period changes (e.g., feature turnover), avoiding overreactions to transient/spurious features. We solve these models via efficient decomposition procedures to enhance solution implementability. We aim to deliver scalable, interpretable, robust, and dynamic methods that align prediction with operational objectives, advancing both methodological foundations and the practical impact of data-driven OM. These methods can deliver tangible benefits to both industry and society, including reduced costs/risks and more stable long-term operations. 在運營管理的數據驅動決策框架中，機器學習模型通常用於預測未知參數，隨後由優化模型將預測結果轉化為運營決策。然而，在這種將預測與優化分開處理的「先預測、後優化」框架下，最小化預測誤差並不一定能夠最小化決策損失。例如，在庫存管理中，最小化均方預測誤差會對高估與低估予以同等處理，但缺貨成本往往高於存貨剩餘成本。因此，未考慮決策目標的預測可能產生準確的預測結果，卻導致欠佳的訂貨決策。這促使決策者將預測與優化相結合，以降低決策誤差。 然而，有效整合預測與優化面臨三項挑戰。第一，預測通常傾向納入更多特徵，以提高預測的準確性；而決策者則往往聚焦於真正驅動決策的關鍵特徵。這一衝突要求以優化且具可解釋性的方式選擇特徵，但同時也增加了建模與計算的複雜性。第二，現實世界的數據未必能夠準確刻畫潛在的不確定性，因而可能導致風險較高的決策。當模型僅保留少數關鍵特徵時，這一問題尤其重要，因為這些特徵中的任何誤差或漂移均可能對決策產生較大影響。第三，許多運營管理問題涉及多個階段：隨著動態環境不斷演變，特徵的相關性及對應決策亦隨之改變。同時，管理者通常傾向維持一組相對穩定的關鍵特徵，以降低數據獲取及方案實施的成本。然而，當決策集中於少數關鍵特徵時，不同階段之間的重大變化（例如地緣政治變化）可能導致更大的不穩定性，並加重實施負擔。 為應對上述挑戰，本項目透過識別能夠緊密連結預測與優化的關鍵特徵，構建一個魯棒且時序一致的決策框架。首先，我們將根據決策者的領域知識，引入明確的基數約束，建立整合框架，以識別符合決策感知目標的關鍵特徵。為克服計算困難，我們將設計針對性的模型重構方法及算法，以實現高效且切合實際的應用。第二，我們將利用數據驅動的模糊集，建立魯棒優化模型，以處理存在不確定性的歷史數據。透過可處理的模型重構，我們將提供具可擴展性的求解方法，以確保可靠的決策表現。第三，我們將設計多階段、具時序一致性的模型，使其能夠適應逐步變化的動態環境，同時限制不同時期之間不規則的變動（例如特徵更替），避免模型對短暫或虛假的特徵作出過度反應。我們將透過高效的分解程序求解這些模型，以提升方案的可實施性。 本項目旨在開發具可擴展性、可解釋性、魯棒性及動態適應能力的方法，使預測與運營目標保持一致，從而推進數據驅動運營管理的方法論基礎及其實際影響。這些方法可為業界和社會帶來切實效益，包括降低成本與風險，以及實現更穩定的長期運營。

15511726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511726.value: 從感知到行動：宏觀經濟不確定性對個人投資者預期的影響

15511726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15511726.value: Prof Liu, Yang Prof Wang, Pang

15511726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511726.value: In recent years, global geopolitical tensions and unprecedented disaster events have heightened macroeconomic uncertainty. This uncertainty significantly influences retail investors, whose growing market presence impacts overall financial stability. Previous studies show that standard (first-moment) macroeconomic variables such as GDP growth can significantly impact asset prices and market returns (Amromin and Sharpe, 2014; Deng et al., 2025). However, it remains unclear how macroeconomic uncertainty (second-moment variables) influences investors’ risk perceptions and portfolio choices. Investigating these questions has been challenging. First, macroeconomic uncertainty and investors’ expectations can endogenously influence each other. Second, macroeconomic uncertainty often accompanies rapid macroeconomic shocks, making it difficult to disentangle the impact of first-moment and second-moment economic conditions (Coibion et al. 2024). Additionally, reliance on survey-based evidence in previous studies creates a gap between measuring perceived uncertainty and observing actual portfolio decisions. To overcome these challenges, this project will employ Randomized Control Trials (RCTs) in partnership with a major Hong Kong discount broker. We will exogenously vary the macroeconomic information a subset of retail investors receives, creating a clean test to identify causal effects on their risk perceptions and portfolio choices. To guarantee the credibility of our experimental treatments, the heterogeneous macroeconomic information will be sourced from credible, published forecasts by different leading investment banks. Moreover, we will survey a diverse group of retail investors with varying levels of income, education, investment experience, and risk tolerance, and investigate their actual trading decisions after the macroeconomic information treatment. By analyzing both survey responses and subsequent real trading data, we will directly link stated beliefs to actual investment behavior. Is economic uncertainty a catalyst or a signal for caution? The answer may depend on the option value of postponing investment under the macroeconomic context in which uncertainty arises. We propose that macroeconomic uncertainty has an asymmetric effect on investors. During an economic upturn (with optimistic first-moment GDP growth), uncertainty can amplify optimism, as investors focus on the potential for greater upside gains. Conversely, during a downturn (with pessimistic first-moment GDP growth), the same uncertainty magnifies pessimism and highlights downside risks, prompting investors to retreat. This critical first-moment economic context may determine whether second-moment macroeconomic uncertainty encourages retail investors’ risk-taking or triggers aversion. 近年來，全球地緣政治緊張局勢加劇，加上一系列前所未有的災害事件，顯著推升了宏觀經濟不確定性。宏觀經濟不確定性會對散戶投資者產生重要影響；與此同時，隨著散戶投資者在金融市場中的參與程度不斷提高，其投資行為對整體金融穩定的影響亦日益受到關注。既有研究表明，GDP增長預期等反映宏觀經濟預期水平的一階矩，能夠顯著影響資產價格與市場回報（Amromin and Sharpe, 2014；Deng et al., 2024）。然而，反映預測離散程度的二階矩（即宏觀經濟不確定性）如何影響投資者的風險認知與投資組合選擇，目前仍缺乏清晰且具因果識別力的研究證據。 研究上述問題面臨多項挑戰。第一，宏觀經濟不確定性與投資者預期之間可能存在雙向因果關係。第二，宏觀經濟不確定性的上升往往伴隨快速且劇烈的宏觀經濟衝擊，因此難以區分宏觀經濟預期水平（一階矩）與其不確定性（二階矩）各自產生的影響（Coibion et al., 2024）。此外，既有研究大多依賴問卷調查證據，因而難以判斷投資者所陳述的主觀不確定性感知能否轉化為實際的投資組合決策。 為克服上述識別難題，本項目擬與香港一家大型互聯網折扣券商合作開展隨機對照試驗（randomized controlled trials，RCTs）。我們將以外生方式改變部分散戶投資者所接收的宏觀經濟資訊，藉此建立具有清晰識別條件的實驗框架，估計不同宏觀經濟資訊對投資者風險認知及投資組合選擇的因果效應。為確保實驗干預的可信度，不同實驗組所接收的差異化宏觀經濟資訊將取自多家領先投資銀行正式發佈的權威預測。 本研究將結合問卷調查結果與實驗干預後的真實交易數據，直接連結投資者所陳述的主觀信念與其實際投資行為。研究樣本將涵蓋收入水平、教育程度、投資經驗及風險承受能力各異的散戶投資者，並追蹤其在接受宏觀經濟資訊干預後的實際交易決策。經濟不確定性究竟是促進風險承擔的催化劑，還是提示投資者保持審慎的風險訊號？答案可能取決於不確定性所處的宏觀經濟環境，以及在該環境下延遲投資所具有的選擇權價值。我們提出，宏觀經濟不確定性對投資者具有非對稱影響。在經濟上行期，即GDP增長預期較為樂觀時，不確定性可能進一步強化投資者的樂觀情緒，因為投資者會更加關注潛在的上行收益空間。相反，在經濟下行期，即GDP增長預期較為悲觀時，同等程度的不確定性可能放大投資者的悲觀預期並凸顯下行風險，促使其減少風險資產配置或退出市場。因此，宏觀經濟不確定性究竟會鼓勵風險承擔，還是引發風險規避，關鍵取決於其所處的宏觀經濟情境。

15511826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511826.value: 當笑話冷場時：職場幽默失敗如何引發面子威脅與行為反彈

15511826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511826.value: Workplace humor, while often used to build rapport and ease tensions, carries inherent risks—failed attempts can damage the joke-teller’s professional image and workplace relationships. Despite humor’s ubiquity in worklife, we know surprisingly little about how joke-tellers respond when their humor falls flat. This research examines the psychological and behavioral consequences of failed workplace humor from the joke-teller’s perspective, addressing a critical gap in humor research that has predominantly focused on audience reactions. Drawing on face theory (Goffman, 1967), we propose that joke-tellers’ perceptions of audience reactions to failed humor—ranging from overt criticism to blank stares to forced smiles—shape their experience of face threat and subsequent workplace behaviors. We theorize that negative reactions (explicit disapproval) and neutral reactions (non-engagement) threaten joke-tellers’ face more severely than polite but inauthentic positive reactions (courtesy laughs). These perceived face threats, we argue, trigger counterproductive workplace behaviors (CWBs) as joke-tellers either confront their audience (approach-oriented CWBs) or withdraw from future interactions (avoidance-oriented CWBs). We then identify expressed humility—acknowledging limitations, appreciating others, and demonstrating teachability—as a remedy that can interrupt this destructive cascade. Our research program comprises four pre-registered experimental studies. A pilot study (N = 142) provided initial support, showing that negative audience reactions increased perceived face threats, which in turn predicted both approach- and avoidance-oriented CWBs. Study 1 will replicate these findings with 800 Chinese employees, testing the model in a high face-concern culture. Study 2 will experimentally manipulate audience reactions through vignettes to establish causality. Study 3 will employ a novel social-interactive paradigm where participants share humor with an AI chatbot programmed to deliver standardized reactions, enabling real-time behavioral measurement of CWBs. Study 4 will test expressed humility as an intervention, examining whether guided reflection exercises that promote humility can buffer against face-threat-driven CWBs. This research makes three key contributions. First, we advance organizational humor theory by adopting an actor-centric perspective, revealing how joke-tellers’ subjective interpretations drive behavioral responses. Second, we extend face theory by demonstrating how momentary communication failures can escalate into workplace behaviors that damage relationships and productivity. Third, we identify expressed humility as a practical intervention, offering organizations a pathway to transform potentially destructive moments into opportunities for connection and growth. Our findings will inform workplace communication training and provide evidence-based strategies for navigating the inevitable awkward moments that punctuate organizational life. 職場幽默雖然常被用於建立融洽關係、緩解緊張氣氛，但也伴隨著固有風險。失敗的幽默嘗試可能損害說笑話者的職業形象與職場關係。儘管幽默在工作生活中無所不在，我們對說笑話者在幽默「冷場」後如何反應卻所知甚少。本研究從說笑話者的視角出發，考察職場幽默失敗的心理與行為後果，填補了幽默研究長期以聽眾反應為主要關注點而留下的重要空白。 基於面子理論（Goffman, 1967），我們提出，說笑話者對聽眾針對失敗幽默的反應的感知——從公開批評、面無表情，到勉強的微笑——會形塑其面子威脅體驗及後續職場行為。我們的理論主張是：負面反應（明確表達不認可）與中性反應（毫無回應）對說笑話者面子的威脅，比出於禮貌但並不真誠的正面反應（應酬式笑聲）更為嚴重。我們進一步論證，這些感知到的面子威脅會引發反生產工作行為（CWB）：說笑話者或與聽眾正面對抗（趨近型CWB），或迴避未來的互動（迴避型CWB）。隨後，我們指出表達謙遜——承認自身侷限、欣賞他人、展現可教性——可作為一種補救措施，阻斷這一破壞性的連鎖反應。 本研究計畫包含四項預先註冊的實驗研究。一項前導研究（N = 142）提供了初步支持：負面聽眾反應增強了感知面子威脅，進而預測趨近型與迴避型兩類CWB。研究一將以800名中國員工為樣本重複驗證上述發現，在高面子關注文化中檢驗該模型。研究二將透過情境短文實驗操弄聽眾反應，以確立因果關係。研究三將採用一種新穎的社會互動範式，讓參與者向一個被設定為給出標準化反應的AI聊天機器人分享幽默，從而對CWB進行即時行為測量。研究四將檢驗表達謙遜作為介入手段的效果，考察促進謙遜的引導式反思練習能否緩衝面子威脅所驅動的CWB。 本研究有三項主要貢獻。第一，我們採用行動者中心視角推進組織幽默理論，揭示說笑話者的主觀解讀如何驅動其行為反應。第二，我們拓展面子理論，展示瞬間的溝通失敗如何升級為損害關係與生產力的職場行為。第三，我們將表達謙遜確立為一項可操作的介入措施，為組織提供一條路徑，把潛在的破壞性時刻轉化為建立連結與促進成長的契機。研究結果將為職場溝通訓練提供依據，並為因應組織生活中無可避免的尷尬時刻提供具實證基礎的策略。

15512026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512026.value: 数字教育平台中人工智能的应用：用户参与、技能发展与平台政策的因果证据

15512026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512026.value: Digital transformation is reshaping the education industry, with online platforms now driving innovation, strategy, and market competition. These platforms facilitate new forms of interaction between students and instructors, while evolving engagement strategies and technologies continue to redefine the delivery and value of educational services. The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools marks a new phase in this transformation, influencing how users engage, learn, and develop essential capabilities. While AI offers substantial gains in productivity, crucial questions remain about its long-term effects on independent problem-solving, creativity, and authentic skill development, especially in the context of digital platforms. This study is among the first to provide large-scale, causal evidence on how sustained AI usage in academic settings influences both AI-assisted learning and authentic, unaided problem-solving. Using data from a nationwide dual-function education platform that supports coursework submissions with AI access and hosts contests in which AI use is strictly prohibited, we trace student adoption of and engagement with AI, and map subsequent impacts on skill development. We apply a state-of-the-art large language model algorithm to identify AI adoption and measure usage intensity, and use a four-year staggered difference-in-differences framework to estimate the causal impact of AI engagement on learning outcomes across diverse student segments. A comprehensive user survey further uncovers attitudinal and behavioural mechanisms underlying AI engagement and adaptation. To provide actionable guidance for platform strategy and policy, we conduct a randomized controlled experiment via the platform, randomly assigning classes registered for the same course to alternative AI-use guidelines (e.g., AI caution, reflection promotion, standard practice) and examining the effects on engagement and skill development. By integrating advanced data analytics, survey insights, and experimental evidence, this study provides causal evidence of how AI adoption shapes user engagement and skill development. The findings offer managerial implications for platform designers, business strategists, and policymakers seeking to optimize capability formation and long-term value creation through AI integration. More broadly, the research addresses the global challenge of leveraging AI to foster sustainable skill development, creativity, and problem-solving in digital marketplaces. 数字化转型正在重塑教育行业，在线平台如今已成为推动创新、战略与市场竞争的重要力量。这些平台促进了学生与教师之间新型互动方式的形成，而不断演进的参与策略、平台政策与技术也持续重新定义教育服务的提供方式及其价值。生成式人工智能工具的快速扩散标志着这一转型进入了新阶段，并正在影响用户的参与、学习以及关键能力的发展。 尽管 AI 有潜力提升生产效率，但其对独立解决问题、创造力以及真实技能发展的长期影响仍存在关键疑问，尤其是在数字平台情境下。本研究旨在提供大规模的因果证据，考察在学术环境中持续使用 AI 如何同时影响 学生借助AI 辅助来学习的效果和在真实情境下非辅助的解决问题的能力。 我们基于一个全国性教育平台的数据展开研究：该平台一方面支持带有 AI 访问功能的课程作业提交，另一方面举办严格禁止使用 AI 的竞赛。我们追踪学生对 AI 的采用与使用参与情况，并分析其对后续技能发展的影响。研究采用最先进的大语言模型算法识别 AI 采用情况并衡量使用强度，同时估计 AI 参与对不同学生群体学习结果的因果影响。同时，通过全面的用户调查，进一步揭示 AI 使用的行为机制。 为了进一步可以为平台战略与政策提供可操作的指导，我们借助该平台设计一组随机对照实验，考察AI知道政策对学生的AI使用和能力发展方面的影响。 通过整合先进的数据分析、调查洞见与实验性证据，本研究提供有关 AI 采用如何塑造用户参与和技能发展的因果证据。研究结果为平台设计者、商业战略制定者以及政策制定者提供用户洞察和管理启示。

15512326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512326.value: 欧盟强迫劳动监管对中国新能源汽车供应链的影响

15512326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512326.value: Global supply chains are facing new compliance risks, where a single violation can lead to market exclusion. The European Union’s Regulation (EU) 2024/3015 on Prohibiting Products Made with Forced Labour requires companies to ensure full traceability across all production stages and prohibits goods made under noncompliant working conditions. This regulation has major implications for China’s new energy vehicle (NEV) industry, which is now the country’s fastest-growing export sector to Europe. However, its upstream supply chains in batteries and critical minerals remain highly exposed to labour-related risks. This project studies how Chinese NEV supply chains respond to the EU regulation in three areas. The first is sourcing, examining whether firms diversify suppliers and reduce dependence on high-risk upstream nodes. The second is logistics, assessing whether EU-bound shipments experience longer lead times after enforcement but achieve more stable delivery once compliance systems are in place. The third is production, testing whether firms increase automation and reduce reliance on overtime to meet compliance requirements. The study builds a model–month panel combining data from MarkLines supplier records, customs declarations, vessel tracking data, and recruitment information. A difference-in-differences approach compares EU-bound and non-EU product flows before and after enforcement, supported by event studies and matching tests. The project introduces compliance-driven disruption as a new type of supply chain risk. It provides evidence on how mandatory traceability changes firms’ sourcing, logistics, and production practices, offering insights for managing sustainability and regulatory challenges in global markets. 全球供应链正面临新的合规风险，单一违规行为也可能导致产品被排除在重要市场之外。欧盟《禁止强迫劳动产品进入欧盟市场条例》（Regulation (EU) 2024/3015）要求企业确保产品在所有生产阶段具有可追溯性，并禁止在不合规劳动条件下生产的商品进入欧盟市场。该条例对中国新能源汽车产业具有重要影响。新能源汽车是中国增长最快的对欧出口行业之一，但其上游供应链，尤其是电池和关键矿产环节，仍可能面临较高的劳动合规风险。本项目研究中国新能源汽车供应链如何应对欧盟强迫劳动监管，重点关注三个方面。第一是采购调整，考察企业是否会分散供应商，并降低对高风险上游节点的依赖。第二是物流表现，评估面向欧盟市场的产品在监管执行后是否会经历更长的交付周期，以及在合规体系建立后交付是否趋于稳定。第三是生产调整，检验企业是否会通过提高自动化水平、减少对加班劳动的依赖等方式来满足合规要求。项目将构建车型—月份层面的面板数据，整合 MarkLines 供应商记录、海关申报数据、船舶追踪数据和招聘信息。研究将采用双重差分方法，比较监管实施前后面向欧盟和非欧盟市场的产品流向变化，并结合事件研究和匹配检验进行稳健性分析。本项目将“合规驱动的供应链中断”作为一种新的供应链风险类型加以研究。项目将提供实证证据，揭示强制性可追溯要求如何改变企业的采购、物流和生产实践，并为企业应对全球市场中的可持续发展要求和监管挑战提供启示。

15512526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512526.value: 柔性結構下供應多元化的三階段魯棒優化

15512526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512526.value: Process flexibility has long been recognized as a critical supply chain strategy, allowing firms to adapt swiftly and effectively to uncertain demand. In recent years, the focus has broadened to mitigating supply uncertainty as global supply chains confront heightened exposure to disruptions caused by geopolitical tensions, natural disasters, and pandemics. Flexible configurations, a particular type of two-tier supply chain network, allow each plant to serve multiple products and, beyond that, enable each product to be sourced from multiple plants. This reconceptualizes flexibility: shifting from enhancing capacity utilization through demand pooling to safeguarding resilience through supply diversification, now a strategic priority for supply chain leaders. While academic research has extended process flexibility to incorporate supply uncertainty, most studies remain confined to two-stage models where supply and demand are realized simultaneously. Such models overlook the sequential nature of uncertainty and the information dependency of allocation decisions, where capacity is typically allocated after supply availability is observed but before demand is realized. We propose a three-stage framework that explicitly models sequential uncertainty and foregrounds supply diversification. This framework not only reflects practice more faithfully but also disentangles diversification from demand pooling, forging a conceptual bridge between process flexibility and sourcing flexibility. The proposal comprises two work packages (WPs). The first (WP1), primarily analytical, evaluates the performance of a notable chaining configuration, called "k-chain,'' under sequential realizations of supply and demand ambiguity, deriving allocation policies and performance guarantees. A particular focus is to understand whether the sparse yet efficient long chain (i.e., 2-chain) remains effective or whether greater connectivity (e.g., the 3-chain) is required. The second (WP2), prescriptive in nature, develops models and scalable algorithms for optimal capacity configuration under general flexible structures. These algorithms integrate distributionally robust optimization with advanced decomposition techniques and will be validated through large-scale experiments and industry-inspired case studies. This proposal seeks to advance the theory of process flexibility beyond demand pooling, establish performance guarantees for diversification-oriented designs, and develop tractable algorithms for practical supply chain configuration. The findings are expected to enrich the academic literature and provide actionable insights into managerial practice on the interplay among process flexibility, supply diversification, and resilience. 柔性製造一直被視為重要的供應鏈策略，有助企業迅速及有效應對需求的不確定性。近年，全球供應鏈日益受到地緣政治局勢緊張、自然災害及疫情等因素影響，研究重點亦逐步擴展至供應不確定性及中斷風險。 柔性結構是一種連接生產單位與產品的網絡，讓每個生產單位可供應多種產品，而每種產品亦可由多個生產單位供應。此概念將柔性製造的作用，由透過需求整合提升產能運用，擴展至透過供應多元化加強供應鏈韌性。後者亦為供應鏈管理的重要策略。儘管現有研究已將供應不確定性納入生產流程靈活性模型，大部分仍採用供應與需求同時實現的兩階段框架，未能充分反映不確定因素的先後次序，以及分配決策對資訊的依賴。實際上，產能分配一般在供應情況明確後、需求實現前作出。 本研究提出一個三階段框架，明確反映供應與需求不確定因素的先後次序，並以供應多元化為核心。此框架更切合實際運作，亦能區分供應多元化與需求整合，從而連繫柔性製造與採購靈活性。 研究分為兩個工作項目。第一項以理論分析為主，評估供應及需求不確定因素依次實現時，(k)-鏈結構的表現，並推導分配策略及表現保證，重點研究結構精簡而高效的長鏈是否仍然有效，或是否需要採用連接度較高的結構，例如三鏈。第二項以決策方法為主，為一般靈活結構開發可擴展的最優產能配置算法。相關算法結合分佈穩健優化及先進分解方法，並會透過大型數值實驗及參照業界情況的案例研究進行驗證。 本研究旨在將生產流程靈活性理論由需求整合拓展至供應多元化，為以多元化為導向的配置建立表現保證，並開發具實際可行性的供應鏈配置算法。研究成果預期可推進相關理論發展，並就柔性製造、供應多元化及供應鏈韌性之間的關係，提供具體的管理啟示。

15512826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512826.value: 中美科技政策冲击下的企业信息披露：制度与信号视角

15512826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15512826.value: Prof Lo, Chris K Y Lo Prof Tang, Christopher S.
rows: Prof Lo, Chris K Y Lo

15512826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512826.value: In this project we will study how techno-nationalism (TN) has reshaped corporate disclosure and market reactions among U.S.–listed technology and manufacturing firms from 2015 to 2025. To reflect the rapid cadence of U.S.–China technology policy, where actions can be introduced, revised, or superseded within days, we will construct a continuous, quarterly techno-policy shock pressure that aggregates official measures across export controls, entity-list changes, investment screening, standards and data governance, and strategic guidance. We will pair this pressure with LLM-parsed earnings-call transcripts to quantify TN signal strength and specificity, and we will fix firm TN exposure at baseline along three channels, TN orientation, technology sensitivity, and supply-chain dependence on China (subsidiaries in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan), and integrate it with the shock pressure in firm- and time-fixed-effects panels. Event study and robustness checks will be adopted to test the results. Theoretically, the design links institutional theory (coercive/normative/mimetic pressures) with signaling theory (strong/specific signals). Practically, the results will deliver a replicable TN shock pressure measure and text-based diagnostics that inform procurement, compliance, and investor-relations strategies for firms and policymakers in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan and help anticipate how U.S. partners communicate under tightening regimes. 本项目旨在研究2015年至2025年期间，科技民族主义（Techno-nationalism, TN）如何重塑美国上市科技及制造企业的信息披露行为及资本市场反应。鉴于中美科技政策变化迅速，相关政策措施可能在短时间内出台、修订或取代，本研究将构建一个连续的季度科技政策冲击压力指数，综合出口管制、实体清单调整、对外投资审查、技术标准与数据治理以及战略政策导向等官方政策措施，以刻画科技政策环境的动态变化。 本研究将结合大型语言模型（LLM）解析的企业业绩说明会（earnings call）文本，量化企业科技民族主义信息披露的信号强度（signal strength）和信号具体性（signal specificity），并从三个维度构建企业基准科技民族主义暴露程度，包括企业科技民族主义导向、技术敏感性，以及对中国供应链的依赖程度（包括位于中国内地、香港及台湾地区的子公司布局）。随后，将上述指标与科技政策冲击压力指数结合，建立包含企业固定效应和时间固定效应的面板模型，并结合事件研究法（event study）及多项稳健性检验，分析科技政策冲击、企业披露策略及市场反应之间的关系。 在理论上，本研究融合制度理论（强制性、规范性与模仿性压力）与信号理论（信号强度与信号具体性），解释企业在科技政策环境变化下的信息披露行为及其经济后果。在实践上，本研究将形成可复制的科技政策冲击压力测度体系及基于文本分析的诊断工具，为企业采购、合规管理、投资者关系管理以及政府部门制定相关政策提供参考，并帮助中国内地、香港及台湾地区的企业和政策制定者更好地理解和预测美国合作伙伴在科技政策持续收紧背景下的信息披露策略。

15513326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15513326.value: 我应该从审计工作开始职业生涯吗？初始审计经历的长期职业影响

15513326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15513326.value: Audit is a common entry point for accounting graduates. Drawing on large-scale resume data, I identify approximately 120,000 graduates who begin their careers in audit; yet more than 80% leave within five years, typically transitioning to corporate accounting, finance, or non-finance roles. Despite the prevalence and acceptance of this path (Levenson et al. 2010), little systematic evidence exists on whether starting in audit constitutes an effective career strategy that enhances long-term development. This project provides the first causal evidence on how initial audit experience shapes long-term career trajectories. To address the endogeneity of career choices, I exploit local audit office openings, closures, and mergers as exogenous shocks that shift graduates’ likelihood of starting in audit. This setting enables a causal interpretation of the effect of audit entry on subsequent career outcomes. I construct a matched sample of audit starters and comparable non-audit starters and track their career development over time. The analysis addresses five key questions: (1) Does initial audit experience lead to distinct career paths relative to non-audit starters? (2) Does it result in superior career outcomes in terms of compensation, rank, and employer size? (3) How persistent are these effects over the career horizon? (4) Do the effects vary by Big 4 versus non-Big 4 affiliation, audit tenure, and educational background? (5) Through which channels does initial audit experience shape future career outcomes? This study makes four contributions. First, it advances research on human capital and career development in accounting and auditing (e.g., Knechel et al. 2021; Condie et al. 2023; Ahn et al. 2025) by providing, to the best of my knowledge, the first causal evidence on how initial audit experience shapes future career trajectories. Second, it extends the literature on the economic consequences of audit experience (Custódio and Metzger 2014; Hoitash et al. 2016; Chi et al. 2017) by shifting the focus from (ex-)partners’ decision-making to the career welfare of staff auditors. Third, it contributes to the broader labor economics literature on the lasting effects of early career choices (Topel and Ward 1992; Dustmann and Meghir 2005; Oreopoulos et al. 2012) by examining audit as a distinctive and influential first job. Finally, the findings offer timely insights for students weighing career options, firms addressing recruitment and retention challenges, and policymakers confronting labor shortages in the accounting profession. 审计是会计专业毕业生常见的职业起点。基于大规模简历数据，我识别出约12万名以审计作为首份工作的毕业生；然而，其中超过80%的人会在五年内离开审计行业，通常转向企业会计、金融或非金融类岗位。尽管这一职业路径十分普遍且被广泛接受（Levenson et al. 2010），目前仍缺乏系统性证据来回答：以审计开启职业生涯，是否是一项能够促进长期职业发展的有效策略。 本项目首次提供关于初始审计经历如何影响长期职业轨迹的因果证据。为解决职业选择的内生性问题，我利用当地审计事务所办公室的设立、关闭和合并，作为影响毕业生进入审计行业概率的外生冲击。该研究设计使我能够对进入审计行业对后续职业结果的影响作出因果解释。我构建了一个由审计职业起步者和具有可比特征的非审计职业起步者组成的匹配样本，并长期追踪其职业发展。实证分析重点回答以下五个问题：（1）与非审计职业起步者相比，初始审计经历是否会使个人形成不同的职业路径？（2）初始审计经历是否会带来更优的职业结果，包括更高的薪酬、职位等级和雇主规模？（3）这些影响在整个职业生涯中具有多强的持续性？（4）这些影响是否因四大会计师事务所与非四大会计师事务所经历、审计任职年限以及教育背景而异？（5）初始审计经历通过哪些机制影响未来的职业结果？ 本研究具有四方面贡献。第一，本研究推进了会计与审计领域关于人力资本和职业发展的研究（例如，Knechel et al. 2021；Condie et al. 2023；Ahn et al. 2025）。据我所知，本研究首次提供关于初始审计经历如何塑造未来职业轨迹的因果证据。第二，本研究拓展了关于审计经历经济后果的文献（Custódio and Metzger 2014；Hoitash et al. 2016；Chi et al. 2017），将研究重点从前任或现任审计合伙人的决策行为，转向基层审计人员自身的职业福祉。第三，本研究通过将审计视为一种具有鲜明特征且影响深远的首份工作，进一步丰富了劳动经济学中关于早期职业选择长期影响的研究（Topel and Ward 1992；Dustmann and Meghir 2005；Oreopoulos et al. 2012）。最后，本研究的发现可为正在权衡职业选择的学生、面临招聘与人才留任挑战的企业，以及应对会计行业劳动力短缺问题的政策制定者提供及时且具有现实意义的参考。

15513626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15513626.value: 航空公司漂綠行為的建模與數據驅動評估：對航空公司營運及最優監管策略的影響

15513626.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15513626.value: Prof Chen, Tiantian Prof FU, Xiaowen Prof Qi, Wei

15513626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15513626.value: As environmental awareness among air passengers grows, airlines increasingly highlight their sustainability credentials through initiatives such as voluntary carbon offsetting (VCO) programs and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) adoption. However, insufficient regulatory oversight has led to mounting concerns over "greenwashing", where airlines exaggerate their environmental performance to mislead and attract environmentally conscious passengers. While recent regulatory crackdowns in Europe have targeted high-profile cases, anti-greenwashing legislation in major markets like mainland China and Hong Kong remains underdeveloped. Existing research has primarily focused on airline green investment and emission reduction, but has not systematically modeled the market mechanisms of airline greenwashing or provided actionable guidance for effective regulation design, leaving a critical gap in both academic understanding and policy practice. This project develops an integrated, data-driven framework to systematically evaluate airline greenwashing and its implications for airline operations and regulatory design. The research is structured into three interrelated modules. Module 1 establishes game-theoretic models to analyze strategic interactions among airlines, environmentally conscious passengers, and regulators, focusing on how government policies, such as greenwashing penalties and enforcement effort, can balance incentives for airline's true green investment with protection of passengers. The model examines how market competition, passenger preferences shape market equilibrium and identifies regulation design that maximize social welfare. However, the effectiveness of these strategies depends on accurate measurement of greenwashing and understanding of passenger responses, which will be addressed in Module 2. Module 2 develops large language model (LLM)-empowered toolkits to empirically identify and quantify airline greenwashing by integrating multi-source, heterogeneous data from booking websites, sustainability reports, and operational records. It also employs LLM-based agents as virtual passengers to simulate diverse passenger responses to airline greenwashing, enabling robust estimation of demand impacts across complex market scenarios. The empirical outputs from Module 2 are used to calibrate the game-theoretic model in Module 1, ensuring evidence-based regulatory recommendations. Module 3 applies the integrated framework to the mainland China and Hong Kong aviation markets, providing the first systematic measurement of airline greenwashing in these regions, evaluating its effects on market equilibrium and generating regulatory implications for this market. This project advances the literature by combining economic modeling and AI-driven analytics to uncover the mechanisms and welfare impacts of airline greenwashing. It delivers an evidence-based toolkit for regulators to design targeted, socially optimal interventions, providing scientific and practical guidelines that support sustainable transformation of the aviation sector in mainland China, Hong Kong, and beyond. 隨著航空旅客的環保意識日益提高，航空公司越來越多透過自願碳抵銷(voluntary carbon offsetting, VCO) 計劃及採用可持續航空燃料 (sustainable aviation fuel, SAF) 等措施，展示其可持續發展表現。然而，由於監管不足，市場對「漂綠」(greenwashing) 的關注日益增加，即航空公司可能誇大其環保表現，以誤導並吸引具環保意識的旅客。儘管歐洲近期已針對若干高調案例加強監管執法，但在中國內地及香港等主要市場，反漂綠相關法規仍有待完善。現有研究主要集中於航空公司的綠色投資與減排行為，尚未系統性地建模分析航空公司漂綠的市場機制，亦未能為有效監管設計提供具可操作性的指引，因而在學術理解及政策實踐方面均存在重要缺口。 本項目將建立一個整合式、數據驅動的研究框架，以系統評估航空公司漂綠行為及其對航空公司營運與監管設計的影響。研究包括三個相互關聯的模組。模組一將建立博弈論模型，分析航空公司、具環保意識的旅客及監管者之間的策略互動，重點研究政府政策（如漂綠罰則及執法力度）如何在激勵航空公司進行真正綠色投資與保護旅客利益之間取得平衡。該模型將考察市場競爭及旅客偏好如何影響市場均衡，並識別可最大化社會福利的監管設計。然而，這些策略的有效性取決於對漂綠行為的準確量度及對旅客反應的理解，這將由模組二處理。模組二將開發由大型語言模型（large language model, LLM）賦能的工具套件，透過整合來自訂票網站、可持續發展報告及營運記錄等多源異質數據，實證識別並量化航空公司的漂綠行為。同時，模組二將採用基於大型語言模型的智能體作為虛擬旅客，模擬不同類型旅客對航空公司漂綠行為的反應，從而在複雜市場情境下穩健估計其需求影響。模組二所得的實證結果將用於校準模組一的博弈論模型，以確保監管建議具備實證基礎。模組三將把上述整合框架應用於中國內地及香港航空市場，首次對這些地區的航空公司漂綠行為進行系統性量度，評估其對市場均衡的影響，並提出適用於相關市場的監管啟示。 本項目透過結合經濟建模與人工智能驅動的數據分析，揭示航空公司漂綠行為的形成機制及其福利影響，從而推進相關文獻發展。項目亦將為監管機構提供一套以證據為基礎的工具，以設計具針對性且符合社會最優的干預措施，並提供科學及實務指引，支持中國內地、香港及其他地區航空業的可持續轉型。

15514426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15514426.value: 报童模型的多重面向：基于报童模型的企业社会责任研究

15514426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15514426.value: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) has become an essential consideration for firms seeking to address the welfare of stakeholders beyond their business interests. This project explores how a buyer, modeled as a newsvendor, can strategically improve the welfare of two critical yet often overlooked populations: 1) upstream underprivileged workers employed by its supplier and 2) downstream underserved consumers who cannot afford its products. Both populations are highly interacted with the industries of essential goods—such as garment workers in Bangladesh, farm workers in California, and medical device assemblers in Malaysia—alongside the persistent reliance of vulnerable populations on donated products. The interplay between these two populations—increased product consumption can raise wages for workers and boost employment opportunities, while greater production volumes can make products more accessible to consumers—creates opportunities for firms to fulfill their social responsibility through the supply chain. We theoretically model a supply chain with a buyer caring about the two populations and its supplier seeking profit maximization. Our model emphasizes wage improvements for upstream underprivileged workers and product donations to downstream underserved consumers who cannot afford products, in contrast to the focus on the surplus of consumers with purchasing power. Considering that a supplier could be incentivized to raise wages when its buyer increases order quantities, we explore how a buyer can improve the welfare of upstream underprivileged workers through effective bargaining strategies with wage subsidies. Observing that a firm's pre-committed donations not only benefit downstream underserved consumers but can also stimulate demand by attracting affluent customers with social consciousness, we investigate how the buyer can balance its profit with the welfare of underserved consumers through pre-committed donations and unsold donations, using a general stochastic demand function. Furthermore, we analyze the interplay between the upstream and downstream CSR initiatives, to understand how the quantity of products produced and consumed links the welfare of both populations through the buyer’s decisions and CSR concerns. By thoroughly examining the effectiveness of different bargaining strategies and product donation schemes, we evaluate how welfare is allocated between the two populations and how profits are distributed between the two firms. Our findings can offer actionable insights for firms aiming to balance profit with broader social impact through supply chain management. This project contributes to the CSR literature in supply chain management by emphasizing the importance of often-overlooked stakeholders and integrating them into the newsvendor model. 企业社会责任（Corporate Social Responsibility，CSR）已成为企业在商业利益之外回应利益相关者福祉诉求时必须考虑的重要议题。本项目考察作为报童型决策者的采购商如何通过战略性决策，改善两类重要但常被忽视的群体的福祉：一是受雇于其供应商的上游弱势劳动者；二是无力购买其产品的下游弱势消费者。这两类群体与基本生活必需品行业密切相关，例如孟加拉国的制衣工人、美国加利福尼亚州的农业工人以及马来西亚的医疗器械装配工人；与此同时，弱势群体对捐赠产品的长期依赖也广泛存在。这两类群体之间存在相互关联：产品消费的增加能够促进劳动者工资水平的提高并创造更多就业机会，而生产规模的扩大则有助于提升消费者获得产品的可及性。这种关联为企业通过供应链履行社会责任提供了新的可能。 本文从理论上构建了一个供应链模型，其中，采购商同时关注上述两类群体的福祉，而供应商以利润最大化为目标。不同于既有研究主要关注具有购买能力消费者的消费者剩余，本文重点考察上游弱势劳动者的工资改善，以及面向无力购买产品的下游弱势消费者的产品捐赠。考虑到采购商增加订购量可能激励供应商提高工资水平，本文研究采购商如何通过有效的议价策略与工资补贴改善上游弱势劳动者的福祉。与此同时，企业预先承诺的产品捐赠不仅能够惠及下游弱势消费者，还可能通过吸引具有社会责任意识的富裕消费者而刺激市场需求。基于这一现象，本文在一般随机需求函数下，研究采购商如何通过预先承诺捐赠与滞销品捐赠，在自身利润与服务不足消费者福祉之间实现权衡。此外，本文进一步分析上游与下游企业社会责任举措之间的相互作用，以揭示产品生产量与消费量如何通过采购商的运营决策及其社会责任关切，将两类群体的福祉联系起来。 通过系统考察不同议价策略与产品捐赠机制的有效性，本文评估社会福祉如何在上述两类群体之间配置，以及利润如何在供应链上下游企业之间分配。研究结论可为企业通过供应链管理协调利润目标与更广泛的社会影响提供具有可操作性的管理启示。本项目通过强调供应链中经常被忽视的利益相关者，并将其纳入报童模型分析框架，拓展了供应链管理领域的企业社会责任研究。

15514926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15514926.value: 裁員倖存者加入對在職團隊成員協作行為情感影響的自然準實驗研究

15514926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15514926.value: In recent years, mass layoffs have become a defining feature of the global economy. In the United States alone, 1.8 million workers were laid off in mid-2025, while a World Economic Forum survey found that 41% of companies worldwide plan to reduce their workforces within the next five years. In Hong Kong, a 2025 Colliers survey revealed that over 80% of firms had downsized. Yet, unlike traditional layoffs, nowadays organizations not only dismiss employees but also retain and redeploy those deemed high-value human capital—a practice that is spreading across industries and regions. For example, Meta has restructured its AI division by eliminating certain positions while transferring high-performing employees to other teams, and Starbucks’ $1 billion USD reorganization closed underperforming stores while reassigning skilled baristas to other stores. Despite the prevalence of such practice that redeploys layoff survivors, academic research has yet to fully understand its consequences. Micro scholars have examined layoffs primarily as psychological events that impact three major groups of employees: those laid off, those who survive, and those who implement the layoffs (Brockner et al., 2004; Lam et al., 2023); whereas macro scholars have viewed redeployment as a practice of human-capital reallocation and organizational renewal (Helfat & Eisenhardt, 2004; Tate & Yang, 2015). What is unfortunately missing is an integrated understanding of what happens when layoff survivors, those retained and relocated for their value, join existing teams, and how their joining shapes the affective and behavioral reactions of incumbent team members. Drawing on affective events theory (Weiss & Cropanzano, 1996), uncertainty-identity theory (Hogg, 2000, 2007, 2021), and the newcomer socialization literature, this project proposes that the join of layoff survivors conveys two competing messages: it symbolizes the team’s strategic value and temporary safety within the organization, yet simultaneously introduces potential threats to incumbents. These dual meanings are expected to elicit distinct affective responses—reduced fear but diminished joy—leading incumbents to collaborate more actively with fellow incumbents but less willingly with layoff survivors as new team members. To test these hypotheses, I will conduct a natural field quasi-experiment using archival data from a leading solar-energy company in mainland China, combining large-scale facial-expression analytics (via Noldus FaceReader) and objective collaboration records. A pilot study of 76,617 daily photos from 2,728 incumbent employees provided initial evidence that the join of layoff survivors significantly reduced fear among incumbents and produced status-contingent effects on joy. 近年來，大規模裁員已成為全球經濟的重要特徵之一。然而，與傳統裁員不同，如今的組織在裁減部分員工的同時，也愈來愈傾向於保留那些被視為具有較高人力資本價值的員工，並將其重新調配至組織內其他崗位或團隊。這種做法正在不同行業和地區迅速普及。儘管這種對裁員留任者進行內部重新配置的做法日益普遍，現有學術研究對其後果仍缺乏充分認識。微觀層面的研究主要將裁員視為一種心理事件，並重點考察其對三類員工群體的影響，即被裁員工、裁員留任者以及負責實施裁員的人員（Brockner et al., 2004; Lam et al., 2023）；宏觀層面的研究則將人員重新配置視為人力資本再分配和組織更新的重要實踐（Helfat & Eisenhardt, 2004; Tate & Yang, 2015）。然而，現有研究尚缺乏一個整合性的理論視角，用以解釋：當那些因其價值而被組織保留並重新調任的裁員留任者加入已有團隊時，會發生甚麼，以及他們的加入將如何影響原有團隊成員的情緒與行為反應。 基於情感事件理論（affective events theory; Weiss & Cropanzano, 1996）、不確定性—認同理論（uncertainty-identity theory; Hogg, 2000, 2007, 2021）以及新員工社會化研究，本項目提出，裁員留任者的加入會向原有團隊成員傳遞兩種相互競爭的信息：一方面，這一事件象徵著所在團隊對組織具有較高的戰略價值，並意味著團隊成員在短期內具有相對較高的工作安全性；另一方面，具有較高人力資本價值的裁員留任者進入團隊，也可能給原有團隊成員帶來潛在威脅。這兩重含義預計將引發不同的情緒反應——降低原有團隊成員的恐懼感，卻同時削弱其愉悅感——並進一步影響其合作行為，使其更積極地與其他原有團隊成員合作，卻較少願意與作為新團隊成員加入的裁員留任者開展合作。 為檢驗上述理論假設，本項目將基於一家亞洲科技公司的檔案數據開展一項自然情境下的準實驗研究，並結合大規模面部表情分析技術與客觀的員工協作記錄進行分析。一項基於2,728名原有員工、共76,617張日常照片的初步研究已提供了初步證據：裁員留任者加入團隊後，原有團隊成員的恐懼感顯著下降；與此同時，其愉悅感的變化呈現出因員工地位不同而異的差異化效應。

15600026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600026.value: 培育思維，而非惰性點擊：促進兒童有效學習的人工智能學習工具設計研究

15600026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600026.value: AI-based learning tools are rapidly becoming part of children's education, offering personalized feedback and adaptive support, yet many are designed without sufficient consideration of how children learn effectively or of their developmental needs. As a result, many tools may risk promoting cognitive laziness, weakening learning quality, and discouraging active thinking. The proposed project aims to address this learning gap from a design perspective by investigating interaction mechanisms in AI learning tools that scaffold children’s minds-on learning, defined as active cognitive engagement in reasoning, problem solving, and meaning making rather than mere taps, swipes, or answer-seeking. The research will unfold in three stages: first, contextual inquiry with children will document how they interact with and make sense of AI learning tools in everyday settings; second, participatory design workshops with children, parents, and educators will surface values and co-create developmentally appropriate, pedagogically grounded interaction mechanisms for children's minds-on engagement; and third, toolkit development and evaluation will involve usability testing and structured feedback to ensure the guidelines explicitly support cognitive engagement over stimulus-response clicking. Together, these efforts will generate theoretical insights and a practical toolkit for designers, developers, and educators, grounding design in the realities of children's learning and the values of key stakeholders to provide actionable guidance for creating AI learning tools that nurture young minds rather than promote passive clicks. 人工智能學習工具正迅速融入兒童教育，為學習者提供個人化回饋及適應性支援。然而，現有不少工具在設計時，未有充分考慮兒童如何有效學習及其發展需要，因而可能助長認知惰性、削弱學習質素，並減少兒童主動思考的機會。本研究擬從設計角度回應這項學習層面的缺口，探討人工智能學習工具可如何透過適切的互動機制，支援兒童進行「動腦學習」。本研究所指的動腦學習，是兒童主動投入推理、解難及意義建構等認知活動，而非只停留於點按、滑動或直接尋找答案。研究將分三個階段進行。第一階段會與兒童進行情境研究，了解並記錄他們在日常環境中如何使用、理解及回應人工智能學習工具。第二階段會邀請兒童、家長及教育工作者參與共同設計工作坊，梳理各方重視的價值，並共同構思符合兒童發展階段、具充分教學理據，而且能促進動腦參與的互動機制。第三階段將開發及評估一套設計工具包，透過可用性測試及結構化回饋，確保相關指引能明確促進認知投入，而非鼓勵刺激與反應式的機械點擊。整體而言，本研究將提出相關理論見解，並為設計師、開發人員及教育工作者建立一套實用工具包。研究會以兒童真實的學習經驗及主要持份者所重視的價值為基礎，提供可付諸實踐的設計指引，協助業界開發能培育兒童思考，而非令他們流於被動點擊的人工智能學習工具。

15600826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600826.value: 人工智能支持下英語口語自我調節學習計劃階段的支架設計與成效研究

15600826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600826.value: Prof Hwang, Gwo-Jen Dr Kohnke, Lucas Dr Pan, Xie

15600826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600826.value: English as a foreign language learners often struggle with limited oral proficiency. As classroom time for speaking practice is typically insufficient, effective speaking development relies heavily on self-regulated learning (SRL) beyond the classroom. Among the three SRL phases: forethought, performance, and reflection, the forethought phase is particularly important, as it involves goal setting, strategic planning, and motivational regulation before learning begins, shaping the quality of subsequent learning and performance. However, many learners lack the skills to engage in effective forethought independently. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers adaptive, real-time scaffolding to guide this process, while mind mapping enables learners to organize and visualize their thinking by transforming abstract plans into coherent, structured representations. The integration of AI and mind mapping therefore holds strong potential to support learners in planning and preparing effectively for speaking tasks. This project proposes a Self-regulated AI-supported Forethought for English-speaking (SAFE) model, which positions mind mapping at the center to connect the four SRL dimensions (i.e., cognitive, metacognitive, social-behavioral, and motivational regulation) into a coherent and accessible process. To investigate different balances between learner autonomy and external support, the project further proposes three mind-mapping scaffolding conditions: self-constructed, prompt-guided, and template-driven. It will evaluate SAFE’s effectiveness in enhancing speaking performance, motivation, self-efficacy, and willingness to communicate (WTC) while reducing speaking anxiety, and examine how different scaffolding conditions, mediating and moderating mechanisms, and learner factors influence its overall impact. The project adopts a mixed-method design. Stage 1 involves multiple case studies with 20 students. Data from forethought artifacts and interviews will be thematically analyzed to develop a taxonomy of SAFE strategies. Stage 2 follows an iterative design-based research process to refine and validate the SAFE model. Expert reviews and pilot classroom implementations will guide successive revisions to ensure pedagogical soundness, feasibility, and sustainability. Stage 3 employs a quasi-experimental design with 12 first-year university English classes (approximately 240 students) to compare the SAFE approach with business-as-usual forethought across the three mind-mapping scaffolding conditions. Pre- and post-tests of speaking performance and questionnaires on AI literacy, motivation, self-efficacy, anxiety, and WTC will be administered, complemented by learner artifacts and interviews. Quantitative analyses will evaluate SAFE’s effectiveness and identify mediating and moderating mechanisms, while qualitative data will undergo thematic analysis to reveal patterns in forethought strategies and perceptions of AI scaffolding. Synthesizing both strands, the study will suggest evidence-based guidelines for integrating AI into SRL and speaking instruction. 英語作為外語（EFL）學習者的口語能力發展長期受限。受課時所限，課堂內的口語練習難以滿足需求，口語能力的提升在很大程度上有賴於課堂以外的自我調節學習（self-regulated learning, SRL）。在計劃、執行、反思三個階段中，計劃階段具有先導作用：學習者在此階段所進行的目標設定、策略規劃與動機調節，直接制約其後續的學習行為與學習成效。然而，現有研究與教學實踐顯示，多數學習者尚不具備獨立開展有效計劃的能力，而這一環節長期缺乏系統的教學支持。人工智能（AI）可為此過程提供適應性的即時支架，思維導圖則有助於學習者組織並視覺化其思維，將抽象構想轉化為結構化的表徵。二者的整合，為解決計劃階段支持不足這一難題提供了新的可能路徑。 本計劃擬建構自我調節的人工智能支持英語口語計劃模式（Self-regulated AI-supported Forethought for English-speaking, SAFE）。該模式以思維導圖為樞紐，將自我調節學習的認知調節、元認知調節、社會行為調節與動機調節四個維度整合為連貫而可操作的教學流程。為釐清學習者自主性與外部支持之間的恰當配置，本計劃擬設計自主建構式、提示引導式與模板驅動式三種支架條件。研究旨在檢驗 SAFE 模式在提升口語表現、學習動機、自我效能感與溝通意願，以及降低口語焦慮等方面的成效，並揭示支架條件、中介與調節機制及學習者個別差異對其作用效果的影響。 本計劃擬採用混合研究設計，分三個階段推進。第一階段以 20 名學生為對象開展多重個案研究，對學習產出與訪談資料進行主題分析，建構 SAFE 策略分類框架。第二階段依循設計為本研究（design-based research）路徑，透過專家評審與課堂試行開展多輪迭代修訂，以確保模式的教學合理性、可行性與可持續性。第三階段採用準實驗設計，以 12 個大學一年級英語班級（約 240 名學生）為樣本，在三種支架條件下將 SAFE 教學法與現行計劃階段教學實踐進行對照，實施口語表現的前測與後測，並輔以人工智能素養、學習動機、自我效能感、焦慮與溝通意願等量表，同步收集學習產出與訪談資料。 研究將透過量化分析檢驗模式成效、識別其中介與調節機制，並透過質性分析揭示計劃策略的生成模式及學習者對人工智能支架的感知；在整合兩類證據的基礎上，提煉人工智能融入自我調節學習與口語教學的實證為本指導原則，為本地大學英語口語教學改革提供可推廣的實踐方案與理論依據。

15601026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601026.value: 夜間氣溶膠光學厚度反演技術的新研究

15601026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601026.value: Prof Lee, Kwon-Ho Prof Qin, Kai

15601026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601026.value: Aerosols have a significant impact on air quality, ecosystem, the Earth’s energy balance, and our climate. Extensive studies have been devoted to studying aerosol optical thickness (AOT) under daytime condition using solar irradiance. However, nighttime AOT retrieval remains poorly developed. Existing studies mainly use Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Day/Night Band (DNB) on satellites for nighttime AOT retrieval due to its broad spatial coverage. However, current retrieval algorithms have several uncertainties on: (i) background nighttime light (NTL), which is the dominant factor and is strongly affected by viewing geometry and seasonality; (ii) surface reflectance, which is limited by insufficient and uneven satellite observations; (iii) aerosol models, which are generally simplified into only one type, leading to error in complex environments, e.g. urban areas; (iv) the validation dataset, i.e. AERONET lunar AOT is only available during periods of sufficiently strong moonlight, resulting in gaps from waning to waxing gibbous phases. To address these challenges, this study proposes a new framework to reduce uncertainties in all four aspects. Nighttime AOT will be retrieved from VIIRS DNB calibrated radiance at a spatial resolution of 750 m. Firstly, a seasonal geometry-discrete maximum nighttime light method is proposed to derive the background NTL. Secondly, a hyperspectral camera mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), with ancillary data of land cover types and three-dimensional (3D) building models, will be utilized to model the Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) and rectify the surface reflectance. Thirdly, nighttime aerosol models will be established by considering the daytime aerosol properties, air quality, and meteorological data. The Mie model coupled with a core-shell structure will be utilized to construct the nighttime aerosol models. Fourthly, a nighttime reference dataset will be assembled by combining AERONET lunar AOT, Lidar-derived AOT, and AOT derived from ground NTL using integrated spheres, for validation. The proposed methodology will be validated across three representative regions in East Asia with diverse climates and aerosol regimes: Hong Kong (China), Xuzhou (China), and Gangneung (South Korea). These advancements are expected to yield a set of more accurate nighttime AOT products, which could strengthen climate modelling by improving estimates of diurnal radiative forcing. Besides, assimilation of nighttime AOT will enhance predictions of particulate matters in areas with limited ground-based air quality stations. Given the availability of the data in the retrieval process and the release of our models, this method can be transferable to other regions worldwide. 氣溶膠對空氣質量、生態系統、地球能量平衡及全球氣候均具有顯著影響。目前，針對利用太陽輻射進行日間氣溶膠光學厚度（AOT）反演的研究已相當廣泛；然而，夜間 AOT 反演技術的發展仍相對滯後。鑑於可見光紅外成像輻射儀（VIIRS）的日夜軌道波段（DNB）具有廣闊的空間覆蓋能力，現有研究主要基於該衛星數據進行夜間 AOT 反演。然而，當前反演算法仍存在以下幾項不確定性: (i) 夜間燈光（NTL）背景：作為核心影響因素，背景燈光受觀測幾何與季節性變化的強烈干擾; (ii) 地表反射率：受限於衛星觀測數據不足且分佈不均; (iii) 氣溶膠模型：通常簡化為單一類型，導致在城市等複雜環境中產生較大誤差; (iv) 驗證數據集：AERONET 月光 AOT 僅在月光足夠強烈的時段可用，導致在虧月至盈月期間存在數據斷層。 為解決上述挑戰，本研究提出一種全新的研究框架，旨在全方位降低上述四個方面的反演不確定性。本項目將基於空間分辨率為 750 米的 VIIRS DNB 校準輻射度數據進行夜間 AOT 反演。首先，提出季節性幾何離散最大夜間燈光法以提取背景 NTL。其次，利用搭載於無人機的高光譜相機，結合地表覆蓋類型與三維建築物模型等輔助數據，對雙向反射分佈函數進行建模並校正地表反射率。第三，綜合考慮日間氣溶膠特性、空氣質量及氣象數據，採用耦合核-殼結構的米氏散射模型構建夜間氣溶膠模型。第四，通過整合 AERONET 月光 AOT、激光雷達反演 AOT 以及基於積分球地表 NTL 反演的 AOT，構建綜合夜間基準驗證數據集。所提出的方法將在東亞地區三個具有代表性氣候與氣溶膠模式的區域（中國香港、中國徐州及韓國江陵）進行交叉驗證。 上述技術突破突破預計將產出一套更高精度的夜間 AOT 產品，通過改善對晝夜輻射強迫的估算，進一步強化氣候模型。此外，夜間 AOT 數據的同化將有效提升地面空氣質量監測站點稀少區域的顆粒物預測能力。鑑於反演過程所需數據的可獲取性及本項目模型的開源發佈，該方法未來可推廣應用至全球其他區域。

15601426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601426.value: 慢跑介入對改善注意力不足／過度活躍症青少年執行功能與生理調節之集群隨機對照試驗

15601426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601426.value: Prof Chan, Dorothy Fung-Ying Prof Chan , Oi-wan, Karly Dr Chung, Raymond Chi Keung Dr Mok, Kam-Ming Dr WONG, Simpson, Wai-lap

15601426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601426.value: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) typically degrades high-level executive functions, such as planning, attention, flexibility, and impulse control, and is exhibited by approximately 5.6% of adolescents worldwide. ADHD treatments commonly include medication and psychosocial therapy, but these can be costly and time-consuming, respectively, and are not effective for all patients. Accordingly, this proposed project will investigate the efficacy of slow jogging, a moderate-intensity exercise, as a novel and accessible means of enhancing executive functioning and emotional regulation in adolescents with ADHD. Specifically, over 10 weeks, participants will be divided into three groups. One group will receive a slow-jogging intervention, a second group will receive a high-intensity interval training (HIIT) intervention, which involves alternating between short bursts of high-intensity running and periods of recovery walking, and a third group will serve as a waitlist control group. Slow jogging is performed at a comfortable pace known as the “niko niko” (smiling) pace and emphasises rhythm, mindfulness, and enjoyment. It is hypothesised to promote a balanced physiological state that supports cognitive control and emotional stability. In contrast, HIIT involves short bursts of intense running and may be more stimulating but less sustainable for adolescents with ADHD. The proposed project will be based on a psychophysiological model linking executive function deficits in adolescents with ADHD to autonomic dysregulation—impaired regulation of arousal and emotional responses by the autonomic nervous system—which in turn disrupts prefrontal cortex functioning, the brain region responsible for high-level executive functions. One hundred and eighty adolescents aged 12 to 17 with a clinical diagnosis of ADHD will be recruited from secondary schools and randomly assigned to a slow-jogging group, an HIIT group, or a waitlist control group. Assessments will be conducted at baseline, post-intervention, and three months following intervention completion. We hypothesise that compared with the HIIT and waitlist control groups, the slow-jogging group will exhibit greater improvements in high-level executive function, particularly planning (primary outcome), cognitive flexibility, inhibition, sustained attention, and reaction time variability. We further hypothesise that these gains will be mediated by increased heart-rate variability, highlighting psychophysiological regulation as a key mechanism whereby slow jogging alleviates the symptoms of ADHD in adolescents. Overall, the project may demonstrate that our slow-jogging intervention is a practical tool that can be used in familial and educational settings by adolescents with ADHD to improve their daily functioning, emotional well-being, and academic performance. 注意力不足／過度活躍症（ADHD）通常會削弱高階執行功能，例如規劃、專注力、靈活性及衝動控制，全球約有 5.6% 的青少年受其影響。ADHD 的常見治療方式包括藥物與心理社會治療，但前者可能成本高昂，後者則耗時，且並非對所有患者皆有效。 本研究計劃擬探討「慢跑」作為一種中等強度運動，是否能成為提升 ADHD 青少年執行功能與情緒調節的新穎且合適的方法。具體而言，參與者將在 10 週內分為三組：第一組接受慢跑介入；第二組接受高強度間歇訓練（HIIT），即交替進行短時間高強度跑步與步行恢復；第三組則作為候補控制組。在本研究中，慢跑以舒適的「niko niko」（微笑）步伐進行，強調節奏、正念與享受，相信能有助於保持生理狀態的平衡，從而促進身體的認知控制與情緒穩定。相較之下，HIIT包括短時間的劇烈跑步，可能更具刺激性，但對於患有ADHD 的青少年來說，其可持續性較差。 本研究將基於心理生理模型，該模型連結 ADHD 青少年執行功能缺損與自主神經失調——即自主神經系統在覺醒與情緒反應調節上的障礙，進而影響前額葉皮質的功能，而前額葉皮質正是負責高階執行功能的腦區。研究將招募 180 名年齡介於 12 至 17 歲、具臨床 ADHD 診斷的青少年，並隨機分配至慢跑組、HIIT 組或候補控制組。評估將於基線、介入後及介入完成三個月後進行。我們假設，相較於 HIIT 與候補控制組，慢跑組在高階執行功能上會有更顯著的改善，特別是規劃能力（主要結果）、認知靈活性、抑制能力、持續注意力及反應時間變異性。我們進一步假設，這些改善將由心率變異性增加所中介，突顯心理生理調節是慢跑減輕 ADHD 青少年症狀的關鍵機制。 整體而言，本研究可能證明慢跑介入是一種實用工具，能由 ADHD 青少年在家庭與教育環境中使用，以改善其日常功能、情緒健康與學業表現。

15601526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601526.value: 香港家庭受害與多重受害的發展軌跡：一項基於人群的縱向研究

15601526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601526.value: Prof CHEN, Qiqi Dr Ho, Frederick Ka Wing Prof Ip, Patrick

15601526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601526.value: Family violence is a pervasive public health issue with profound consequences for individuals and society. Traditional research has often examined specific forms of violence—such as child abuse and neglect, intimate partner violence, or elder abuse and neglect—in isolation, overlooking the complex interplay of multiple victimizations within the same family. The concept of Family Polyvictimization (FPV), developed by the principal investigator, addresses this gap by focusing on the co-occurrence of three or more victims within a family, with perpetrators being family members. Our previous cross-sectional studies have established the prevalence and risk factors of FPV, but the developmental trajectories and long-term impacts remain poorly understood due to a lack of longitudinal research. Objectives: This study aims to (1) investigate the trajectories of family victimization (FV) and polyvictimization over three years, categorizing families into sustained/increased FV/FPV, decreased FV/FPV, or non-FV groups; (2) examine family-level risk and protective factors associated with these trajectories; and (3) assess health impacts of different victimization trajectories on all family members, including adults, children, and the elderly. Method: A population-based longitudinal panel study will be conducted, following up 1,400 families previously recruited in a baseline survey in Hong Kong. The sample included families with at least one child under 18 years of age, representing diverse socioeconomic backgrounds. Data will be collected using the validated Family Polyvictimization Screen (FPS), which enables multiple family members to report violence against adults, children, and the elderly within a family. Health-related quality of life and mental health outcomes will be assessed using standardized instruments. Family-level risk and protective factors will be measured through validated scales on family hierarchy, socioeconomic status, family stress, father and grandparent involvement in childcare, social support, and coping strategies. Quantitative data will be analyzed using multinomial logistic regression and multiple regression models, while qualitative in-depth interviews with selected family members will provide contextual insights into the dynamics and service needs related to FPV. Contribution: This study is the first to longitudinally examine the trajectories of family polyvictimization in a representative population sample in Hong Kong. By identifying risk and protective factors and assessing the health impacts of different victimization patterns, the research will advance theoretical understanding of FPV and inform the development of targeted prevention and intervention strategies. The findings will provide evidence for policymakers, practitioners, and service providers to enhance early identification, multidisciplinary collaboration, and integrated approaches to family violence prevention. 摘要： 家庭暴力是一項普遍存在的公共衛生問題，對個人和社會有深遠影響。傳統研究往往孤立地檢視特定形式的暴力——如兒童虐待與忽視、親密伴侶暴力或老年人虐待與忽視——而忽略了同一家庭內多種受害形式之間複雜的相互作用。由首席研究員提出的「家庭多重受害」（FPV）概念，透過聚焦於家庭內三名或以上成員同時遭受由家庭成員施暴的情況，彌補了這項研究空白。我們前期的橫斷面研究已確定了FPV的盛行率和風險因素，但由於缺乏縱向研究，其發展軌跡和長期影響仍知之甚少。 研究目標： 本研究旨在（1）檢視三年內家庭受害（FV）和多重受害的發展軌跡，將家庭分類為持續/增加型FV/FPV、減少型FV/FPV或非FV組；（2）檢驗與這些軌跡相關的家庭層面風險和保護因素；（3）評估不同受害軌跡對所有家庭成員（包括成人、兒童和老年人）健康的影響。 研究方法： 本研究將進行一項基於人群的縱向面板研究，對先前在香港一項基線調查中招募的1,400個家庭進行追蹤。樣本包括至少有一名18歲以下子女的家庭，涵蓋不同的社經背景。資料收集將使用經過驗證的「家庭多重受害篩檢表」（FPS），該工具可使多名家庭成員報告家庭內針對成人、兒童和老年人的暴力情況。健康相關生活品質和心理健康結局將採用標準化工具進行評估。家庭層面的風險和保護因素將透過經過驗證的量表進行測量，內容包括家庭等級結構、社會經濟狀況、家庭壓力、父親和祖父母參與育兒的情況、社會支持及應對策略。量化資料將採用多項邏輯迴歸和多元迴歸模型進行分析，同時，對選定的家庭成員進行定性深度訪談，以提供關於FPV相關動態和服務需求的情境化見解。 研究貢獻： 本研究是首次在香港具有代表性的人群樣本中縱向檢視家庭多重受害發展軌跡的研究。透過識別風險和保護因素，並評估不同受害模式對健康的影響，本研究將推進對FPV的理論理解，並為制定有針對性的預防和介入策略提供基礎。研究結果將為政策制定者、從業人員和服務提供者提供證據，以加強早期識別、多學科協作和綜合性家庭暴力預防方法的實施。

15602026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602026.value: 人工智能強化的遊戲化青少年網絡欺凌旁觀者介入方案，包含家長及教師模組：應用程式與面對面教學之三組隨機對照試驗

15602026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15602026.value: Prof Chan, Edward Ko Ling Prof Li, Chen Prof ZHU, Yuhong

15602026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602026.value: Cyberbullying presents significant risks to young people worldwide, and bystanders are considered crucial to its prevention. Many existing bystander interventions focus on individual skills without fully integrating parents, teachers, and students, limiting coordinated school-home approaches. Evaluations often lack evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs), with outcomes typically assessed only in the short-term and concentrated in high-income countries. These gaps highlight the need for scalable and culturally adaptable solutions. GISCC2.0 (Gamified Intervention for School and Cyberbullying in Children) is an AI-enhanced, game-based bystander intervention grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior and Self-Determination Theory. It builds on the success of GISCC1.0, which was developed and evaluated by the team in China. The primary objective of GISCC2.0 is to improve Behavioral Application of Learned Intervention Strategies. Secondary objectives include enhancing Attitude toward Intervening in Cyberbullying, Self-Efficacy to Support Victims, Ability to Overcome Social Pressure, and Motivation to Intervene in Favor of Victims. The intervention is delivered through app-based and face-to-face formats with shared core scenarios, decision trees, and feedback rubrics, and role-specific adaptations for preadolescents, parents, and teachers. Individual learning incorporates scenario role-play and gamified progression, group learning uses collaborative tasks and structured interactions, and system-level levers include class-wide norm-setting contracts and teacher response protocols. AI components personalize learning experience by providing adaptive feedback while maintaining privacy safeguards and expert oversight. The effectiveness of GISCC2.0 will be evaluated through a three-arm, mixed-methods RCT, with 667 students (Grades 6-7), 667 parents, and 67 teachers across Hong Kong, Qingdao, and Inner Mongolia. Using class-level randomization (1:1:1 blocked by grade) to minimize spillover and align with teaching practices, participants will be assigned to app-based, face-to-face, or waitlist control group. Contamination risks will be mitigated through arm-specific teacher assignments and exposure monitoring. Assessments will occur at baseline, post-intervention, and at three- and six-month follow-ups, with latent growth models used to evaluate the outcomes over time. Data will be analysed using intention-to-treat multilevel models accounting for clustering, mediation tests of theory-based pathways, and qualitative focus groups and interviews to capture user experiences and context. We hypothesize that both active formats will outperform the waitlist control group, and app-based delivery will perform comparably to face-to-face delivery on outcomes. GISCC 2.0 will provide schools with a scalable, cost-efficient, and AI-enhanced program to combat cyberbullying. The program will deliver culturally relevant, policy-informed solutions for education and health systems and offer a replicable model for cross‑sector school-family partnerships. 網絡欺凌給全球青少年帶來嚴重風險，旁觀者被視為預防欺凌的關鍵角色。目前，多數旁觀者介入方案僅聚焦個人技能訓練，未能充分整合家長、教師與學生三方協作，限制了家校協同介入的成效。此外，現有干預措施普遍缺乏隨機對照試驗（RCT）的嚴謹成效證據，成效評估亦多限於短期追蹤。這些不足凸顯出發展具規模推廣性及文化適應性的創新方案之必要。 GISCC 2.0（兒童校園及網絡欺凌遊戲化介入）是一套結合人工智能強化和數字遊戲化設計的旁觀者介入方案，基於計劃行為理論與自我決定理論設計。此方案在團隊於中國內地開發並評估的GISCC 1.0成功經驗基礎上進行優化升級。GISCC 2.0的首要目標是提升學生對所學介入策略的行為應用能力；次要目標則包括增強對網絡欺凌干預的態度、支持受害者的自我效能、克服同儕壓力的能力、以及協助受害者的主動性與動機。 本方案同時提供應用程式（App）及面對面兩種模式，二者核心情境、決策路徑、反饋規則保持一致，並針對高小學生、家長及教師設計角色專屬模組。個別學習環節包括情境角色扮演及遊戲化進階設計，小組學習著重協作任務與結構化互動，系統層面則透過班級契約規範班風及完善教師應對流程。AI技術根據學習者特徵提供個人化回饋，並嚴格保障私隱及由專家監督。 GISCC 2.0 的成效將以三組混合方法隨機對照試驗進行評估，調查地點涵蓋香港、青島及內蒙古，樣本包括667名中一至中二學生、667位家長及67位教師。以班級為隨機分組單位，按年級分層隨機分為App組、面授組及等候名單對照組（1:1:1），以減少學期間干擾並配合學校教學安排。為預防組間交叉干擾，將指定實驗組別專責教師分配並加強參與監測。評估時點包括基線、介入後、三個月及六個月的追蹤，並運用潛在成長模型分析成效變化。數據分析採用意向治療多層次模型，結合理論路徑的中介效應檢驗及質性小組訪談，深入了解用戶體驗和實際情境。研究預期App與面授組成效皆優於對照組，且App模式成效可與面授模式效益相當。 GISCC 2.0將為學校提供一套具擴展性、成本效益高、融合AI技術的校園及網絡欺凌防治課程。該方案將提供具文化適應性、政策導向的教育與健康系統解決方案，並為學校與家庭跨界合作建立可複製的實踐模式。

15602126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602126.value: 基于神经影像与多模态模型的词汇组合实时脑机制研究

15602126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15602126.value: Prof Pylkkanen, Liina Prof Siok, Wai Ting

15602126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602126.value: Humans effortlessly understand novel expressions by combining the meanings of familiar words. We can grasp "smash a cake" without prior encounter because we know what it means to smash something and what a cake is. This ability, known as semantic composition, to generate limitless new meanings from a finite set of elements, is a cornerstone of language. Therefore, understanding the neural basis of this compositional process is an essential step toward explaining the mechanics of human language comprehension. Although cognitive neuroscience has begun to reveal the neural basis of semantic composition, most studies overlook the multifaceted nature of meaning itself. Consequently, how different meaning types—such as perceptual/sensory versus symbolic/linguistic—shape compositional processes remains unclear. This study investigates the spatiotemporal dynamics of these processes, asking: (1) Is there a general-purpose neural circuit for semantic composition, or are distinct circuits recruited for different meaning types? (2) What computational operations underlie this process—is meaning integration achieved through simple addition, or through more flexible, interactive blending, and under what conditions? A key innovation of our work is using a timely solution to a major challenge: accurately quantifying perceptual and symbolic meaning. Previous studies relied on manually defined features and human ratings, which are difficult to scale and lack precision. Here, we leverage a powerful new tool—multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Recent breakthroughs in AI now allow us to automatically and precisely extract two distinct forms of meaning: perceptual representations from video encoders that capture sensory, experiential knowledge, and symbolic representations from text encoders that reflect abstract, linguistic knowledge. Eighty adults will read two-word phrases and short stories while their brain activity is recorded using electroencephalography (EEG). For each target word, perceptual representations will be derived from AI-generated videos, and symbolic representations from the corresponding word forms via a text encoder. Two compositional models—linear addition and nonlinear weighted transformation—will combine single-word meanings into phrase-level representations. We will then apply regression analyses to link these model-derived features with neural responses, revealing how meanings are dynamically combined over time across the different forms of meaning. This project will provide the first detailed account of how real-time semantic composition operates in both the perceptual and symbolic systems. The findings will advance our understanding of how the brain constructs meaning and guide the design of next-generation AI systems that integrate knowledge in a more human-like way. 人类能够通过组合熟悉的单词来理解新颖的表达。即使我们从未见过“砸碎蛋糕”这个短语，也能轻松领会其含义，因为我们知道“砸碎”和“蛋糕”各自意味着什么。这种从有限词汇中生成无限新含义的能力，被称为语义组合，是语言的基石。因此，理解这一组合过程的神经基础，是揭示人类语言理解机制的关键一步。 尽管认知神经科学已开始探索语义组合的神经基础，但大多数研究忽视了意义本身的多面性。由此，不同意义类型——如感知意义（例如词汇所唤起的感官属性）与符号意义（例如词汇之间的抽象关系）——如何塑造组合过程，仍悬而未决。本研究旨在考察这些过程的时空动态，并聚焦于两个核心问题：（1）语义组合依赖的是一个通用神经回路，还是针对不同意义类型会招募不同的神经回路？（2）这一过程背后的计算机制是什么——意义的整合是通过简单的线性相加，还是通过更灵活、交互式的融合实现的？又是在何种条件下采用何种方式？ 本研究的核心创新在于，我们采用了一种前沿的计算方法来解决一个关键难题：如何准确量化感知意义和符号意义。以往研究多依赖人工定义的特征和主观评分，不仅难以规模化，也缺乏足够的精确性。本研究则借助多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）——这一人工智能领域的最新突破——实现了两种意义形式的自动化、高精度提取：从视频编码器获取感知表征（捕捉感官和经验性知识），从文本编码器获取符号表征（反映抽象的语言知识）。 实验将招募八十名成年被试，在阅读二字短语和短篇故事的同时，通过脑电图（EEG）记录其大脑活动。对于每个目标词，感知表征由AI生成的视频提取，符号表征则由文本编码器从词形中提取。随后，我们将采用两种组合模型——线性相加模型与非线性加权变换模型——将单词语义整合为短语层面的表征，并通过回归分析将这些模型衍生的特征与神经响应进行关联，以揭示不同意义类型下语义随时间动态组合的过程。 本项目将首次系统描绘实时语义组合在感知系统和符号系统中如何协同运作。研究成果不仅将深化我们对大脑意义建构机制的理解，也将为开发更具人类认知特性的新一代人工智能系统提供理论指引。

15602326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602326.value: The Scripture of the Jade Sovereign (Gaoshang Yuhuang benxing jijing 高上玉皇本行集經; hereafter YHJ) stands as one of the most significant and influential scriptures to emerge from the Southern Song period. As one of the most widely circulated Daoist scriptures—both within and beyond Daoist circles—the YHJ played a crucial role in establishing the Jade Sovereign (Yuhuang 玉皇) as the head of the Chinese pantheon. Furthermore, it inspired a vast array of liturgies and new scriptures in his honor. Given its profound influence, a textual study of the YHJ is an urgent scholarly priority. This project presents the first complete English translation and comprehensive study of the YHJ. To accurately decipher this technically precise work, the translation is grounded in a rigorous scholarly methodology centered on textual analysis. This analysis necessitates an exhaustive comparative and inter-textual approach, placing each passage of the YHJ in dialogue with a vast array of other Daoist scriptures and, where appropriate and necessary, related non-Daoist texts from other Chinese traditions, especially Esoteric Buddhism. This meticulous cross- referencing is crucial because the scripture was composed in a highly specialized language. Its terminology makes specific, technical references to precise liturgical actions. The key word in this project is intertextuality. Undertaking deep philological investigation, this study demonstrates the crucial fact that the very composition and redaction of the YHJ witness the integration of a vast spectrum of Daoist scriptures, which are interwoven into a new, coherent text. The project makes a dual contribution to the fields of Daoist studies. Firstly, it provides, for the first time, a meticulously researched but accessible English translation of a key text, making it readily accessible to students and scholars alike. Secondly, using a new interpretive framework based on intertextuality, the original translation highlights ritual performance as the central key to understanding the text’s devotional function as well as its cultural impact. This study traces the history of the YHJ and reveals how it came to be located in the late imperial and modern corpus of Daoist literature and how it engendered the production of new scriptures devoted to the Jade Sovereign. 《玉皇經高上玉皇本行集經》（下文簡稱《玉皇經》）乃南宋時期形成之最重要且最具影響力的經典之一。作為流傳最廣的道教經典之一——其傳播範圍不僅遍及道教內部，亦延伸至道教社群之外——《玉皇經》在確立玉皇為中國神祇體系之首的過程中，發揮了關鍵作用。此外，此經亦促成大量奉祀玉皇之科儀文本與新出經典的形成。鑒於此經影響深遠，對《玉皇經》展開文本研究，實為當前學界亟待推進之重要課題。本項目旨在提供《玉皇經》首部完整英譯，並對此經展開全面研究。為準確解讀此一具有高度技術性與精密性的文本，本譯注以文本分析為核心，建立於嚴謹的學術方法之上。此一分析有賴於詳盡的比較研究與互文性研究方法：將《玉皇經》的每一段落置於與眾多道教經典的對讀關係之中；並於適當且必要之處，參照中國其他傳統中的相關非道教文獻，尤以密教佛教文獻為要。如此精細的交叉參照至關重要，蓋因此經以高度專門化的語言寫成。此經所用術語，往往對具體而精確的科儀行為作出技術性指涉。本項目的核心概念為「互文性」（intertextuality）。本研究通過深入的文獻學與語文學考察，揭示一項關鍵事實：從《玉皇經》的撰成與編訂過程本身，即可見出範圍廣泛的道教經典資源如何被整合，並交織為一部新的、結構完整且義理連貫的文本。本項目對道教研究領域作出雙重貢獻。首先，本項目首次提供一部經過嚴謹考證而又便於閱讀的關鍵文本英譯，使學生與學者皆能更便利地利用此經。其次，本項目以互文性為基礎，提出新的詮釋框架；並通過此一原創性譯注，凸顯「儀式展演」乃理解此經奉獻功能及其文化影響的核心關鍵。本研究並追溯《玉皇經》的歷史，揭示此經如何被置入晚期帝國與現代道教文獻體系之中，以及如何促成一系列奉祀玉皇之新經典的生成。

15602526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602526.value: 駕馭生成式人工智能時代的情緒：香港中小學英語教師的情緒軌跡與教學實踐

15602526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15602526.value: Prof Hu, Guangwei Prof ZOU, Di

15602526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602526.value: This research investigates the complex interplay between English language teachers’ emotions and practice as they integrate Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) into K-12 education. Emotions are recognized as central to teachers’ identities and pedagogical approaches, influencing their agency, professional development, and adaptation to educational innovations. The rapid integration of GenAI, strongly promoted by Hong Kong’s education authorities, has created a dynamic and sometimes volatile environment, making it crucial to understand how teachers emotionally navigate this technological shift. Relatedly, understanding teachers’ emotions regarding GenAI and impact of teachers’ emotions on their practice is essential for maintaining a resilient workforce. This study adopts an interactional approach to emotions, which considers both individual and social factors, and is informed by Complex Dynamic Systems Theory. This theoretical lens allows for the examination of emotions as dynamic, context-dependent, and evolving systems, rather than static states. While previous research has explored teacher emotions and AI integration, significant gaps remain: few studies track emotional trajectories over time, focus on the Hong Kong context, or examine K-12 language teachers using a mixed-methods approach. To address these gaps, the research employs a convergent mixed-methods design. The quantitative component utilizes Q methodology to identify distinct emotion profiles among English teachers, capturing subjective experiences and shared viewpoints regarding GenAI integration. 64 teachers from 16 Hong Kong schools (primary and secondary) will sort statements about their emotions towards AI, with data analyzed using by-person factor analysis to reveal core emotion profiles. The qualitative component comprises the analysis of post-sorting interviews, classroom observations, and teaching artifacts (i.e., activity plans and teacher-GenAI interaction records). While post-sorting interviews probe teachers’ emotional responses, observations and artifacts illustrate how emotions are manifested in practice. Thematic analysis is adopted to explore the entanglement of emotion and practice, tracking changes in emotion profiles and teaching approaches over three semesters. The findings will provide insights for policymakers, teacher educators, and developers, informing emotionally responsive interventions and professional development. This research will help move AI adoption in Hong Kong education from the potential “trough of disillusionment” (i.e., declining excitement over the technology due to challenges in sustainable adoption) to the “plateau of productivity” (i.e., achieving sustainable use of the technology since its affordances are broadly demonstrated) according to the Gartner Hype Cycle. Ultimately, the study seeks to facilitate the productive integration of GenAI in education by understanding teachers’ emotional trajectories. 本研究旨在探討英語教師在中小學教育中融入生成式人工智能的過程中，其情緒與教學實踐之間錯綜複雜的相互關係。情緒被視為教師身份認同與教學取向的核心，影響著教師的能動性、專業發展，以及對教育創新的適應能力。在香港教育當局大力推動下，生成式人工智能的迅速普及，營造出一個動態、有時甚至波動不穩的環境，因此理解教師如何在情緒層面應對這場科技變革，變得至關重要。與此相關的是，了解教師對生成式人工智能的情緒反應，以及這些情緒對其教學實踐的影響，對維持教師韌性不可或缺。本研究採用情緒互動取向，同時考量個人與社會因素，並以複雜動態系統理論為理論基礎。此理論視角有助將情緒視為動態、視乎情境而定且不斷演變的系統，而非靜態不變的狀態。雖然過往研究已就教師情緒與人工智能融入教學有所探討，但當中仍存在重大缺口：鮮有研究追蹤情緒隨時間演變的軌跡、聚焦香港的环境，或以混合方法探討中小學語言教師的情況。為填補上述研究缺口，本研究採用匯聚式混合方法設計。量化部分採用Q方法論，以識別英語教師之間不同的情緒模式，捕捉他們對融入生成式人工智能的主觀體驗與共同觀點。來自16所香港中小學的64位教師將對一系列描述其對人工智能情緒反應的陳述句進行排序，所得數據將以「以人為中心」的因子分析法進行分析，藉此揭示核心情緒模式。質性部分則包括分析排序後訪談、課堂觀察，以及教學文件（即活動計劃及教師與生成式人工智能的互動記錄）。排序後訪談旨在探究教師的情緒反應，而課堂觀察及教學文件則呈現情緒如何在教學實踐中具體展現。本研究採用主題分析法，探討情緒與教學實踐之間的交纏關係，並追蹤三個學期內情緒模式與教學取向的變化。研究結果將為政策制定者、教師教育工作者及開發人員提供啟示，有助設計具情緒回應性的介入措施及專業發展方案。根據Gartner 的技術成熟度曲線理論，本研究有助推動香港教育界對人工智能的採用，由可能出現的「泡沫化的谷底期」（即因技術未能持續應用而令熱情逐漸減退）邁向「生產力的高原期」（即技術效用已獲廣泛印證，達致可持續應用）。歸根究底，本研究旨在透過了解教師的情緒軌跡，促進生成式人工智能於教育領域的有效融入。

15603226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603226.value: 土地與社會再生產：中國農業轉型中的性别與世代動態

15603226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603226.value: Despite their significant contributions both in agricultural production, as farmers, workers, retailers, and entrepreneurs, and in family reproduction, through taking up the bulk of domestic chores and performing care work for children and the elderly, the role of rural women’s productive and reproductive labour in sustaining global agri-food systems has constantly been overlooked and under-valued. Rural women’s circumstances are affected not only by what goes on within households, but also by the broader political economic currents of agrarian transformation that directly shape their livelihoods. In many parts of the developing world, agricultural commercialization and intensification has unfolded as a deeply gendered process, reconfiguring farm labor, land use, resource access, and distribution of responsibilities in ways that are distinctly uneven for men and women. This project proposes to investigate the gender and generational dynamics of agricultural transformation in China today, adopting a multiple-case research design to compare how different trajectories of agricultural restructuring have co-evolved with changing strategies of family reproduction. In existing studies of agricultural modernization in China, predominant focus has been given to structural changes in production, regimes of land and labour, and dynamics of class differentiation, with scant attention being devoted to the gendered and generational aspects of agrarian transition. The gradual replacement of smallholder farming and household-based production with a diversity of new operators from agribusinesses to cooperatives has nonetheless reconfigured gender and family dynamics in varied ways. Rather than presenting a uniform narrative, this project will use the comparative method to probe the gendered implications of differentiated pathways of transition in Heilongjiang, Shandong and Guangdong. Using in-depth ethnographic research and postulating a framework that examines interactions between agricultural restructuring, family reproduction, and women’s agency, this project’s findings will afford crucial insights into the social dynamics of varied trajectories of agrarian transition in China. Going beyond the academia, our aim is for this project to generate policy and educational impact by de-invisibilising processes of life-making on and off the farm and centre-staging women’s agency in the co-evolution of agricultural transformation and family reproduction. The United Nations General Assembly has declared 2026 the International Year of the Woman Farmer, providing a timely opportunity for engaging policymakers, non-profit organizations, and the general public. Through firsthand empirical research and public engagement initiatives, this project will contribute to pluralizing global knowledge on women and rural development in the agrarian Global South.

15603426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603426.value: 藉由人形機器人輔助訓練提升自閉症兒童的手勢、語音韻律使用及其整合能力

15603426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15603426.value: Dr Bosker, Hans Prof Chan, Angel Prof Chen, Zhuoming Dr Cheung, Chung Wai Prof Sheng, Li Dr Tang, Tempo Po-yi Prof WEN, Chunyi

15603426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603426.value: Autistic individuals are known to show deficits in speech prosody, gesture and their integration. However, the current intervention plans have not targeted at the integration of speech prosody and gesture and the use of gesture production to improve speech prosody. It is thus high time that we study 1) the training effects in improving the temporal alignment between the speech prosody and gesture. Weak Central Coherence theory may explain autistic children’s difficulties in the temporal alignment between the speech prosody and gesture as they may focus on uni-sensory information instead of multisensory processing. Training programs targeting at multisensory processing may thus lead to improvement in the integration of speech prosody and gesture. 2) the training effects of using gesture to boost the use of speech prosodic cues. Specifically, it is hypothesized that gesture may boost prosodic prominence in focus marking as predicted by cumulative-cue hypothesis, which proposes a positive correlation between acoustic and kinematic correlates of prominence. Ninety autistic children (30 in the training group with gestures, 30 in the training group without gestures and 30 in the control group), 30 typical developing children aged from 10 to 12 will complete pre- and post-training production experiments as well as training. We will analyze acoustic cues using Praat and gesture using ELAN. Statistical modelling will be further applied to all the extracted data to compare pre- and post-training performance. We will program a humanoid robot to make co-speech gestures targeting at improving the temporal alignment and the improvement of speech prosody through gesture training. This project will be among the first to investigate the training effects in improving the deficits in the integration of the visual and auditory modalities in focus marking among autistic children. It also enhances our understanding on the relationship between gesture and speech prosody and the benefit of using gesture to boost the use of prosodic cues. Therefore, the project may provide potentially valuable information for the diagnosis of autism and the design of intervention plans.
