16309826.value: 堵塞轉變在致密軟複合材料的弛豫動力學和非單調老化中的作用

16309826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16309826.value: Soft composite solids, consisting of discrete inclusions within a soft polymeric matrix, are promising candidates for advanced technologies such as soft robotics, flexible electronics, and wearable biomedical devices. Their responsiveness and programmability arise from the complex interplay between the inclusions and the matrix elasticity. While significant progress has been made in modeling these composites through the nonlinear mechanical properties of soft polymer matrices, the role of direct contacts between inclusions remains poorly understood. At high packing densities, the multiscale and disordered features of the inclusion contact networks present a significant challenge for conventional mechanical models to capture the composite's response to external stimuli. To address this issue, the proposed project will leverage the concept of the shear jamming transition from granular physics to establish a new strategy for understanding and programming the relaxation and aging dynamics of dense soft composites. Using a model system of soft silicone gels filled with microspheres near the jamming point, we will integrate bulk rheometry with a customized Boundary Stress Microscope (BSM). This approach will link the boundary stress evolution to the macroscopic rheological responses, thereby connecting local jamming dynamics to the global relaxation behavior. We will reveal the fundamental differences between granular-like relaxation dynamics, characterized by slow logarithmic decay and emergent stress heterogeneity, and the intrinsic viscoelasticity of the polymeric matrix across multiple length and time scales. Furthermore, we will explore the transient memory encoded in these relaxing composites, which stems from the non-equilibrium nature of their contact networks. Specifically, we will investigate how to control the Kovacs-like memory in soft composites, a phenomenon often characterized by non-monotonic aging dynamics in response to a multi-step mechanical training protocol. While previously observed in dry granular materials and suspensions, the Kovacs-like memory is difficult to program due to the mechanical fragility of near-jamming contact networks. In this project, we will demonstrate how the soft matrix can stabilize the Kovacs-like memory and how shear-jamming history can be used to manipulate the non-monotonic aging. By integrating granular physics with the nonlinear mechanics of soft polymers, this research aims to provide new physical principles for designing intelligent, adaptive soft composites with tailorable relaxation and memory. The anticipated outcomes are an important step toward realizing mechano-intelligent systems based on soft materials. 軟物質複合材料（包含柔性聚合物介質及其中的分散填充相）在包括軟體機器人、柔性電子元件及可穿戴生物醫學器件等領域具備可觀的應用潛力。軟複合材料系統的響應性和可編程性由填充相與彈性介質的複雜耦合作用所調控。儘管通過對聚合物彈性體的非線性力學模擬已解釋部分軟複合材料的重要性能，但填充相之間的直接接觸作用仍未得到充分理解。特別在高填充密度條件下，由於填充相接觸網絡具有多尺度與無序特徵，傳統力學模型難以準確描述複合材料對外部刺激的反應。為解決此問題，本研究計畫將借鑒顆粒物理學中的剪切堵塞轉變概念，建立一套新的研究範式，以理解並編程稠密軟複合材料的弛豫與老化動力學。我們將結合宏觀流變表徵與邊界應力顯微鏡技術，研究包含軟硅膠介質與接近堵塞態的微球填充相的模型複合系統。此實驗方法可以將邊界應力演化和宏觀流變性質關聯起來，從而建立局部堵塞動力學與整體弛豫行為之間的連繫。在不同的時空尺度上，我們將揭示類顆粒弛豫動力學（其特徵為緩慢對數衰減以及不均勻應力的湧現）與聚合物彈性體黏彈性之間的區別。此外，我們將研究這些軟複合材料在弛豫過程中的暫態記憶，其起源於填充相接觸網絡的非平衡態性質。具體而言，我們將研究如何控制軟複合材料中的Kovacs記憶效應：這是一種在多重機械訓練模式下，系統表現為非單調弛豫的動態現象。儘管此類記憶特徵曾在乾燥顆粒材料和懸浮液中觀察到，但由於接近堵塞的接觸網絡在力學上非常脆弱，因此難以對該效應進行系統調控。在本研究計畫中，我們將展示柔性介質如何保留穩態的Kovacs 記憶，以及如何利用剪切堵塞訓練來控制非單調老化行為。通過將顆粒物理學與柔性高分子非線性力學相結合，本研究旨在為設計具有可控弛豫與記憶特徵的智能軟複合材料提供新的物理機制。預期成果將是實現基於軟材料的機械智能體系的重要的一步。

16309926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16309926.value: 对磁有序参数和非相对论自旋分裂的微观和宏观认识

16309926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16309926.value: Altermagnetism presents a new class of compensated magnetic materials with vanishing magnetization. Unlike in conventional antiferromagnets, the spin sublattices of altermagnets are spatially anisotropic, owing to crystalline anisotropies and connected through crystalline rotation symmetry operations. As such, altermagnetism is a magnetic crystal order and manifests in even-parity (d, g, i) order parameters. At an electronic level, the real-to-reciprocal-space correspondence results in electronic band structures with non-relativistic spin splitting which encodes the symmetries of the altermagnetic order parameter. Hence, altermagnetism expands our understanding of magnetism and their unique electronic properties motivate concepts for spintronic device applications. To date, angle-resolved photo-electron spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements succeeded in resolving this momentum-space splitting in a few altermagnetic material candidates, such as MnTe, CrSb and RuO2. However, experimental knowledge on the spin texture of the spin-split bands, a defining feature of altermagnetism, is very limited and its impact on the electric material properties remains poorly understood. Therefore, an urgent need exists for using novel experimental approaches to close this knowledge gap. Interestingly, altermagnetic order parameters are predicted support quantum metric and Berry curvature multipoles that can leave distinct fingerprints in the nonlinear electric material properties. Our goal is to investigate this hypothesis by performing nonlinear electric Hall effect measurements on various altermagnets, such as MnTe and CrSb. Comparing our observations with symmetry analyses and band structure calculations will enable us to draw conclusion on the presence and type of altermagnetic order parameters and their impact on electric material properties. Our second goal is to conduct quasiparticle interference measurements with the STM on the surface of these materials to directly probe the non-relativistic spin splitting and spin texture of these bands. We will examine the scattering characteristics of spin-conserving and spin-flip scattering processes at individual magnetic atoms deposited at the sample surface as a function of energy. The comparison of these scattering characteristics with model calculations will provide unique insight into the evolution of the spin-texture in of the non-relativistic split bands in momentum space. Lastly, we will use these experimental methods to also explore novel pathways to realizing altermagnets with different order parameter symmetry beyond crystalline anisotropy. Our proposed research will significantly advance beyond existing studies in this field and generate critical new insight into the electronic structure and electric material properties of altermagnets, informing future efforts toward the technological application of this new material class. 反铁磁体作为一种新型的长程磁有序现象，出现在磁化强度趋于零的补偿磁性材料中。与传统反铁磁体不同，反铁磁体的自旋亚晶格由于晶体各向异性而具有空间各向异性。因此，它们不能通过平移或反演操作连接，而只能通过旋转操作连接。反铁磁体超越了奈尔矢量描述，并表现为偶宇称（d、g、i）序参量。在电子层面上，实空间到倒易空间的对应关系导致了具有非相对论性自旋分裂的电子能带结构，其动量空间特征反映了序参量的类型。因此，反铁磁体从根本上拓展了我们对磁性的理解，并为利用自旋电子器件进行信息传输和处理提供了新的思路。迄今为止，角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量已成功解析出少数候选材料（例如MnTe、CrSb和RuO2）中这种特征性的动量空间分裂，从而支持了反磁性的存在。然而，关于自旋分裂电子​​能带结构的自旋纹理（反磁性的一个决定性特征）的实验数据仍然匮乏，自旋分裂能带结构对材料电学性质的影响也仍然知之甚少。 因此，迫切需要新的实验方法来填补这一知识空白。有趣的是，反磁性序参量被预测支持量子度规和贝里曲率多极矩，这将在非线性电学性质中留下独特的印记。我们的目标是通过对各种反磁性材料（例如MnTe和CrSb）进行非线性霍尔效应测量来验证这一假设。将我们的观测结果与对称性分析和能带结构计算的结果进行比较，将有助于我们得出关于反铁磁序参量的存在及其类型，以及它们对材料电学性质影响的结论。尽管在角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量中观察到了自旋分裂的电子结构，但我们仍然缺乏关于这些能带自旋纹理的知识。我们的目标是利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）在这些材料表面进行准粒子干涉测量，以直接探测这些能带的非相对论性自旋分裂和自旋纹理。我们将研究沉积在样品表面的单个磁性原子在不同能量下的自旋守恒散射和自旋翻转散射过程的散射特性。这将为非相对论性分裂能带在动量空间中的自旋纹理演化提供独特的见解。 最后，我们还将利用这些实验方法探索实现具有不同序参量对称性（超越晶体各向异性）的反铁磁体的新途径。我们提出的研究将显著超越该领域现有的研究，并对交替磁体的电子结构和电材料特性产生重要的全新见解，为未来将这种新型材料应用于技术研究提供信息。

16310526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16310526.value: 解析自組裝單分子層作為非富勒烯有機太陽能電池空穴傳輸層的設計規則

16310526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310526.value: Carbazole-based self-assembled monolayers (SAMs), such as 2PACz, have recently emerged as highly effective hole transport layers (HTLs) for high-performance non-fullerene organic solar cells (OSCs). The concept of using carbazole SAMs was originally inspired by the perovskite solar cell (PSC) community, which has developed a rich library of SAM molecules to achieve ideal interfacial energetics. However, the design principles governing SAM-based HTLs may differ fundamentally between PSCs and OSCs due to their distinct charge transport and recombination characteristics. For example, our group has previously developed polymeric SAMs for PSCs, which are particularly suitable for large-area processing. However, these polymeric systems exhibit limited compatibility with OSCs, likely because the random orientation of their molecular dipoles prevents effective modulation of the electrode work function. These contrasting results raise fundamental questions regarding how interfacial dipoles in SAM-based HTLs control energy-level alignment and charge extraction in OSCs. Our initial results indicate that polymeric HTLs with disordered dipoles are less effective than monomeric SAMs in OSCs, underscoring the need for precise molecular design and directional dipole control. Furthermore, our findings reveal clear differences in the functional requirements of HTLs between OSCs and PSCs. For organic systems, while surface passivation and electron blocking are important, the interfacial dipole and the resulting energy alignment appear to be the most decisive factors for efficient charge collection. This is especially critical in organic semiconductors, where high exciton binding energy and low carrier mobility necessitate an optimized built-in electric field. Even slight interfacial misalignment can introduce a Schottky barrier, weaken the internal field, and lead to voltage and fill factor losses. To address these challenges, this proposal aims to systematically establish the structure–property relationship of SAM-based HTLs and elucidate how interfacial dipoles determine energy alignment and transport in OSCs. Task 1 will correlate dipole orientation with electrode work function using density functional theory and surface spectroscopy. Task 2 will design new carbazole-based SAMs with enhanced perpendicular dipole moments by introducing electron-withdrawing substituents near the anchoring group. Task 3 will map the practical work-function window and the transition to the ohmic regime for representative systems such as PM6:L8-BO and D18:L8-BO. Our preliminary 3PACz-CN SAM, featuring a doubled perpendicular dipole moment, improves the Voc and FF of PM6:L8-BO devices from 0.89 V to 0.91 V and from 80.0% to 82.0%, achieving a PCE of 20.5%. The success of this proposal will establish quantitative design rules for next-generation SAM-based HTLs in OSCs. 近年來以咔唑為基礎的自組裝單分子層（SAMs），例如2PACz，已成為高性能非富勒烯有機太陽能電池（OSCs）中高效的空穴傳輸層（HTLs）。咔唑SAMs的應用概念最初源自於鈣鈦礦太陽能電池（PSCs）領域，該領域已開發出豐富的SAM分子庫以實現理想的界面能階。然而，由於PSCs和OSCs的電荷傳輸和複合特性存在差異，基於SAM的HTLs的設計原則可能存在根本性的差異。例如，我們課題組先前已開發出適用於PSCs的聚合物SAMs，這些聚合物SAMs尤其適用於大面積加工。然而，這些聚合物系統與OSCs的兼容性有限，這可能是因為其分子偶極矩的隨機取向阻礙了對電極功函數的有效調控。這些截然不同的結果引發了關於基於SAM的HTLs中的界面偶極矩如何控制OSCs中的能階排列和電荷提取的基本問題。 我們的初步結果表明，在OSC中，具有無序偶極矩的聚合物HTL的效率低於單體SAM，這凸顯了精確分子設計和定向偶極控制的必要性。此外，我們的研究結果揭示了OSC和PSC對HTL功能需求的顯著差異。對於有機體系而言，雖然表面鈍化和電子阻擋很重要，但界面偶極子及其導致的能階排列似乎是高效能電荷收集的最關鍵因素。這在有機半導體中尤其重要，因為其高激子結合能和低載子遷移率需要優化的內建電場。即使是輕微的界面錯位也會引入肖特基勢壘，削弱內建電場，並導致電壓和填充因子損失。 為了應對這些挑戰，本研究旨在系統地建立基於SAM的HTL的結構-性能關係，並闡明界面偶極矩如何決定OSC中的能階排列和電荷傳輸。任務1將利用密度泛函理論與表面光譜技術，關聯偶極矩取向與電極功函數。任務 2 將透過在錨定基團附近引入吸電子取代基，設計具有增強垂直偶極矩的新型咔唑基SAM。任務 3 將繪製代表性體系（例如 PM6:L8-BO 和 D18:L8-BO）的實際功函數視窗以及向歐姆區轉變的曲線。 我們初步設計的 3PACz-CN SAM 具有雙倍的垂直偶極矩，可將 PM6:L8-BO 裝置的開路電壓 (Voc) 從 0.89 V 提高到 0.91 V，填充因子 (FF) 從 80.0% 提高到 82.0%，從而實現 20.5% 的功率轉換效率 (PCE)。此方案的成功將為下一代OSC 中基於 SAM 的HTL 建立定量設計規則。

16310626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16310626.value: 複形的格拉斯曼簇、瞬子模空間與表示論

16310626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310626.value: This proposal aims to advance the PI’s previous works on Grassmannians of complexes and instanton moduli spaces, with a focus on their significance in geometric representation theory and the symmetries of moduli spaces of sheaves. The project is organized into two main parts. Part I: We will broaden the PI’s representation-theoretic framework for derived Grassmannians to unify Clifford algebra, Hall algebra, and Yangian actions, bringing together symmetries arising from both semiorthogonal decompositions and autoequivalences (notably, the “flop–flop = twist” phenomenon). Part II: Building on this foundation, we will apply the expanded framework to instanton moduli spaces on K3 surfaces and surface blowups. Our approach will extend both the PI’s joint works on Clifford and affine Lie algebra actions and Addington–Takahashi’s categorical sl2 action, developing a broader symmetry framework that links existing algebraic structures and explores new connections to Seiberg–Witten theory. 本研究計劃旨在項目負責人過往有關複形格拉斯曼簇及瞬子模空間的研究基礎上作進一步發展，重點探討這些幾何空間在幾何表示論中的作用，以及層模空間所具有的各種對稱性。 本計劃分為兩個主要部分。 第一部分：我們將擴展項目負責人為導出格拉斯曼簇所建立的表示論框架，把克利福德代數、霍爾代數及楊代數的作用納入一個統一的理論，並結合源自半正交分解與自等價的不同對稱性，尤其是稱為「flop–flop = twist」的現象。 第二部分：在上述基礎上，我們將把擴展後的框架應用於 K3 曲面及經爆破的曲面上的瞬子模空間。這一研究將同時推廣項目負責人與合作者關於克利福德代數作用及仿射李代數作用的研究，以及 Addington–Takahashi 的範疇化 sl2作用，從而建立一個更廣泛的對稱性框架，連繫現有的代數結構，並探索它們與 Seiberg–Witten 理論之間的新關係。

16310926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16310926.value: 用於樣本縮減量子態層析的可證明高效的非凸算法

16310926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310926.value: The practical application of Quantum State Tomography (QST) is severely limited by a sample complexity that scales exponentially with the number of qubits. This project confronts this challenge by developing computationally efficient, non-convex algorithms with provably reduced sample requirements, based on the low-rank structure of the density matrix. For states modeled by a low-rank matrix, we will use advanced analytical techniques to prove that algorithms such as Riemannian Gradient Descent can achieve successful reconstruction with an optimal number of Pauli measurements for that model class. To address systems more accurately described by the low-rank Tensor-Train (TT) structure, we will tackle the problem of its sample complexity by formulating QST as a tensor completion task. We will design novel online Riemannian algorithms and leverage martingale concentration inequalities to establish rigorous, non-asymptotic recovery guarantees with sample requirements that scale sub-exponentially or, ideally, polynomially with the number of qubits. This research will provide a robust theoretical foundation for practical QST in high-dimensional quantum systems. 量子態層析的實際應用受到嚴重限制，其樣本複雜度隨量子比特數量呈指數級增長。本項目旨在通過開發計算高效的非凸算法來應對這一挑戰，這些算法基於密度矩陣的低秩結構，並可能降低樣本需求。對於由低秩矩陣建模的量子態，我們將使用先進的分析技術來證明，諸如黎曼梯度下降之類的算法能夠以最優的泡利測量次數成功重構該模型。為了更精確地處理由低秩張量列 結構描述的系統，我們將通過將 QST 建模為張量補全任務來解決其樣本複雜度問題。我們將設計新型在線黎曼算法，並利用鞅集中不等式建立嚴格的、非漸近的恢復保證，且樣本需求隨量子比特數量呈亞指數級或理想情況下呈多項式級增長。這項研究將為高維量子系統中的實用量子系統理論提供穩健的理論基礎。

16311126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311126.value: 從張量網路到量子幾何

16311126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311126.value: One key difference between classical and quantum physics lies in the nature of the wave function. Unlike a classical particle that can be described by a single point in space, a quantum mechanical entity, like an electron, is represented by a wave function. This wave function encodes not just the probability of finding the electron at various positions, but also more intrigue features which are only revealed when certain interference effects are probed. However, many physical properties, such as energy or effective speed of the electrons in a piece of material, are largely insensitive to the intricate structure within the wave function. The field of topological quantum materials investigates how wave function features affect material properties. Here, "topology" refers to robust, unchanging properties, such as electrical conductance quantized to precise integer values in suitable units. This behavior defies everyday expectations, where physical quantities, like an ammeter reading, vary continuously with small system changes. Recently, it was realized that these topological effects are part of a broader framework tied to the geometry of the electronic wave function. Geometry, derived from the concept of distance, can also be used to describe how "close" electronic wave functions are to one another. In weakly interacting materials, where electron states are labeled by their momenta, this comparison reveals how wave functions modulate as momentum changes. Such modulation explains both quantized properties and more subtle, non-quantized effects that can vary smoothly with system parameters. Recent advances have shown that quantum geometry can lead to fascinating physical phenomena, such as emergent length scales, unconventional nonlinear transport, and unexpected tunneling behaviors. However, extending this framework to quantum many-body systems is challenging. The quantum state of a system with many particles grows exponentially in complexity, and small physical changes can produce wave functions that seem vastly different. Defining "distance" in such systems and uncovering the resulting geometry are key open problems in this area of research. To tackle this, our project employs tensor network representations. These limit the vast space of quantum states to a manageable subset, focusing on those with limited quantum entanglement, which often represent the lowest-energy states of realistic systems. By applying this approach, we aim to generalize quantum geometry frameworks to many-body systems, uncovering new physical properties beyond current understanding. This research could lead to new understanding on how quantum geometries emerge from quantum many-body wave functions and the physical properties they control. 波函數是古典物理與量子物理之間的一個關鍵差異。不同於可由空間中的單一點來描述的古典粒子，量子力學中的實體（例如電子）是由波函數來表示。這個波函數不僅代表了在不同位置找到電子的機率，也包含了更多引人入勝的特徵。然而，許多物理性質，例如材料中電子的能量或有效速度，對波函數內部精細結構大多不敏感。 拓樸量子材料領域研究的是波函數特徵如何影響材料性質。在此，「拓樸」指的是穩健且不變的性質，例如在適當單位下精確量子化為整數值的電導。這種行為違反了日常直覺；在日常經驗中，物理量（例如電流表讀數）會隨著系統的微小變化而連續改變。近來，人們意識到，這些拓樸效應其實屬於一個更廣泛的框架，並與電子波函數的幾何有關。幾何源自「距離」的概念，也可用來描述電子波函數彼此之間有多「接近」。在弱交互作用材料中，電子態可由其動量標記；比較這些電子態時，可以揭示波函數如何隨動量變化而調變。這種調變不僅能解釋量子化性質，也能解釋更細微、非量子化且可隨系統參數平滑變化的效應。 近年的進展顯示，量子幾何能導致許多引人入勝的物理現象，例如湧現的長度尺度、非傳統的非線性輸運，以及出乎意料的穿隧行為。然而，將此框架推廣至量子多體系統仍充滿挑戰。含有許多粒子的系統，其量子態的複雜度會呈指數成長；而微小的物理變化也可能產生看似截然不同的波函數。在這類系統中定義「距離」，並揭示由此產生的幾何，是此研究領域中的關鍵問題。 我們將嘗試利用張量網路表示法去研究這個問題。這種方法將龐大的量子態空間限制在一個可處理的表示中；這些只有有限量子糾纏的量子態在很多清況下已可表達真實系統的最低能量態。透過應用此方法，我們旨在將量子幾何框架推廣至多體系統，揭示目前理解之外的新物理性質。這項研究可能幫助我們理解量子幾何如何從量子多體波函數中湧現，以及它們所支配的物理性質為何。

16311226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311226.value: V₂Se₂O型交錯磁體中的非常規超導

16311226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311226.value: In conventional superconductors, zero electrical resistance emerges from the formation of spin-singlet Cooper pairs—electron pairs with opposite spins. The introduction of magnetism tends to disrupt this pairing, as the spin-polarized environment in ferromagnets suppresses spin-singlet formation. This suppression, however, may promote the emergence of unconventional superconducting states, such as spin-triplet pairing, where electrons with parallel spins form Cooper pairs. The interplay between superconductivity and magnetism leads to lots of novel phenomena such as spin-polarized supercurrents and Majorana zero modes (MZMs), exotic quasiparticles with significant potential for topological quantum computing. Recently, a new class of collinear antiferromagnets exhibiting spin-splitting band structures, known as altermagnets, has been identified. Prototypical examples include materials within the V₂Se₂O family, such as Rb/K-intercalated V₂Te₂O and V₂Se₂O. These materials, first predicted by the PI [Nat. Commun. 12, 2846 (2021)], have been confirmed to host altermagnetism by independent experimental groups [Nat. Phys. 21, 754 (2025); Nat. Phys. 21, 760 (2025)]. Although altermagnets possess zero magnetization, their anisotropic spin-dependent conductivity allows non-canceling spin contributions under applied current, and hence they can generate spin-polarized currents as ferromagnets without producing stray magnetic fields. This unique combination makes them highly promising for spintronic applications and suggests superior compatibility with superconductivity compared to conventional ferromagnets. This project aims to explore unconventional superconductivity in V₂Se₂O-type altermagnets. We will first employ symmetry analysis to identify pairing symmetries compatible with the altermagnetic order and compute phase diagrams under varying spin-splitting strengths. Then, we will study superconducting spintronic devices based on altermagnets, such as Josephson junctions and superconducting spin valves. Leveraging dissipationless supercurrents, these devices could form the basis for highly energy-efficient digital electronics. Finally, we will explore heterostructures that host crystal-symmetry-protected MZMs within altermagnets, which can realize MZM hybridization via crystal-symmetry breaking fields. This approach could circumvent the persistent challenge of controllably coupling isolated MZMs in other platforms and may provide an alternative way for designing fault-tolerant topological quantum computers. Upon successful execution, this project is expected to yield a fundamental understanding of superconductivity in altermagnets and to propose device concepts that may outperform conventional superconductor-ferromagnet heterostructures. 常規超導電性源於自旋相反的電子配對。磁性通常抑制這種配對，卻可能催生非常規配對，例如自旋相同電子間的配對。超導與磁性的相互作用可引發新奇現象，如自旋極化超電流和馬約拉納零模。然而，超導體-鐵磁體異質結的研究常受限於阿布里科索夫渦旋：鐵磁體的雜散場會穿透超導體，形成攜帶磁通量的渦旋。一旦施加電流，這些渦旋便會産生電阻，進而破壞超導態。 近年來，一類具有自旋分裂的共線反鐵磁體—交錯磁體—被發現，並在V₂Se₂O型材料（如Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O和KV₂Se₂O）中得到實驗驗証。儘管交錯磁體擁有磁矩相互補償的子晶格，但在施加電流時，不同自旋的貢獻並不完全抵消。這類材料既能像鐵磁體一樣支持自旋極化電流，又不會産生鐵磁體特有的雜散場，因而在自旋電子學應用中更具優勢，也可能與超導態更加兼容。 本項目旨在研究V₂Se₂O型交錯磁體中的非常規超導電性。我們將通過對稱性分析確定與交錯磁序兼容的配對對稱性，並利用平均場計算繪製隨自旋分裂變化的相圖。同時，我們將研究基於交錯磁體的超導器件，如約瑟夫森結和超導自旋閥。由於超電流無耗散、不發熱，這類超導自旋電子器件有望應用於低能耗數字設備。此外，我們還將在交錯磁體/超導異質結中探索由晶體對稱性保護的馬約拉納零模。與現有方案相比，交錯磁體中馬約拉納零模的雜化可通過晶體對稱性破缺場加以調控，從而克服孤立馬約拉納零模難以耦合的難題，爲基於馬約拉納零模的容錯拓撲量子計算提供全新設計思路。 本項目的順利推進，將深化我們對交錯磁體中非常規配對機制的理解，並有望提出性能超越傳統超導體-鐵磁體異質結構的器件方案。

16311526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311526.value: 結合單分子與群體測量光譜學方法的α-突觸核蛋白與線粒體核蛋白複合物的液-液相分離過程研究

16311526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311526.value: With populations age and lifespans lengthen, neurodegenerative diseases become prevalent. As a common and currently incurable disorder, Parkinson's disease is characterized by Lewy bodies with α-synuclein aggregation and mitochondrial dysfunction. Elevated α-synuclein levels lead to its accumulation on mitochondria and mitochondrial fragmentation, triggering the release of mitochondrial nucleic acids and nucleoprotein complexes, which promotes further interactions and complicates disease pathology. However, studies on these interactions and their mitochondrial impact are lacking. It remains unknown how α-synuclein interacts with inner mitochondrial components and affects its aggregation pathways associated with Parkinson's disease. Our preliminary data shows that α-synuclein overexpression significantly affects mitochondrial transcription levels and cellular viability. We observed specific binding between α-synuclein and mitochondrial nucleoprotein complexes containing mitochondrial DNA and mitochondrial transcription factor A (TFAM), a key factor linked to neurodegeneration, which may indicate a promising avenue for transcriptional control and cellular regulation. Nevertheless, it is challenging to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms due to the dynamic properties of nucleoprotein complexes and the structural heterogeneity of α-synuclein, both prone to liquid-liquid phase separation. As a typical intrinsically disordered protein, α-synuclein interacts with various binding partners to initiate liquid-liquid phase separation and toxic aggregation, forming dynamic nanoclusters and transient species with heterogeneous structures in inhomogeneous mixtures, which cannot be clearly resolved using conventional bulk measurements, calling for advancements in research methodologies. To monitor the intrinsic dynamics and structural flexibility of α-synuclein and mitochondrial nucleoprotein complexes, we propose integrating single-molecule and ensemble spectroscopic techniques, particularly through a novel platform: optical tweezers-coupled Raman spectroscopy. This platform enables mechanical manipulating of a single molecule to capture different folded states, conformational dynamics, and binding kinetics with other molecules, while simultaneously incorporating label-free chemical resolution to characterize molecular structures, interactions, and environments through Raman or Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SERS) measurements. Specifically, we will manipulate and characterize a single mitochondrial nucleoprotein complex/α-synuclein/mitochondrial nucleoprotein complex-α-synuclein condensate during interactions with various binding partners and cellular extracts to identify critical intermediate species and elucidate molecular mechanisms involved in mitochondrial functions and α-synuclein liquid-liquid phase separation and aggregation. Additionally, we will combine classical ensemble approaches alongside control experiments for verification. Complementarily, statistical analysis at single-molecule level can reconstruct ensemble observations while offering unique insights into heterogeneous population and probability. Through interdisciplinary collaborations, we will explore potential interventions to combat mitochondrial dysfunction and α-synuclein aggregation in neurodegenerative diseases. 隨著人口老齡化與預期壽命延長，神經退化性疾病的發生率持續攀升。柏金遜病作為一種常見且迄今無法治癒的神經退化性疾病，其核心病理特徵為α-突觸核蛋白異常聚集形成路易小體，伴隨粒線體功能障礙。α-突觸核蛋白表現量升高後，可在粒線體表面富集並誘導粒線體碎片化，進而促使粒線體核酸與核蛋白複合物釋放；這些釋放產物又會與α-突觸核蛋白進一步相互作用，使疾病病理機制更趨複雜。然而，現有研究對上述交互作用及其粒線體效應的詮釋仍顯不足，尤其是α-突觸核蛋白如何與粒線體內組分交互作用、進而影響其與帕金森氏症相關的聚集途徑，目前尚不清楚。 我們的前期數據表明，α-突觸核蛋白過度表現會顯著影響粒線體轉錄水平及細胞活力。我們觀察到α-突觸核蛋白與含有粒線體 DNA 及粒線體轉錄因子 A（TFAM）的粒線體核蛋白複合物之間存在特異性結合，鑑於 TFAM 是調控粒線體轉錄的核心因子且與神經退化性病變密切相關，這項發現可能為轉錄調控與細胞調節提供一條頗具前景的研究路徑。然而，闡明其潛在分子機制仍面臨巨大挑戰。 α- 突觸核蛋白作為典型的內在無序蛋白，結構高度異質，可與多種結合伴侶相互作用並觸發液 - 液相分離及毒性聚集，在非均相體系中形成動態奈米簇與結構異質的瞬態物種；線粒體核蛋白複合物本身亦具有動態特性且易發生液 - 液相分離。這些瞬態、異質的物種難以透過傳統群體測量法清晰解析，因此需要改進研究方法。 針對α-突觸核蛋白及粒線體核蛋白複合物的內在動態轉換與結構柔性，我們提出結合單分子與群體測量的光譜學方法，利用光鑷耦合拉曼光譜的新型平台，對單一分子進行力學操縱，捕捉其不同折疊狀態、構象動力學及與其他分子的動態轉換，同時引入無標記化學分辨能力，透過拉曼光譜或表面增強拉曼光譜（SERS）測量表徵分子結構、相互作用及微環境。具體而言，我們將在其與多種結合伴侶及細胞提取物相互作用的過程中，對單個線粒體核蛋白複合物、α-突觸核蛋白以及線粒體核蛋白複合物—α-突觸核蛋白凝聚體進行操縱與表徵，以識別關鍵中間物種，闡明線粒體功能及α-突觸核蛋白液—液相分離與聚集所涉及的分子機制。同時，我們將結合經典群體測量方法與對照實驗驗證單分子發現；單分子層次的統計分析則可進一步重構群體觀測結果，揭示異質性物種的分佈特徵與機率規律，從而實現單分子與群體層面的相互印證。最終，透過跨學科合作，我們將探索應對神經退化性疾病中粒線體功能障礙與 α- 突觸核蛋白聚集的潛在干預策略。

16311726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311726.value: 超快光譜解析解析光催化和電催化二氧化碳轉化反應的機制

16311726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311726.value: Carbon dioxide reduction (CO2RR) offers a critical pathway toward carbon neutrality, yet its reaction efficiency and selectivity are governed by elementary steps that unfold on ultrafast timescales and remain invisible to conventional characterization. This proposal will elucidate the mechanistic origins of photocatalytic and electrocatalytic CO2RR by directly resolving charge-carrier dynamics and transient intermediates from femtoseconds to microseconds, and by determining how interfacial chemical environments regulate these processes. We will integrate three complementary ultrafast platforms—femtosecond transient absorption (TA, spanning UV–Vis–NIR), electrically pumped transient absorption (E-TA) tailored for bias-driven electrocatalysis, and two-dimensional infrared (2D IR) and sum-frequency generation (SFG) spectroscopies—to build a coherent, time-resolved picture that bridges excited-state physics, interfacial chemistry, and macroscopic catalytic performance. Aim 1 quantifies charge generation, separation, transport, and recombination in model photocatalysts and electrode materials, leveraging optical TA for sub-ps events and E-TA for ns bias-induced carrier dynamics to test whether photo- and field-driven activation proceed through convergent pathways. Aim 2 identifies and tracks short-lived reaction intermediates within the 1000–2200 cm⁻¹ window, using 2D IR to decongest overlapping bands (e.g., *CO2⁻, *OCHO, *COOH, *OCCO) via cross-peak correlations and SFG to isolate adsorbates at buried interfaces with molecular orientation sensitivity. Aim 3 quantifies how electrolyte identity, pH, alkali-cation speciation, and interfacial hydration reshape carrier lifetimes, proton-coupled electron transfer, and intermediate stability, thereby tuning competition with the hydrogen evolution reaction. Our recent advances establish feasibility and unique capability: (i) 2D IR studies of molecular vibrational polaritons formed by Fe(CO)5 demonstrated that polaritons can accelerate energy transfer between different vibrational modes, suppressing pseudorotation while promoting intramolecular vibrational energy redistribution, validating our ability to disentangle different componential dynamics; and (ii) TA measurements on a crystalline MOF (Y-TCPDA) revealed an order-of-magnitude extension of charge-transfer lifetimes correlated with enhanced photocatalytic activity, illustrating our capacity to link femtosecond dynamics to catalytic metrics. The laboratory houses operational fs/ns TA and fs 2D IR instruments, with SFG and E-TA under active build-out to deliver surface specificity and electrical control. By unifying carrier kinetics, vibrational fingerprints of intermediates, and environmental effects in a single, time-resolved framework, this project will uncover hidden steps that gate CO2 activation and C–C coupling, establish quantitative structure–dynamics–function relationships for CO2RR, and deliver actionable design rules for next-generation catalysts and reaction environments relevant to sustainable fuels, chemicals manufacturing, and environmental remediation. 二氧化碳还原反应（CO2RR）為邁向碳中和提供了一條關鍵途徑，然而其反應效率與選擇性受制於在超快時間尺度上發生的基元步驟，這些步驟對傳統表徵手段而言仍是不可見的。 本研究將通過直接解析從飛秒到微秒尺度的電荷載流子動力學與瞬態中間體，並確定介面化學環境如何調控這些過程，來闡明光催化與電催化CO2RR的機理起源。我們將整合三個互補的超快平台——涵蓋紫外-可見-近紅外（UV–Vis–NIR）範圍的飛秒瞬態吸收光譜（TA）、專為偏壓驅動電催化設計的電泵浦瞬態吸收光譜（E-TA），以及二維紅外光譜（2D IR）與和頻產生光譜（SFG）——以建構一個連貫的、時間分辨的圖像，橋接激發態物理、介面化學與宏觀催化性能。 目標一：量化模型光催化劑與電極材料中電荷的生成、分離、傳輸與復合過程，利用光學瞬態吸收光譜捕捉亞皮秒事件，並利用E-TA捕捉奈秒級偏壓誘導的載流子動力學，以檢驗光驅動與電場驅動的活化過程是否經由趨同的路徑進行。 目標二：在1000–2200 cm⁻¹範圍內識別並追蹤短壽命反應中間體，利用二維紅外光譜藉由交叉峰關聯解析重疊譜帶（例如CO2⁻、OCHO、COOH、OCCO），並利用SFG以分子取向敏感性分離埋藏介面上的吸附物種。 目標三：量化電解質種類、pH值、鹼金屬陽離子物種形態及介面水合作用如何重塑載流子壽命、質子耦合電子轉移過程與中間體穩定性，從而調控其與氫氣演化反應之間的競爭關係。 我們近期的研究進展證實了此提案的可行性與獨特能力：（一）對Fe(CO)5所形成分子振動極化激元的二維紅外光譜研究表明，極化激元能夠加速不同振動模式間的能量轉移，抑制假旋轉的同時促進分子內振動能量的重新分佈，證實了我們解析不同組分動力學的能力；（二）對結晶態金屬有機框架（Y-TCPDA）的瞬態吸收光譜測量揭示了電荷轉移壽命延長一個數量級，且此延長與增強的光催化活性相關，展示了我們將飛秒動力學與催化指標相聯繫的能力。本實驗室已配備可運作的飛秒/納秒瞬態吸收與飛秒二維紅外光譜儀器，同時SFG與E-TA正在積極建置中，以實現表面特異性與電場控制。 透過在單一、時間分辨的框架中統一載流子動力學、中間體的振動指紋以及環境效應，本項目將揭示制約CO2活化與C–C偶聯的隱藏步驟，建立CO2RR的定量結構-動力學-功能關係，並為與可持續燃料、化學品製造及環境修復相關的下一代催化劑與反應環境提供可操作的設計準則。

16311826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311826.value: 涵蓋弱效應至量子反常霍爾效應的霍爾器件統一模型及其在計算領域的應用

16311826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311826.value: The relentless demand for more powerful and energy-efficient computing is pushing the limits of conventional silicon technology. To overcome this challenge, we must turn to exotic quantum materials whose unique internal properties—governed by the laws of quantum mechanics—can enable entirely new ways of processing information. One such property is the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), where a voltage spontaneously appears across a magnetic material when an electrical current is passed through it, without the need for an external magnet. This effect is not just a scientific curiosity; it can be harnessed to create ultra-efficient electronic components. However, a major roadblock exists. Scientists currently lack a unified understanding of the AHE. We have separate models for materials that show a weak effect and for ideal, "perfect" quantum materials that exhibit a quantized AHE (QAHE) at extremely low temperatures. The vast, promising middle ground—materials with a very strong AHE at practical temperatures—remains poorly understood and unexploited. This gap prevents us from reliably designing devices for real-world applications. This project aims to solve the core problem by creating the first comprehensive model for AHE-based devices. We will achieve this by systematically studying a range of advanced magnetic materials, measuring how their AHE responds to changes in temperature, magnetic field, and electrical current. Using these experiments, we will develop a "universal" theoretical and computational model that accurately describes the effect from its weakest to its strongest quantum form in collaboration with condensed matter theorists. This project builds upon our team's track record and promising preliminary results. We have already demonstrated the fabrication and control of key material systems, including magnetic topological insulators that exhibit the giant AHE, through well-established collaborations with material growth experts. Our initial experiments have successfully shown current-induced switching and analog memory operation in prototype devices, and we have developed a foundational simulation framework that validates our approach. These results provide a solid foundation for the proposed research. The impact of this research will be twofold. In terms of new knowledge, it will provide a fundamental understanding of how quantum phenomena in materials can be controlled and utilized under non-ideal, practical conditions. For society, this knowledge will directly enable the design of a new class of low-energy computing hardware. By bridging the gap between abstract quantum physics and practical engineering, this project will help lay the foundation for the next revolution in information technology. 對更強大及更節能計算技術的持續需求，正不斷挑戰傳統矽技術的極限。要克服這項挑戰，我們必須轉向探索嶄新的量子材料——這些材料獨特的內在特性受量子力學定律支配，能夠實現全新的資訊處理方式。反常霍爾效應（AHE）正是其中一項特性：當電流通過磁性材料時，即使沒有外加磁鐵，材料兩端亦會自發地產生電壓。此效應不僅是科學上的奇觀，更可用於製造超高效能的電子元件。然而，目前存在一個重大障礙：科學界對反常霍爾效應仍缺乏統一的理解。現有的模型各自獨立——一類適用於呈現弱效應的材料，另一類則適用於在極低溫下呈現量子化反常霍爾效應（QAHE）的理想「完美」量子材料。至於介乎兩者之間、前景廣闊的中間地帶——即在實際溫度下呈現極強反常霍爾效應的材料——卻仍未被充分理解和開發。這個缺口使我們無法可靠地設計出適用於實際應用的器件。本項目旨在透過建立首個針對反常霍爾效應器件的綜合模型，解決這一核心問題。我們將系統性地研究一系列先進磁性材料，量度其反常霍爾效應如何隨溫度、磁場及電流的變化而改變，從而達成目標。基於這些實驗，我們將與凝聚態物理理論學家合作，建立一套「通用」的理論及計算模型，準確描述由最弱至最強量子形態的整個效應範圍。本項目建基於本團隊的科研往績及具前景的初步成果。透過與材料生長專家的長期合作，我們已成功製備及操控多個關鍵材料系統，包括呈現巨反常霍爾效應的磁性拓撲絕緣體。我們的初步實驗已成功在原型器件中展示電流誘導開關及模擬記憶體運作，並已建立一個驗證我們研究方法的基礎模擬框架。這些成果為擬議的研究奠定了堅實基礎。本研究的影響將體現在兩方面。在新知識層面，它將從根本上闡明如何在非理想的實際條件下控制及利用材料中的量子現象。對社會而言，這些知識將直接促成新一代低能耗計算硬件的設計。透過連繫抽象的量子物理與實際工程應用，本項目將有助為資訊科技的下一次革命奠定基礎。

16500826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16500826.value: 平台隔离是否会构建数字“罪恶之城”？— 来自微调GenAI模型平台的证据

16500826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500826.value: One in three popular GenAI applications involves pornography. These applications are largely fueled by fine-tuned GenAI models, which are hosted and distributed on open platforms. This raises important questions about how platforms should manage content to help users navigate through porn-related vs. non-porn-related fine-tuned GenAI models. This study investigates platform segregation, an emerging governance strategy that enables hosting platforms to separate “safe” models from mixed models. We contend that developers refrain from producing porn-related models due to their generally stronger moral boundaries compared to those who engage in producing porn-related models. By extending moral boundary theory to the GenAI context and integrating it with literature on platform content moderation, we will examine the effects of platform segregation on both types of model developers and the downstream impact on users of these fine-tuned GenAI models. In this proposed project, we will collect data from one of the largest platforms that hosts a vast array of fine-tuned GenAI models and images generated by these models. We will leverage the implementation of a segregation policy on the platform and employ a regression discontinuity-in-time (RDiT) strategy to identify the causal impact of platform segregation on model developers and model users. Specifically, for model developers, we will examine how platform segregation affects the development of porn-related models. For model users, we will investigate the impact of segregation on the number of pornographic images they generate using these models and the porn intensity level of these images. Additionally, we will explore the underlying mechanisms of these effect, the interplay between model developers and model users, and potential spillover effects of the policy on other socially undesirable contents on the platform. This project will contribute to the emerging literature on GenAI governance by focusing on the governance of fine-tuned GenAI models, a rapidly growing area that has received limited academic attention from the IS community. Our project will also address a gap in the platform content moderation literature by focusing on pornography – a topic that has been largely overlooked in the literature but plays an increasingly significant role in the GenAI ecosystem. The findings of this research will provide valuable insights for platforms, governments, and professional organizations regarding effective strategies for governing pornographic GenAI models and the pornographic content they generate. 大约三分之一的主流生成式人工智能（GenAI）应用涉及色情内容。这些应用在很大程度上由经过微调的GenAI模型驱动，而这些模型通常托管和分发在开放平台上。这引发了关于平台如何管理内容，以帮助用户区分色情相关与非色情相关的微调GenAI模型的重要问题。本研究调查了平台隔离（platform segregation）这一新兴的治理策略，该策略使得托管平台能够将“安全”模型与混合模型分离开来。我们认为，“安全”模型开发者的道德边界通常比那些参与生产色情相关模型的开发者更为严格，因此他们会避免开发此类模型。通过将道德边界理论延伸至GenAI应用，并将其与平台内容管理文献相结合，我们将考察平台隔离对两类模型开发者及其下游微调GenAI模型用户的影响。 在本拟议项目中，我们将收集来自一个托管大量微调GenAI模型及其生成的图像的平台上的数据。我们将利用该平台隔离政策的实施，采用时间回归不连续设计（RDiT）策略，以识别平台隔离对模型开发者和模型用户的因果影响。具体而言，对于模型开发者，我们将考察平台隔离如何影响色情相关模型的开发。对于模型用户，我们将调查隔离政策对他们使用这些模型生成的色情图像数量以及这些图像的色情强度水平的影响。此外，我们还将探讨这些影响的潜在机制、模型开发者与模型用户之间的相互作用，以及该政策对平台上其他社会不希望内容可能产生的溢出效应。 本研究将通过聚焦于微调GenAI模型的治理，为新兴的GenAI治理文献做出贡献。这是一个快速增长的领域，但信息系统（IS）学术界对其的关注有限。本研究还将通过聚焦于色情内容——一个在文献中很大程度上被忽视的，但在GenAI生态系统中扮演着日益重要的角色的内容——来弥补平台内容管理文献中的一个空白。本研究的发现将为平台、政府和专业组织提供宝贵的见解，以制定治理色情GenAI模型及其所生成色情内容的有效策略。

16501226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16501226.value: 通向債務風險的快車道？中國地鐵審批中的基礎設施發展與地方財政

16501226.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16501226.value: Prof LIN, Yatang Prof LIU, Zhengcheng

16501226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16501226.value: Funding for infrastructure development has become a critical global challenge as cities confront rapid urbanization and the urgent need for improved public services and transportation networks. Municipalities often rely on debt financing for these essential projects, raising important questions about debt solvency and fiscal stability. While infrastructure investments can stimulate economic growth and enhance fiscal conditions through increased revenues, they also carry significant financial risks if not managed carefully. This proposed project will examine the implications of subway expansion plans on municipal finance in China, focusing on their effects on the issuance and pricing of Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs). Understanding this dynamic is crucial for policymakers as they balance infrastructure development with fiscal responsibility, particularly amid rising scrutiny of municipal debt levels. China’s subway systems have expanded significantly over the past few decades, becoming vital for urban mobility and economic vitality. This growth has alleviated traffic congestion and promoted commercial development, but the high costs of construction and maintenance can impose substantial financial burdens on local governments. For instance, the average cost of building a kilometer of subway can be considerable, raising concerns about increasing municipal debt. To address these challenges, the central government has implemented restrictions on new subway constructions in cities without existing systems to mitigate the risks associated with rising debt. This context underscores the need to evaluate how subway plan approvals impact municipalities’ financial health. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset at the city and bond levels from 2008 to 2017, this study aims to determine whether such approvals improve fiscal conditions through increased tax revenues and economic growth or exacerbate existing vulnerabilities, potentially placing cities in precarious financial situations. 隨著城市快速都市化，以及公共服務與交通運輸網絡改善需求日益迫切，基礎設施建設的融資問題已成為全球各國共同面臨的重要挑戰。地方政府通常仰賴債務融資以推動此類重大建設，然而，此舉亦引發對債務償付能力與財政穩定性的廣泛關注。基礎設施投資固然可能透過促進經濟成長與增加財政收入來改善地方財政狀況，但若缺乏審慎規劃與管理，亦可能伴隨顯著的財務風險。 本研究擬探討中國地鐵擴張規劃對地方財政之影響，特別聚焦於其對市政企業債券（Municipal Corporate Bonds, MCBs）發行與定價之作用機制。在地方政府債務水準日益受到關切的背景下，釐清基礎設施擴張與財政承擔之間的關係，對政策制定者於促進城市發展與維持財政紀律之間取得平衡，具有重要意義。 過去數十年間，中國地鐵系統快速擴張，已成為支撐城市運輸效率與經濟活力的重要基礎設施。地鐵建設一方面有助於紓解交通壅塞、提升城市可達性，並帶動商業與區域經濟發展；另一方面，其高額建設與後續維護成本亦可能對地方政府形成沉重財政負擔。例如，地鐵每公里造價通常相當高昂，因而加劇外界對地方政府債務持續攀升之憂慮。 為因應相關風險，中央政府已對尚未建成地鐵系統之城市的新建地鐵計畫設置限制，以抑制債務擴張可能帶來之財政風險。在此背景下，評估地鐵規劃獲批對地方財政健康之影響，具有重要的政策與學術價值。基於 2008 年至 2017 年之城市層級與債券層級綜合資料，本研究旨在檢驗地鐵規劃審批是否能透過提升稅收收入與促進經濟成長改善地方財政狀況，抑或進一步加劇既有的財政脆弱性，使城市面臨更高之財政風險。

16501426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16501426.value: 在线购物中的消费者决策建模：基于搜索过程的产品属性重要性学习

16501426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16501426.value: Abstract In today's digital marketplace, consumers often turn to online searches before making purchases, especially when they are unfamiliar with a product. When buying less familiar and infrequently purchased items with numerous attributes, consumers can easily observe the primary attributes from product descriptions. However, they frequently face uncertainty regarding the relevance of these attributes to product quality. This uncertainty can significantly influence their decisions on which keywords to enter in their search queries, which products to click on from search results, and ultimately, which products to purchase. The propose of this project is to empirically study consumers search and purchase decisions while taking into account of consumer learning of the importance of product attributes during the search process. We develop a dynamic structural model that captures consumer’s search query, click and purchase decisions, integrated through consumer learning of the relevance of product attributes to its quality throughout the search process. We apply this model to a dataset from a large digital platform for financial products that contains individual consumers’ search query, click and purchase histories for mutual funds. This work contributes to the existing literature by providing a modeling framework that integrates consumer learning of the relevance of product attributes to product quality into the search and purchase decision process. The results generated from this work provide insights for online platforms. By understanding how consumers learn and which information they find most relevant, companies can tailor their information design strategies to better meet consumer needs, leading to improved customer satisfaction and increased sales. 在当今数字化市场环境中，消费者在进行购买决策前，尤其是在面对不熟悉的产品时，往往会先进行在线搜索。对于那些不常购买且具有多种属性的产品，消费者通常可以从产品描述中直接观察到其主要属性。然而，他们往往不确定这些属性对于产品质量的重要性。这种不确定性会显著影响其搜索行为与购买决策，包括输入何种关键词、在搜索结果中点击哪些产品，以及最终选择购买哪一产品。 本项目旨在实证研究消费者的搜索与购买决策过程，并将消费者在搜索过程中对产品属性重要性的学习纳入分析框架之中。我们构建了一个动态结构模型，用以刻画消费者的搜索关键词选择、点击行为与购买决策，并通过消费者在搜索过程中对产品属性与产品质量关系的学习，将这些决策行为加以整合。我们将该模型应用于某大型数字金融平台的数据，该数据包含个人消费者在共同基金产品上的搜索、点击与购买历史记录。 本研究通过构建一个将产品属性重要性学习纳入搜索与购买决策过程的建模框架，对现有文献作出补充与拓展。研究结果有助于加深对消费者信息处理与学习机制的理解，为在线平台的信息展示与设计策略提供启示。通过理解消费者如何学习以及其认为哪些信息更为重要，企业可以优化信息设计，更好地满足消费者需求，从而提升用户满意度与销售表现。

16501826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16501826.value: 同步风险下的人工智能协同交易

16501826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16501826.value: This research proposal aims to investigate the trading strategies of AI arbitrageurs in financial markets characterized by synchronization risks, particularly in the context of asset price bubbles. Asset price bubbles occur when prices exceed fundamental values, and their identification is often challenging due to difficulties in measuring this value. Existing literature highlights that bubbles can persist when arbitrageurs are either unaware of their emergence or face frictions that hinder their trading activities. Notably, rational arbitrageurs may choose to ride bubbles rather than countering them, leading to delayed arbitrage and potential market crashes. A key mechanism behind this delayed response is synchronization risk, which arises when arbitrageurs become aware of the bubble's existence one by one. In this study, we will develop a simulation laboratory motivated by theory to explore whether AI-powered trading algorithms can learn to coordinate their responses to mispricing in the presence of synchronization risk. Unlike traditional models that assume rational expectations, our approach will incorporate reinforcement learning algorithms that enable AI arbitrageurs to learn through trial and error. We aim to address four critical research questions: (1) How do AI algorithms trade after recognizing a bubble in a multi-trader environment? (2) How do learning outcomes depend on factors such as the number of traders, the period over which arbitrageurs become aware sequentially, the informativeness of signals about bubble existence, and algorithm hyperparameters? (3) How do the behaviors of AI traders compare to those predicted by economic models under rational expectations? (4) How do AI traders interact with sophisticated human arbitrageurs in a mixed trading environment? Our project will contribute to the burgeoning literature on AI interactions in multi-player settings by examining AI coordination under synchronization risk, drawing on the seminal work of Abreu and Brunnermeier (2003). While existing studies focus on collusion in dynamic games, our research will reveal new insights into the mechanisms that allow AI to delay the correction of mispricing. By systematically exploring these dynamics through simulation, we aim to identify the algorithmic mechanisms that facilitate coordinated trading behaviors among AI arbitrageurs. Ultimately, this research has the potential to enhance our understanding of AI’s capacity for mutual knowledge development and its implications for regulatory policies in financial markets. 本研究计划旨在探讨在以同步风险（Synchronization Risks）为特征的金融市场中，特别是在资产价格泡沫的背景下，人工智能（AI）套利者的交易策略。当资产价格超过其基本价值时，就会出现资产价格泡沫；由于基本价值难以准确衡量，识别这些泡沫往往具有挑战性。现有文献强调，当套利者没有意识到泡沫的出现，或面临阻碍其交易活动的摩擦时，泡沫可能会持续存在。值得注意的是，理性的套利者可能会选择“骑乘泡沫”而不是对抗泡沫，从而导致套利行为的延迟和潜在的市场崩盘。这种延迟反应背后的一个关键机制是同步风险，即当套利者陆续意识到泡沫存在时所产生的风险。 在本研究中，我们将开发一个受理论启发的仿真实验室，以探索在存在同步风险的情况下，人工智能驱动的交易算法是否能够学会协调它们对错误定价的反应。与假设理性预期的传统模型不同，我们的方法将引入强化学习算法，使AI套利者能够通过试错进行学习。 我们旨在解决四个关键的研究问题：第一，在多交易者环境中，AI算法在识别出泡沫后将如何进行交易；第二，学习结果如何取决于交易者数量、套利者依次意识到泡沫的时间跨度、有关泡沫存在信号的信息量，以及算法的超参数等因素；第三，AI交易者的行为与理性预期下的经济模型所预测的行为相比有何异同；第四，在混合交易环境中，AI交易者将如何与经验丰富的人类套利者进行互动。 借鉴 Abreu 和 Brunnermeier（2003）的开创性工作，我们的项目将通过研究同步风险下的AI协调问题，为探讨多参与者环境中AI互动这一新兴文献领域做出贡献。尽管现有研究主要集中在动态博弈中的共谋问题，但我们的研究将揭示有关使AI能够延迟纠正错误定价机制的新见解。通过仿真模拟系统地探索这些动态，我们旨在确定促进AI套利者之间协调交易行为的算法机制。最终，这项研究有望加深我们对AI发展“共同知识”能力的理解，并为其在金融市场监管政策方面的启示提供参考。

16503226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503226.value: 氣候變化的新代價：極端天氣對交通運輸系統的經濟影響

16503226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503226.value: Extreme weather poses one of the most pressing risks of climate change, threatening infrastructure, supply chains, and economic resilience. Transportation systems are particularly exposed: localized floods or storms can disrupt traffic flows and create delays far beyond the affected region. Yet the mechanisms through which these disruptions translate into economic losses remain only partially understood. While climate science documents rising risks and economics has examined localized damages, little is known about how shocks propagate across transport networks and translate into broader welfare consequences. This project addresses these gaps by examining precipitation-related disruptions in China’s national trucking system, with direct relevance for densely connected coastal economies such as Hong Kong. Using proprietary high-frequency GPS data from tens of thousands of vehicles, matched with detailed weather and spatial information, we will quantify how rainfall affects delivery speeds, trip durations, stoppages, and route deviations. We will then trace how localized shocks spread through interconnected routes, identifying the network structures that amplify or mitigate disruption. Finally, we will assess the economic implications of these delays, including higher transport costs and reduced consumer welfare from untimely delivery, and evaluate adaptation strategies—from firm-level rerouting and rescheduling to infrastructure investment by policymakers. By linking climate shocks to real-time logistics performance and network spillovers, this study will provide the first systematic evidence on the economic costs and adaptive responses of weather-induced transport disruptions. The findings will deepen understanding of supply chain vulnerability under climate risk and inform strategies to strengthen transport resilience, a perspective especially relevant for compact, trade-dependent cities such as Hong Kong, where weather-related transport shocks can have outsized economic effects. 極端天氣是氣候變化帶來的最嚴峻風險之一，對基礎設施、供應鏈及經濟韌性構成重大威脅。交通運輸系統尤其容易受到影響：局部洪水或暴風雨不僅會中斷受影響地區的交通流動，亦可能透過運輸網絡造成遠距離的延誤。然而，這些擾動如何轉化為更廣泛的經濟損失，其背後機制仍未被充分理解。現有氣候科學研究已記錄氣候風險的上升趨勢，而經濟學研究亦探討了局部災害造成的損失，但對於氣候衝擊如何沿交通網絡擴散，以及如何進一步影響整體經濟福祉，相關研究仍然有限。 本項目旨在填補上述研究空白，通過研究中國全國貨運卡車系統中由降雨引致的運輸擾動，分析極端天氣對交通網絡及經濟活動的影響。研究結果亦與香港等高度互聯的沿海經濟體密切相關。本項目將利用涵蓋數萬輛車輛的高頻率專有 GPS 數據，並結合詳細天氣及空間資訊，量化降雨對貨運速度、行程時間、停留情況及路線調整的影響。研究將進一步追蹤局部天氣衝擊如何在相互連接的運輸路線中傳播，並識別哪些網絡結構因素會放大或減輕相關擾動。 此外，本項目將評估運輸延誤所帶來的經濟影響，包括更高的物流成本，以及因貨物未能及時交付而造成的消費者福利損失。同時，研究亦會分析不同適應策略的成效，包括企業層面的改道與行程調整，以及政策層面的基礎設施投資。通過將氣候衝擊與即時物流運作表現及網絡溢出效應相連結，本研究將首次系統性地揭示天氣導致的交通運輸中斷所帶來的經濟成本，以及相關的適應措施。 研究成果將加深對氣候風險下供應鏈脆弱性的理解，並為提升交通運輸韌性提供政策依據。這一視角對香港等高度集中、依賴貿易的城市尤為重要，因為在此類城市中，與天氣相關的交通運輸衝擊可能產生遠超其地理範圍的經濟影響。

16503926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503926.value: 订单流信息的策略性采集与分享

16503926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503926.value: In today’s rapidly evolving financial landscape, the execution of orders and the sharing of information have become critical concerns for both regulators and market participants. As trading activity increasingly shifts away from traditional exchanges, understanding the mechanisms that grant certain firms an edge in attracting order flow is paramount. This research proposal delves into the strategic use and collection of order-flow information by financial intermediaries, with a particular focus on off-exchange trading. To explore these complex interactions, we propose a theoretical model that jointly examines the order-routing and information-sharing decisions of both clients and intermediaries, allowing for the possibility that dealers can tailor their information sharing and fees to different types of clients. Our framework enables us to address several pressing questions: What strategies do dealer-operated off-exchange venues employ to attract order flow? Who possesses the order-flow information off-exchange, and how much is it worth? How does selective information sharing in these environments impact overall market functioning and the welfare of investors? By recognizing that market fragmentation and the degree of information sharing depend on the strategic interactions between clients and intermediaries, our framework can shed light—both qualitatively and quantitatively—on several policy discussions. For example, we will investigate the implications of restricting Payment for Order Flow (PFOF), the effects of holding a dual role as both an internalizer and an exchange market maker, and the potential costs and benefits of implementing “Chinese Walls” for market participants. Lastly, we will empirically test our model’s predictions regarding commission fee structures and the informativeness of trades. This analysis will highlight the welfare losses and distributional effects experienced by different types of traders in the market. 在当今快速演变的金融环境中，订单执行与信息共享已成为监管机构和市场参与者共同关注的关键议题。随着交易活动日益从传统交易所转向其他交易场所，理解某些机构在吸引订单流方面获得优势的机制变得尤为重要。 本研究计划深入探讨金融中介机构在场外交易对订单流信息的策略性使用与收集。为分析这些复杂的互动关系，我们拟构建一个理论模型，将客户与中介机构的订单路由决策和信息共享决策纳入同一框架，并允许交易商根据不同类型的客户定制信息共享方式和收费结构。该框架使我们能够回答若干亟待解决的问题：由交易商运营的场外交易场所采用何种策略来吸引订单流？在场外交易环境中，谁掌握订单流信息，而这些信息又具有多大价值？在此类环境下，选择性信息共享将如何影响整体市场运行以及投资者福利？ 通过认识到市场碎片化程度以及信息共享程度取决于客户与中介机构之间的策略互动，我们的框架能够从定性和定量两个层面为若干政策讨论提供洞见。例如，我们将研究限制订单流支付（Payment for Order Flow, PFOF）的影响，探讨同时担任内部化交易商和交易所做市商这一双重角色的效应，并评估为市场参与者设置“信息隔离墙”（Chinese Walls）可能带来的成本与收益。最后，我们将对模型关于佣金费用结构和交易信息含量的预测进行实证检验。该分析将揭示市场中不同类型交易者所承受的福利损失及其分配效应。

16504126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504126.value: 轉售模式與代理銷售模式共存時線上市場中的資訊共享

16504126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504126.value: Online retailing is a cornerstone of the modern economy. Platforms such as Tmall and Amazon serve as vital intermediaries that connect sellers and suppliers with consumers. These platforms predominantly operate under two contrasting models. Reselling Model (Vendor Central): “Vendors” sell their products in bulk to the platform at wholesale prices. The platform then resells those products to consumers (e.g., Amazon's Vendor Central, JD.com). Vendors essentially operate as suppliers, not directly interacting with end customers. The platform acts as the official storefront and retailer for the vendors’ products, setting retail prices and handling fulfillment. Agency Selling Model (Seller Central): Third-party “sellers” directly interact with and sell to end customers via the platform (e.g., Amazon Seller Central, Tmall). The platform acts as an intermediary facilitating the transaction and payment processing while charging a commission or agency fee. Agency selling allows sellers to act as their own agents, directly managing sales to customers while leveraging the platform’s technology and logistics. Sellers set their own retail prices. Online platforms collect vast amounts of consumer data, including browsing behavior, cart activity, demographics, and purchase history, enabling them to generate quite accurate demand forecasts. Sharing this data with the vendors in the reselling channel risks exacerbating double marginalization. However, in the agency model, the platform's earnings are directly tied to sellers' revenue, aligning interests and mitigating this issue, potentially creating incentives for information sharing. Industry practices vary. Amazon provides its data tool AMALYZE to all suppliers, regardless of their operating mode, supporting analysis of products, keywords, and pricing. Contrastingly, JD.com grants access to its JD Business Intelligence (which offers real-time demand forecasts and competitive insights) to agency sellers only; reselling-channel vendors have no access to it, even for a fee. However, the issue of how the coexistence (hybrid) of agency and reselling modes affects information-sharing incentives has received little attention, despite its real-world relevance. In the hybrid format, the traditional consideration of data transparency may no longer apply. We will address three critical questions: Should platforms share demand forecasts only with agency sellers, or with vendors also? Does the presence of agency selling enable profitable data sharing with the vendors? How does the market structure (the number of sellers and vendors and the degree of product substitution) affect the incentives for information sharing? Answers to these questions will provide managerial insights into how platforms leverage their core advantage: data. 線上零售是現代經濟的基石。天貓與亞馬遜等平台作為重要的中介，連結了賣家、供應商與消費者。這些平台主要運行於兩種截然不同的模式之下。 轉售模式（Vendor Central）： 「供應商」以批發價將產品大量出售給平台，平台再將這些產品轉售給消費者（如亞馬遜的 Vendor Central、京東）。供應商本質上是作為供貨方，並不直接與終端顧客互動。平台則充當供應商產品的官方店面與零售商，負責設定零售價格並處理履約。 代理銷售模式（Seller Central）： 第三方「賣家」透過平台直接與終端顧客互動並銷售產品（如亞馬遜 Seller Central、天貓）。平台作為中介，促成交易與支付處理，並收取佣金或代理費。代理銷售使賣家能作為自身代理人，直接管理銷售，同時利用平台的技術與物流。賣家自行設定零售價格。 線上平台收集大量消費者數據，包括瀏覽行為、購物車活動、人口統計與購買歷史，從而能生成相當精準的需求預測。在轉售渠道中，與供應商共享這些數據可能加劇「雙重邊際化」問題。然而，在代理模式下，平台收益直接與賣家收入掛鉤，利益一致性減輕了此問題，並可能創造資訊共享的誘因。 行業實踐各異。亞馬遜向所有供應商提供其數據工具 AMALYZE，不論其運行模式，支持產品、關鍵字與定價分析。相反地，京東僅向代理賣家提供 JD 商業智慧工具（提供即時需求預測與競爭洞察）；轉售渠道的供應商即使付費也無法使用。 然而，代理與轉售模式並存（混合模式）如何影響資訊共享誘因的問題，迄今鮮少受到關注，儘管其在現實中高度相關。在混合模式下，傳統的數據透明性考量可能不再適用。我們將探討三個關鍵問題：平台是否應僅與代理賣家共享需求預測，還是也應與供應商共享？代理銷售的存在是否使得與供應商共享數據更具盈利性？市場結構（賣家與供應商的數量以及產品替代程度）如何影響資訊共享的誘因？這些問題的答案將為管理者提供洞見，幫助平台發揮其核心優勢：數據。

16504226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504226.value: 一个主观非贝叶斯更新的框架

16504226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504226.value: While Bayes' rule remains the benchmark updating rule in economic analysis—yielding a rich body of insights—numerous systematic violations have been documented. In response, a variety of non-Bayesian rules have been proposed to capture deviations such as confirmation bias and overreaction to unexpected events. Existing models typically hinge on two features of new information: (1) its likelihood under the decision maker's prior (perceived surprise), and (2) the divergence between the prior and the Bayesian posterior (perceived conflict). Both are usually treated as objectively determined once the prior is fixed. This project adopts a subjective approach. We propose that decision makers mentally associate states or signals—viewing some as instances of the same underlying incident—and therefore do not fully distinguish among them when judging surprise or conflict. When evaluating the likelihood of new information, the decision maker may map it to a broader perceived event, inducing a nonmonotonic relation between perceived surprise and objective probability. When assessing prior–posterior conflict, she may compare beliefs across a subjective partition of the state space rather than state-by-state. We revisit prominent models that allow deviations from Bayes' rule and extend them to incorporate subjective association, thereby generating new behavioral implications. We also explore applications of these extended models in strategic settings such as games and information design, and in other domains of economic analysis. Beyond theory, the project yields practical guidance for designing and interpreting information where framing and categorization matter. In markets, subjective association helps explain consumers' disproportionate reactions to ``extreme'' signals and inertia to mixed evidence, informing branding and A/B testing that calibrate category labels and message granularity to steer belief revision predictably. In finance and policy communication, the framework clarifies when salient narratives trigger outsized updates despite moderate probabilities, aiding disclosure and advisory design that reduce misinterpretation and stabilize expectations. For platforms and analytics teams, the axioms imply testable restrictions that can be embedded in behavioral forecasting and targeting models, improving prediction and the evaluation of interventions that rely on belief change. 尽管贝叶斯法则仍是经济分析中信念更新的基准规则，并由此产生了丰富的研究洞见，但文献中也记录了大量系统性偏离贝叶斯更新的现象。因此，学界提出了多种非贝叶斯更新规则，用以刻画确认偏误、对意外事件过度反应等偏离贝叶斯更新的行为。现有模型通常依赖新信息的两个特征：（1）该信息在决策者先验信念下的似然性，即感知惊讶程度；以及（2）先验信念与贝叶斯后验信念之间的差异，即感知冲突。通常认为，一旦先验信念给定，这两个特征便由客观因素决定。 本项目采取一种主观视角。我们认为，决策者会在心理上将某些状态或信号相互关联，将它们视为同一潜在事件的不同实例，因此在判断惊讶程度或冲突程度时，并不会完全区分这些状态或信号。在评估新信息的似然性时，决策者可能会将其归入一个更宽泛的感知事件，从而使感知惊讶程度与客观概率之间呈现非单调关系。在评估先验信念与后验信念之间的冲突时，决策者可能会基于状态空间的主观划分来比较信念，而不是逐一按状态进行比较。 我们将重新审视若干允许偏离贝叶斯法则的代表性模型，并将其扩展为能够纳入主观关联的框架，从而推导出新的行为含义。我们还将探索这些扩展模型在战略情境中的应用，例如博弈与信息设计，以及其在经济分析其他领域中的应用。 除理论贡献之外，本项目还将为信息的设计与解读提供实践指导，尤其适用于框架设定和分类方式十分重要的情境。在市场中，主观关联有助于解释消费者为何会对“极端”信号作出不成比例的反应，以及为何会在面对混合证据时表现出惯性；这一视角可为品牌塑造和 A/B 测试提供启示，即通过调整类别标签和信息颗粒度，以可预测的方式引导信念修正。在金融和政策沟通中，该框架有助于阐明在何种情况下，显著叙事会在概率并不高的情况下引发过度更新，从而帮助设计信息披露和咨询机制，以减少误解并稳定预期。对于平台和数据分析团队而言，该框架中的公理意味着一系列可检验的限制条件，可被嵌入行为预测和定向投放模型中，从而提升预测能力，并更好地评估依赖信念变化的干预措施。

16504426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504426.value: 精英迁移与经济发展：来自分裂朝鲜半岛的证据

16504426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16504426.value: Prof Becker, Sascha Prof Won, Cheongyeon

16504426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504426.value: This project examines whether large-scale migration from North to South Korea between 1945 and 1953 helped spark South Korea’s later economic transformation. When Korea was divided after World War II, the North was more industrialized, with established factories and infrastructure, while the South remained largely agricultural (Eckert, 1990; Edward et al., 1980). Yet within a few decades, the South became one of the world’s fastest-growing economies, while the North stagnated. An estimated 0.7–1.3 million people moved from North to South Korea during this period—around 8–15% of the North’s population. Many were educated professionals, entrepreneurs, and religious leaders fleeing the new regime in the North (Armstrong, 2004). This large and selective inflow of human capital may have played a crucial role in shaping South Korea’s future. We hypothesize that northern migrants accelerated development by bringing technical expertise, fostering entrepreneurship, strengthening educational and religious institutions, and creating knowledge networks that encouraged innovation and growth. To test this, the project will assemble new historical datasets, combining population censuses, migrant records, firm and patent data, and archival information on schools, churches, and civic organizations from 1930 to 2020. We will also conduct our own ancestry surveys to trace inter-generational effects. Comparing regions that received more or fewer migrants will allow us to see whether northern inflows spurred faster industrial, educational, and institutional development. Our empirical strategy uses several complementary methods to identify causal effects. We exploit geographic factors—such as transport routes and terrain—that influenced where migrants could settle but were unrelated to local economic potential. We also compare changes over time between regions with differing migrant exposure to isolate the migration effect. Furthermore, we analyze individual-level data on entrepreneurs, scientists, and religious leaders to trace specific channels of migrant influence. This research contributes to growing literature on the economic consequences of forced migration (Becker & Ferrara, 2019) while offering new insights into South Korea’s development puzzle. Studies of Germany demonstrate how selective migration across the East-West divide after World War II influenced postwar development patterns (Becker, Mergele, & Woessmann, 2020). Understanding how selective population movements shaped one of history’s most successful development cases provides lessons for contemporary contexts facing large-scale displacement. The findings will inform debates on refugee integration, human capital transfer, and the long-term developmental impacts of political migration. 本项目旨在探讨1945年至1953年间由朝鲜（北方）向韩国（南方）的大规模人口迁移，是否对韩国日后的经济转型起到了推动作用。第二次世界大战后，朝鲜半岛分裂，北方工业化程度较高，拥有既有的工厂与基础设施，而南方则以农业为主（Eckert, 1990; Edward et al., 1980）。然而在短短数十年内，南方一跃成为全球增长最快的经济体之一，北方则陷入停滞。 据估计，在此期间约有70万至130万人由北方迁往南方，约占北方人口的8%至15%。其中许多人是为逃离北方新政权而南下的，他们多为受过良好教育的专业人士、企业家及宗教领袖（Armstrong, 2004）。这一大规模且具有高度选择性的人力资本流入，可能对塑造韩国的未来发挥了关键作用。我们提出假设：北方移民通过带来技术专长、培育企业家精神、强化教育与宗教机构，以及构建鼓励创新与增长的知识网络，加速了南方的发展。 为检验这一假设，本项目将构建全新的历史数据集，整合1930年至2020年间的人口普查、移民记录、企业与专利数据，以及有关学校、教会与公民组织的档案资料。我们还将自行开展家族谱系调查，以追溯其代际影响。通过比较接收移民数量不同的地区，我们得以考察北方人口流入是否推动了更快速的工业、教育与制度发展。 我们的实证策略采用多种互补方法以识别因果效应。我们利用地理因素——例如交通路线与地形——这些因素影响了移民的定居地点，却与当地的经济潜力无关。我们同时比较移民接收程度不同的地区随时间推移的变化，以分离出迁移效应。此外，我们分析企业家、科学家与宗教领袖的个体层面数据，以追溯移民产生影响的具体渠道。 本研究为日益丰富的关于被迫迁移之经济后果的文献作出贡献（Becker & Ferrara, 2019），同时为韩国的发展之谜提供新的见解。有关德国的研究表明，二战后跨越东西方分界线的选择性迁移如何影响了战后的发展模式（Becker, Mergele, & Woessmann, 2020）。理解选择性人口流动如何塑造了历史上最成功的发展案例之一，可为当代面临大规模人口流离失所的情境提供借鉴。研究结果将为有关难民融合、人力资本转移，以及政治性迁移之长期发展影响的讨论提供依据。

16504926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16504926.value: Prof CHO, Hang Jun Prof Yang, Hisan

16504926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504926.value: In an era of deepening polarization, organizations increasingly face stigmatization campaigns that potentially divide rather than unite their stakeholders. This study investigates a critical yet underexplored consequence of contested stigmatization: how these campaigns reshape the workforce composition of targeted organizations through employee sorting processes. When stigmatizing claims remain disputed, employees may respond heterogeneously based on their moral judgments and perceptions of how others view organizational practices. Some employees may exit because they personally condemn the practices or because association carries social costs. Others may remain or intensify commitment because they reject stigmatizing claims or are less concerned about external perceptions. This sorting could strengthen rather than weaken targeted organizations by consolidating workforces around those more resistant to external pressures. We develop and test theory on contested stigmatization by examining fossil fuel divestment movements that emerged in the U.S. Unlike conventional stigmatization where consensus typically forms around clear wrongdoing, fossil fuel stigmatization occurs in a polarized context where both the legitimacy of fossil fuel practices and the validity of environmental critiques remain fundamentally disputed. This contestation creates conditions where employee sorting unfolds through dual pathways: employees may depart because continued employment conflicts with their environmental values, or because association with stigmatized organizations could impose social and career penalties regardless of personal beliefs. Whether departures stem from either concern, the result would likely be selective rather than random workforce change. We examine how contested stigmatization reshapes fossil fuel companies' workforce composition and organizational behavior. We analyze whether stigmatization increases employee turnover at targeted firms, whether graduates from universities committing to divestment become less likely to enter fossil fuel employment, and whether resulting compositional changes manifest in shifts toward more oppositional political stances. Using comprehensive datasets tracking employee mobility patterns, university divestment commitments, and political contribution records, we document both the sorting process and its organizational consequences. The fossil fuel context offers theoretical leverage because targeted firms have maintained viability despite over a decade of intensive stigmatization efforts. This persistence challenges theories predicting organizational decline following sustained stigmatization campaigns. By demonstrating how employee sorting may consolidate rather than fragment organizational resistance, this research identifies boundary conditions for stigmatization effectiveness in polarized societies. It contributes to stigmatization theory by revealing mechanisms through which contested legitimacy may limit campaign impacts, extends stakeholder theory by showing how stakeholder heterogeneity becomes consequential under contestation, and provides insights into why stigmatization campaigns may produce unintended consequences. 16505326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505326.value: 平台中具有飛輪效應與重尾觀測的因果估計

16505326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505326.value: Two-sided online platforms such as e-commerce, ride-hailing, and social media have become central to modern life. To improve user experience and guide product development, these platforms routinely rely on online experiments, often called A/B tests. These tests help measure the impact of new features before large-scale rollout. However, designing reliable A/B tests is highly challenging in practice. Two major difficulties are especially pressing: (1) the flywheel effect created by sharing mechanisms, and (2) heavy-tailed data observed in user activity and revenue. The flywheel effect refers to a self-reinforcing cycle of user engagement: when a user shares content, recipients may themselves become sharers, creating cascades that expand reach and fuel long-term growth. Measuring this effect is vital for platforms that depend on viral sharing, but traditional A/B testing methods assume users act independently. This assumption ignores complex social interactions and feedback loops, often leading to severe underestimation of the true value of sharing features. Heavy-tailed data arises when a small fraction of users accounts for a disproportionately large share of engagement or spending—for instance, a few “super-users” contributing most of the revenue. In such cases, standard statistical methods become unreliable, as extreme values dominate averages and obscure meaningful treatment effects. This reduces the sensitivity of A/B tests and may cause platforms to overlook valuable innovations. The proposed project will develop new statistical tools and experimental designs to address these challenges. For flywheel effects, we will construct models that explicitly account for social network interactions and dynamic sharing cascades. We will design estimators that remain valid under interference across users, enabling accurate measurement of long-term engagement benefits. For heavy-tailed outcomes, we will develop robust estimation strategies that stabilize averages, reduce variance, and incorporate pre-experimental data. We will also explore interleaving experiments—where users are simultaneously exposed to multiple recommendation algorithms—as a way to improve statistical efficiency. The proposed research will yield practical methods that make online experiments more reliable, efficient, and insightful. Ultimately, it will enhance the ability of organizations to innovate responsibly, improving decision-making in environments where user interactions and extreme behaviors play a central role. 電子商務、網約車和社交媒體等雙邊線上平台已成為現代生活的核心。為了改善使用者體驗並指導產品開發，這些平台經常依賴線上實驗（通常稱為 A/B 測試），以在大規模推出之前衡量新功能的影響。然而，在實踐中設計可靠的 A/B 測試極具挑戰性，其中有兩個主要困難尤為緊迫：(1) 分享機制產生的飛輪效應，以及 (2) 在使用者活躍度與營收中觀察到的重尾數據。飛輪效應是指使用者參與度的自我強化循環：當使用者分享內容時，接收者本身也可能成為分享者，從而產生擴大觸及範圍並推動長期成長的級聯效應。對於依賴病毒式分享的平台而言，衡量這種效應至關重要，但傳統的 A/B 測試方法假設使用者行為是獨立的，忽略了複雜的社交互動與回饋迴圈，往往導致嚴重低估分享功能的真實價值。另一方面，重尾數據出現在一小部分使用者佔據了不成比例的極高參與度或消費額時（例如少數「超級使用者」貢獻了大部分的營收）。在這種情況下，標準的統計方法會變得不可靠，因為極端值會主導平均數並掩蓋有意義的實驗處理效應，進而降低測試敏感度，可能導致平台錯失有價值的創新。本提案計畫將開發新的統計工具與實驗設計來應對這些挑戰。針對飛輪效應，我們將構建明確考慮社交網路互動與動態分享級聯的模型，並設計在使用者間存在干擾時依然有效的估計式，以準確衡量長期參與度的效益；針對重尾結果，我們將開發穩健的估計策略來穩定平均數、降低變異數並整合實驗前的數據；此外，我們還將探索交錯實驗（讓使用者同時接觸多種推薦演算法）作為提高統計效率的方法。本項提議的研究將產生實用的方法，使線上實驗變得更可靠、更高效且更具洞察力，最終將提升組織負責任地進行創新的能力，並改善在使用者互動和極端行為扮演核心角色的環境中的決策過程。

16505426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505426.value: 策略性摘要：AI 摘要在引导消费者搜索中的作用

16505426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505426.value: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled information summaries to become ubiquitous in applications such as e-commerce (e.g., Amazon review highlights), search engines (e.g., Google overviews), and video platforms (e.g., YouTube auto-summaries). These tools are intended to reduce decision-makers’ information acquisition costs amid information overload. This proposed research will aim to answer the following question: How can AI summaries be designed to guide diverse consumers in processing information at varying depths and making informed decisions? We propose a unified framework combining analytical modeling and empirical validation, focused on consumer search. Theoretically, we will model consumers' optimal information search by integrating two novel features: (a) the limited attention of consumers and (b) the nature of summaries as correlated, aggregated signals from reviews. Unlike standard models, which assume independent signals and full attention, our approach will capture consumers’ trade-off between processing a low-cost aggregated signal and expending greater effort to obtain a more precise signal. Here, the summary design—low-cost but imprecise versus effortful and precise—plays a pivotal role in moderating this trade-off. As a result, the fidelity (precision) of a summary can steer consumers’ search paths and purchase likelihoods non-monotonically. We will contrast this with fixed-cost benchmarks to highlight the role of rational inattention. Empirically, we will test our predictions via a randomized controlled experiment. We plan to invite participants to complete incentive-aligned product shopping tasks. We will vary the total reviews, summary informativeness (via large language model or embedding-based methods), and prices. We will track consumers’ complete shopping behaviors (summary/review opening, time spent, purchases) and perceptions (informativeness, confidence) to test our theoretical predictions. The expected contributions of the proposed work will advance consumer search theory by relaxing full-attention and independence assumptions, thus enriching the platform information design literature. Managerially, the research will provide guidelines for designers regarding when a summary should be designed to induce further searching (i.e., “summary as an invitation to search”), and when it should be designed to stop further information acquisition (i.e., “summary is all you need”). This research will inform AI-driven platforms to optimize summaries for improved consumer outcomes. 在生成式人工智能的推动下，信息摘要已广泛渗透到各类应用场景之中，包括电子商务（如亚马逊的评论亮点）、搜索引擎（如谷歌的AI概览）以及视频平台（如YouTube的自动摘要）。这些工具旨在缓解信息过载，降低决策者的信息获取成本。本研究计划试图回答的问题是：应如何设计AI摘要，以引导异质性消费者以不同深度处理信息，并做出知情决策？ 我们提出一个融合解析建模与实证检验的统一框架，聚焦于消费者搜索。在理论层面，我们刻画消费者的最优信息搜索行为，并同时引入两个新特征：（a）消费者的注意力有限；（b）摘要是由评论聚合而成、并与评论相关的信号。与假设信号相互独立且注意力充分的标准模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了消费者面临的权衡：是处理成本低廉的聚合信号，还是付出更大努力以获取更精确的信号。摘要信号的设计由此在调节这一权衡中起到关键作用——低成本但不够精确的摘要，对应需要耗费努力但更为精确的评论。其结果是，摘要的保真度（精确性）会以非单调的方式引导消费者的搜索路径与购买概率。我们进一步与固定成本的基准模型进行对照，凸显理性疏忽（rational inattention）在其中的作用。 在实证层面，我们通过随机对照实验检验上述理论预测。我们计划邀请被试完成激励相容的商品购物任务，并对评论总量、摘要的信息量（借助大语言模型或基于嵌入向量的方法进行操纵）以及价格加以随机操纵。我们记录消费者完整的购物行为（是否打开摘要/评论、停留时长、购买决策）及其主观感知（信息量、决策信心），以检验理论预测。 本研究的贡献在于放松了注意力充分与信号独立这两项假设，推进消费者搜索理论，并丰富平台信息设计的相关文献。在管理层面，本研究可为设计者提供指引：何时应将摘要设计为促使消费者进一步搜索（即"摘要作为搜索的邀请"），何时又应将其设计为终止进一步的信息获取（即"摘要足矣"）。这一研究可为AI驱动的平台优化摘要设计、改善消费者决策结果提供参考。

16505526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505526.value: 全球經濟下的女性創業：來自越南的證據

16505526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16505526.value: Prof LIN, Yatang Prof Wang, Jin Dr Zhan, Chaoqun

16505526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505526.value: This research proposal investigates the gendered impacts of trade shocks on entrepreneurship and business leadership in Vietnam, a rapidly developing economy characterized by significant trade dependence and a notable gender gap in entrepreneurship. Despite an increase in women's startup activity over the past decades, female-led firms continue to experience lower revenues and profits compared to their male counterparts, particularly in developing countries. This study aims to explore how global market forces, particularly import, export, and foreign direct investment (FDI) shocks, influence the performance and entry of female entrepreneurs. Combining administrative firm and household data, the research addresses three critical questions: i. Do trade shocks narrow or widen the performance gaps between female- and male-led enterprises? ii. How do these shocks affect female entrepreneurial activity? iii. Which mechanisms may explain the observed gender-differentiated effects of trade shocks? The analysis focuses on three major trade events in Vietnam: the 2001 U.S.–Vietnam Bilateral Trade Agreement, Vietnam's 2007 WTO accession, and the U.S.–China trade tensions since 2018. By employing a unified empirical framework, the study will assess the implications of these trade shocks on the performance of female-led firms and the broader entrepreneurial landscape for women in Vietnam. This research contributes to the literature on trade and gender gaps, providing new insights into how trade liberalization can either mitigate or exacerbate existing barriers faced by female entrepreneurs. Furthermore, it aims to inform policy recommendations that promote inclusive growth and enhance the participation of women in economic development. 本研究計畫旨在考察貿易衝擊對越南創業活動與企業領導中的性別化影響。越南是一個快速發展的經濟體，具有高度貿易依賴性，同時在創業領域存在明顯的性別差距。儘管過去數十年來女性創業活動有所增加，但與男性經營的企業相比，女性領導的企業在收入與利潤方面仍然較低，這一現象在發展中國家尤為突出。本研究旨在探討全球市場力量，尤其是進口、出口與外國直接投資（FDI）衝擊，如何影響女性創業者的企業績效以及進入創業領域的情況。 本研究將結合企業行政資料與住戶資料，重點回答三個關鍵問題：第一，貿易衝擊會縮小還是擴大女性領導企業與男性領導企業之間的績效差距？第二，這些衝擊如何影響女性創業活動？第三，哪些機制可以解釋貿易衝擊所產生的性別差異化影響？本研究將重點分析越南的三項重大貿易事件：2001年《美越雙邊貿易協定》、越南於2007年加入世界貿易組織（WTO），以及2018年以來的中美貿易摩擦。透過採用統一的實證分析框架，本研究將評估這些貿易衝擊對女性領導企業績效的影響，以及其對越南女性整體創業環境的更廣泛影響。 本研究將為貿易與性別差距相關文獻作出貢獻，並為理解貿易自由化如何緩解或加劇女性創業者所面臨的既有障礙提供新的見解。此外，本研究亦旨在為政策建議提供依據，以促進包容性增長，並提升女性在經濟發展中的參與度。

16505726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505726.value: 基于财富对称内生化企业与工人的异质性——一个包含家庭所有企业与纳什讨价还价的劳动力搜寻框架

16505726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505726.value: This proposal develops a unified framework that integrates the two primary traditions of modern macroeconomics: the Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides (DMP) model of labor-market frictions and the Bewley–Huggett–Aiyagari (BHA) model of endogenous wealth inequality. Efforts have been made to integrate these two models, maintaining heterogeneity on the worker side and sometimes assuming exogenous firm differences. Building on this literature, the present project extends the analysis by endogenizing wealth heterogeneity on both sides (workers and firms) through the same underlying frictions. Specifically, we construct a model in which firms are owned by and traded among households, unemployment arises from search and matching, and wages are determined by Nash bargaining. Our model, inspired by Jin and Zhu (2022), uses bilateral bargaining that naturally links the wealth of one party to the feasible outcomes of the other. A worker’s wealth affects their wage bargain and job-search behavior, while a firm owner’s wealth influences vacancy creation and hiring. These interactions generate a feedback loop between wealth inequality and labor-market dynamics that cannot be captured by either the DMP or BHA frameworks alone. In equilibrium, wealth differences jointly determine employment, wages, and job creation, producing a coherent account of how inequality and unemployment co-evolve. The project will quantitatively analyze this framework and develop the computational tools required to solve it. A central technical contribution is a fixed-point algorithm that employs a moment-based approximation to manage the high-dimensional distribution of workers’ capital within the bargaining process while preserving key interdependencies. The model will be calibrated to U.S. and Hong Kong data to examine how frictions shape the joint distribution of wealth, employment, and wages. Beyond its theoretical contribution, the project provides a platform for policy analysis. The wealth–bargaining feedback mechanism alters the transmission of monetary and fiscal policies: inflation or transfers can shift bargaining positions and hence influence both inequality and unemployment.
