By embedding two-sided heterogeneity into a unified, frictional setting, the model offers new insights into how wealth dynamics interact with job creation and policy effectiveness in decentralized labor markets. 本提案旨在开发一个统一的分析框架，将现代宏观经济学的两大核心传统相结合：关于劳动力市场摩擦的 Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides (DMP) 模型，以及关于内生财富不平等的 Bewley-Huggett-Aiyagari (BHA) 模型。现有的文献在尝试整合这两个模型时，通常保留了工人端的异质性，或假设企业端存在外生差异。在这些研究的基础上，本项目进一步拓展了分析范围，通过相同的底层摩擦机制，将劳资双方（工人和企业）的财富异质性同时内生化。具体而言，我们构建的模型中，企业由家庭所有并在家庭间进行交易，失业源于搜寻与匹配摩擦，而工资则由纳什讨价还价（Nash bargaining）决定。 受 Jin 和 Zhu (2022) 的启发，我们的模型采用了双边讨价还价机制，该机制自然地将一方的财富与另一方的可行收益联系起来。工人的财富会影响其工资谈判和求职行为，而企业主的财富则会影响岗位空缺的创造和雇佣决策。这些互动在财富不平等与劳动力市场动态之间产生了一个反馈循环，这是单独的 DMP 或 BHA 框架所无法捕捉的。在均衡状态下，财富差异共同决定了就业、工资和岗位创造，从而为不平等与失业如何协同演化提供了一个自洽的解释。 本项目将对这一框架进行定量分析，并开发求解该模型所需的计算工具。其中一项核心技术贡献是引入了一种不动点算法，该算法采用基于矩的近似方法（moment-based approximation），在讨价还价过程中处理工人资本的高维分布，同时保留了关键的相互依赖关系。模型将利用美国和香港的数据进行参数校准，以考察摩擦如何塑造财富、就业和工资的联合分布。 除了理论贡献之外，本项目还为政策分析提供了一个平台。财富-讨价还价的反馈机制改变了货币和财政政策的传导路径：通货膨胀或转移支付能够改变谈判地位，进而同时影响不平等和失业。通过将双边异质性嵌入到一个统一的摩擦性环境中，该模型为分散化劳动力市场中财富动态、岗位创造以及政策有效性之间的相互作用，提供了全新的见解。

16505826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505826.value: 超越智能，迈向理性：面向金融决策的AI去偏研究

16505826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505826.value: We propose to develop debiasing methods for large language models (LLMs) used in financial decision-making. This empirical study has three goals: (1) build a finance domain-specific benchmark that measures the biases in probabilistic reasoning and rational decision-making, such as overconfidence, recency bias, and extrapolation; (2) design debiasing methods that involve fine-tuning of open-source models to go beyond prompt engineering; and (3) validate these methods by testing improvements on downstream financial tasks and in simulated market settings. Our proposal to move beyond prompting and adopt supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) will enable solutions that are robust to prompt injections and are transferable to high-stakes fields. Our focus on open-source models is aimed at completing this goal. Financial institutions are eagerly integrating LLMs into their business operations (McKinsey, 2023). At the same time, recent studies show that these models act as “simulated economic agents” (Homo silicus) that inherit human cognitive biases (Horton, 2023). These biases extend to probabilistic reasoning and decision-making under uncertainty (Bini et al., 2025), which can lead to costly errors when adopted without proper mitigation. Most existing solutions rely on various prompting strategies to nudge the AI agent to adopt a “rational persona.” However, these solutions are temporary, fragile, and can even backfire due to information overload. This creates a demand for our proposed approach. The quickly advancing AI safety tools make our proposal timely. Techniques such SFT and DPO now offer ways to permanently adapt model behavior (Rafailov et al., 2024). The availability of powerful open-source models (e.g., Llama 3) reinforces this trend. Rapid adoption of generative AI by financial institutions has created a demand for building rational agents in the finance domain and new developments in model fine-tuning techniques have created a supply. 本研究拟为应用于金融决策的大语言模型（LLM）开发去偏方法。该实证研究包含三个目标：(1) 构建金融领域专用基准，用以测度概率推理与理性决策中的偏差，例如过度自信、近因偏差与外推偏差；(2) 设计超越提示工程的去偏方法，通过对开源模型进行微调予以实现；(3) 通过检验模型在下游金融任务及模拟市场环境中的表现改进，验证上述方法的有效性。我们主张超越提示工程，采用监督微调（SFT）与直接偏好优化（DPO），从而获得能够抵御提示注入、并可迁移至其他高风险领域的解决方案。本研究聚焦开源模型，正是为实现这一目标。 金融机构正积极将大语言模型融入其业务运营（McKinsey, 2023）。与此同时，近期研究表明，这些模型表现为继承了人类认知偏差的"模拟经济主体"（Homo silicus, Horton, 2023）。此类偏差延伸至概率推理与不确定性下的决策（Bini et al., 2025），若在缺乏适当缓解措施的情况下贸然采用，可能导致代价高昂的错误。现有方案大多依赖各类提示策略，促使AI智能体采纳"理性人设"。然而，这些方案只是权宜之计，稳健性不足，甚至可能因信息过载而适得其反。 这正凸显了本研究方法的必要性。AI安全工具的快速发展使本提案恰逢其时。SFT与DPO等技术如今已能够对模型行为进行持久性调整（Rafailov et al., 2024）。强大开源模型（如Llama 3）的可获得性进一步强化了这一趋势。生成式AI在金融机构中的迅速普及，为构建金融领域的理性智能体创造了需求；而模型微调技术的新进展，则提供了相应的供给。

16506026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506026.value: 会计准则与审计准则的交互作用研究

16506026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506026.value: This proposed study explores the interplay between accounting and auditing standards and their joint impact on financial reporting quality and audit outcomes. While prior research has largely examined these standards in isolation, this study proposes a theoretical framework to analyze their coordinated effects, addressing a critical gap in the literature. The model focuses on a firm raising capital from external investors through financial reports audited by an independent auditor. Accounting and auditing standards act as benchmarks for judicial assessment of compliance and negligence, thereby determining legal liability for managers and auditors in cases of audit failure. I propose to investigate how these standards, both independently and jointly, impact accounting system quality, audit effort, and investment efficiency. By offering insights into the optimal coordination of standard-setting by bodies such as the FASB and PCAOB, this proposed study contributes to the literature with a unified economic framework to guide the development of accounting and auditing standards. 本研究计划旨在探究会计准则与审计准则之间的交互作用，及其对财务报告质量与审计结果的联合影响。既有文献多将两类准则置于彼此割裂的框架下分别考察，而本研究拟构建一个统一的理论模型，以系统分析二者协同效应，从而弥补该领域的一项关键研究空白。模型设定中，企业通过经独立审计的财务报告向外部投资者筹集资本。会计准则与审计准则共同构成司法层面判定合规性与过失的重要基准，进而决定着审计失败情形下管理层与审计师所应承担的法律责任。本研究拟深入探讨上述两类准则既各自独立、又相互联动地影响会计系统质量、审计努力程度及投资效率的具体机制。通过揭示财务会计准则委员会（FASB）与公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）等准则制定机构在最优协同层面的制度逻辑，本研究期望为会计准则与审计准则的协调发展提供一个统一的经济学分析框架，从而丰富并推进该领域的理论文献。

16506126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506126.value: 雙重差分，事件研究与近似殘差平衡

16506126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506126.value: In economics and related fields, researchers often use methods like Difference-in-Differences (DID) and Event Studies (ES) to estimate causal effects, such as how a policy or event impacts certain groups over time. These techniques are hugely popular—appearing in over 30% of recent applied economics papers—because they help isolate the "treatment" effect, like the influence of job training on earnings or minimum wage laws on employment. However, current leading approaches rely on "propensity scores" (probabilities of receiving treatment based on observable factors), which come with significant challenges. These include strict assumptions that probabilities aren't too close to 0 or 1 (leading to arbitrary data trimming), the need for accurate propensity modeling to ensure efficiency, and computational instability when inverting these scores, especially in datasets with poor overlap between treated and untreated groups. This project addresses these issues by extending a promising alternative called "approximate residual balancing," originally developed for simpler, single-period data. Instead of using propensity scores, this method focuses on modeling outcomes directly and finds data-driven weights to balance key factors across groups, minimizing bias without the problematic assumptions. I will adapt it to more complex DID and ES setups, including staggered treatment adoption over multiple periods (e.g., policies rolling out at different times), comparisons using "never-treated" or "not-yet-treated" groups, and even continuous treatments (like varying policy intensities). The approach combines theoretical derivations under standard assumptions, computer simulations to test performance, and real-world applications to datasets on job training, minimum wages, healthcare spending, and hospital reforms. The research will deliver new, robust estimators that work reliably even without strong overlap, achieving high efficiency and stability while running quickly via simple optimization tools. This advances knowledge by providing alternatives to traditional methods, offering insights into optimal covariate balancing in causal inference—similar in spirit to debiased machine learning but easier to implement. Practically, it will enable more accurate policy evaluations in economics, finance, and beyond, potentially influencing decisions on labor, health, and fiscal policies with broader societal impacts. 在經濟學及相關領域，研究人員經常使用雙重差分法（Difference-in-Differences，DID）和事件研究法（Event Studies，ES）來估計因果效果，例如分析某項政策或事件如何隨時間影響特定群體。這些方法極為普及——近期超過百分之三十的應用經濟學論文都採用了這類方法——因為它們有助於分離出「處置」效果，例如職業培訓對收入的影響，或最低工資法例對就業的影響。然而，目前的主流方法依賴「傾向分數」，即根據可觀察因素估算個體接受處置的概率，因而面臨若干重大挑戰。這些問題包括：必須作出嚴格假設，要求有關概率不能太接近零或一，實務上因而可能需要以帶有任意性的方式刪減樣本；必須準確設定傾向分數模型，才能確保估計效率；以及在對傾向分數取倒數時容易出現數值不穩定，尤其是在處置組與未處置組之間重疊不足的資料中。 本研究旨在解決上述問題，方法是延伸一種很有潛力的替代方法——「近似殘差平衡」（approximate residual balancing）。此方法最初是為較簡單的單期資料而發展。它不使用傾向分數，而是直接對結果變數建模，並以資料驅動方式找出權重，使不同群體在重要因素上達致平衡，從而在不依賴上述限制性假設的情況下盡量減少偏誤。本研究將把此方法推廣至更複雜的 DID 和 ES 設定，包括多期資料中處置在不同時間分批實施，例如政策在不同時點逐步推行；以「從未接受處置」或「尚未接受處置」的群體作為比較組；以及連續型處置，例如不同程度的政策強度。研究將結合標準假設下的理論推導、用以檢驗方法表現的電腦模擬，以及職業培訓、最低工資、醫療支出和醫院改革等真實資料的實證應用。 本研究將提出一套新的穩健估計量，即使不具備強重疊條件，仍能可靠運作，並具有較高的統計效率與穩定性；同時，這些估計量可透過簡單的最佳化工具快速計算。在學術層面，本研究將為傳統方法提供替代方案，並加深我們對因果推斷中最適協變量平衡的理解；其理念與去偏機器學習相近，但更容易實施。在實務層面，本研究將有助於在經濟學、金融學及其他領域進行更準確的政策評估，並可能影響勞工、醫療及財政政策的決策，從而產生更廣泛的社會效益。

16506226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506226.value: 转型中的审计：技术错配带来的挑战

16506226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506226.value: Over the past few years, the integration of new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), has transformed the landscape of financial functions, reshaping organizational structures and altering the nature of work. Audit firms are particularly well-positioned for the rapid adoption of new technologies due to their project-based structures and the ability to process large amounts of diverse and unstructured data. A notable example of proactive AI adoption is PwC’s initiative to train junior accountants for managerial roles as AI automates much of the routine entry-level work. In contrast, their clients, especially those in traditional industries such as banking and manufacturing, tend to be more conservative in adopting new technologies, often relying on outdated procedures that have remained largely unchanged for decades. For instance, many banks still utilize processes for basic transactions that date back twenty years, which limits their ability to keep pace with advancements in technology. This proposed study aims to investigate the discrepancies in technology adoption between auditing firms and their clients’ accounting and finance teams, exploring how these mismatches impact audit quality and audit efficiency. The divergence in technology adoption creates challenges in the auditing processes, as mismatches can lead to incompatible data interfaces, delays in coordination, and increased communication costs. Consequently, the efficiency gains achieved by audit firms may be constrained by their clients' slower adoption pace, raising concerns about the potential impact on audit quality. This research will systematically analyze the technology adoption mismatches between audit firms and their clients, focusing on skill mismatches, infrastructure mismatches, and organizational structure mismatches. Utilizing data on the technology profiles of both auditors and client firms' accounting and finance teams, we will assess misalignment in technology capabilities and infrastructure. We will then explore the implications of these mismatches on the quality and efficiency of the audit process. This research will contribute to the growing literature on the role of technology in accounting and auditing functions. Our findings will have significant implications for both audit firms and their clients, highlighting the importance of aligning technological capabilities to improve coordination, communication, and ultimately, audit performance. This study will serve as a critical resource for practitioners and policymakers seeking to understand the evolving dynamics of audit relationships in an increasingly digital world, emphasizing the need for strategic investments in technology and skills development to address the challenges posed by technology integration. 过去几年中，以人工智能为代表的新技术整合，正在深刻改变财务职能的运行格局，重塑组织结构，并改变工作的性质。由于审计事务所通常采用项目制组织结构，并具备处理大量、多样化及非结构化数据的能力，因此尤其适合快速采用新技术。一个积极采用人工智能的典型例子是，普华永道启动了相关计划，将初级会计人员培养为管理岗位人才，因为人工智能正在自动化大量常规性的入门级工作。 相比之下，审计客户，尤其是银行、制造业等传统行业的企业，在采用新技术方面往往更加保守，通常仍依赖数十年来基本未发生变化的旧有流程。例如，许多银行在处理基础交易时仍使用二十年前形成的流程，这限制了它们跟上技术进步的能力。本研究拟考察审计事务所与其客户的会计和财务团队之间在技术采用方面的差异，并探讨这些技术错配如何影响审计质量和审计效率。 技术采用上的分化给审计流程带来了挑战，因为技术错配可能导致数据接口不兼容、协调延误以及沟通成本上升。因此，审计事务所通过技术采用所获得的效率提升，可能会受到客户技术采用进程较慢的制约，并由此引发对审计质量潜在影响的担忧。本研究将系统分析审计事务所与其客户之间的技术采用错配，重点关注技能错配、基础设施错配和组织结构错配。通过利用审计人员以及客户企业会计和财务团队的技术画像数据，我们将评估双方在技术能力和基础设施方面的不匹配程度。随后，本研究将进一步探讨这些错配对审计流程质量和效率的影响。 本研究将为有关技术在会计与审计职能中作用的文献作出贡献。研究发现也将对审计事务所及其客户产生重要启示，强调技术能力匹配对于改善协调、沟通并最终提升审计绩效的重要性。本研究还将为实务工作者和政策制定者理解日益数字化环境下审计关系的演变动态提供重要参考，并强调有必要对技术和技能发展进行战略性投资，以应对技术整合所带来的挑战。

16506626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506626.value: 多群体匹配的公平与效率

16506626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506626.value: Matching markets are fundamental to resource allocation in healthcare, transportation, and logistics, yet their real-world deployment increasingly requires fairness guarantees that extend beyond traditional efficiency objectives. A defining feature of modern platforms—such as kidney exchange programs (hospitals), ride-hailing services (regional fleets), and freight brokerage (logistics cooperatives)—is that participants are organized into institutional groups whose continued participation depends on equitable outcomes. Critically, these groups typically arrive sequentially, forcing platforms to make irrevocable matching decisions under uncertainty—a dynamic regime in which traditional fairness notions, designed for static or individual-level settings, are either infeasible or ineffective. The proposed project will introduce and rigorously analyze the multi-group matching problem, a novel framework that formalizes group-level fairness via a natural participation constraint: each group must receive at least an γ-fraction of the matching it could achieve in isolation (its autarky benchmark). We establish a striking foundational result: in static settings, fairness is free—every maximum matching (fractional or integral, bipartite or general) satisfies full group fairness, in stark contrast to individual-level fairness concepts that may be infeasible even in small graphs. The core challenge emerges in dynamic environments. We will develop a comprehensive theory of fair online matching under multi-stage arrivals, where groups appear over time and decisions are irrevocable. The proposed research will: (i) characterize the complete Pareto frontier between fairness (γ) and competitive ratio, progressing from two-stage to multi-stage bipartite matching and ultimately to general graphs; (ii) design optimal or near-optimal online algorithms by unifying convex-programming techniques with group-aware refinements of classical combinatorial structures (e.g., the Edmonds–Gallai decomposition); and (iii) validate these mechanisms through numerical experiments on real-world-inspired instances. By bridging online algorithms, matching theory, and institutional economics, the proposed project will provide principled, scalable foundations for dynamic platforms that are simultaneously efficient, fair, and robust—offering actionable tools for policymakers, platform designers, and regulators in an era of federated and algorithmically mediated markets. 匹配市场是医疗、交通与物流等领域资源配置的基石，然而其在现实世界中的部署日益要求超越经典效率目标的公平性保证。在诸多应用场景中——如肾脏交换（医院）、网约车（区域车队）与货运经纪（物流合作社）——存在一个共同特征：参与者以机构群体的形式组织，而其持续参与依赖于公平的分配结果。关键在于，这些群体往往是顺序到达的，这迫使平台在不确定性下做出不可撤销的匹配决策；在这一动态环境中，传统的公平概念显得力不从心。 本项目提出并分析多群体匹配问题，这是一个全新的理论框架，它通过一个自然的参与约束来形式化群体层面的公平性：每个群体必须至少获得其在孤立状态下所能实现的匹配规模的 α 比例（即其自给自足基准）。与个体层面的公平概念——即便在小型图中也可能不可行——不同，我们所提出的群体层面准则在静态环境下始终与最大匹配相容，从而揭示出：当完全信息可得时，"公平无需代价"。 核心挑战源于动态环境。本项目将构建一套关于多阶段到达下公平在线匹配的完整理论，其中群体随时间逐步出现，且决策不可回溯。具体研究内容包括：(i) 在二分图与一般图中刻画公平性参数（α）与竞争比之间的帕累托前沿；(ii) 设计具有可证明保证的最优或近似最优在线算法；(iii) 基于源于真实场景的实例，通过数值实验验证上述机制的有效性。 通过融合在线算法、匹配理论与制度经济学的思想，本研究将为设计同时兼具效率、公平性与稳健性的动态平台奠定理论基础，并为受监管市场或联邦式市场中的政策制定者与平台运营者提供可操作的决策洞见。

16506726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506726.value: 公眾參與規則制定與資訊披露要求的形成

16506726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506726.value: Disclosure mandates are a central tool of U.S. regulation. By requiring firms to release information, they enable investors, consumers, regulators, and the public to make better-informed decisions. Such mandates can improve resource allocation, strengthen oversight of corporate behavior, and protect stakeholders. Yet their adoption does not arise in a vacuum. Disclosure rules often emerge in response to corporate scandals, financial crises, new technologies, or lobbying, reflecting broader political and economic forces. This paper examines how citizen participation shapes the formation of disclosure mandates. Citizen participation in rulemaking introduces important trade-offs. On one hand, it broadens representation and can counterbalance the influence of powerful, well-organized interests—particularly firms that frequently oppose disclosure mandates. On the other hand, public input does not always improve regulatory quality. Business groups may still dominate the process by organizing mass comment campaigns or submitting repetitive or fabricated entries. Agencies also face administrative burdens in processing large volumes of comments, which can dilute attention from substantive issues. The analysis focuses on the early 2000s launch of Regulations.gov, a federal website that digitized the public comment process. Previously, citizens had to travel to reading rooms or mail written comments on proposed rules. The new platform made documents publicly available online and allowed comments to be submitted at little cost. Adoption was staggered across agencies, creating natural variation in participation over time. I exploit this rollout to study how greater public input affects regulatory outcomes. First, I test whether digitization increased the number of public comments received. Second, I evaluate whether agencies with more citizen engagement were more or less likely to finalize disclosure mandates, and whether finalized rules required greater disclosure than initially proposed (e.g., how the same rules evolve across versions over time). Third, I analyze whether firms adjusted lobbying efforts in response to heightened citizen input. Finally, I assess whether rules shaped by broader participation differ in their economic consequences for firms, including compliance costs and operations. The paper makes three contributions. First, it provides new evidence on the political economy of disclosure mandates, moving beyond anecdotal case studies to systematic analysis. Second, it highlights the role of citizen participation in shaping regulatory outcomes, offering a contrast to contexts dominated by business lobbying. Third, it contributes to broader debates in law and political science on the value of public commenting: while often praised for enhancing legitimacy and transparency, its practical effects on rulemaking remain underexplored. 資訊披露要求是美國監管體系中的一項核心工具。透過要求企業公開資訊，這類規定使投資者、消費者、監管機構和社會公眾能夠作出資訊更充分的決策。資訊披露要求可以改善資源配置、加強對企業行為的監督，並保障持份者的權益。然而，這些要求的制定並非憑空發生。披露規則往往是因應企業醜聞、金融危機、新興科技或遊說活動而產生，反映了更廣泛的政治與經濟力量。本文探討公民參與如何影響資訊披露要求的形成。 公民參與規則制定帶來了重要的權衡。一方面，它擴大了意見代表的廣度，並可制衡勢力強大且組織完善的利益團體——尤其是經常反對資訊披露要求的企業。另一方面，公眾意見並不總能提升監管品質。商業團體仍可能透過組織大規模意見提交活動，或提交內容重複甚至虛假的意見來主導相關程序。此外，政府機構在處理大量意見時亦面臨行政負擔，可能因此分散對實質問題的關注。 本文的分析聚焦於美國聯邦政府在2000年代初推出的 Regulations.gov。該網站將公眾意見徵詢程序數碼化。在此之前，公民必須親自前往閱覽室，或以郵寄方式就擬議規則提交書面意見。新平台不僅讓相關文件可供公眾在線查閱，也讓公眾能以極低成本提交意見。各政府機構分階段採用該平台，因而在不同時期形成了公眾參與程度的自然差異。 本文利用這一分階段推行的過程，研究公眾意見增加如何影響監管結果。首先，本文檢驗數碼化是否增加了政府機構收到的公眾意見數量。其次，本文評估公民參與程度較高的政府機構是否更有可能或更不可能正式頒布資訊披露要求，以及最終規則所要求的披露是否多於最初的提案（例如，同一項規則的不同版本如何隨時間演變）。第三，本文分析企業是否因應公民參與增加而調整其遊說活動。最後，本文評估由更廣泛公眾參與所塑造的規則，是否在企業所面對的經濟後果方面有所不同，包括合規成本和營運活動。 本文作出三方面的貢獻。第一，本文就資訊披露要求背後的政治經濟因素提供新的證據，超越軼事性個案研究，進行系統性分析。第二，本文凸顯公民參與在塑造監管結果方面的作用，並與由企業遊說主導的情境形成對照。第三，本文亦為法律和政治學領域有關公眾意見徵詢價值的廣泛討論作出貢獻：儘管公眾意見徵詢經常被視為有助提升正當性和透明度，其對規則制定的實際影響仍未得到充分研究。

16507626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16507626.value: 全球采购与供应链重构中的产品—市场关联机制

16507626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507626.value: Firms today source inputs globally, and decisions about what products to import and from which countries are increasingly interconnected. For example, official 2025 vehicle parts-content labels show that the Tesla Model 3 Long Range AWD uses 75% U.S./Canada content, while the Ford F-150 lists just 45%; several Toyota models report 0% North American content—sourcing entirely from Japan. These patterns reflect more than just price—they embody firms’ long-term relationships with suppliers, shipping reliability, and experience navigating compliance and logistics across markets. This project develops a new framework to study global sourcing portfolios by focusing on the coupling of product and origin market decisions—an area that has been largely overlooked in both empirical and theoretical trade research. While existing work often analyzes what firms buy and where they buy it as separate problems, real-world disruptions—such as tariffs, natural disasters, or export controls—typically strike specific combinations of products and countries. Firms must then reconfigure their sourcing by substituting across suppliers or reprioritizing the mix of products they import from each country. These coupled adjustments, which are central to supply chain resilience, remain insufficiently captured in current models. The novelty of the project lies in making this interdependence of two margins (products and markets) explicit and tractable. We use detailed Chinese customs data at the firm–product–origin level to document how sourcing patterns vary with prior import experience and established supplier relationships. These reduced-form patterns help guide model assumptions and calibration but are not designed to deliver causal identification. The core of the project is a structurally estimated quantitative trade model in which firms choose product–origin pairs under sourcing frictions and cost complementarities. We estimate model parameters using targeted moments from the data, then simulate counterfactual scenarios involving trade shocks, supplier incentives, or friend-shoring rules. These simulations quantify trade-offs between concentration and diversification and show how firms can design more resilient import strategies. The project contributes to international trade and supply chain restructuring literatures by offering a new portfolio-based perspective. It delivers insights for firms managing global sourcing networks and helps policymakers understand how trade and industrial policies influence both specific supplier choices and broader sourcing strategies. 当今，企业在全球范围内采购投入品，而进口何种产品以及从哪些国家进口这两类决策之间的关联日益紧密。例如，2025年官方公布的汽车零部件来源构成标签显示，特斯拉Model 3长续航全轮驱动版的美国和加拿大零部件含量为75%，而福特F-150仅为45%；数款丰田车型的北美零部件含量为0%，其零部件全部来自日本。这些采购模式反映的不仅是价格因素，还体现了企业与供应商之间的长期合作关系、运输可靠性，以及企业在不同市场处理合规与物流事务的经验。 本项目构建一个研究全球采购组合的新框架，重点考察进口产品选择与来源市场选择之间的关联机制。这一问题在现有国际贸易实证和理论研究中长期未得到充分关注。现有研究通常将企业“买什么”和“从哪里买”作为两个相互独立的问题加以分析，但关税、自然灾害或出口管制等现实冲击通常作用于特定的产品—国家组合。企业因而必须重新配置其采购结构，在不同供应商之间进行替代，或重新调整从各国进口的产品组合及其优先次序。这些产品与市场两个维度上的联动调整是供应链韧性的核心，但现有模型仍未能对其进行充分刻画。 本项目的创新之处在于，明确刻画产品边际与市场边际之间的相互依存关系，并以可求解的形式将其纳入模型。我们利用中国海关企业—产品—来源国层面的详细数据，系统描述采购模式如何随企业既往进口经验和既有供应商关系而变化。这些简约式经验规律为模型设定和参数校准提供依据，但其目的并非进行因果识别。 本项目的核心是一个采用结构估计方法的定量贸易模型。在该模型中，企业在存在采购摩擦和成本互补性的条件下选择产品—来源国组合。我们利用从数据中选取的目标矩估计模型参数，并进一步模拟涉及贸易冲击、供应商激励措施或“友岸外包”规则的反事实情景。这些模拟量化了采购集中化与多元化之间的权衡，并说明企业如何制定更具韧性的进口策略。 本项目从采购组合的角度，为国际贸易和供应链重构文献提供了新的研究视角。项目将为企业管理全球采购网络提供启示，也有助于政策制定者理解贸易政策和产业政策如何同时影响具体的供应商选择和更广泛的采购战略。

16507726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16507726.value: 我们会向未来看多远？ 在决策过程中前瞻性于眼动建模的作用

16507726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16507726.value: Prof Fan, Haosheng Prof Wedel, Michel

16507726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507726.value: Visual attention is critical during decision making, and the way people move their eyes and focus on alternatives affects their choice. Not surprisingly, there is a growing literature in marketing, economics, and computer science that integrates eye movements into choice models. While these approaches improve choice predictions and obtain more accurate estimates of consumer preferences, they mainly focus on choice and do not predict eye-movement patterns. Based on economic theories of sequential search, recent literature in marketing have tried to simultaneously model eye movements and choice. These models are appealing, as they allow researchers to predict eye movements and subsequent choice from the same underlying preference parameters. Such eye movement and choice predictions are relevant, as they would allow managers and policy makers to better understand the impact of individual differences (e.g., time pressure) and marketing activities (e.g., shopping website design) on attention and subsequent choice. Unfortunately, these recent models provide poor counterfactual predictions of eye movements, leading to worse choice predictions compared to scenarios where eye movements are not predicted. This project aims to address these important limitations by developing a novel eye-tracking model of visual attention and choice. We argue that there are two important reasons that prior literature could not recover eye-movement patterns during choice decisions: 1) They assume that consumers are one-step forward looking, and 2) They ignore bottom-up processes. The one-step forward looking assumption entails that the search decision of consumers only considers information from one eye fixation. While computationally attractive, this assumption implies that consumers obtain little information from moving their eyes, underestimating the benefits of search. Furthermore, the one-step forward looking decision ignores bottom-up processes. Research in psychology shows that bottom-up processes, such as the tendency of attending salient options, are important predictors eye movements. Our project will develop an eye-tracking model of consumer choice that considers multiple-step forward looking and bottom-up processes. The proposed model aims to generate realistic counterfactual simulations of eye movements and subsequent choice. The model will be tested on eye-tracking data collected in choice-based conjoint experiments in which time pressure is manipulated. This manipulation allows to validate the forward-looking assumption, which is hypothesized to be reduced under time pressure. Moreover, counterfactual predictions will be tested in follow-up experiments to further illustrate the managerial relevance of the proposed model, which will be made publicly available. 视觉注意力在决策过程中发挥着关键作用，而人们如何移动视线以及关注不同选项，会影响其最终选择。因此，市场营销学、经济学和计算机科学领域出现了大量将眼动行为纳入选择模型的研究。这些方法虽然能够提高选择预测的准确性，并能更精确地估计消费者偏好，但其主要关注选择结果本身，并无预测眼动模式。基于循序搜索的经济学理论，近期市场营销领域的研究开始尝试同时构建眼动与选择模型。此类模型颇具吸引力，因为研究人员能够利用同一组潜在偏好参数预测眼动行为和后续选择。这些对眼动行为和选择的预测具有实际意义，因为它们有助于管理者和政策制定者更好地理解个体差异（例如时间压力）以及营销活动（例如购物网站设计）对注意力及后续选择的影响。然而，这些最新模型对眼动的反事实预测效果不佳，从而导致其选择预测表现甚至不如不预测眼动行为的模型。本项目旨在通过开发一种新颖的视觉注意力与选择的眼动追踪模型，解决这些重要局限。 我们认为，现有研究未能复原决策过程中的眼动模式，主要有两个原因：1）它们假设消费者是单步前瞻的；2）它们忽略了自下而上的过程。单步前瞻假设意味着消费者的搜索决策仅考虑单次眼动注视所获取的信息。虽然这种假设在计算上具有吸引力，但它意味着消费者从眼动中获得的信息有限，从而低估了搜索行为所带来的收益。此外，单步前瞻的决策忽略了自下而上的过程。心理学研究表明，自下而上的过程，例如人们优先关注显著选项的倾向，是预测眼动行为的重要因素。本项目将开发一种同时考虑多步前瞻和自下而上过程的消费者选择眼动模型。该模型旨在生成眼动及后续选择的真实反事实模拟。模型将通过在控制时间压力下，基于选择的联合实验中所收集的眼动追踪数据进行检验。该控制有助于验证前瞻性假设——该假设预计在时间压力下会减弱。此外，我们还将在后续实验中检验模型的反事实预测能力，以进一步说明该模型的管理相关性。该模型将会向公众开放。

16508226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508226.value: 多層級供應鏈中的負責任採購

16508226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508226.value: In recent years, consumers have become increasingly concerned about whether their products are responsibly sourced. Brands are usually held accountable for social responsibility violations (e.g., child labour, pollution) in their supply chains, even though they may be committed by lower-tier suppliers with whom brands have no direct relationship. When these violations occur and are publicized, they inflict great harm to the guilty brands. For instance, socially conscious consumers may boycott the brands, resulting in loss of revenue and damage to reputation. The brands may have to pay large compensation to victims who suffer from the violations. Because of these high costs of violations, social responsibility in sourcing becomes a strategic priority for global brands. A supply chain typically consists of multiple tiers of suppliers. Because of globalization, many brands have expanded their sourcing base to include suppliers in both developed and developing countries. A major challenge for the brands is about selecting and managing lower-tier suppliers whom they do not know well and may not have a direct relationship with. Yet these suppliers, especially those in developing countries, have a higher risk of social responsibility violation. A brand has two basic strategies in sourcing from lower-tier suppliers. Under a control strategy, the brand sources directly from a supplier. Under a delegation strategy, the brand delegates the sourcing decision to a tier-one supplier. Although these two strategies are not new, brands have traditionally focused on operational factors such as response time, procurement cost and quality in making sourcing decisions. With the emergence of social responsibility as another important factor, little is known about how brands should incorporate it in their sourcing decisions. Although the merits of control versus delegation sourcing strategies have been investigated in the supply chain outsourcing literature, the comparison is based on mostly traditional operational performance measures such as procurement cost, response time and quality. There is a growing literature on responsible sourcing in supply chain. However, there is no existing work that compares the control and delegation sourcing strategies in a multi-tier socially responsible supply chain. Our proposal is motivated by both the business practices and a gap in the academic literature. We hope to develop a novel theory that contributes to the supply chain management literature. We also hope that our theory can yield useful insights to help supply chain managers improve their practices and to inform policy-makers to formulate effective polices that promote social responsibility. 近年來，消費者越來越關注其購買的產品是否來自負責任的採購。儘管社會責任違規行為（例如童工、污染）可能是由與品牌沒有直接關係的低層級供應商所犯下，但品牌通常仍需為其供應鏈中的此類違規行為負責。當這些違規行為發生並被公眾知曉時，會對涉事品牌造成巨大傷害。例如，具社會意識的消費者可能會抵制該品牌，導致其收入損失及聲譽受損。品牌可能還需要向受違規行為影響的受害者支付巨額賠償。正因違規代價高昂，採購中的社會責任已成為全球品牌的戰略重點。 供應鏈通常由多個層級的供應商組成。隨著全球化發展，許多品牌已擴大其採購基地，涵蓋來自發達國家和發展中國家的供應商。品牌面臨的一大挑戰，在於如何選擇與管理那些它們不熟悉且可能沒有直接關係的低層級供應商。然而，這些供應商（尤其是發展中國家的供應商）發生社會責任違規的風險更高。 品牌在向低層級供應商採購時有兩種基本策略：在「控制策略」下，品牌直接向供應商採購；在「授權策略」下，品牌則將採購決策授權給一級供應商。儘管這兩種策略並不新鮮，但品牌傳統上在制定採購決策時，主要關注響應時間、採購成本和質量等運營因素。隨著社會責任成為另一個重要考量因素，品牌應如何在採購決策中納入該因素，目前仍所知有限。 雖然供應鏈外包文獻已探討過「控制」與「授權」採購策略的優缺點，但該比較主要基於採購成本、響應時間和質量等傳統運營績效指標。關於供應鏈中負責任採購的文獻雖然日益增多，但目前尚無研究在多層級社會責任供應鏈中對控制和授權採購策略進行比較。 我們的研究提議受到商業實踐以及學術文獻缺口的雙重驅動。我們希望建立一套創新理論，為供應鏈管理文獻作出貢獻；同時也希望我們的理論能提供有用的見解，幫助供應鏈管理者改進實踐，並為政策制定者提供參考，以制定促進社會責任的有效政策。

16508626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508626.value: 独生子女 CEO 与企业信息披露

16508626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508626.value: This study investigates the impact of only-child CEOs on managerial disclosure decision. We plan to investigate whether there is causal relationship between only-child CEOs and managerial disclosure, using three complementary identification strategies—a regression discontinuity design exploiting the exogenous shift in the probability of being an only child due to China’s One-Child Policy, an instrumental variable approach leveraging regional variation in policy enforcement, and a difference-in-differences design around CEO turnovers. As a growing number of only-child individuals enter the workforce and rise to leadership positions, understanding whether being an only child affects a CEO’s decision making has become increasingly important. 本研究探讨了独生子女 CEO 对管理层信息披露决策的影响。我们计划利用三种互补的检验策略，来研究独生子女 CEO 与管理层信息披露之间是否存在因果关系：一是利用中国独生子女政策改变独生子女概率的断点回归设计；二是利用政策执行强度区域差异的工具变量法；三是围绕 CEO 变更事件的双重差分设计。随着越来越多的独生子女步入职场并升至领导岗位，理解独生子女是否会影响 CEO 的决策已变得日益重要。

16508926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508926.value: 从合规到赋能：技术驱动的隐私保护如何兼顾安全与经济发展

16508926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508926.value: The rapid spread of state-level consumer data privacy laws in the United States has revealed a critical paradox in digital governance: policies designed to protect individuals may simultaneously impose measurable economic costs on the communities they aim to safeguard. This project investigates how current “compliance-based” privacy regulations rooted in a Responsibility Shifting model, affect local economies and public finance, and whether a Responsibility Internalization approach, based on firm-level technological capabilities, can deliver comparable privacy protection without these social costs. Employing a novel empirical strategy, the study links the staggered enactment of state privacy laws to more than two million municipal bond transactions from 2015 to 2023, using these markets as a high-frequency barometer of investors’ perceptions of local economic health. The resulting analysis quantifies how privacy regulation influences municipal borrowing costs and broader indicators of fiscal stability. To complement this macroeconomic perspective, the project applies large-scale computational text analysis to corporate 10-K filings to identify firm-level adoption of Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs). By classifying these technologies according to their functional principles as Anonymization, Security, Access Control, and Transparency, the study isolates which design strategies most effectively reduce data breaches and consumer privacy complaints. By integrating financial econometrics with computational text analysis, this research advances a new governance paradigm in which technology becomes a proactive vehicle for privacy protection. The project offers evidence-based guidance for designing privacy policies that safeguard individuals while sustaining innovation, fiscal stability, and long-term community growth. 美国各州消费者数据隐私法的迅速普及，揭示了数字治理中的一个关键悖论：旨在保护个人的政策，可能同时给其所要保护的社区带来可衡量的经济成本。本项目研究当前以责任转移为基础的 “合规驱动型” 隐私监管如何影响地方经济与公共财政，并进一步考察，以企业层面的技术能力为基础的责任内化模式，能否在不产生上述社会成本的情况下，提供同等程度的隐私保护。 本研究将美国各州隐私法分阶段实施的时间差异，与2015年至2023年间超过两百万笔市政债券交易相匹配，并将市政债券市场作为衡量投资者对地方经济健康状况判断的高频指标。相关分析将量化隐私监管如何影响地方政府的融资成本，以及更广泛的财政稳定性指标。 为了补充上述宏观经济视角，本项目还将对企业提交的10-K年度报告开展大规模计算文本分析，以识别企业对隐私增强技术（Privacy-Enhancing Technologies，PETs）的采用情况。研究将根据这些技术的功能原理，将其划分为不同功能类别，从而识别哪些技术设计策略能够最有效地减少数据泄露事件和消费者隐私投诉。 通过将金融计量经济学与计算文本分析相结合，本研究推动形成一种新的治理范式，即将技术作为主动保护隐私的重要工具。本项目将为隐私政策设计提供基于实证证据的指导，使政策能够在保护个人隐私的同时，维持创新活力、财政稳定和社区的长期发展。

16509326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16509326.value: 带可充电资源的收益管理：在电动自行车共享平台中的应用

16509326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16509326.value: Prof Liu, Zhe Dr Zhu, Weiming

16509326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16509326.value: The sharing economy has fundamentally reshaped urban mobility and services, giving rise to a new generation of business models. A very recent example is the (undocked) electric bike (e-bike) sharing platform. In the e-bike setting, batteries can be removed from depleted e-bikes, charged at unified charging stations, and then swapped back to e-bikes at random locations. Unlike traditional electric vehicles, which must be taken offline and immobilized at a fixed charging station, a depleted e-bike is made available almost instantly through an on-site battery swap performed by an operator, decoupling the e-bike itself from the lengthy recharging process. From a high-level resource management perspective, this represents a novel operational paradigm, defined by the dynamic coupling of fixed assets (e-bikes) with detachable and rechargeable assets (batteries). This creates a complex operational decision-making: the firm must coordinate a fleet of e-bikes scattered across the region, a central pool of batteries, and the mobile operators that connects the two resources. This project aims to explore the platform’s revenue maximization problem in this novel and complex setting with fixed and rechargeable resources. We formulate a general optimization model that accounts for the operational strategy coordinating the two resources. Collaborating with a leading e-bike platform from a major technology firm in China, we will build a decision-making model that answers several critical questions: How many e-bikes and batteries should the firm invest for revenue maximization? What is the efficient operation strategy to manage operators for battery swap under the spatial effect and uncertain demand? Economically, we will shed light on important questions in platform economy, such as the trade-off between capital expense (capex) and operation expense (opex) as well as spatial effect in managing the rechargeable resources. Furthermore, we aim to gain a deeper understanding of the benefit and challenge of the new paradigm: It represents a multiple-layer resource pooling, where not only are bikes shared among users, but batteries are also shared among bikes. Working directly with the e-bike platform, we will calibrate and test our model using real-world operational data and conduct multiple empirical studies. We will deliver a set of solutions that can help the firm make data-driven decisions in its daily operations. Moreover, the managerial insights gained will provide a blueprint for the future development of sharing economy with rechargeable resources, which may apply to other settings such as electric vehicle fleets, delivery drones, and service robots. 共享经济从根本上重塑了城市出行与服务，并催生了新一代的商业模式。近期涌现的无桩共享电动自行车（电单车）平台便是其中的一个典型代表。在共享电单车场景下，电池可以从电量耗尽的车辆上拆卸下来，在集中的充电站进行充电，随后再由运维人员在各个随机地点将满电电池换回车内。与传统电动汽车必须下线并停放在固定充电站不同，电量耗尽的电单车通过运维人员的现场换电操作，几乎可以立即恢复可用状态，从而实现了车辆本身与漫长充电过程的“解耦”。从高阶资源管理的视角来看，这代表了一种全新的运营范式，其核心特征是固定资产（电单车）与可拆卸、可充电资产（电池）的动态耦合。这引发了复杂的运营决策问题：企业必须协调散布在区域内的电单车车队、集中的电池池，以及连接这两种资源的移动运维人员。 本项目旨在探究在这种包含固定资源与可充电资源的全新复杂场景下，平台的收益最大化问题。我们构建了一个通用优化模型，以刻画协调这两种资源的运营策略。通过与中国某大型科技公司旗下的头部共享电单车平台合作，我们将建立一个决策模型，以回答以下几个关键问题：为实现收益最大化，企业应投入多少电单车和电池？在空间效应和需求不确定的环境下，管理运维人员进行高效换电的运营策略是什么？在经济学层面，我们将阐释平台经济中的重要问题，例如资本支出（Capex）与运营支出（Opex）之间的权衡，以及管理可充电资源时的空间效应。此外，我们旨在更深入地剖析这一新范式的优势与挑战：它代表了一种“多层级资源池化（multiple-layer resource pooling）”模式，即不仅车辆在用户之间共享，电池也在车辆之间共享。 通过与该电单车平台的直接合作，我们将利用真实的运营数据对模型进行校准和测试，并开展多项实证研究。本项目将输出一套解决方案，以辅助企业在日常运营中做出数据驱动的决策。此外，本项目所提炼的管理启示将为包含可充电资源的共享经济的未来发展提供蓝图，相关洞见亦可推广至电动汽车车队、配送无人机以及服务机器人等其他应用场景。

16509426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16509426.value: 先知不等式的新方法与在资源分配问题上的应用

16509426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16509426.value: This project focuses on advancing the theory and application of prophet inequalities and their role in solving online resource allocation problems under uncertainty. Prophet inequalities provide a powerful framework for designing online algorithms that make sequential decisions with incomplete information, comparing their performance to an optimal offline benchmark. While classical models assume that arrivals are independent and drawn from known distributions, such assumptions often do not hold in real-world scenarios such as e-commerce platforms, supply chains, and online advertising systems. The research aims to relax these assumptions by considering more general and realistic settings, including unknown distributions and stochastic arrival processes with temporal correlations. One of the central goals is to design efficient, feasible, and near-optimal online policies that maximize cumulative rewards while respecting resource constraints. This will be achieved by leveraging and extending linear programming (LP) benchmarks—particularly fluid LP and the recently developed type-coverage LP—and by translating these LP solutions into online policies using novel rounding techniques such as online contention resolution schemes (OCRS). The project is structured in three stages. In the first stage, the focus is on improving theoretical guarantees for multi-unit prophet inequalities under known distributions and generalizing the results to broader resource allocation problems involving multiple resources and actions. In the second stage, the project investigates sample-based settings, where only limited distributional information is available. Here, threshold-based policies will be developed using insights from dual variable learning and online LP theory. The final stage tackles stochastic arrival processes, such as Markov chains, by designing policies that remain effective under correlated customer behavior. Preliminary results show promising improvements over existing benchmarks, including tighter competitive ratios under Poisson arrivals and new bounds for the single-sample setting. The project will also include empirical validation using real-world datasets to test the practicality of the proposed policies and to model realistic arrival processes. By bridging the gap between elegant theoretical models and practical online decision-making challenges, this project has the potential to significantly advance the fields of operations research, algorithmic decision-making, and stochastic optimization. The outcomes are expected to contribute both foundational theory and implementable algorithms that can be applied to real-time resource allocation systems across various industries. 本项目致力于推进先知不等式的理论与应用研究，并探索其在解决不确定环境下在线资源分配问题中的作用。先知不等式为在线算法的设计提供了一个强有力的理论框架：算法需要在信息不完全的情况下依次做出决策，并将其表现与最优离线基准进行比较。经典模型通常假设到达事件相互独立，且服从已知分布；然而，在电子商务平台、供应链和在线广告系统等现实场景中，这些假设往往并不成立。 本研究旨在放宽上述假设，考虑更加一般且贴近现实的情形，包括未知分布以及具有时间相关性的随机到达过程。项目的核心目标之一是设计高效、可行且接近最优的在线策略，使其在满足资源约束的同时实现累积收益最大化。为此，研究将利用并拓展线性规划基准，尤其是流体线性规划和近期提出的类型覆盖线性规划，并采用在线竞争消解方案等新型舍入技术，将这些线性规划的解转化为在线策略。 本项目分为三个阶段。第一阶段将重点改进已知分布下多单位先知不等式的理论保证，并将相关结果推广至更广泛的资源分配问题，包括涉及多种资源和多种行动的问题。第二阶段将研究基于样本的情形，即只能获得有限分布信息的情形。在这一阶段，研究将结合对偶变量学习和在线线性规划理论的相关思路，开发基于阈值的策略。最后一个阶段将处理马尔可夫链等随机到达过程，通过设计相应策略，使其在客户行为具有相关性的情况下仍能保持良好效果。 初步结果表明，相较于现有基准，本研究取得了令人鼓舞的改进，包括在泊松到达过程下获得更优的竞争比，以及针对单样本情形建立新的理论界限。项目还将利用真实世界数据集开展实证验证，以检验所提出策略的实用性，并对现实中的到达过程进行建模。 通过弥合优雅的理论模型与实际在线决策挑战之间的差距，本项目有望显著推动运筹学、算法决策和随机优化等领域的发展。预期研究成果将同时包括基础理论贡献和可落地实施的算法，并可应用于各行业的实时资源分配系统。

16509826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16509826.value: 大型語言模型推理的排隊理論分析與最佳排程

16509826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16509826.value: Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have become essential infrastructure powering modern AI applications, from customer service chatbots to medical diagnostics and software development assistants. However, running these models efficiently remains a critical bottleneck. When a user submits a query, the system must first process the entire prompt (the ``prefill'' phase) and then generate the response token-by-token (the ``decode'' phase). These two phases have fundamentally different computational characteristics: prefill is compute-intensive and processes text in parallel, while decode is memory-intensive and generates text sequentially. Current systems use ad-hoc scheduling rules without rigorous performance guarantees, leading to suboptimal performances. This project develops a comprehensive mathematical framework for optimal scheduling of LLM inference across multiple GPUs (the specialized chips that run these models). We address fundamental challenges that lie beyond the scope of classical queueing theory. Processing speed depends on job state: prompt length, tokens generated, and batch composition affect iteration time due to the quadratic complexity of attention mechanisms. This state-dependent service requires novel measure-valued process methodologies that track the evolving distribution of job states across the system rather than assuming constant service rates. The research employs a three-phase approach progressively refining the model toward production-ready systems. Phase I establishes the theoretical foundation by developing and empirically validating an affine workload model capturing state-dependent service rates. We use measure-valued processes to track job-state distributions in multi-GPU systems where each GPU processes one job at a time, deriving fluid approximations under heavy-traffic scaling and designing control policies with provable asymptotic optimality properties. Phase II introduces realistic GPU batching where each GPU processes multiple jobs concurrently, subject to a critical architectural constraint: at most one prefill job per batch. This creates performance asymmetries between mixed batches (prefill plus decode) and decode-only batches. We analyze cross-GPU routing strategies enabling GPU specialization, dedicating some GPUs to prefill while others run decode-only iterations, thereby eliminating co-batching penalties and achieving higher throughput. Phase III incorporates practical constraints neglected in earlier phases: finite GPU memory capacity and KV-cache transfer costs between GPUs. We characterize specialization thresholds determining when routing remains beneficial despite transfer overhead, and design memory-aware policies combining admission control, eviction strategies, and routing decisions. The project will deliver validated workload models enabling accurate performance analyisis, implementable scheduling policies with provable optimality guarantees, and practical guidelines for system designers. These contributions bridge the gap between theoretical queueing analysis and production LLM serving systems. 大型語言模型（LLM），例如 ChatGPT，已成為現代人工智能應用的重要基礎設施，廣泛應用於客戶服務聊天機械人、醫療診斷及軟件開發助手等領域。然而，如何高效運行這些模型仍然是一項關鍵瓶頸。當使用者提交查詢時，系統首先需要處理完整的提示內容（「預填充」階段），然後逐一生成回應詞元（「解碼」階段）。這兩個階段具有截然不同的運算特性：預填充屬於計算密集型工作，能並行處理文字；解碼則屬於記憶體密集型工作，並以序列方式生成文字。目前的系統大多採用缺乏嚴格效能保證的經驗式排程規則，因此可能導致次佳效能。 本項目將建立一個全面的數學框架，以研究跨多個圖形處理器（GPU）進行大型語言模型推理時的最佳排程問題。我們所處理的核心挑戰超越了傳統排隊理論的適用範圍。系統的處理速度取決於工作的狀態；提示長度、已生成詞元數目及批次組成均會因注意力機制的二次複雜度而影響每次迭代的時間。這種依賴狀態的服務機制，需要採用新穎的測度值過程方法，追蹤系統中工作狀態分布的演變，而不能假設服務速率保持不變。 本研究採用三階段方法，逐步完善模型，使其更接近實際運作的系統。第一階段建立理論基礎，發展並以實驗驗證一個能描述依賴狀態服務速率的仿射工作量模型。我們將利用測度值過程，追蹤每個 GPU 每次處理一項工作時多 GPU 系統中的工作狀態分布，推導重負載縮放下的流體近似，並設計具有可證明漸近最優性質的控制政策。第二階段引入實際的 GPU 批次處理機制，讓每個 GPU 同時處理多項工作，並考慮每個批次最多只能包含一項預填充工作的關鍵架構限制。這項限制令混合批次（預填充加解碼）與純解碼批次之間產生效能差異。我們將分析跨 GPU 路由策略，透過讓部分 GPU 優先處理預填充工作、其他 GPU 執行純解碼迭代，實現 GPU 專門化，從而消除共同批次處理對解碼工作的效能影響並提高吞吐量。第三階段加入早期階段未考慮的實際限制，包括有限的 GPU 記憶體容量及 GPU 之間傳輸鍵值快取的成本。我們將確定在存在傳輸開支的情況下，跨 GPU 路由仍然有利的專門化臨界條件，並設計結合准入控制、驅逐策略及路由決策的記憶體感知政策。 本項目將提供經驗證的工作量模型，以支援準確的效能分析；提出具備可證明最優性保證且可實施的排程政策；並為系統設計者提供實用指引。研究成果將有助於連接排隊理論分析與實際大型語言模型服務系統之間的差距。

16510026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16510026.value: 异质服务系统动态定价与资源分配的联合优化

16510026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16510026.value: The expansion of large-scale, technology-intensive service industries—such as drone delivery and cloud computing—has underscored the need for advanced revenue management tools to optimize constrained resources. Companies like SF Express and Zipline in the drone delivery sector dynamically adjust prices and prioritize orders based on real-time fleet capacity and shifting demand. Similarly, cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform utilize sophisticated management systems to dynamically allocate computing resources and adjust pricing according to workload intensity and available capacity. Given the significant demand volatility and limited resources inherent in these industries, dynamic and real-time decision-making capabilities are essential. By integrating dynamic pricing with real-time scheduling, service providers can create mutually beneficial outcomes that segment the market based on diverse customer preferences regarding price and waiting time. Impatient customers can access immediate service at a premium, while cost-sensitive users may choose more economical, delayed options. This strategy allows providers to maximize both revenue and resource utilization while enhancing the perceived value of their services by aligning resource allocation with varying customer priorities. However, there is a notable lack of academic research that formalizes these mechanisms within a unified analytical framework. Furthermore, developing effective dynamic pricing and scheduling policies is complex, requiring advanced optimization and predictive modeling capabilities. This project aims to develop a joint dynamic pricing and resource allocation policy for a multi-class, many-server queueing system, with the objective of maximizing the service provider's total expected revenue. We will establish a dynamic programming framework to analyze the structural properties of the optimal policy. Building on these insights, we will employ approximate dynamic programming to design efficient algorithms that deliver near-optimal solutions with theoretical performance guarantees. Additionally, we will conduct numerical experiments to quantify the benefits of integrating dynamic pricing with real-time scheduling and to identify conditions under which providers can enhance revenue without compromising consumer welfare. The successful completion of this research will deepen our understanding of the interplay between dynamic pricing and real-time scheduling, enabling service providers to achieve higher revenue while better accommodating diverse customer demands. Furthermore, the findings are expected to inform managerial practices in service resource operations and contribute to policy discussions on designing regulatory frameworks that protect consumer interests while fostering sustainable business growth. 随着无人机配送和云计算等新兴行业的快速发展，这些行业以大规模服务系统为特征，动态定价和实时调度等收益管理工具对于有限服务资源的有效分配变得日益重要。这两种方法对提高排队管理效率都有显著贡献。然而，这两种策略之间的关系仍未得到充分检验。从流量控制的角度来看，动态定价和动态资源分配表现出部分替代性；而从收益管理的角度来看，它们表现出一定程度的互补性。因此，将两者进行适当结合可以使服务提供商在保持服务效率的同时，获得更高的收入。 尽管已有广泛的研究在排队管理背景下分别探索了动态定价和实时调度，但很少有研究在一个统一的分析框架内探讨它们的融合。本研究旨在为多类、多服务器的排队系统开发一种动态定价与资源分配的联合策略，其目标是最大化提供商的总收入。我们提出了一个动态规划框架来研究最优策略的结构特性。在此基础上，将采用近似动态规划技术来设计高效算法，从而生成具有理论性能保证的近乎最优的解决方案。此外，数值实验将评估将动态定价与实时资源分配相结合所带来的增量收益，并确定提供商可以在不降低消费者福利的情况下提高收入的条件。 本研究的成功完成将加深对如何联合利用动态定价和实时资源分配，以提高服务系统效率和提供商盈利能力的理解。研究结果有望为服务资源运营中的管理实践提供参考，并为关于设计保护消费者利益、同时支持商业可持续增长的监管框架的政策讨论做出贡献。

16510426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16510426.value: 金融科技作為緩衝器：關於中小企業應對地緣政治貿易衝擊韌性的因果證據

16510426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16510426.value: Abstract: Geopolitical shocks—from tariff escalations to licensing and sanctions—disrupt supply chains, raise input costs, and threaten the viability of small and medium enterprises (SMEs). We partner with a multibillion-dollar financial technology (FinTech) firm that will share anonymized data from ongoing firm-level experiments and archival panels, together with AI-driven guidance generated by proprietary machine-learning models. Using randomized treatment assignment and event-time variation around tariff rounds, we provide causal estimates of how AI-informed trade-risk insights and flexible working-capital support affect Hong Kong and Mainland China SMEs’ trade continuity, payments performance, and survival. The design integrates high-frequency partner data with public sources on tariffs, customs flows, geopolitical risk, input–output linkages, logistics costs, and FX, and employs modern staggered-DiD estimators and diagnostics. Mechanism tests quantify (i) liquidity channels and (ii) supply-chain bargaining/search channels. Heterogeneity analyses target firms most exposed to U.S.–China frictions. By delivering policy-ready elasticities that map information and liquidity interventions into real margins, the project contributes to academic debates on trade-policy incidence and firm finance while directly informing Hong Kong’s SME financing support and export-resilience strategy. PI: Dr. Eyub Yegen (Hong Kong University of Science and Technology -- HKUST) Collaborator: Dr. Ray Fisman (Boston University, NBER) 地緣政治衝擊——從關稅升級到許可限制及制裁——擾亂了供應鏈，推高了投入成本，並威脅中小企業（SME）的生存能力。我們與一家市值數十億美元的金融科技（FinTech）公司合作，利用其正在進行的企業級實驗數據及歷史面板數據（均已脫敏處理），結合由專有機器學習模型生成的AI驅動指導意見，開展本項研究。透過採用隨機干預分配以及利用關稅調整節點的事件時間差異，我們評估了基於AI的貿易風險洞察與靈活營運資金支持，如何對香港及中國內地中小企業的貿易連續性、支付表現及生存狀況產生因果影響。研究設計整合了合作夥伴提供的高頻數據與關於關稅、海關流量、地緣政治風險、投入產出關聯、物流成本及匯率的公開數據，並採用了現代交錯雙重差分（staggered-DiD）估計量及診斷方法。機制檢驗旨在量化（i）流動性管道和（ii）供應鏈議價/搜尋管道的作用。異質性分析則聚焦在那些受中美經貿摩擦影響最嚴重的企業。本計畫透過提供可直接用於政策制定的彈性指標－即量化資訊介入和流動性介入對企業實際經營結果的影響－不僅豐富了關於貿易政策歸宿（incidence）及企業金融的學術討論，也為香港制定中小企業融資支持政策及出口韌性策略提供了直接參考。

16510526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16510526.value: This study explores the implementation of time-consistent fiscal policies in dynamic economies, with a focus on addressing challenges posed by high initial debt, stochastic environments, and structural constraints. Changes in government administration often lead to time inconsistency, where short-term decision-making undermines long-term welfare-maximizing strategies. While Lucas and Stokey (1983) demonstrated how debt maturity structures could align successive administrations to implement Ramsey tax plans, subsequent research, such as Debortoli, Nunes, and Yared (2021), highlighted critical limitations of this approach, particularly under high debt levels and the Laffer curve constraints. Jiang, Sargent, and Wang (2025) addressed these issues by proposing a modified timing protocol and a "short route" debt management strategy using short-term debt to ensure the implementation of Ramsey plans. Building on this foundation, this study extends the analysis to stochastic and continuous-time settings, examining the design and dynamic implementation of Ramsey plans under uncertainty. By focusing on optimal strategies for managing short-term debt and hedging contracts, this research aims to provide robust, practical solutions for fiscal policy implementation in complex, uncertain environments. 本研究探讨动态经济中时间一致性财政政策的实施，重点关注高初始债务、随机环境以及结构性约束所带来的挑战。政府更迭往往会导致时间不一致问题，即短期决策可能削弱长期福利最大化政策的执行。Lucas and Stokey (1983) 指出，债务期限结构可以约束继任政府，使其实施 Ramsey 税收计划。然而，后续研究（如 Debortoli, Nunes and Yared, 2021）强调了这一方法的重要局限性，尤其是在高债务水平和Laffer曲线约束下。针对这些问题，Jiang, Sargent and Wang (2025) 提出了修正的时序机制，以及一种利用短期债务来确保 Ramsey 计划得以实施的“短路径”债务管理策略。在此基础上，本研究将分析扩展到随机环境和连续时间框架，考察不确定性下 Ramsey 计划的设计与动态实施。通过聚焦短期债务管理和对冲合约的最优策略，本研究旨在为复杂且不确定环境中的财政政策实施提供稳健且具有实践意义的解决方案。

16510826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16510826.value: 基於人工智能體模擬的服務營運管理

16510826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16510826.value: Service operations management addresses decisions in complex stochastic systems (e.g., inventory, supply chains, queueing, pricing, staffing) where performance is often analytically intractable. Heterogeneous agents with distinct objectives and information interact through coordination and competition, further complicating analysis. These challenges make simulation‑based optimization a standard tool for evaluation, design, and policy selection. Traditional simulations often assume fully rational, perfectly informed agents, whereas real managers, workers, and customers face cognitive limits and exhibit systematic biases (e.g., satisficing, framing, reference dependence). Such misspecification can cause policies that appear optimal on paper to underperform in practice, motivating behaviorally faithful, multi-agent simulations. We propose to leverage state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) to generate human-like responses and study the optimization of service operations via LLM-powered multi-agent simulations (LLM‑MAS). Incorporating human decision‑making into these simulations helps designers identify policies and mechanisms that achieve desired performance under realistic behavioral dynamics. For example, a policymaker may set taxes and subsidies in a supply chain to balance welfare, fiscal, and environmental goals; an auctioneer may design prize allocation to induce higher participant effort. In both cases, capturing how heterogeneous individuals respond to incentives and to one another motivates the use of LLM‑MAS. Our proposal introduces a theoretical framework for embedding LLMs—which operate on text—into simulation-optimization pipelines that work with numeric state, action, and outcome variables, and it clarifies how information flows among agents to drive system dynamics. Within this framework, we cast service-system design as stochastic optimization with decision‑dependent uncertainty, where LLM‑MAS generates the stochastic feedback. The framework accommodates both one-shot and long-run feedback. To solve the resulting optimization problem, we use zeroth-order stochastic approximation and develop variance-reduction strategies for randomized simultaneous-perturbation gradient estimates. Because LLM queries are time-consuming, costly, and noisy with occasional hallucinations, we also show how partial knowledge of the LLM-MAS structure can be exploited to tailor algorithms and improve efficiency. Finally, we provide a theoretical analysis of algorithm performance, bounding the number of LLM queries needed to reach a target solution. Overall, this study offers a practical way to integrate LLMs into agent-based modeling and simulation optimization for complex decision-making. 服務營運管理探討複雜隨機系統中的各類決策問題，例如存貨、供應鏈、排隊、定價與人力配置等。在這些系統中，績效通常難以透過解析方法加以評估。具有不同目標與資訊的異質智能體，會透過協調與競爭彼此互動，使分析更加複雜。基於上述挑戰，以模擬為基礎的最佳化已成為系統評估、設計與政策選擇的標準工具。 傳統模擬通常假設智能體完全理性且掌握完整資訊。然而，現實中的管理者、工作者與顧客皆受到認知能力限制，並會呈現系統性的行為偏誤，例如滿意化決策、框架效應與參照依賴。此類模型設定的偏誤可能導致理論上看似最優的政策，在實際執行時表現不佳，因此有必要建立更能忠實反映真實行為的多智能體模擬。 本研究擬運用最先進的大語言模型（large language models, LLMs）產生近似人類的反應，並透過由大語言模型驅動的多智能體模擬（LLM-powered multi-agent simulations, LLM-MAS），研究服務營運系統的最佳化問題。將人類決策行為納入此類模擬，有助於系統設計者在更貼近現實的行為動態下，辨識能夠達成預期績效的政策與機制。 例如，政策制定者可能需要設定供應鏈中的稅賦與補貼，以平衡社會福利、財政及環境目標；拍賣機制設計者則可能需要設計獎勵分配方式，以促使參與者投入更多努力。在這兩類情境中，皆須掌握具有不同特徵的個體如何回應誘因，以及彼此之間如何相互影響，因此適合採用 LLM-MAS 進行分析。 本研究提出一套理論架構，將以文字作為輸入與輸出的大語言模型，嵌入以數值型狀態、行動及結果變數運作的模擬最佳化流程，並釐清智能體之間的資訊流動如何驅動系統動態。在此架構下，我們將服務系統設計建構為具有決策相依不確定性的隨機最佳化問題，並由 LLM-MAS 產生隨機回饋。此架構可同時涵蓋單次互動與長期運作所產生的回饋。 為求解所形成的最佳化問題，本研究採用零階隨機近似方法，並針對隨機化同步擾動梯度估計，發展降低變異數的策略。由於查詢大語言模型不僅耗時且成本高昂，其輸出亦帶有雜訊，並可能偶爾產生幻覺，因此本研究亦探討如何利用對 LLM-MAS 結構的部分先驗知識，設計更具針對性的演算法，以提升計算效率。最後，我們將對演算法效能進行理論分析，並推導達到指定目標解所需之大語言模型查詢次數上界。 整體而言，本研究提供一套具實務可行性的途徑，將大語言模型整合至基於智能體的建模與模擬最佳化之中，以支援複雜決策問題的分析與設計。

16510926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16510926.value: “紫色溢价”：具有政治重要性的企业在国内受优待，却遭外国对手针对吗？

16510926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16510926.value: This project investigates how domestic and international politics interact to shape firms’ risks and returns. We hypothesize that politically important firms -- e.g., US firms that employ many workers in closely contested swing (“purple”) electoral units -- earn a stock price premium in normal times due to domestic political insurance, yet face elevated downside risk during international conflicts when foreign actors strategically target those same constituencies. To examine this hypothesis, we will develop a scalable, firm-level Swing Exposure metric that quantifies each public firm’s employment/operational footprint in electorally competitive counties, combining establishment-level data with county-level election results. Using this metric, we will test two predictions: (i) Domestic insulation—in normal times, high swing-exposure firms are insulated from bad outcomes by domestic policymakers, yielding higher prices (a purple premium) and lower expected returns; and (ii) International vulnerability—during trade wars or geopolitical tensions, foreign governments disproportionately target swing regions, raising risk for purple firms and weakening or reversing that premium. Our empirical design constructs quintile portfolios sorted on swing exposure and examines return differentials and factor-model alphas across normal periods versus conflict windows (e.g., the 2018–2020 U.S. trade war). We also plan to study election-cycle variation (pre- vs. post-election years) and co-movement with Economic Policy Uncertainty to probe mechanisms. Identification leverages substantial time-variation in swing status across states and counties over recent decades, which induces turnover in firms’ swing exposure even when firm locations are fixed. Beyond academic contribution—integrating distributive politics, politically targeted trade retaliation, and asset pricing at the firm level—the project delivers practical tools for investors, corporates, and regulators. We will release public-use methodology and code required to construct firm-level swing-exposure measures after publication, alongside practitioner briefs and educational materials. For Hong Kong—deeply connected to U.S.–China trade and capital flows—these outputs will enable risk teams, suppliers, and regulators to identify footprint-driven political exposures, scenario-test trade shocks, and improve portfolio resilience. Ultimately, we provide evidence and infrastructure to manage the growing intersection of electoral geography and market risk. 本项目旨在探讨国内与国际政治如何相互作用，进而影响企业的风险与收益。我们提出如下假设：具有重要政治影响力的企业（例如，在美国选情胶着的“摇摆”选区——即“紫色”选区——雇佣大量员工的企业）在正常时期因享有国内政治“保险”效应而获得股价溢价；然而，在国际冲突期间，当外国势力针对这些特定选区采取策略性行动时，这些企业则面临更高的下行风险。 为验证这一假设，我们将构建一个可扩展的企业级“摇摆选区敞口”（Swing Exposure）指标。该指标结合了微观层面的企业分支机构数据与县级选举结果，量化了每家上市公司在选情激烈的县域内的就业或运营布局。利用该指标，我们将检验两项预测：(i) 国内保护效应——在正常时期，摇摆选区敞口较高的企业受国内政策制定者保护，免受不利后果影响，从而获得更高的股价（即“紫色溢价”）及较低的预期收益；(ii) 国际脆弱性——在贸易战或地缘政治紧张局势期间，外国政府往往针对摇摆选区采取针对性措施，从而增加此类企业的风险，并削弱甚至逆转上述溢价。 我们的实证设计将基于摇摆选区敞口构建五分位投资组合，并比较正常时期与冲突时期（如2018–2020年美国贸易战期间）的收益差异及因子模型Alpha值。此外，我们还计划研究选举周期（选举前与选举后年份）的变化以及与“经济政策不确定性”指数的联动效应，以深入探究其作用机制。因果识别策略利用了近几十年来各州及各县摇摆选区状态的显著时间变化；即便企业地理位置保持不变，这种状态变化也会导致企业摇摆选区敞口水平的波动。 本项目不仅在学术层面做出了贡献——将分配政治、针对性贸易报复与企业级资产定价理论有机结合——还为投资者、企业及监管机构提供了实用工具。研究成果发表后，我们将公开构建企业级摇摆选区敞口指标所需的方法论与代码，并发布面向实务界的简报及教育资料。对于与中美贸易及资本流动联系紧密的香港而言，这些分析成果将助力风险管理团队、供应商及监管机构识别由地理分布引发的政治风险敞口，针对贸易冲击进行情景压力测试，并增强投资组合的韧性。归根结底，我们提供的依据与基础设施，将有助于应对选举地理格局与市场风险之间日益交织的影响。

16511026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16511026.value: 多屬性產品線設計與第二級價格歧視

16511026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16511026.value: This research proposes a unified analytical framework for understanding how firms design optimal product lines and fighting-brand strategies in markets characterized by heterogeneous consumer preferences. We extend the traditional one-dimensional quality models to a multi-attribute environment. In our model, a firm simultaneously determines the attribute mix and pricing of products targeted at distinct consumer segments---high-end and low-end. The equilibrium analysis reveals that the optimal low-end (fighting) brand is not merely a degraded version of the premium product but a strategically rebalanced bundle: the firm increases the attribute valued by price-sensitive consumers while reducing the attribute prioritized by high-end buyers to maximize attraction to low-end buyers and minimize cannibalization in the high-end segment. The model generates clear comparative statics linking the extent of differentiation and cannibalization to the population share of high-end consumers and the intensity of their valuation advantage. 本研究提出一個統一的分析框架，用以理解企業如何在消費者偏好異質的市場中，設計最適產品線及抗衡品牌（fighting brand）策略。我們將傳統的一維品質模型擴展至多屬性環境。在本模型中，企業同時決定針對不同消費者群體——高端與低端市場——之產品的屬性組合與定價。 均衡分析顯示，最適的低端抗衡品牌並非僅是高端產品的降級版本，而是經過策略性重新平衡的屬性組合：企業提高價格敏感型消費者所重視的屬性，同時降低高端消費者優先看重的屬性，藉此最大程度地吸引低端消費者，並盡量減少對高端市場的蠶食。 本模型得出清晰的比較靜態結果，將差異化及市場蠶食的程度，與高端消費者的人口佔比及其估值優勢的強度連結起來。

16601326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601326.value: 儒家理智德性與典範統治

16601326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601326.value: A central tenet of early Confucianism is that rulers must be morally and intellectually virtuous to govern well. Early Confucian philosophers disagree, however, on what qualities count as intellectual virtues, how many there are, and to what extent rulers must exhibit them in governing. The aim of this project is, first, to offer a systematic analysis of early Confucian views on intellectual virtue and its relation to good governance and, second, to critically evaluate these views by bringing them into dialogue with contemporary epistemologists. Research on early Confucianism has largely focused on its moral philosophy, leaving the distinctively epistemological aspects that inform early Confucian thought underexplored. Although Confucians emphasise the importance of having intellectual qualities such as wisdom (智), lucidity (明), and various capacities for knowing (知), there exists no comprehensive and systematic study of these concepts and their relation to the question of what knowledge is and what role it plays in exemplary rulership. One of my aims is to fill this research gap by providing a comprehensive analysis of the distinctively intellectual qualities that the early Confucians take to be essential to being an exemplary ruler. By focusing on exemplary rulership, this project aims to highlight the practical context in which the early Confucians were doing epistemology, and it demonstrates the contemporary relevance of what Confucian texts have to offer on intellectual virtue. An essential part of this project’s argument is the thesis that, although there is a great variety of views on intellectual virtue expressed by different early Confucian texts, they broadly agree on a general conception of intellectual virtue as (what I call) epistemic skill. More specifically, they agree that intellectual virtue is a skill for acquiring and putting relevant knowledge into practice, that it can be developed with adequate training, and that it is essential for governing and acting morally well. Some of this project’s research will be published in a monograph, currently under contract with Cambridge University Press, provisionally titled “Early Confucian Ethics”. The aim of the monograph is to provide an integrated and unified account of early Confucian ethical thought by highlighting the importance of both the moral and intellectual Confucian virtues and to defend it as a viable way of thinking about the role of virtue in practical reasoning. 早期儒學思想的一種核心主張是，統治者必須具備道德和理智的美德才能良好地治理國家。然而，早期儒家的哲學家們對於哪種品質能夠被算為理智德性，有多少這樣的品質，以及統治者在治理上應該展現這些品質到何種程度存在分歧。這個研究課題的目的是：首先，為早期儒學關於理智德性的觀點以及它與良好治理國家的關係作系統分析；其次，用當代認知論的思想來批判性地評估這些觀點。 關於早期儒學的研究大多著眼於儒學的道德哲學，而對早期儒學思想中與認知論相關的維度卻研究得不多。雖然儒學家強調擁有思想品質（比如説智和明，以及知的各種能力）的重要性，但是對這些概念及其與“何為知識”及“知識在典範的統治中發揮何種作用”等問題的關聯，卻未有全面而系統的研究。 我的目標之一是透過全面分析早期儒家視為 “典範統治者”必備的思想品質，來填補這一研究空白。本研究聚焦於典範統治此議題，旨在凸顯早期儒家進行認識論探討時的實踐語境，並闡明儒家典籍中關於理智德性的論述在當代所具有的現實意義。 這個課題論證的一個核心觀點是：儘管早期儒家文獻對“理智德性”的看法各異，但它們在理智德性的一般概念上大體一致，即將其視為一種“認知技能”（這是我所使用的術語）。具體而言，這些文獻一致認為：理智德性是一種獲取相關知識並將其付諸實踐的技能；它可以透過充分的訓練得以培養；同時，它對於治理事務及實踐道德至關重要。 這個課題研究的部分成果將以專書形式出版：目前已與劍橋大學出版社簽約，暫定名爲《Early Confucian Ethics》。本專著旨在透過凸顯儒家道德美德與理智德性的重要性，對早期儒家倫理思想進行綜合且統一的闡述，並論證其作為一種探討美德在實踐推理中作用的可行思想路徑。

16601526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601526.value: 使用压缩算法来映射心理词典并改善人工智能对齐

16601526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16601526.value: Prof Chan, Antoni B. Prof Hsiao, Janet Hui-wen

16601526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601526.value: In visual word recognition, people decompose words into constituents, and words that share constituents are linked in the mental lexicon. Some evidence suggests that people decompose words to the same constituents as a compression algorithm called byte-pair encoding (BPE), which would imply that visual word recognition approaches optimal efficiency and could improve models of the mental lexicon. Furthermore, most large language models (LLMs) use BPE to segment text into tokens, and if tokens map onto psychologically real constituents, it could facilitate concept alignment. That is to say, BPE could help LLMs interpret words like people do. However, supplying LLMs with human-like constituents is not enough; concept alignment also requires that LLMs use those constituents in a human-like manner. People use orthographic constituents selectively, with stronger formal associations between words with fewer semantic associates, which averts failures in word meaning access. So far, LLMs seem to lack this tendency, suggesting that adaptive strategies which people use to compensate for underdetermined meanings are not recovered through statistical learning, so LLMs miss this opportunity for concept alignment. To test these possibilities, we will conduct three sets of experiments. Study 1 will use masked priming in lexical decisions to provide evidence that BPE identifies psychologically real orthographic constituents in English. For example, according to one promising BPE model, people should recognize “allure” faster following “pasture”, which shares the final constituent “ure”, than following “stature”, which has the final constituent “ature”. Studies 2 and 3 will provide evidence that BPE constituents correspond to links in the mental lexicon and that people use those links to supplement representations of vague or unfamiliar words (e.g., “gypsum”) with orthographically related words (e.g., “gypsy”). To investigate these links in the mental lexicon, we will construct multiplex networks, which simultaneously consider orthographic and semantic connections between words, and we will evaluate their performance based on how well they model word associations in Dutch, English, and Spanish, generated by people and LLMs. We hypothesize that people internalize complex orthographic patterns, which influences how people retrieve and represent word meanings, and that although LLMs have direct access to those patterns, they lack adaptive strategies that are essential to human word processing. These findings would support theories of language evolution, improve models of the mental lexicon, and identify potential sources of AI misalignment. 在视觉词汇识别中，人们会将单词分解为成分，共享成分的单词在心理词典中相互关联。一些证据表明，人们将单词分解成的成分与一种称为字节对编码（BPE）的压缩算法所得到的成分相同，这意味着视觉词汇识别接近最优效率，并可能改进心理词典模型。此外，大多数大语言模型（LLM）使用BPE将文本切分为词元；如果这些词元对应于心理上真实的成分，就可能促进概念对齐。也就是说，BPE可能帮助LLM像人类一样理解单词。然而，仅向LLM提供类似人类的成分还不够；概念对齐还要求LLM以类似人类的方式使用这些成分。人们选择性地使用正字法成分，在语义关联词较少的单词之间形成更强的形式关联，从而避免词义通达失败。迄今为止，LLM似乎缺乏这种倾向，这表明人们用来补偿词义欠确定的适应性策略无法通过统计学习获得，因此LLM错过了这一概念对齐的机会。 为了检验这些可能性，我们将开展三组实验。研究1将在词汇判断任务中使用掩蔽启动，以提供证据证明BPE识别出英语中具有心理现实性的正字法成分。例如，根据一个有前景的BPE模型，人们在“pasture”之后识别“allure”应比在“stature”之后更快，因为“pasture”与“allure”共享末尾成分“ure”，而“stature”的末尾成分是“ature”。研究2和研究3将提供证据表明，BPE成分对应于心理词典中的联结，并且人们利用这些联结，用正字法相关的词（如“gypsy”）来补充模糊或不熟悉词（如“gypsum”）的表征。为了探究心理词典中的这些联结，我们将构建同时考虑词之间正字法和语义连接的多重网络，并根据这些网络在多大程度上能模拟由人类和LLM生成的荷兰语、英语和西班牙语词汇联想来评估其表现。 我们假设，人们会内化复杂的正字法模式，这会影响人们提取和表征词义的方式；尽管LLM可以直接获取这些模式，但它们缺乏对人类词汇加工至关重要的适应性策略。这些发现将支持语言演化理论，改进心理词典模型，并识别AI对齐偏差的潜在来源。

16602126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602126.value: 香港印度裔和菲律賓裔人士的跨地域歸屬感與照顧實踐

16602126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16602126.value: Dr Gube, Jan Christian C. Dr KHALIKOVA, Venera

16602126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602126.value: This transdisciplinary project investigates how people from Filipino and Indian backgrounds in Hong Kong experience, understand and express their sense of belonging across multiple locations, and asks how these translocal connections are influenced by care relationships. People of South and Southeast Asian heritage in Hong Kong encounter systemic marginalization, which calls into question conventional notions of belonging based on cultural and linguistic homogeneity. Furthermore, a sense of belonging that transcends local boundaries is usually linked to care needs and responsibilities, including personal, domestic and health care as well as the flow of resources such as money, gifts, news, and support. These critical aspects of belonging, in the context of a sometimes challenging local environment, are not well understood, highlighting a gap in scholarly knowledge and effective policy measures. This matters because the lack of a nuanced conception of belonging may undermine Hong Kong’s efforts to be an inclusive talent-nurturing society. The project involves collaboration between academics at three Hong Kong universities (in linguistics, anthropology and education), support NGOs, and trainee teachers. Embedding care in questions of what it means to belong, we will conduct a contextualising survey, and – with four family groups – will engage in innovative linguistic and arts-based ethnography. Central to each family network is a Key Participant (KP), an adult in Hong Kong with south-south translocal connections and care relationships in either the Philippines or India, country backgrounds with significance for South and Southeast Asian people in Hong Kong. We will explore how our participants experience these relationships through interaction, narrative and the creative expression of their translocal belonging; consider, through our exploration, the challenges that people with links in Hong Kong and elsewhere experience when developing a sense of belonging; and understand how belonging for people with translocal networks is mutually shaped by care relationships. To do this, our work will generate and analyse narratives of belonging and care in localities in Hong Kong and abroad that are meaningful for the participants, combining these with creative outputs on the project’s theme of translocal belonging and care, developed through the KPs’ own photography. Impact will be achieved by developing training and educational materials for schools and for health and social workers, and through an exhibition for a general audience. A long-term goal is to establish the topic of belonging among minoritized people as an area of research strength in Hong Kong. 這項跨學科項目旨在探討香港的印度裔和菲律賓裔人士跨地域的歸屬感的經歷，以及他們如何理解和表達歸屬感。研究亦會討論這些跨地域聯繫如何受到照顧關係的影響。一方面，香港的南亞和東南亞裔人士面對系統性的邊緣化；另一方面，傳統意義上的歸屬感基於文化和語言的同質性。以上兩點促使我們反思歸屬感這一概念。此外，跨地域的歸屬感通常與照顧需求和責任有關，包括個人照顧、家庭照顧和醫療保健，以及金錢、禮物、資訊和支持等資源的流動。本地環境有時充滿挑戰，在此情況下，這些歸屬感的關鍵方面尚未得到充分理解，凸顯了學術知識和政策措施方面的不足。這一點至關重要。香港致力成為一個具有包容性的社會，若對歸屬感缺乏細微的理解，則可能削弱這方面的努力。 本項目由香港三所大學的學者、非政府組織和實習教師共同合作。其中，三位學者分別為語言學、人類學和教育學專家。我們以「歸屬感」為主題，探討關懷的意義。我們會與四個家庭群組合作，採用新穎的語言和藝術民族志研究方法，並進行情景化調查。每個家庭網絡的核心人物是一位關鍵參與者（KP），並且為一名成年人。菲律賓和印度對在港南亞和東南亞裔人士有重要意義，因而這位關鍵參與者需要與菲律賓或印度有南南跨地域聯繫和關懷關係。研究從三個方面探索項目參與者就這些跨地域關係的經歷，這三方面包括：他們之間的互動、敘事和對跨地域歸屬感的創造性的表達。參與者與香港、與其他地區均有關聯，形成跨地域的網絡。透過探索，我們思考在建立歸屬感的同事，他們還面臨了怎樣的挑戰。研究亦能幫助我們理解歸屬感與關懷關係是如何相輔相成的。為此，我們會收集並分析香港及海外地區對參與者而言具有意義的歸屬感和關懷敘事，並將這些敘事與圍繞項目主題——跨地域歸屬感和關懷——的創意作品相結合，這些創意作品將透過關鍵人物（KP）的攝影作品呈現。 我們將透過為學校、衛生和社會工作者開發培訓和教育材料，以及舉辦面向公眾的展覽來擴大計畫的影響力。我們的長期目標是將少數族群歸屬感這個主題確立為香港的研究優勢領域。

16602326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602326.value: 邊地書寫與文化交涉：二十世紀初的遠東俄僑文學

16602326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602326.value: This research project aims to explore the rich landscape of Russian émigré literature in the Far East, set against the intricate backdrop of East Asian literature and culture in Manchuria. The tumultuous events of the twentieth century-specifically the First World War, the 1917 Russian Revolution, and the ensuing civil war-forced many Russian citizens to flee the Russian Empire, with a significant number seeking refuge in the Far East. While substantial scholarship has focused on Russian émigré literature in Western contexts, the literary contributions of émigrés in the Far East remain largely underexplored, warranting closer examination. Historically, Russian émigré literature in the Far East has been viewed as secondary to the modernist movements in Russia. However, it not only serves as a compelling counterpart to Russian émigré narratives in Europe, shaped by distinct cultural environments, but also enriches the literary landscape of Manchuria, which is predominantly influenced by East Asian discourses. By bringing together the study of the Russian diaspora with the literature of Manchuria-both of which have gained increasing attention in recent English-language scholarship-this project endeavors to illuminate the significance of Russian émigré literature in the Far East, offering fresh insights into themes of exile, belonging, displacement, cultural hybridity, memory, and nostalgia. This study will focus on trans/spatial narratives to investigate how literature became a vital means for émigrés to navigate their experiences of uncertainty and dislocation in transcultural contexts. It seeks to address critical questions: How did the experiences of Russian émigrés in the Far East differ from those of their counterparts in Europe? In a region like Manchuria, characterized by the complex interplay of Chinese, Russian, Japanese, and Korean cultures, how did these émigrés engage with their host societies? Moreover, how did these transcultural interactions manifest in their literary works? Utilizing the concepts of homeland/borderland and secular/natural spaces, this research will leverage recent scholarly insights in spatial humanities to analyze the works of notable Russian émigré writers, including Valerii Pereleshin, Nikolai Baikov, and Nataliia Il'ina, alongside East Asian figures such as Xiao Hong and Ushijima Haruko. Additionally, an examination of early twentieth-century Russian periodicals will help reconstruct the community's habitus. By exploring how Russian émigrés in Manchuria expressed their displacement in the early twentieth century, this project makes visible the pivotal role of literature in enriching Russian émigré discourse in unfamiliar terrain, emphasizing its significance for understanding diaspora, border-crossing, and transnational identities. 本研究旨在系統考察遠東俄僑文學的多重面向，並將其置於東北亞文學文化的宏觀語境中加以審視。二十世紀初期，第一次世界大戰、一九一七年俄國革命及隨之而來的內戰，迫使大批俄僑流亡海外，許多人輾轉遷移至遠東地區。相較於學界對流亡歐洲或北美俄僑的關注，遠東俄僑的文學實踐與文化貢獻，至今仍處於相對邊緣化的研究範疇，亟待進一步的系統性探討。 就學術定位而言，遠東俄僑文學過往多被視為俄國本土現代主義文學的支流或衍生物，其價值長期被低估。然而，此類文學不僅在異質文化環境的形塑下，構成與歐洲北美俄僑敘事相互參照的重要對應體系，同時亦為以中日韓語為主導的東北亞文學版圖注入獨特的跨文化質素。近年來，英語學術界對俄僑離散與滿洲文學的關注日趨增長，本計畫旨在連結東亞與斯拉夫區域研究，藉以重新評估遠東俄僑文學之歷史意義與理論價值，並為流亡、歸屬、遷徙、文化混雜、記憶與懷舊等核心命題提供嶄新的詮釋路徑。 在研究方法上，本計畫將以「跨域／空間敘事」為切入視角，探討文學如何成為僑民在跨文化情境中應對生存不確定性與空間疏離感的重要媒介。具體研究問題包括：遠東俄僑的流亡經驗與歐洲北美俄僑的經歷之間存在何種結構性差異？在東北亞此一中俄日韓國文化交互滲透的區域，俄僑如何與當地社會建立互動關係？此類跨文化交涉又如何影響其文學作品中的主題與敘事策略？ 為回應上述問題，本計畫將援引「故鄉／邊地」與「世俗空間／自然空間」等分析範疇，並結合空間人文之理論進展，深入剖析別列列申、巴依科夫、伊莉娜等俄僑作家之代表作，同時納入蕭紅、牛島春子等相關東亞作家之作品進行參照比較。此外，本計畫亦將系統梳理二十世紀初俄僑在滿洲發行之期刊文獻，以重建該群體之文學生產場域與文化慣習。藉由考察遠東俄僑在二十世紀初如何於文學中再現其失根狀態與跨界經驗，本研究將嘗試揭示文學在異質文化空間中的關鍵作用，並進一步闡明文學對於理解離散與跨國認同議題之深層啟示。

16602726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602726.value: 治理與創新的權衡：中國生成式人工智能前沿競爭力的形成與可持續路徑

16602726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16602726.value: Prof Yang, Guobin Prof Yarime, Masaru

16602726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602726.value: The rapid rise of Chinese generative AI firms—achieving frontier-level capabilities within only five years—presents a paradox for innovation theory. It has unfolded under a coordination-intensive governance regime emphasizing safety and control, seemingly at odds with the conventional expectation that stringent regulation suppresses technological breakthroughs. Whether such governance-embedded innovation represents sustainable adaptation or short-term mobilization that risks institutional lock-in remains unresolved—a question with implications extending beyond China to global debates on governing transformative technologies. This project investigates how Chinese AI developers navigate regulatory imperatives through three organizational mechanisms: anticipatory compliance, efficiency optimization, and institutional entrepreneurship. By examining these mechanisms, the study assesses under what conditions regulatory coordination may function as a catalyst rather than merely a constraint on innovation. To capture this dynamic, it advances a Governance-Innovation Trade-off Model that analyzes how governance enhances technical performance while constraining exploratory capacity, identifying boundary conditions that separate adaptive coordination from institutional rigidity. Employing an integrated multi-method design, the project triangulates evidence across organizational, technical, and institutional levels. Case studies of leading Chinese AI firms use process tracing and elite interviews to reveal how regulatory signals translate into design architectures and management strategies. Computational benchmarking and value auditing of frontier models assess governance-performance trade-offs in safety, accuracy, and adaptability.
