17606726.value: In the past decade, there is a growing global trend of Foreign Influence Law (FIL) legislation, aimed at curbing “hostile” foreign influence over domestic political processes. The phenomenon of expanding FIL regimes in both liberal democracies and authoritarians raises a series of stimulating questions. What common pattern and divergences emerge in FIL regulation and enforcement across different regime types? How do democracies and non-democracies differ in addressing threats to regime security posed by opposing ideological forces? Do open-society principles and the rule of law in democratic contexts falter when confronted with authoritarian challenges? In what way can FILs undermine human rights, and how can the authorities strike the right balance between safeguarding national security and protecting human rights? Despite its academic significance and far-reaching implications for individuals in today’s globalized world – marked by clashing political ideological – the phenomenon remains understudied. This project offers the first comprehensive, in-depth comparative analysis of global foreign influence regulation, critically evaluating the structured issues of FILs and identifying ways to minimize FILs’ impact on citizens’ rights. It comprise two main components First, the study will develop models of foreign influence regulation by examining dedicated FILs across jurisdictions with diverse political ideologies – paying special attention to FILs that serve as models and have global reach. Drawing on systematic case studies, it will apply a comparative framework built around a checklist of key indicators measuring liberality and restrictiveness in major FIL regimes. This analysis will then identify the commonalities and differences in both legal and extra-legal strategies that both democracies and non-democracies use to counter hostile foreign threats. The second part build on the comparative analysis to critically assess Hong Kong’s FIL regime and extract lessons for its enforcement in the city. It will uncover the unintended consequences of stringent FILs on Hong Kong’s status as an international financial hub and propose policy suggestions and judicial review techniques to promote effective, rights-respecting implementation. The project promises both theoretical and practical values. Theoretically, it will contribute to scholarship on the interaction between authoritarian legality and the liberal rule-of-law, as well as enrich theoretical discussions on democratic tolerance. Practically, this study will reveal the inherent and structured issues associated with FILs, including the erosion of the rule of law and negative democratic inputs. 近年來，全球範圍內旨在遏制外國影響力的立法日益增多，其目的在於抑制「敵對性」外國勢力對國內政治及社會的影響。在同時期內，自由民主國家與威權國家都加強推進外國影響力法的立法與執法，引發了一系列值得深究的問題：不同政體類型在外國影響力法的規制與執法方面呈現出哪些共同模式與差異？面對不同意識形態力量及其對政權安全的潛在威脅，不同政體類型的應對方式有何不同？民主語境中的開放社會原則與法治，在面對威權主義挑戰時是否失靈？外國影響力法在多大程度上可能侵蝕人權，而權力機關及法院又應如何在維護國家安全與保障人權之間取得適當平衡？ 在當今政治意識形態衝突日益顯著的國際政治環境中，外國影響力法的全球性擴張已對公民個體在眾多領域的權利義務產生深遠影響。然而，相關學術研究仍相當匱乏。本項目將對全球外國影響力規制展開全面深入的比較分析，批判性評估外國影響力法的結構性問題，並探尋將其對公民權利影響降至最低的路徑。項目主要包括兩個部分。 首先，本研究將通過考察不同政治意識形態法域中的專門性外國影響力法，建構規制外國影響力的類型模型，重點考察具有示範效應及全球性影響的外國影響力法。在系統性個案研究的基礎上，項目將採用以關鍵指標清單為核心的比較框架，用以衡量主要外國影響力法制度的開放性與限制性程度。通過這一分析，本研究將比較民主國家與非民主國家在應對敵對性外國威脅時所採取的法律與超法律策略之共同點與差異。 第二部分將在上述比較分析的基礎上，對香港的外國影響力法制度進行批判性評估，並提煉其在香港執法中的經驗與啟示。本研究旨在探討外國影響力法對香港國際金融中心地位可能產生的潛在影響，並提出政策建議與司法審查路徑，以推動該制度在實施中兼顧實效性與權利保障。 本項目兼具理論與實踐價值。在理論層面，它將有助於推進關於威權法制與自由法治之間互動關係的研究，並豐富有關民主寬容等理論的學術對話。在實踐層面，本研究將揭示外國影響力法所固有的結構性問題，包括其對法治與民主參與的潛在威脅，旨在推動權利保障與國家安全維護機制的完善。

17607626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607626.value: 主權公民運動：偽法律的術語與話語

17607626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607626.value: This project concerns the sovereign citizen movement, focusing primarily on the United States. Sovereign citizens take a radically anti-government stance, and gather their information and views from online conspiracy theorists and the US fringe media. Sovereign citizens deny that they have consented to be US citizens of the United States. While most sovereign citizens are non-violent, some police officers have been attacked or even killed. The FBI has designated these groups as a domestic terrorism threat. Sovereign citizens have developed their own jurisprudence and their own legal jargon (“pseudolaw”). One key notion is that the government creates at birth a legal persona, a corporate “strawman”, which is fundamentally distinct from the “flesh-and-blood” self. On official documents the name of this persona is often spelled in capital letters, and this is regarded as a visible index of this government-created fiction. In dissociating oneself from this strawman identity one can avoid the obligations that accrue with citizenship. Sovereign citizens deny the need a licence or registration for a private vehicle, as they are “travelling” as “freemen on the land” rather than “driving”—which they regard as a purely commercial activity. The sovereign citizen movement begins with white racist groups; yet the ideology appeals to constituencies whose historically problematic positioning within the US constitutional order dramatizes the issue of consent to political authority. For example, some African-American groups lay claim to a “Moorish” identity and therefore to legal immunities the United States. The sovereign citizen phenomenon has drawn the attention of legal scholars, primarily because of the antagonistic and bizarre interactions between sovereign citizens, police, and the courts. This project brings to the scholarly literature in law an explicit focus on language and discourse, treating the movement as a sub-culture with its own linguistic and sociological characteristics, and its own sub-cultural beliefs about language, writing, signs. Sovereign citizens display an intense ambivalence towards both law and language. The project identifies, documents, and analyzes the pseudolegal terminology employed by sovereign citizens, annotating its history, development, and diffusion, and foregrounding the role of language and discourse within this complex and evolving phenomenon. Within this framework the project will examine and analyze courtroom interactions with a view to understanding the dynamics of the legal process when the basis of the legal order is fundamentally challenged. 本項目關於主權公民運動，主要聚焦於美國。主權公民持極端反政府立場，並從網路陰謀論者與美國邊緣媒體獲取資訊與觀點。主權公民否認自己已同意成為美國公民。雖然大多數主權公民是非暴力的，但也有警察遭受攻擊甚至被殺的情況。 FBI 已將這些團體列為國內恐怖主義威脅。 主權公民發展出自己的法律觀點與法律術語（“偽法律”）。一個關鍵概念是，政府在出生時創造了一個法律人格，即“稻草人”(strawman)，這與“血肉之軀”的自我本質上是不同的。在官方文件上，這個人格的名字常以大寫字母拼寫，這被視為政府創造的虛構事實的明顯象徵。通過與這個稻草人身份脫離關聯，個人可以避免因公民身份而產生的義務。主權公民否認私家車需要牌照或登記，因為他們認為自己是在“自由人”身份下“旅行”，而非“駕駛”—他們將駕駛視為純粹的商業行為。 主權公民運動始於白人種族主義團體，但這一意識形態吸引了那些在美國憲法秩序中具有歷史性爭議地位的群體，突出表現出對政治權威的同意問題。例如，一些非裔美國人團體宣稱自己具有“摩爾”身份，因此享有美國的法律豁免權。主權公民現象引起法律學者的關注，主要是因為主權公民與警方和法院之間存在敵對且怪異的互動。 本項目在法律學術文獻中明確聚焦於語言與話語，將該運動視為具有自身語言和社會學特徵的亞文化，以及其對語言、書寫與符號的亞文化信仰。主權公民對法律和語言都表現出強烈的矛盾態度。本研究將辨識、記錄並分析主權公民使用的偽法律術語，註釋其歷史、發展與傳播，並突顯語言與話語在這一複雜且不斷演變的現象中的角色。 在此框架下，該項目還將檢視並分析法庭上的互動，以理解當法律秩序的基礎受到根本挑戰時，法律程序的動態。

17608126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608126.value: 香港過失法中的損害要件

17608126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608126.value: The proposed research will analyse ‘damage’ in the tort of negligence, with a particular focus on claims for psychiatric injuries in Hong Kong. Tort law enables a plaintiff to obtain a remedy, usually compensation, against a wrongdoer. By far the most practically significant ‘tort’ is the tort of negligence: it encompasses everything from road traffic accidents to poor financial advice. To succeed in a negligence action, plaintiffs must establish that a defendant’s breach of a duty to take reasonable care caused them damage. Damage is considered to be the ‘gist of the action’ in negligence. Yet despite its importance, it is under-analysed compared to other elements of the negligence enquiry. It is not always clearly defined in the case law, and damage issues are frequently subsumed within questions relating to other elements, such as the duty of care, leading to confused analysis of distinct topics. Often, academic analysis of damage has focused on only one jurisdiction or one particular form of damage. Not only has this meant that connections have been lost, but Hong Kong, despite being the source of a number of significant cases on the topic, has been overlooked in the literature. The converse of this is the law on psychiatric injuries, where there is a significant body of academic literature but a dearth of reported claims in Hong Kong. Although there has been some speculation on why this might be, it remains just that: speculation. The absence of any significant studies relating to this type of injury in Hong Kong constitutes a notable gap in the literature. Drawing on the doctrinal and comparative literature, the proposed project will fill these gaps by addressing key conceptual and theoretical questions related to damage, including understanding its definition and its proper place in the tort of negligence. The project will also include an empirical strand to elucidate the practical issues related to psychiatric injury claims in Hong Kong. Improving our understanding of damage will help to address many related questions in the law of negligence. Discovering why there is a lack of psychiatric injury claims in Hong Kong is important. Although there may be cultural explanations, the lack could also be due to a lack of access to justice. I intend to disseminate the findings of this research by publishing three articles in world-leading journals, and blogs and policy-papers. 本研究擬分析香港過失侵權法中的「損害」，特別聚焦於精神傷害索償。 侵權法容許原告人向侵權人尋求補救，通常為金錢賠償。迄今為止，最具實際重要性的「侵權」行為是過失侵權：其涵蓋範圍從道路交通意外到不當財務建議不等。要在過失訴訟中勝訴，原告人必須證明被告違反了合理謹慎注意之義務，並對其造成了損害。 損害被視為過失訴訟中的「訴訟要旨」。然而，儘管其地位重要，相比於過失侵權審查中的其他要素，損害所獲得的分析卻較為不足。在判例法中，損害並非總是被清晰界定，而損害問題亦經常被歸入與其他要素（如注意義務）相關的考量之中，導致不同議題的分析出現混淆。學術上對損害的分析往往僅集中於單一司法管轄區或某一特定形式的損害。這不僅使不同脈絡之間的聯繫被忽略，更令香港——儘管其在該議題上產生了多宗重要案例——在文獻中被邊緣化。與此相對的是精神傷害法律領域，該領域雖有大量學術文獻，但在香港卻鮮有已呈報的索償案件。雖然對此現象已有若干推測，惟至今仍僅屬臆測。香港缺乏任何與此類傷害相關的重要研究，構成了文獻中的明顯空白。 本項目將借鑑法理學與比較法文獻，填補上述空白，透過探討與損害相關的核心概念及理論問題，包括理解其定義及其在過失侵權法中的適當定位。項目亦將納入實證研究，以闡明香港精神傷害索償的實際運作問題。加深我們對損害的理解，將有助於解決過失法中許多相關問題。探討香港為何缺乏精神傷害索償案件，具有重要意義。儘管可能存在文化上的解釋，但此缺失亦可能源於求助司法的途徑不足。本人擬透過在世界頂級期刊發表三篇論文，以及撰寫博客和政策文件，以傳播本研究的成果。

17608326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608326.value: 爭議中的時間界線：數位螢幕使用參與對青少年自殺風險之影響——作為其與生活型態面向交互作用之歷程

17608326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17608326.value: Dr Junus, Alvin Dr Xiao, Yunyu

17608326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608326.value: Researchers contend that the rise of digital technologies and social media are closely tied to increased prevalence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors (STBs) and worsened mental health in general among youths. Youths’ digital screen engagement (DSE) – which comprises of digital screen time and the type of content being engaged – which are key indicators of this unfolding crisis. However, the scope of existing empirical investigations has been predominantly confined to just one of these two complementary aspects of DSE. Moreover, most existing studies have not considered the notion that DSE would be contesting for higher shares of youths’ time with aspects of (offline) lifestyle that could inherently promote emotional resilience. The Health Hexagon Model (HHM) operationalizes these salubrious elements into six facets: sleep, physical activity, diet, closeness with nature, supportive kinships and friendships, and a sense of purpose, meaning, or sacredness. Yet, most existing studies have only examined the interplay between DSE and at most one of the six lifestyle facets of HHM, thereby generating stylized findings and biased assessments of the impact of DSE on youth STB and mental health in general. This project aims to embrace a holistic perspective to more accurately assess DSE’s impact on youths’ mental health. At the macro-level, it aims to generate population-level insights on youths’ time-use patterns and uncover nuanced links between specific patterns and mental health. At the micro-level, it aims to shed light on how dynamic interplays between DSE and mental health symptoms at fine-grained temporal resolutions may shape youths’ mental health trajectories. Altogether, this project is aimed at moving scholarly discourse beyond an emphasis on simply reducing screen time. We aim to push the possibility of evidence-based recommendations that scientists can contribute, i.e., reducing which content’s screen time, for whom, and how might the reduced screen time be effectively substituted. Such insights will have a strong potential to set new forefronts for efforts aimed at improving youth mental health in today’s highly digitalized era locally and globally. 研究人員主張，數位科技與社群媒體的興起，與青少年自殺意念及行為（STBs）的盛行率上升，以及整體心理健康狀況惡化密切相關。青少年的數位螢幕使用參與（DSE）——包含數位螢幕使用時間及所接觸內容的類型——是此一持續惡化危機的關鍵指標。然而，現有實證研究的範疇多半僅限於DSE的這兩個互補面向中的其中一項。此外，多數既有研究並未考量DSE可能與（線下）生活型態的各個面向爭奪青少年較多的時間，而這些線下生活型態面向本身即能促進情緒韌性。健康六邊形模型（HHM）將這些有益健康的要素操作化為六個面向：睡眠、身體活動、飲食、親近自然、支持性的親屬與友誼關係，以及目的感、意義感或神聖感。然而，多數現有研究僅探討DSE與HHM六個生活型態面向中至多一個面向之間的交互作用，因而產生了樣板化的發現，並對DSE對青少年STB及整體心理健康的影響造成了偏誤的評估。 本計畫旨在採納整體性的視角，以更精確地評估DSE對青少年心理健康的影響。在鉅觀層面上，其目標在於產生關於青少年時間使用模式的人口層級洞見，並揭示特定模式與心理健康之間的細微關聯。在微觀層面上，則旨在闡明DSE與心理健康症狀在細緻時間解析度下的動態交互作用，可能如何形塑青少年的心理健康軌跡。 總而言之，本計畫旨在將學術論述推展至超越單純減少螢幕時間的重點。我們致力於推動科學家能貢獻的實證建議之可能性，亦即：減少哪一種內容的螢幕時間、針對誰，以及減少的螢幕時間應如何有效地被替代。此類洞見將具有強大潛力，為當前高度數位化時代中，本地及全球層面上改善青少年心理健康的努力，開創新的前沿。

17608726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608726.value: 讀寫障礙患者視覺神經夾帶的異常

17608726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17608726.value: Prof Ku, Yixuan Dr Xu, Melody Jia-Qi

17608726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608726.value: Developmental dyslexia (DD) affects about 7% of the population, impacting their quality of life. A widely accepted view attributes DD to deficits in phonological processing, whereby individuals exhibit poor representation and manipulation of speech sounds. However, evidence also suggests that DD is linked to deficits in other domains such as visual processing. The temporal sampling framework proposes that deficits in neural entrainment to rhythmic information exist in all domains, including auditory, visual, motor, and attention. Neural entrainment is a neurological process that occurs when synchronized rhythmic fluctuations of neural excitability, known as neural oscillations, adjust to external rhythmic stimuli such as speech or visual cues. Neural entrainment may play an essential role in optimal information processing because of the expectation of exact timing for the next stimulus. Although previous studies have documented reduced neural entrainment in the auditory modality in DD, and it can be easily measured even in young children, neural entrainment has not been used as an early sign in DD diagnosis because we lack understanding of many important questions. We propose an SSVEP (steady-state visually evoked potentials) study in Chinese children and adults with DD to examine neural entrainment in the visual modality, which may advance early DD diagnosis in the future. In the proposed SSVEP paradigm, the left half of a visual stimulus flickers at one frequency (fundamental frequency 1, f1), and the right half flickers at another (fundamental frequency 2, f2). Brain potentials can then be recorded at both fundamental frequencies (i.e., f1, f2), as well as at the intermodulation frequency (i.e., f1+f2). The neural entrainment at the intermodulation frequency tends to be greater in real symmetric Chinese characters (e.g., 林) than symmetric pseudo-characters (e.g., ). Using this novel paradigm, we will examine 1) whether individuals with DD have a lower neural entrainment than typical controls at both the fundamental frequencies and the intermodulation frequency, 2) whether their neural entrainment is impaired at a specific frequency band, 3) whether neural entrainment impairment occurs only for linguistic stimuli, and 4) how neural entrainment impairment changes with age. The proposed study will not only advance our understanding of the neural underpinnings of visual processing in DD, but also lay the groundwork for future applications of the SSVEP paradigm in young children, potentially predicting DD before children learn to read. The project findings may also provide insights on early intervention using brain stimulation to modulate neural entrainment. 讀寫障礙影響7%的人羣。一個被廣泛接受的理論認爲讀寫障礙是由於語音缺陷引起的，然而讀寫障礙患者在視覺，動作等很多領域有共發障礙，不僅是聽覺領域。時間採樣理論認爲讀寫障礙患者對節律信息的神經夾帶異常普遍存在於各個領域中，包括聽覺，視覺，動作，注意，這有助於爲讀寫障礙提供一個統一的底層機制的解釋。神經夾帶指的是神經振盪的頻率被外部刺激的頻率同化，神經夾帶可能是優化信息處理的關鍵，因爲神經元放電的頻率和信息出現的頻率一致。 雖然前人研究發現讀寫障礙在聽覺中的神經夾帶減弱，而且神經夾帶很容易在幼兒中測試，但是神經夾帶減弱並沒有成爲讀寫障礙診斷的一個早期標誌，因爲對神經夾帶異常還有很多關鍵問題沒有回答，比如：1）神經夾帶在視覺中是否也有減弱？2）神經夾帶減弱最嚴重的頻段是哪個頻段？3）神經夾帶減弱是否只存在於語言刺激中？對非語言刺激是否正常？4）神經夾帶減弱是否隨年齡發展而變化？我們擬使用SSVEP實驗範式（穩態視覺電位）對漢語讀寫障礙兒童和成人進行研究，這一研究有利於推動讀寫障礙的早期診斷。

17609326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609326.value: 從好萊塢到哔哩哔哩：「混剪+彈幕」IP影視內容的創造型譯製

17609326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609326.value: This project advances understanding of audiovisual translation (AVT) within the framework of technological democratization, which has fundamentally transformed audience engagement worldwide. The study examines an increasingly prominent yet understudied area for translation studies: screen fiction driven by cultural intellectual properties (IPs) associated with Hollywood franchises. It investigates the digital transcreational practice surrounding such IP screen fiction, with focus on the unique contributions of Chinese audiences on the platform Bilibili. These audiences take up the role of transcreators through video remixing and the platform’s synchronous commentating system, known as danmu (bullet texts), which allows users to insert comments directly into the video frame during a viewing process. The research aims to demonstrate the audiences’ capacities to influence through digital participations in remix+danmu transcreation the translation and reception of IP-driven transmedia storytelling in China. Existing scholarship in transmedia franchising has largely neglected the critical role of AVT in transcultural dissemination. In China, due to local restrictions on foreign-language media, official translations of IP screen fiction in Hollywood franchises such as Star Wars, Doctor Who, and Alien remain incomplete or unavailable. Despite the existence of other Chinese translations such as fansubs, no single AVT medium can fully capture the nuance and breadth of a franchise, which often spans across multiple media and involves complex processes of genesis, diversion, remake and reboot. Audiences with specific genre and franchise-related expertise leverage video remix and danmu to retell, review and remediate franchise content. Yet little research has been conducted on these user-driven transcreations, and particularly in relation to the participatory system of Bilibili despite the platform’s momentous role in facilitating user engagement with global popular cultures. To address the existing gaps in knowledge, this project will conduct case-based analyses of IP screen fictions such as Andor, Doctor Who: 60th Anniversary Specials, and Alien: Earth, which have not been officially released in China. The study investigates how audience transcreators on Bilibili retell IP screen fictions through remix and danmu and explores the theoretical implications of such user-driven transcreation for AVT research. Methodologically, the project will involve collecting video and textual data and interviewing Bilibili’s users and content creators for computational cultural analytics on sustained contextual engagement. Dissemination through scholarly publications and conference presentations will highlight the significance of remix+danmu as emergent transcreative media in Chinese digital production, offering new insights into what constitutes audiovisual translation in a networked franchise era. 本研究聚焦於以好萊塢系列影視為核心的文化智慧財產（Cultural IPs）在中國的傳播與再創作。研究將著重分析中國觀眾在哔哩哔哩（Bilibili）平台上，透過影片混剪及彈幕評論，進行內容的再製作。彈幕系統允許用戶在觀看影片時，實時插入評論，創造出一種全新的互動模式。 本研究將以尚未在中國內地正式推出的作品為例，包括《安多爾》（2022–2023）、《超時空奇俠：60週年特輯》（2023）和《異形：地球》（2025），分析觀眾如何透過混剪和彈幕進行內容再創作，並討論這種用戶主導的跨文化傳播對視聽翻譯的理論意義。研究將收集影片與文字資料，並對哔哩哔哩的用戶與內容創作者進行訪談，進行演算文化分析，以理解其持續的文化參與過程，旨在展示「混剪+彈幕」在中文數位媒體中的新角色。

17610326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610326.value: Ann Hui’s career spans the last four decades of Hong Kong cinema. She entered filmmaking in 1979 as part of a young generation of directors who came to be collectively known as the Hong Kong New Wave. They ushered in an extraordinary chapter in Hong Kong film culture, one in which commercial and critical success went hand in hand, and experimental approaches meshed fluidly with popular appeal. Of the very small number of women who have made their names as directors in Hong Kong’s mainstream film industry, Hui has achieved the most enduring success, with over thirty films to date. These have earned plaudits at prestigious international film festivals as well as praise at home, leading one critic to describe her as “the most Hong Kong of Hong Kong directors.” But despite her status and significant body of work, there is a dearth of scholarship on Hui. Not a single book-length study has been published on her in English (with the exception of one monograph focusing on her film Song of the Exile). I seek support for the completion of the first English-language academic monograph dedicated to Ann Hui. I plan to publish this project as part of the Contemporary Film Directors series from University of Illinois Press, a book series that is unique in its long-running commitment to the format of the single-director study, while also prioritizing inventive methods that challenge conventional ideas of authorship. The need for critical reflection on the construct of authorship is especially pressing in Hui’s case, given her rejection of the label of auteur and its implication of a singular distinct style. “I have not been innovative in terms of film language or technique,” she insists, and “I adopt different styles for different films.” Nonetheless, to look closely at Hui’s body of work is to discover a deep and abiding fascination with authorship – with literary sources, as in her adaptations of stories by the modern fiction writer Eileen Chang; with the lives of writers, which have inspired her documentaries and fictional biopics; or with subjective point-of-view as a starting point for creative approaches to film form. Thus my book engages with authorship as a conceptual lens into Hui’s filmography. 許鞍華的職業生涯橫跨香港電影近四十年。她於1979年進入電影界，是後來被稱為“香港新浪潮”的年輕一代導演之一。他們開啟了香港電影文化的一個非凡篇章，商業成功與評論界的讚譽齊頭並進，實驗性的手法與大眾的喜愛完美融合。在香港主流電影界為數不多的女導演中，許鞍華取得了最為持久的成功，至今已執導三十餘部影片。這些影片不僅在國際知名電影節上斬獲殊榮，也贏得了國內的讚譽，以至於一位影評人稱她為「最具香港特色的香港導演」。然而，儘管她地位顯赫，作品豐富，但關於許鞍華的學術研究卻十分匱乏。到目前為止，除了2010年岳慧玲撰寫的關於她電影《流亡之歌》的專著外，尚未有一部英文專著出版。 我計劃撰寫第一部專門研究許鞍華的英文學術專著。該計畫將作為伊利諾大學出版社「當代電影導演」系列叢書的一部分出版。該系列叢書的獨特之處在於其長期致力於單一導演研究，同時優先考慮挑戰傳統作者概念的創新方法。鑑於許鞍華拒絕「作者導演」的標籤及其所暗示的單一獨特風格，對作者身份的建構進行批判性反思在她身上尤為迫切。 「我在電影語言或技巧方面並沒有創新，」她堅持說，「我為不同的電影採用不同的風格。」然而，仔細審視許鞍華的作品，就會發現她對作者身份有著深刻而持久的迷戀——對文學素材的迷戀，例如她改編的現代小說家張愛玲的故事；對作家生平的迷戀，這啟發了她的紀錄片和故事；因此，本書以作者為概念視角，深入探討許鞍華的電影創作。它將透過對許鞍華電影製作的全面分析，填補現有文獻的空白，同時也將加深讀者對香港當代電影的理解。

17610626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610626.value: 以創新促協作：透過設計本位研究發展生成式人工智能支援的跨專業教育課程以培育未來醫療專業人員

17610626.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17610626.value: Prof Gašević, Dragan Prof King, Ronnel Bornasal Dr Ng, Davy Tsz Kit Prof Orlu, Mine Prof Whitehead, Cynthia Dr Xyrichis, Andreas

17610626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610626.value: Communication and collaboration failures contribute to 60-70% of preventable adverse events in healthcare globally, with Hong Kong's Hospital Authority documenting similar patterns linking communication deficits to sentinel events. While interprofessional education (IPE) has demonstrated effectiveness in developing collaborative skills, the healthcare sector’s accelerating integration of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) introduces unprecedented educational challenges. Existing GenAI applications in healthcare education emphasize individualized learning rather than team-based collaborative competencies, creating a disconnect between traditional IPE training and the AI-mediated teamwork environments students will encounter in clinical practice. Addressing this disconnect, the sequential two-phased project pursues four aims: (1) iteratively develop a GenAI-enabled IPE model, (2) implement its optimized version, (3) examine underlying mechanisms in Hong Kong and UK contexts, and (4) examine generalizability across educational contexts. Phase 1 implements design-based research incorporating quasi-experimental comparisons across three iterations using distinct clinical scenarios (Dementia, Depression, Cancer). Each iteration employs an independent cohort of 160 healthcare students from five disciplines, forming 10 interprofessional teams, randomly assigned to conditions comparing near-peer facilitation enhanced with ChatGPT (8 teams) against near-peer facilitation alone (8 teams; N=480 total across Phase 1). Mixed-methods evidence—combining pre-post competency measurements with stakeholder focus groups and interviews—drives systematic refinements between cycles, generating empirically-grounded design principles for GenAI integration. Phase 2 employs structural equation modeling with independent Hong Kong and UK cohorts (n=430 per location; 860 total) experiencing the refined intervention. Mediation analyses investigate whether AI tool usability, behavioral engagement, and emotional engagement transmit intervention effects on collaborative competencies. Moderation analyses examine AI literacy as a contextual factor influencing student responsiveness. Conducting parallel analyses across both sites examines whether findings generalize across different educational contexts. The research yields implementable frameworks for integrating GenAI into interprofessional training, simultaneously strengthening current team-based competencies while developing AI collaboration capabilities essential for technology-integrated healthcare environments. Beyond healthcare education, these design principles inform human-AI collaboration training in high-stakes team environments where effective coordination between professionals and AI systems is increasingly critical. 全球醫療服務中，溝通及協作失誤佔可預防不良醫療事件的60%至70%；香港醫院管理局的資料亦顯示類似情況，指出溝通不足與醫療風險警示事件相關。雖然跨專業教育（interprofessional education, IPE）已證實有助培養協作能力，但隨着醫療界加速整合生成式人工智能（generative artificial intelligence, GenAI），教育亦面對前所未有的挑戰。現有GenAI在醫療教育中的應用主要着重個人化學習，而非以團隊為本的協作能力，令傳統IPE培訓與學生未來在臨床實務中將面對的人工智能支援團隊協作環境之間出現落差。 為回應這一落差，本研究採用循序進行的兩階段設計，並有四項研究目標：（1）透過反覆迭代發展GenAI支援的IPE模式；（2）實施經優化的模式；（3）探討該模式在香港及英國情境下的作用機制；以及（4）檢視研究結果在不同教育情境下的可推廣性。第一階段採用設計本位研究，透過三輪迭代，分別使用不同的臨床情境，包括認知障礙症、抑鬱症及癌症，進行準實驗比較。每輪均採用一組獨立樣本，包括來自五個專業的160名醫療及健康專業學生，組成10個跨專業團隊，並隨機分配至兩種條件，比較結合ChatGPT的近同儕引導（8隊）與僅採用近同儕引導（8隊；第一階段總樣本數N=480）。研究將結合介入前後的能力評估，以及持份者焦點小組和訪談所得的混合方法證據，作為每輪之間進行系統性優化的依據，從而建立以實證為基礎的GenAI整合設計原則。 第二階段將在香港及英國分別採用獨立樣本（每地n=430；總樣本數為860），參與經優化的介入，並以結構方程模型進行分析。中介分析將探討人工智能工具的可用性、行為投入及情緒投入，是否中介介入對協作能力的影響；調節分析則檢視人工智能素養是否作為情境因素，影響學生對介入的反應。研究將在香港及英國兩地進行平行分析，以檢視研究結果能否推廣至不同的教育情境。 本研究將建立可實際應用的GenAI融入跨專業培訓框架，在強化現有團隊協作能力的同時，培養學生在科技整合醫療環境中所需的與人工智能協作能力。研究所得的設計原則亦可延伸至醫療教育以外的高風險團隊環境，為專業人員與人工智能系統之間日益重要的有效協調及人機協作培訓提供指引。

17611326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611326.value: 人工智能与债务调解：一项田野实验

17611326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611326.value: Can artificial intelligence (AI) improve legal practice? AI has already generated significant research interest in the field of law. However, few studies have examined whether AI assistance actually impacts legal practice in real-world settings, or through what mechanisms such impact occurs. This project addresses these questions in the context of debt mediation, using an experimental design embedded in actual practice. Specifically, I will partner with a mediation agency in China to develop and deploy a machine learning algorithm that predicts the likelihood of successful settlement for each mediation case. In half of the cases, randomly assigned, mediators will receive the AI-predicted probability of mediation success. To prepare for this project, I have already built an algorithm using real data from the agency, and it has demonstrated strong predictive power. This study aims to answer two main questions: 1. Does AI assistance improve mediation outcomes? Specifically, do cases assisted by AI achieve higher settlement rates and recovery amounts compared to cases without AI input? 2. What mechanisms drive any observed improvements? Predictive AI could influence mediators in several ways. I will test and measure the relative importance of the following potential mechanisms: i) Effect on Mediation Strategy and Efficiency: With AI predictions, mediators are better informed about each case's prospects and can tailor their strategies accordingly. Efficiency of mediation may also be improved. I will examine mediation strategies and efficiency at scale using novel measurements enabled by advanced language models. ii) Nudging Effect: AI predictions may prompt mediators to increase their efforts. iii) Better Time Allocation: With AI input, mediators may allocate their time more strategically, focusing more on cases with higher predicted success. This will be measured by assessing whether the impact of AI on call frequency and communication time varies with the AI-predicted probabilities. By way of background, debt collection litigation places a tremendous strain on judicial systems worldwide. Over 25% of civil lawsuits in U.S. state courts involve consumer debt collection, and in China, small loan disputes account for 20–25% of all civil cases. This overwhelming caseload limits judges’ capacity to address each case thoroughly, making alternative dispute resolution methods—such as debt mediation—an essential strategy for judicial relief. Understanding the real-world effects of AI assistance in debt mediation will offer valuable insights for both behavioral theories and legal practice, with broad implications for the adoption of AI in justice systems globally. 人工智能（AI）能否改善法律实践？ 人工智能已经在法学领域引发了广泛的研究兴趣。然而，现有研究较少考察 AI 辅助是否会在真实场景中实际影响法律实践，以及这种影响是通过何种机制产生的。本项目将在债务调解的语境下回答这些问题，并采用嵌入真实业务流程的实验设计。 具体而言，我将与中国的一家调解机构合作，开发并部署一套机器学习算法，用于预测每一起调解案件成功达成和解的概率。在随机分配的一半案件中，调解员将收到由 AI 生成的调解成功概率。为筹备本项目，我已经使用该机构的真实数据搭建了该算法，并且该算法已展现出较强的预测能力。 本研究旨在回答两个主要问题： 第一，AI 辅助是否能够改善调解结果？ 具体而言，与没有 AI 输入的案件相比，接受 AI 辅助的案件是否具有更高的和解率和更高的回款金额？ 第二，如果观察到改善，其背后的作用机制是什么？ AI 可能通过多种方式影响调解员。本研究将检验并衡量以下几种潜在机制的相对重要性： 1、对调解策略和效率的影响： 在获得 AI 预测结果后，调解员能够更充分地了解每个案件的成功前景，并据此调整调解策略。效率将通过以下指标衡量：（a）单位沟通时间内的和解成功率；以及（b）单位沟通时间内的回款金额。 2、助推效应： AI 预测可能促使调解员投入更多努力。该机制将通过以下指标衡量：（a）处理每个案件时拨打更多电话；以及（b）实验组中每个案件的沟通时间更长。 3、更优的时间分配： 在 AI 输入的帮助下，调解员可能会更有策略地分配时间，将更多精力投入到 AI 预测成功概率较高的案件中。该机制将通过考察 AI 对通话频次和沟通时间的影响是否会随着 AI 预测成功概率的变化而变化来衡量。 作为研究背景， 债务催收诉讼给世界各地的司法系统都带来了巨大压力。在美国州法院，超过四分之一的民事诉讼涉及消费者债务催收；在中国，小额金融借款纠纷占全部民事案件的 20% 至 25%。如此沉重的案件负担限制了法官充分处理每一起案件的能力，因此，以债务调解为代表的替代性纠纷解决机制，已成为缓解司法压力的一项重要策略。

17611426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611426.value: 支持香港學生學術詞彙學習成果：一項結合語料庫詞彙表、人工智慧生成文本集以及詞彙研究、資源和教學法專業發展的干預研究

17611426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611426.value: Academic vocabulary is fundamental for K-12 students and academic success (Coxhead, 2000; Hiebert, 2020). The HK EdB emphasizes Academic English as critical for across the curriculum; Yet locally and internationally, there is limited research to guide teachers, policymakers, and training on effective pedagogies, especially in multilingual contexts like Hong Kong. While high-quality corpus-derived wordlists exist, few studies have taken them into classrooms, integrated them into research-based pedagogies, and measured student outcomes (Dang & Webb, 2025). Although interventions are not the only form of educational evidence, they are increasingly valued in policy and teacher-training debates, with (quasi-)experimental data often prioritized (Hattie, 2023; Shanahan, 2020). This proposed 24‑month, quasi-experimental project targets Grades 6–8 in five schools, led by an international team. It will deliver a scalable academic vocabulary intervention, trialing AI’s generative capacity to produce texts contextualizing vocabulary from corpus-informed wordlists. A persistent challenge in translating corpus wordlists into practice is the risk of decontextualized instruction (Beck et al., 2013). Embedding target words in authentic contexts is difficult for teachers (Dang & Webb, 2025). This study will address that by generating texts that contextualize vocabulary and build curriculum content knowledge, while teaching core elements such as morphology (Lawrence et al., 2017). The PI’s prior GRF project developed a Hong Kong-specific vocabulary database with rich morphological data, but its classroom impact remains untested, and the current proposal further maximizes that funding's impact. The intervention -GAIN (Gen‑AI for Academic vocabulary Instruction)- comprises four 20‑minute sessions per cycle, 22 cycles over a year (McKeown et al., 2018). Each cycle targets five academic words, embedded in AI‑generated texts to: (1) contextualize learning; (2) develop morphological awareness; (3) build lexical connections; and (4) support fluency. Drawing on current, research-informed pedagogical frameworks and theory, GAIN aims to build students’ ability to acquire words through understanding word parts, connections, context, and background knowledge. Outcomes will be measured using the Vocabulary Knowledge Scale, Academic Vocabulary Test, Woodcock Passage Comprehension, and Metacognitive Vocabulary Learning Questionnaires, with pre‑, post‑, and delayed post‑tests analyzed via latent growth modeling. Qualitative data from interviews and lesson artifacts will undergo content analysis. By applying corpus-based lists through AI‑generated contextualization, this project addresses a critical gap and, if funded, will yield a scalable, low‑cost pedagogy for Hong Kong and internationally. 學術詞彙對中小學生至關重要。香港教育局已將學術英語認定為學生在各學科學習中取得成功的關鍵。然而，無論在本地或國際上，我們缺乏足夠的研究來指導教師、政策制定和教師培訓，尤其是在香港學校等多語言環境下，如何運用有效的教學方法。雖然具有可衡量結果的干預措施並非唯一重要的教育證據，但此類證據的需求卻十分迫切：循證實踐在圍繞政策、教學和教師培訓的討論中日益佔據核心地位，而（準）實驗數據通常備受重視。我們有機會建立一個具有國際意義的本地學術詞彙教學證據庫。該計畫為期24個月，採用準實驗設計，重點在於五所中小學校的6-8年級過渡階段學生，並由國際專家團隊參與。該研究是一項多組分的學術詞彙幹預措施，旨在實現規模化和影響力。本研究創新地嘗試利用人工智慧的生成能力，從語料庫詞彙表中產生能夠將學術詞彙融入脈絡的文本。在將基於語料庫的詞彙表應用於實踐的過程中，一直存在著研究成果轉化成實際應用的難題，人們擔心這些詞彙表可能會導致脫離語境的詞彙教學。這些詞彙表中的詞彙固然重要，但如何將它們融入有意義的脈絡一直是教師面臨的挑戰。我們提出一個解決方案：產生能夠將目標詞彙融入語境的文本，從而在建構課程內容知識的同時，促進詞法等學術詞彙核心要素的教學。 這項介入措施，我們稱之為GAIN（用於學術詞彙教學的人工智慧生成系統），要求教師在每個週期內進行四次20分鐘的詞彙課（一年共22個週期）。每個週期針對語料庫詞彙表的五個學術詞彙。在四次課中，這些詞彙被嵌入到人工智慧生成的文本中，旨在：1）將教學內容融入課程內容；2）培養詞法意識；3）建立與相關詞彙的聯繫；4）提升流利度並進行複習。 GAIN 課程包含對詞義、策略、詞法和語義聯繫的直接教學；討論；多次接觸以及人工智慧生成的文本，這些都為課程內容提供了脈絡和複習機會。

17611926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611926.value: Humility and self-confidence seem to have a paradoxical relationship. Humility and self-confidence both appear vital to constructive engagement with others, yet they also seem to be directly opposed. This issue, which I refer to as the ‘humility/confidence paradox’, raises the question of why and how to value humility and/or confidence in ourselves or in others in schools and other settings. Despite a bourgeoning global literature on humility and self-confidence in philosophy, psychology, and education, little agreement is found within or across fields about what they are: Are they virtues, dispositions, attitudes, or beliefs? Many accounts focus on either humility or self-confidence but do not consider how they relate to each other. In addition, many contend that the value of humility and self-confidence is context-dependent. That is, they argue that their appropriateness should be judged based on the context: for example, one’s social role and status, cultural considerations, potential consequences, the extent of one’s knowledge, or one’s capacity for self-evaluation. However, considering such factors makes it difficult, if not impossible, to generalize about what makes these traits good versus when they go too far. These academic disputes ultimately give us no guidance on why or how we should cultivate or promote humility or self-confidence in education and society. This project will develop and defend a novel, practice-oriented account of humility and self-confidence and their value in education and other social settings. Through examining relevant real-world examples, I will argue for a context-independent (or inclusive) conception of humility and confidence after contending with major objections. I further articulate humility and confidence as intertwined dispositions toward personal and social practices rather than as virtues involving belief or approaches to belief. This practice-oriented account uncovers a positive educational and social role for some postures that are usually problematized in Western thought, such as imposter syndrome, false modesty, and strategic ignorance. It also provides constructive responses to cross-cultural dilemmas related to confidence and humility as well as concerns about virtue signalling and grandstanding. The project will result in a scholarly book on the humility/confidence paradox and its significance in schools and other settings. 在谦逊与自信之间似乎存在着一种悖论式的矛盾关系。此二者对于与他人进行建设性地互动都至关重要，但它们却又看似截然对立。这一问题，我将其称之为 “谦逊/自信悖论” (humility/confidence paradox)，引发了如下问题：在学校以及其他场景中，我们为何重视谦逊和/或自信的价值，以及如何重视它们。 尽管在全球范围内的哲学、心理学、教育学领域中，关注谦逊和自信的研究文献日益增多，但这些领域内部和跨学科之间对于它们究竟是什么少有共识：它们究竟是美德 (virtues)，性情倾向 (dispositions)，态度 (attitudes)，或是信念 (beliefs)？并且许多论述要么专注于谦逊，要么专注于自信，却未能考虑此二者之间如何彼此关联。此外，许多人认为，谦逊与自信的价值有赖于语境，即他们主张谦逊与自信的恰当性应当基于具体的情境才能得以判断：譬如，一个人的社会角色与地位、文化因素、潜在后果、个人的知识水平和自我评估的能力。然而，在考虑到这些因素的情况下，要对“什么使得谦逊与自信是好的特质”以及“什么使得谦逊与自信过犹不及”作出概括性的论述，即便并非全无可能，也是十分困难的。因此，这些学术论争最终也未能为我们提供指导，说明为何或如何在教育与社会中培养或促进谦逊或自信。 本研究项目将发展并捍卫一种新颖的、以实践为导向的谦逊和自信的论述，以及它们在教育及其他社会情境中的价值。通过对相关现实世界案例的考察，并且在回应了主要的一些反对意见之后，我将论证一种具有情境独立性 (context-independent) 或曰情境包容性 (context-inclusive) 的谦逊与自信的概念。我将进一步把谦逊与自信阐释为一组内在联结的性情倾向，指向个人与社会实践，而非涉及信念或信念方法的美德。这一实践导向的论述将揭示出，那些在西方思想中被视为有问题的一些姿态实际上具有积极的教育与社会作用，例如冒名顶替综合症 (imposter syndrome)、虚伪谦虚 (false modesty)与策略性无知 (strategic ignorance)。本项目还对与谦虚和自信相关的跨文化困境，以及与美德表演 (virtue signaling)和哗众取宠(grandstanding)相关的担忧，提供了建设性的回应。本项目的成果将最终形成一本学术专著，探讨谦逊/自信悖论以及它在学校以及其他场景中的意义。

17612026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17612026.value: 利用多模態遙感與基礎模型提升高層緊密型沿海城市高分辨率不透水面提取

17612026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17612026.value: Prof Gamba, Paolo Prof Zhang, Yongjun

17612026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17612026.value: Accurate mapping of fine-resolution urban impervious surfaces (UIS), such as roads, buildings, and port facilities, is critical in environmental monitoring and disaster management for the resilient and sustainable urban development. As one of the world’s most dynamic coastal megacities, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) houses over 86 million people, hosting three of the world’s top ten container ports, and contributes more than one-third of China’s exports. However, mapping reliable UIS in this region remains highly challenging due to its subtropical climate, dense and vertical urban forms, and complex coastal settings. Persistent cloud cover limits optical satellite observations, while shadows from skyscrapers, ports, and compact city centers create spectral confusions from optical data and scattering confusions from synthetic aperture radar (SAR), where similar materials such as concrete, asphalt, and container surfaces exhibit confusing signals. These issues lead to significant uncertainties in UIS estimation using single-source remote sensing technologies. To overcome these limitations, the project aims to develop a novel fine-resolution UIS estimation framework by synergistically integrating multimodal optical and SAR satellite data based on the remote sensing foundation model in coastal cities in GBA. First, we will systematically analyze the spectral confusion mechanisms from optical data and scattering confusion mechanisms from SAR data of typical land covers in high-rise compact coastal cities. Second, we will develop a novel framework that synergistically integrates optical and SAR data by a multimodal foundation model with a complex-valued Transformer network. This framework is designed to exploit the complementary strengths of spectral and scattering features to overcome urban land cover confusions in high-rise compact coastal cities. The expected outcomes of this research include: 1) A formalized spectral-scattering mechanism of comprehensive coastal land cover confusions and its scale effects for UIS mapping in high-rise compact coastal cities; 2) An accurate fine-resolution UIS products in the GBA using innovative and scalable multimodal foundation model. The fine-resolution UIS dataset can further support coastal infrastructure management and sustainable urban planning in the coastal cities of GBA. Beyond the GBA, the advanced foundation model can be transferred to UIS mapping in other coastal cities facing similar challenges. 準確提取高分辨率城市不透水面（UIS），如道路、建築物及港口設施，對於韌性與可持續城市發展中的環境監測與災害管理至關重要。粵港澳大灣區（GBA）是全球最具活力的沿海特大城市群之一，人口逾8,600萬，擁有全球前十大集裝箱港口中的三個，貢獻中國逾三分之一的出口額。然而，受亞熱帶氣候、高密度垂直城市形態及複雜海岸環境影響，該地區的UIS精準製圖極具挑戰。持續雲覆蓋限制了光學衛星觀測；摩天大樓、港口及緊密城市中心產生的陰影，導致光學數據的光譜混淆及合成孔徑雷達（SAR）數據的散射混淆——混凝土、瀝青及貨櫃等材質呈現相近信號，令單一數據源的UIS估算存在顯著不確定性。為此，本項目旨在基於遙感基礎模型，協同融合多模態光學與SAR衛星數據，構建適用於GBA沿海城市的高解析度UIS估算新框架。首先，系統分析高層緊密型沿海城市典型地物的光譜混淆機制與SAR散射混淆機制；其次，利用融合複值Transformer網絡的多模態基礎模型，協同整合光學與SAR數據，充分挖掘光譜與散射特徵的互補優勢，以克服地物分類混淆問題。

17613026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613026.value: 社会福利安全网：东亚和西方的最低收入保障政策对比研究

17613026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613026.value: Prof Aya , Abe Dr Chang, Yu-Ling Dr Kang, Ji Young Prof Ku, Inhoe Dr Marchal , Sarah Dr Natili , Marcello Prof Ng, Irene Y.H. Dr Wang, Julia Shu-Huah Dr Zhao, Xi

17613026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613026.value: Minimum income protection (MIP) schemes provide the last resort for the poor, serving as a cornerstone of the welfare state. Societies exhibit similarities and differences in their approaches to delivering MIP. Emerging comparative studies classify different types of MIP based on their characteristics to grasp a comprehensive picture of the last-resort safety net. Much of the existing literature is focused on Western countries, leaving the rest of the world largely unexplored and limiting our understanding of diversity in MIP. This project aims to expand the MIP comparison by incorporating East Asian societies. East Asia’s welfare model possesses two unique aspects that can enrich the current comparative study of MIP. Influenced by Confucian values, East Asian societies culturally tend to emphasize family as a source of help. Another feature is its ‘productivism,’ subordinating social concerns to economic considerations when formulating social policies. In the context of MIP, the stringency of familial obligations influences the extent to which family duties should be fulfilled before individuals living in poverty can seek government support. Preference towards productive elements can be demonstrated through the features of Active Labor Market Policies (ALMP). These policies aim to incentivize able-bodied MIP beneficiaries to integrate into the workforce. It is intriguing to explore whether and how the inclusion of East Asia might reshape the typology of MIP. This project aims to answer two research questions: 1) What are the typologies of MIP in East Asian and Western societies? 2) Is there a unique East Asian MIP model that is distinct from Western countries? For example, do East Asian societies tend to be more familistic or adopt a specific type of ALMP? We will use fuzzy set ideal type analysis to compare four dimensions of MIP—coverage, generosity, family obligation, and ALMP—in eleven societies, six from East Asia (Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong SAR, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan) and five Western countries (Denmark, Germany, Italy, the UK, and the US). The four dimensions lead to sixteen combinations of ideal types, which are further clustered into eight theoretically relevant types of MIP. This project advances the conceptualization and development of comparative MIP studies by expanding the scope (e.g., including East Asian societies), dimensions (e.g., family obligation), and timeframe of comparison (e.g., data in 2026). An enhanced typology study lays the foundation for future studies to examine MIP’s shaping forces and effects. 最低收入保障计划为贫困群体构筑了最后一道安全网。不同社会在制度设计和运作方式上既有共通之处，也呈现出显著差异。新兴的比较研究试图根据其制度特征对最低收入保障进行类型学划分，以更全面地把握各地安全网的整体面貌。然而，现有文献多聚焦于西方国家，对世界其他地区的关注相对不足，从而限制了我们对最低收入保障制度多样性的深入理解。本研究试图将东亚社会纳入比较框架，以拓展既有研究的视野。 东亚福利模式具有两个独特面向，有望丰富当前最低收入保障的比较研究。其一，受儒家文化影响，东亚社会普遍重视家庭在福利供给中的角色，倾向于将家庭视为首要求助对象。其二，这一区域呈现出鲜明的“生产主义”取向。在最低收入保障的语境下，家庭义务的严格程度直接塑造了个体在寻求政府援助之前所需承担的责任边界。与此同时，对生产性要素的偏好，则鲜明地体现在积极劳动力市场政策的制度设计之中。由此引出一个值得深入探讨的问题：东亚经验是否以及如何重塑现有的最低收入保障类型学？ 本研究旨在回应两个核心问题：第一，东亚与西方社会的最低收入保障呈现出怎样的类型学特征？第二，是否存在一种区别于西方的、独特的东亚最低收入保障模式？具体而言，东亚社会是否更倾向于家庭主义取向，或在积极劳动力市场政策上呈现出特定类型？我们将采用模糊集理想型分析法，对十一个社会的四项核心维度——覆盖范围、慷慨度、家庭义务及积极劳动力市场政策——进行比较。这十一个社会涵盖六个东亚社会及五个西方国家。 通过拓展比较的地理范围（纳入东亚社会）、丰富分析维度（纳入家庭义务）及更新比较的时间框架（以2026年为基准），本研究力求推进最低收入保障比较研究的概念建构与理论发展。一项更系统、更具包容性的类型学研究，将为后续探讨最低收入保障制度的形成机制及其社会效应奠定坚实基础。

17613426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613426.value: 母乳中的晝夜節律：連結母親身心健康與嬰兒睡眠的途徑

17613426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613426.value: Dr Hui, Amelia P.W. Ms Lin, Yan Prof Liu, Jianghong Prof Lok, Kris Yuet Wan

17613426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613426.value: Sleep problems affect 20%–30% of infants worldwide and often persist into later childhood, contributing to emotional, behavioral, and cognitive difficulties. Maternal mental health and sleep quality are key determinants of infant sleep, yet the biological mechanisms underlying these associations remain unclear. This study investigates human milk melatonin as a potential biological pathway linking maternal wellbeing to infant sleep regulation. Human milk contains hormones that follow daily rhythms, with melatonin peaking at night and absent during the day. Because infants cannot produce melatonin in early life, they rely on external cues to support circadian development and sleep consolidation. Emerging evidence suggests that maternal stress and sleep disruption can alter hormonal profiles, raising the possibility that maternal distress disrupts milk melatonin rhythms. Critically, approximately 17% of mothers experience postpartum depressive symptoms, and 35%–75% report poor sleep. Given the co-occurrence of maternal mental health problems and poor sleep—both of which can alter milk composition—downstream effects on infant sleep are plausible. Modern feeding practices, such as expressing milk during the day and feeding it at night, may compound these disruptions by misaligning milk intake with infants' circadian needs. Our preliminary data indicate that maternal mental health and sleep problems predict subsequent child sleep difficulties, but whether disrupted milk melatonin rhythms mediate this relationship remains unknown. We propose a longitudinal study of 360 mother–infant dyads from late pregnancy through three months postpartum to examine the interplay among maternal depressive symptoms, maternal sleep quality, milk melatonin rhythmicity, and infant sleep outcomes. Using advanced longitudinal modeling, we will explore infant sleep development trajectory, test whether human milk melatonin alteration mediate the relationship between maternal wellbeing (depression and poor sleep) and infant sleep problems. Reciprocal effects of infant sleep disturbances on maternal wellbeing will also be examined to clarify bidirectional processes. This project innovatively integrates psychological, behavioral, and biological factors within a unified framework, emphasizing chrono-nutrition in breastfeeding. Findings will provide the first comprehensive evidence on biological pathways linking maternal mental health, milk composition, and infant sleep. Results will inform evidence-based guidelines for milk expression and feeding timing and support early identification of high-risk dyads. By shifting from symptom management to pathway-based prevention, this research has potential to enhance maternal recovery, infant development, and family wellbeing while informing public health strategies. 全球約有 20%–30% 的嬰兒受到睡眠問題影響，而這些問題往往會持續至兒童後期，並可能導致情緒、行為及認知方面的困難。母親的心理健康和睡眠質素是影響嬰兒睡眠的重要因素，但其背後的生物學機制仍未明確。本研究將探討母乳中的褪黑激素是否為連結母親身心健康與嬰兒睡眠調節的潛在生物學途徑。 母乳含有呈現每日節律變化的荷爾蒙，其中褪黑激素濃度在夜間達到高峰，而在日間幾乎無法檢測。由於嬰兒在生命早期尚未能自行產生褪黑激素，因此需要依賴外在訊號，以促進晝夜節律的發展及睡眠的鞏固。新近證據顯示，母親的壓力及睡眠受擾可能改變其荷爾蒙分泌模式，因此母親的心理困擾可能會擾亂母乳中的褪黑激素節律。 值得注意的是，約有 17% 的母親出現產後抑鬱症狀，而 35%–75% 的母親表示睡眠質素欠佳。鑑於母親的心理健康問題與睡眠欠佳經常同時出現，而兩者均可能改變母乳成分，因此對嬰兒睡眠產生後續影響是合理且值得關注的。現代餵哺方式，例如在日間擠出母乳並於夜間餵哺，亦可能令母乳攝取時間與嬰兒的晝夜節律需要不一致，從而進一步加劇有關影響。 我們的初步數據顯示，母親的心理健康及睡眠問題可預測其後出現的兒童睡眠困難；然而，母乳褪黑激素節律受擾是否在此關係中發揮中介作用，目前仍未清楚。我們擬開展一項縱向研究，招募 360 對母嬰，並由妊娠後期追蹤至產後三個月，以探討母親抑鬱症狀、母親睡眠質素、母乳褪黑激素節律性與嬰兒睡眠結果之間的相互關係。 本研究將採用先進的縱向統計模型，探討嬰兒睡眠的發展軌跡，並檢驗母乳褪黑激素節律的改變是否在母親身心健康問題，包括抑鬱及睡眠欠佳，與嬰兒睡眠問題之間發揮中介作用。我們亦會分析嬰兒睡眠受擾對母親身心健康的反向影響，以釐清當中的雙向作用機制。 本項目具創新性地將心理、行為及生物學因素整合於一個統一框架之中，並強調母乳餵哺中的時間營養學概念。研究結果將首次提供全面證據，說明母親心理健康、母乳成分與嬰兒睡眠之間的生物學聯繫。研究亦將為母乳擠出及餵哺時間制定實證指引，並支援及早識別高風險母嬰組合。透過將研究重點由症狀管理轉向以生物學途徑為基礎的預防，本研究有望促進母親產後康復、嬰兒發展及家庭福祉，並為相關公共衞生策略提供依據。

17613526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613526.value: 教師教學輸入與學生聆聽策略的互動：探索內隱策略教學在以英語授課的科學課堂中的實踐

17613526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613526.value: Dr Chung, Hiu Yui Edsoulla Prof Lo, Yuen Yi Prof Macaro, Ernesto

17613526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613526.value: In English Medium Instruction (EMI) programmes, students learn content subjects (e.g. science) through English as their second or foreign language. Previous studies have found teacher talk to dominate in EMI classrooms, with students experiencing difficulties in comprehending teacher input. It is therefore essential to investigate how students can learn to listen using a range of listening strategies. For example, students can be taught how to infer the meaning of unfamiliar words, recall their prior knowledge, and monitor their understanding. However, EMI teachers are usually content subject experts, not language experts. It is thus unreasonable to assume that they would know how to explicitly teach students strategies. Situated in the state-of-the-art theory that students’ strategy use can be regulated or prompted by the teacher, this study proposes a novel perspective that teacher input can be regarded as implicit strategy instruction. For example, a teacher can break down a complicated word (e.g. biodiversity = bio+diversity) to prompt students in making inferences. The study will be divided into three phases. Phase I will involve the development of an intervention programme and a pilot study on two experienced EMI teachers and their students. Phase II will be a quasi-experimental study in two schools. In each school, following lesson observations, stimulated recall interviews with selected students, a pre-intervention questionnaire and a science quiz to establish a baseline, four classes of students (n=30 each) will participate in the programme. For Class 1, the PI will engage the school teachers in dialogic reflection and co-planning of a second unit of lessons, highlighting how the teacher can provide implicit strategy instruction through strategy-prompting input; Class 2 will receive explicit strategy instruction and take the second unit of lessons; Class 3 will receive both explicit and implicit strategy instruction; and Class 4 will serve as a control group, taking the unit of lessons in the usual way without any strategy instruction. All classes will complete a post-intervention strategy questionnaire and science quiz, and four students in each class will take part in stimulated recall interviews to measure the effectiveness of strategy instruction. Lesson videos will also be analysed to examine how teachers have changed their input provision. In Phase III, the findings will be evaluated to theorise the usefulness of implicit strategy instruction. The study will have important pedagogical implications regarding how EMI teachers can provide implicit strategy instruction, thereby guiding students to become more strategic learners. 在英語授課 (EMI)的課堂中，學生需要應用英語作為第二語言來學習不同學科（例如科學）的內容。過往研究發現在這些課堂中，教師話語常常佔據了課堂互動的大部份時間，而學生在聆聽理解老師話語的時候往往會遇到不少困難。因此，我們有必要研究學生怎樣透過學習應用不同的聆聽策略來幫助他們理解老師的教學。例如，我們可以教授學生如何根據上文下理猜測陌生單詞的含義，透過回顧先前的知識經驗幫助理解，又或自我評估有多理解老師的講話。然而，以英語授課(EMI)的專業學科老師一般都是個別學科的專家，而非英語專家。因此，假設他們懂得外顯策略教學，幫助學生學習聆聽策略並不合適。本研究立足於最先進的理論當中，指出學生的語言學習策略可以受教師的調節或促進，並基於此理論發展出一套新的觀點，把教師的教學輸入看作內隱策略教學。例如，一位老師可以將一個複雜的字詞分拆（例如生物多樣性 biodiversity 分拆為 bio 和 diversity），促進學生猜測此字詞的意思。 本研究分為三個階段。首先，在第一階段，研究團隊會制定一項干預研究的計劃和材料，並與兩名EMI科學教師和他們的學生做先導性研究。第二階段會在兩所學校開始推行干預研究。在每所學校，研究團隊會透過觀課，訪談，問卷和科學小測來找出學生科學學習的基線，然後在四個班別推行不同的教學。在班別一，研究員會跟科學老師進行對話反思，並與他們共同規劃下一個單元的課程，集中討論怎樣透過教學的話語和輸入給予學生內隱策略教學。班別二會接受外顯策略教學，讓學生學習應用不同的聆聽策略幫助他們理解老師的講話。班別三會同時接受內隱策略教學和外顯策略教學，而班別四是參照組別，只會如常上課。所有班別在這個單元的學習之後會完成一份問卷和科學小測。另外，每班別會有四名學生參與訪談。課堂錄影也會用作分析教師怎樣給予學生輸入。在第三階段，所有的研究成果會用作評估內隱策略教學的成效。 本研究的結果會對 EMI 教學提供重要的啟示，尤其是教師可以怎樣給予學生內隱策略教學，並幫助學生成為更具策略的學習者。

17613826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613826.value: 翻轉專家主導：邁向由下而上之科技倫理教育方案評估工具設計途徑

17613826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613826.value: Prof Datu, Jesus Alfonso Daep Prof HUANG, LINUS Prof Jackson, Liz

17613826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613826.value: How Computer Science (CS) professionals design technologies can gravely impact our individual and collective well-being. Algorithmic bias in hiring exacerbates employment inequities, while AI chatbots without fact-checking measures can lead to “AI hallucinations.” In response to these “tech-ethics” problems, academics and industry professionals call for teaching ethics to undergraduate and graduate students in Computer Science programs (e.g., Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence) so that they can integrate ethical considerations into technology design. Tech-ethics education, however, is complicated. Scholars disagree on its goals, content (what should be taught), and how to evaluate its effectiveness. Importantly, the goals, content, and evaluation should be interlinked, as evaluation instruments, such as the Socially Responsible Computing Readiness (SRCR) Scale, must be designed and aligned with the goals of tech-ethics education. The present project contributes to this scholarship by examining the SRCR Scale, a program evaluation instrument (in progress), drawing insights from individuals with industry experience. The project’s core innovation lies in expertise reversal: While the scholarship positions tech-ethics philosophers and researchers as educational experts (“top-down” approach), the present project challenges this assumption and treats those with industry experiences as experts of tech-ethics education (“bottom-up” approach). The project asks: What capacities – knowledge, skills, and dispositions – are needed to navigate tech-ethics problems in practice? What are the real-world ethical dilemmas that students need to learn about before entering the industry? If tech-ethics education is about preparing CS professionals who can engage in ethical technology design in the real world, tech-ethics education and its evaluation tool must be informed by such “on-the-ground” perspectives. The study is as follows: First, the PI plans to interview individuals with industry experience on what it takes to address ethical problems that arise from developing technologies. The PI will utilize the interview data to revise the SRCR Scale. Second, the project will disseminate a survey to examine the content validity of the revised SRCR Scale. Third, leveraging the interview data, the PI plans to design pilot Normative Case Studies (NCS), which present fictional stories that mirror real-world ethical problems faced by technology professionals, to produce a scenario-based tech-ethics reasoning skills test. These pilot NCS would lay the groundwork to examine the convergent validity of the SRCR Scale. 資訊科學（CS）專業人員設計科技的方式，會嚴重影響我們個人與集體的福祉。招募過程中的演算法偏見加劇了就業不平等，而缺乏事實查核機制的 AI 聊天機器人則可能導致「AI 幻覺」。為了因應這些「科技倫理」問題，學界與業界專業人士呼籲應向資訊科學相關系所（例如：人工智慧理學碩士班）的大學部與研究所學生教授倫理學，以便他們能將倫理考量融入科技設計之中。 然而，科技倫理教育相當複雜。學者們對其目標、內容（應該教什麼）以及如何評估其成效，至今仍存在分歧。重要的是，目標、內容與評估應環環相扣，因為像是「社會責任運算準備度量表」（Socially Responsible Computing Readiness Scale, 簡稱 SRCR 量表）這類的評估工具，其設計必須與科技倫理教育的目標相契合。 本計畫旨在檢視發展中的方案評估工具「SRCR 量表」，並從具備業界經驗的人士中汲取見解，以期對此學術領域做出貢獻。本計畫的核心創新之處在於專業反轉（expertise reversal）：現有學術研究多將科技倫理哲學家與研究人員定位為教育專家（即「由上而下」的方法），而本計畫則挑戰此預設，將具備業界經驗者視為科技倫理教育的專家（即「由下而上」的方法）。 本計畫提問：在實務上處理科技倫理問題需要哪些素養（包含知識、技能與意向）？學生在進入業界前，需要了解哪些真實世界的倫理困境？如果科技倫理教育的目的是培育能在真實世界中從事合乎倫理之科技設計的 CS 專業人員，那麼科技倫理教育及其評估工具，就必須建立在這些「第一線」（on-the-ground）視角的基礎上。 本研究步驟如下： 第一，計畫主持人（PI）計畫訪談具備業界經驗的人士，探討解決科技開發過程中所衍生之倫理問題所需的要素。計畫主持人將運用這些訪談資料來修訂 SRCR 量表。 第二，本計畫將發放問卷，以檢驗修訂後 SRCR 量表的內容效度（content validity）。 第三，計畫主持人計畫運用訪談資料，設計前導性的「規範案例研究」（Normative Case Studies, NCS）。這些案例將透過虛構故事來反映科技專業人員面臨之真實倫理問題，藉此發展出一套情境式的科技倫理推理技能測驗。這些前導性 NCS 將為檢驗 SRCR 量表的收斂效度（convergent validity）奠定基礎。

17614626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614626.value: 新的開始：香港男同志、父親身份與家庭實踐

17614626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614626.value: This research examines pathways and barriers to parenthood for gay fathers in Hong Kong. There has been a generational shift from gay men becoming parents through heterosexual marriages to gay parenthood through adoption, foster care, co-parenting with (often) lesbians, or surrogacy (altruistic/commercial; traditional/gestational). With access to adoption and foster care difficult for gay men, and co-parenting or altruistic surrogacy often complicated by custody issues, commercial gestational surrogacy has become the predominant pathway to fatherhood, despite costs and varying legality. Studies of pathways to parenthood for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and other sexual minorities (LGBTQ+) have primarily focused on lesbian mothers, though literature on gay fathers is growing. Despite increases in lesbians and gay men seeking alternative family formations in Hong Kong, few studies explore these journeys. This research aims to address this gap as one of the first sociological studies of gay fathers’ pathways to parenthood in Hong Kong, examining the process from initial planning to childcare, focusing on (1) the ‘becoming father’ transformative process by which gay men develop ‘procreative consciousnesses’ and actualise fatherhood; (2) family dynamics between gay co-fathers and natal family members, as well as interactions with wider social circles; and, when applicable, (3) the process of commercial surrogacy, particularly the labour process between gay fathers and female labourers (e.g., egg donors, surrogates). Situated in the sexual citizenship and doing family literatures and the queer reproductive justice framework, this research uses in-depth interviews with gay fathers (n=30) and other stakeholders (n=40) to engage with three debates: (1) the extent to which gay fatherhood represents a new definition of sexual citizenship and challenges traditional associations between homosexuality/childlessness, masculinity/femininity (the identity/citizenship debate); (2) the extent to which gay men’s pursuit of parenthood challenges or reinforces heteronormativity and patriarchy, as many practices are modelled on heterosexist nuclear family, contradicting queer ideals that disconnect intimacy from blood ties or reject reproduction (the queer family debate); (3) the extent to which pathways to gay fatherhood adhere to economic justice principles, particularly in commercial surrogacy where relationships may be equal or exploitative, given its class-specific and transnational nature (the labour debate). Contributing to the sociology of gender/sexuality, family, and labour, this research offers social and policy implications regarding sexual diversity, family equality, and social inclusion, with beneficiaries including LGBTQ+ individuals, families, and communities; the social welfare and education sectors; government; and the general public. 本研究探討香港男同志成為父親的途徑，以及他們在過程中遇到的困難。過往，不少男同志是在異性婚姻中成為父親；近年則有越來越多男同志透過其他方式建立家庭，包括領養、寄養、與女性（往往為女同志）共同育兒，以及代孕。由於男同志在香港申請領養或寄養並不容易，共同育兒和利他代孕亦可能涉及管養權等複雜問題，商業代孕（由代孕者懷胎）雖然費用高昂，而且在不同地方的法律地位不一，卻逐漸成為不少男同志實現父親身份的主要途徑。 雖然關注男同志父親的研究日漸增加，但有關同志人士如何成為父母的研究，仍主要集中於女同志母親。近年香港亦有越來越多女同志及男同志組織另類家庭，但這些歷程仍鮮有研究探討。本研究旨在填補這方面的空白，從社會學角度了解香港男同志如何計劃、實現和實踐父親身份，並考察由最初準備到照顧子女的整個過程。研究重點包括：第一，男同志如何逐步形成對生育和父親身份的想法，並把成為父親的願望付諸實行；第二，共同育兒的男同志父親之間、他們與原生家庭成員之間的家庭關係，以及他們與朋友、同事、學校和社會服務等更廣泛社交圈子的互動；第三，在涉及商業代孕的個案中，男同志父親如何與參與代孕過程的女性，例如卵子捐贈者和代孕者，建立關係和協調安排。 本研究將透過深入訪談，訪問男同志父親（n=30）及其他相關持份者（n=40），並關注三個主要問題。第一，男同志成為父親，如何改變社會對同性戀、男性身份和家庭角色的理解，以及性小眾作為公民的權利與認可。第二，男同志透過生育和育兒建立家庭，究竟是挑戰傳統異性戀家庭和男權觀念，還是某程度上延續這些觀念。第三，在商業代孕過程中，不同參與者之間的關係是否公平，尤其是當代孕涉及高昂費用、跨境安排和不同階層之間的資源差距時，相關女性的權益和保障如何得到重視。 本研究將有助社會更了解男同志父親和性小眾家庭的需要，並為性／別多元、家庭平等和社會共融提供政策參考。研究成果對同志人士、家庭及社群，社會福利和教育界，政府，以及社會大眾均有參考價值。 *「同志」一詞在此泛指女同性戀、男同性戀、雙性戀、跨性別、酷兒及其他性小眾。

17614826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614826.value: 香港創傷後壓力症的全生命週期概況：一項涵蓋 24 年全港性電子健康紀錄隊列的發病率、多重共病、服務使用與死亡率分析

17614826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17614826.value: Dr Chan, Kwun Nam Joe Prof Chang, Wing Chung Dr Ni, Michael Yuxuan Prof Sham, Pak-Chung

17614826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614826.value: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a mental disorder that can arise after experiencing or witnessing traumatic events and is associated with substantial distress, poorer physical health, and reduced life expectancy. In Hong Kong, repeated population-level stressors—such as social unrest and epidemics—suggest a greater and more complex PTSD burden than previously recognised. Yet most existing research focuses on specific groups, provides only snapshots in time, or uses designs poorly suited to tracing long-term trajectories. There is limited information on age- and period-specific incidence, on when and how physical and mental disorders co-occur, and on how PTSD shapes healthcare use and the risk of serious outcomes such as self-harm, suicide, and death. This study addresses these gaps by analysing territory-wide, real-time electronic health records spanning 24 years (2002–2025). We will estimate the incidence of newly diagnosed PTSD overall, by age group, and across periods, profile clinically defined multimorbidity of physical and mental disorders across the lifespan, and examine diagnostic conversion from incident PTSD to severe mental disorders such as schizophrenia or bipolar disorder. We will also evaluate mental health service utilisation (out-patient clinic visits, emergency attendances, hospital admissions, and use of allied health services), risks of adverse events (self-harm and suicide attempts), and short- and long-term mortality (all-cause and cause-specific). All individuals aged 16 years or older who attended specialist out-patient clinics, general out-patient clinics, accident and emergency departments, or were admitted to hospitals between 1 January 2002 and 31 December 2025 will be eligible. PTSD, mental, and physical disorders will be identified using International Classification of Diseases codes. The first recorded PTSD code will define the person’s first-ever (incident) diagnosis. To clarify PTSD-specific risks, we will use a matched, population-based cohort design with two comparators: age- and sex-matched individuals from the general population without recorded mental disorders, and people with first-diagnosed anxiety disorders other than PTSD. The study will deliver the first territory-wide estimates of PTSD incidence in Hong Kong over 24 years, including age- and period-specific trends during social unrest and epidemics, and a comprehensive profile of physical–mental multimorbidity, service utilisation, adverse outcomes, and mortality. The findings will provide a real-world view of clinically diagnosed PTSD, identify high-risk periods and subgroups across the lifespan, and inform targeted prevention, integrated care pathways, surge planning, and resource allocation to improve continuity of care, thereby strengthening population mental health in Hong Kong.

17615126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615126.value: 地緣政治與經濟發展的戰略平衡：大國競爭背景下美國各州如何調整其對華政策及其對香港特別行政區的啟示

17615126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615126.value: The proposed study seeks to enrich the existing literature on sub-national diplomacy, generally referred to in academic literature as “the involvement of the constituent units (regions) of national states in international affairs”, and to provide practical advice for the Hong Kong S.A.R. government in promoting regional and national interest. Studying sub-national policies targeting China in the state governments of the U.S. over the past decade, this research project compares sub-national diplomacy in the age of globalization and in the present era of geopolitical rivalry, revealing the evolution of policy motivations, actors, and mechanisms. The findings will also offer policy-relevant guidance for the Hong Kong S.A.R.’s external engagement in an era of heightened geopolitical complexity. According to existing literature, sub-national diplomacy emerged alongside the development of globalization. Domestic decentralization and international liberalization of economies around the turn of the 21st century led to the emergence of sub-national actors in international affair. In today’s world, geopolitical tensions have reshaped the global order and the pretext for the previous pattern of sub-national diplomacy has significantly subsided. Provinces, regions, and cities increasingly find themselves drawn into the “whole government approach” in great power competition. While previous studies have documented the U.S. and European countries’ policy shifts towards China on the sub-national level, the policy mechanisms of how these shifts took place remains to be explored. Without a clear understanding of the key actors in the political systems and how they transpired to push for policy change, the policy shifts can easily be attributed to overall worsening of bilateral relationships between China and the West with little insight. Furthermore, in a federalist political system such as the U.S., studying the interplay between state governments and the federal government on foreign relations could reveal novel understanding of the policy diffusion dynamics. The intergovernmental policy diffusion framework could also be applied to other important fields such as AI regulation or climate governance, contributing to the understanding of American public policy process in today’s polarized political climate. 「次國家外交」在既有研究中通常被界定為「民族國家的組成單位（地區）參與國際事務」。本研究亦旨在豐富有關次國家外交的既有文獻,並為香港特別行政區政府在促進區域發展與國家利益方面提供實務建議。透過研究過去十年間美國州議會涉華法案，本研究將比較全球化時代與當前地緣政治競爭加劇時期的次國家外交行為，並且試圖揭示其政策動機與運作機制的演變。本研究發現亦將為香港特別行政區提供政策建議，幫助特區政府在地緣政治複雜性日益加劇的時代更好開展對外交流合作。 二十一世紀之交，國家內部的分權與國際經濟自由化共同促成了次國家行動者參與國際事務。當今世界，地緣政治緊張局勢正重塑全球秩序，而此前支撐次國家外交模式的前提已顯著減弱。省、州、地區與城市日益被納入大國競爭中的「全政府戰略」之中。 既有研究雖已提到美國及歐洲國家在次國家層面對華政策的轉向，但政策轉向的機制仍有待進一步探討。若未能清楚理解政策轉向中的關鍵行動者及其動機，相關政策轉向便容易被籠統歸因於中國與西方關係的整體惡化，而難以產生更具分析深度的洞見。 此外，在美國這類聯邦制政體中，研究州政府與聯邦政府在對外關係上的互動，有助於揭示聯邦制中政策擴散的新動態。政府間政策擴散框架亦可應用於例如人工智能政策或氣候治理等其他重要領域，從而有助於理解當今政治極化氣候下的美國公共政策過程。

17615526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615526.value: 運動零食改善輕度認知障礙老年人認知表現之務實性隨機對照試驗

17615526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17615526.value: Prof Cheng, Calvin Pak-Wing Dr Fong, Daniel Yee-Tak Prof Gibala, Martin Prof Sit, Cindy Hui-ping

17615526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615526.value: Cognitive decline is a growing public health concern. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is the pre-clinical stage preceding early dementia, characterized by deficits in one or multiple cognitive domains beyond normal aging. MCI is the critical time frame for early intervention to prevent deterioration into dementia. Exercise are widely endorsed to promote healthy aging and reduce cognitive decline risk, yet specific exercise recommendations for MCI remain undefined. Recent epidemiological studies reveal a dose–response benefit for vigorous-intensity, but not moderate-intensity, physical activity, linking it to reduced Alzheimer’s disease-related mortality, particularly when undertaken in short bursts of 1–2 minutes. These studies also suggest optimal risk reduction at the amounts of vigorous physical activity recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO). The concept of exercise snacks—brief, purposeful bouts of vigorous exercise spread across the day—is emerging as a promising way to deliver the WHO physical activity recommendations, because it offers flexibility, which mitigates time and logistical barriers, and enhances convenience and adherence by embedding exercise into everyday settings. Nonetheless, the effectiveness of exercise snacks for combating cognitive decline is unexplored, especially in real-world settings. The proposed project will directly compare exercise snacks and community-based exercise to address the question: Do exercise snacks induce equivalent cognitive benefits relative to community-based exercise at a matched weekly exercise duration, and can both interventions improve cognitive performance compared to usual care in adults with MCI? We will conduct a robust three-group pragmatic randomized controlled trial with a pretest–posttest design. Older adults with MCI will be randomly allocated to exercise snacks group, community-based exercise group, or usual care control group. Each intervention group will receive a 12-month exercise intervention accumulating 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity exercise weekly, either via exercise snacks (five bouts of ~2 minutes daily) or supervised group exercise (three 25-minute sessions weekly), whereas the usual care group will receive a health education session. Outcome measures, including cognitive performance measured using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment, mental health, cardiorespiratory fitness, intervention adherence, health-related quality of life, medication usage, adverse events, and habitual physical activity, will be examined by assessors blinded to the group allocation at baseline, 12 months (postintervention), and 24 months (12-month postintervention follow-up). Data will be analyzed using generalized estimating equations. Our findings are expected to refine the exercise guidelines for older adults with cognitive impairment and inform the optimal exercise approach for MCI management. 認知功能下降已成為日益受到關注的公共衛生議題。輕度認知障礙（MCI）是早期失智症發生前的臨床前期階段，其特徵為一項或多項認知領域的功能缺損超出正常老化所預期的範圍。MCI 是進行早期介入、預防進一步惡化為失智症的關鍵時期。運動被廣泛推薦作為促進健康老化及降低認知功能退化風險的方法，然而，目前針對 MCI 患者的具體運動建議仍未明確。近期流行病學研究顯示，高強度身體活動與降低阿茲海默症相關死亡率之間存在劑量反應關係，而中等強度身體活動則未顯示相同效益。特別是以每次 1 至 2 分鐘的短時間高強度活動形式進行時，其保護效果更為顯著。這些研究亦指出，當高強度身體活動量達到世界衛生組織（WHO）建議的標準時，可達到最佳的風險降低效果。「運動零食」的概念近年來逐漸受到重視，其定義為將短暫且具目的性的高強度運動分散於一天中多次進行。此方式被視為達成 WHO 身體活動建議的一種具前景策略，因其具有高度彈性，可減少時間和執行上的障礙，並透過將運動融入日常生活情境來提升便利性與依從性。然而，目前尚未有研究探討運動零食在延緩認知功能衰退方面的效果，尤其缺乏真實世界環境中的實證資料。因此，本研究將直接比較運動零食與社區運動計畫的效果，以回答以下問題：在每週運動總時間相同的情況下，運動零食是否能產生與社區運動相當的認知效益？此外，相較於一般照護，這兩種運動介入方式是否皆能改善 MCI 成人的認知表現？本研究將採用嚴謹的三組務實性隨機對照試驗之前測─後測設計。符合條件之 MCI 高齡者將隨機分派至運動零食組、社區運動組或一般照護對照組。兩個介入組均接受為期 12 個月、每週累積 75 分鐘高強度運動的介入方案，但運動形式不同：運動零食組（每天進行 5 次、每次約 2 分鐘的高強度運動） 、社區運動組（每週參與 3 次、每次 25 分鐘的團體監督運動課程）及一般照護組（接受一場健康教育課程）。研究結果將由不知道受試者分組情況的評估員於基線（介入前）、12 個月（介入結束後）以及 24 個月（介入結束後追蹤 12 個月）進行評估。主要及次要評估指標包括：以蒙特婁認知評估量表（MoCA）測量的認知表現、心理健康狀況、心肺適能、介入依從性、健康相關生活品質、藥物使用情形、不良事件發生率及日常身體活動量。研究資料將採用廣義估計方程式（GEE）進行分析。本研究預期可進一步完善高齡認知功能障礙族群的運動指引，並為輕度認知障礙患者提供最適運動介入策略的實證依據，以促進其認知健康管理。

17615626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615626.value: 中国捐赠型众筹平台的监管：挑战与未来方向

17615626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615626.value: Donation-based crowdfunding platforms have become a major force in Chinese philanthropy, raising over RMB100 billion (approximately USD14 billion) and benefitting millions since 2014. These platforms fall into two categories: charitable donation-based crowdfunding platforms (CDCPs), which support public interest projects, and non-charitable donation-based crowdfunding platforms (NDCPs), which provide assistance to individuals facing financial hardship. However, the rapid growth of the platforms has outpaced regulatory development, resulting in operational inefficiencies, fund mismanagement, and declining public trust. This research will examine how China’s unique social, economic, and political context shapes the regulation of CDCPs and NDCPs across three dimensions: legal, administrative, and contractual. The legal dimension investigates the legislative framework, particularly the Charity Law (2016, amended 2023), to assess how these platforms are defined and regulated, the allocation of responsibilities among operators, donors, and beneficiaries, and how key issues such as transparency, accountability, and liability are addressed. The administrative dimension focuses on the role of regulators, analysing how laws are interpreted and enforced, the balance between fostering innovation and ensuring oversight, and the influence of non-legal factors such as political priorities and public opinion on regulatory practice. The contractual dimension explores agreements between donors, platform operators, and beneficiaries, with particular attention to risk allocation, dispute resolution, and the use of standardised contracts to protect stakeholders and promote fairness. To address the three dimensions, the project will adopt a mixed-methods approach, combining doctrinal legal analysis, comparative study, and semi-structured qualitative interviews. Doctrinal analysis will map the current legal landscape and identify regulatory gaps, while the comparative study will examine regulatory practices in the United States, Hong Kong, Australia, and England to identify lessons and best practices for China. Interviews with platform operators, regulators, donors, and beneficiaries will provide empirical insights on operational challenges and opportunities. The proposed research promises both theoretical and practical contributions. Theoretically, it will contribute to the discourse on the role of law in governing digital philanthropy, offering a nuanced understanding of how legal principles such as transparency and accountability apply to online crowdfunding platforms. Practically, it will deliver evidence-based recommendations to strengthen regulatory effectiveness, public trust, and the protection of all stakeholders in China’s evolving crowdfunding sector. 捐赠型众筹平台已成为中国慈善事业中的重要力量。自2014年以来，此类平台累计筹款超过人民币1000亿元（约合140亿美元），惠及数百万人。根据功能和性质的不同，这些平台可分为两类：一类是慈善捐赠型众筹平台（CDCPs），主要支持公共利益项目；另一类是非慈善捐赠型众筹平台（NDCPs），主要为面临经济困难的个人提供援助。然而，平台的快速发展已超出现有监管体系的完善速度，由此引发了运营效率不足、资金管理不善以及公众信任下降等问题。 本研究将考察中国独特的社会、经济与政治背景如何影响对慈善捐赠型众筹平台和非慈善捐赠型众筹平台的监管，并将从法律、行政和合同三个维度展开分析。法律维度将重点研究相关立法框架，尤其是《慈善法》（2016年制定，2023年修订），以评估此类平台在法律上如何被界定和规制，平台运营者、捐赠人和受益人之间的责任如何分配，以及透明度、问责机制和法律责任等关键问题如何得到回应。行政维度将关注监管机构的作用，分析法律在实践中如何被解释和执行，如何在鼓励创新与加强监管之间取得平衡，以及政策重点、公众舆论等非法律因素如何影响监管实践。合同维度则将考察捐赠人、平台运营者和受益人之间的协议安排，尤其关注风险分配、争议解决，以及标准化合同在保护利益相关方、促进公平方面的作用。 为回应上述三个维度的问题，本研究将采用混合研究方法，结合教义法学分析、比较研究和半结构式定性访谈。教义法学分析将用于梳理当前法律体系并识别监管空白；比较研究将考察美国、香港、澳大利亚和英格兰的监管实践，以总结可供中国借鉴的经验和最佳做法；对平台运营者、监管者、捐赠人和受益人的访谈则将提供关于平台运行挑战与发展机遇的实证洞见。本研究预计将在理论和实践两个层面作出贡献。理论上，本研究将推进关于法律在数字慈善治理中作用的讨论，并对透明度、问责等法律原则如何适用于网络众筹平台提供更细致的理解。实践上，本研究将提出基于证据的政策和制度建议，以提升监管有效性、增强公众信任，并更好地保护中国不断发展的众筹领域中各方利益相关者的权益。

17616126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616126.value: 中國的「爛尾樓」危機：房地產開發敗局、購房者應對與政府對策

17616126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17616126.value: Prof Chen, Jie Dr Waldron, Richard

17616126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17616126.value: China's unfinished residential development (URD) crisis represents a fundamental breakdown in state-led urbanisation, with 231 million square metres of stalled construction affecting 7.85 million households since 2021. Comparable Western housing crises have been arguably spurred by state-encouraged property development via financial deregulation and speculative incentives. Conversely, China's unprecedented URD crisis emerged from contradictions within its state-led development model, where growth-oriented planning strategies, land revenue dependence and pre-sale systems have created conditions for systematic overbuilding, predominantly in non-first-tier cities. The crisis reveals how state institutions can actively foster – rather than merely regulate – development failures and risks, with state-led strategies simultaneously pursuing housing development and creating the conditions for crisis. Under China's institutional model, local governments are incentivised to pursue aggressive land development, while developers adopt highly-leveraged practices that transfer construction risks to homebuyers via pre-sales. When official debt-control policies triggered widespread developer defaults in 2020-2021, accumulated risks materialised as URDs, exposing millions of homebuyers to housing precarity – where individuals service mortgages on uninhabitable and unsalable properties while securing alternative housing, prompting homebuyer and state responses to manage the crisis. This project examines China's URD crisis through three theoretical lenses within the political economy of housing and urban statecraft: institutional facilitation of capital accumulation and crisis generation; homebuyer navigation of compounding housing precarity; and state recalibration of governance frameworks in response to crisis conditions. Three research questions guide this inquiry: 1) How have state-led urbanisation strategies and institutional arrangements facilitated excessive housing development and generated URDs? 2) How do affected homebuyers navigate and respond to extreme housing precarity? 3) How have state actors responded to the URD crisis through their evolving roles, strategies and governance approaches? Using a mixed-methods approach across three case study cities, the study combines document and policy analysis, stakeholder interviews, focus groups, homebuyer interviews with photo elicitation and social media content analysis. Collaborating with three local planning institutes, it will identify common structural dynamics underlying URD formation, reveal how crisis manifestations vary across different urban contexts and examine homebuyer and state responses to URDs. The study makes three theoretical contributions: extending URD studies beyond post-2008 Western contexts to state-led development models; conceptualising compounding housing precarity as the intersection of financial burden, uninhabitability and livelihood disruption; and theorising statecraft adaptation under crisis conditions. Findings will inform institutional innovations in sustainable housing production and homebuyer protection, with transferable insights for other state-led urbanisation contexts. 中國的「爛尾樓」危機反映了國家主導城市化模式中的根本性斷裂。自2021年以來，已有2.31億平方米的停工建築，影響了785萬戶家庭。相比之下，西方國家類似的房地產危機，普遍被認為是由國家通過金融放鬆管制與投機激勵，鼓勵房地產開發所致。然而，中國前所未有的爛尾樓危機，卻源於其國家主導開發模式本身的內在矛盾：以增長為導向的規劃策略、對土地財政的依賴，以及不完善的預售制度，共同造成了系統性的過度開發，且主要集中在非一線城市。這場危機揭示了國家機構如何可能積極助長——而不僅僅是監管——開發失敗與風險，即國家主導的策略在推動住房開發的同時，也一併製造了危機的條件。在中國的體制模式下，地方政府有動機追求激進的土地開發，而開發商則採取高槓桿操作，通過預售制度將建設風險轉嫁給購房者。當官方的去槓桿政策於2020至2021年間引發大規模開發商違約時，累積的風險便以爛尾樓的形式暴露出來，使數百萬購房者陷入住房困境。他們一方面要償還無法居住、也無法轉賣房產的房貸，另一方面又要另外解決住房問題，由此引發了購房者應對策略，國家層面也需要採取相應的策略。 本研究計劃從政治經濟的理論視角，系統考察中國的爛尾樓危機。具體的研究問題如下：第一，國家主導的城市化策略與制度安排，是如何助長過度住房開發並導致爛尾樓產生的？第二，受影響的購房者如何應對這種極端的住房困境？第三，政府如何通過其不斷演變的角色、策略和治理方式，來應對爛尾樓危機？ 本研究採用混合研究方法，以三個案例城市為研究對象，結合文件與政策分析、利益相關方訪談、焦點小組、輔以照片引談法的購房者訪談，以及社交媒體內容分析。研究將與地方規劃機構合作，從而識別爛尾樓形成背後的共同結構性動因，揭示危機表現形式在不同城市背景下的差異，並考察購房者和國家對爛尾樓的應對方式。 本研究在理論上有三點貢獻：一是將爛尾樓研究的視野，從2008年後的西方語境，拓展到國家主導的開發模式；二是將複合型住房困境概念化為財務負擔、居住不適性與生計中斷三者交織的結果；三是為危機背景下的治理調適建立理論框架。研究成果將有助於推動可持續住房生產和購房者保護方面的制度創新，並為其他國家主導城市化的語境，提供可借鑒的啟示。

17616326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616326.value: 以隨機對照試驗檢視基數、序數及運算之間的相互關係

17616326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
