Multiple EEG analytical methods, i.e., event-related potentials, functional connectivity, neural oscillations, and aperiodic activity, will characterize neural activities related to pain empathy. Bayesian predictive modeling will examine neural and behavioral dynamics between mothers and children, showing how pain empathy develops over time and links brain activity to behavioral measures. Results will elucidate (1) the neural dynamics underlying impaired pain empathy in autism, (2) the impact of raising an autistic child on the mother’s empathic brain response, and (3) the empathic link between mothers and their children. These findings will clarify the principles and factors necessary for designing interventions for families raising autistic children. 疼痛共情（pain empathy）是指個體对他人疼痛的感知、判斷及情緒反應，是促進人際理解與情感聯結的重要社會能力。自閉症兒童在此方面存在顯著困難，可能與其非典型神經活動有關。為深入理解其共情功能失調的神經機制，本研究採用為期三年的縱向設計，結合腦電圖（EEG）與行為測量，以母子對作為分析單位，探討以下問題：（1）自閉症與一般發展兒童在共情他人生理疼痛與社會性疼痛時神經機制的異同；（2）自閉症兒童母親對他人疼痛的共情神經反應；（3）母子神經與行為個層面上的共情關聯。 現有研究多局限於生理疼痛（e.g.,Liu et al., 2023； Wang & Tong, 2025）的探討，缺乏對社會性疼痛的探討，並忽略了疼痛本身的多維度性；且先前研究尚未考察養育自閉症兒童對母親共情神經反應的影響及其對子女共情發展的塑造作用；且多取單一年齡層作橫斷面設計爲主，較少納入行爲共情指標，難以揭示母子共情發展的動態聯繫。 本研究將三年縱向追蹤87對6-7歲的自閉症兒童與一般發展的母親，以及87對一般發展的兒童與其母親。所有參與者均接受認知與情感共情的行為評估；母親填寫焦慮與壓力問卷。腦電圖（EEG）記錄於首年與末年進行，藉母子共同觀看描繪日常生活中生理與社會性疼痛的情境動畫短片以誘發共情反應。數據分析將綜合事件相關電位（ERPs）、功能連接、神經振盪與非週期性活動等多維腦電圖指標，並採用貝葉斯預測模型考察母子在神經及行為上的互動與變化。結果預期闡明（1）自閉症兒童疼痛共情困難的神經機制；（2）養育經歷對母親共情相關腦反應的影響；（3）母子共情在神經與行爲層面的聯繫。本研究為自閉症家庭共情干預提供理論與實證依據。

17627626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17627626.value: 地下水可持續利用約束下的玉米種植密度優化：融合衛星影像、深度學習與作物模型的綜合框架

17627626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17627626.value: Closing the persistent yield gap in China's crop production system is a critical objective for national food security. On the North China Plain (NCP)—a region that produces over 40% of the nation's corn but faces severe groundwater overdraft—suboptimal planting density (PD; plants per unit area) is a major, yet addressable, contributor to this gap. While increasing PD is a proven lever for higher yields, its implementation is complex and challenging. Excessively high PD can lead to plants competing for resources and yield loss, while the associated rise in irrigation demand poses a grave threat to the sustainability of already-stressed aquifers. This creates a pressing need for spatially explicit approaches to optimize corn planting density, balancing yield gains with groundwater sustainability. Current methods for mapping PD face a fundamental scalability challenge. While high-resolution imagery can directly count plants, it is cost-prohibitive for large-scale application. Conversely, leveraging medium-resolution Sentinel data presents a cost-effective opportunity, but requires overcoming the intrinsic challenge of retrieving sub-pixel PD signals, which are confounded by soil background and dynamic crop growth. To bridge this gap, this project develops a robust deep learning framework that fuses multi temporal Sentinel 2 optical indices with Sentinel 1 radar features within an attention enhanced temporal convolutional architecture. By leveraging temporal dependencies and feature level attention, the model will effectively disentangle the persistent structural signature of PD from transient phenological dynamics, enabling robust, field-level PD mapping across the NCP. Ground truth labels from field campaigns and UAV anchor model training and validation. Building on this accurate mapping of actual PD, we further redefine potential PD by integrating groundwater constraints. Using a coupled crop and land surface model, we simulate the feedback between density-driven crop growth, irrigation water use, and groundwater dynamics. This allows us to identify, for each location, the sustainable potential PD—the highest density that improves yield without leading to a long-term decline in the water table. Integrating actual and sustainable potential PD yields the first spatially explicit map of planting density gap (PDG) for the NCP under groundwater sustainability constraints. This final output strategically pinpoints "high-benefit, low-risk" areas where targeted PD increase can achieve significant yield gains without compromising groundwater resources. Our integrated methodology provides a scalable, policy-ready framework for sustainable intensification, equipping farmers and policymakers with evidence-based guidance to enhance crop productivity and national food security while safeguarding the region's vital groundwater resource. 縮小中國作物生產系統中長期存在的產量差距，是保障國家糧食安全的關鍵目標。在華北平原——這一玉米產量佔全國 40% 以上、但同時面臨嚴重地下水超採問題的地區——未達最適的種植密度（單位面積株數）是造成產量差距的一個重要且可調控因素。提高種植密度已被證實是提升產量的有效途徑，但其實施過程複雜且具有挑戰性。過高的種植密度可能導致植株之間競爭光、水分和養分等資源，進而造成產量損失；同時，灌溉需求的增加也會對已承受巨大壓力的含水層可持續性構成嚴重威脅。因此，亟需發展具有空間顯式性的玉米種植密度優化方法，在提高產量與維持地下水可持續性之間取得平衡。 目前，用於種植密度製圖的方法面臨根本性的可擴展性挑戰。高解析度影像雖然可以直接識別和計數植株，但在大尺度應用中成本過高。相較之下，利用中等解析度的 Sentinel 資料提供了一種具成本效益的途徑，但其核心挑戰在於如何提取亞像元尺度的種植密度訊號；這些訊號往往受到土壤背景和作物動態生長過程的干擾。為彌合這一差距，本項目將發展一套穩健的深度學習框架，在注意力增強的時間卷積架構中融合多時相哨兵-2 光學指數與哨兵-1 雷達特徵。透過利用時間依賴關係和特徵層級注意力機制，該模型將有效分離種植密度所具有的持續性結構訊號與短期物候動態變化，從而實現華北平原範圍內穩健的田塊尺度種植密度製圖。來自田間調查和無人機觀測的地面真值標籤將用於支撐模型訓練與驗證。 在準確繪製實際種植密度的基礎上，本項目將進一步結合地下水約束，重新定義潛在種植密度。透過耦合作物模型與陸面模型，我們將模擬由種植密度驅動的作物生長、灌溉用水和地下水動態之間的反饋關係。這將使我們能夠針對每一個地點識別其可持續潛在種植密度，即在不導致地下水位長期下降的前提下，能夠提高產量的最高種植密度。整合實際種植密度與可持續潛在種植密度後，本項目將生成華北平原首幅在地下水可持續性約束下的種植密度差距空間顯式圖。該最終成果將精準識別「高收益、低風險」區域，即在這些區域有針對性地提高種植密度，可以在不損害地下水資源的前提下實現顯著增產。 本項目所提出的綜合方法將提供一套可擴展且可直接服務政策制定的可持續集約化框架，為農民和政策制定者提供基於科學證據的決策支持，以在保護華北平原重要地下水資源的同時，提高作物生產力並保障國家糧食安全。

17627826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17627826.value: 為香港裡城市設施節點上多功能公共建築類型的市政大廈建立檔案

17627826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17627826.value: Archiving an indigenous multi-functional public building type of Hong Kong: the urban infrastructural node of the Municipal Services Building (MSB) proposes to critically examine a selection of eight of the until-now overlooked public building type, its vertically-stacked multi-functional composition indigenous to Hong Kong’s density and evolution of its institutional frameworks. Conceived in the mid-1970s, following the institutional restructuring that expanded Urban Council (UC)’s remit to culture, the buildings, formerly known as the UC complexes, were built as part of the expanded portfolio of what the UC showcased in the 1986 Building Journal as “urban amenities by the people, for the people and of the people.” Realized alongside visibly-iconic buildings such as the Cultural Centre and Art Museum, these were ordinary architectures for everyday use—with wet markets at the base, libraries in the middle, sports facilities atop, and sometimes theatres and galleries in between. A systematic documentation of their architectural proposals and transformations, drawing on both drawing records and measured surveys, as well as an archival excavation of the UC’s reports and meeting notes, i.e. from the UC’s Planning-Development (1974-1980) then Capital-Works Committee (1981-1999) will firstly contextualize these public architectural productions in the aspirations as well as challenges of the time. The UC’s engagement of Hong Kong’s seminal private architects, including Chung Wah Nan, Dennis Lau, Palmer and Turner, and Wong Ouyang, also showed the importance of these public nodes in the rising skyline of the 1980s-1990s dominated by the commercial towers and shopping malls and manifesting the city’s otherwise laissez faire economic priorities. A second part of the project proposes to collect also artefacts—drawings, photos, ephemera—as well as oral histories from the surviving actors who were involved in the MSB’s design and realizations, archiving the significance of these yet-to-be-recognized late-20th-century buildings. Even though Hong Kong has increasingly recognized post-war spaces as heritage—though the youth of the MSBs preclude their recognition—and the M+ Museum is collecting the works of locally-trained post-war architects, highlighting the value of their designs to architectural discourse in general, there remains until today little formal documentation of the MSBs. With the slated demolition and renovations that have and will change the urban interface of this unique architectural type, archiving both their physical and institutional formations takes on growing urgency. 《為香港裡城市設施節點上多功能公共建築類型的市政大廈建立檔案》，本項目將從至今仍被忽視的公共建築類型裡精選出的八個案例作為分析的對象，深入研究勘测這些生成於香港高密度環境下並伴隨制度框架轉變時的垂直堆疊、具多功能的本土建築範例。在市政局的职权范围由于架構調整擴展到文化娛樂管理後，這些在1970年代所被策劃建成的建築（原本在英文被叫做’Urban Council complex [市政局綜合大廈]‘）就是市政局在1986年出版的《香港建築雜誌[Building Journal]》中所提到的“民有、民治、民享的城市設施”的活樣板。 與一些顯眼的地標性建築（例如文化中心和美術館等）幾乎同時落地的就是這些用途平凡的日常建築（菜市場在底層，圖書館在中間層次，體育館在頂層，有時候劇院和畫廊也會夾在中間層裡）。通過考察圖紙檔案，實際測繪，加上查閱當年的市政局報告和會議記錄（包括市政局1974-1980規劃組和1981-1999基建工程組的檔案），此項目對原始設計方案和實施中發生的變遷進行系統化梳理記錄，首先揭示了這些公共建築產生時的願景和遭遇的挑戰。市政局曾雇用了香港一些開創代私人建築事務所，諸如鐘華南、劉榮廣、P+T和王歐陽等進行設計，顯示了這些作為城市節點的公共建築在80-90年代的重要地位，要知道那是在一個代表了無干涉主義經濟政策的由商業大樓和購物商場稱霸的時代。此項目的第二部分將大量收集包括圖紙，歷史照片等的實體文物，還有參與過市政大廈設計實踐相關人士們的口述歷史，把這些仍未被重視的20世紀後期建築的精髓存入檔案。雖然香港的戰後建築在越來越多地被識別為遺產，M+博物館也收藏了不少戰後世代受本土教育的建築師們的作品，讓他們的對建築領域的貢獻受到關注，但是本項目研究的這些市政大廈相對年輕的樓齡仍然阻礙了官方的認可，至今仍然鮮少有關於市政大廈作為一種建築類型完整的研究記錄。被列入被拆除或翻修名單已經並將繼續會改變這種建築類型在城市裡獨特的視覺形象，也讓它們作為實體以及在理念形態上的歸檔變得更為迫切。

17628126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17628126.value: 出生後早期（1至3個月齡「迷你青春期」）的睪固酮水平、家長的影響，以及48 、60及72個月齡時的性別相關發展

17628126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17628126.value: BACKGROUND Thousands of non-human mammal experiments across numerous species have demonstrated organising (long-term, programming) effects of early exposure to androgenic hormones (e.g., testosterone) on aspects of behavioural development that show average sex differences. In human gender development, the early postnatal testosterone surge during “mini-puberty” at 1–3 months of age has been postulated to be a critical window for testosterone to exert organising effects (Kung, 2022; Kung et al., 2024). Parental influences may also contribute to a range of gender-related outcomes. NOVELTY The current longitudinal study is first-of-its-kind, generating novel insights into the role of early postnatal testosterone, as well as its interaction with parental influences, in shaping gender-related outcomes. METHOD: Prior Time Points & Measures The longitudinal cohort was built and recruited by the PI’s team (Kung et al., 2025). This cohort completed assessment time points at 1–3, 12, & 24 months of age, and the 36-month-old follow-up is currently underway. At 1–3 months of age, 3 weekly saliva samples were collected from each infant for testosterone assays. At ages 1–3, 12, 24, and 36 months, measures assessing parental input and child developmental outcomes have been included. Individual, in-person data collection sessions have been conducted at ages 12, 24, and 36 months. METHOD: New Time Points & Measures This new project will conduct follow-ups at 48, 60, and 72 months of age. Gender-related outcomes will be assessed during individual, in-person sessions. These new follow-ups will continue to assess previously included outcomes such as play preferences, physical aggression, and social communication (eye contact & autistic traits). These new follow-ups will also continue to assess parental input. As children reach age 48 months in the current project, additional gender-related outcomes can be assessed. These additional outcomes include activity level, mental rotation (a visuo-spatial skill), and aspects of language/verbal development. Child-reported, parent-reported, cognitive, observational, and accelerometery measures will be employed. METHOD: Sample Size In total, 472 infants were enrolled at age 1–3 months. The participation rate at follow-ups across ages 12 (completed), 24 (completed), and 36 months (on-going) has been high (~90% at each follow-up). It is expected that around 200 boys and 200 girls (~85% participation rate) will take part in the proposed follow-ups at 48, 60, and 72 months of age. IMPORTANCE This one-of-a-kind longitudinal project will luminate the developmental origins of numerous phenomena in human development. 背景 針對多種非人類哺乳動物進行的數千項實驗表明，早期接觸雄性激素（如睪固酮）會對表現出性別差異的行為發展方面產生「組織效應」（即長期的、程序性的影響）。就人類性別發展而言，學界推測，出生後1至3個月期間出現的「小青春期」（mini-puberty）睪固酮激增，是睪固酮發揮組織效應的關鍵窗口期（Kung, 2022; Kung et al., 2024）。家長的影響也可能在多種性別相關結果的形成中發揮作用。 創新點 本項縱向研究尚屬首創，為理解出生後早期睪酮的作用及其與家長的影響的相互作用在塑造性別相關結果方面的機制，提供了新的見解。 方法：既往時間點與測量指標 此縱向隊列由專案負責人（PI）的團隊建立並招募（Kung et al., 2025）。此隊列已完成嬰兒1–3個月、12個月及24個月齡時的評估，目前正在進行36個月大的追蹤。在1–3個月齡期間，研究人員每週採集一次每位嬰兒的唾液樣本，以測定睪固酮濃度。在1–3個月、12個月、24個月及36個月齡時，均納入了父母影響及兒童發展結果的測量指標。此外，在12個月、24個月及36個月大時，也進行了面對面的個別資料收集工作。 方法：新增時間點與測量指標 本計畫將進行48 、60及72個月齡的追蹤。性別相關結果將透過面對面的個別評估進行測量。這些新增追蹤將繼續評估先前已納入的指標，如遊戲偏好、身體攻擊行為以及社會溝通能力（包括眼神交流和自閉症特質）。同時，這些追蹤也將持續評估父母的影響。隨著本計畫中的兒童達到48個月大，研究將能夠評估更多性別相關的結果。這些新增指標包括活動層次、心理旋轉能力（一種視覺空間技能）以及語言/言語發展的相關面向。研究將採用兒童自述、家長報告、認知評估、觀察法、加速度計測量等多種評估方式。 方法：樣本量 本研究共納入了472名1至3個月大的嬰兒。在12個月齡（已完成）、24個月齡（已完成）和36個月齡（進行中）的追蹤中，參與率一直維持在較高水準（各次追蹤均約為90%）。預計將有約200名男童和200名女童（參與率約85%）參加建議的48 、60及72個月齡的追蹤。 重要意義 這項獨具特色的縱向研究將產生具有全球創新性的研究成果，並揭示人類發展過程中許多現象的早期發展起源。

17628226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17628226.value: 教師優先：透過一種新型專業發展計劃與人工智能驅動教練工具，實現促進身心健康與教學公 平的社會情感學習

17628226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17628226.value: As the global movement to scale up school-based social and emotional learning (SEL) accelerates, cultivating teachers’ own social and emotional competencies (SEC) has emerged as a cornerstone for effective, sustainable, and equitable SEL implementation. Teacher SEL refers to empowering educators to embody core SEC, to enhance their wellbeing and SEL practices, thereby fostering caring and inclusive environments that support all students’ growth and well-being. In East Asia, both teachers and students face mounting mental health challenges, yet research on teacher SEL in this region is limited—especially regarding its impact on overall outcomes and disparities therein. The Principal Investigator (PI) has advanced the field by developing and validating a multidimensional measure of teacher SEC, including competencies closely related to promoting equitable learning conditions. The PI’s work has demonstrated links among teacher SEC, teacher well-being, and student SEL outcomes, and explored the impact of universal SEL programs on student disparities. However, experimental evidence on teacherfocused SEL interventions—both in terms of average effects and equity implications—is scarce in East Asia. This project addresses these gaps by leveraging digital technology for remote learning and real-time personalized support through the development and evaluation of an online professional development program and an AI-powered supplementary coaching tool. The program, developed with the Greater Good Science Center at UC Berkeley and culturally adapted with East Asian educators and researchers, integrates asynchronous online modules with synchronous collaborative sessions. The AI coaching tool, co-developed with a Hong Kong-based AI company, offers individualized, interactive support. Both interventions emphasize not only general SEC but also equity-promoting competencies tailored to regional sociocultural contexts. The study will employ a three-arm cluster randomized controlled trial (RCT) in 30 Hong Kong public primary schools (approximately 360 teachers and 7,200 students), comparing (1) program only, (2) program plus AI coaching tool, and (3) a control group. Leveraging established partnerships with local schools and a NGO, the study will measure outcomes at baseline and post-intervention, including teacher SEC, teacher well-being, SEL implementation, classroom climate, student SEC, and student well-being. The project will assess both direct, indirect, and trickle-down effects of the program, and the incremental value of the AI coaching tool, on average and across diverse student subgroups. By rigorously evaluating culturally relevant, technology-supported SEL professional development, this project aims to generate robust evidence on effectiveness, feasibility, and equity impacts, guiding the future scale-up of teacher SEL initiatives in East Asia. 隨著全球推廣學校社會情感學習的趨勢不斷加速，培養教師自身的社會情感能力已成為實現有效、可持續且公平的社會情感學習實踐的基石。教師社會情感學習旨在讓教育工作者，使其體現核心社會情感能力，從而提升其心理健康水平與社會情感學習教學實踐，最終營造出關愛包容的環境，促進全體學生的成長與身心健康。在東亞地區，師生皆面臨日益嚴峻的心理健康挑戰，然而該區域針對教師社會情感學習的研究仍顯不足——特別是在其對整體教育成果及其中差異性影響的探索方面。 本研究的首席研究員通過開發並驗證了一套多維度教師社會情感能力測量工具（包含與促進公平學習環境密切相關的能力維度），推動了該研究領域的發展。其前期研究已證實教師社會情感能力、教師幸福感與學生社會情感學習成果之間的關聯性，並探討了通用型社會情感學習項目對學生差異化發展的影響。然而在東亞地區，針對教師社會情感學習干預措施的實驗性證據——無論是平均效應還是公平性影響——仍然稀缺。 本項目通過開發並評估一種網上專業發展課程與人工智能驅動教練工具，運用數字技術實現遠程學習與實時個性化支持，以彌補上述研究缺口。該課程由加州大學伯克利分校 GreaterGood Science Center共同研發，並經東亞教育工作者與研究人員進行文化適應性調整，整合了非同步網上單元與同步協作環節。而與香港人工智能企業合作開發的人工智能教練工具，則提供個性化互動支持。兩項干預措施不僅注重通用社會情感能力培養，更特別強化契合區域社會文化背景的公平促進能力。 研究將在香港30所公立小學（約360名教師及7200名學生）開展三組整群隨機對照試驗，對比評估：（1）課程方案，（2）課程方案結合人工智能教練工具，以及（3）對照組的效果。利用與當地學校及非政府組織的既有合作關係，研究將在干預前後測量多項成果指標，包括教師社會情感能力、教師身心健康、社會情感學習實踐水平、課堂氛圍、學生社會情感能力及學生身心健康。項目將系統評估課程方案產生的直接、間接與擴散效應，以及人工智能教練工具對不同學生亞群體的平均增量價值與差異化影響。 通過對文化適應性技術輔助型社會情感學習專業發展計劃的嚴謹評估，本研究旨在為東亞地區教師社會情感學習推廣提供關於有效性、可行性及公平性影響的堅實證據，為未來大規模實踐提供科學指引。

18200826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18200826.value: 運用大語言模型建構通用且可適應的產品設計品質機能展開平台

18200826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18200826.value: Prof Tsung, Fugee Prof Yu, Philip Leung Ho

18200826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18200826.value: Quality function deployment (QFD) has long been a cornerstone of customer-driven product development. QFD systematically separates customer requirements (CRs) from engineering characteristics (ECs) and bridges the gap between the two, thereby ensuring that the final product meets both technical standards and customers’ expectations. Since its inception in the 1960s, QFD has gained widespread popularity and registered numerous successes across various industries. An industry study even ranked QFD among ‘the 10 action programs that received the most attention’ and ‘the top 10 programs that had the greatest pay-offs’ [1][2]. Despite its impressive track record, QFD also faces significant challenges in today’s fast-paced business environment. Notably, the QFD process is often complex, labour-intensive, and time-consuming, requiring a multidisciplinary team of customers, designers, engineers, marketing experts, and QFD moderators. However, because today’s business landscape demands lean operations and rapid time to market, allocating the resources needed for QFD, including time and expertise, has become challenging. In response, it is necessary to explore ways to make QFD more efficient and effective in today’s fast-changing business environment. Recent breakthroughs in generative AI and large language models (LLMs) have opened up new avenues for businesses to streamline their operations. Such developments have also inspired us to develop a resource-efficient, generic and adaptive LLM2QFD platform for product development. To that end, we propose to infuse an LLM with relevant domain expertise using parameter-efficient fine-tuning to obtain a domain-specific LLM. Subsequently, companies can provide a limited amount of product-relevant data to further tune this domain-specific LLM, yielding a tailored QFD model capable of translating novel CRs into ECs, determining correlations among ECs, and prioritising them. The proposed methodology for our project offers three major benefits: (1) the rapid automation of the QFD process, (2) a significant reduction in the expertise required of companies, and (3) a better understanding of CRs that are often expressed in ambiguous, if not convoluted, natural-language utterances. To the best of our knowledge, our proposed project is the first initiative to address QFD-related challenges using LLMs. We anticipate that it will expand the frontiers of research on QFD and its applications in industry and business. Beyond that, our novel approach is expected to make significant contributions to product design, quality engineering, and related research areas within industrial engineering and operations management. 品質機能展開(QFD)長期以來一直是以顧客為導向的產品開發核心方法。QFD能夠系統性地將顧客需求與工程特性區分開來，並建立兩者之間的連結，從而確保最終產品同時符合技術標準與顧客期望。自 1960 年代問世以來，QFD 已獲得廣泛應用，並在眾多產業中取得顯著成效。一項研究將QFD 列為「最受重視的十大行動方案之一」以及「投資回報最高的十大方案之一」。 儘管 QFD 擁有卓越的應用成果，但在當今快速變化的商業環境中仍面臨諸多挑戰。尤其是，QFD 流程通常相當複雜、勞力密集且耗時，往往需要由顧客、設計師、工程師以及 QFD 主持人等多領域專業人士共同參與。然而，現今企業環境強調產品快速上市與精實營運，使企業難以投入推行 QFD 所需的大量時間與專業人力資源。因此，有必要探討如何在快速變遷的商業環境下，提升 QFD 的效率與效能。 近年來，生成式人工智慧與大型語言模型的重大突破，為企業提升營運效率開闢了新方向。受到這些發展的啟發，我們擬開發一個兼具資源效率、通用性及適應性的 LLM2QFD 產品開發平台。為達成此目標，本研究將透過參數高效微調技術，將相關領域專業知識注入大語言模型，建構出特定領域的大語言模型。當企業利用 LLM2QFD 平台進行產品設計或產品改良時，只需提供少量與產品相關的資料來調整該領域專屬模型，即可建立一個客製化的 QFD 模型。此模型能夠將新的顧客需求轉換為對應的工程特性，分析各工程特性之間的關聯性，並對工程特性的重要程度進行排序。本研究所提出的方法具有三項主要優勢：(1) 快速實現 QFD 流程自動化；(2)大幅降低企業對專業知識與專家資源的需求；(3)更深入理解顧客需求，尤其是以複雜且模糊自然語言表達的需求。 我們預期，本計畫將拓展 QFD 研究及其於產業與商業領域應用的發展邊界。據我們所知，本研究是首個利用大語言模型解決 QFD 挑戰的嘗試。此創新方法有望在產品設計、品質工程，以及工業工程與作業管理等相關研究領域促成突破性進展。

18301226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18301226.value: 利用混合廢塑膠熱解油生物合成聚羥基脂肪酸酯共聚物之抑制機制與緩解策略

18301226.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18301226.value: Prof Chen, George Guo-Qiang Prof Kwon, Eilhann E.

18301226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18301226.value: Plastics have become an integral part of contemporary life due to their numerous desirable properties; however, these petrochemical-based polymers accumulate and persist in the environment, causing emerging environmental problems. The development of bioplastics has garnered much interest due to their biodegradability and biocompatibility. Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) are a family of naturally occurring biodegradable polyesters produced by pure strains or mixed microbial culture as intracellular carbon and energy storage polymers. Copolymers of these PHA exhibit certain tailor-made physical and textural properties that make them suitable for industrial applications. However, the high cost of PHA-based copolymer production hinders commercialisation. Microbial fermentation using waste-derived carbon sources offers a sustainable alternative for producing bioplastics at ambient temperatures and pressures, but its low production yields and rates pose a considerable challenge. To address these limitations, the proposed project aims to evaluate the feasibility of using inexpensive carbon sources, namely waste-derived pyrolytic oil, derived from the thermochemical conversion of mixed plastic waste, to produce truly biodegradable plastics for industrial applications. The research will first examine the suitability of mixed plastic waste from local recycling communities as pyrolysis feedstock and develop and modify the thermochemical conversion process by optimising pyrolysis setups and manipulating operating conditions to produce waste-derived pyrolytic oil. This oil will then serve as a low-cost carbon source to investigate and optimise the production of bioplastics, specifically PHA-based copolymers. A key focus will be to investigate impurities in waste-derived pyrolytic oil that have high inhibitory effects on PHA accumulation and to explore a simple, rapid, and reliable pre-treatment method for their elimination. Furthermore, the project will clarify the inhibition mechanisms of high-risk inhibitors by identifying the functional microorganisms and key PHA biosynthetic enzymes and elucidating potential bottlenecks using metagenomics technology. Finally, the process will be validated in pilot-scale bioreactors using pre-treated pyrolytic oil and selected culture to produce PHA-based copolymers exhibiting specific properties suitable for industrial applications through reactor optimisation. This proposed work will provide a sustainable pathway for managing plastic waste and producing biodegradable plastics, thereby promoting the economic feasibility of the recycling industry. 塑膠因其優異特性已成為現代生活不可或缺的一部分；然而，此類傳統石化基聚合物於環境中累積並持久存留，衍生出新興環境問題。生物塑膠因具備良好的生物可降解性及生物相容性而備受關注。聚羥基脂肪酸酯（Polyhydroxyalkanoates, PHA）為一類由純菌株或混合微生物菌群所合成的天然生物可降解聚酯，作為細胞內碳源與能量儲存聚合物。此類 PHA共聚物展現出可定制的物理及質感特性，極具工業應用潛力。然而，PHA共聚物高昂的生產成本嚴重阻礙其商業化進程。利用廢物衍生碳源進行微生物發酵，雖為常溫常壓下生產生物塑膠提供可持續的替代途徑，惟其偏低的產量及生產速率仍構成重大挑戰。為解決上述局限，本項目旨在評估利用低成本碳源——即透過熱化學轉化混合廢塑膠所得的熱解油——生產可於工業應用的真正生物可降解塑膠之可行性。本研究首先將評估從本地回收社區收集的混合廢塑膠作為熱解原料的適用性，並透過優化熱解裝置及調控操作條件，開發與改良熱化學轉化工藝，以生產廢物衍生熱解油。該熱解油隨後將作為低成本碳源，用以深入研究及優化生物可降解塑膠（特別是 PHA 共聚物）之合成工藝。本研究之核心重點在於釐清廢物衍生熱解油中對 PHA累積具強抑制作用的雜質，並開發簡單、快速且可靠的預處理方法予以消除。此外，本研究將利用宏基因組學技術，透過識別功能微生物及 PHA 生物合成關鍵酶，闡明高風險抑制劑之抑制機理與潛在瓶頸。最後，本研究將在中試規模生物反應器中，利用預處理後的熱解油與選定的菌群進行工藝驗證，並透過反應器優化，生產具備特定工業應用性能的 PHA 共聚物。本研究將為廢塑膠管理及生物可降解塑膠生產提供可持續途徑，進而提升回收產業之經濟可行性。

18500226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18500226.value: 富碳飼料可減少魚類對抗生素、金屬與微塑膠的吸收，進而降低抗生素與金屬抗性基因在魚類及環境中的傳播

18500226.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18500226.value: Prof Kwan, Hoi Shan Dr Tsang, Yiu Fai Prof Wong, Ming Hung

18500226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18500226.value: The proposed study will aim to investigate the effects of fish feed formulations enriched with spent coffee grounds (SCG)-based activated charcoal (AC) and biochar (carbon-enriched feed) on reducing the accumulation of antibiotics, metals and microplastics (MPs) in fish, as well as the effect of the feed on microbiota, and spread of antibiotic and metal resistance genes (ARGs and MRGs) in fish guts and environment. The specific objectives will be (1) to produce and characterise SCG-based AC and biochar and analyse the concentrations of antibiotics (sulfonamides and tetracyclines), MPs (polyethylene and polypropylene), metals (cadmium, copper, mercury, lead and zinc), ARGs and MRGs in SCG, SCG-based AC and biochar, and commercial feed; (2) to evaluate the effects of SCG-based AC and biochar feeds on fish growth and immunity via laboratory trials using Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) as a model fish; (3) to conduct an exposure experiment of Nile tilapia fed with carbon feed to study the uptake of antibiotics, metals and MPs in fish and the effects of bacterial communities, ARGs and MRGs in the fish gut; and (4) to conduct a field-scale fish culturing experiment to study fish growth and immunity and the accumulation of the abovementioned antibiotics, metals and MPs in fish, pond water and sediment. Specifically, the metagenomics of the microbiota, ARGs and MRGs in the fish gut and the environment and human health risks posed by the antibiotics and metals in fish meat after the fish are harvested will be examined. The proposed study will address the co-exposure of aquaculture fish to antibiotics, metals and MPs within fish feed, which is believed to be a significant source of contamination and a cause of the spread of ARGs and MRGs in fish and the environment. The findings will provide new grounds for designing novel feed formulations and further understanding the ecotoxicity in fish caused by co-exposure to antibiotics, metals and MPs and the co-selection of ARGs and MRGs in fish and the aquatic environment. 本項目旨在研究以咖啡渣為基礎製作的活性炭和生物炭飼料（富碳飼料）對於減少魚體內抗生素、金屬和微塑膠積累的效果；并進一步探討其對於魚腸道微生物群的影響，以及對抗生素和金屬抗性基因在魚腸道及環境中的擴散影響。具體目標包括：(1) 以咖啡渣製造活性炭和生物炭，並分析其的理化特性。同時，將針對咖啡渣、基於咖啡渣的活性炭及生物炭，以及商業飼料中進行檢測，分析抗生素（磺胺類和四環素）、微塑膠（聚乙烯和聚丙烯）、金屬（鎘、銅、汞、鉛、鋅）、以及抗生素和金屬抗性基因的濃度；(2) 通過以尼羅羅非魚（Oreochromis niloticus）作為模式魚的實驗室試驗，評估添加基於咖啡渣的活性炭和生物炭飼料對魚類生長和免疫力的影響；(3) 進行尼羅羅非魚攝食富碳飼料的暴露實驗，研究魚體中抗生素、金屬和微塑膠的攝取情況，以及其對魚腸道內細菌群落、抗生素和金屬抗性基因的影響；(4) 進行野外規模的魚類養殖實驗，研究魚類生長和免疫力，以及上述抗生素、金屬和微塑膠在魚體、魚塘水和沉積物中的積累情況。此外，本研究將透過宏基因組學方法，解析魚類腸道與環境中微生物群落的組成，以及抗生素與金屬抗性基因的分佈特徵，並進一步評估人類食用這些魚肉時，相關抗生素與重金屬殘留對人體健康的潛在風險。這項研究將解決養殖魚類因攝食飼料而同時暴露於抗生素、金屬和微塑膠的問題，這被認為是污染的主要來源，也是導致 抗生素和金屬抗性基因在魚體及環境中擴散的原因。研究結果將為設計新型飼料配方提供重要基礎，並深化對魚類因同時暴露於抗生素、金屬和微塑膠所引發的生態毒性的理解，以及對抗生素和金屬抗性基因在魚類及水生環境中共選擇機制的認識。

18500326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18500326.value: 領導者們的團隊導向人工智能應用對團隊產出的影響：團隊效率與團隊創造力的權衡

18500326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18500326.value: Prof LI, Ning Dr Mikel-Hong, Kris Dr Yu, Andrew

18500326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18500326.value: As organizations increasingly adopt AI––highly autonomous AI systems that can process vast amounts of data independently––there are likely to be drastic changes to the traditional understanding of leadership and team effectiveness. Although existing research has examined AI’s impact on individual work processes and organization-wide transformations, current knowledge lacks understanding of how AI reshapes leadership behaviors and subsequent team outcomes. Thus, the goal of this proposed research is to build theory about the impact of leaders’ team-focused AI use on two team-level outcomes critical for team functioning: team efficiency and team creativity. Drawing from the human–AI collaboration and algorithmic management literature, we predict that the greater the levels of leaders’ team-focused AI use, the higher the levels of directive leadership, which in turn, predicts higher levels of team efficiency. However, we also theorize a potential dark side: it results in lower levels of empowering leadership, which in turn, reduces team creativity. Drawing from the multidimensional scaling theory of team, we further predict that in teams with higher levels of skill differentiation, leaders not only use AI to take advantage of the highly skill-diverse teams and enhance efficiency, but are also motivated to consult team members for their unique perspectives that AI cannot generate. As a result, the effect of leaders’ team-focused AI use on directive leadership is strengthened while that on empowering leadership is attenuated, thereby boosting team efficiency while maintaining team creativity, respectively. The proposed study contributes to the literature by shifting the conversation on the impact of AI on individual outcomes to a team context and proposing that there could be both bright and dark sides of leaders’ team-focused AI use. In doing so, we open up new avenues for future research on the impact of AI on leadership styles—an overlooked area of AI research. Additionally, we illuminate the moderating role of team skill differentiation. In doing so, we contribute to our knowledge of when leaders’ team-focused AI can strengthen team efficiency while mitigating the negative association with team creativity, thus helping organizations understand how to design their teams to harness the power of leaders’ team-focused AI use. Finally, our work contributes to the strategic positioning of both HKSAR and China by contributing to an expanded knowledge of the costs and benefits of AI use in the team context. 隨著組織日益廣泛地採用人工智慧（即能夠獨立處理海量數據的高度自主化人工智慧系統），傳統的領導模式和團隊效能概念正在面臨劇烈變革。儘管現有研究已探討人工智能對個體工作流程及組織級轉型的影響，但對於人工智慧如何重塑領導行為及其對後續團隊結果的影響，目前仍缺乏深入理解。為此，本研究建構了一個理論框架，旨在探討領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用如何影響兩項關鍵的團隊層級產出——團隊效率與團隊創造力。 基於人機協作與演算法管理的相關文獻，本研究預測：領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用程度越高，其指導型領導強度亦隨之增強，進而顯著提升團隊效率；然而，本研究也指出了潛在的負面影響：此類人工智能應用會降低授權型領導強度，進而削弱團隊創造力。借鑑團隊多元尺度分析，本研究進一步預測：在技能差異化程度較高的團隊中，領導者不僅會利用人工智慧充分發揮團隊的技能優勢以提升效率，還會傾向於向團隊成員諮詢人工智能無法提供的獨特觀點。因此，領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用對指導型領導的促進作用得以強化，而對授權型領導的抑制作用則得到緩衝，從而在提升團隊效率的同時維繫了團隊創造力。 本研究將人工智能影響力的討論焦點由個體層面拓展至團隊情境，並揭示了領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用的雙刃劍效應，從而構成了重要的理論貢獻。這一拓展為未來對人工智能如何塑造領導風格的研究開闢了全新視角，填補了既有研究領域中長期被忽視的方向。此外，本研究闡明了團隊技能差異化的調節作用，揭示了領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用在何種情境下能夠同時提升團隊效率，並減弱對團隊創造力的負向關聯，進而指引組織如何藉由精準的團隊設計，以充分發揮領導者的團隊導向人工智能應用的效益。最後，本研究深化了對團隊情境下人工智慧應用成本與效益的理解，為香港特別行政區及國家的相關戰略定位與發展提供了學術支撐。

18600426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18600426.value: 雙語句法建構研究： 運用混合析因序貫多階段隨機試驗設計增強雙語句法意識及閱讀理解

18600426.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18600426.value: Prof Chou, KeeLee Prof Deacon, S. Hélène

18600426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600426.value: Children’s ability to understand written texts sets the foundation for learning at school and success at work. However, reading comprehension worldwide is declining, and educators are struggling to effectively support students’ mastery of reading comprehension, a task even more complex in a Hong Kong bilingual environment, where children must learn two structurally distinct languages, Chinese (L1) and English (L2). Approximately 13% of Hong Kong Chinese-English bilingual children experience reading comprehension difficulties in both languages, most often related to weaknesses in syntactic or morphosyntactic awareness. Our recently published studies suggest that syntactic structure binds lexical and sentence information, then contributes to reading comprehension through two pathways: syntax-to-lexicon and syntax-to-sentence. This project extends our previous investigations by developing the BiSyntax (Bilingual Intervention on Syntax) programs to strengthen these pathways in bilingual children. Employing an adaptive 4-arm randomized controlled trial (RCT) with a 2 × 2 factorial design and a 2-stage sequential multiple assignment randomized trial (SMART) design, we will: (1) develop L1 Chinese and L2 English syntax interventions and evaluate their effectiveness on improving syntactic awareness and reading comprehension in each language; (2) identify optimal pathways (i.e., syntax-to-lexicon, syntax-to-sentence, or combined) for improving bilingual children’s syntactic awareness and reading comprehension; (3) test whether increasing the intensity of one pathway or adding additional booth activities benefits participants who show no improvement from initial training; and (4) assess the crossover effects of Chinese syntactic training to English syntactic awareness and reading comprehension, and vice versa. We will recruit 378 Chinese-English bilingual children (ages 10–11) from eight primary schools. Participants will be randomized into one of three embedded two-stage adaptive interventions, which differ in their pathway sequence: starting with syntax-to-lexicon, starting with syntax-to-sentence, following a combined pathway, or a control group. All children will complete pretest, training, posttest 1, and posttest 2. During the pretest and posttest, participants will complete behavioral assessments of Chinese and English syntactic awareness and reading comprehension, and measures of control variables. By integrating factorial and adaptive methodologies, this project will advance precision education in both theory and practice. Theoretically, it will disentangle syntax-to-lexicon versus syntax-to-sentence pathways; test whether their effects are additive, synergistic, or redundant; and quantify cross-language transfer. Practically, our project will replace static group assignments and one-size-fits-all methods with individualized instruction that dynamically adapts to students’ ongoing responsiveness, and promote continuously refined strategies to improve both teaching effectiveness and academic outcomes. 兒童理解書面文本意義的能力是其在校學習和未來職業成功的基礎。然而，全球閱讀理解水準正在下降（PISA，2022），教育工作者在如何有效支持學生掌握閱讀理解能力方面面臨巨大挑戰。在香港的雙語環境中，這一任務更加複雜，因為兒童需要同時學習兩種結構差異顯著的語言——中文（L1）和英文（L2）。約有 13% 的香港中英雙語兒童在兩種語言中均存在閱讀理解困難（Tong 等，2018）。尤其是，這些困難往往與句法或形態句法意識的薄弱密切相關（Tong 等，2022）。我們近期發表的理論與實證研究表明，句法結構作為文本的“骨架”，將詞彙資訊與句子資訊整合在一起（如 Deacon 等，2024；Tong 等，2022；2025），並通過“句法到詞彙路徑”和“句法到句子路徑”促進閱讀理解的發展。本項目在此前研究基礎上進一步拓展，開發 BiSyntax（雙語句法干預）專案，以強化香港中英雙語兒童在這兩條路徑上的能力。 本研究將採用自我調整四組隨機對照試驗（RCT），結合 2 × 2 析因設計與兩階段序貫多重分配隨機試驗（SMART）設計，具體目標包括：（1）開發中文（L1）與英文（L2）句法干預方案，並評估其在提升兩種語言句法意識和閱讀理解方面的效果；（2）確定最優干預路徑（即句法到詞彙路徑、句法到句子路徑或二者結合）以提升雙語兒童的句法意識與閱讀理解；（3）檢驗對初始訓練未表現出改善的參與者，是否可通過增強某一路徑的訓練強度而獲益；（4）評估中文句法訓練對英文句法意識與閱讀理解的跨語言遷移效應，以及反向遷移效應。 本研究將從香港 8 所小學招募 378 名 10–11 歲的中英雙語兒童。參與者將被隨機分配至三種嵌套的兩階段自我調整干預方案之一，其區別在於路徑順序不同：從“句法到詞彙路徑”開始、從“句法到句子路徑”開始，或採用雙路徑結合模式。所有兒童將完成四個階段：前測、兩階段訓練、後測一和後測二。在前測與後測階段，參與者將完成中英文句法意識與閱讀理解的行為測評，以及相關控制變數的測量。 通過整合析因設計與自我調整方法，本專案將在理論與實踐層面推動精准教育的發展。在理論上，本研究將區分“句法到詞彙”與“句法到句子”的作用機制，檢驗其效應是相加、協同還是冗餘，並量化跨語言遷移效應。在實踐上，本項目將以個別化、動態調整的教學方式取代傳統靜態分組與“一刀切”教學模式，根據學生的持續反應靈活調整干預策略，從而不斷優化教學效果並提升學業表現。

18601126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601126.value: 個人化小睡模式對有亞臨床失眠及情緒困擾的年輕人之隨機對照試驗

18601126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18601126.value: Prof Chan, Antoni B. Prof Chan, Christian Shaunlyn Prof Chung, Ka Fai Prof HO, Yan Yee Fiona Prof Hsiao, Janet Hui-wen Miss Kojima, Hinako Dr Lee, Jung Jae Jay Prof Li, Jun Dr SUN, Iris Rong Wei

18601126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601126.value: Is napping good or bad for our mental health? Existing studies offered piecemeal and contradictory answers. This 'napping paradox' is at least partly a result of the differences in the study populations and the lack of specification of napping features, as well as the cross-sectional correlational design commonly used. Without unequivocal evidence, sleep authorities generally warn the public about the potential detrimental effects of napping on nighttime sleep, particularly for individuals with insomnia. Healthy individuals are loosely recommended to nap as needed or wanted, earlier in the day and for a short duration. The handful of clinical guidelines addressing napping tends to neglect specific factors, e.g. napping frequency, reasons, intentionality, and regularity. Even less has been done in understanding and optimising the effects of napping, and none, to our knowledge, in individuals with subclinical symptoms of insomnia, depression or anxiety, which are highly prevalent in the community, especially in university students. In this randomised control trial, a novel personalised nap-optimization protocol will be conducted, based on individuals’ naturalistic nap-mood pattern (Nap-Op intervention group, n=150), in addition to a general sleep health education (SH) for all participants (SH only control group, n = 100). Over 28 days (and nights), we shall comprehensively monitor the associations of napping behaviours and rest activity rhythms (RAR) with subsequent nighttime sleep quality and self-reported cognitive-affective states, using actigraphy watches, portable electroencephalographic (EEG) headbands, sleep diaries, and ecological momentary assessments (EMA). Utilising the deep learning approach of Hidden Markov Modelling (HMM) to quantify the 24-hour continuous patterns of activity (wake) and rest (daytime napping and nighttime sleep), in conjunction with other napping characteristics gathered through both objective tools and self-reports, we shall conduct the nap-optimization protocol to give napping recommendations on timing, duration, and frequency in planning for naps, based on the identified individualised RAR patterns as predictors of sleep and cognitive-affective states. To evaluate the efficacy of the nap-optimization protocol, in comparison to the general napping recommendations focusing on contraindications and precautions, we shall analyse the within- and between-group differences in mood outcomes, nighttime sleep quality, and also RAR, baseline and post-intervention. Assisted by machine learning, tracking technologies, and sophisticated statistical analyses, this study will help identify the 'who' (baseline individual characteristics as moderators) and the 'how' (behavioural and EEG features of naps) for optimising napping as an individualised evidence-based practice to achieve the goal of precision beyond medicine to community health for all. 小睡對我們的心理健康是好是壞？目前的研究結果不一。這種「小睡悖論」部分源於研究對象來自不一樣的群體、對小睡特徵缺乏明確界定，以及普遍採用橫斷面相關性研究設計。由於缺乏一致結論，權威的睡眠機構通常警告公眾：小睡或對夜間睡眠產生負面影響，尤其對於失眠患者；對於健康人士，通常僅籠統地建議按需要或意願小睡，並盡量安排在白天較早時段及持續較短時間。少數涉及小睡的臨床指南中，往往忽視了一些具體因素，例如小睡頻率、小睡原因、小睡意向及小睡規律性，更不用談探討及提升小睡的效果的相關研究。據我們所知，尚未有此類研究針對具有失眠、憂鬱或焦慮亞臨床症狀的人群，而這些症狀在普通人群中相當普遍，尤其是在大學生中。 這項隨機對照試驗將實施一項新穎的個人化小睡改善方案。該方案將根據每位參與者的自然小睡模式和情緒狀態進行設計（Nap-Op 介入組，n=150）；所有參與者都將接受睡眠衛生教育（SH），對照組（SH only n=100）。在為期 28 天的研究期間，我們將使用腕動計、可攜式腦電圖頭帶、睡眠日記以及生態瞬時評估（EMA），以監測小睡行為、休息活動節律（rest activity rhythms, RAR）、夜間睡眠質量，以及日間認知和情緒功能。再運用機械學習方法，量化全天 24 小時連續性的活動（清醒）與休息（白天小睡與夜間睡眠）模式，以識別個人獨有的休息活動節律，及其跟睡眠與認知和情緒狀態的關聯。基於此預測結果，我們將提供小睡時間、時長與頻率的建議，以在後續四週協助規劃小睡。我們將分析每位參與者於介入前後的情緒、夜間睡眠質量以及休息活動節律，從而了解此科學化小睡模式的效果。在機器學習、追蹤技術與高階統計分析的協助下，本研究將有助於分辨「誰」（作為調節變項的基線個體特徵）以及「如何」（小睡特徵），以將改善小睡為一種個人化、具實證基礎的實踐，進而實現精準化和邁向普及社區健康的目標。

18601526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601526.value: 中文字詞學習中的雙語“自我教学”：在整合性框架下、在粵語—普通話雙語兒童中再探“自我教学假说”

18601526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18601526.value: Prof Li, Hui Dr Wang, Hua-Chen

18601526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601526.value: This work seeks to advance scientific understanding of the processes by which bilingual children acquire robust written word knowledge through independent text reading. One of the most influential theories in explaining children’s written word learning is the Self-Teaching Hypothesis (Share, 1995), which emphasizes the centrality of phonological recoding (print-sound translation) in written word learning. This hypothesis has received abundant empirical support across writing systems, including Chinese; however, the original hypothesis did not consider bilingual contexts, and this gap has been mirrored in existing empirical studies. In a multilingual era, more than half of the world’s population is bilingual, and many children face a medium-of-instruction (MoI) mismatch. Such a mismatch often requires young children to pick up a new spoken language for schooling that differs from their mother tongue, thereby introducing obstacles to reading development and beyond. In Hong Kong specifically, the MoI for learning to read Chinese shifts between Cantonese (local dominant language) and Mandarin (national standard). Thus, a re-evaluation and refinement of the Self-Teaching Hypothesis in bilingual written word learning is urgent, with implications for both theory and educational practice. To this aim, this project is among the first to test the hypothesis in bilingual children learning to read the same writing system through two spoken languages. Beyond a MoI mismatch obstacle, Cantonese-Mandarin bilingual children must cope with a spoken-written register gap when the MoI is Cantonese, because Cantonese does not map onto written Chinese as closely as Mandarin. But how do bilingual children pick up written words differently in their mother tongue and MoI early in their lives? Relatedly, how do these children overcome the MoI mismatch obstacle and the spoken-written register gap over their reading development? While the PI’s pilot work on Grade 2 children in Hong Kong supports the feasibility of them reading Chinese words in Cantonese and Mandarin, it is not intuitive to unpack how they self-teach Chinese in two spoken languages. Therefore, three studies will be conducted to clarify children’s bilingual self-teaching development. The overarching aim is to uncover the underlying mechanisms by which Cantonese-Mandarin bilingual children self-teach Chinese in their mother tongue versus MoI (Studies 1 and 2) and how their ability to self-teach Chinese in two spoken languages develops longitudinally (Study 3). The findings will deepen understanding of critical mechanisms underlying literacy development across languages and will inform effective reading instruction in multilingual contexts. 本研究旨在深化我們對雙語兒童如何通過獨立文本閱讀，習得穩固書面詞彙知識的科學理解。解釋兒童書面詞彙學習最具影響力的理論之一，是「自我教學假說」（Self-Teaching Hypothesis；Share, 1995）。該假說提出，語音重編碼（即字形—語音轉換）是書面詞彙學習的核心機制，並已在包括中文在內的不同書寫系統中獲得廣泛支持。然而，原初假說並未考慮雙語情境，而現有實證研究亦延續了這項缺漏。 在當今多語並存的時代，全球逾半人口均為雙語使用者，許多兒童面對家庭語言與教學語言（Medium of Instruction, MoI）不一致的情況。這種不一致往往意味著幼兒必須為了接受學校教育而學習一種有別於母語的新口語（即教學語言），因而對其閱讀發展及其他方面構成挑戰。在香港，兒童學習中文閱讀時所採用的教學語言，主要在粵語（本地主導語言）與普通話（國家通用語言）之間有所不同。因此，針對雙語書面詞彙學習重新檢視並完善「自我教學假說」，已成為一項迫切需要；這不僅具有理論意義，亦對教育實踐具有重要啟示。為此，本研究將在雙語兒童通過兩種口語學習同一書寫系統的情境下，檢驗「自我教學假說」。 香港的粵語—普通話雙語兒童可能經歷兩種常見的家庭語言—教學語言不一致路徑：一是在家使用粵語、在學校以普通話學習；二是在家使用普通話、在學校以粵語學習。此外，以粵語作為教學語言會帶來顯著的口語—書面語語體差距，因為相較於普通話，粵語與現代書面中文的一致程度較低。因此，香港長期存在一項爭議：以粵語作為教學語言——對大多數兒童而言與其家庭語言一致，但口語—書面語語體差距顯著——抑或以普通話作為教學語言——與其家庭語言不一致，但口語—書面語語體差距較小——更有利於兒童的閱讀發展？本研究將通過三項實驗，為這項爭議提供實證依據。 本研究的整體目標，是闡明：（1）在閱讀發展初期，雙語兒童通過家庭語言與教學語言習得書面詞彙的方式有何不同；以及（2）隨着閱讀能力發展，他們如何應對家庭語言—教學語言不一致及顯著的口語—書面語語體差距。據此，研究一與研究二將考察粵語—普通話雙語兒童分別通過母語及教學語言自主習得中文書面詞彙的機制；研究三則將採用縱向研究設計，追蹤兒童運用兩種語言自主習得中文書面詞彙之能力的發展軌跡。研究結果將深化我們對跨語言讀寫能力發展的理解，並為多語環境下有效的閱讀教學提供實證指引。

18601826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601826.value: 活態文化遺產與青年身份認同：香港、倫敦、廣州及新加坡校訓與校歌的社會語言學研究

18601826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18601826.value: Prof Hou , Xingquan Prof Lee, John Chi Kin Prof O’Regan, John Dr Shen, Ruiqing

18601826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601826.value: School mottos and anthems are far more than slogans or songs; they are powerful symbols that reflect a school’s values and history. Recited or sung daily, they shape students’ sense of identity and belonging. While common themes like “love” or “diligence” often appear, there remains a gap in understanding why certain values emerge in specific cultural settings or how these symbols influence students’ identity and community ties. This project seeks to address this gap by exploring the social and cultural forces behind these traditions and their effects on youth. The study compares schools in four global cities: Hong Kong, London, Guangzhou, and Singapore. Hong Kong, with its unique mix of Eastern and Western influences, is the central focus. It is compared to London (a hub of Western education), Guangzhou (representing Chinese cultural roots without colonial history), and Singapore (a similarly multicultural society). This comparison acts as a “natural experiment” to uncover how factors like colonial history, national policies, and religious beliefs shape school symbols and their meanings. The research adopts an exploratory sequential mixed-methods design. In Phase I, we analyze 100-200 school mottos and anthems per city through archival and textual studies to identify key values and historical trends. Phase II builds on this by conducting fieldwork in selected schools, using a balanced selection strategy. It integrates qualitative methods (participant observation and focus-group interviews) with quantitative surveys of 300 students per city. This approach investigates how these school symbols function as “living heritage” and influence students’ identities and sense of community. The study draws on Critical Discourse Analysis to uncover hidden messages in symbols, the Ethnography of Communication to examine everyday interactions, and Social Identity Theory to assess psychological impacts. This integrated framework bridges broad cultural trends with individual experiences, offering a fresh, comprehensive view of how school traditions pass on cultural heritage. Ultimately, the findings will offer practical insights for educators and policymakers on using school symbols to foster community and enhance educational outcomes, aligning with UNESCO’s Sustainable Development Goals (e.g., SDG 4, Quality Education). By focusing on Hong Kong while contributing to global knowledge, this project aims to make a meaningful impact in sociolinguistics, cultural studies, and education, emphasizing local relevance with international significance. 校訓和校歌不僅僅是口號或歌曲，它們是反映學校價值觀和歷史的重要象徵。學生每天唸或唱這些內容，會影響他們對自己的認同感和對學校的歸屬感。雖然很多學校都有「愛」、「勤」等共同主題，但我們對兩個問題還不夠了解：一是為什麼某些價值觀會在特定的文化環境中出現；二是這些象徵到底如何影響學生的身份認同和社群連結。本研究就是要填補這個知識空白，探討這些傳統背後的社會文化因素，以及它們對年輕人的影響。 我們會系統性地比較四個國際城市（香港、倫敦、廣州和新加坡）的學校。香港是我們的研究重心，因為它融合了東西方文化；我們把它跟倫敦（代表西方教育體系）、廣州（代表沒有殖民歷史的中華文化）和新加坡（也是多元文化社會）做對照。這樣的比較就像一個「自然實驗」，可以幫助我們釐清殖民歷史、國家政策、宗教信仰等因素，如何影響學校象徵的選擇和它們的意義。 研究方法採用「探索性序列混合設計」。第一階段，我們會在每個城市分析一百到兩百則校訓和校歌，透過文獻檔案和文本分析，找出其中的主要價值觀和歷史變化趨勢。第二階段，我們會根據第一階段的結果，挑選有代表性的學校進行實地調查。我們會兼顧不同類型的學校，並同時使用質性方法（包括實地觀察和焦點小組訪談）和量化方法（對每個城市三百名學生進行問卷調查），來探討這些學校象徵如何作為「活態文化遺產」發揮作用，以及它們如何影響學生的身份認同和社群歸屬感。 我們的分析會運用三個理論視角：批判性話語分析（用來發掘象徵中隱藏的訊息）、溝通民族誌（用來觀察師生日常的互動），以及社會認同理論（用來評估這些象徵對學生心理層面的影響）。這個整合性的架構，可以幫助我們把大環境的文化趨勢和個別學生的親身經歷連結起來，從而對學校傳統如何傳承文化遺產，得到一個全新而全面的認識。 最後，我們的研究結果能為教育工作者和政策制定者提供實用的建議，協助他們善用學校象徵來增強學生的凝聚力、提升教學品質，這也呼應了聯合國可持續發展目標中的「優質教育」（SDG 4）。這項計劃以香港為核心，同時也具有國際比較的視野，期望在社會語言學、文化研究和教育領域產生實際貢獻，真正做到「立足本地，放眼世界」。

18602026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602026.value: 疍家話作為中國海上絲綢之路上的語言介面：接觸、演變與趨同

18602026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602026.value: Prof Peyraube, Alain Prof Simmons, Richard Van Ness

18602026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602026.value: The Maritime Silk Road (MSR), active from the 2nd century BCE to the 19th century CE, was a crucial network of cross-cultural exchange, with multilingual port hubs like Guangzhou facilitating Eurasian trade. While existing research has extensively covered material exchanges and elite actors, it critically overlooks the sociolinguistic processes mediated by subaltern communities (Gap 1). This oversight is compounded by contact linguistics’ limited focus on maritime multilingualism and marginalized agency (Gap 2), as well as fragmented research on the Tanka people, who historically served as crucial linguistic and trade intermediaries in South Chinese ports. Despite their centuries-long role as a maritime linguistic conduit bridging Sinitic, Austronesian, and Eurasian traders, no study systematically examines how the Tanka language functioned as a dynamic linguistic interface between maritime and terrestrial language spheres, nor documents its endangered state in Southeast China (Gap 3). Building on PI’s five grants for Tanka studies (3 RGC and 2 University grants), this project reconceptualizes the Tanka not merely as subjects but as a historically evolving linguistic interface that mediated multilingual encounters along the MSR. Using a combined qualitative and quantitative approach, we employ structured interviews as the primary method to collect extensive linguistic data on Tanka language varieties from key MSR ports: Guangzhou, Quanzhou, Haikou, and Beihai, encompassing six field sites with 12 informants. This includes a substantial corpus of phonetic, lexical, and grammatical features, alongside naturalistic speech samples. Grounded in theories of language contact and convergence, the project traces the historical trajectory from contact-induced change to linguistic evolution and, ultimately, convergence. We employ an integrated three-part analytical framework examining contact (mechanisms of language interaction and power dynamics), evolution (diachronic changes in Tanka language), and convergence (linguistic outcomes in maritime contact zones). The project generates transformative impacts across multiple dimensions. Theoretically, it challenges unidirectional diffusion models by introducing the Port Language Chain Model, which emphasizes Tanka agency in multidirectional transmission. It also proposes the Maritime Convergence Nexus Model, redefining marginalized groups as active architects of trade lingua franca. Methodologically, it establishes protocols for documenting endangered maritime contact languages applicable globally. Practically, the project produces the first Dictionary of Tanka Language, an essential resource for preserving intangible cultural heritage, while providing evidence-based insights for equitable language policies in multilingual port cities. By positioning Tanka at the forefront of revising MSR linguistic history, this project redefines our understanding of language contact, convergence, and subaltern resilience in globalization. 自公元前2世紀便已初具雛形，影響延續至公元19世紀的海上絲綢之路，不僅是一條商品流通的通道，更是一個至關重要的跨文化交流網絡。以廣州為代表的多語港口樞紐，成為了歐亞貿易往來的關鍵節點。現有的研究雖然已大量探討過物質商品的交換以及精英階層的歷史活動，但卻明顯忽略了由底層群體所推動的社會-語言的變異與演變過程。這個缺口，也因語言接觸研究對海洋多語現象及邊緣群體語言主體性的關注不足而變得更加顯著。同時，關於疍家人的研究至今仍處零散狀態，但他們在歷史上正是中國南方港口中不可或缺的語言與貿易中介。數百年來，疍家人一直扮演著海上語言管道的角色，連結著漢語、南島語以及歐亞各貿易群體的其他語言。然而，現有的研究卻仍然無法回答疍家話是如何作為海洋與陸地語言場域之間的動態界面而存在的這一問題，也未能記錄其在當前中國東南沿海急遽消失的現狀。 在前期疍家話研究基礎之上，本項目試圖進一步從新的視角理解疍家話：不只將其視為一個靜態客體，更視其為語言歷史接觸過程中的一種動態語言界面，並持續在海上絲綢之路沿線的多語接觸中發揮中介功能。本研究採用質性與量化相結合的方法，以結構式訪談為主要工具。我們在廣州、泉州、海口、北海等重要港口，對疍家話的各類變體進行了廣泛的語言調查，共涵蓋六個調查點與十二位發音人。數據內容豐富，包含語音、詞彙、語法，以及自然語料。基於語言接觸與趨同理論，我們試圖追溯疍家話中因語言接觸而產生的變異、語言內部機制驅動的歷史演變，及與其他語言趨同的歷史軌跡。分析架構分為三個環環相扣的層面：接觸層（檢視語言互動的機制與權力關係）、演變層（考察疍家話的歷時變化），以及趨同層（探討海上接觸地帶中的語言結果）。 本項目預期在多個方面產生重要影響。在理論層面，我們挑戰傳統的單向擴散模型，提出「港口語言鏈模式」，強調疍家群體在多向傳播中的主動角色。同時，本研究亦提出「海洋趨同樞紐模型」，將過去被邊緣化的群體重新定位為貿易通用語的積極建構者。在方法層面，我們將建立一套適用於全球瀕危海上接觸語言的記錄規範。在實踐層面，本項目將編纂首部疍家話詞典，為非物質文化遺產的保護提供關鍵資源，也為多語港口城市制定更具公平性的語言政策，提出以實證為基礎的具體建議。透過將疍家人置於改寫海上絲綢之路語言史的核心位置，本項目期待著能重新定義我們對語言接觸、趨同的理解，同時由此進一步深化對全球化進程中底層群體韌性的認識。

18602126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602126.value: 同舟共濟：建構緩解老年群體孤獨感的同伴支持模式

18602126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602126.value: Prof Choi, Namkee G Prof Chou, Kee Lee Prof Warner, Lisa M. Prof YEUNG, Yuen Lan Dannii

18602126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602126.value: Globally, three major trends have emerged: 1)rapid population aging; 2)a growing loneliness epidemic, impacting mental and cognitive health of older adults; and 3)despite these challenges, today’s older adults are better educated and possess greater socioemotional resources than previous generations, positioning them as potential active contributors to society. Integrating these trends, an empirically supported strategy to combat loneliness among older adults is to develop a peer-support model through volunteering, whereby older adults deliver non-specialist psychosocial interventions to lonely peers. In a completed project, our team successfully conducted a dual randomized controlled trial (RCT), in which we trained 185(vs.190 active controls) older volunteers feeling lonely to deliver psychosocial interventions to 1,151 vulnerable peers feeling lonely. We found significant mutual benefits: 1)volunteers experienced reduced loneliness and improved mental health at 6- and 12-month follow-ups against active controls; and 2)recipients reported loneliness reduction and mental health improvement at 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month follow-ups against their active controls. However, key questions remain:1)Are the effects of this peer-support model reciprocal at the dyad (volunteer-recipient pair) level? 2)What mechanisms drive these benefits at the individual and interpersonal levels? 3)What dyadic relationship factors predict the effects for both? Theoretically and methodologically, research predominantly focused on either volunteers or recipients, largely overlooking the reciprocal effects and interpersonal dynamics, despite empirical evidence supporting their importance for intervention outcomes. To address these gaps, our proposed dual RCT comprises two interconnected trials. In the Volunteer RCT, 384 lonely older adults will be randomized to either lay counselor volunteer groups to deliver psychosocial interventions or active control groups. In the Recipient RCT, a separate sample of 192 lonely older recipients will be randomly assigned to one of two psychosocial interventions delivered by volunteers. Volunteers and recipients will be randomly matched in a one-to-one dyadic structure. We will examine: 1)the effects of the peer-support model on both volunteers and recipients at individual and dyadic levels; 2)underlying mechanisms; and 3)whether and how interpersonal perception and exchange during intervention delivery predict outcomes. Data will be collected at baseline, during intervention delivery, and at 3- and 6-month follow-ups. The primary outcome is loneliness; secondary outcomes include psychological well-being, perceived stress, depression, anxiety, and cognitive function. Our project will 1)address significant theoretical and methodological gaps; 2)provide comprehensive understanding on why, how, and for whom models reduce loneliness by combining a dual RCT with daily dyadic assessments; and 3)inform development of peer-support models to promote mental health. 全球範圍內，出現了三大趨勢：1）人口快速老化；2）孤獨感疫情日益加劇，影響年長者的心理健康與認知功能；以及3）儘管面臨這些挑戰，當今的年長者比前幾代受過更好的教育，並擁有更豐富的社會情緒資源，使他們能夠成為社會的積極貢獻者。結合這些趨勢，一項經實證支持、用以對抗年長者孤獨感的策略，是透過志願服務發展同儕支持模式，讓年長者能夠向孤獨的同儕提供非專業的心理社會介入。 在一項已完成的計畫中，我們的團隊成功進行了一項雙重隨機對照試驗，我們訓練了185名（對比190名活躍對照組）感到孤獨的長者義工，向1,151名感到孤獨的弱勢同儕提供心理社會介入。我們發現了顯著的互惠效益。然而，仍有關鍵問題待解：1）這種同儕支持模式的效果在配對（志願者－接受者）層面上是否具有互惠性？2）在個人和人際層面上，驅動這些效益的機制為何？3）哪些配對關係因素能預測雙方的效果？在理論和方法上，研究多半聚焦於志願者或接受者其中一方，大幅忽略了互惠效果和人際動態，儘管實證證據支持這些因素對介入結果的重要性。 為填補這些缺口，我們提出的雙重隨機對照試驗包含兩個相互關聯的試驗。在志願者隨機對照試驗中，384名孤獨的年長者將被隨機分配到非專業諮商義工組，以提供心理社會介入，或分配到活躍對照組。在接受者隨機對照試驗中，另一組192名孤獨的年長接受者將被隨機分配到由志願者提供的兩種心理社會介入之一。義工和接受者將以一對一的配對結構進行隨機配對。我們將檢視：1）同儕支持模式對志願者和接受者在個人及配對層面上的效果；2）其潛在機制；以及3）介入過程中的人際知覺與交換是否及如何預測結果。資料將於基準點、介入進行期間，以及3個月和6個月的追蹤時收集。主要結果指標為孤獨感；次要結果指標包括心理幸福感、知覺壓力、憂鬱、焦慮和認知功能。 我們的計畫將：1）填補重要的理論與方法學缺口；2）透過結合雙重隨機對照試驗與每日配對評估，提供對模式為何、如何以及對誰能降低孤獨感的全面理解；以及3）為發展促進心理健康的同儕支持模式提供參考依據。

18602526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602526.value: 語言到讀寫：韻律、句法與語用技能對聽障及聽損兒童閱讀發展的縱貫性貢獻

18602526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602526.value: Dr Chen, Yuan Dr CHUNG, Wei-Lun Dr YUEN, Chi Pun Kevin

18602526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602526.value: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) children show significant delays in language and reading development. Prosody (speech rhythm), syntax (structure rules), and pragmatics (social communication) are core language components that develop rapidly during early childhood and are essential for reading development. Despite their importance, the interrelationships among these language domains and their longitudinal impact on reading development in DHH children remain unclear. To address this gap, this three-year longitudinal study aims to (1) investigate the interconnections between these skills in preschool-aged DHH children; (2) examine their co-development across the preschool-to-primary-school transition; and (3) determine their longitudinal contributions to reading achievement. A total of 300 Mandarin-speaking DHH children with bilateral severe-to-profound hearing loss (better-ear pure-tone average > 70 dB HL at 0.5, 1, 2, and 4 kHz) and 300 age-matched typically-developing (TD) children will be assessed annually from kindergarten year 2 (K2) through Grade 1 (G1) on prosodic (lexical tone identification, phrasal boundary, sentential intonation), syntactic (word order, morphosyntax, grammar), and pragmatic (introduction and responsiveness, nonverbal communication, social-emotional attunement, executive function, and negotiation) skills. Reading outcomes (word reading and reading comprehension) will be assessed at G1. Foundational language and cognitive abilities will be measured annually as controls. A Bayesian multigroup confirmatory factor analysis will model the interconnections between prosody, syntax, and pragmatics in K2 DHH and TD children (Objective 1), hypothesizing weaker interconnections among these domains in DHH children. A Bayesian multigroup latent growth model will estimate and compare the developmental trajectories of these domains between groups from K2 to G1 (Objective 2), anticipating slower linear growth in DHH children. A Bayesian multigroup structural equation model will examine how initial levels and growth rates in each domain predict G1 reading outcomes across groups (Objective 3), hypothesizing that predictive weights will be weaker across all domains for DHH children compared to TD peers. Theoretically, this study advances the prosody-syntax interface model and the Reading Systems Framework by clarifying the longitudinal interdependencies between prosodic, syntactic, and pragmatic skills, highlighting their critical influence on reading development under constrained auditory input conditions in DHH children. Practically, our longitudinal data will help educators identify critical developmental stages and delays in prosodic, syntactic, and pragmatic skills among DHH children, guiding targeted support during their preschool-to-primary-school transition. By integrating theoretical insights with practice, our research will inform policymakers on resource allocation for supporting language and literacy development, advocating for equitable systems to enhance DHH children’s long-term academic success. 聽障兒童在語言與閱讀發展上明顯落後。幼兒時期，韻律（語音節律）、句法（結構規則）與語用（社交溝通）等核心語言能力迅速發展，且對日後閱讀能力的建立至關重要。然而，目前仍缺乏研究探討這三種能力之間的內在關聯，發展軌跡，以及它們對聽障兒童閱讀發展的長期影響。為填補此研究缺口，本三年期縱貫研究旨在：（1）探究學前聽障兒童在韻律、句法與語用能力間的相互關係；（2）追蹤這三項能力的發展軌跡（從幼兒園到小學）；（3）了解它們對後續閱讀發展的縱貫預測作用。 本研究預計招募300名以中文為母語的聽障兒童（較佳耳於0.5、1、2、4 kHz之純音平均聽閾＞70 dB HL）以及300名年齡匹配的聽力正常兒童（TD），自幼兒園中班（K2）至小學一年級（G1）期間，每年進行一次評估。評量內容涵蓋韻律（聲調辨識、短語邊界、語句語調）、句法（語序、形態句法、語法）及語用（開啟話題與回應、非語言溝通、社會情緒調和、執行功能與協商）等能力，並於G1階段測量閱讀成果（認字與閱讀理解）。基礎語言與認知能力則每年納入測量，作為控制變項。 在分析方法上，本研究首先採用貝葉斯多群組驗證性因素分析，針對K2階段的聽障與TD兒童的韻律、句法與語用結構建模以了解他們之間的關聯（目標一），我們預期聽障兒童在這三個能力間的關聯程度將低於TD兒童。其次，本研究將採用貝葉斯多群組潛在成長模型比較兩組兒童從K2至G1期間三項能力的成長軌跡（目標二），我們假設聽障兒童的線性成長速率相較TD兒童普遍較慢。最後，本研究通過貝葉斯多群組結構方程模型以檢視各能力的起始水平與成長速率對G1閱讀表現的預測力（目標三），並假設聽障兒童在各領域的預測強度均低於TD兒童。 在理論層面上，本研究將有助於深化韻律-句法介面模型（prosody-syntax interface model）與閱讀系統架構理論（Reading Systems Framework），進一步釐清韻律、句法與語用在縱貫時間軸上的相互依賴關係，並凸顯在聽覺輸入受限的情況下，這些能力對聽障兒童閱讀發展的關鍵作用。在實務應用上，本研究的縱貫資料可協助教育工作者掌握聽障兒童在韻律、句法與語用層面的重要發展階段與可能落後徵兆，從而在學前至小學的轉銜期間，提供更精準的教學介入。透過理論與實務的雙軌並進，本研究成果亦能作為政策制定者在資源配置上的實證依據，推動更公平的語言與讀寫支持體系，進而促進聽障兒童的長期學業發展。

18602726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602726.value: 作為翻譯之城的香港：語言與文化動態中的地方意義建構

18602726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602726.value: For over half a century, Hong Kong’s visual identity has been shaped by the extraordinary density of urban texts, where Chinese and English signs created a distinctive streetscape that symbolized the city’s vitality and cross-cultural character. These texts form a holistic urban discourse that shapes social interactions and cultural meanings. Although recent regulations have led to the removal of many large-scale signs, Hong Kong remains a text-rich environment where multiple languages and scripts continue to shape public spaces, urban discourses, and cultural identity in evolving forms reflecting social and technological change. Previous studies have focused mainly on contemporary practices or isolated periods, often overlooking the evolution of urban textscapes amid shifting sociocultural and geopolitical realities, and the impact of physical carriers (from three-dimensional signage to mobile displays) on the city’s semiotic ecosystem. The interplay among text display, urban density, and architectural styles remains undertheorized, as does the spectrum of translation practices mediating between literal linguistic conversion and broader cultural acculturation. This project examines public signs in Hong Kong as a holistic system of everyday discourse, situating developments from 2015 to 2027 within a broader historical and sociopolitical context. Through fieldwork across diverse neighborhoods, from text-rich vernacular areas to text-poor financial districts, I will investigate the interaction of signage with color schemes, architectural details, and other semiotic resources in constructing urban visual identity. The research theorizes anew China-Western convergence by conceptualizing Hong Kong as a “city of translations”, where language and semiotic affordances mediate cultural interaction across China, the West, and beyond. Archival research and theoretical analysis of collected data will support an innovative framework for urban languages and semiotics, and the role of translation in shaping civic participation. An interactive digital platform will be established to serve as both a research corpus and a public engagement tool, which will enable continuous documentation of Hong Kong’s evolving linguistic landscape and fostering community participation in cultural preservation and creative imagination. This project will advance our understanding of urban spaces as mediators of cultural exchange, providing insights for language policy, heritage conservation, and urban planning. By conceptualizing Hong Kong as a city of translations, it will contribute new theoretical perspectives to sociolinguistics, translation studies, and cultural studies, and innovate our understanding of multilingual urban environments amid rapid technological and social change. 半個世紀以來，香港的城市形象一直深受繁密街頭文字的影響。中英文招牌遍布大街小巷，塑造出獨特的城市景觀，展現香港充滿活力、東西文化交匯的特質。這些城市文字共同構成一套完整的城市話語系統，影響人們的社會互動和文化理解。雖然近年政府規管措施令不少大型招牌被拆除，但香港仍然是一個文字豐富的城市空間。多種語言和文字系統持續出現在公共空間中，並隨著社會和科技的變遷，以新的形式影響城市話語和文化認同。 前人研究大多集中於當代現象或個別歷史時期，較少關注城市文字景觀如何在不斷變化的社會文化和地緣政治環境中演變，也較少探討文字載體由立體招牌到流動電子顯示屏的轉變，如何影響香港的符號生態系統。此外，文字展示方式、城市密度與建築風格之間的關係仍缺乏充分理論探討，而翻譯實踐如何從語言轉換延伸至更廣泛的文化轉化與適應，同樣有待深入研究。 本研究把香港公共標示視為一個整體的日常話語系統，並將2015年至2027年間的發展放置於更廣泛的歷史和社會政治背景中加以考察。透過在不同社區進行田野調查，包括文字密集的民間街區及文字較少的金融區，我將探討招牌如何與色彩配置、建築細節及其他符號資源互相配合，共同塑造香港的城市視覺形象。 本研究亦將重新思考中國與西方文化融合的過程，並提出「翻譯之城」的概念來理解香港。在這座城市裡，語言和各種符號資源促進中國、西方以及其他文化之間的交流與互動。透過檔案研究和理論分析，本研究將建立一套有關城市語言與符號學的新理論框架，並探討翻譯在促進公民參與中的作用。同時，研究將建立一個互動數碼平台，既作為研究資料庫，也作為公眾參與工具。該平台能持續記錄香港不斷變化的語言景觀，並鼓勵社區參與文化保存及創意想像。 本研究將深化我們對城市空間作為文化交流媒介的理解，並為語言政策、文化遺產保育和城市規劃提供新的見解。透過將香港概念化為一座「翻譯之城」，本研究將為社會語言學、翻譯研究和文化研究帶來新的理論視角，並推動我們重新理解在科技與社會急速變遷下的多語城市環境。

18602926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602926.value: 探討成就目標、遊戲信念和遊戲性在促進高小學生及其照顧者幸福感的角色

18602926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602926.value: Dr Fung , Wing Kai Dr Lam, Chun Bun Ian

18602926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602926.value: A 2023 survey commissioned by the Hong Kong government from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, revealed that 6.9% of local students aged 6 to 17 manifested suicidal behaviours, 6.1% had anxiety and 5.4% suffered depression. Despite continuous government efforts to foster well-being, the mental health situation of primary education stakeholders, among them children, parents, and teachers, and including increases in student suicide and teacher burnout, is worrying. On the one hand, Hong Kong’s highly competitive and result-dependent academic system shapes children’s performance-oriented mindset. On the other, Hong Kong parents highly value academic achievement, investing considerable time and finances to promote their children’s subject knowledge through participating in extra tuition classes or enrichment programmes at the expense of more holistic development. Although people generally recognise that play is essential to facilitate learning and development in early childhood, school-aged children’s need to play tends to be downplayed or disregarded to squeeze extra time for academic activities. This study proposes a framework that acknowledges that children’s achievement goal orientation and playfulness are both important factors in sustaining their well-being through the senior primary years. Other influential factors include the goal orientation and play beliefs of parents and teachers that affect their parenting styles, parent-child conflicts, and teacher-child relatedness, and their own well-being. The potential influences of these factors on children’s academic skills (e.g., reading and mathematics) will also be explored. The study employs a longitudinal design with three data collection points over three years (Time 1 - primary 4, Time 2 – primary 5, Time 3 - primary 6), incorporating a series of survey and direct-assessed measures, to collect data from 300 participating children and their parents and teachers. Multilevel path analysis will be used to estimate the longitudinal predictions among the variables. This study expands and augments current theory by examining the unique roles of achievement goal orientation and playfulness in the well-being of senior primary school children. Practically, it also informs alternative approaches to improving the well-being of parents and teachers in the Hong Kong primary education sector. 香港政府於2023年委託香港中文大學進行一項調查顯示，在本地6至17歲的學童當中，6.9%出現自殺行為，6.1%有焦慮症狀，5.4%患有抑鬱症。儘管政府致力促進學童幸福感，但是小學教育相關持份者，包括兒童、家長及教師的心理健康狀況，以及上升的學生自殺個案和教師倦怠情況，都令人憂慮及值得關注。 香港的教育制度競爭激烈並以成績作為根據，塑造了學童的表現導向思維。另一方面，香港的家長高度重視學童的學業成績，投入大量時間和金錢讓子女參加補習班或各類增潤課程以提升子女的學科知識，犧牲了他們的全面發展。雖然社會普遍認同遊戲對促進幼兒學習與發展至關重要，但往往低估或忽視學齡兒童對遊戲的需求，以便騰出更多時間去進行學習活動。 本研究提出一個理論框架，認同兒童的成就目標導向（achievement goal orientation）及遊戲性（playfulness）均是維持其高小階段幸福感的重要因素。其他具影響力的因素還包括家長與教師的目標導向和對遊戲的信念，這些因素會影響他們的教養模式、親子衝突、師生關係，以及自身的幸福感。本研究亦會探討上述因素對兒童學業能力（如閱讀及數學能力）的潛在影響。 本研究採用縱向研究設計，在三年間進行三次數據收集（時間點一：小學四年級；時間點二：小學五年級；時間點三：小學六年級），結合問卷調查及直接評估測量方法，向300名參與研究的兒童及其家長和教師收集數據。研究將採用多層次路徑分析（multilevel path analysis），估計各變項之間的縱向預測關係。 本研究透過探討成就目標導向及遊戲性在高小學生幸福感中的獨特作用，擴展並深化現有理論。在實務層面上，研究結果亦可在提升本港小學教育界家長及教師的幸福感方面，提供新的思路及方案。

18603726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18603726.value: 速進體育課堂的主觀時間體驗

18603726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18603726.value: Dr Chan, Ching Yat Roy Prof Ha, Sau Ching Amy Prof Hettinga, Florentina Dr Leung, Ka Man Prof Marcora, Samuele Dr Tse, Choi Yeung Andy

18603726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18603726.value: Adolescent physical inactivity is a major public health concern, associated with long-term risks of obesity, cardiovascular disease, and poor mental health into adulthood. In Hong Kong, where academic attainment is strongly prioritised and PE occupies limited curricular space, students’ opportunities to experience activity as enjoyable and meaningful are restricted. Existing interventions have typically addressed structural barriers or used technology as novelty, but these approaches have rarely produced lasting change. This project adopts a psychophysiological approach, focusing on how pupils experience the passage of time during PE and whether this experience is linked to enjoyment, value, and sustained motivation. Time perception in this context refers to how long an activity feels while it is happening and how its duration is remembered. Activities perceived as shorter than chronological time are more likely to be recalled positively, enjoyed, and repeated. Conversely, when time drags, activities are often considered effortful or aversive. The project investigates whether these temporal impressions can serve as an innovative mechanism for improving adolescent engagement in PE and establishing positive, healthy behaviours that can be sustained into adulthood. Approximately 140 students aged 13–15 will participate in a longitudinal repeated-measures study embedded within standard 60-minute lessons. Baseline assessments will capture pupils’ typical experiences of time, enjoyment, and motivation in non-standardised PE sessions, alongside the simple physiological index of heart rate variability (HRV) which provides a practical, non-invasive marker of attentional regulation. Students will complete three structured lessons delivered through an approach-motivation framework designed to be autonomy-supportive, mastery-focused, and consistent across schools. After each session, pupils will report perceived time, enjoyment, task value, behavioural intention, and effort, with effort distinguished as both aversive cost and motivational engagement. HRV will be recorded during the sessions to provide supporting evidence of the psychophysiological processes associated with temporal experience. A six-month follow-up will assess how lessons are recalled and whether experiences of time are associated with longer-term motivation and intention. By reconceptualising PE as both a behavioural and temporal experience, FAST PE provides a theoretically grounded framework for enhancing adolescent activity and guiding future interventions, ensuring that innovations, including technology, are not short-term novelties but aligned with how time is perceived. Findings may inform curriculum design, teacher development, and public health strategy, while shaping how pupils experience, recall, and value activity. The project lays innovative foundations for sustained behavioural practices and investigates how perceptions of time influence engagement across wider contexts. 青少年缺乏體能活動是一項重大的公共衞生問題，與成年後肥胖、心血管疾病及心理健康欠佳等長期風險相關。在香港，學業成績備受重視，而體育課在課程中所佔的時間有限，學生因而較少有機會將體能活動體驗為愉快且有意義的經歷。現有介入措施一般著重處理結構性障礙，或利用科技帶來新鮮感，但這些方法甚少能產生持久的改變。本研究從心理生理學角度出發，聚焦於學生在體育課中如何感受時間的流逝，以及這種體驗是否與愉悅感、價值感及持續動機有關。 本研究所指的時間知覺，是指活動進行期間其持續時間在主觀上給人的感受，以及事後如何回憶該活動所經歷的時間。當活動在主觀上感覺比實際鐘錶時間短時，人們較可能對其產生正面回憶、感到愉快，並願意再次參與。相反，當時間感覺過得緩慢時，活動往往會被評價為費力或令人抗拒。本研究旨在探討這些時間印象能否成為提升青少年參與體育課，以及建立可延續至成年期之正面健康行為的一項作用機制。 約140名13至15歲學生將參與一項嵌入常規60分鐘體育課堂的縱向重複測量研究。基線評估將記錄學生在非標準化體育課堂中一般的時間體驗、愉悅感及動機，並同時測量心率變異性（heart rate variability, HRV）。HRV是一項簡便而非侵入性的生理指標，可作為注意力調節的實用標記。學生其後將完成三節結構化體育課，課堂採用趨近動機（approach motivation）框架設計，強調自主支持、掌握能力，並確保不同學校之間的教學方式具有一致性。 每節課後，學生將報告其主觀時間知覺、愉悅感、任務價值、行為意向及努力程度；其中，努力程度將分別從令人抗拒的成本及動機投入兩個層面加以區分。研究亦會在課堂期間記錄HRV，以提供有關時間體驗相關心理生理歷程的輔助證據。六個月後將進行跟進評估，以了解學生如何回憶這些課堂，以及早期的時間體驗是否與較長期的動機及行為意向相關。 FAST PE將體育課重新理解為同時具有行為與時間體驗的活動，從而提供一個具理論基礎且可擴展的框架，以促進青少年的體能活動。研究結果可為未來的課程設計、教師專業發展及公共衞生策略提供參考，其影響亦可延伸至體育課以外的領域。透過塑造學生如何體驗、回憶及評價體能活動，本研究有助奠定終身健康行為實踐的基礎，並為進一步探討時間知覺如何影響更廣泛情境中的參與及投入，開拓具影響力的研究方向。

18604026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18604026.value: 華人社會在家自學的質性縱貫研究

18604026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18604026.value: Dr Hsu, Yung-kang Prof Qian, Haiyan Prof Wang, Hui-Lan

18604026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18604026.value: While homeschooling has been growing globally, most research on this topic relies on cross-sectional studies and parental accounts, which have lacked longitudinal evidence on how parents and children navigate challenges and sustain homeschooling during educational transitions. This gap is particularly pronounced in non-Western, high-stakes Chinese contexts where educational credentials are highly valued, and families face unique sociocultural and regulatory tensions. Without longitudinal, child-inclusive insights, policymakers and educators lack the evidence to effectively address educational diversity and emerging educational models in the post-pandemic and AI era. Accordingly, we propose a longitudinal study to investigate the educational trajectories of Chinese homeschooling families while disentangling the processes and outcomes related to child development and transitions. Building on the PI’s foundational study (2021-2023) of homeschooling families in Taipei and Hong Kong—two Chinese cities with shared cultural backgrounds but differing legal approaches to homeschooling—the proposed study tracks the original cohort as their adolescent children face transitions (e.g., university admissions, vocational accreditation). We will also recruit 30-50 new families who began homeschooling recently to capture generational and contextual shifts, such as post-pandemic motivations and digital learning adaptations. The study will employ a qualitative longitudinal research (QLR) design. Semi-structured interviews will be conducted with parents from both the original and new cohorts to explore their views, practices, and challenges. Interviews will also be conducted with children aged 12+ to examine their perspectives and outcomes. Observations on pedagogical interactions, family dynamics, and learning environments will complement the interview narratives—researchers will conduct field visits during typical learning times for a sub-sample of families in both cohorts (approximately 10-15, selected for diversity and willingness). An Iterative Thematic Inquiry (ITI) approach will be adopted to analyze data, along with systematic within-family and cross-cohort comparisons, to identify continuities, changes, factors shaping trajectories, and outcomes. The study’s significance lies in its unique capacity to generate globally relevant knowledge on how homeschooling, as an alternative educational pathway, is sustained, adapted, or discontinued amidst challenging transitions and contexts. By longitudinally tracking families and incorporating children’s voices within the Chinese context, our findings will offer theoretical insights into the negotiation of educational agency and structural constraints, while (re-)imagining educational futures relevant to societies facing the rise of emerging educational models. The findings will also inform policies on educational diversification, offering empirical evidence for designing supportive frameworks for non-traditional learning in competitive ecosystems. 儘管在家自學於全球日益普及，但目前關於這主題的研究大多依賴於橫斷面研究和家長敘述，缺乏縱向研究證據來揭示家長和學童如何在教育轉型期應對挑戰、持續在家自學。在非西方、高風險的華人社會背景下，這項研究空白尤為突出。在華人社會，教育證書備受重視，家庭面對著獨特的社會文化和監管壓力。當缺乏有關縱向的、以學童為中心的視角的實證依據，政策制定者和教育工作者將難以有效應對後疫情時代和人工智慧時代教育多樣性及新興教育模式的證據。 因此，我們提出一項縱向研究，旨在調查華人在家自學的軌跡，並深入剖析與學童發展和轉型相關的過程和結果。本研究以首席研究員（PI）於2021年至2023年開展的關於台北和香港（兩個文化背景近似但在家自學法律政策不同的城市）的在家自學家庭的基準研究為基礎，追踪原有研究對象，觀察部分家庭的學童在青少年時期面臨的各種過渡階段（例如大學入學、職業資格認證）。此外，我們還將招募30至50個近年開始在家自學的新家庭個案，以了解不同群組和情境上的變化，例如疫情後在家自學的動機和數位學習的適應情況。 本研究將採用質性縱向研究（QLR）設計。我們將對原有研究對象和新加入研究對象的家長進行半結構式訪談，以了解他們的觀點、實踐和面臨的挑戰。同時，我們也將訪談12歲或以上的學童，以了解他們的視角和學習成果。我們也對教學互動、家庭動態和學習環境進行觀察，以補充訪談敘述：研究人員將在兩個「新舊」群組中選取部分家庭（約10-15個，選擇標準為多樣性和參與意願）在典型的學習時間段進行實地觀察。我們將採用迭代式主題探究（ITI）方法分析資料，並進行系統性的家庭內部和群組間比較，以識別延續性、變化、影響發展軌跡的因素以及最終結果。 本研究的意義在於其能獨特地產生與全球相關的知識：探討在家自學作為一種替代教育途徑，如何在充滿挑戰的轉型和環境中得以維持、調整或終止。透過對華人家庭進行縱向追踪，並融入學童聲音，我們的研究結果將為教育自主性和結構性限制的協商提供理論見解，同時（重新）構想與新興教育模式興起相關的社會未來的教育模式。研究結果也將為教育多元化政策提供參考，為在競爭激烈的生態系統中設計支持非傳統學習的框架提供實證依據。

18605826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18605826.value: 喉頭與舌位高度在第一語言及第二語言聲調發音中的作用：超聲波研究

18605826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18605826.value: This project builds on the applicant’s current GRF study (#18601423) which investigates tone-vowel interaction in Cantonese and Mandarin. This line of work challenges the traditional ‘source and filter’ assumption that tone and segments are independent of each other. In this proposal, we seek to extend our current work on the tongue to another articulator – the larynx, using ultrasound imaging. This used to receive little attention in the past due to the low temporal resolution of ultrasound scanners, but is now emerging in phonetics due to much higher frame rates. To date, there are only a handful of published studies looking at larynx height with ultrasound (notably by Marc Brunelle at U of Ottawa) on Southeast Asian languages, leaving behind a huge gap in the literature on Chinese languages which also have rich tonal inventories. This project seeks to answer the following questions: - How do L1 and L2 speakers differ in tone production (esp. ‘tonal coarticulation’) - How are the movements of the tongue and the larynx temporally coordinated during tone production? - Does larynx height predict individual differences in tone-vowel interaction? We plan to test native Cantonese and Mandarin speakers, who also speak the other language as L2. Twenty participants will be recruited for each L1 group. They will produce Cantonese and Mandarin (either as L1 or L2) disyllables, and have their voice, as well as tongue and larynx movement recorded using ultrasound imaging. Our findings will enhance our understanding of articulatory planning and execution with respect to tone. 本項目建立在申請人現有的優配研究金（GRF）研究項目（#18601423）基礎之上，旨在探討粵語和普通話中的聲調與元音相互作用。此項研究挑戰了傳統認為聲調與音段互相獨立的「聲源—濾波器」（source and filter）假設。我們將利用超聲波成像技術，將現時針對舌頭的研究拓展至另一發音器官——喉頭。過去由於超聲波掃描儀的時間分辨率（temporal resolution）較低，喉頭超聲波較少受到關注；然而，隨著拍攝幀率（frame rates）顯著提升，此領域近年在語音學中逐漸興起。至今，僅有極少數已發表的文獻（包括渥太華大學 Marc Brunelle 的研究）利用超聲波探討東南亞語言的喉頭高度，在擁有豐富聲調系統的漢語語族研究方面仍留下了巨大的空白。 本項目旨在回答以下問題：第一語言（L1）與第二語言（L2）發音者在聲調發音（特別是「聲調協同發音」）上有何差異？在聲調發音過程中，舌頭與喉頭的運動在時間上如何協調？喉頭高度能否預測聲調與元音相互作用中的個體差異？ 我們計劃測試以粵語和普通話為母語、並將另一種語言作為第二語言（L2）的發音者。每個 L1 組別將招募 20 名參與者。他們將讀出粵語及普通話（作為 L1 或 L2）的雙音節詞，並透過超聲波成像技術記錄其聲音以及舌頭和喉頭的運動。本研究將有助加深我們對聲調發音籌劃與執行（articulatory planning and execution）機制的理解。

18606026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18606026.value: 傳承白語詞彙退化建模：語言優勢在白語-普通話雙語發展中的預測作用

18606026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18606026.value: Dr Cai, Mingjia Dr Li, Xuan

18606026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18606026.value: Heritage language vocabulary attrition refers to the reduced accessibility or loss of lexical items in a minority language. It has become a vital lens for understanding the intricate interplay between language processing and sociolinguistic environments in bilingual development. While recent research increasingly recognizes language dominance as a dynamic, multidimensional sociopsychological construct influencing this regression, the specific ways in which language dominance affects heritage language attrition remain underexplored. Key unresolved questions include not only whether and how language attrition occurs, but also which facets of language dominance most strongly predict attrition trajectories over time. Building on our previous research with adult Bai-Putonghua bilinguals, this project aims to fill these gaps by adopting a longitudinal, multidimensional approach to measuring language dominance as a predictor of real-time heritage Bai vocabulary attrition. We will follow 300 Bai-Putonghua bilingual children in Dali, Yunnan, China, throughout their first two years of formal Putonghua schooling—a critical period marked by rapid shifts in their language environment. Methodologically, this project addresses limitations in the existing literature, which often treats vocabulary attrition as a unitary process and rarely integrates dynamic assessments of language dominance with detailed longitudinal linguistic data.
