To overcome these shortcomings, we employ repeated sampling, multifaceted lexical metrics, comprehensive dominance profiling, and advanced statistical modelling. Lexical attrition will be measured through a picture description task designed to elicit spontaneous language use while controlling for individual memory capacity. A comprehensive set of lexical indices, including token count, mean length of utterance, moving-average type-token ratio, words per minute, and parts-of-speech distribution, will be analyzed. Language dominance will be assessed using a validated, multidimensional questionnaire capturing four key dimensions: language use, history, attitude, and proficiency. Data on lexical performance and language dominance will be collected at five time points. Analyses will begin with ANOVA and proceed to advanced techniques such as generalized linear mixed models and latent growth curve modelling to examine both cross-sectional and longitudinal effects of language dominance. This study represents one of the first systematic efforts to link dynamic profiles of language dominance with real-time heritage vocabulary attrition in early bilinguals. By integrating sociolinguistic and psycholinguistic perspectives and applying rigorous multidimensional frameworks alongside fine-grained lexical measures, the project contributes to advancing empirical research on the dynamics of heritage language change. The findings will have significant theoretical implications for models of bilingual development and practical applications in heritage language preservation and minority language maintenance.

18606526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18606526.value: 基於詞匯證據的四川涼山彜語分化時間研究

18606526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18606526.value: This study employs lexical evidence to investigate three unresolved questions regarding the history of the Liangshan Yi language (Ngwi or Loloish, Tibeto-Burman) and the peopling of the Liangshan Yi speakers. The two linguistic questions are: (1) when the Liangshan Yi language split from other Loloish languages in Yunnan and Guizhou, and (2) when the Liangshan Yi dialects diverged from one another. By establishing these linguistic divergence timelines, this research subsequently addresses a key ethnohistorical question: (3) when the Liangshan Yi people migrated across the Jinsha River from Yunnan into Sichuan. Methodologically, six Liangshan Yi dialects and four Loloish languages from Yunnan and Guizhou were examined. The lexical data collection focuses on terms that provide temporal insights into when these concepts had emerged, including how Chinese loanwords were adapted into the Loloish languages based on Chinese historical phonology. These words can be categorized into three historical layers: Pre-Han concepts (before 220 CE), such as stone, bronze, iron, wheat, barley, and buckwheat; Tang-Song concepts (618 to 1279 CE), such as eggplant, matchmaker, and fertilizer; and Ming-Qing concepts (1368 to 1912 CE), such as maize, tobacco, potato, and peanut. These concepts are either native of the Loloish languages or borrowed from Chinese. Strict sound correspondences across all phonological categories are examined to establish relatedness. If sound correspondence is established across all Loloish varieties under comparison, it indicates no divergence at the time when the concepts emerged. Conversely, a lack of correspondence suggests divergence. To support the strict sound correspondence among the selected lexicon, additional lexical evidence from the same ten Loloish varieties, totaling approximately 25,000 lexical items, is employed to form the empirical foundation. The findings will be used to: 1. To determine whether Liangshan Yi is phylogenetically related to other Loloish languages in Yunnan and Guizhou. While we expect vocabulary expressing early concepts to show regular sound correspondences and later concepts to show divergence, we may observe alternative correspondence patterns. These could indicate that some languages currently classified as "Ngwi" or "Loloish" do not belong to its current (sub)group. 2. To establish the upper and lower temporal limits for the divergence of the Liangshan Yi language from other Loloish languages in Yunnan and Guizhou, and the divergence of the Liangshan Yi dialects from each other. 3. To infer the timing of Liangshan Yi migration into Sichuan. As language divergence primarily results from speaker population separation, estimated divergence times directly inform migration chronology. 本研究通過詞彙證據調查中國四川涼山彝語（藏緬語族彝語支語言）的分化時間及涼山彝族的遷徙歷史。本研究聚焦兩個語言學問題：（1）涼山彝語何時與雲南、貴州的其它彝語支語言發生分化；（2）涼山彝語各方言之間何時發生分化。在厘清上述語言分化時間線的基礎上，本研究進一步回答一個重要的族群史問題：（3）涼山彝族先民何時越過金沙江，從雲南遷入四川。 在方法上，本研究考察了六種涼山彝語方言及四種分佈于雲南、貴州的彝語支語言。重點採集的詞彙是那些能夠為概念出現時間提供年代線索的詞語，包括漢語借詞如何依據漢語歷史音韻被借入彝語支語言。這些詞彙可根據歷史層次劃分為三類：漢前概念（西元220年以前），如石、銅、鐵、小麥、大麥和蕎麥；唐宋概念（618—1279年），如茄子和媒人；明清概念（1368—1912年），如玉米、煙草、土豆和花生。表達上述概念的詞彙，或為彝語支語言固有，或借自漢語。 本研究對所有（超）音段（包括聲母、韻母、聲調）進行嚴格語音對應分析，以確立語言間的親緣關係。若在所有比較的彝語支語言或方言中均能建立語音對應，則表明在這些概念出現時，所比較的語言或方言尚未發生分化；反之，若缺乏對應關係，則說明分化已經發生。為支撐所選詞彙中的嚴格語音對應，本研究使用了來自相同十種彝語支語言的額外詞彙材料，共計約25,000個詞彙條目，作為實證分析的基礎。

18606826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18606826.value: 生成式人工智能與第二語言寫作：探究學習者發展、設計教師教育的教學框架及跨語言驗證教學實踐

18606826.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18606826.value: Dr Lee, Ju Seong Prof Wang, Yijen

18606826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18606826.value: The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence tools like ChatGPT into educational contexts has created what can be termed an “implementation-before-investigation” phenomenon, where pedagogical practice has outpaced empirical research on learning outcomes. This study addresses the fundamental question of whether generative AI supports genuine second language (L2) writing development or merely enhances performance whilst technological support is available. Through a rigorous three-phase mixed-methods design, this project investigates both learner development and teacher preparation across multiple linguistic contexts. Phase 1 employs a quasi-experimental study with 200 L2 English learners using a matrix design that alternates between AI-supported and independent writing tasks. Crucially, pre- and post-benchmark assessments conducted without AI support will measure authentic development using established quantitative metrics (error-free T-units, lexical diversity) and qualitative measures (coherence, cohesion). Systematic interventions will introduce evidence-based strategies including prompt engineering, critical evaluation of AI output, and AI-assisted revision workflows. Phase 2 develops and validates a pedagogical framework through training 300 student teachers across English and modern languages programmes (French, Japanese, Korean). This cross-linguistic approach enables investigation of framework transferability across different orthographic systems and pedagogical traditions. Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling will examine relationships between teacher beliefs, confidence, perceived AI usefulness, and pedagogical intentions. Phase 3 validates findings through classroom implementation, following student teachers into practicum and early in-service contexts. Simplified assessment tools from Phase 1 will monitor authentic student development whilst PLS-SEM modelling validates predictive relationships between teacher preparation and observed pedagogical behaviours. This research directly addresses critical gaps in our understanding of the impact of AI on language education by differentiating between AI-enhanced performance and sustained learning development. The validated pedagogical framework will provide scalable, evidence-based guidance for responsible AI integration, with cross-linguistic validation ensuring applicability across Hong Kong’s multilingual educational landscape and beyond. Outcomes will inform teacher education curricula, institutional policies, and assessment practices, contributing to principled approaches to AI integration during this transformative period in language education. 以 ChatGPT 為代表的生成式人工智能工具與教育情境快速融合，形成了可稱為「先實踐、後研究」的現象，即教學實踐走在有關學習成效的實證研究之前。本研究針對一個根本性問題：生成式人工智能究竟能否真正地促進第二語言（L2）寫作的發展，還是只在有科技支援的情況下提升表現而已。 本項目採用嚴謹的三階段混合研究方法，同時考察多語言情境下的學習者發展與教師職前培養。第一階段是準實驗研究，採用矩陣設計對 200 名以英語為第二語言的學習者交替分配有人工智能輔助的和獨立完成的寫作任務。研究會在無人工智能支援的條件下進行介入前與介入後的基準評估，以量化指標（無錯誤 T 單位、詞彙多樣性）及質性指標（連貫性、銜接性）衡量真實的寫作發展。系統性介入將引入以實證為本的策略，包括提示詞工程、對人工智能輸出的批判性評估，以及人工智能輔助的修訂流程。 第二階段透過培訓 200 名修讀英語及現代語言課程（法語、日語、韓語）的職前教師來發展和驗證一套教學框架。跨語言的設計有助於研究此框架在不同文字系統與教學傳統之間的可遷移性。研究會運用偏最小平方結構方程模型（PLS-SEM），分析教師信念、信心、對人工智能有用性的感知，以及教學意圖之間的關係。 第三階段將職前教師的實習期及初任教師階段納入追蹤，以驗證研究結果在真實課堂中的適用性。研究會以第一階段簡化後的評估工具監察學生的真實發展，並再次運用 PLS-SEM 驗證教師培育與實際教學行為之間的預測關係。 本研究直接解決了當前在理解人工智能對語言教育影響方面存在的關鍵性空白，清晰區分人工智能所帶動的即時表現與持續的學習發展。經驗證的教學框架將為人工智能的負責任應用提供可推廣、具實證基礎的指引；跨語言的驗證亦確保研究成果適用於香港多語言的教育環境以至海外情境。研究成果可為教師教育課程、機構政策及評估實務提供參考，亦有助於在語言教育的變革時期建立有原則的人工智能整合路徑。

18608126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18608126.value: 香港幼稚園藝術為本表演（ABPs）：持份者態度及自我報告的實踐情況

18608126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18608126.value: Dr KONG, Siu-Hang Eric Prof Leung, Suzannie Kit-ying Dr Mendoza, Norman Biliwang Dr Wong, Kit Mei (Betty) Dr Yang, Weipeng

18608126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18608126.value: Evidence from our prior project (#04592) suggests that the practice of offering public arts-based performances (ABPs) in Hong Kong kindergartens (e.g., children’s concerts, theater plays, dances) might have unintended negative consequences. In semi-structured interviews, teachers and principals commented that preparing ABPs is: (a) potentially detrimental to children’s learning, as regular classroom activities are interrupted for rehearsals; (b) not beneficial for the artistic creativity and self-expression of children, as scripts for the performances are generally pre-determined by adults; and (c) often stressful for teachers, leading to increased anxiety and even intentions to leave the teaching profession. No prior study has focused on the topic of ABPs. The aim of our future research program is to systematically examine this commonly taken-for-granted cultural practice, which could be inadvertently impacting on children’s learning and teachers’ wellbeing. This initial project will give voice to the main four stakeholders in kindergarten education: teachers, principals, parents, and children. Adopting a neutral stance and guided by the Theory of Planned Behavior, we will investigate three research questions: RQ1: What are the attitudes toward ABPs of Hong Kong kindergarten teachers, principals, parents, and children (focusing on cognitive, affective, and behavioral factors), and how do these attitudes differ across stakeholder groups? RQ2: What are the self-reported ABP pedagogical practices of teachers and principals, and what factors influence the adoption of these practices? RQ3: How do teachers’ and principals’ attitudes toward ABPs correlate with their self-reported ABP pedagogical practices? We will use a sequential exploratory mixed-methods design (QUAL→QUAN), with semi-structured individual interviews (qualitative) followed by surveys (quantitative). Data collection instruments will be tailored to each stakeholder. Interviewees (n = 80) will be recruited from 20 carefully selected kindergartens, including the principal, one K3 teacher, one K3 child, and his/her parent in each school. Transcripts will be analyzed using open and axial coding. Based on the findings, we will design four principle-based surveys (one per stakeholder). Surveys will include four to six items for each of the three latent factors. A chain-referral sampling method will be used to recruit 60 principals, 100 K3 teachers, 170 parents, and 210 children from kindergartens across Hong Kong. Descriptive, non-parametric, and parametric statistical analyses will be conducted. Findings will lead to subsequent projects, interventions, frameworks, and policies to better foster children’s artistic creativity and self-expression in kindergartens. 我們先前計畫（#04592）的證據表明，香港幼兒園開展基於藝術的公開表演活動（ABPs，如兒童音樂會、戲劇表演、舞蹈表演等）可能會產生意想不到的負面後果。在半結構化訪談中，教師和園長指出，籌備此類表演活動存在以下問題：(a) 可能不利於兒童的學習，因為排練會打斷常規的課堂教學活動；(b) 不利於兒童藝術創造力和自我表達的發展，因為表演劇本通常由成人預先設定；(c) 往往給教師帶來巨大壓力，導致焦慮感增加，甚至產生離職念頭。 先前尚無研究專門探討「基於藝術的公開表演活動」（ABPs）這一議題。我們未來的研究計畫旨在有系統地檢視這一常被視為理所當然的文化實踐，因為它可能在無意中影響兒童的學習和教師的身心健康。這個初步計畫將傾聽幼兒園教育中四大主要利害關係人——教師、園長、家長和兒童——的聲音。我們將秉持中立立場，以「計劃行為理論」（Theory of Planned Behavior）為指導，探討以下三個研究問題： RQ1 香港幼兒園教師、園長、家長和兒童對ABPs持何種態度（著重認知、情緒和行為因素）？不同利害關係人群體之間的態度有何差異？ RQ2 教師與園長自述的ABPs教學實務情形如何？哪些因素影響了這些實踐的採用？ RQ3 教師和園長對ABPs的態度與其自述的ABPs教學實踐之間存在何種關聯？ 我們將採用「順序探索性混合研究設計」（QUAL→QUAN），即先進行半結構化個人訪談（質性研究），隨後進行問卷調查（量化研究）。資料收集工具將針​​對各類利害關係人量身訂做。我們將從20所精心挑選的幼兒園招募受訪者（共80人），每所幼兒園包括園長、一名K3（高班）教師、一名K3兒童及其家長。訪談記錄將採用開放式編碼和軸心編碼進行分析。基於研究發現，我們將設計四份以原則為基礎的問卷（針對每一類利害關係人各一份）；每份問卷將針對上述三個潛在因素，分別包含4至6個題項。研究將採用連鎖推薦抽樣法，向香港各幼兒園招募60位校長、100位K3（幼兒園高班）教師、170位家長及210名兒童作為研究對象，並進行描述性統計、非參數統計及參數統計分析。研究結果將為後續計畫、介入措施、框架建構及政策制定提供依據，從而更好地在幼兒園環境中培養兒童的藝術創造力與自我表達能力。

18608326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18608326.value: 修辭頌聖：初唐七世紀時期的駢體聖傳研究

18608326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18608326.value: The seventh century witnessed a zenith of hagiographic writing in the form of parallel verse (pianwen) in Tang-dynasty China. In this new development of Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism, why was there a surge of exquisite hagiographies and what role did they play? The proposed project studies this vogue of writing parallel-verse hagiographies from new perspectives and with important goals to achieve. This material has long remained understudied mainly because of two biases, namely 1) modern literary studies of medieval China favoring poetry, a term narrowly understood as the equivalent of shi 詩, almost exclusively; 2) the convention is to regard this kind of writing as intellectually shallow and predictable. The PI strives to refute these biased views by restoring the aesthetic value of this material and, in so doing, broadening the coverage of Tang verse as well as providing first-hand materials for how religious and intellectual schools strove to promote themselves. The material under investigation achieved aesthetic appeal, a main aspect for recovering its value. These hagiographists employed florid diction, perfect parallel couplets, and apposite allusions in carefully designed structures in portraying the religious or intellectual apotheosized figures. The project will analyze these rhetorical devices to demonstrate why they achieved such a high place and why writers of the time vied for recognition by means of these kinds of compositions. Given their large number and disparity in literary quality, the texts under investigation, from printed materials, manuscripts, and stele inscriptions, must be selective to highlight their major contribution. The hagiographies selected for our investigation are mainly by renowned writers of the time, such as Wang Bo (650–676), Yang Jiong (b. 650), Lu Zhaolin (d. ca. 689), and Chen Ziang (661–702). In addition, some works of monumental value in the respective religions/schools will also be selected. About ten such pieces of writing have been chosen for intensive investigation; each piece comprises about 3,500 to 4,500 characters. Restoration of the aesthetic appeal of seventh-century hagiographies is of crucial importance in relevant scholarships. It renders due recognition of many understudied literary works and broadens the coverage of Tang verse in the study of Tang literature. It also provides annotated translations for the study of medieval Chinese religions, which has long been based on limited primary sources. These main contributions will apply to the Chinese and Western-language speaking worlds; the project will conduct dialogues between them to enhance interactions. 公元七世紀的中國，是駢體聖傳創作的巔峰期。這些具有獨特文學特徵的文本湧現在初唐儒、釋、道三教交融的背景下，讓人不禁好奇它們大量生成的原因，以及在當時所扮演的角色。 本計畫從嶄新視角來研究這股駢體聖傳的風潮。長期以來，這類材料因兩大偏見而備受忽視：第一，現代中古文學研究幾乎偏重於狹義的「詩」，導致對「韻文」的界定過於狹隘；第二，傳統觀點認為聖傳內容華而不實、流於淺薄。有鑒於此，計畫主持人致力於駁斥這些偏見，透過重塑這些材料的審美價值，不僅能拓展唐代韻文的研究層面，更為研究宗教與思想學派如何自我宣傳，提供了第一手史料。 鑑於文獻數量龐大且質量參差，本計畫將從刻本、手稿與碑銘中，精選出最具代表性的作品。研究對象除王勃（650—676）、楊炯（650年生）、盧照鄰（約689年卒）及陳子昂（661—702）等名家外，亦包含各宗教或思想學派中具里程碑價值的作品。目前已選定約十篇代表作進行研究；每篇篇幅約為3,500至4,500字。 重新審視並肯定七世紀聖傳文學的審美價值，對相關學術領域意義重大。這不僅能讓長期被忽視的佳作重獲認可，更拓寬了唐代文學的研究疆域。此外，本計畫提供的譯注成果，也將為長期受限於原始史料的中古宗教研究開闢新路。以上貢獻將惠及中西學術界，成為促進雙方對話與交流的重要橋樑。

18608526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18608526.value: 自我效能感、素材使用與基于素材的寫作表現的關係：素材模態的影響

18608526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18608526.value: Source-based writing (SBW), defined as the ability to construct an essay for a specific purpose using provided sources, is widely acknowledged as a crucial skill for college students’ academic and career success. However, students often struggle to appropriately integrate sources into their writing. To explain individual differences in writing performance, previous studies have highlighted the importance of source use as a cognitive factor and self-efficacy as a motivational factor. Yet, the mechanism through which these factors interplay to influence writing performance remains unclear. Moreover, most existing research has adopted reading-to-write or reading–listening–writing tasks, leaving a noticeable gap in the exploration of students’ writing when video sources are provided. Given the global shift toward digital and multimodal environments in language education, writing across modalities is rapidly becoming a core literacy skill. Consequently, it becomes very necessary to study the role of source modality in SBW. Focusing on the relationship between source use, self-efficacy and writing performance, the proposed study will involve 300 first- and second-year undergraduates in Hong Kong, who will be randomly assigned to complete a Chinese SBW task. All students will receive the same source content, but the modality will differ: one group will write based on three videos, whereas the other will use written texts transcribed and edited from these videos. Students’ writing self-efficacy, prior knowledge and cognitive load will also be collected. Furthermore, a subsample of 30 students will be invited to attend a post-task stimulated recall interview. All produced texts will undergo detailed textual analysis, beginning with segmentation into T-units to examine source use in terms of idea origin and linguistic transformation. Writing performance will then be obtained through a separate round of scoring. Comparisons will first be made to identify differences between the two groups in source use, self-efficacy, and writing performance. Structural equation modeling will be employed to explore the relationships among these variables in depth. Interview data will be analysed thematically to capture qualitative insights that complement and enrich quantitative findings. This study will not only clarify how source use and self-efficacy interact to influence writing performance, but also deepen our understanding of their characteristics across different source modalities. The findings are also expected to offer practical implications for curriculum design and instructional strategies. Ultimately, we hope better prepare our students for the complex literacy demands of real-world academic and professional contexts. 基於素材的寫作要求學生利用所提供的素材寫成文章，以達成特定的寫作目的，它也被廣泛認爲是大學生學業成功和職業發展的關鍵技能。然而，學生在寫作中往往難以恰當地整合素材。對此，以往研究指出作爲認知因素的素材使用和作爲動機因素的自我效能感的重要性。然而，目前研究尚不清楚這些因素如何相互影響進而作用於寫作表現。此外，現有研究大多采用讀後寫或讀-聽-寫任務，對於提供視頻素材時學生寫作表現的探索存在明顯空白。隨著國際上語言教育都呈現向數字化和多模態環境轉變的趨勢，跨模態寫作正迅速成爲一項核心素養技能。因此，研究素材模態對基於素材寫作的影響十分必要。 本研究聚焦於素材使用、自我效能感與寫作表現之間的關係，擬選取香港300名一、二年級本科生參與研究，並將其隨機分配完成一項基於中文素材寫作的任務。所有學生將獲得相同的素材內容，但素材模態有所不同：一組學生基於三段視頻進行寫作，另一組則使用由這些視頻轉寫並編輯而成的文字文本。同時，還將收集學生的寫作自我效能感、先前知識和認知負荷數據。此外，將邀請30名學生作爲子樣本參加任務後的刺激回憶訪談。 所有寫作文本將進行細緻的文本分析，首先將其切分爲T單位，以考察素材使用在觀點來源和語言轉換方面的情况。寫作表現則通過研究員獨立評分獲得。對於所得數據，首先進行組間比較，以識別兩組在素材使用、自我效能感和寫作表現上的差异。隨後采用結構方程模型深入探究這些變量之間的關係。訪談數據將進行主題分析，以獲取質性洞見，補充和豐富量化研究發現。 本研究不僅有助認識素材使用與自我效能感如何交互影響寫作表現，還將加深理解我們對這些因素在不同素材模態下所表現出的特徵。研究結果亦有望爲課程設計和教學策略提供參考。最終，我們希望幫助學生更好地應對真實學術和職業情境中複雜的素養要求。

18608926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18608926.value: 評估基於模擬的學習對亞太地區學校領導者的跨文化成效

18608926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18608926.value: Dr Banoglu, Koksal Prof Gurr, David Prof Hallinger, Philip Dr Kulophas, Dhirapat Dr Liu, Sheng-nan Dr Thien, Lei Mee

18608926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18608926.value: School leader learning has long been criticized for the slow pace of adopting new learning methods, especially those using learning technologies. Despite early innovators' success in experimenting with simulation-based learning (SBL) in the 20th century, the adoption of SBL remains limited in educational leadership and management (EDLM). The use of simulations is particularly scarce in EDLM programs in the Asia Pacific region. This project responds to several gaps in research and practice. First, there is a need for relevant, high-impact instructional content that leverages learning technologies in preparing school leaders to implement educational reforms. Second, there is a need to validate the effectiveness of active learning methods that address global social and environmental sustainability challenges. Finally, single-society or single-university studies dominate the multi-disciplinary literature on simulation-based learning. Thus, there is a need for comparative studies of simulation effectiveness, especially cross-cultural research. This project leverages an existing English language online computer simulation, Leading Change for Sustainability in Schools (LCSS), to study the effects of SBL on prospective school leaders in five societies (Mainland China, Hong Kong Thailand, Malaysia, and Australia). In the development stage, the research team will translate, culturally adapt, program, and test five new versions of the LCSS simulation in the five societies. Next, the research team will examine the effectiveness of an LCSS instructional module (i.e., intervention) with students in EDLM preparation programs. The learning engagement and outcomes of participant samples will be evaluated and compared across the five societies using a quasi-experimental, non-equivalent groups, time-series research design. Data on the participants’ simulation usage, decision-making, and results will be used to examine changes in behavioral engagement, knowledge, skills, and attitudes. Qualitative data extracted from an online discussion forum will be analyzed with sentiment and thematic analysis to gain further insights into students’ cognitive and behavioral engagement and responses to simulation-based learning. Finally, the research will explore how individual-and societal-level factors influence the effectiveness of SBL. The project will make several significant contributions. First, it will yield five culturally-adapted, validated versions of the online simulation on two essential EDLM curriculum topics: sustainability and change management. Second, the research will yield insights into the use, acceptance, and effectiveness of learning technologies in EDLM programs. Finally, the multi-society, quasi-experimental study conducted in the Asia Pacific region will break new ground in SBL research by analyzing learning engagement and outcomes within a cross-cultural framework. 長久以來，學校領導者的學習一直因採納新學習方法的步伐緩慢而廣受批評，尤其是在運用學習科技方面。在上個世紀，早期創新者成功嘗試了基於模擬的學習，但基於模擬的學習在教育領導與管理領域的應用仍然十分有限。基於模擬的學習在亞太地區教育領導與管理課程中的應用尤其罕見。 本研究項目旨在回應研究與實踐中的若干缺口。首先，在培育學校領導者推行教育改革的過程中，需要具有高度相關性和高影響力、並能善用學習科技的教學內容。其次，對於回應全球社會及環境可持續發展挑戰的主動學習方法，需驗證其成效。最後，基於模擬的學習的多學科文獻中，現有研究大多集中於單一社會或單一高校。因此，有必要開展比較研究，尤其是模擬學習成效的跨文化研究。 本項目將利用現有的英文版線上模擬遊戲──引領學校可持續發展變革，研究基於該模擬遊戲的學習對五個社會中準學校領導者的影響。研究涵蓋中國內地、中國香港、泰國、馬來西亞及澳洲五個社會。 在開發階段，研究團隊將在上述五個社會中翻譯、文化調適、編程及測試該模擬遊戲，以開發五個新的本地化版本。其後，研究團隊將融合該模擬遊戲的教學單元（即干預）應用於教育領導與管理類課程，並通過學生反饋檢驗其成效。研究將採用準實驗、非等值組別、時間序列設計，評估並比較五個社會參與者樣本的學習投入及結果。 研究將利用參與者的模擬系統使用數據、決策過程及決策結果數據，分析其行為投入、知識、技能及態度的變化。此外，研究團隊將對從線上討論區提取的質性數據進行情感及主題分析，以了解學生的知行投入，以及他們對基於模擬學習的反應。最後，本研究將探討個人及社會層面因素如何影響基於模擬的學習成效。 本項目將作出几項重要貢獻。首先，本研究將開發五個經過文化調適及驗證的模擬游戲版本，涵蓋教育領導與管理課程中兩項重要議題：引領可持續發展及變革管理。其次，本研究將就學習科技在教育領導與管理類課程中的使用情況、接受程度及成效提供重要參考。最後，此項在亞太地區開展的跨社會準實驗研究，將透過跨文化框架分析學習投入及學習成果，為研究基於模擬的學習開拓新方向。

18609226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18609226.value: 香港綠色殯葬推廣的語料庫輔助多模態話語分析

18609226.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18609226.value: Dr Lau, Chaak Ming Dr LU, Fangcao Prof Zhu, Hongqiang

18609226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18609226.value: Cremation has been the most popular means of body disposition in Hong Kong; however, this practice raises concerns about pollution, public health, and land shortages, thereby threatening the sustainability of the city’s development. Green burial practices (GBP), such as using biodegradable materials and scattering cremated remains at green burial sites (e.g., gardens or at sea), offer environmentally friendly alternatives that can address the urgent demand for land resources and ease the financial burden on families. Since 2021, the SAR government has launched a campaign to promote GBP. The promotion involves textual and multimodal discourses, including webpages, videos, posters, and online articles. Prior research on the popularisation of GBP has tended to focus on public opinions toward these practices. However, crucial arguments, and linguistic and audio-visual elements that constitute the advertising discourse, have been overlooked, and the effectiveness of such discourse has remained unmeasured. This study perceives the green burials campaign as a form of strategic public communication, where the discourses aim to reformulate addressees’ beliefs, values, attitudes, and behaviours. Adopting a mixed-methods approach, the research will examine textual and multimodal discourses. Specifically, corpus-assisted discourse analysis, with the assistance of large-language models, will be conducted to reveal the discourses/themes and metadiscourse features in the textual data. Moreover, multimodal discourse features of the webpages, videos, and psoters related to GBP will be revealed and examined. These analyses elucidate how linguistic and semiotic patterns, as well as key themes/discourses, are utilised and constructed to (re)contextualise and (re)frame GBP in ways that are compatible with traditional Chinese funeral cultures and to influence addressees’ view towards GBP. To supplement the discourse studies, a survey will be distributed to investigate addressees’ perceptions of the promotional discourse and to measure its effectiveness. The significance of this project is three-fold. First, it contributes to the growing literature on death concepts, funeral culture, and environmental sustainability by explicating how GBP can be made compatible with traditional funeral cultures and help enhance environmental and socio-economic sustainability. Second, it elucidates the dynamic relationships between metadiscourse and contradictory ideologies (i.e., traditionalism and environmentalism) in advertising discourse. Third, it offers practical implications for enhancing the green burial promotion in terms of language style, content organisation, arguments, and the use of audio-visual resources. 火葬一直是香港最常見的遺體處理方式，但卻引起了大眾對環境污染、公共衛生和土地短缺等方面的顧慮，亦威脅到城市發展的可持續性。綠色殯葬，例如使用可生物降解材料及在綠色殯葬花園或海上撒放骨灰，為傳統殯葬提供了環保的替代方案。綠色殯葬既能回應社會對土地資源的迫切需求，也能減輕家庭的經濟負擔。自2021年起，香港特區政府開始推廣綠色殯葬，宣傳形式包括網頁、影片、海報和網上文章等多種文本及多模態話語元素。以往關於綠色殯葬普及化的研究多聚焦於公眾對這種殯葬方式的看法，但對構成宣傳話語的關鍵論點、語言和視聽元素的分析較為缺乏，因此，這些宣傳話語的成效也未有充分評估。 本研究將綠色殯葬推廣視為一種策略性公共傳播，其話語旨在重新塑造受眾的觀念、價值觀、態度與行為。研究採用混合方法，分析文本及多模態話語。具體而言，研究將借助大語言模型進行語料庫輔助話語分析，以揭示文本中的話語/主題及元話語(metadiscourse)特徵。此外，研究將分析綠色殯葬相關的網頁、影片和海報的多模態話語特點。這些分析有助於揭示語言和符號的使用模式，以及關鍵主題/話語如何運作和建構，從而將綠色殯葬情境化和框架化，使其與傳統華人殯葬文化相融合，並影響受眾對綠色殯葬的看法。研究還將進行問卷調查，以了解受眾對宣傳話語的感受，並評估其成效。 本研究具有三方面意義：第一，本研究通過說明綠色殯葬如何與傳統殯葬文化相容，並促進環境和社會經濟的可持續發展，豐富對死亡觀念的了解、殯葬文化及環境可持續性的相關研究。第二，本研究闡釋宣傳話語中元話語與矛盾意識形態（如傳統主義與環保主義）之間的動態關係。第三，從語言風格、內容組織、論證方式及視聽資源運用等方面，本研究提供改善綠色殯葬宣傳效果的實務建議。

18609626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18609626.value: 透過空間遊戲活動促進幼稚園兒童的空間化 STEM 學習：對照實驗

18609626.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18609626.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Edwards , Susan Dr Lin, Dan Prof Newcombe, Nora S. Prof Yelland, Nicola

18609626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18609626.value: Young children’s spatial skills influence their later achievements in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), but early childhood education in Hong Kong often neglects spatial skills. Children are more likely to achieve long-term development of spatial skills through a contextualised curriculum with spatialisation elements than through short-term decontextualised spatial training. Hence, it is important to develop an age-appropriate, play-based curriculum that incorporates spatial learning to develop kindergarteners’ spatial skills. Our pilot studies indicated that spatialized STEM content (e.g., creating a 3D map) enables children to navigate, recognise, visualise, and represent spatial relationships within their physical and visual environments, which can improve their spatial skills (*Hu et al., 2024). However, no controlled experiments have tested the effectiveness of a spatializing STEM curriculum on young children’s spatial learning. In addition, teachers often lack knowledge in spatialized curriculum, which must be addressed through a situated professional development (SPD) program that supports the coherence of knowledge and application. To address this research gap, this mixed-methods study will determine the effectiveness of a spatializing STEM curriculum, alongside an SPD program for teachers, in enhancing kindergarteners’ spatial skills. Three levels of the SPD program will be implemented: 1) understanding the spatial learning; 2) comprehensive implementation; and 3) projection level to develop spatial learning in kindergarten classes. This controlled experiment will examine the effectiveness of our proposed spatializing STEM curriculum and SPD program by evaluating children’s spatial learning outcomes across three conditions: (a) teaching as usual (control), (b) teaching with a spatial concept package (treatment 1), and (c) teaching with an SPD package and spatializing STEM curriculum (treatment 2). We will recruit 54 teachers to support the spatial learning of 549 kindergarteners. All children will complete pre- and post-test spatial tests, and we will analyse these data using difference-in-differences multilevel structural equation modelling with residual centring. In the qualitative part, we will collect classroom recordings during and after the intervention and interview teachers about their implementation processes and outcomes. We will analyse these qualitative data using thematic analysis. This proposed project will fill a knowledge gap by determining the impact of spatialized STEM curriculum on young children’s spatial skills. Additionally, this initiative will empower teachers to integrate spatial learning into children’s daily lives. The evidence-based findings will provide significant benefits to kindergarteners, teachers, and curriculum policy-makers in preparing future STEM learners from an early age. 幼兒的空間能力影響其日後在科學、技術、工程和數學（STEM）領域的表現，但是香港的幼兒經常會忽略培養空間能力。比較短期脫離情境的空間訓練，具有情境化融入空間課程更有助於長期發展幼兒的空間能力。因此，開發適合幼兒年齡，並以遊戲化融入空間學習的課程，對於培養幼兒的空間能力十分重要。我們團隊先導研究的結果表明，空間化的STEM內容（例如製作三維地圖）可以幫助兒在物理和視覺環境中進行導航、識別、可視化及表徵空間關係，提升幼兒的空間能力（Hu et al., 2024）。 然而，目前尚未有對照實驗來驗證空間化STEM課程對幼兒空間學習的成效。除此之外，教師也缺乏關於對於空間化課程的教學的知識。針對這個問題需要透過「情境化專業發展」（SPD）計劃來提升結合知識和實踐。為填補此研究空白，本研究用混合研究方法將評估空間化STEM課程，及配套教師SPD專業發展計劃提升幼兒的空間能力及驗證。 SPD計畫分為三個層次實施：1) 感知空間學習；2) 理解空間學習；3) 預測空間學習。本對照實驗將透過評估幼兒在三種不同教學條件下的空間學習成果，來幫助驗證我們設計的空間化STEM課程及SPD專業發展的有效性，這三種條件包括：(a) 常規教學（對照組）；(b) 使用空間概念教學包進行教學（實驗組1）；以及 (c) 使用SPD教學包結合空間化STEM教學包進行教學（實驗組2）。54位教師將被邀請參與項目，幫助549位幼兒在幼稚園進行空間學習。 幼兒需要完成空間能力的前測與後測，所收集的材料將用雙重差分多層結構方程模型進行分析。質性研究部分將收集介入期間的課堂錄像，並在其後的訪談教師來了解項目施過程與成效，隨後採用主題分析法對這些質性資料進行分析。此計劃研究空間化STEM課程對幼兒空間能力的影響來填補此領域的空白。除此之外，將賦能幼兒教師，支持將空間學習融入幼兒的日常生活。研究結果將為幼兒、教師及課程政策制定者帶來效益，為培養年幼的STEM學習者奠定基礎。

18610326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18610326.value: 開發人工智能平台以促進教師與人工智能共同創作中學數學建模教學材料：設計為本的研究項目

18610326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18610326.value: Dr Bai, Shurui Tiffany Dr Ling, Man Ho Dr Ng, Davy Tsz Kit Dr Yee, Tat Leung, Tony Prof Zhang , Qiaoping

18610326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18610326.value: To enhance the relevance of mathematics in real-world applications, the government advocates for engaging students in tackling real-world problems through mathematical modelling. However, its instructional materials must be carefully contextualised and designed to ensure authenticity and feasibility for students. Relying solely on teachers to manually create these materials increases their workload, resulting in a limited availability of comprehensive instructional materials that hinders teaching practices. This project leverages Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) to address this barrier in mathematics education without depending on general-purpose AI tools, as these tools pose a risk of AI hallucination. The primary objective of this design-based research (DBR) project is to develop and optimise an AI-powered platform that supports teacher–AI co-creation of instructional materials for mathematical modelling. Its design draws on the usefulness theoretical framework covering technological, educational, and social aspects. Particular emphasis is placed on instructional design theories in the educational aspect, encompassing modelling perspectives, levels of learning experiences, activity-design principles, and key elements of modelling cycles. These theoretical resources will be embodied in AI and progressively refined through three DBR cycles. Teacher professional development (TPD) activities will first be provided to familiarise teachers with mathematical modelling instruction and the AI-powered platform. Each DBR cycles will involve approximately 20 teachers and 450 junior secondary students across six schools. Teachers will engage in creating instructional materials with AI and improving them based on peer feedback. They will then pilot the co-created materials, revise them, and repilot the revised materials in their schools. Data will be collected during the TPD period, teacher engagement in material development, and school trials. Qualitative content analysis will be conducted on teacher–AI interactions and their co-created materials to gain insight into how teachers utilise the platform and to identify areas for enhancement. Teacher interviews will provide further insights for improving the platform's functionalities and support mechanisms. During the school trials, classroom observations and teacher interviews will facilitate an investigation regarding the actual implementation of the co-created materials, including how teachers deliver the instructional content and how students respond. Changes in effects between the pilot and repilot of the instructional materials will be examined through student tests and interviews. Analysing both significant and non-significant improvements, alongside participants' perspectives, will inform the identification of effective instructional strategies and challenges. These insights will contribute to optimising the theoretical resources underpinning AI to assist teachers in future material development and teaching practices. 為提高數學在實際應用中的相關性，政府提倡讓學生通過數學建模來解決現實世界的問題。然而，教學材料必須仔細地情境化處理和周詳地設計，以確保其內容真實和對學生而言具可行性。僅依賴教師創作這些材料會增加他們的工作量，完整的教材亦供應有限，妨礙教學的實踐。本項目利用生成式人工智能來解決數學教育中的這一個障礙，而不依賴通用型人工智能工具，因為這類工具存在人工智能幻覺的風險。 這個設計為本的研究（DBR）項目的主要目標是開發和優化一個支援教師與人工智能共同創作中學數學建模教學材料的人工智能平台。其設計參考實用性理論框架，涵蓋技術、教育和社群方面。特別強調教育方面的教學設計理論基礎，包括建模觀點、學習經驗的層次、活動設計原則和建模循環的關鍵要素。這些理論將以人工智能形式予以落實，並通過三個DBR循環逐步修訂與完善。 我們首先提供教師專業發展（TPD）活動，協助教師熟悉數學建模教學和人工智能平台。每個DBR循環將涉及來自六所學校的參與者，包括約20位教師和450名初中學生。教師將與人工智能共同創作教學材料，並根據同儕反饋進行改進。隨後，他們將會先在校內試用這些共同創作的材料，經修訂後再次進行試用。 我們將在TPD期間、教師參與教材開發過程及學校試用期間收集數據，將對教師與人工智能的互動及其共同創作的材料進行質性內容分析，以深入了解教師如何利用該平台，並探索改進的方向。另外，通過教師訪談取得更多反饋，將用於進一步改善平台功能和支援機制。在學校試用期間，通過課堂觀察和教師訪談收集的數據，包括教師如何傳授教學內容和學生的回應，將促進對共同創作教學材料在實踐中的成效與落實情況的研究。通過學生測試和訪談，分析教材在試用和再次試用之間的成效變化。透過分析顯著與非顯著的改進結果，並結合參與者的觀點，將有助識別教學策略是否有效和可能的挑戰。這些見解將用於優化支撐人工智能的理論基礎，進而在未來協助教師進行教材開發和實踐。

18611526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18611526.value: 打開校長領導力素養的「黑盒子」：測量、驅動因素與結果

18611526.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18611526.value: Prof Gurr, David Prof Walker, Allan David

18611526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18611526.value: The work of school principals has become more complex and challenging than ever due to unprecedented uncertainties, constant changes, and overwhelming digitalization (Fullan, 2025; Walker et al., 2024). To address this phenomenon, the UNESCO (2024) Global Education Monitoring Report on leadership in education calls for a new effective leadership paradigm involving 'new leadership literacies' not only to handle intricate issues but also to foster school transformation and sustainability in the new era (Arnold, 2021; Flaxman, 2023). Moreover, school principals are the gatekeepers and role models for all school initiatives. Informed by the notion of 'principal first' (PI, 2025a), principals are encouraged to cultivate their leadership literacy to 'self-lead, lead followers, and lead schools'. Hence, principals need to be positioned firmly at the center of 'futures-literate' initiatives from OECD (2025) and UNESCO (2023). However, our literature review found that principal leadership literacy, regarded as one of the crucial new literacies, has attracted little attention. This project will aim at (1) developing and validating a Principal Leadership Literacy Instrument (PLLI); (2) identifying salient individual, organizational, and contextual drivers of principal leadership literacy; (3) investigating positive outcomes of principal leadership literacy; and (4) exploring the relationships among principal leadership literacy and its said drivers and outcomes. To achieve the four aims, the project will employ an exploratory sequential mixed-methods design with qualitative and quantitative strands. The qualitative strand includes 2 interview studies with 24 principals and a panel of 3 experts. The quantitative strand involves 2 survey studies with approximately 200 and 350~400 Hong Kong school principals. This project will make four major contributions. First, the project will provide empirical insights to advance the theoretical framework on principal leadership literacy by opening the 'black box' (e.g., principal leadership literacy) between its drivers and positive outcomes. Second, the project will produce a PLLI, advancing quantitative investigations into leadership literacy and offering a rigorous tool for future international comparisons. Third, this project will enable policymakers to establish priorities to better craft related policies for principal preparation, selection, and standardization (e.g., Hong Kong professional standards for principals) to enhance principal literacy development in Hong Kong. Fourth, this project will yield a practical blueprint to foster principal leadership literacy, particularly as individual, organizational, and contextual drivers identified are malleable for future solution-focused interventions aiming for establishing 'futures-literate' schools in Hong Kong. This will advance international and local initiatives for a 'futures-literate' society in Hong Kong and beyond. 面對前所未有的不確定性、持續不斷的變革以及席捲而來的數位化浪潮，校長的工作變得比以往任何時候都更為複雜且充滿挑戰。針對這一現狀，聯合國教科文組織（UNESCO, 2024）關於教育領導力的《全球教育監測報告》呼籲建立一種包含「新型領導力素養」的有效領導力新範式；這種素養不僅有助於應對錯綜複雜的問題，還能在新時代推動學校的轉型與可持續發展。然而，文獻綜述顯示，作為關鍵新型素養之一的校長領導力素養，目前尚未得到足夠的關注。 本計畫旨在：(1) 發展並驗證「校長領導力素養量表」（PLLI）；(2) 辨識影響校長領導力素養的關鍵個人、組織及情境驅動因素；(3) 檢視校長領導力素養帶來的正向成效；以及 (4) 探究校長領導力素養與其驅動因素及成效之間的關係。為實現上述目標，本計畫將採用包含質性與量化研究成分的「探索性順序混合研究設計」。其中包括校長和專家小組訪談研究；以及定量問卷調查研究。 本計畫將透過揭示校長領導力素養的驅動因素與其積極成效之間的「黑盒子」并提供實證見解，從而豐富並深化關於校長領導力素養的理論架構。其次，本計畫將發展一套校長領導力素養指數（PLLI），這將推動針對領導力素養的量化研究，並為未來的國際比較提供嚴謹的評估工具。 Keywords 領導力素養、學校校長、量表發展、混合研究方法

18611726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18611726.value: 教師調適力：探究其內涵、範疇、路徑、重要性與動態規律

18611726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18611726.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Dr COLLIE, J. Rebecca Prof Klassen, Robert

18611726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18611726.value: Teachers in Hong Kong face exceptionally high job demands, routinely working longer hours than their international counterparts. While their dedication has supported outstanding student achievement and a strong global reputation for educational excellence, it has also led to increasingly severe burnout and job dissatisfaction. Alarmingly, nearly one-third of all teachers have left the profession in the past three years, mostly unrelated to retirement. This trend poses significant risks to the stability and quality of Hong Kong’s education system. To address these challenges, this research systematically investigates teacher buoyancy—the ability to cope with and recover from everyday work challenges—by focusing on five guiding questions: what are the types and dimensions of teacher buoyancy in Hong Kong; where is buoyancy particularly needed in our educational context; how can it be effectively enhanced; why is it so important for our teachers; and when does it fluctuate during daily professional experiences. By structuring the inquiry around these core questions, the research seeks to provide a comprehensive understanding of buoyancy’s role, mechanisms, and practical implications within Hong Kong’s educational environment. The project consists of four interconnected studies. Study 1 involves qualitative interviews and panel discussions with 45 teachers to generate context-specific scenarios that deepen our understanding of teacher buoyancy in Hong Kong schools. Study 2 uses a quantitative cross-sectional survey of 300 teachers to examine the structure and key factors of teacher buoyancy. Study 3 adopts a longitudinal design, surveying 588 teachers twice to explore how job demands and resources influence buoyancy over time, and how buoyancy relates to well-being, perceived teaching quality, and intentions to leave. Study 4 implements a 10-day diary approach with 138 teachers to capture the dynamic, state-like aspects of buoyancy and its daily antecedents, coping strategies, and teaching outcomes. The significance of this research is threefold. First, it will advance theoretical understanding of the dimensions and contextual features of teacher buoyancy in Hong Kong. Second, the findings will inform evidence-based, buoyancy-focused interventions for school leaders and policymakers to promote teacher well-being, sustain teaching quality, and reduce attrition. Finally, the project will identify effective coping strategies that empower teachers themselves to navigate daily setbacks and challenges. By investigating the processes that foster better buoyancy among teachers, this research aims to support a healthier, more engaged, and more effective teaching workforce, ultimately enhancing student outcomes and broader educational landscape in Hong Kong. 香港教師面臨極高的工作要求，工時普遍長於國際同儕。雖然他們的敬業精神造就了卓越的學生表現，並為香港建立了卓越的國際教育聲譽，但這也導致了日益嚴重的職業倦怠和工作不滿。令人擔憂的是，在過去三年中，近三分之一的教師離開了教職，且大多數並非因退休所致。這一趨勢對香港教育系統的穩定性和質量構成了重大風險。 為了解決這些挑戰，本研究系統性地調查了「教師調適力」（Teacher Buoyancy）—即教師應對日常工作挑戰並從中快速恢復的能力— 並聚焦於五個指導性問題：香港教師調適力的類型與維度為何；在我們的教育背景下，哪些環節特別需要調適力；如何有效提升調適力；為何調適力對我們的教師如此重要；以及調適力在日常專業工作中何時會出現波動。通過圍繞這些核心問題進行探究，本研究旨在全面了解調適力在香港教育環境中的角色、機制及其實際意義。 本項目由四項相互關聯的研究組成。研究一包括對 45 名教師進行定性訪談和小組討論，旨在構建符合本地情境的案例，以加深對香港學校中教師調適力的理解。研究二採用定量橫斷面調查，對 300 名教師進行問卷調查，以檢視教師調適力的結構與關鍵影響因素。研究三採用縱向設計，對 588 名教師進行兩次問卷調查，旨在探討工作要求與資源如何隨時間影響調適力，以及調適力與教師身心健康、教學質量感知及離職意向之間的關係。研究四對 138 名教師進行為期 10 天的日記研究，以捕捉調適力的動態、狀態特徵，及其日常的前因、應對策略和教學成果。 本研究的意義體現在三個方面。首先，它將推進對香港教師調適力維度及情境特徵的理論理解。其次，研究結果將為學校領導和政策制定者提供以實證為基礎、側重調適力的干預措施，以促進教師身心健康、維持教學質量並降低離職率。最後，項目將識別有效的應對策略，賦能教師自身以應對日常挫折與挑戰。通過探討培養教師調適力的過程，本研究旨在支持一支更健康、更投入且更高效的教學隊伍，最終提升學生的學習成果並改善香港的整體教育環境。

18611926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18611926.value: 幼兒數學及閱讀發展研究計劃

18611926.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18611926.value: Dr Cheung, Sum Kwing Prof Chung, Kevin Kien Hoa Dr KWAN, Lok Yin Joyce

18611926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18611926.value: Mathematics and reading are two core subjects in school learning. Both are strong predictors of one’s achievement in later life. Prior to formal instruction in elementary school, children have already started to acquire some skills in mathematics and reading in kindergarten which lay the foundation for learning in later years. Hence, it is important to provide quality support for early development in both mathematics and reading. Although each subject has its own specific skills that children need to develop during early years (e.g., verbal counting for mathematics and phonological awareness for reading), previous studies have shown that the two subjects are interrelated. Some core skills specific to one domain are related to the achievement in the opposite domain (e.g., verbal counting is associated with reading achievement whereas phonological awareness is associated with mathematical achievement). However, we still do not have a full picture of this cross-domain relation. Hence, this project aims to discover how fundamental skills in one domain are associated with the development in the other domain, i.e., mathematics versus reading, during the kindergarten years. Its findings will offer important implications for screening and support for early difficulties in mathematics and reading. To trace children’s development in mathematics and reading, this project is a longitudinal study with four phases across the second and third years of early childhood education in Hong Kong. While most of the previous studies addressing the interrelation between mathematics and reading have focused on inter-individual differences (e.g., why some children have better or worse performance than others), this project takes a different approach by focusing on intra-individual growth (e.g., what predicts the rate of change over time for individual children). Our approach is better aligned with the goal of education, which highlights the importance of supporting individual children to realize their potential. Hence, intra-individual growth is the key. This project aims to discover the “cross-domain” skills which are associated with the growth trajectory of mathematical and reading performance. In particular, it asks whether the initial achievement in one domain predicts the growth of achievement in the other domain. Furthermore, it asks which specific skills in one domain predict the growth of abilities in the other domain, and whether family SES has a role to play in the predictive relations. By addressing these questions, this project will offer a fuller picture of the reciprocal relation between mathematics and reading. 數學與閱讀是學校學習中的兩門核心科目，兩者都是預測個人日後成就的重要指標。在接受小學正式教學之前，兒童早在幼稚園階段便已開始習得某些數學與閱讀技能，為日後的學習奠定基礎。因此，為兒童數學與閱讀早期發展提供優質的支援至關重要。 雖然每門學科都有其特定技能需要兒童在早期階段開發（例如：數學的「口頭數數」與閱讀的「語音意識」），但過往研究顯示這兩門學科是相互關聯的。某些特定領域的核心技能與另一領域的成就相關（例如：「口頭數數」與閱讀成就相關，而「語音意識」則與數學成就相關）。 然而，過往研究仍未能完全了解這種跨領域的關聯性。因此，本計劃旨在探討在幼稚園階段，數學領域的基本技能如何與閱讀領域的發展相關聯。其研究結果將為篩查及支援兒童在數學與閱讀方面的早期困難提供重要啟示。 為了追蹤兒童在數學與閱讀方面的發展，本計劃是一項縱向研究，分為四個階段，涵蓋香港幼稚園教育第二及第三學年。 雖然過往多數探討數學與閱讀之間相互關係的研究都著重於個體間差異（例如：為何某些兒童的表現優於或遜於其他兒童），但本研究採取不同的方法，著眼於個體內成長（例如：哪些因素能預測個別兒童隨時間發展的速度）。 本研究方向更符合教育目標，強調支持兒童實現自身潛能的重要性。因此，個體內成長至關重要。本項目旨在研究與數學和閱讀表現成長軌跡相關的「跨領域」技能。 具體而言，本計劃探討某一領域的初期表現是否能預測另一領域的發展。此外，本研究亦探討某一領域中的哪些具體技能能預測另一領域能力的成長，以及家庭社會經濟地位是否能夠影響其關聯性。透過探討這些問題，本計劃將更全面地詮釋數學與閱讀之間的相互關係。

18616726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18616726.value: 正念優勢介入對緩解伴侶工作—家庭衝突及提升福祉之影響：整群隨機對照試驗

18616726.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18616726.value: Prof Chan, Ka Shing Kevin Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Dr KWOK, Jojo Yan Yan Dr Law, Wilbert Prof YEUNG, Yuen Lan Dannii

18616726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18616726.value: Dual-earner couples with childrearing responsibilities experience higher levels of work-to-family conflict (WFC) compared to other workers. WFC, defined as the pressures and demands of work interfering with family life, can lead to marital conflict and various mental health issues, including burnout, psychological distress, and depression. More than half of dual-earner couples report experiencing WFC, yet many do not receive family-friendly support from employers, who often are not sympathetic to their needs. Given dual-earner couples represent a vastly growing family structure and their detriment impedes fertility rates and economic growth, identifying effective solutions to alleviate WFC and promote wellbeing is of paramount importance. This project aims to broaden the work-family research paradigm by not only focusing on the impairments of multiple role responsibilities but also incorporating the foundational elements of marital, family, and psychosocial functioning that contribute to thriving families. Drawing on the spillover-crossover model and mindfulness-to-meaning theory, we propose a mindfulness-based strengths practice (MBSP) program that combines mindfulness techniques with a focus on character strengths, applied to work-family context. This program is designed to help dual-earner couples mitigate the detrimental impact of WFC, enabling them to thrive within the work-family interface. MBSP encourages dual-earner couples to focus on the present moment, regulate thoughts and emotions, and leverage partner strengths to navigate challenges. We hypothesize that MBSP will have stress-attenuating, stress-buffering, and wellbeing-amplifying effects on dual-earner couples’ WFC and wellbeing. A dyadic, three-group, four-wave, cluster randomized controlled trial will be conducted on 180 dual-earner couples with childrearing responsibilities (360 participants). Participants will engage in an 8-week MBSP web-based training program, which will be compared against an active control receiving a healthy lifestyle program and a waitlist control. Effectiveness will be evaluated through measures on individual and interpersonal mindfulness, character strengths, WFC, marital satisfaction, family satisfaction, and subjective wellbeing, assessed at pre-intervention, interim, immediately post-intervention, and 6-month follow-up. Linear mixed modeling will be conducted to compare changes in outcome variables across groups and structural equation modeling will test the hypothesized actor-partner interdependence model. Completion of this project will yield significant contributions: (1) theoretical advancements by determining whether mindfulness and character strengths effectively reduce WFC and promote wellbeing for individuals and their partners; (2) methodological contributions by generating experimental intervention data that rigorously test the theoretical assumptions underlying existing correlational research on WFC; and (3) practical implications through the development of a feasible, effective, and sustainable MBSP program tailored for dual-earner couples.

18617026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18617026.value: 運用AI驅動、LLM支持的互動社交機器人促進語言學習：三階段干預框架下的混合方法研究

18617026.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18617026.value: Dr Fung, Ka Yan Dr Lin, Dan Prof Song , Sheng Hui

18617026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18617026.value: In Hong Kong, approximately 42% (N=28,600) of the 67,870 integrators in the 2024–2025 academic year are students diagnosed with specific learning disabilities (SpLD) (Education Bureau, 2025). Since SpLD was formally recognized under Special Educational Needs (SEN) in 2008, targeted resources and support mechanisms have been introduced to address their unique challenges. Teacher education programs now emphasize understanding the cognitive and behavioural traits of SpLD students, equipping educators with evidence-based strategies to support their learning. With advancements in educational technology, researchers and practitioners are increasingly exploring how digital tools can improve learning outcomes and accessibility for SEN students. Social educational robots have shown promise in providing feedback and assistance, helping students overcome learning barriers and enhance academic performance. However, many current solutions follow a “one-size-fits-all” model, which may not meet individual needs. The potential of AI-empowered social robots, supported by large language models, to foster social, emotional, and communication skills in students with dyslexia remains underexplored. The team has initiated some small-scale studies on using robots to support learning among students with SEN. (Fung et al., 2025; Chung et al., 2024). Supportive interactions have been shown to positively influence student engagement, motivation, and language proficiency, addressing both the emotional and functional dimensions of learning. This study further investigates how social robots are designed to engage students with dyslexia from both functional and emotional perspectives. A robot-assisted language learning system will be developed specifically for Chinese language acquisition, following a three-phase framework of invention: Phase 1 (Formative Study), Phase 2 (System Development), and Phase 3 (Pilot Study). Guided by the Self-Determination Theory framework, the study will examine outcomes such as behavioural, emotional, and cognitive engagement, along with intrinsic motivation. In Phase 3, a mixed-methods study will be conducted with 240 primary school students, divided into a control group and two experimental groups. The control group will use traditional paper-based materials, Experimental Group 1 will engage with PowerPoint-based content, and Experimental Group 2 will interact directly with the social robot. To ensure robust findings, a triangulation methodology will be employed, incorporating questionnaires, classroom observations, semi-structured interviews, and language proficiency assessments. The insights support Chief Executive’s 2025 Policy Address, which envisions the integration of artificial intelligence into future education. These findings could inspire theoretically advancement, inform policy decisions, guide resource allocation and shape curriculum design that contribute to a more inclusive and technologically empowered educational landscape. 2024–2025學年的統計數字，香港共有67,870名融合生，特殊學習困難學生約佔42% (教育局，2025)。2008年，政府已將「特殊學習困難」納入為有特殊教育需要類別，並逐步提供教師培訓、資源與支援，以適切這些學生的學習需要。隨著科技進步，數字教育有助提升有特殊教育需要學生的學習成果。近年來，教師也常應用社交機器人於學教活動內，以提供即時回饋，促進學業表現。然而，目前許多活動，仍採取「一刀切」的模式，未能充分回應學生的個別差異。人工智能驅動的社交機器人，若能結合大型語言模型，可促進讀寫困難學生的社交、情感與溝通方面發展，其效用值得深入探討。本研究團隊曾展開先導研究，利用機器人支援有特殊教育需要學生的學習。結果顯示，具支持性的互動能夠正面影響學生的投入度、學習動機與語言能力，並同時回應學習的情感層面與功能層面。 本研究旨在從功能性與情感性兩個角度，深入地探討社交機器人如何促進讀寫困難學生的學習參與。研究計劃將開發一套專為中文語言習得而設的機器人輔助學習系統，並依循三階段的創新框架，包括「形成性研究」 、「系統開發」及「試點研究」，以自我決定理論為基礎，檢視學生在行為、情感與認知投入方面的表現，以及其內在動機的變化。在第三階段中，研究也採用混合方法，於240名小學生內，進行三組教學，分別為傳統紙本教材、簡報教材及社交機器人互動，並採用三角檢證法，結合問卷調查、課堂觀察、半結構式訪談以及語言能力測驗等多元方法，以全面分析學生的學習成效。 本研究與香港特區行政長官李家超於2025年施政報告中提出的願景相呼應，即推動人工智能在未來教育中的整合。成果不僅能為教育政策的制定提供參考，亦可指導資源調配與課程設計，從而促進教育的包容性與科技化，建構更具前瞻性的教育生態。此外。本研究也藉社交機器人的介入，提升讀寫困難學生的語言及情感學習、學習動機與投入度。

18617126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18617126.value: 發展教師智能化整合技術的學科教學知識（Intelligent-TPACK）的隨機對照研究：利用聊天機器人輔助的鷹架支持自我調節學習

18617126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18617126.value: Dr Chen, Chen Logan Prof Chiu, Kin Fung, Thomas Dr Ismail, Celik Prof Lai, Chun Prof Looi, Chee Kit

18617126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18617126.value: Teachers’ intelligent-TPACK (I-TPACK) refers to their knowledge of how to make effective and ethical use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to enhance curriculum design and instruction (Celik, 2023; Chiu, 2025). Despite growing international emphasis on cultivating teachers’ I-TPACK (UNESCO, 2024; Vidal et al., 2023), current professional development programmes seldom embed self-regulated learning (SRL) principles that help teachers plan, monitor, and reflect on their GenAI integration. Previous SRL-based interventions have demonstrated positive effects on learning outcomes, yet few have extended to teacher professional learning or employed GenAI-enabled scaffolding to deliver adaptive and personalised support. To address this gap, the proposed project will develop and test a chatbot-scaffolded SRL (CSSRL) model integrating Zimmerman’s three SRL phases with four types of GenAI-enabled scaffolding (representational, cognitive, metacognitive, and motivational) to support teachers’ personalised learning. Building on the PI’s pilot work, a 15-week online professional development programme comprising five I-TPACK modules will be developed, consisting of an experimental condition (CSSRL) and a control condition (flipped professional development, [FPD]). Both conditions cover identical learning content, but will differ in instructional design. In the CSSRL condition, each module will guide teachers through a full SRL cycle supported by a large language model-based chatbot providing real-time, phase-aligned, and context-responsive scaffolding, whereas the FPD condition will follow a conventional flipped format without SRL structuring or chatbot support. The programme will be evaluated through a randomised controlled trial with 220 secondary school teachers in Hong Kong. Participants will be individually randomised to an experimental condition (CSSRL; n =110) or a control condition (FPD; n =110). Data sources will include three survey waves assessing teachers’ I-TPACK at T1 (pre-programme), T2 (post-programme), and T3 (two-month follow-up), as well as a performance-based task, interviews, artefacts, reflective journals, and chatbot logs. Quantitative, qualitative, and learning analytics approaches will be integrated to evaluate programme effectiveness, identify enabling and constraining factors, and refine the CSSRL model by testing how different scaffolding types align with SRL phases and shape learning outcomes. The project contributes theoretically by establishing an evidence-based CSSRL model integrating chatbot-facilitated scaffolding with SRL phases to enhance professional learning. Building on this model, it represents the first professional development programme offering teachers personalised and adaptive SRL support. Beyond the local context, this low-threshold, scalable, and research-informed programme offers a benchmark for professional development and generates transferable insights to guide international efforts to strengthen teachers’ GenAI competency. 教師智能化整合技術的學科教學知識（intelligent technological pedagogical content knowledge, I-TPACK）是指教師為有效且合乎倫理地運用生成式人工智能以提升課程設計與教學成效而需具備的知識（Celik, 2023；Chiu, 2025）。儘管國際社會日益重視教師 I-TPACK 的培養（UNESCO, 2024；Vidal et al., 2023），現有教師專業發展課程甚少融入自我調節學習（self-regulated learning, SRL）來協助教師規劃、監控並反思其在教學中運用GenAI 的過程。以SRL 為核心的實驗研究已證實其能有效促進學習成效，但鮮有研究將SRL應用於教師專業學習或運用 GenAI 輔助鷹架提供彈性的、個人化的支援。 為填補上述研究缺口，本研究將建構並檢驗「聊天機器人輔助的鷹架支持自我調節學習」（chatbot-scaffolded self-regulated learning, CSSRL）模式。該模式整合 Zimmerman 提出的三個 SRL 階段，以及四類由 GenAI 提供的學習鷹架（表徵鷹架、認知鷹架、後設認知鷹架與動機鷹架）以支援教師的個人化學習。本研究將以項目負責人的前期試行研究為基礎，開發一套為期 15 週、包含五個 I-TPACK 模組的線上教師專業發展課程。課程分為實驗組（CSSRL）與對照組（翻轉式專業發展，flipped professional development, FPD）。兩組的學習內容完全相同，但採用不同的教學設計。在 CSSRL 組中，每個模組均引導教師完成一個完整的 SRL 循環，並由以大語言模型為基礎的聊天機器人依據不同學習階段與具體情境即時提供相應的學習鷹架。FPD 組則採用一般的翻轉學習模式，既不設置 SRL 學習架構，也不提供聊天機器人支援。 本課程將透過隨機對照試驗進行成效評估，研究對象為 220 名香港中學教師。參與者將以個人為單位，隨機分配至實驗組（CSSRL；n = 110）或對照組（FPD；n = 110）。研究資料包括於三個時間點的問卷調查，分別於 T1（課程開始前）、T2（課程結束後）及 T3（課程結束兩個月後的追蹤測量）評估教師的 I-TPACK。此外，本研究的資料來源亦包括實作表現評量、訪談、學習成果作品、反思日誌及聊天機器人互動紀錄。本研究將整合量化分析、質性分析與學習分析方法，以評估課程成效、辨識促進或制約教師學習的因素，並探討不同類型的學習鷹架如何配合各個 SRL 階段並影響學習成果，進而完善 CSSRL 模式。 在理論層面，本研究將建立一套以實證為基礎的 CSSRL 模式，將聊天機器人提供的學習鷹架與 SRL 各階段有機整合，以促進教師專業學習。本研究以此模式為基礎，開發首個為教師提供個人化與適應性SRL 支援的專業發展課程。本研究的價值並不限於香港本地情境：這套低門檻、可規模化且以研究實證為基礎的課程，可為不同國家及地區的教師專業發展提供參考範式，並為提升教師的 GenAI 素養提供具參考價值的啟示。

18617326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18617326.value: 探討家長的 GenAI 回饋素養及其對學生學業學習之影響：工具發展與驗證

18617326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18617326.value: Prof Chen, Gaowei Prof CHIU, Ming Ming Dr Lam, Chun Bun Ian Prof Li, Sandy S C Prof Yan, Zi

18617326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18617326.value: Children do activities at home, and those who get better feedback from their parents learn more. However, most parents do not know how to supervise their students’ daily chats with Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI)—they lack Parent-GenAI feedback literacy (P-GenAIFL). So, they can be overprotective, overcontrolling, or overly critical of their children’s GenAI use and obstruct their learning. Although many researchers examined students’ and teachers’ GenAI feedback literacies, no one designed and validated a survey instrument to assess P-GenAIFL to show its effects on student learning outcomes. Without such an instrument, we cannot examine P-GenAIFL and determine its effect on student learning, let alone test the effectiveness of parent intervention programs. To address this issue, we will do a study with three parts. First, we create and validate an instrument to measure P-GenAIFL knowledge, beliefs, and practices. Second, we assess the P-GenAIFL of parents in Hong Kong. Third, we explore the effects of P-GenAIFL on students’ learning outcomes. Guided by our definition of P-GenAIFL and individual interviews with experts and parents, we identify the subdimension(s) of each P-GenAIFL dimension and create items for them. Experts check these items for substantive and content validity. Parent feedback help us refine the items. The parents/caregivers of 300 junior secondary students in Hong Kong will pilot test and semi-finalize the P-GenAIFL instrument. In the main study, another 300 parents will collect their children’s school grades and complete the P-GenAIFL. Using these P-GenAIFL responses, we determine the dimensionality of the P-GenAIFL items, each item’s quality, each subdimension’s reliability, and the scales’ external validity (against actual daily practices) in our Rasch model. Next, we assess their P-GenAIFL profiles and test whether P-GenAIFL is linked to their children’s school grades via structural equation modeling, accounting for the nested data structure. Pilot study data will be utilized in the main analysis if at least four items per subdimension remain, as common items to link the pilot and the main scales. Scholars will use our validated P-GenAIFL instrument to conduct quantitative studies determining the antecedents, mechanisms, and moderators of parents’ P-GenAIFL across contexts. Our findings regarding the local P-GenAIFL profiles and its link to students' learning outcomes will inform (a) stakeholders seeking to understand Hong Kong parents’ P-GenAIFL strengths and weaknesses and (b) corresponding parent intervention programs to boost students' learning. 兒童在家進行活動，而那些從父母得到較佳回饋的孩子學到更多。然而，大多數家長不知道如何督導子女每日與生成式人工智慧（GenAI）的對話——他們缺乏「家長對 GenAI 的回饋素養」（P-GenAIFL）。因此，他們可能對子女使用 GenAI 過度保護、過度控制或過度批評，從而妨礙其學習。儘管許多研究者已檢視學生與教師的 GenAI 回饋素養，但尚未有人設計並驗證一份調查工具來評估 P-GenAIFL，以顯示其對學生學習成果的影響。沒有這樣的工具，我們便無法檢視 P-GenAIFL 並確定其對學生學習的影響，更遑論測試家長介入方案的有效性。 為了解決此問題，我們將進行一項包含三個部分的研究。首先，我們編製並驗證一份測量 P-GenAIFL 知識、信念與實踐的工具。其次，我們評估香港家長的 P-GenAIFL。第三，我們探討 P-GenAIFL 對學生學習成果的影響。在我們對 P-GenAIFL 的定義以及與專家及家長進行個別訪談的引導下，我們找出每個 P-GenAIFL 構面的次構面，並為其編寫題項。專家會檢查這些題項的實質效度與內容效度。家長回饋有助於我們修正題項。 香港 300 名初中生的家長／照顧者將進行預試，並初步定稿 P-GenAIFL 工具。在主研究中，另外 300 名家長將蒐集其子女的學校成績，並填寫 P-GenAIFL。利用這些 P-GenAIFL 填答資料，我們在 Rasch 模型中確定 P-GenAIFL 題項的向度性、每個題項的品質、每個次構面的信度，以及量尺的外部效度（對照實際日常實踐）。接著，我們評估其 P-GenAIFL 樣貌，並透過結構方程模式檢驗 P-GenAIFL 是否與其子女的學校成績有關，同時考量巢套資料結構。若每個次構面至少保留四題，預試資料將在主分析中作為連結預試與主量尺的共同題項使用。 學者將使用我們已驗證的 P-GenAIFL 工具進行量化研究，以探討不同情境下家長 P-GenAIFL 的前因、機制與調節因素。我們關於本地 P-GenAIFL 樣貌及其與學生學習成果關聯的發現，將有助於：(a) 想了解香港家長 P-GenAIFL 優勢與弱點的利害關係人，以及 (b) 相應的家長介入方案，以提升學生學習。

18618326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18618326.value: 正念強化的家長行為訓練對自閉症兒童家庭的成效、機制及經濟效益評估：一項隨機對照試驗

18618326.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18618326.value: Dr Cheung, Amanda Kingsze Prof Krägeloh, Christian Prof Lam, Gary Yu-hin Prof Zhang, Dexing

18618326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18618326.value: Autistic children often exhibit externalizing behavior problems that can affect their daily functioning and well-being. Early intensive behavioral interventions are crucial for improving their long-term outcomes, and Behavioral Parent Training (BPT) supports these intervention efforts by training parents to implement behavioral management strategies for their children in everyday life. However, many parents of autistic children experience significant stress, which can hinder their effective implementation of these strategies and impede behavioral improvements in their children. Conventional BPT primarily focuses on child behavior outcomes and does not directly address parental psychological well-being. However, child behavior problems and parenting stress often co-occur and influence each other reciprocally. Without addressing both concerns concurrently, families of autistic children may be trapped in a vicious cycle where parental stress reduces BPT fidelity and efficacy, while persistent child behavior problems further exacerbate parental stress. To break this cycle, it is essential to integrate psychotherapeutic support into BPT to promote parental mental health, enabling parents to effectively implement behavioral management strategies. A particularly promising psychotherapeutic approach to complement BPT is mindfulness training. As mindfulness emphasizes nonjudgmental awareness, acceptance, and non-reactivity, it can help parents alleviate stress and foster emotional equanimity. By enhancing mental wellness, parents can more calmly and consistently implement behavioral management strategies for their children. Given these potential benefits, mindfulness training is a valuable approach for integration into BPT to create synergy. The proposed project aims to establish an innovative, dual-focus intervention for families of autistic children by incorporating mindfulness training into BPT. While conventional BPT focuses on improving child behavior, Mindfulness-Enhanced BPT (ME-BPT) additionally targets reducing parenting stress to provide more comprehensive family support. Specifically, we will conduct a randomized controlled trial to investigate: (1) whether ME-BPT is more efficacious than BPT in reducing child behavior problems and parenting stress; (2) whether parental mindfulness mediates these effects; and (3) whether ME-BPT is more cost-effective than BPT. Theoretically, this project will create novel knowledge about the comparative efficacy of ME-BPT and BPT in improving child and parental outcomes. It will also advance understanding of the specific psychological mechanism through which ME-BPT provides distinct benefits compared to BPT. Practically, ME-BPT, if proven efficacious and cost-effective, can be applied as an evidence-based method to simultaneously address child and parental well-being, offering long-term benefits for families of autistic children. Supported by these favorable outcomes, we could promote ME-BPT to government and community organizations for incorporation into family support services.

18619126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18619126.value: 好工作還是好地方？公共部門的職業偏好與高學歷年青人才的就業目的地選擇

18619126.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18619126.value: Dr Jiang, Ronghao Prof Lin, Sainan Dr Wu, Alfred Dr Yang, Fan

18619126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18619126.value: The employment landscape of highly educated youths in China is characterized by a distinctive pattern of sectoral preference with around two-thirds of university students expressing a strong intention to secure a stable career in state sector. Such sectoral preference is increasingly difficult to be met in China’s top-tier cities dominated by volatile private sector jobs. Whether to prioritize the access to state sector employment or the location in vibrant urban centers in the employment decision-making process of university students upon graduation is an issue of significant policy implications for both urban/regional governments concerned about the battle for educated talents and national economic planners wary of a potential brain drain from private to state sector. Existing literature on the university-to-work migration of university graduates is dominated by the debate over the relative importance of economic returns, urban amenities and social network as the attractive factors of the destination locations, with little attention paid to the role of job preference in China’s institutional context. Meanwhile, studies on the occupation choice and labor market outcomes of China’s university graduates are concerned with the impact of higher education and social origin on their choice between state and private sector employment without probing further into their complex and diversified location choices. Knowledge gaps are apparent in the missing link between these two bodies of literature warranting a serious investigation of the interaction between sectoral preference and spatial preference in shaping the destination choices of highly educated youths in China. This research will include a quantitative analysis of the choice experiment survey of final-year university students and a qualitative analysis of university graduates eventually working in state sector through data collected from universities in Wuhan and Guangzhou. It aims to 1) identify the destination choice pattern of university students driven by the preference for state sector employment; 2) investigate the individual and social factors conditioning the destination choices of public career-oriented university students; 3) excavate the variegated spatial pathways and strategies leading to the job attainment in state sector by university graduates. The findings of this proposed project will contribute new knowledge to advance theoretical inquiry into the complex nature and dynamics of the destination choices of highly educated youths in different institutional and cultural contexts and will be of direct relevance to Hong Kong with strategic interests in attracting and retaining mainland students. 在中國，高學歷青年就業的格局呈現出鮮明的行業偏好特徵：約三分之二的大學生非常希望在穩定的國有部門工作。然而，這種行業偏好日益難以在由私營部門主導的中國一二線城市中得到滿足。大學畢業生在就業決策時，應將優先爭取進入國有部門的就業機會，還是優先選擇充滿活力的城市區位，是對關心人才爭奪的城市和區域政府和警惕人才從私營部門向國有部門流失的國家宏觀經濟管理者都十分重要的政策議題。 現有關於大學畢業生就業流動的研究，主要集中在爭論目的地選擇中經濟回報、城市宜居性與社會網絡等吸引因素的相對重要性，而較少關注部門與工作偏好在中國製度情境下所扮演的作用。與此同時，關於中國大學畢業生職業選擇與勞動力市場結果的研究，通常討論高等教育以及社會出身對其在國有部門與私營部門之間擇業的影響，但並未進一步深入其複雜且多樣化的空間區位選擇。這兩個研究領域之間存在明顯的研究空白：即需要認真探討“行業偏好”與“空間偏好”之間的互動及其對中國高學歷青年目的地選擇的影響。 本研究將包括對武漢和廣州畢業年級大學生開展的選擇實驗問卷的定量分析以及對最終進入國有部門工作的大學畢業生進行的質性分析。研究旨在：1）識別由國有部門就業偏好驅動的大學生目的地選擇模式；2）探究影響公共部門就業傾向的大學生目的地選擇的個人與社會因素；3）挖掘大學畢業生進入國有部門就業所經歷的多樣化空間路徑與策略。本項目的研究發現將有助於推進對不同制度與文化情境下，高學歷青年目的地選擇的複雜性與動態性的理論探討，同時對致力於吸引與留住內地學生的香港具有重要的借鑑意義。

21104726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21104726.value: 解析中央外側（及鄰近）丘腦核團與前扣帶皮層組成之丘腦皮質迴路在小鼠噪音誘發逃避行為中的功能

21104726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21104726.value: Innate defensive behavior is a crucial survival response for animals. Previous research has established the importance of various lower-level brain regions and pathways in directly controlling innate defensive responses. Furthermore, our and other studies have recognized the modulation effect of higher-order cortical areas, especially the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), on these behaviors, highlighting the ACC’s role in flight behavior through direct and indirect projections to lower-level pathways. However, the role of the thalamocortical circuit involving thalamic nuclei and the ACC in innate defensive behavior remains largely unknown. Therefore, we raise the question of how this circuit participates in generating proper defensive behavior. We hypothesize that thalamic input significantly drives ACC neurons to modulate this defensive behavior. In this proposed study, first, we will characterize the anatomical connection between the thalamus and ACC using retrograde and anterograde tracing, alongside c-fos staining, to visualize activation patterns in noise-induced flight behavior (Objective 1). Preliminary data have indicated an intensive projection from the central lateral (and neighboring) thalamic nuclei (CLN) to the ACC. Second, we plan to investigate neuronal activities within this circuit during noise-induced flight behavior, employing fiber photometry recording and electrophysiological tagging techniques (Objective 2). Early data show robust activation in the circuit correlating with flight behavior. Third, we will test the necessity and sufficiency of the CLN to ACC projection in mediating flight behavior using optogenetic and chemogenetic manipulation (Objective 3). Our hypothesis is supported by initial findings that manipulating this pathway alters the flight response, and intriguingly, preliminary data suggest that this pathway suppresses the noise-induced running in the head-fixing paradigm and leads to an optimal flight route in the free-moving paradigm. Lastly, we intend to explore the mechanisms underlying this suppression effect by the thalamocortical circuit (Objective 4). This will involve in vivo and in vitro electrophysiological recordings to examine neuronal responses in the ACC and its various downstream areas when activating the projection from the CLN to the ACC, and check connectivity patterns between these areas. This research will answer critical questions about the involvement of this circuit in generating appropriate defensive behavior, aiming to reveal how this pathway potentially works as a "brake" to optimize flight behavior and avoid an aimless charge. The findings will contribute to a deeper apprehension of the neural basis of fear and anxiety, potentially highlighting new targets for disorders such as PTSD and specific phobias. 先天防禦行為是動物至關重要的生存反應。先前的研究已確立了各種低階腦區及其通路在控制先天防禦反應中的重要性。此外，我們及其他研究已認識到高級皮層，尤其是前扣帶皮層（ACC），對這些行為的調控作用。其中，ACC通過對低階通路的直接與間接投射在逃避行為中扮演重要角色。然而，丘腦核團與ACC組成的丘腦皮質迴路在先天防禦行為中的作用目前仍缺乏研究。因此，本項目著重於研究這一迴路如何參與產生適當防禦行為的過程，並提出相關假設：丘腦輸入會顯著驅動ACC神經元，以調控動物的防禦行為。 在本研究計畫中，首先，我們將利用順向與逆向追蹤，確認丘腦與ACC之間的解剖連結，以及c-fos染色，展現噪音誘發逃避行為中的神經激活模式（目標一）。初步數據已顯示中央外側（及鄰近）丘腦核團（CLN）向ACC發出密集的投射。其次，我們計畫採用鈣成像記錄與電生理標記技術，研究噪音誘發逃避行為過程中此迴路內的神經元活動（目標二）。早期數據顯示該迴路的強烈激活與逃避行為密切相關。第三，我們將利用光遺傳學與化學遺傳學操控，研究CLN至ACC迴路在調控逃避行為中的必要性與充分性（目標三）。初步發現支持我們的假說：操控此通路會改變逃避反應；值得注意的是，初步數據顯示此通路能抑制頭部固定範式中噪音誘發的奔跑行為，並在自由活動範式中產生最佳逃避路徑。最後，我們擬探討此丘腦皮質迴路發揮抑制效應的潛在機制（目標四）。相關實驗涉及體內與體外電生理記錄，以檢視激活CLN至ACC投射時，ACC 及其各下游區域的神經元反應，並確認這些區域之間的連結模式。 本研究將闡明此迴路在產生適當防禦行為中的功能，並揭示此通路如何作為「煞車」以優化逃避行為從而避免無目的的衝撞。本研究結果將有助於深化對恐懼與焦慮神經基礎的理解，並有望為創傷後壓力症候群（PTSD）及特定恐懼症等疾病提供新的治療靶點。

21200226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200226.value: 邁向拜占庭容錯系統的全棧自適應

21200226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200226.value: Byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) systems, composed of distributed nodes, ensure security and reliability even under arbitrary node behaviors. Grounded in decades of foundational work, BFT systems are critical in today’s blockchains, cloud computing, cyber-physical systems, and more. However, as scale and user demands grow, the performance of traditional BFT systems is constantly questioned. Existing research efforts on improving performance primarily focus on designing static and siloed BFT systems tailored to a specific workload, fault scenario, and hardware setup. Unfortunately, prior studies have shown that such rigid and siloed systems are fragile in realistic deployments where workloads are dynamic, adversarial attacks evolve, and hardware configurations could change. The performance of a given system varies significantly as the environment changes, and the previously best-performing system could immediately become the worst. In other words, there is no one-size-fits-all BFT system that consistently delivers satisfactory performance. This lack of a clear “winner” among BFT systems, combined with their complexity, makes it difficult for application developers to select one and properly configure it. Worse yet, their choice might be invalidated as workloads or fault scenarios change. In this project, we aim to address this challenge by designing full-stack adaptive BFT systems that learn to adjust to environmental dynamics in real-time, in order to optimize runtime performance. Our plan includes two tasks: 1) Designing learned adaptive BFT consensus protocols. We will start by co-designing reinforcement learning algorithms with leader-based BFT consensus protocols, enabling adaptive protocol switching and parameter tuning while preserving safety and liveness. We will then extend our approach to directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based BFT protocols which exhibit more complexity and larger action space. To achieve the pinnacle of adaptivity, we will next investigate automated synthesis of new variants of leader-based and DAG-based BFT consensus protocols during runtime, where the new variants outperform existing protocols. This builds on our initial research on formalizing protocol design dimensions and valid design choices. 2) Developing an adaptive execution stack for BFT systems. The second half of our project goes beyond the consensus layer, aiming to adapt the entire execution stack to maximize end-to-end system performance. Building on insights from the first task, we will design learned adaptive transaction management paradigms for BFT systems. We will then develop an adaptive infrastructure layer for BFT systems based on our initial work on resource disaggregation. Finally, we plan to orchestrate cross-layer adaptation to unlock holistic system-level improvements. 拜占庭容錯（Byzantine Fault Tolerant，BFT）系統由多個分散式節點組成，即使部分節點出現任意或惡意行為，仍能確保系統的安全性與可靠性。經過數十年的基礎研究，BFT 系統已成為區塊鏈、雲端運算及網絡物理系統等領域的重要基礎。然而，隨着系統規模和使用者需求增長，傳統 BFT 系統的效能日益受到挑戰。現有研究大多針對特定工作負載、故障情境及硬件配置，設計靜態且彼此割裂的系統。這類僵化設計在實際部署中十分脆弱，因為工作負載會動態變化、對抗性攻擊會持續演化，而硬件配置亦可能改變。同一系統的效能會隨環境顯著波動，原本表現最佳的系統甚至可能迅速變成最差。因此，並不存在一套能在所有情況下持續提供理想效能的通用 BFT 系統。各類系統之間缺乏明確的最佳選擇，加上其設計與配置複雜，令應用程式開發者難以選擇合適的系統及正確設定參數，而原有選擇亦可能因工作負載或故障情境改變而失效。 本項目旨在設計全棧自適應 BFT 系統，使其能夠實時學習環境變化並作出調整，以優化運行效能。研究包括兩項任務。第一，設計學習驅動的自適應 BFT 共識協議。我們將協同設計強化學習算法與基於領導者的 BFT 協議，使系統能在維持安全性與活性的前提下，自適應地切換協議及調整參數。其後，我們會將方法擴展至結構更複雜、動作空間更大的有向無環圖（Directed Acyclic Graph，DAG）式 BFT 協議。進一步而言，我們將研究在運行期間自動合成新的領導者式及 DAG 式協議變體，使其效能超越現有協議。此工作建基於我們對協議設計維度及有效設計選項形式化的初步研究。第二，開發 BFT 系統的自適應執行棧。我們將研究範圍由共識層擴展至整個執行棧，以最大化端到端系統效能。基於第一項任務的研究成果，我們將設計學習驅動的自適應交易管理範式，並以資源解耦方面的初步工作為基礎，開發自適應基礎設施層。最後，我們將協調跨層自適應機制，實現整體性的系統級效能提升。

21200626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200626.value: 铺贴不规则地面瓷砖：施工现场3D扫描与CNC湿式切割机系统

21200626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200626.value: Ceramic tiling is a common flooring finish worldwide because of its durability and diverse aesthetic options. Recent advancements in construction robotics have mainly focused on installing large, regular tiles in unobstructed open spaces. However, these robotic systems cannot handle irregular tiles, limiting their applications for residential interiors. In Hong Kong residential apartments, smaller rooms and narrow corridors require a large proportion of irregular tiles. A preliminary study on public housing floor plans shows that up to 40% of tiles are irregular (by piece count, for 60 cm tiles). Across the entire tiling process, measuring and cutting these irregular pieces remains the most time-consuming and error-prone task. Because of the narrow tolerances required to fit site-specific perimeters, the geometry of these irregular tiles cannot be reliably derived from digital floor plans, making on-site measurement essential. Unfortunately, thus far, robotic tiling projects have overlooked these irregular tiles, leaving them to be measured, cut, and installed manually by workers using traditional methods. This project proposes a human-machine collaboration approach to improve the productivity of (1) measuring irregular floor edges by using high-accuracy 3D scanners that have recently become affordable, and (2) cutting irregular tiles with a computer-controlled wet saw that will be developed in this project. The system is designed to be transportable and deployable in existing job-sites and strives to improve worker productivity as a drop-in enhancement of the existing manual workflow without requiring significant retraining.
