These findings highlight PLIN5 as a potential mediator of MNP-induced muscle damage and a promising target for intervention. However, real-world MNP exposure is chronic, and sex-specific responses, particularly given higher PLIN5 expression in females, remain unexplored. Moreover, the role of PLIN5 in mediating the benefits of ET under prolonged exposure conditions has yet to be validated. This project will build on these findings by: (1) Investigating the long-term (up to 3 months) effects of MNP exposure on skeletal muscle health in both sexes. (2) Determining the therapeutic role of PLIN5 through targeted restoration in MNP-exposed muscle using the same animal model established in Aim 1. (3) Evaluating the efficacy of ET in reversing MNP-induced muscle dysfunction via PLIN5 modulation, using targeted knockdown approaches in the same model. We hypothesize that MNP exposure leads to impaired metabolism and subsequent deterioration of skeletal muscle by disrupting PLIN5 expression. Restoring PLIN5—e.g., via ET—may counteract these effects, offering a promising strategy against MNP-induced muscle deterioration. By integrating environmental science, biomedicine, and orthopaedics, this multidisciplinary study addresses a timely and emerging public health issue. The findings will not only advance our understanding of how environmental stress affects musculoskeletal systems but also offer practical strategies for mitigating their impact. This research aligns with global efforts to address plastic pollution and contributes to public health by identifying modifiable risk factors and interventions. 微塑膠及納米塑膠（MNPs）在日常生活中愈來愈常見，近期更在包括肌肉骨骼系統在內的人體組織中被檢出。儘管愈來愈多證據顯示，MNPs 暴露與多個器官的不良影響有關，但其對骨骼肌的影響仍未得到充分了解；而骨骼肌是維持身體活動、代謝及整體健康的關鍵組織。 我們的先導研究顯示，年輕成年雄性小鼠暴露於 MNPs 一個月後，會出現顯著的肌肉退化。組織學分析顯示肌肉形態受損，功能測試則顯示肌力下降。代謝評估顯示，骨骼肌的脂質代謝及能量產生受到干擾。值得注意的是，我們發現，MNPs 暴露後，肌肉中 PLIN5 的表達下調。PLIN5 是一種脂滴相關蛋白，對能量及脂質代謝至關重要。恢復 PLIN5 表達可改善能量產生、減少脂質積聚，並部分恢復肌肉功能。此外，已知可上調骨骼肌 PLIN5 表達的耐力訓練（ET），亦改善了 MNPs 暴露小鼠的肌肉相關指標，從而提供了一項非侵入性的干預策略。 這些發現顯示，PLIN5 可能是 MNPs 誘發肌肉損傷的介導因子，亦是具潛力的干預標靶。然而，現實環境中的 MNPs 暴露通常是長期持續的，而性別特異性反應，尤其是在雌性具有較高 PLIN5 表達水平的情況下，仍未得到充分研究。此外，在長期暴露條件下，PLIN5 在介導 ET 有益作用方面的角色亦尚待驗證。本項目將在上述發現的基礎上： （1）研究長期（最長三個月）MNPs 暴露對雄性及雌性骨骼肌健康的影響。 （2）利用研究目標一所建立的同一動物模型，在受 MNPs 暴露的肌肉中針對性恢復 PLIN5 表達，以確定 PLIN5 的治療作用。 （3）在同一動物模型中採用針對 PLIN5 的基因敲低方法，評估 ET 透過調控 PLIN5 逆轉 MNPs 誘發肌肉功能障礙的成效。 我們假設，MNPs 暴露會透過干擾 PLIN5 表達，導致代謝受損，繼而引起骨骼肌退化。恢復 PLIN5 表達（例如透過 ET）或可抵消這些影響，為對抗 MNPs 誘發的骨骼肌退化提供一項具潛力的策略。 本跨學科研究結合環境科學、生物醫學及骨科醫學，回應一項適時且新興的公共衞生議題。研究結果不僅有助增進我們對環境壓力如何影響肌肉骨骼系統的了解，亦可為減輕相關影響提供實際策略。本研究與全球應對塑膠污染的努力一致，並透過識別可改變的風險因素及干預措施，為公共衞生作出貢獻。

24123626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24123626.value: SGLT2 抑制劑用於 2 型糖尿病患者心血管—腎臟事件一級預防的長期成本效益：運用患者層面華人糖尿預後預測模型，以價值基礎定價法進行衞生技術再評估

24123626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24123626.value: Diabetes is a prevalent chronic disease impacting around 1 in 10 people worldwide and the number of people with diabetes are growing. Diabetes impacts on cardiovascular-renal health outcomes with major socioeconomic implications. Existing and newly developed glucose-lowering medications have been proven to reduce complications, hospitalizations and premature mortality. Sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) are a novel class of oral glucose-lowering drugs that lower blood glucose levels by increasing urinary glucose excretion. Existing clinical trials have demonstrated remarkable efficacy of SGLT2i in reducing cardiovascular-renal events in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D) with existing or at high risk of cardiovascular-renal events. However, evidence for effectiveness of SGLT2i in the broader population of patients with T2D with low or moderate risk of cardiovascular events is limited. Majority of cost-effectiveness research focuses on SGLT2i in high-risk patients with diabetes with existing cardiovascular-renal diseases. Available evidence regarding cost-effectiveness of SGLT2i for primary prevention in Caucasian and Chinese populations is inconclusive. This inconsistency can be attributed to research method differences and failure to account for the distinct risk progression patterns and disease development between Caucasians and Chinese. Utilization of risk equations developed in Western dominant cohorts in Chinese patients has contributed to resulting discrepancies. This study aims to evaluate the long-term effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of administering SGLT2i alone or in combination with other glucose-lowering drugs in patients with T2D without prior cardiovascular-renal events in Hong Kong. Furthermore, we aim to identify patient subgroups, based on biomarkers and demographics, to maximize the cost-effectiveness of different treatment combinations involving SGLT2i for primary prevention. We will utilize our in-house developed and externally validated patient-level simulation model - Chinese Diabetes Outcomes Model (CDOM v2.0) with integrated risk equations, hospital costs and quality of life (QoL) regression models derived from real-world data of 24,533 Chinese patients with T2D in Hong Kong followed-up between 2000-2019. External validation of the model will be conducted using datasets from mainland China, Taiwan, and Malaysia to bolster generalizability. Additionally, the study emphasizes the role of value-based pricing in the health-technology reassessment of SGLT2i, particularly as these medications are set to lose patent protection in 2025. This approach ensures that medication pricing reflects true clinical value and real-world outcomes, facilitating fair competition and effective resource allocation in healthcare systems. Findings will provide valuable insights for clinicians in selecting medications and tailoring personalized interventions, while also informing policymakers on drug formulary decisions and healthcare resource allocation. 糖尿病是一種常見的慢性疾病，影響全球約十分之一人口，而且糖尿病患者人數正持續上升。糖尿病會影響心血管及腎臟健康結局，並帶來重大的社會經濟影響。現有及新研發的降血糖藥物已被證實可減少併發症、住院及過早死亡。 鈉—葡萄糖協同轉運蛋白 2 抑制劑（SGLT2i）是一類新型口服降血糖藥物，透過增加尿糖排泄以降低血糖水平。現有臨床試驗顯示，SGLT2i 對於已有心血管—腎臟事件或屬相關高風險的 2 型糖尿病（T2D）患者，在減少心血管—腎臟事件方面具顯著療效。然而，對於心血管事件風險屬低至中等的較廣泛 T2D 患者群體，SGLT2i 的有效性證據仍然有限。 大部分成本效益研究集中於已有心血管—腎臟疾病的高風險糖尿病患者使用 SGLT2i 的情況。現有關於 SGLT2i 在白人及華人人群中用於一級預防的成本效益證據仍未有定論。這種不一致可歸因於研究方法差異，以及未能充分考慮白人與華人在風險進展模式及疾病發展方面的差異。在華人患者中使用主要由西方人群隊列建立的風險方程，亦導致研究結果出現差異。 本研究旨在評估於香港未曾發生心血管—腎臟事件的 T2D 患者中，單獨使用 SGLT2i 或與其他降血糖藥物聯合使用的長期有效性及成本效益。此外，我們亦旨在根據生物標誌物及人口學特徵識別患者亞組，以最大化不同包含 SGLT2i 的治療組合在一級預防中的成本效益。 我們將採用由本團隊自行開發並經外部驗證的患者層面模擬模型 - 華人糖尿預後預測模型（Chinese Diabetes Outcomes Model，CDOM v2.0）。該模型整合了風險方程、住院成本及生活質素（quality of life, QoL）迴歸模型，並建基於香港 24,533 名 T2D 華人患者於 2000 至 2019 年期間隨訪的真實世界數據。模型的外部驗證將使用來自中國內地、台灣及馬來西亞的數據集進行，以提升其可推廣性。 此外，本研究強調以價值為本定價在 SGLT2i 衞生技術再評估中的作用，尤其是這類藥物將於 2025 年失去專利保護。此方法確保藥物定價能反映其真實臨床價值及真實世界結局，從而促進公平競爭，並有助醫療系統有效分配資源。 研究結果將為臨床醫生在藥物選擇及制訂個人化介入方案方面提供有價值的見解，同時亦為政策制定者在藥物名冊決策及醫療資源分配方面提供參考。

24202326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24202326.value: 基於大型語言模型與文字提示的多樂器音樂轉錄

24202326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24202326.value: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) refers to the process of converting music recordings into symbolic representations such as MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface), a standard digital format that encodes musical notes and performance information. AMT is an interdisciplinary research problem at the intersection of music information retrieval (MIR) and artificial intelligence (AI). AMT serves as a fundamental building block for various downstream tasks, including music analysis, recognition, source separation, editing, and symbolic music generation. With the global music industry generating over USD 28.6 billion in annual revenue and more than 500 million streaming subscribers, the demand for intelligent music understanding technologies continues to grow. As a core enabling technology, AMT has significant impact across various domains, including AI music creation, retrieval, lowering the barriers to music education, and historical music preservation. Despite the importance of Automatic Music Transcription (AMT), developing multi-instrument AMT systems remains highly challenging. First, there is a scarcity of annotated audio–MIDI data for multi-instrument transcription. Such annotations are difficult and costly to obtain, particularly for rare instrument combinations. To address this issue, Task 1 proposes leveraging large-scale MIDI datasets in conjunction with high-quality audio synthesizers to generate diverse multi-instrument training data. Second, current AMT systems rarely support user-centered transcription guided by natural language prompts, where users may wish to obtain outputs in various formats with flexible control. To overcome this limitation, Task 2 will build upon the synthetic data from Task 1 to develop large language model (LLM)-based AMT systems that enable controllable transcription through natural language interaction. Third, existing AMT frameworks often fail to generalize to unseen instruments. To overcome this limitation, Task 3 will build upon large language models in Task 2 to develop multi-instrument AMT systems by developing instrument-aware token representations that support both closed- and open-set instruments. The research team brings together leading expertise in AI-based music processing (PI, CUHK) and music signal processing (Co-Is from QMUL and MIT). The PI’s group is internationally recognized in the field of AMT, with relevant publications in top-tier journals (TASLP, TISMIR). The team is well equipped with robust computational infrastructure, including 512 TB of large-scale storage, to support the proposed research. Preliminary results on AMT have been adopted by industry (ByteDance, Huawei) and featured by media outlets, demonstrating both the feasibility and impact of the proposed work. Overall, the project will strengthen Hong Kong’s leadership in AI-driven music technology research. 自動音樂轉錄（Automatic Music Transcription, AMT） 是指將音樂錄音轉換為符號化表示形式的過程，例如 MIDI（Musical Instrument Digital Interface，樂器數位介面）。MIDI 是一種標準化的數位格式，用於編碼音符及演奏相關資訊。AMT 是一個跨學科研究問題，涵蓋音樂資訊檢索（Music Information Retrieval, MIR）與人工智慧（Artificial Intelligence, AI）領域。作為多項下游任務的基礎技術，AMT 在音樂分析、音樂辨識、音源分離、音樂編輯以及符號化音樂生成等方面發揮關鍵作用。 隨著全球音樂產業年收入超過 286 億美元，並擁有超過 5 億名串流媒體訂閱用戶，國際間對智慧化音樂理解技術的需求持續增長。AMT 已成為該領域的重要研究方向，相關研究成果已發表於頂級期刊（如 TASLP、TISMIR）。研究團隊具備完善的計算基礎設施，包括 512 TB 大規模儲存系統，可支援本研究的開展。團隊在 AMT 領域的初步研究成果已被業界（如 字節跳動、華為）採用，並受到媒體報導，充分展現本研究工作的可行性與影響力。總體而言，本計畫將進一步鞏固香港在人工智慧驅動音樂科技研究領域的領先地位。 作為核心使能技術，AMT 對多個領域具有重要影響，包括 AI 音樂創作、音樂檢索、降低音樂教育門檻，以及歷史音樂保存等。儘管自動音樂轉錄（AMT）具有重要意義，開發多樂器自動音樂轉錄系統仍面臨高度挑戰。首先，多樂器轉錄所需的音訊–MIDI 配對標註資料十分匱乏。此類標註資料的取得成本高且困難，尤其是在包含罕見樂器組合的情況下。為了解決此問題，任務一（Task 1） 將結合大規模 MIDI 資料集與高品質音訊合成器，生成多樣化的多樂器訓練資料，以提升模型訓練能力。其次，現有 AMT 系統通常缺乏基於自然語言提示（natural language prompts）的使用者導向轉錄能力，使使用者無法透過文字互動靈活控制輸出格式與轉錄結果。為克服此限制，任務二（Task 2） 將基於任務一生成的合成資料，開發以大型語言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）為核心的 AMT 系統，實現透過自然語言互動進行可控音樂轉錄。第三，現有 AMT 框架通常難以泛化至未見過的樂器。為解決此問題，任務三（Task 3） 將基於任務二中的大型語言模型，設計具備樂器感知（instrument-aware）的 token 表示方法，開發支援封閉集合（closed-set）與開放集合（open-set）樂器的多樂器 AMT 系統，提升模型對未知樂器的泛化能力。 研究團隊匯聚了人工智慧音樂處理與音樂訊號處理領域的頂尖研究力量，包括（香港中文大學 CUHK 的主持人 PI）在 AI 音樂處理方面的專長，以及（倫敦瑪麗女王大學 QMUL 與麻省理工學院 MIT 的共同研究者 Co-Is）在音樂訊號處理方面的專業能力。

24203626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24203626.value: 用於晶片上的光學互連的配備高效Si/Si3N4回饋和波導耦合的單片平面III-V雷射器

24203626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24203626.value: The exponential growth of global data traffic is pushing traditional electrical interconnects beyond their physical limits, creating critical bottlenecks in bandwidth, latency, and energy efficiency, threatening the sustainability and scalability of cutting-edge technologies. To address this challenge, optical interconnects, especially Si photonics that marry the economics of CMOS manufacturing with the superior data transmission capability of integrated photonics, is regarded as the most promising technology. Effective as the solution is, its widespread adoption has been hampered by the lack of efficient on-chip lasers, necessitating the integration of III-V on Si. While various III-V integration strategies have been developed, challenges in performance, production, and footprint remain. Monolithic integration represents the ultimate goal for integrated Si photonics and may be the only economically feasible approach for optoelectronic integrated circuits, but existing methods struggle with weak optical confinement, defect-induced performance degradation, inefficient coupling, and excessive power consumption. This research proposes a novel approach to realize monolithic lateral integration of III-V lasers with silicon photonics for optical interconnects. Unlike conventional methods, our approach offers several distinct advantages: (1) strong optical confinement, compact mode volume and high III-V material quality, enabling low power consumption and high lasing performance; (2) eliminate thick buffer layers that impede coupling and allow for efficient in-plane coupling of III-V and Si with compact footprint; (3) elegant laser cavity design for single-mode lasers with enhanced gain while eliminating undesired III-V etching and regrowth. Building on our previous work of optically-pumped III-V lasers on SOI with III-V gratings and photodetectors using lateral integration, we propose a research using lateral integration with four key objectives: (1) design III-V laser cavities incorporating Si DBRs and Si₃N₄ surface gratings to form distributed reflector lasers with mode selection and enhanced gain; (2) develop couplers enabling efficient coupling between III-V and Si waveguides with a compact footprint of less than 10 μm and fabricate Si waveguide coupled III-V laser; (3) design lateral p-i-n structures and demonstrate electrically-pumped III-V distributed reflector lasers on SOI; (4) demonstrate optical interconnect links integrating our lasers, high-performance photodetectors and advanced couplers. This approach addresses the critical challenges for lasers in integrated Si photonics and offers a pathway toward fully integrated optoelectronic circuits. By placing compact III-V lasers exactly where needed on chip in an elegant, efficient, low-cost, and scalable manner, our technology will advance optical interconnects with fully integrated Si photonics for next-generation computing and communication systems. 全球資料流量的指數級增長正在推動傳統電互連技術超越其物理極限，在頻寬、延遲和能源效率方面造成關鍵瓶頸，威脅著尖端技術的可持續性與可擴展性。為應對這一挑戰，光互連技術，特別是將 CMOS 製造的經濟性與集成光子學卓越資料傳輸能力相結合的矽光子學，被視為最具前景的技術。儘管這項解決方案效果顯著，但其廣泛應用一直受限於高效片上激光器的缺乏，因此必須將 III-V 材料與矽進行集成。 雖然已開發出多種 III-V 集成策略，但在性能、量產與尺寸方面仍存在挑戰。單片集成（monolithic integration）代表著集成矽光子學的終極目標，也可能是光電集成電路唯一具經濟可行性的方案，但現有方法仍面臨光學局限性弱、缺陷導致性能劣化、耦合效率低，以及功耗過高等問題。本研究提出一種新穎方法，以實現 III-V 激光器與矽光子學的單片橫向集成（monolithic lateral integration），用於光互連。與傳統方法不同，我們的方法具有以下幾項顯著優勢：（1）具有強光學局限、緊湊模式體積和高品質 III-V 材料，可實現低功耗與高激光性能；（2）消除阻礙耦合的厚緩衝層，使 III-V 與矽能以緊湊尺寸實現高效面內耦合（in-plane coupling）；（3）巧妙的激光腔設計可實現具增強增益的單模激光器，同時避免不必要的 III-V 蝕刻與再生長。 在我們先前於 SOI 上以 III-V 光柵與光電探測器實現橫向集成光泵浦 III-V 激光器的工作基礎上，我們提出以橫向集成為核心的研究，設定四項關鍵目標：（1）設計結合矽分佈式布拉格反射器（Si DBR）與氮化矽（Si₃N₄）表面光柵的 III-V 激光腔，形成具模式選擇與增強增益的分佈式反射鏡激光器（distributed reflector laser）；（2）開發能實現 III-V 與矽波導間高效耦合、尺寸小於 10 μm 的緊湊耦合器，並製作矽波導耦合式 III-V 激光器；（3）設計橫向 p-i-n 結構，並展示於 SOI 上實現電泵浦 III-V 分佈式反射鏡激光器；（4）展示整合我們所研發激光器、高性能光電探測器與先進耦合器的光互連鏈路。 此方法解決了集成矽光子學中激光器所面臨的關鍵挑戰，並為實現完全集成的光電集成電路提供了一條可行路徑。透過以優雅、高效、低成本且可擴展的方式，將緊湊的 III-V 激光器精確放置於晶片所需位置，我們的技術將推動光互連技術與完全集成矽光子學的發展，服務於下一代計算與通訊系統。

24207426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24207426.value: 適用於穩健早期容錯量子電腦的高效編譯基礎架構

24207426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24207426.value: The advent of quantum computing promises transformative breakthroughs in a wide range of critical domains, including drug discovery, power systems, and finance. However, the practical realization of these benefits is critically dependent on achieving fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC), machines that keep working reliably despite noise and imperfections. Early FTQC is not merely an incremental improvement but a paradigm shift, demanding system solutions that are fundamentally aware of the physical realities of quantum hardware. In the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era that admits as many as hundreds qubits available and still with heavy noise, and the transition toward early FTQC is severely constrained by fundamental hardware limitations. Especially for superconducting qubits, the engineering limits of monolithic chip fabrication, the profound and unavoidable heterogeneity of qubit performance. Existing compilers, largely ``blind'' to the fine-grained physical details and dynamic nature of the hardware. In addition, magic state distillation, where we can use to preparing special resources needed by quantum error correction that could protect many really useful algorithms reliable, further exposes architectural inefficiencies in conventional layouts, In most designs these resources are made far from where they are used, forcing repeated transfers across the chip that add delay and block parallelism. Together, these limitations constitute a critical bottleneck on the path to early FTQC. This project introduces a holistic, multi-layered compilation and control infrastructure designed to bridge the hardware–software gap and tackle the intertwined challenges of scale, the fact that every single qubit is slightly different and unique, and reliability. Central to this effort is the development of a deeply hardware-aware compilation system that collects device-level information and builds behavioral models for physical qubits. Unlike conventional approaches that are limited to hardware topologies or simplified noise abstractions, our framework explicitly incorporates physical phenomena such as Two Level Systems correlations, frequency detuning, drift error, and readout error. By extending compilation coverage from the logical gate level down to the physical pulse level, the most fundamental language used to control the qubits, the proposed system ensures robust adaptability to hardware dynamics. In parallel, we will pioneer a novel architectural paradigm that tightly integrates resource generation with computation, thereby overcoming key performance bottlenecks in early fault-tolerant protocols. Our approach is orthogonal to ongoing progress in algorithms and error correction, allowing seamless adoption within current ecosystems. In effect, it provides a low-friction upgrade path that speeds the transition from NISQ prototypes to scalable, early FTQC. 量子計算的出現，有望在藥物研發、電力系統及金融等廣泛且關鍵的領域帶來顛覆性的突破。然而，能否實際實現這些效益，關鍵取決於能否達成「容錯量子計算」（FTQC）——即即使面臨噪聲與缺陷，仍能持續可靠運作的量子計算機。早期容錯量子計算不僅是漸進式的改進，更是一場範式轉移，需要能從根本上理解量子硬體物理實況的系統解決方案。在「有噪中間規模量子」（NISQ）時代，儘管可用的量子位元數量多達數百個，但仍存在嚴重的噪聲干擾；而向早期容錯量子計算的過渡，則受到根本性硬體限制的嚴重制約。特別是對於超導量子位元而言，單片晶片製造的工程限制，以及量子位元性能中深刻且無法避免的異質性， 現有的編譯器，在很大程度上對硬體的細微物理細節及其動態特性「視而不見」。此外，魔術態蒸餾——我們可藉此準備量子錯誤校正所需的特殊資源，以確保許多真正有用的演算法能可靠運作——進一步揭露了傳統佈局中的架構效率問題。在大多數設計中，這些資源的製備位置遠離其使用處，迫使資料必須在晶片上反覆傳輸，從而增加延遲並阻礙並行處理。綜上所述，這些限制構成了邁向早期全容量量子計算（FTQC）道路上的關鍵瓶頸。 本專案提出了一套全面且多層次的編譯與控制基礎架構，旨在彌合硬體與軟體之間的鴻溝，並解決規模擴展、每個量子位元皆略有不同且獨一無二，以及可靠性等相互交織的挑戰。此項工作的核心在於開發一套深度硬體感知型編譯系統，該系統能收集裝置層級的資訊，並為物理量子位元建立行為模型。有別於僅限於硬體拓撲或簡化雜訊抽象化的傳統方法，我們的框架明確納入諸如雙層系統關聯、頻率失調、漂移誤差及讀出誤差等物理現象。透過將編譯範圍從邏輯閘層次延伸至物理脈衝層次——即控制量子位元所使用的最基礎語言——所提出的系統確保了對硬體動態的強健適應性。與此同時，我們將開創一種嶄新的架構範式，將資源生成與運算緊密整合，從而克服早期容錯協定中的關鍵效能瓶頸。 我們的方法與當前在演算法和錯誤校正領域的進展互不衝突，可無縫融入現有生態系統。實際上，它提供了一條低阻力的升級路徑，能加速從 NISQ 原型機向可擴展的早期容錯量子計算（FTQC）的過渡。

24208026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24208026.value: 時鐘拍賣在銷售與採購中的能力與侷限

24208026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24208026.value: Clock auctions are a natural class of simple auction mechanisms that can be used for both sales and procurement. Clock auctions are known to enjoy a unique collection of desirable properties, including obvious strategyproofness, credibility, and privacy. These properties make clock auctions one of the most suitable solutions for real-world applications where the stakes are high: For example, clock auctions are the backbone of the radio spectrum reallocation mechanism run by the US Federal Communications Commission, which involved billions of US dollars. All this highlights the importance of understanding and utilizing the full power of clock auctions. The high-level goal of this project is to develop further theoretical understanding of the power and limitations of clock auctions, in both sales and procurement. In particular, we will focus on single-parameter settings, and consider 4 conceptually and technically related subtasks, covering 4 important aspects of both sales and procurement. The feasibility of all these subtasks is supported by preliminary results and existing technical tools -- a significant fraction of the latter were developed by the PI and collaborators. Our projected results would guide the real-world design of sales / procurement mechanisms where both practicality and theoretical guarantees are desired. 時鐘拍賣是一類自然的簡單拍賣機制，可同時適用於銷售與採購。時鐘拍賣被認為擁有一組獨特的理想性質，包括明顯的策略防護性、可信度及隱私性。這些性質使得時鐘拍賣成為高風險實際應用中最合適的解決方案之一：例如，時鐘拍賣是美國聯邦通訊委員會所執行的無線電頻譜重新配置機制之骨幹。所有這些都凸顯了理解和運用時鐘拍賣完整能力的重要性。 本計畫的總體目標是進一步增進對時鐘拍賣在銷售與採購中能力與侷限的理論理解。具體而言，我們將專注於單參數設定，並考慮四個在概念上與技術上相互關聯的子任務，涵蓋銷售與採購的四個重要面向。所有這些子任務的可行性均有初步結果及現有技術工具支持。我們預期的成果將能指導現實世界中銷售／採購機制的設計，這些機制需同時兼顧實用性與理論保證。

24211626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24211626.value: 基於正交訓練的大型語言模型高效擴展關鍵技術研究

24211626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24211626.value: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed artificial intelligence, yet their escalating scale brings prohibitive training costs, energy demands, and accessibility challenges. To sustain progress, we must develop principled frameworks that enable efficient scaling without compromising generalization or robustness. We present a new research proposal – Efficient Scaling of LLMs via Principled Orthogonal Training, to develop mathematically grounded methods for parameterization, optimization, and adaptation under orthogonal transformation. The central premise is that orthogonal transformations preserve the spectral and geometric structure of weight matrices, yielding stable training dynamics, better conditioning, and efficient parameter reuse. Building on previous advances in orthogonal finetuning and spectrum-preserving training, we aim to formalize a unifying theoretical framework for orthogonal training, connecting it to matrix spectral theory and generalization theory. This foundation will guide the design of algorithms that (i) enable low-cost pretraining through iso-spectral parameterizations, (ii) support efficient adaptation via orthogonal subspace updates, and (iii) ensure stability in multi-task and continual learning settings. This proposal integrates two thrusts: Theory: Develop rigorous analyses of orthogonal parameter spaces, spectral invariance, and convergence guarantees, emphasizing the plasticity–stability trade-off in large-scale training. Algorithms: Design scalable optimization methods that enforce or approximate orthogonality with minimal overhead, including matrix-free updates, parameter-efficient finetuning, and spectrum-preserving pretraining techniques. The broader impact is twofold: (i) advancing the theoretical understanding of how orthogonal structures promote efficiency and generalization, and (ii) delivering practical tools that democratize LLM training and deployment by lowering computational barriers. With scalable algorithmic design, this project aims to advance efficient, scalable training of LLMs. 大型語言模型（LLMs）已徹底改變人工智慧，然而規模持續擴大帶來高昂的訓練成本、能源需求與可及性挑戰。為求持續進步，我們必須建立有原則的框架，在無損泛化能力與強健性的前提下實現高效擴展。 我們提出一項研究計畫——「透過正交訓練實現 LLM 高效擴展」，旨在發展奠基於數學的參數化、最優化及適應方法，並以正交變換為核心。其基本前提是，正交變換能保留權重矩陣的頻譜與幾何結構，帶來穩定的訓練動力學、更佳的條件數以及有效的參數重用。 奠基於正交微調與保譜訓練等先前進展，我們目標是建立統一的正交訓練理論框架，將其與矩陣頻譜理論及泛化理論相連。此基礎將指導演算法設計，以實現：(i) 透過等譜參數化進行低成本預訓練；(ii) 透過正交子空間更新達成 LLM 高效適應；(iii) 確保多任務與持續學習情境下的穩定性。 本提案整合兩大主軸：(i) 對正交參數空間、頻譜不變性與收斂保證進行嚴謹分析，著重探討大規模訓練中的可塑性－穩定性權衡。(ii) 演算法：設計可擴展的最佳化方法，以最小額外成本強制或近似正交性，包含無矩陣更新、參數高效微調及保譜預訓練技術。 本提案廣泛影響包含兩方面：(i) 深化對正交結構如何促進效率與泛化能力的理論理解；(ii) 提供實用工具，透過降低計算門檻，使 LLM 的訓練與部署更為普及。藉由可擴展的演算法設計，本計畫旨在推進大型語言模型的高效、可擴展訓練。

24213126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24213126.value: 具安全意識的人形機器人全身運動與操作學習框架

24213126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24213126.value: Humanoid robots are designed to move, act, and assist in spaces originally built for humans. They have the potential to support healthcare, logistics, disaster response, and even everyday household activities. However, despite recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and robotics, today’s humanoids remain far from becoming reliable partners in daily life. Their biggest limitations are threefold: locomotion skills are still separated into individual, narrow tasks; manipulation learning is data-hungry and often fragile; and overall safety is difficult to guarantee in complex human environments. This project seeks to address these limitations by developing a new generation of safe and adaptive whole-body locomotion and manipulation framework for humanoid robots. The research combines the strengths of traditional control theory, which offers mathematical guarantees, with modern machine learning, which provides flexibility and scalability. By merging these two perspectives, we aim to create robots that are not only agile and capable, but also trustworthy in real-world environments. First, we will unify diverse locomotion skills, including walking, jumping, carrying, and different full-body maneuvers, within a single, adaptable controller. Unlike current methods that train one skill at a time, our integrated offline-to-online learning pipeline will distill multiple expert behaviors into a generalist controller, enhancing robustness and adaptability to varying terrains, loads, and contact conditions. Second, we will develop keyframe-guided whole-body manipulation that goes beyond simple imitation. By identifying critical “keyframes” in human demonstrations that reveal intent and task structure, the robot can reason over long horizons, adapt to new environments and tools, and learn for complex tasks such as carrying, pushing, or tool use with improved data efficiency and generalization. Third, we will design neural safety filters that unify rigorous control with learning-based flexibility. A neural Control Barrier Function will learn human safety priors, since humans naturally avoid unsafe behavior, and embed them into a model-based whole-body controller. This minimally invasive, real-time safety layer will correct unsafe commands from high-level learning modules, ensuring reliable operation in dynamic, safety-critical environments. Finally, a digital twin of the humanoid and its environment will enable continual improvement through closed-loop Real-to-Sim-to-Real cycles. By aligning high-fidelity simulation with real-world data, all modules, including control, manipulation, and safety, will co-evolve to improve robustness, safety, and generalization. Overall, this research will push humanoid robots toward becoming agile, intelligent, and safe partners in human environments, advancing both robotics science and Hong Kong’s strategic priorities in logistics, re-industrialization, and public service automation. 人形機器人的設計目標，是在原本為人類建造的空間中運動、執行任務並提供協助。它們有望應用於醫療護理、物流、災害應變，以至日常家居活動。然而，儘管人工智能與機器人技術近年取得重大突破，現有的人形機器人距離成為日常生活中可靠的合作夥伴仍有相當距離。其主要限制可歸納為三方面：不同運動技能仍被分割為各自獨立且適用範圍狹窄的任務；操作學習需要大量數據，且往往難以泛化；在複雜的人類環境中，整體安全性亦難以得到保證。本項目旨在針對上述限制，為人形機器人研發新一代具安全意識且可自適應的全身運動與操作框架。本研究將結合傳統控制理論與現代機器學習的優勢：前者能夠提供嚴謹的數學保證，後者則具備靈活性與可擴展性。透過融合這兩種技術視角，我們期望開發出不僅靈活且能力全面，而且能夠在真實環境中值得信賴的人形機器人。首先，我們將把步行、跳躍、搬運及不同全身動作等多樣化運動技能，統一於單一且具適應能力的控制器之中。不同於現有每次只訓練一項技能的方法，我們所提出的離線至在線一體化學習流程，將把多個專家策略的行為知識蒸餾至一個通用控制器，從而提升機器人面對不同地形、負載及接觸條件時的穩健性與適應能力。其次，我們將研發由關鍵幀引導、並超越簡單模仿的全身操作學習方法。透過識別人類示範中能夠揭示行為意圖與任務結構的關鍵幀，機器人將能夠進行長時程推理，適應新的環境與工具，並以更高的數據效率及更佳的泛化能力，學習搬運、推動物件及使用工具等複雜任務。第三，我們將設計神經安全過濾器，把嚴謹的控制方法與學習方法的靈活性結合起來。由於人類在示範中通常會自然地避開不安全行為，神經控制屏障函數將從人類示範中學習安全先驗知識，並將其嵌入基於模型的全身控制器。此實時且最小干預的安全層將修正高層學習模組所產生的不安全指令，確保機器人在動態且對安全要求嚴格的環境中可靠運作。最後，我們將建立人形機器人及其環境的數碼孿生，透過「實體至模擬再回到實體」的閉環循環實現持續改進。透過利用真實世界數據校準高擬真模擬環境，控制、操作與安全等所有模組將能夠協同演進，持續提升系統的穩健性、安全性與泛化能力。總括而言，本研究將推動人形機器人成為人類環境中靈活、智能且安全的合作夥伴，不僅促進機器人科學的發展，亦將配合香港在物流、再工業化及公共服務自動化方面的策略重點。

24302026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24302026.value: 開發用於光控藥物的短波紅外光激发的光笼分子

24302026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24302026.value: Light-controlled delivery and release of therapeutics offers a powerful tool for addressing global challenges in disease management. Local prodrug activation with precise and remote control of light promises a highly controllable and minimally invasive therapeutic modality. This promise, however, has yet to be fully realized, largely owing to the poor penetration of light into the human body. In general, the longer the wavelength of light, the deeper the light can penetrate. Red-shifting the operational wavelength is therefore a key guiding principle for developing and optimizing light-activated molecules and materials for clinical use. Photocleavable molecules (i.e., photocages) that undergo a photocleavage reaction and release bioactive components upon light activation are promising tools for light-controlled medication. Recent advances have led to a continuously expanding library of photocages activated by ultraviolet, visible and near-infrared (UV/Vis/NIR; 300−1,000 nm) light. Compared to UV/Vis/NIR light, short-wave infrared (SWIR) light (1,000−1,700 nm) features lower photon energy and enhanced tissue penetration. These physical advantages allow SWIR light to cause minimal photodamage and to penetrate to deep tissues. However, photocages activated by SWIR light remain unexplored. The challenges mainly lie in the lack of available SWIR light-absorbing compounds (chromophores) and straightforward approaches to introduce photocleavable functionality to those chromophores. The benefits of photocages activated by SWIR include not only the advantages of longer wavelengths, but also the potential of combining with one or more UV/Vis/NIR-active components, such as drug molecules. In this proposal, the applicant aims to pioneer a family of SWIR-activated photocages (SWP) and apply them towards the development of next-generation, light-controlled medication. The applicant will leverage Zimmermann’s meta-effect—an empirical rule in photochemistry—alongside computational calculations to design a series of SWP derived from the tetra-annulated xanthene. The first objective of the proposal is to establish a synthetic strategy for SWP, develop a computational method to predict their photocleavable ability, and characterize the photocleavage of SWP experimentally. The second objective herein is to benchmark the photocleavage and photo-release performance of a SWIR light-activated prodrug SWP-DOX against that of a prodrug activated by visible light. The third objective of this project is to harness the combined photocleavable and fluorescent properties of SWP-DOX to enable the characterization of the full lifecycle of SWP-DOX in cells. This chemistry-oriented and biomedicine-targeted proposal is poised to fill a gap in the field of photocleavable molecules and provide a strategy to advance translational phototherapeutics. 光控藥物遞送為改善疾病的治療和管理提供了一種有力的方案。其中，利用精確且無創的光控制實現局部前藥激活，是一種高度可控且微創的治療模式。然而，由於光在人體組織中的穿透深度有限，這一願景尚未得到充分實現。一般來說，光的波長越長，其組織穿透深度就越深。因此，不斷紅移光控體系的激發波長，是開發與優化臨床應用型光籠分子的核心指導原則。光籠分子是一類能在光激活下發生光解反應並釋放藥物的有機功能分子。近年來的研究已建立起涵蓋紫外、可見及近紅外光激活的光籠分子體系。與之相比，短波紅外光（1,000–1,700 nm）具有更低的光子能量和更強的組織穿透力，能在抵達深層組織的同時顯著降低光損傷。然而，短波紅外光激活的光籠分子目前仍極為匱乏。因此，本項目旨在開創一類基於四環稠合氧雜蒽結構的短波紅外光激活光籠分子，並將其應用於下一代光控藥物的開發。具體而言，本項目將：1）結合理論計算，設計並合成具有短波紅外光激發特性的光籠分子，系統考察其光解性質；2）探索基於該光籠分子的光控藥物前體在光解下的釋放性能，為推動光治療方案的臨床轉化奠定基礎。

24307726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24307726.value: 空間組學中用於標準化與聚類後標誌物發現的統計方法

24307726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24307726.value: Spatial omics technologies are transforming biomedical research by enabling genome-wide measurement of molecular activity while preserving the spatial context within tissues. These advances create unprecedented opportunities to uncover cell–cell interactions, tissue organization, and disease mechanisms. A crucial step in realizing this potential is identifying spatial domain markers, which are essential for defining tissue architecture and understanding disease progression. The routine workflow for identifying these markers typically follows three steps: normalization, clustering, and differential expression testing. However, this pipeline faces several challenges. First, normalization strongly influences downstream clustering, but existing strategies are not specifically designed for spatial data and often overlook technical variation related to spatial location. Second, using the same data for both clustering and marker detection creates the problem of "double dipping", which can lead to inflated false discoveries, particularly when domain boundaries are poorly defined. Third, determining the appropriate resolution for spatial domains remains difficult, including deciding when boundaries are unclear. This proposed project will develop a suite of rigorous statistical methods to address these challenges. Aim 1 will introduce a spatial normalization method that corrects localized technical variation by modeling spatial adjacency with a neighborhood graph, removing technical artifacts while preserving meaningful biological variation. Aim 2 will develop SpaDS and SpaMDS, data splitting based approaches for differential expression testing after clustering for spatial omics, enabling robust spatial domain marker discovery with controlled false discovery rate and high power. Aim 3 will deveop an adaptive algorithm that links clustering resolution directly to the existence of robust spatial markers. These methods will be assessed across various spatial omics platforms and tissue types to demonstrate their generalizability and applicability to complex study designs. Together, this project will advance spatial omics analysis by introducing rigorous normalization as a foundation for reliable downstream analysis. Using newly proposed methods for post-clustering identification of markers, the project will enable the discovery of robust spatial domains and markers in complex study designs, uncovering molecular programs across diverse biological systems and diseases. Ultimately, these advances will provide a generalizable statistical framework that strengthens spatial omics as a tool for biomedical discovery and translational applications in diagnostics, therapeutics and precision medicine. 空間組學技術在保留組織內部空間信息的同時，能夠在全基因組範圍內測量分子活性，正逐步改變生物醫學研究。這些技術進展為揭示細胞間相互作用、組織結構和疾病機制帶來了前所未有的機遇。充分發揮這些技術潛力的一個關鍵步驟，是識別空間域標誌物。這些標誌物對於解析組織結構和理解疾病進展至關重要。 識別空間域標誌物的常規分析流程通常包括三個步驟：標準化、聚類和差異表達檢驗。然而，這一分析流程面臨多項挑戰。首先，標準化會顯著影響下游聚類結果，但現有方法並非專門針對空間數據而設計，並且往往忽略與空間位置相關的技術變異。其次，使用同一批數據同時進行聚類和標誌物檢測，會產生「數據重複使用」（double dipping）問題，可能導致錯誤發現率增加，尤其是在空間域邊界定義不清的情況下。第三，如何確定空間域的適當分辨率仍是一項難題，其中包括如何判斷空間域邊界是否明確。 本研究項目擬開發一套嚴謹的統計方法，以解決上述問題。研究目標一將提出一種空間標準化方法，利用鄰域圖對空間鄰接關係進行建模，校正局部技術變異，在去除技術噪聲的同時保留具有生物學意義的信號。研究目標二將開發 SpaDS 和 SpaMDS，這兩種方法均以數據拆分為基礎，用於空間組學數據聚類後的差異表達檢驗，從而在控制錯誤發現率並保持較高統計功效的前提下，實現穩健的空間域標誌物識別。研究目標三將開發一種自適應算法，把聚類分辨率與穩健空間標誌物的存在直接聯繫起來。 本研究將在多種空間組學平台和不同組織類型中對這些方法進行評估，以驗證其普適性及其在複雜研究設計中的適用性。總體而言，本研究將通過建立嚴謹的標準化方法，為可靠的下游分析奠定基礎，進而推動空間組學分析方法的發展。借助新提出的聚類後標誌物識別方法，本研究將能夠在複雜研究設計中發現可靠的空間域及其標誌物，並揭示不同生物系統和疾病中的分子程序。最終，這些研究進展將建立一套具有普適性的統計框架，進一步提升空間組學作為生物醫學發現工具的可靠性，並促進其在診斷、治療和精準醫學等領域的轉化應用。

24507026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24507026.value: 誰能成為領導者？社會階層背景如何塑造領導者湧現的路徑

24507026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24507026.value: Economic mobility remains a major challenge for individuals raised in lower social class families. Even when they achieve strong educational qualifications and show leadership ability, they are still underrepresented in leadership roles across professional settings. Past research often explains this disparity by pointing to personal deficits, such as low self-esteem and lack of ambition. While these explanations offer useful insights, they miss broader interpersonal dynamics and societal biases that shape leader emergence. They also overlook how people from lower social classes can use effective strategies to overcome barriers and succeed professionally. This project integrates expectancy-violation theory and status-based stereotyping research to investigate how individuals’ social class background and their displays of assertiveness (e.g., independence, confidence) and sociability (e.g., warmth, friendliness) jointly affect their leadership emergence. We hypothesize that both assertiveness and sociability can help them emerge as leaders, but these characteristics will be more effective when they go against class-based expectations. Individuals from lower social class background are often expected to be more sociable but less assertive. Therefore, compared with peers from higher social class background, they will be over-rewarded when displaying assertiveness but will be under-rewarded when displaying sociability. Using a full-cycle, multimethod approach, this research will combine field data and experimental methods to establish both ecological validity and causality. In Study 1, we will analyze archival data from the U.S. Congress to examine how legislators’ social class background and their display of assertiveness and sociability jointly affect their influence over other legislators. In Study 2, we will survey working adults in various organizations to test how their social class background interacts with perceived assertiveness and sociability to predict their leadership emergence. In Studies 3a and 3b, we will experimentally manipulate social class background and assertiveness (Study 3a) or sociability (Study 3b) to establish their causal effects on leadership emergence. This project will advance our understanding of leadership dynamics in socioeconomically diverse workplaces. It will contribute to research on social class and leadership emergence by shifting the theoretical focus from individual deficits to interpersonal processes and social expectations. It will also highlight strategies that can help individuals from lower social class background advance in their careers. The findings will be particularly relevant for Hong Kong and other societies where concerns about social mobility and fair career advancement are growing. 經濟流動性對於成長於較低社會階層家庭的個人而言，仍是一項重大挑戰。即使他們取得優秀的教育資歷並展現出領導能力，在各類專業場域中的領導職位中仍然代表性不足。過去研究經常將這種差距歸因於個人層面的不足，例如自尊較低或缺乏抱負。雖然這些解釋提供了有用的見解，但它們忽略了影響領導者湧現的更廣泛人際互動動態與社會偏見。同時，這些解釋也未能充分說明來自較低社會階層的個人如何運用有效策略來克服障礙，並在職業生涯中取得成功。 本研究計畫整合期望違反理論與基於地位的刻板印象研究，探討個人的社會階層背景，以及其展現的果斷性，例如獨立、自信，與親和性，例如溫暖、友善，如何共同影響其領導者湧現。我們假設，果斷性與親和性皆有助於個人湧現為領導者，但當這些特質違反基於階層的社會期望時，其效果會更為顯著。來自較低社會階層背景的個人通常被預期更具親和性，但較不具果斷性。因此，相較於來自較高社會階層背景的同儕，他們在展現果斷性時將獲得較高的獎賞，但在展現親和性時則會獲得較低的獎賞。 本研究將採用完整研究循環與多方法取徑，結合實地資料與實驗方法，以同時建立生態效度與因果推論。在研究一中，我們將分析美國國會的檔案資料，檢驗立法者的社會階層背景，以及其展現的果斷性與親和性，如何共同影響其對其他立法者的影響力。在研究二中，我們將針對不同組織中的在職成人進行問卷調查，測試其社會階層背景如何與他人知覺到的果斷性與親和性交互作用，進而預測其領導者湧現。在研究三甲與研究三乙中，我們將透過實驗方式操弄社會階層背景與果斷性（研究三甲）或親和性（研究三乙）以建立其對領導者湧現的因果。 本研究計畫將推進我們對社會經濟背景多元職場中領導動態的理解。它將透過將理論焦點從個人不足轉向人際互動過程與社會期望，為社會階層與領導者湧現研究作出貢獻。同時，本研究也將指出有助於較低社會階層背景個人在職涯中向上發展的策略。研究發現對香港以及其他日益關注社會流動性與公平職涯晉升的社會尤其具有重要意義。

24507126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24507126.value: 國別報告對企業自製或外購決策的影響

24507126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24507126.value: This research proposal investigates the unintended strategic consequences of the Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCr) in the European Union (EU). While the policy’s primary objective is to enhance corporate tax transparency and accountability, the effect on fundamental real decisions remains unexplored. This study examines whether the transition in disclosure requirements alters corporate strategy, specifically the make-or-buy decision. I theorize that CbCr , by disclosing the geographic distribution of profits and intra-group transactions, dramatically changes the costs associated with complex vertical integration. To avoid scrutiny over potential profit-shifting, MNEs may respond by simplifying their value chains, shifting activities from in-house production (“make”) towards outsourcing to arm’s-length suppliers (“buy”). Our conceptual framework is grounded in the literature of transaction cost economics, with our contribution in incorporating the impact of transparency-induced costs as a determinant of firm boundaries. A challenge in testing this question is the availability of a granular dataset that observes the decision of internal production v.s. outsourcing. To overcome this challenge, I will employe a unique combination of high-frequency international shipment data from Panjiva and supply chain data from Factset Revere to observe changes in corporate boundaries. This study aims to make several contributions. First, the study extends the literature on disclosure regulations by moving beyond financial outcomes to examine real strategic choices. Second, the paper provides the first large-scale evidence on the operational side effects of CbCr , offering critical insights for policymakers on the full economic impact of transparency mandates. Finally, it offers managerial insights into navigating the new landscape shaped by the disclosure requirement by regulators.

24507226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24507226.value: 銀行與金融科技的銀行即服務合作關係與存款市場動態

24507226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24507226.value: Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) enables banks to partner with fintech firms, offering access to core banking functions such as deposit accounts, payment processing, and regulatory compliance. This model attracts less rate-sensitive, low-cost deposits from fintech customers, providing a funding advantage over the rate-sensitive, high-cost deposits typical of traditional and online banks. Consequently, BaaS has become critical for banks seeking to expand deposit bases amid funding challenges. However, these deposits face fintech sector volatility and regulatory scrutiny of BaaS partnerships, distinguishing their stability from that of traditional and online banks. This study examines the impact of bank-fintech BaaS partnerships on deposit markets. Using a hand-collected panel dataset of BaaS partnerships, I employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework to identify the impact of BaaS partnerships on deposit growth. I then test heterogeneity between BaaS and non-BaaS banks during the 2022 rate-hike cycle to assess differential deposit retention of BaaS banks and its impact on monetary policy transmission and examine heterogeneity around the April 2024 bankruptcy of Synapse Financial Technologies to evaluate deposit vulnerabilities of BaaS banks. While BaaS partnerships enhance funding efficiency through low-cost deposit inflows, they introduce a distinct risk compared to traditional and online banks, driven by deposits sensitive to fintech sector volatility and regulatory shocks. These dynamics underscore the need for deeper insights into fintech-driven deposit markets to inform bank-fintech regulation. 銀行即服務(Banking-as-a-Service, BaaS)使銀行得以與金融科技公司建立合作關係,提供存款帳戶、支付處理及法規遵循等核心銀行功能的使用權限。此模式能從金融科技客戶吸引利率敏感度較低、成本較低的存款,相較於傳統銀行與網路銀行典型的高利率敏感度、高成本存款,形成資金來源上的優勢。因此,在資金籌措面臨挑戰之際,BaaS 已成為銀行擴大存款基礎的關鍵途徑。然而,此類存款易受金融科技產業波動及 BaaS 合作關係所面臨的監管審查影響,其穩定性與傳統銀行及網路銀行的存款有所不同。 本研究探討銀行與金融科技 BaaS 合作關係對存款市場的影響。本文利用手工蒐集的 BaaS 合作關係追蹤資料集(panel dataset),採用交錯差異中之差異法(staggered difference-in-differences)識別 BaaS 合作關係對存款成長的影響。接著,本文檢驗 2022 年升息週期期間 BaaS 銀行與非 BaaS 銀行之間的異質性,以評估 BaaS 銀行的存款留存差異及其對貨幣政策傳導的影響;並進一步檢驗 2024 年 4 月 Synapse Financial Technologies 破產事件前後的異質性,以評估 BaaS 銀行的存款脆弱性。 儘管 BaaS 合作關係透過低成本存款流入提升了資金效率,但相較於傳統銀行與網路銀行,其亦引入一種獨特的風險——源自對金融科技產業波動與監管衝擊敏感的存款。此等動態凸顯了深入理解金融科技驅動之存款市場的必要性,以為銀行與金融科技監管提供依據。

24508226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24508226.value: 交易網路中交易商市場力量之估計

24508226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24508226.value: Financial markets are often structured as trading networks intermediated by dealers. Dealer market power within these networks has a significant impact on asset prices. However, disentangling the impact of asset and trader characteristics on the asset prices is empirically challenging due to complex network structures. Unlike existing approaches that rely on restrictive network assumptions or potentially biased reduced-form centrality measures, we introduce a novel structural framework that enables the estimation of the impact of asset and trader characteristics in arbitrary network structures. Using this framework, we can recover the distribution of dealer market power and identify its concentration with U.S. corporate bond market data. We then construct the time series of dealer holding costs and customer selling pressure, which helps identify the causes of the March 2020 U.S. corporate bond market turmoil. Our model enables counterfactual analyses that address bond market efficiency and stability, such as the removal of key dealers or the introduction of all-to-all trading platforms. The findings from this study will provide policy implications for redesigning the corporate bond markets. The methodology outlined in this proposal can be extended to other markets, such as the repo market and the crypto market in Hong Kong and mainland China. 金融市場的結構通常是由交易商作為中介所組成的交易網路。在這些網路中，交易商的市場力量對資產價格具有重大影響。然而，由於網路結構錯綜複雜，在實證上要釐清資產與交易者特徵對資產價格的影響是一項挑戰。現有方法大多依賴限制性的網路假設，或使用可能存在偏誤的簡約式中心性指標（reduced-form centrality measures）；有別於此，我們引入了一個嶄新的結構性框架，能夠在任意的網路結構中，估計資產與交易者特徵所帶來的影響。利用這個框架，我們能透過美國公司債市場的數據，推導出交易商市場力量的分配情況，並識別其集中度。接著，我們建構了交易商持有成本與客戶拋售壓力的時間序列，這有助於找出 2020 年 3 月美國公司債市場動盪的原因。我們的模型允許我們針對債券市場的效率與穩定性進行反事實分析（counterfactual analyses），例如探討移除關鍵交易商或引入全對全（all-to-all）交易平台的影響。本研究的發現將為重新設計公司債市場提供政策意涵。此提案中所概述的方法論也能延伸應用至其他市場，例如香港與中國大陸的回購市場與加密貨幣市場。

24508826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24508826.value: 大學求職者的社會經濟背景與工作質量：社會認知傾向於社會網絡的中介機制

24508826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24508826.value: Work is a critical pathway for socioeconomic mobility, yet access to high-quality employment remains unequal across individuals with different social class origins. Job quality is a multidimensional construct that encompasses both objective and subjective features of work that are beneficial to workers (Burgess & Connell, 2008; Congdon et al., 2020; Howell & Kalleberg, 2019). One factor believed to help curb the transmission of intergenerational inequality is a college education (Jerrim & Macmillan, 2015; Torche, 2011). However, a college education on its own may fall short of equalizing opportunities among individuals from different social class backgrounds in the labor market. This raises a key question: How do social class origins impact college-educated job seekers’ job search process and job quality of employment? We draw from a sociocultural perspective of social class (Stephens et al., 2014, 2017), and integrate a micro-foundational perspective of social networks (Tasselli, 2015; Tasselli et al., 2025) to address this question. We propose that higher social class origins are related to higher agentic beliefs, which are further positively related to the person average network size and tie status, and network growth over time. Such average and dynamic network characteristics are positively related to the objective dimensions of job quality (e.g., wage level, nonwage benefits, and opportunities for promotion). In comparison, lower social class origins are related to higher communal beliefs, which are further related to person average network tie strength and network maintenance over time. These average and dynamic network characteristics are positively related to subjective dimension of job quality (e.g., person-job fit). This research contributes to both the social class and social networks literatures. It also offers practical insights for addressing socioeconomic inequality and upward socioeconomic mobility in the workplace. 工作是社會經濟流動的關鍵途徑，然而不同社會經濟背景的個體在獲取高質量就業機會方面仍然存在不平等。工作質量是一個多維度的構念，涵蓋了對勞動者有益的客觀和主觀工作特徵。大學教育被認為是有助於遏制代際不平等傳遞的一個因素。然而，僅憑大學教育本身可能不足以在勞動市場中為來自不同社會階級背景的個體實現機會公平化。這引出了一個關鍵問題：社會經濟背景如何影響大學求職者的求職過程及其就業的工作質量？我們借鑒社會階層的社會文化視角，並整合社會網絡的微觀基礎視角來探討這一問題。我們提出，較高的社會經濟背景與較高的能動性信念相關，而能動性信念進一步與個體的平均社會網絡規模和關係地位、以及社會網絡隨時間的增長呈正相關。這些平均和動態的網絡特徵與工作質量的客觀維度（如薪資水平、非薪資福利和晉升機會）呈正相關。相較之下，較低的社會經濟背景與較高的群體性信念相關，而群體性信念進一步與個體的平均網絡關係強度和網絡隨時間的維持（而非增長）相關。這些平均和動態的網絡特徵與工作質量的主觀維度（如個人與工作的適配）呈正相關。本研究對社會經濟背景和社會網絡兩個領域的文獻均有所貢獻，同時也為解決社會經濟不平等和促進職場中的社會經濟向上流動提供了實踐性啟示。

24509826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24509826.value: 信貸市場中的政府保險：來自 1930 年代美國房貸市場的證據

24509826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24509826.value: What does government insurance do in credit markets? When default risk is shifted to the public balance sheet, does it change the mortgage contract menu and pricing, who lends, and real outcomes like construction and homeownership? This project provides inception-era evidence by exploiting the launch of the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) in 1934. To answer these questions, I assemble newly harmonized historical data: loan–level NBER loan experience cards (1920–1945) with rates, maturities, amortization, LTV, lender type, and FHA status; FHA Annual Reports (1934–1945) on endorsements and rules; and market-level covariates from the 1930/1940 Censuses, City and County Data Books, New Deal spending, and related macro-financial series. Methodologically, I identify local causal effects using the maximum insurable loan-size cutoff introduced by FHA: a difference-in-discontinuities design compares near-cap loans just below versus above the cap before and after 1934. I then study market-wide effects by instrumenting FHA penetration with the interaction between initial local lender density and national rates and contrast these insurance effects with the 1938 FNMA liquidity expansion. I will quantify heterogeneity across lenders (local intermediaries vs. life insurers), spillovers to conventional (uninsured) loans, and effects on real outcomes. I expect to show that insurance eligibility lowered rates and shifted contracts toward longer maturities, full amortization, and higher permissible LTVs; that markets with greater insurability modernized faster and experienced higher growth in housing markets; and that liquidity later compressed spreads without creating new eligibility discontinuities. The project contributes to literatures on government guarantees, the New Deal mortgage transformation, and modern mortgage intermediation by cleanly separating risk sharing from liquidity. Practically, it informs how program design—eligibility borders, premiums, and timing—translates into household access, lender behavior, and housing investment. 政府保險在信貸市場中究竟扮演什麼角色？當違約風險被轉移到公共資產負債表上時，它是否會改變房貸合約的選擇菜單與定價、放款者的組成，以及建築活動與住房自有率等實質結果？本研究透過利用 1934 年聯邦住房管理局（FHA）成立時的制度變化，提供其創始時期的證據。 為回答這些問題，我整合了新近編製的歷史資料：NBER 的逐筆貸款經驗卡（1920–1945），涵蓋利率、期限、攤還方式、貸款成數（LTV）、放款者類型與 FHA 保險狀態；FHA 年度報告（1934–1945），包含核保量與規則；以及來自 1930/1940 年人口普查、城市與郡縣資料手冊、新政支出與相關宏觀金融序列數據。 在方法上，我利用 FHA 引入的最高可保貸款額上限來識別地方性的因果效果：採用「差異中的不連續」設計，比較上限附近的貸款在 1934 年前後的變化。接著，我以初始地方放款者密度與全國房貸保險率的交互作用作為工具變數，研究市場層面的影響，並將這些保險效果與 1938 年聯邦國家抵押協會（FNMA）所帶來的流動性擴張進行對照。我將量化不同放款者（地方中介 vs. 人壽保險公司）之間的異質性、對傳統（未保險）貸款的溢出效果，以及對實質結果的影響。 我預期將展示：保險資格降低了利率，並使貸款合約轉向更長期限、完全攤還，以及更高允許的貸款成數；具有較高可保性（insurability）的市場更快現代化，並在住房市場中呈現更高成長；而後續的流動性擴張壓縮了利差，但並未創造新的資格不連續。本研究對政府擔保、新政時期房貸轉型，以及現代房貸中介等文獻有所貢獻，並清楚區分了風險分擔與流動性兩者的作用。從政策角度而言，本研究說明了計畫設計——資格邊界、保費與時點——如何影響家庭的信貸取得、放款者行為與住房投資。

24510226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24510226.value: 將供給面動差納入未知廠商行為下的需求估計

24510226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24510226.value: Understanding consumer demand is essential for assessing how markets respond to changes in policy, regulation, or competition. For example, governments and researchers often ask: How do subsidies influence the adoption of electric vehicles? What are the likely price effects of a merger between online platforms? How would a new airline route affect consumer welfare? To answer such questions, economists must first measure how consumers respond when prices or product features change. Over the past three decades, the Berry–Levinsohn–Pakes (BLP) framework has become the standard tool for estimating demand in markets with differentiated products. This approach allows for differences in consumer preferences and helps address the fact that prices are often influenced by hidden demand factors. While powerful, researchers frequently try to improve precision by adding assumptions about how firms behave on the supply side of the market. These assumptions can be useful when correct, but risky when wrong, since firm conduct is rarely observed. Companies may collude, coordinate tacitly, or be shaped by complex ownership structures. If these possibilities are not correctly captured, the resulting demand estimates—and any policy implications—may be biased. Our project proposes a more cautious and robust strategy. Instead of committing to a single assumption about firm behavior, we treat conduct as unknown and allow it to vary within a realistic range. To do this, we use a modern econometric toolkit built around moment inequalities and partial identification. In simple terms, these methods do not attempt to pinpoint a single “true” number for demand parameters but instead identify the set of values that are consistent with the observed data and plausible economic behavior. Inference based on moment inequalities allows us to quantify this range and make valid statistical statements even when there is uncertainty about the exact supply model. We will combine theoretical analysis with computer simulations to evaluate when and how including supply-side information improves demand estimation under such uncertainty. Finally, we will apply our method to the pharmaceutical and airline industries, two settings where firm conduct is often opaque but where accurate demand estimation is critical for policy evaluation. 了解消費者需求，對於評估市場如何回應政策、監管或競爭環境的變化至關重要。例如，政府與研究人員經常會問：補貼會如何影響電動車的普及？網上平台之間的合併可能會對價格產生甚麼影響？新增一條航空航線又會如何影響消費者福利？要回答這些問題，經濟學家首先必須衡量當價格或產品特徵發生變化時，消費者會如何作出反應。 在過去三十年間，Berry–Levinsohn–Pakes（BLP）框架已成為估計差異化產品市場需求的標準工具。這一方法容許消費者偏好存在差異，亦有助於處理價格往往受到不可觀察需求因素影響的問題。儘管這一方法功能強大，研究人員仍經常透過加入對市場供給面企業行為的假設，以提高估計的精確度。當這些假設正確時，它們確實可能有所幫助；但若假設錯誤，則可能帶來風險，因為企業行為通常無法直接觀察。企業可能存在合謀、默契協調，或其行為受到複雜所有權結構的影響。若未能正確刻畫這些可能性，所得的需求估計，以及由此推導出的政策含意，都可能產生偏誤。 我們的研究提出一種更為審慎且穩健的策略。與其對企業行為作出單一而明確的假設，我們將企業行為視為未知，並容許其在一個合理的範圍內變化。為此，我們採用一套以矩不等式（moment inequalities）和部分識別（partial identification）為核心的現代計量經濟學工具。簡單來說，這些方法並不試圖為需求參數確定一個唯一的「真實」數值，而是識別出一組與觀察到的數據及合理經濟行為相一致的參數值。基於動差不等式的統計推論，讓我們能夠量化這一範圍，並且即使在確切的供給模型存在不確定性的情況下，仍能作出有效的統計判斷。 我們將結合理論分析與電腦模擬，評估在這類不確定性下，何時以及如何納入供給面資訊能夠改善需求估計。最後，我們會將所提出的方法應用於製藥業與航空業。這兩個產業中的企業行為往往並不透明，但準確的需求估計對政策評估而言卻十分重要。

24600226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24600226.value: The public law–private law divide has long served as a key organising principle for legal classification. In general, private law governs interpersonal relationships, enabling individuals to arrange their affairs freely, while public law regulates the administration of society, constraining individual autonomy in pursuit of collective interests. In the common law tradition, trusts are firmly embedded in private law. By contrast, China has adopted a policy-driven approach to the trust. Chinese legislators transplanted the trust as a private law instrument but deployed it to advance state policy objectives. Following the enactment of the Chinese Trust Law in 2001, regulators promptly issued numerous regulations to align trust practices with macroeconomic priorities and social welfare goals. As a result, China’s trust industry bears little resemblance to its Western counterparts, revolving around commercial trusts managed by licensed trust companies. Many of these trusts were exploited as shadow banking vehicles, allowing financial institutions to channel credit to enterprises unable to obtain loans from the state banking system. These practices heightened systemic financial risks and disrupted the state’s macroeconomic policies, obviously deviating from the policy objectives for which the trusts were intended. This project examines China’s trust regime from three perspectives: law in books (the statutory framework), law in action (the operation of trusts in practice), and law in perception (how trusts are understood by legislators, regulators, and other stakeholders). Through these lenses, it identifies the hybrid public law–private law nature of Chinese trusts: a distinctive fusion of private law principles and state-driven policy objectives. The project makes three key contributions. First, it uncovers significant discrepancies among law in books, law in action, and law in perception, analysing how these discrepancies have created confusion and hindered the development of both trust law and the industry. Second, it demonstrates that China’s policy-driven approach is the root cause of these discrepancies. It further evaluates the hybrid model of Chinese trusts, considering both its effectiveness in advancing policy objectives and its ability to unlock the potential of the trust as a private law device. These findings will provide a foundation for constructing a sustainable trust law framework that balances state policies with party autonomy. Third, the project contributes to comparative law scholarship by presenting China’s experience as a cautionary lesson for other civilian jurisdictions that have adopted or are contemplating the introduction of trusts. 公法與私法的區分長期以來是法律體系的一項基本分類原則。概言之，私法調整平等主體之間的關係，以意思自治為基本原則，允許個人自主安排其事務；公法則著眼於社會治理和公共利益，通過國家權力的介入對個人自治施加必要限制。在普通法傳統中，信託屬於典型的私法制度。中國的信託制度卻呈現出鮮明的政策驅動特徵：立法者將信託作為一種私法制度引入中國，卻又賦予其實現國家政策目標的功能。2001年《中華人民共和國信託法》頒布後，監管部門相繼出台大量規範性文件，引導信託實踐服務於宏觀經濟調控和社會福利等政策目標。 這一發展路徑塑造了中國獨具特色的信託業形態。不同於西方國家，中國的信託實踐長期以持牌信託公司開展的商事信託為中心。其中，大量信託曾被異化為影子銀行工具，使金融機構得以繞開傳統銀行信貸渠道，向難以從國家銀行體系獲得貸款的企業輸送資金。此類實踐不僅加劇了系統性金融風險，也對國家宏觀調控政策造成衝擊，與國家發展信託制度所追求的政策目標漸行漸遠。 本項目從三個相互關聯的維度考察中國信託制度：一是「書本中的法」（law in books），即信託的法條規範；二是「行動中的法」（law in action），即信託制度在實踐中的實際運行；三是「認知中的法」（law in perception），即立法者、監管者及其他利益相關者對信託性質與功能的理解。通過三個維度的交叉考察，本項目揭示中國信託所具有的公私法混合屬性：信託在法律形式上以私法原則為基礎，其發展和運行卻又深受國家政策目標的塑造，由此形成私法自治與國家政策相互交織的獨特制度形態。 本項目擬在三個方面推進現有研究。第一，揭示「書本中的法」「行動中的法」與「認知中的法」之間存在的顯著落差，並分析這些落差如何造成制度認知和實踐運行上的混亂，進而制約中國信託法和信託業的發展。第二，論證中國信託制度的政策驅動路徑是產生上述落差的重要根源，並在此基礎上對其公私法混合模式作出評價：一方面考察這一模式能否有效實現國家政策目標，另一方面分析其是否為信託作為私法制度充分發揮功能留下足夠空間。相關研究將為構建兼顧國家政策與當事人自治、具有可持續性的中國信託法制度提供理論基礎。第三，本項目將中國經驗置於比較法視野之下，揭示信託制度移植過程中政策目標與私法邏輯之間可能產生的張力，為已經引入或正在考慮引入信託制度的其他大陸法系法域提供具有警示意義的中國經驗。

24607026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24607026.value: 創制藝術與科技：亞洲數碼科技與藝術協作網絡實踐

24607026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24607026.value: Arts Tech has become a buzzword in recent cultural policy in Hong Kong (The Government of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region [HKSAR], 2021; Li, 2024), but there is a lack of a nuanced understanding of how artworks are created, and the cultural ecologies of how artists and practitioners operate in the field. This research examines the practices of digital studios and collectives, which serve as organisational entities that enable collaborative artistic practices with technology. By studying the practices of digital studios, I draw attention to alternative and emerging infrastructures for art and technology, as well as the challenges and needs of artists and organisations working in this field. A deeper understanding of these practices will enable more appropriate policymaking to support and enable these groups and practices. This research will extend beyond Hong Kong to networks in neighbouring cities in East and Southeast Asia and more broadly the Asia Pacific (including Australia). By looking at studios in Hong Kong, Taipei, Shanghai/Beijing, Singapore, and Melbourne, the intention is to understand the situated practices of how these entities respond to their local social, political, and economic environments, and develop projects and collaborations as producers, curators, and artists themselves. The aim is to initiate an inter-Asian network of studios and collectives to facilitate the sharing of knowledge and resources, and develop cultural exchanges within the region. As co-founder of the digital studio MetaObjects, I have gained firsthand experience through my own practice and engagement in the field. This research extends past research developed in my monograph, titled Ecologies of Artistic Practice: Rethinking Cultural Economies Through Art and Technology (The MIT Press, 2025), which sets a foundation for my thinking through international case studies. This research firstly aims to highlight digital studios as a cultural institutional form for incubating artistic practices engaging with technology, and secondly, focuses on initiating dialogue and exchange among studios and their networks in the Asia-Pacific region, where research on art and technology histories and practices is limited. While research is situated in the Asian context, it aims to bridge a wider dialogue through international connectivity and diasporic linkages, which characterises how practitioners navigate a globalised cultural economy. To complement this research, I have received a CUHK Direct Grant (2024-25) exploring the narratives on Arts Tech in Hong Kong, and a grant for the Fund for Innovative Technology-in-Education (FITE), which aims to produce digital humanities resources for teaching and learning. 藝術科技已成為香港近期文化政策中的熱門詞彙（香港特別行政區政府，2021；李，2024）。然而，對於藝術作品背後的創作過程，以及藝術家與從業者如何在業界運作，我們卻對背後的文化生態缺乏細緻的理解。是次研究以數碼工作室和藝術團體的實踐為核心，探討這些機構如何作為組織載體，推動與科技結合的藝術合作；同時亦透過考察數碼工作室的運作常規，聚焦於藝術與科技的非主流與新興基礎設施，藉以剖析業內藝術家和機構所面臨的挑戰和實際訴求。對當中的實踐理解更深，將有助制定更具針對性的政策，為相關團體的發展和協作實踐帶來實質的支援。 是次研究的範圍，從香港延伸至東亞與東南亞的鄰近城市，及至澳洲等亞太地區的團隊網絡。透過檢視香港、台北、上海／北京、新加坡與墨爾本的工作室，了解各大團體如何因應當地社會、政治和經濟環境，採取相應的實踐策略，並以製作人、策展人與藝術家身分開展計劃和合作。研究目標為建立亞洲工作室與團體網絡，藉此促進知識與資源共享，並加深區內的文化交流。 身為數碼製作工作室MetaObjects元物的共同創辦人，我在業界的實踐與參與累積了豐富經驗。是次研究，亦延續了我們個人著作《藝術實踐生態：從藝術與科技再思文化經濟》（麻省理工學院出版社，2025）的研究脈絡。書中的國際案例研究，亦成為了我思考的起點。研究首先探討數碼工作室如何作為文化體制，孕育出結合科技的藝術實踐。其次是研究亞太區工作室及其網絡如何帶動對話與交流，填補亞太區在相關藝術與科技史與實踐研究的缺口。儘管研究以亞洲為主，當中亦連繫國際網絡與離散群體，藉以開拓更廣闊的對話空間，展現從業者遊走於全球的文化經濟中。為呼應並延伸是次研究，我將運用香港中文大學直接資助（2024–25）來探討香港藝術科技敘事，並利用科教創新基金的撥款來製作專門用於教學的數碼人文資源。

24613426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24613426.value: 人工智能時代下的教學擾動：大學教師應對評核挑戰的先導個案研究

24613426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24613426.value: The accelerating uptake of artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education presents both opportunities and challenges. Among the most pressing is AI-related academic dishonesty, such as the unauthorised use of generative AI to complete assignments. These practices destabilise long-standing rules and ethical values, leaving many academics uncertain not only about safeguarding integrity but also about the broader purposes of university education. In Hong Kong and elsewhere, this has produced a climate of regulative ambiguity: universities actively promote AI for research, teaching, and administration while restricting student use and imposing regulations whose effectiveness is unclear. This study will address three key research challenges: how assessment can maintain integrity while recognising new technological realities; how academics will negotiate contested understandings of academic integrity, AI literacies, and AI ethics; and how AI reshapes power and control relations in assessment design and governance. The project will conceptualise AI not simply as a detriment but as a site of productive tension that illuminates shifting modes of teaching, learning, and assessment. It will take a qualitative case study approach in three stages. Stage 1 will comprise 15–20 in-depth, artefact-elicited interviews in which academics compare ‘old’ and ‘new’ assessment practices using course outlines, rubrics, and tasks. Stage 2 will analyse these accounts to examine how modalities of pedagogic control are reconfigured. Stage 3 will involve brief follow-up interviews and a concluding workshop to exchange perspectives and validate findings. The analysis will be informed by cultural–historical activity theory, which conceptualises assessment as a human activity mediated by subjects, rules, tools, divisions of labour, communities, and outcomes. Contradictions within and between these elements provide analytical entry points for understanding how AI destabilises assessment design and propels change. Complementarily, Basil Bernstein’s theory of the pedagogic device will be used to analyse how AI-induced disruptions and concerns over academic misconduct reshape power and control relations in assessment. The project will generate new knowledge by documenting how faculty in Hong Kong higher education are rethinking assessment in response to AI, offering empirical insight into their strategies, dilemmas, and innovations. Conceptually, it will extend CHAT and Bernstein’s framework to the emerging field of AI in education. Practically, it will provide evidence-based guidance for institutions seeking to balance integrity with innovation. More broadly, it will position AI disruption as both a challenge and an opportunity for renewal in assessment and higher education governance. 人工智能（AI）在高等教育迅速普及，既帶來機遇，也引發新的挑戰，其中尤以學生未經許可使用生成式AI完成作業等學術不誠實行為最受關注。這些問題不但衝擊既有的學術規範，也令大學教師重新思考評核、學術誠信以至大學教育的目的。與此同時，大學一方面鼓勵在研究、教學和行政工作中使用AI，另一方面又限制學生使用，令相關規管充滿不確定性。 本研究將探討三個問題：評核如何在新科技環境下維持學術誠信；教師如何理解和處理學術誠信、AI素養及AI倫理；以及AI如何改變評核設計和管治中的權力與控制關係。研究將訪問15至20名香港大學教師，利用課程大綱、評分準則及評核課業等材料，了解他們如何因應AI調整評核方式，並透過跟進訪談及工作坊深化和確認研究結果。 研究將結合文化歷史活動理論及Basil Bernstein的教學機制理論，分析AI如何打破原有的評核安排，並推動教學、評核及管治方式的轉變。研究除了記錄教師面對的困難、策略和新做法，也希望為大學如何兼顧學術誠信與創新提供實證參考，並把AI帶來的衝擊視為重新思考高等教育評核與管治的契機。

24618026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24618026.value: 功能愈多，韌性愈強？探討公民如何在多平台、多模式社交媒體環境中因應監控憂慮表達政治意見

24618026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24618026.value: The National Security Law has redefined the boundaries of freedom of expression in Hong Kong, prohibiting acts that threaten state security, including online speech. Although the government has emphasized its minimal impact on ordinary citizens, concerns have been raised about increased surveillance and potential chilling effects on online political expression. The limited research on online expression following the implementation of the law and the broader literature on repression and self-censorship suggest that citizens concerned about surveillance adapt their online political expression rather than refraining from it entirely. They leverage social media features to maintain their political expression, such as adjusting privacy settings and removing politically dissimilar contacts from their online networks. However, these studies often focus on specific strategies or single platforms and thus lack a holistic consideration of individuals’ ability to switch between platforms for different modes of expression, despite the proliferation of different social media platforms and new features. For example, individuals may use encrypted messaging applications like Telegram or ephemeral messaging like Instagram Stories to express opinions on sensitive topics, while publicly posting less sensitive opinions on platforms like Facebook to interact with more contacts. To understand how Hong Kong citizens navigate and employ different modes of expression across social media platforms to maintain political expression amid heightened surveillance, this project introduces the concept of social media political expression repertoire (SMPER), which refers to the ability to use various social media features across platforms for different modes of political expression. Based on this concept, interviews will be conducted to explore the range of features across social media platforms that Hong Kong citizens employ for political expression and their rationales for selecting these features in different situations. The survey component of the project will explore whether a richer SMPER (i.e., greater ability to engage in different expression modes) relates to higher political expression on social media and weakens the negative association between surveillance concerns and political expression. This project will make important contributions. Theoretically, its focus on SMPER responds to recent calls in the field of political communication to examine individuals' use of multiple platforms, addressing the bias toward single platforms or specific platforms features in past studies. Moreover, it sheds light on how a richer repertoire of online expression options, enabled by the multi-platform and multi-modal social media environment, helps sustain citizens’ political expression amidst growing sanctions—a sign of citizens’ political resilience. 香港國安法禁止危害國家安全的行為，相關規定亦適用於網上言論；法例的實施重新界定了香港言論自由的界限。儘管政府強調法例對一般市民的影響有限，但社會仍有人關注法例對網上政治意見表達的影響。現有少量關於國安法實施後網上表達的研究，以及更廣泛有關自我審查的文獻均指出，當公民對監控有所憂慮時，他們往往不是完全停止網上表達，而是調整其表達方式，例如他們會利用社交媒體的不同功能來維持意見表達，包括調整私隱設定，以及移除社交網絡中政治立場不同的聯繫人。可是，現有研究大多聚焦於個別功能或單一社交媒體平台，因而未能全面考慮在社交媒體平台及功能日益多元化的環境下，個人如何透過切換不同平台及不同表達模式來維持政治意見表達，例如有些人可能會利用 Telegram 等加密即時通訊應用程式，或 Instagram Stories 等限時動態功能，就較具爭議性的議題發表意見；同時則會在 Facebook 等平台公開分享較不敏感的觀點，以便與更多用家互動。為了解市民如何在監控憂慮增加的環境下，跨越不同社交媒體平台運用不同表達模式來維持政治意見表達，本研究提出「社交媒體政治意見表達組合」（Social Media Political Expression Repertoire, SMPER）的概念。SMPER 指個人跨越不同社交媒體平台，運用各種功能，以不同模式表達政治意見的能力。本研究首先透過深度訪談，探討香港市民在表達政治意見時運用社交媒體上的各種功能，以及他們在不同情境下選擇這些功能的考量。其次，研究將透過問卷調查檢驗：擁有較豐富 SMPER（即具備較高能力採用不同意見表達模式）的市民，是否會在社交媒體上進行更多意見表達，以及 SMPER 是否能夠減弱監控憂慮與意見表達之間的負向關係。本研究具有重要的理論貢獻。首先，以 SMPER 為核心概念，回應近年政治傳播研究呼籲更重視多平台使用的趨勢，補足過去研究過度聚焦於單一平台或個別平台功能的不足。其次，本研究有助闡明，在多平台、多模式的社交媒體環境下，公民如何憑藉更豐富的網上意見表達選項，在面對監控憂慮時表達意見。

24621126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24621126.value: 被商品化的創傷：「慰安婦」紀念雕像─少女像的全球後世

24621126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24621126.value: This project investigates the global proliferation of the Girl Statue, a memorial to the “comfort women,” victims of sexual violence by the Japanese Empire (c.1931-1945), and its transformation into a commodity. Since its first installation in Seoul in 2011, the statue has circulated across diverse media: monuments, miniatures, LEGO toys, digital AR games, silver coins, and tattoos, originating in East Asia and spreading worldwide. The project asks: how does a symbol of historical trauma become an object of consumption and leisure? By tracing the statue’s transformation from sacred monument to circulating meme, it reveals the tension between its commemorative purpose and its reality as a commodity. I argue that the statue’s global reproduction, though well-intended, has generated a commodity economy that risks reenacting the very logic of violence it seeks to redress—extending the violence of the Japanese empire into the U.S. neoliberal empire today. As the first scholarly work to shift focus from testimony-based studies of “comfort women” to the memorial’s afterlives in visual and popular culture, this project examines the neoliberal commodification of trauma in the name of justice and humanitarianism. Combining interviews with artists, activists, and consumers with analysis of visual archives and community-based art, the methodology contributes to the anthropological turn in contemporary art history. Grounded in rigorous visual analysis, it critically engages with the “artist-as-ethnographer” model to interrogate the unexamined visual economy that now dominates global memory. Advancing a framework of ethnic and feminist spectatorship that foregrounds racial and sexual minoritarian subjectivities, the project repositions close visual analysis as a mode of ethical care. These findings offer a new lens for understanding the global memorialization of trauma, with implications for visual culture, memory studies, and cultural studies grappling with war and imperial violence. The proposed two-year grant will support completion of a monograph and two journal articles. Funding is sought for fieldwork, archival research, and interviews, and a teaching relief for writing and revision. The book manuscript is under discussion with Duke University Press and requires final research. Two chapters have been refined through workshops at Harvard and Tulane Universities, and two journal articles intended for Asia-Pacific Journal: Japan Focus and positions: asia critique will complement the monograph’s frameworks. Ultimately, this project demonstrates how the “comfort women,” in becoming images, continue to comfort the present. 本計畫研究了「少女像」的全球傳播過程。該雕像是一座用於紀念在第二次世界大戰期間（約 1931–1945 年）遭受大日本帝國性暴力侵害的「慰安婦」的紀念碑，並探討其令人憂慮的商品化轉型。自 2011 年以來，該雕像已遠遠超出其位於首爾原址的範圍，以公共紀念碑、熱氣球、塑膠微型模型、樂高玩具、刺青以及數位化身等各種形式大量湧現。本計畫提出了一個關於我們這個時代的關鍵問題：歷史創傷的象徵如何演變成大眾消費與休閒的對象？筆者主張，該雕像出於善意的全球複製，催生了一種商品經濟，而這種商品經濟卻冒著重演其試圖糾正之暴力邏輯的風險，從而將帝國暴力的陰影延續到當代新自由主義帝國的循環之中。 作為首項將研究焦點從證言轉向圍繞這段歷史之視覺文化與大眾文化的重要研究，本計畫做出了顯著的方法論介入。它結合細緻的視覺分析、對藝術家、行動者與消費者的訪談，以及社群藝術研究，推進了針對當代藝術的人類學研究方法。此一多重方法框架批判性地運用了「作為民族誌學者的藝術家」模型，以檢視當今主導全球記憶卻尚未受到充分探討的視覺經濟。透過追溯該雕像從神聖紀念碑到流通迷因（meme）的歷程，本計畫提出了一種新的種族與女性主義觀看框架，將細緻凝視重新定位為一種以種族與性少數群體主體性為核心的新型倫理關懷模式。這些研究發現為理解全球創傷紀念化提供了一個至關重要的新視角，對視覺文化、記憶研究與批判種族研究領域皆具有迫切的借鑑意義。 擬議中的兩年期補助將用於支持完成一部學術專著以及兩篇期刊論文。其中兩個章節已透過哈佛大學與杜蘭大學的研討會進一步精煉，而計畫中的兩篇期刊論文也將進一步拓展本專著的理論架構。申請經費將用於必要的田野調查、檔案研究，以及撰寫與修改著作所需之教學減免。最終，本計畫揭示了「慰安婦」在演變為圖像的過程中，如何持續撫慰（「慰安」）當下，並為評估此一轉變所涉及的政治與倫理風險提供批判性工具。

24621326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24621326.value: 從心智到機器：人工智慧的控制架構

24621326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24621326.value: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have redefined the landscape of artificial intelligence (AI). These systems now generate text, code, and scientific hypotheses, exhibiting remarkable linguistic and problem-solving abilities. Yet, their behavior remains unreliable: they hallucinate, contradict themselves, and reproduce human biases. Scaling models further has reached diminishing returns, and progress increasingly depends on developing language agents—LLMs embedded in architectures capable of perception, memory, and planning. These agents resemble modular cognitive systems, raising a central question in both cognitive science and AI—the control problem: how do multiple specialized components coordinate with each other to produce coherent, intelligent behavior? This project develops a unified framework for understanding and implementing control in cognitive systems, both biological and artificial. Drawing on my previous work on control and cognitive architecture (Bechtel & Huang, 2022; Huang, 2017; Huang, 2019), the project proceeds in two stages. First, I will develop a mechanistic account of how the brain achieves coherent, intelligent behavior without relying on a single central controller. Integrating recent findings from decision neuroscience and reinforcement learning, I will revise and advance a “Society-of-Mind” account that treats the mind as a multi-agent system. Crucially, diverse neural processes cooperate with simple control signals—akin to a “democratic” procedure that leverages wisdom-of-the-crowd effects. This model explains how flexible and systematic behavior emerges from the coordinated interaction of specialized subsystems implicated in working memory, episodic memory, and hierarchical representations of categories and relations. Second, I will translate this account into design principles for language agents. Through a structured review of existing agent architectures and targeted analyses of their control strategies, I will identify which strategies enhance the reliability, coherence, and adaptability of language agents, and how biologically-inspired design principles can complement them. The outcome is a clear set of implementable principles to guide the next generation of AI systems. Each stage will produce a peer-reviewed article and a conference presentation. This research will be conducted with collaborators specializing in cognitive neuroscience and computer science at National Taiwan University and Microsoft Research Asia, respectively. Situated within the interdisciplinary strengths of AI research at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, it will bridge philosophy, cognitive science, and AI design to advance our understanding of the control architectures of human and artificial agents. In turn, this understanding will enable us to build more capable and safer AI systems for the future. 研究背景 大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的最新進展重新定義了人工智慧 (AI) 的版圖。這些系統現在能夠生成文本、程式碼與科學假設，展現出卓越的語言與解決問題的能力。然而，它們的行為仍然不可靠：它們會產生幻覺、自相矛盾，並複製人類的偏見。進一步擴展模型規模已達到報酬遞減的階段，而未來的進展越來越依賴於開發語言代理——即嵌入於具備感知、記憶和規劃能力架構中的 LLMs。這些代理類似於模組化的認知系統，並在認知科學與人工智慧領域引發了一個核心的「控制問題」：多個專業化的組件如何相互協調以產生連貫、智慧的行為？ 研究計畫概述 本計畫將開發一個統一的框架，用於理解與實現在生物及人工認知系統中的控制。借鑒我過去在控制與認知架構方面的研究 (Bechtel & Huang, 2022; Huang, 2017; Huang, 2019)，本計畫將分兩個階段進行。 第一階段：人類大腦的控制機制 首先，我將發展一個機制性的解釋，說明大腦如何在不依賴單一中央控制器的情況下實現連貫、智慧的行為。結合決策神經科學與強化學習的最新發現，我將修訂並推進一種將心智視為多智能體系統的「心智社會」觀點。至關重要的是，多樣的神經過程透過簡單的控制訊號進行合作——這類似於一種利用「群眾智慧」效應的「民主」程序。該模型解釋了靈活且系統性的行為是如何從涉及工作記憶、情節記憶以及類別與關係的層次表徵等專業子系統的協調互動中產生的。 第二階段：語言代理的設計原則 其次，我將把這種解釋轉化為語言代理的設計原則。透過對現有代理架構的結構化回顧及其控制策略的針對性分析，我將確定哪些策略能提高語言代理的可靠性、連貫性與適應性，以及受生物學啟發的設計原則將如何對其進行補充。其成果將是一套清晰且可實施的原則，用以指導下一代人工智慧系統的發展。 每個階段都將產出一篇經過同行評審的論文及一次學術會議發表。 合作與未來展望 本研究將分別與國立台灣大學和微軟亞洲研究院專精於認知神經科學與計算機科學的合作者共同進行。本計畫植基於香港中文大學在人工智慧研究上的跨領域優勢，將橋接哲學、認知科學與人工智慧設計，以推進我們對人類與人工代理控制架構的理解。進而，這種理解將使我們能夠為未來建立更強大且更安全的人工智慧系統。

25108626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25108626.value: 雙重作業訓練對患有慢性肌肉骨骼痛症及衰弱的社區長者於管理疼痛及改善衰弱方面之成效：隨機對照試驗

25108626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25108626.value: The aim of this project is to establish high-quality evidence on the effect of dual-task training in frail community-dwelling older individuals with chronic musculoskeletal pain (CMP). This randomised controlled trial will examine the effects of dual-task training on pain severity, frailty levels and other important patient-centred outcomes in this population. CMP is common in older adults and causes substantial physical and psychosocial impairments. CMP is also associated with another prevalent condition known as frailty, a state of reduced physiological reserves and increased vulnerability caused by a decline encompassing multiple systems. Growing evidence showed that functional decline resulting from CMP and frailty can be partly attributed to underlying cognitive decline. In our ongoing study, nearly three-quarters of 180 older adults (age ≥60 years) with CMP had mild cognitive impairment, while three in five CMP sufferers (58%) were frail. Frailty is associated with adverse health outcomes, increased healthcare utilisation, disability, and mortality. Physical exercise is generally recommended for managing CMP and frailty. However, this approach does not specifically address cognitive impairment. Since physical and cognitive deficits contribute and are related to functional decline in individuals with CMP and frailty, both of which are interrelated, targeted treatments that address both conditions are urgently needed. Dual-task training, which incorporates physical and cognitive training, has been shown to enhance physical and cognitive functions, and overall well-being in older adults and diseased populations (e.g. those with cognitive impairment and stroke). However, well-conducted studies supporting the application of dual-task training in managing frail individuals with CMP are lacking. In this proposed randomised controlled trial, 246 community-dwelling, frail older adults (age ≥60 years) with CMP will be randomly assigned to undergo either dual-task training (individualised sessions of integrated physical and cognitive training, twice/week by physiotherapist), conventional exercise (identical physical training, without cognitive training), or no structured training. Primary outcome will be changes in pain severity assessed by the Brief Pain Inventory at baseline, immediately after intervention, and at 6-month follow-up. Secondary outcomes will include changes in frailty levels, physical function, cognitive function, psychological distress, catastrophizing thoughts, pain self-efficacy, disability, health-related quality of life, overall impression, and healthcare-related costs. Appropriate univariate and multiple regression analyses will be performed for intention-to-treat analyses.
