The trial will assess whether dual-task training can improve pain and frailty, which are key factors influencing healthy ageing in older populations. High-quality evidence guiding the application of dual-task training on patient-centred outcomes will be obtained. 本研究項目之目標是為評估雙重作業訓練對患有慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛及衰弱的社區長者之成效。本項隨機對照試驗將探討雙重作業訓練對此類長者的疼痛程度、衰弱程度和其他重要的健康指標之影響。 慢性肌肉骨骼痛症在長者中十分常見，痛症對其身體、心理及社交功能造成嚴重影響。慢性肌肉骨骼痛症亦與另一種常見的健康問題 – 衰弱症有關。衰弱症是由多個身體系統功能下降而引致的狀況，患者的生理儲備會因此而減少，令身體應對外界壓力的能力降低。近來更多研究顯示，慢性肌肉骨骼痛症及衰弱症所引致的功能衰退，部分原因可能與認知功能下降有關。在一項我們正進行中的研究發現，在180名年滿60歲並患有慢性肌肉骨骼痛症的長者中，接近四分之三有輕度認知障礙。另外，接近五分之三（58%）有衰弱情況。衰弱症與其他不良健康指標、殘疾及死亡風險有關。 慢性肌肉骨骼痛症及衰弱症一般建議以運動來幫助，但一般常用運動並非專門針對改善認知功能受損。慢性肌肉骨骼痛症與衰弱症互有關聯，而身體及認知功能缺損都是導致這類患者日常功能衰退的重要因素。因此，現時急需研發能同時改善這兩種健康問題的針對性治療。現時，研究已顯示雙重作業訓練（結合體能和認知訓練）能改善長者及不同患者群組（例如:認知障礙或中風患者）的身體功能、認知功能和整體健康。然而，現時仍缺乏高質量的研究支持應用雙重作業訓練於患有慢性肌肉骨骼痛症的衰弱長者上。 這項隨機對照試驗中，我們將招募年滿60歲、患有慢性肌肉骨骼痛症並有衰弱情況的社區長者。參加者將被隨機分配至三組之一:第一組為雙重作業訓練組（接受每星期兩次、結合體能和認知訓練）、第二組為常規訓練組（接受相同的體能訓練，但不包括認知訓練），或第三組為對照組（常規方式，即不會接受任何訓練）。主要結果指標為疼痛程度的變化。研究人員將於介入項目前、介入項目完成後及介入項目完成後六個月，使用簡明疼痛量表（Brief Pain Inventory）進行評估。其他結果指標包括:衰弱程度、身體功能、認知功能、心理功能、疼痛災難化思維、疼痛自我效能、殘疾狀況和生活質素的變化、整體治療印象及醫療相關成本。數據將按意向性分析（Intention-to-treat）的原則，並採用合適的統計方法以進行評估分析。 因慢性肌肉骨骼痛症及衰弱症都是影響長者健康老齡化的主要因素，本試驗將評估雙重作業訓練能否改善這兩種常見的健康問題。研究結果將為日後應用雙重作業訓練以改善患者為本的健康指標，提供高質素的科學依據。

25205326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25205326.value: 面向開放世界的代理邊緣人工智能系統：框架、算法與實現

25205326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25205326.value: Following the success of generative AI, modern-era agents are creating a new paradigm of AI execution logic, shifting from passive model invocation to proactive model autonomy. Notably, the agentic system can perceive, reason, act, and evolve in the environment with minimal human intervention. However, the versatile agents remain largely confined to centralized infrastructures, including on-cloud powerful knowledge engines (e.g., world models) and uplink data. Such physical barriers between centralized autonomous capabilities and highly distributed real-world end-users (e.g., smart cities, healthcare, trading, and robotics) can inevitably incur service latency and privacy issues. Recent edge AI techniques have partially alleviated these issues by compressing large foundation models (e.g., LLMs/VLMs) onto edge devices, including Apple MM1-2024 and DeepSeek R1-Distill-2025, and enabling collaborative and real-time reasoning through federated analytics across edges. Despite great endeavors, current AI agents still face fundamental challenges in open edge environments. First, as the core engine of autonomy, a mature world model is expected to be more complex in both architecture and collaboration mode than LLMs or other pre-trained large models, encompassing various physical worldviews/knowledge instead of only languages and/or images for real-world perception and reasoning. Next, off-the-shelf edge models are mostly quantized based on separate network modules, lacking the synergistic design of various architectures related to world models, and more importantly, without a data perspective (e.g., in-memory computation and management). Furthermore, as another important feature of AI agents, model evolution requires significantly faster processes, even with constrained computing capabilities and scarce data. Lastly, due to the involvement of multiple worldviews and agents, a more robust and secure system is also needed to supplement the current design of existing edge AI systems. Aimed at facilitating the utilization of versatile AI agents at ubiquitous edges, this project proposes a series of enabling techniques to construct an agentic edge AI system capable of handling open-world autonomy. In particular, we will first carefully devise a hierarchical and collaborative world model framework to enable edge-native engines for the agents. Building upon the edge-native framework, we will then design three supporting schemes consisting of well-designed algorithms that are responsible for lightweight and accelerated data-model offloading, dynamic and efficient system evolution, and enhanced security for the agentic edge AI system. Last, we will implement a prototype to validate our framework and algorithms and further draft a set of potential real-world applications that benefit the research community, industries, and citizens in Hong Kong and globally. 儘管學界與業界已做出相當努力，當前的AI代理在開放邊緣環境中仍面臨根本性挑戰。首先，作為自主能力的核心引擎，成熟的世界模型預期在架構與協作模式上將比大型語言模型或其他預訓練大模型更為複雜，必須涵蓋多種物理世界觀／知識，而非僅限於語言及／或影像，方能實現對真實世界的感知與推理。其次，現成的邊緣模型大多基於獨立的網絡模組進行量化，缺乏與世界模型相關之各種架構的協同設計，更重要的是，欠缺數據層面的考量（例如記憶體內計算與管理）。此外，作為AI代理的另一項重要特徵，模型演化即使在運算能力受限且數據稀缺的情況下，亦需顯著加快其進程。最後，由於涉及多種世界觀與多個代理，現有邊緣AI系統的設計亦亟需更穩健且更安全的系統加以補充。為促進多功能 AI 代理在普及邊緣端之應用，本項目提出一系列關鍵使能技術，以建構能處理開放世界自主能力之代理邊緣AI系統。具體而言，我們將首先精心設計一個分層協作的世界模型框架，以實現代理的邊緣原生引擎。基於該邊緣原生框架，我們將進一步設計三項支援方案，包含精心設計的算法，分別負責輕量化且加速之數據－模型卸載、動態且高效之系統演化，以及增強的代理邊緣AI系統安全性。最後，我們將實現一個原型以驗證我們的框架與算法，並進一步擬定一系列潛在的實際應用，以惠及香港及全球之研究社群、產業與市民。

25205526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25205526.value: 一图万境：从单帧图像生成持久一致的三维视频世界

25205526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25205526.value: Recent advances in video generation have made it possible to create short, visually stunning clips from text or images. However, these systems behave like "painters on a flat canvas": they create pixels without any persistent understanding of the 3D world. As a result, while these videos may look impressive at first, they quickly collapse over time—objects drift, styles shift, and occluded content fails to reappear. This lack of 3D awareness breaks the temporal coherence and prevents the creation of truly persistent, explorable environments. Solving this breaks a fundamental barrier, unlocking the future of immersive virtual reality, reliable robotics, and next-generation media. This project aims to address this by developing a system that generates 3D persistent, long-form video from a single image and a user-defined camera trajectory. Our core idea is that a unified model generating both RGB frames and 3D structure is key to build a consistent virtual world. Training such a model, however, presents three challenges: (1) Data Scarcity: There is no large-scale long video datasets with accurate 3D information. (2) Model Design: Existing generators cannot simultaneously produce long videos and 3D structure. (3) Long-term Consistency: Maintaining coherence over long sequences requires a memory mechanism to recall past information. We address these challenges with three interconnected solutions. (1) Data: We will build a 3D Video Data Engine that collects data from three sources: high-quality 3D renderings, simulator-generated videos and, as a novel component, 3D information extracted from real-world videos using foundation models. (2) Model: We will develop a Geometrically-Grounded Long Video Generator. First, we will train a 3D-VAE to compress data into a unified latent space that jointly encodes appearance and geometry. Within this space, an autoregressive diffusion forcing model will predict future frames. By conditioning the entire process on a starting image and camera trajectory, the system is designed to maintain consistency across long sequences. (3) Memory: We will design a Hierarchical Memory System that captures both short-term context and a persistent long-term 3D map of the scene. This enables the model to recall past information, maintain continuity, and progressively refine environments over time. If successful, our system will redefine AI-generated content by constructing persistent, navigable 3D worlds from a single image. This capability will unlock incredible new possibilities for immersive VR, game development, robotics, and simulation, positioning Hong Kong as a hub for next-generation AI research and applications. 近年来，视频生成技术取得了显著进展，已能够根据文本或图像生成短时、高质量且具有较强视觉冲击力的视频。然而，现有方法本质上仍更像是在“二维画布上作画”：模型主要生成像素，却缺乏对三维世界持续、稳定的理解。因此，生成结果虽然在短时间内具有较好的视觉效果，但随着视频长度增加，往往迅速出现物体漂移、外观风格变化、遮挡物体无法正确重现等问题。三维空间认知能力的缺失破坏了视频的长期时序一致性，也使现有生成模型难以构建真正持续存在、可自由探索的虚拟环境。突破这一瓶颈，将为沉浸式虚拟现实、可靠的机器人智能以及下一代数字媒体奠定重要基础。 本项目拟研究一种从单张图像和用户指定的相机轨迹出发，生成具有持久三维一致性的长时视频的新方法。项目的核心思想是：只有在统一模型中同时生成 RGB 视频内容与三维场景结构，才能建立长期稳定、一致的虚拟世界。 实现这一目标面临三项关键挑战。第一，数据稀缺：目前缺乏兼具长时视频和准确三维信息的大规模训练数据。第二，模型设计：现有生成模型难以同时实现长视频生成与三维结构建模。第三，长期一致性：随着序列不断延长，模型需要有效的记忆机制来保存并调用历史场景信息，从而维持环境的持续一致。 针对上述挑战，本项目提出三个相互关联的研究方向。首先，在数据层面，构建三维视频数据引擎（3D Video Data Engine），综合三类数据来源：高质量三维渲染数据、仿真器生成的视频数据，以及利用基础模型从真实世界视频中提取的三维信息，从而建立规模化、多样化的三维长视频训练数据。其次，在模型层面，研发几何约束的长视频生成模型（Geometrically-Grounded Long Video Generator）。我们将首先训练一种 3D-VAE，将视觉外观与三维几何结构联合压缩至统一潜空间；随后在该潜空间中采用自回归 Diffusion Forcing 模型逐步预测未来视频帧。通过始终以初始图像和相机轨迹作为条件，模型能够在长序列生成过程中维持视觉与几何的一致性。最后，在记忆层面，设计层次化记忆系统（Hierarchical Memory System），同时建模局部的短期上下文和持续更新的长期三维场景地图，使模型能够回溯历史信息、保持时空连续性，并在生成过程中逐步完善和细化场景表示。 若本项目取得成功，将推动 AI 内容生成从“生成连续图像”迈向“构建持续存在的三维世界”。系统有望仅凭单张图像，即生成长期一致、可导航、可探索的三维动态环境，为沉浸式虚拟现实、游戏开发、机器人、仿真等领域带来新的技术可能，并进一步推动香港在下一代人工智能基础研究与应用方面形成国际竞争力。

25207926.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25207926.value: 高效多项式承诺方案：通用架构、构造及应用

25207926.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25207926.value: A polynomial commitment scheme (PCS) is a powerful cryptographic primitive that enables a prover to commit to a polynomial with a succinct value, and later allows a verifier to confirm claimed evaluations of the committed polynomial. Multilinear PCSs are critical in many applications, such as zk-SNARKs (zero-knowledge succinct non-interactive arguments of knowledge), lookup arguments, verifiable secret sharing, and verifiable databases. Improving the efficiency of multilinear PCSs would significantly benefit these cryptographic designs. Although numerous constructions of multilinear polynomial commitments have been applied in various aspects, most are ad-hoc designs tailored to specific scenarios, limiting their generalizability and leading to additional costs when adapting to different cases. Meanwhile, while existing code-based and lattice-based solutions offer post-quantum security, their efficiency remains unsatisfactory for real-world applications. This project will introduce a generic architecture for constructing multilinear PCSs by combining two lines of research. First, we refine sumcheck-based PCS to develop a new, efficient protocol for evaluation claims. Next, we provide a comprehensive analysis of PCS constructions based on multilinear-to-univariate transformations, revealing that the sumcheck protocol can be reinterpreted as an interactive oracle proof (IOP) in which polynomials are transmitted as oracles. By integrating these two approaches, we establish a general architecture for multilinear PCS that is flexible across various scenarios without incurring additional transformation costs. Furthermore, we provide efficient multilinear PCS constructions based on this architecture. Our framework easily derives new variants of state-of-the-art PCSs, improving their efficiency in different scenarios. Additionally, it enables the design of new PCSs with superior properties compared to existing approaches. Specifically, we introduce code-based and lattice-based PCSs that significantly reduce proof sizes to sub-logarithmic, addressing the gap in practical post-quantum solutions. Finally, we extend our techniques to broader applications, including the development of efficient zk-SNARKs, lookup arguments, and practical solutions for data availability in layer-2 blockchains. Our methods substantially reduce the proof sizes of zk-SNARKs and lookup arguments, and enable more efficient data recovery with less information. This project offers significant technical and societal impact. Efficient PCSs are foundational to technologies such as zk-SNARKs, lookup arguments, and layer-2 blockchains, all of which play critical roles in ensuring security, privacy, and scalability. These techniques are essential for decentralized applications like identity management and decentralized finance, which are central to the Web3 ecosystem. By improving the efficiency of these underlying technologies, this project will help make Web3 more accessible and practical for a broader range of real-world applications. 多项式承诺方案（PCS）是一种强有力的密码学原语，它允许证明者用一个简短的值来承诺一个多项式，并在此后允许验证者确认该被承诺多项式的声明求值。多线性 PCS 在许多应用中至关重要，例如 zk-SNARKs（零知识简短非交互式知识论证）、查找论证、可验证秘密共享以及可验证数据库。提高多线性 PCS 的效率将显著惠及这些密码学设计。 尽管已有许多多线性多项式承诺的构造被应用于各个领域，但大多数都是针对特定场景设计的定制化方案，限制了其通用性，并且在适配不同场景时会带来额外的开销。同时，现有的基于编码和基于格的解决方案虽然具备后量子安全性，但其效率对于实际应用而言仍不够理想。 本项目将结合两条研究路线，提出一种用于构造多线性 PCS 的通用架构。首先，我们将优化基于 sumcheck 的 PCS，从而为求值声明开发一种全新的高效协议。其次，我们对基于“多线性到单变量转换”的 PCS 构造进行深入分析，揭示出 sumcheck 协议可以被重新解释为一种交互式神谕证明（IOP），其中多项式是以Oracle的形式传输的。通过融合这两种方法，我们建立了一个通用的多线性 PCS 架构，该架构在各种场景下都具备高度灵活性，且不会产生额外的转换成本。 此外，我们基于该架构提供了高效的多线性 PCS 构造。我们的框架可以轻松衍生出最前沿PCS 的新变体，从而提升它们在不同场景下的效率。同时，它还能设计出与现有方法相比具备更优异特性的新型 PCS。具体而言，我们引入了基于编码和基于格的 PCS，将证明大小显著降低至亚对数级，填补了实用后量子解决方案的空白。 最后，我们将相关技术扩展到更广泛的应用中，包括开发高效的 zk-SNARKs、查找论证，以及针对 Level-2 区块链数据可用性的实用解决方案。我们的方法大幅减少了 zk-SNARKs 和查找论证的证明大小，并能够以更少的资源实现更高效的数据恢复。 本项目具有显著的技术与社会价值。高效的 PCS 是 zk-SNARKs、查找论证和 Level-2 区块链等技术的核心基石，这些技术在保障安全性、隐私性和可扩展性方面发挥着至关重要的作用。对于身份管理和去中心化金融等构成 Web3 生态核心的去中心化应用而言，这些技术不可或缺。通过提升这些底层技术的效率，本项目将推动 Web3 在更广泛的现实应用中落地，使其更具实用性与普适性。

25208526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25208526.value: 圍繞機場的網約車需求預測問題：一種基於物理過程的深度學習解決方案

25208526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25208526.value: Ride-sourcing systems have been adopted globally. Among operational technologies for ride-sourcing, demand prediction remains the most critical, as its outcomes provide real-time references for downstream tasks (e.g., pricing and idle vehicle repositioning) to address demand-supply imbalances. Recent advancements have established deep learning as the foundation for ride-sourcing demand prediction. However, while current models perform well in general locations, they face significant accuracy challenges in transport hubs—especially airports—where the demand for departures from these areas via ride-sourcing exhibits more diverse patterns and frequent fluctuations. Such prediction difficulties in airports arise from their unique nature of their passenger sources, high susceptibility to disruptions, and heterogeneous passengers’ behaviors. The mainstream approach to this issue involves increasing the number of model parameters and complexity to enhance learning capacity for airport-specific departure demand patterns. However, due to the black-box nature of deep learning models, researchers cannot control specific parameter learning targets, often resulting in insufficient learning of important patterns, and overfitting of insignificant ones—where models capture unimportant local patterns or noise while neglecting dominant trends. This issue is acute in airports with volatile ride-sourcing demand patterns. As airports are typically located in remote suburbs with long transit times to urban cores, inaccurate predictions lead to severe efficiency losses in ride-sourcing management (e.g., long-time waiting for passengers/drivers). Given the massive departure demands from airports, the improvement of prediction and management here would deliver substantial benefits to travelers worldwide. To address the limitations above, we will propose a novel ride-sourcing demand prediction framework incoperating physical processes. The model will be designed around the physical process (e.g. flight arrivals, airport staying and departure mode choice) of passengers departing from airports via ride-sourcing, embedding the complete processes, constraints, and inherent patterns directly into the deep learning model. By explicitly capturing these deterministic patterns, avoid solely reliance on learned parameters, the framework significantly reduces redundant parameters, thereby mitigating overfitting risks while maintaining pattern integrity and consistently improving prediction accuracy. Furthermore, this framework will be integrated with spatiotemporal networks to enhance adaptability to wider scenarios and improve predictive performance. Finally, we will develop an airport-centric ride-sourcing simulator to generate and validate best design schemes for the framework through extensive experiments. The project's outcomes could be adopted by ride-sourcing platforms (e.g., Uber or DiDi globally, and local taxi companies in Hong Kong) to optimize stakeholder benefits in both airports and similar areas. 網約車系統已在全球廣泛採用。在網約車的各項營運技術中，需求預測仍最為關鍵，因其預測結果可為下游任務（如定價或空車調度等）提供即時參考，以處理供需失衡的問題。近期深度學習的進展，已使其成為網約車需求預測的基礎技術。然而，儘管當前模型在一般地區表現良好，在交通樞紐—特別是機場—卻面臨顯著的準確度挑戰，因為這些區域透過網路叫車出發的需求，呈現更多樣化的型態與頻繁的波動。機場預測困難的根源，在於其旅客來源的特殊性、極易受干擾影響，以及旅客行為的異質性。主流處理方式為增加模型參數與複雜度，以提升對從機場出發的需求型態的學習能力。然而，由於深度學習模型的黑箱本質，研究人員無法控制特定參數的學習目標，往往導致重要型態學習不足，次要型態卻過度擬合—亦即模型捕捉到不重要的局部型態或雜訊，卻忽略了主導趨勢。此問題在網約車需求波動劇烈的機場尤為嚴峻。由於機場多位於偏遠郊區，往返市區交通時間長，預測不準確將導致網約車管理效率嚴重受損（例如乘客或駕駛長時間等候）。鑑於機場龐大的出發需求，若能改善該區域的預測與管理，將為全球旅客帶來顯著效益。 為解決上述限制，我們將提出一套融入物理過程的新型網約車需求預測框架。該模型將以旅客透過網路叫車從機場出發的物理過程（例如航班抵達、機場停留及離開模式選擇）為設計核心，將完整流程、限制條件與內在型態直接嵌入深度學習模型中。透過明確捕捉這些確定性型態，避免僅依賴學習所得參數，本框架可大幅減少冗餘參數，從而降低過度擬合風險，同時維護型態完整性，持續提升預測準確度。此外，此框架將與時空學習神經網絡整合，以增強對更廣泛情境的適應性並改善預測效能。最後，我們將開發一套以機場為中心的網約車系統模擬器，透過大量實驗產生並驗證框架的最佳設計方案。本計畫成果可為網約車平台（如全球優步或滴滴，以及香港本地計程車公司）採用，以優化機場及類似區域內的各方效益。

25208626.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25208626.value: 面向小批量服裝生產的代理式縫制模板設計師

25208626.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25208626.value: The garment industry is facing a shift from mass production to small-lot production, driven by the trend of fast fashion. Fast fashion has fueled major reductions in order-to-delivery times to approximately 15 days for garment factories that use Shien’s supply chain. The fast garment production cycle does not mean low quality because garment factories seek to earn more profit from subsequent orders if the first fashion trial becomes a “hot seller”. Within garment production, sewing is challenging because it is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Today, skilled sewing workers are typically 40–50 years old, as the younger generation is not willing to engage in garment production. This labor shortage is a serious problem that poses a challenge for the whole industry. Our long collaboration with garment companies has confirmed this concern, with most of them exploring sewing automation solutions to decrease the dependency on skilled workers while maintaining stable sewing quality. However, 3D sewing machines and sewing robotics are too expensive for small and medium-sized garment businesses to afford. Most of them prefer to adopt automatic sewing machines as a cheaper solution and to let workers be responsible for putting cutting pieces into sewing templates. This solution works well for mass production because well-designed sewing templates can be repetitively produced for parallel production so that the design cost (time) can be shared by mass production. Usually, an experienced template designer needs at least one day to generate the template designs for one order. If the generation of these template designs can be assisted by large language models (LLMs), which would free human designers to undertake professional improvement or correction work, the adoption of automatic sewing machines could feasibly resolve the dilemma for most garment factories. Motivated by this real-life demand, this project aims to develop an end-to-end pipeline for training MLLMs for individual human designers to generate their own agentic designers. According to the results of our previous tests, only fine-tuning on current open-source MLLMs results in the generation of template designs with hallucinations, because they are trained with internet data and the fundamental philosophy of sewing template design is not infused. For such cases, two tokenizers will be developed in this project to infuse the domain knowledge into MLLMs through continual pretraining. Then, a preference optimization approach will be designed to enable the MLLM to efficiently further align with human designers’ decision-making. 在快時尚趨勢的推動下，服裝行業正面臨著從批量生產向小批量生產的轉變。快時尚使希音供應鏈上的服裝廠的訂單交貨時間大幅縮短至20天左右。快速的服裝節奏並不意味著低質量，因為工廠需要從後續訂單中賺取最大利潤，才能讓第一次時裝試銷成為“熱銷產品”。 在服裝生產中，縫紉是一項具有挑戰性的工作，既費時又費力。今天，熟練的縫紉工人通常是40 -50歲，因為年輕一代不願意從事服裝生產。勞動力短缺是困擾整個行業的一個嚴重問題。我們與服裝公司的長期合作證實了這一點，他們中的大多數都在探索縫紉自動化解決方案，以減少對熟練工人的依賴，並保持穩定的縫紉質量。然而，3D縫紉機或縫制機器人對於中小型服裝企業來說過於昂貴。他們中的大多數人更喜歡采用自動縫紉機，作為一種更便宜的解決方案，並讓工人負責將裁片放入縫紉模板中。這種解決方案適用於批量生產，因為精心設計的縫紉模板可以重覆生產並行生產，這樣大批量生產可以分擔設計成本/時間。通常，經驗豐富的模板設計人員至少需要一天的時間來為一個訂單生成模板設計。如果這些模板設計可以由大型語言模型輔助，並釋放人類設計師進行專業的改進或校正工作，采用自動縫紉機是可行的，可以解決大多數服裝廠的困境。 受這一現實行業需求的推動，該項目旨在開發一個端到端的培訓管道，為個人縫紉模板設計師訓練多模態大模型，以培養他們自己的代理設計師。我們之前的測試發現，如果對當前的開源多模態大模型進行微調，會輸出帶有幻覺的模板設計。這是因為目前的多模態大模型是用互聯網數據進行培訓的，他們很難通過使用這些數據來理解縫紉模板設計的基本理念。在這種情況下，本項目將開發兩個分詞器，通過持續的預訓練將領域知識注入多模態大模型。然後，設計一種偏好優化方法，有效地使多模態大模型進一步與人類設計師的設計決策保持一致。

25210026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25210026.value: 基於開放交通數據與排放實測特徵化交通相關空氣污染的動態模式

25210026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25210026.value: On-road traffic is a major contributor to greenhouse gases and ground-level air pollution in dense urban areas. The spatio-temporal resolution of regulatory traffic-related emissions modeling is often hindered by the scarcity of dynamic traffic data and localized emission factors incorporation. In addition, in hilly cities like Hong Kong (HK), city morphological factors, such as the steep road grade, amplify the uncertainties in emission estimation, given dynamic and directional traffic flows, but are often neglected in regulatory models. Such simplification alters the magnitude and spatio-temporal patterns of emission hotspots, resulting in substantial errors in downstream air quality prediction and exposure assessment applications. Therefore, this study proposes to explore the unique opportunities provided by emerging open traffic data and non-intrusive emission testing methods to overcome the shortcomings in existing emission modeling tools, while carefully examining associated uncertainties. The project concentrates on Hong Kong’s three typical on-road traffic gaseous emissions: NOx, CO, and hydrocarbons, which are strictly regulated locally. First, we develop a localized emission factor database through an extensive on-road plume-chasing experiment, updating the aging regulatory emissions database. This is the first exploration of ultrafast-response gas analyzers for plume-chasing in HK. We propose to test emissions from a representative portion of the on-road fleet and road conditions in seasons, especially those with large road grades. Second, we validate and calibrate our road grade-incorporated emission model using the plume-chasing results, further enabling city-wide traffic emission modeling. Third, dynamic traffic is estimated by employing a crowd-sourced congestion index that covers all roads and utilizes publicly available traffic camera/detector data at strategic locations, with a spatial regression-based approach as the back-up plan. Finally, dynamic traffic is combined with the calibrated emission model to develop a spatio-temporally resolved city-scale multi-emission inventory, which is applied to roadside dispersion modeling at critical times and hotspots to assess population exposure. Uncertainties in the entire ‘testing-modeling-impact assessing’ chain are also quantified step by step. Our approach advances city-scale emission modeling tools in their resolution, heterogeneity, and consistency with on-road measurements and open data, valid for both fossil fuel and electric vehicles in global urban areas. The research outputs are useful for devising localized emission control policies to improve public health and incentivizing transportation energy transition to curb climate change. 道路交通是密集都會區溫室氣體及地面空氣污染物的主要來源。然而，傳統監管交通排放模型的時空解析度，往往受限於動態交通數據的匱乏，以及缺乏在地化排放因子的納入。此外，在香港這類多山丘的城市中，陡峭道路坡度等城市形態因素，會因應動態與方向性的交通流量，顯著放大排放估算的的不確定性，但這些因素在監管模型中常被忽略。此類簡化改變了排放熱點的幅度與時空模式，導致下游空氣質素預測及暴露評估應用出現重大誤差。 因此，本研究旨在探討新興開放交通數據與非侵入式排放測試方法所帶來的新機遇，以克服現有排放建模工具的不足，同時仔細審視相關的不確定性。項目聚焦於香港三種受嚴格監管的典型馬路交通氣體排放物：氮氧化物（NOx）、一氧化碳（CO）及碳氫化合物（HC）。首先，我們透過廣泛的馬路追煙（plume-chasing）實驗建立在地化的排放因子資料庫，以更新老化中的監管排放資料庫。這是香港首次探索利用超快速響應氣體分析儀進行追煙測試。我們計劃在不同季節，特別是在大坡度的路段，測試具代表性的馬路車隊及道路狀況的排放。其次，我們利用追煙測試結果驗證並校準已納入道路坡度的排放模型，從而實現全港性的交通排放建模。第三，動態交通流量的估算，將採用覆蓋所有道路的眾包（crowd-sourced）塞車指數，並結合重要位置的公開交通監測鏡頭及檢測器數據；同時以基於空間回歸的方法作為備用方案。最後，將動態交通數據與校準後的排放模型結合，開發出具高時空解析度的全港性多污染物排放清單，並應用於關鍵時間點與熱點的路邊擴散建模，以評估人口暴露風險。整個「測試—建模—影響評估」鏈結中的不確定性亦會進行逐步定量分析。 我們的研究方法提升了城市級排放建模工具的解析度、異質性，以及與道路實測和開放數據的一致性，適用於全球都會區的化石燃料車輛及電動車。研究成果有助於制定在地化的排放控制政策以改善市民健康，並推動交通能源轉型以應對氣候變化。

25210426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25210426.value: 用於鐵路噪音控制的聲學特性可編程的摺紙-薄膜可部署聲屏障：從計算設計到全尺寸驗證

25210426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25210426.value: Hong Kong, one of the world’s largest metropolises, faces significant noise pollution from multiple sources due to its dense urban environment. Among these, railway noise stands out as a critical issue, given the city’s heavy reliance on its metro system. The Mass Transit Railway (MTR) network, now comprising 10 heavy rail lines, 99 stations (spanning over 240 km), and serving more than 5 million passenger trips on an average weekday, has expanded rapidly to meet growing demand. This expansion is set to continue, with large-scale projects, such as the Northern Metropolis and Kau Yi Chau Artificial Islands development underway, as outlined in the Strategic Studies on Railways and Major Roads Beyond 2030. However, the substantial daily passenger load accelerates wear and tear on railway infrastructure, leading to rail corrugation and imbalanced vibration-induced forces. These mechanical deteriorations generate low-to-medium frequency rolling noise during regular metro operations, which constitutes the dominant component of railway noise pollution. Yet, the environmental noise impact of railways remains a persistent and often overlooked challenge. Sound barriers are well-established solutions that have been widely implemented for railway noise mitigation in Hong Kong. Conventional sound barriers and enclosures, typically made of concrete, acrylic, or composite panels, are commonly deployed throughout the railway network. While these structures demonstrate measurable noise reduction benefits, they face several inherent limitations, particularly regarding space constraints, investment cost, and effectiveness against low-frequency noise. To overcome these challenges, there is a pressing need to advance noise control solutions by developing innovative sound barriers with superior acoustic performance and practical functionality. The rapid development of computational methods and the emergence of acoustic metamaterials (AMs) now make this advancement feasible. However, despite their potential, the real-world applications of AM-enabled sound barriers with acoustically tunable, deployable, cost-effective, energy-efficient, and climate-resilient properties, remain largely unexplored. Bridging this gap between theoretical research and practical implementation is essential to fully fulfill the transformative potential of these next-generation noise control solutions. To overall objective of this research is to develop a novel sound barrier based on hybrid origami-membrane structures, engineered to be programmable for optimal on-demand operation that adapts to external noise characteristics. This programmability, enabling precise tunability of acoustic properties, will be realised through the development of an integrated computational framework that synergises novel physical modelling and advanced machine learning techniques. The research outcomes will deliver significant advances in environmental sustainability and noise control engineering. 香港密集的城市環境使其面臨嚴峻的噪音污染挑戰，其中鐵路噪音尤為突出，這主要源於城市對地鐵系統的高度依賴性。每日龐大的客流量加速了軌道結構的疲勞損耗，導致鋼軌波磨及由不平衡振動引發的動態激勵力，進而在常規營運條件下產生以中低頻成分為主的輪軌滾動噪音。為緩解此一問題，聲屏障已被廣泛部署於香港鐵路沿線。傳統聲屏障雖具有降噪效果，但在高密度城市空間中卻面臨固有局限，包括安裝空間受限、建設成本高昂，以及對低頻噪音衰減效果不佳等。為突破這些瓶頸，亟需開發兼具優異聲學性能與工程實用性的新型屏障。近年來，計算方法的高速進步與聲學超材料的興起，為實現此一目標提供了技術可能。然而，儘管潛力巨大，能夠兼顧聲學可調性、可部署性、成本效益、能源效率及氣候適應性的超材料聲屏障，其在工程實踐中的應用至今仍鮮有探索。為解決這一難點，本研究旨在開發一種基於混合摺紙—膜結構的新型可編程聲屏障，其能夠根據外部地鐵噪音特性進行按需調控。為實現可編程聲學特性，本研究將建立一套整合計算框架，融合新穎的物理建模方法與先進機器學習技術，並透過不同尺度的實驗進行設計有效性論證。研究成果預期將為城市環境噪音治理與可持續基礎設施設計提供重要的理論依據與技術支撐。

25221326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25221326.value: 開發基於金屬有機框架（MOFs）的納米多孔氧化劑用於污染物的吸附與解毒

25221326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25221326.value: Currently, people are exposed to a wide range of pollutants, including chemical warfare agents (CWAs) misused in regional conflicts and toxic industrial chemicals (TICs) released from industrial activities. The threat posed by CWAs and TICs to both human health and environmental safety underscores the urgent need for advanced adsorption and detoxification technologies. Conventional adsorbents, such as activated carbon, usually rely on physical adsorption, which often results in low adsorption capacities, especially at low concentrations. Even worse, harmful substances are not degraded after being adsorbed, posing secondary risks during handling and disposal. Adsorbent materials with dual functions of capture and detoxification are in high demand for personal protection and air purifiers. In this project, we aim to develop metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) based nanoporous oxidants by dispersing oxidative agents at the molecular level within the adsorbent nanopore towards the simultaneous adsorption and detoxification of toxic substances. Our preliminary data validates the feasibility of this detoxifying nanoporous oxidant concept. For example, the prepared nanoporous oxidant shows enhanced SO₂ adsorption at lower relative pressures and simultaneously oxidizes it into a less hazardous non-volatile sulfate form. Similarly, the nanoporous oxidant can directly oxidize mustard gas simulants into less-toxic sulfoxides under solvent-free conditions. Importantly, the reactive oxidants embedded within the nanoporous carrier can be regenerated through a simple treatment with oxidant aqueous solutions, enabling repeated use and extending the operational lifetime. Leveraging these promising preliminary results, we will pursue the optimization of nanoporous oxidant synthesis and undertake an in-depth exploration of their structure–performance relationships, integrating experimental investigations with advanced theoretical modeling and simulations. We aim to establish foundational design principles that govern nanoporous oxidants' performance in toxic chemical remediation via in-situ detoxification following adsorption. This work will provide insights for the development of safe, regenerable, and high-efficiency nanoporous oxidants for use in defense against CWAs and TICs.

25221526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25221526.value: 地緣政治動盪下的供應鏈契約設計：應對零售商的隱性目標

25221526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25221526.value: The frequent geopolitical conflicts, such as the US-China trade tensions, have intensified market volatility and undermined economic stability, exposing firms to significant demand uncertainty. This turbulence amplifies heterogeneity in profit risk across businesses, with firms exhibiting diverse risk attitudes and profit targets. However, firms conceal their true objectives, particularly in highly volatile environments or under competitive pressures, as a strategy to preserve bargaining power and operational flexibility. This information asymmetry impedes supply chain (SC) coordination. To address this industry-rooted challenge, it is critical to develop contract mechanisms that align incentives without mandating disclosure of firms’ private objectives, thereby enhancing SC performance. From our recent discussions with industry partners, we have found that quantity discount (QD) contracts are widely adopted across industries, with some retailers actively negotiate additional incentives (such as target sales rebate (TSR)) to improve their profitability. However, manufacturers typically lack a priori knowledge of retailers’ risk attitudes and profit targets. This information asymmetry motivates us to investigate the effectiveness of implementing this sophisticated QD with TSR (QDTSR) contracts when retailers’ objectives are unobservable. By applying a game-theoretical approach, our preliminary analysis reveals that conventional QD, TSR, and “menu of TSR” contracts fail to achieve SC coordination under such information asymmetry. However, we uncover that a “menu of QDTSR” contracts can resolve this coordination challenge by maximizing overall SC profitability while enabling both the manufacturer and retailer to meet their profit targets through appropriate contract design mechanisms. Building on these insights, this project plans to conduct a comprehensive analysis of SC contracting under information asymmetry regarding retailers’ objectives, with a focus on four key extensions: (i) multi-retailer SCs with heterogeneous and unobservable risk attitudes and profit targets, (ii) evaluation of alternative QD-based contracts (e.g., “QD with revenue-sharing”, and others); (iii) investigation of price-dependent demand in additive and multiplicative forms; and (iv) examination of the tariff imposition case. We also demonstrate the robustness of our findings by employing alternative risk measurement approaches and a Nash bargaining framework. To gain deeper insights, we have established collaborations with industry partners who are committed to sharing their practical experience and operational data. These partnerships will enable us to validate our theoretical results and ensure the real-world relevance. Overall, the findings of this project will provide significant theoretical and managerial implications for contract design in SCs facing information asymmetry and geopolitically volatility. 近年來，中美貿易緊張等地緣政治衝突頻繁發生，加劇了市場波動並削弱了經濟穩定性，使企業面臨顯著的需求不確定性。此類動盪進一步放大了不同企業之間在利潤風險上的異質性，企業也因而展現出不同的風險態度與利潤目標。然而，在高度波動的環境或競爭壓力下，企業往往會隱藏其真實目標，以維持議價能力與營運彈性。這種資訊不對稱阻礙了供應鏈協調。為應對此挑戰，本研究探討如何設計契約機制，使其能在無須企業揭露其私有目標的前提下，提升供應鏈績效。根據與業界的討論，數量折扣契約已被廣泛應用於不同產業，而部分零售商亦會積極協商額外激勵措施，例如目標銷售返利，以提升其獲利能力。這促使我們探討在零售商目標不可觀測的情況下，結合數量折扣與目標銷售返利的進階契約，是否能有效促進供應鏈協調。透過博弈論方法，我們發現，「數量折扣與目標銷售返利的進階契約選單」能透過適當的契約設計機制解決此協調難題。該契約選單不僅能最大化整體供應鏈利潤，亦能使製造商與零售商雙方達成各自的利潤目標。基於上述發現，本項目計劃對零售商目標存在資訊不對稱情境下的供應鏈契約設計展開全面分析，研究內容包括：考慮多零售商供應鏈，其中零售商具有不可觀測的風險態度與利潤目標；評估其他以數量折扣為基礎的契約；探討不同需求形式；以及考察關稅徵收情境。整體而言，本項目的研究發現將為面臨資訊不對稱與地緣政治波動的供應鏈契約設計，提供重要的理論貢獻與管理啟示。

25223826.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25223826.value: 兼具寬頻隔聲與通風功能的超緊湊型可編程聲學光柵

25223826.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25223826.value: Hong Kong faces a noise challenge unparalleled by other metropolitan cities due to its extremely limited land supply. High-rise buildings are densely packed, forming urban canyons where noise becomes highly reverberant and intrusive. Closing windows and doors is the most immediate solution for blocking noise intrusion, but this also blocks natural ventilation. In the post-COVID era, when natural ventilation has been recognized as vital for improving indoor air quality and reducing health-related risks, overcoming this trade-off has become essential for creating comfortable and healthy living environments. Extensive research has focused on ventilation windows and ventilated acoustic metasurfaces (AMSs). While ventilation windows — consisting of two glass panes with staggered vents — effectively reduce mid-to-high-frequency noise, their considerable thickness requirement for mitigating low-frequency noise limits practical applications. Ventilated AMSs, featuring engineered metastructures that allow airflow, offer broadband noise insulation. However, most studies are limited to normal incidence, and the structural complexity of these designs poses challenges for cost-effective fabrication and large-scale implementation. These limitations highlight a research gap in achieving broadband low-frequency noise attenuation with ultracompact structures. Motivated by these challenges, this project develops an ultracompact programmable acoustic grating (UPAG) consisting of two layers of subwavelength slats, each of which can be independently switched between open and closed states to control acoustic wave propagation and airflow. The binary states, denoted as ‘0’ (open) and ‘1’ (closed), allow diverse coding sequences, with each configuration producing distinct noise attenuation and ventilation performance. Compared with conventional ventilated structures, the UPAG stands out for three major innovations: (i) a unique noise-reduction mechanism capable of overcoming the long-standing trade-off between open ratio and acoustic performance; (ii) effective mitigation of noise generated from both directional and omnidirectional sources; and (iii) a structurally simple yet practical design based on slat units. A comprehensive theoretical model will be established to predict the noise reduction performance of the UPAG with any coding sequence. A multi-objective optimization algorithm will be developed to determine coding sequences and geometrical parameters, systematically balancing noise reduction and airflow. The underlying noise reduction mechanism will be thoroughly investigated, providing design guidelines to meet specific requirements of noise reduction and ventilation across diverse scenarios. By addressing both scientific challenges and practical implementation barriers, the proposed research is expected to make contributions to the development of a new class of programmable, ultrathin, and easily deployable acoustic structures, that promote comfortable and healthy living environments. 香港土地資源極為有限，所面對的噪音問題較其他國際大都市更為嚴峻。高層建築密集分布，形成典型的城市峽谷，使噪音在建築物之間產生多重反射，進一步加劇其對室內環境的干擾。關閉門窗是阻隔外界噪音最直接的方法，但同時亦會妨礙自然通風。在後疫情時代，自然通風已被廣泛認為對改善室內空氣質素及降低健康風險具有重要作用。因此，如何突破噪音控制與自然通風之間的固有矛盾，已成為營造舒適及健康居住環境的重要課題。 過往大量研究集中於通風窗及具通風功能的聲學超表面（acoustic metasurfaces, AMSs）。通風窗通常由雙層玻璃及錯列通風口組成，能有效降低中高頻噪音；然而，若要衰減低頻噪音，往往需要較大的結構厚度，因而限制了其實際應用。具有通風功能的聲學超表面則利用可允許氣流通過的人工微結構實現寬頻隔音，但現有研究大多集中於正入射聲波，其結構亦往往較為複雜，不利於低成本製造及大規模應用。這些局限顯示，目前仍缺乏能夠以超緊湊結構實現寬頻低頻噪音衰減，同時兼顧自然通風的有效方案。 針對上述挑戰，本項目將研發一種超緊湊可編程聲學光柵（ultracompact programmable acoustic grating, UPAG）。該結構由兩層亞波長柵條組成，每一柵條均可獨立切換至開啟或關閉狀態，以調控聲波傳播及氣流通過。其二元狀態分別定義為「0」（開啟）及「1」（關閉），可形成多種編碼序列，而不同配置將呈現不同的噪音衰減及通風性能。與傳統通風聲學結構相比，UPAG 具有三項主要創新：（i）提出一種獨特的降噪機制，有望突破長期存在的開口率與聲學性能之間的權衡；（ii）能有效抑制來自定向及全向聲源的噪音；以及（iii）採用以柵條單元為基礎的簡潔實用結構，具備良好的製造便利性及工程應用潛力。 本項目將建立完整的理論模型，以預測 UPAG 在任意編碼序列下的噪音衰減性能，並發展多目標最佳化演算法，以確定最佳編碼序列及幾何參數，系統地平衡降噪與通風需求。同時，項目將深入探討其核心降噪機制，並建立相應的設計指引，以滿足不同應用場景下對噪音控制及自然通風的特定要求。 透過同時解決基礎科學問題及實際應用障礙，本研究預期將推動一類全新的可編程、超薄且易於部署的聲學結構之發展，為兼顧噪音控制與自然通風提供新的技術途徑，並有助於營造更舒適及健康的居住環境。

25227526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25227526.value: 面向高效分布式量子计算：网络架构、纠缠分发与电路编译的一体化设计

25227526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25227526.value: Current monolithic quantum processors face significant limitations in terms of qubit count and scalability, which constrain their ability to address practical problems. Distributed Quantum Computing (DQC) is a promising paradigm for scaling quantum computation capabilities by interconnecting multiple Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) and performing computations collaboratively. Despite the promise, current approaches to DQC face critical limitations. Network designs are often generic and overlook platform-specific constraints; entanglement distribution strategies are largely internet-oriented and not tailored for DQC; and compilers treat circuit transformation, qubit mapping, and gate scheduling as sequential tasks. Moreover, these three interdependent layers—network architecture, entanglement distribution, and circuit compilation—are rarely designed jointly. These limitations significantly constrain their performance and practicality. Therefore, this project aims to develop a holistic design for DQC that integrates these three layers. First, we will address the networking challenges of interconnecting QPUs by designing platform-aware interconnection networks that explicitly account for the physical constraints of different quantum platforms. These include multistage switching networks for optical platforms and direct networks for superconducting systems, enhancing scalability and performance under hardware constraints. Second, we will develop DQC-native entanglement distribution strategies that globally optimize path routing, resource allocation, purification approaches, and the selection of quantum network coding (QNC) schemes, supporting both online and offline modes. These strategies will be co-designed with network topologies and will expose tunable entanglement request parameters to the compiler for cross-layer coordination. Third, we will investigate an integrated compiler for distributed execution. Unlike conventional approaches that treat circuit transformation, qubit mapping, and gate scheduling as independent components, we propose an integrated compiler framework that jointly optimizes these components while adaptively tuning parameters exposed by the entanglement distribution layer. The project’s substantial impact is advancing DQC through a holistic design of interconnection networks, entanglement distribution, and circuit compilation. Building on this perspective, the core contributions are: (1) design platform-aware and scalable interconnection networks tailored to distinct quantum hardware platforms; (2) propose DQC-native and efficient entanglement distribution strategies that globally optimize network coding, path routing, purification, and resource management; (3) develop an integrated compiler that jointly optimizes circuit transformation, qubit mapping, and scheduling while coordinating with entanglement management; and (4) Provide a simulator to evaluate the proposed approaches and serve as a reproducible testbed for the DQC community. 現時的單體式量子處理器在量子位元數量及可擴展性方面面臨重大限制，制約了其解決實際問題的能力。分佈式量子計算（Distributed Quantum Computing, DQC）透過互連多個量子處理單元（Quantum Processing Units, QPUs）並協同執行運算，是擴展量子計算能力的一個極具前景的範式。儘管前景可觀，現有的分佈式量子計算方法仍存在關鍵局限：網絡設計往往過於通用，忽略了特定平台的約束；糾纏分發策略大多以互聯網為導向，並非為分佈式量子計算而設；而編譯器則將電路變換、量子位元映射及閘門調度視為順序執行的獨立任務。此外，網絡架構、糾纏分發與電路編譯這三個相互依存的層面甚少被聯合設計。這些局限嚴重制約了其性能及實用性。因此，本項目旨在為分佈式量子計算開發一套整合此三個層面的整體化設計。首先，我們將設計平台感知的互連網絡，明確考慮不同量子平台的物理約束，以應對互連量子處理單元的網絡挑戰，包括為光學平台設計多級交換網絡，以及為超導系統設計直連網絡，從而在硬件約束下提升可擴展性及性能。其次，我們將開發原生於分佈式量子計算的糾纏分發策略，對路徑路由、資源分配、純化方法以及量子網絡編碼（Quantum Network Coding, QNC）方案的選擇進行全局優化，並同時支援在線及離線模式。這些策略將與網絡拓撲進行協同設計，並向編譯器開放可調校的糾纏請求參數，以實現跨層協調。第三，我們將研究面向分佈式執行的整合式編譯器。有別於將電路變換、量子位元映射及閘門調度視為獨立組件的傳統方法，我們提出一個整合式編譯器框架，聯合優化上述組件，並自適應地調校由糾纏分發層開放的參數。本項目的重大影響在於透過互連網絡、糾纏分發與電路編譯的整體化設計，推動分佈式量子計算的發展。基於此視角，本項目的核心貢獻為：（一）設計平台感知且可擴展的互連網絡，切合不同量子硬件平台的特性；（二）提出原生於分佈式量子計算的高效糾纏分發策略，對網絡編碼、路徑路由、純化及資源管理進行全局優化；（三）開發整合式編譯器，聯合優化電路變換、量子位元映射及調度，並與糾纏管理相互協調；（四）提供模擬器以評估所提出的方法，並為分佈式量子計算社群提供的仿真測試平台。

25232026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25232026.value: 提升模塊化建造的碳效率與碳公平：融合全要素碳與博弈論的可持續解決方案

25232026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25232026.value: Buildings account for 39% of global energy-related carbon emissions, highlighting an urgent need for decarbonization strategies. Modular Construction (MC) is a transformative solution to address housing shortages and enhance productivity in high-density cities. Its implementation is accelerating across the Greater Bay Area (GBA), including 30,000 temporary housing units by 2028 and over 150,000 public housing units by 2033/34 in Hong Kong (HK), alongside 3 million square meters of construction in Shenzhen. However, this large-scale adoption generates substantial carbon emissions, creating a conflict between urgent housing needs and vital carbon neutrality goals. This challenge is exacerbated by the inadequacy of conventional carbon management tools, which rely on a static, one-dimensional “carbon quantity” metric. This limited measure fails to capture the critical trade-offs that exist between carbon reduction, multi-resource efficiency, and stakeholder incentives under real-world uncertainty conditions. Consequently, technically carbon reduction strategies often fail in practice because they are economically inefficient. This research breaks this bottleneck by integrating dynamic carbon efficiency optimization with stakeholder equity mechanisms across the MC supply chain. It includes three interconnected stages. First, a novel project-level Total Factor Carbon (TFC) concept is defined, shifting the focus from what carbon is to how efficiently carbon is spent. This concept is operationalized through a three-dimensional framework and corresponding metrics, evaluating TFC performance across temporal (lifecycle stage, lifespan), spatial (building hierarchy, geographic environment), and axiological (stakeholder priority, involvement) dimensions. Second, a hybrid Deep Generative Dynamic Bayesian Network (DG-DBN) integrated with Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) is developed to identify probabilistic, time-evolving TFC trajectories. The risk-averse optimization strategies are identified by minimizing the TFC “Inefficiency Gap”, with Genetic Algorithms (GA) efficiently searching for adaptive strategy solutions. Third, a cooperative game model will be constructed, using modified Shapley values to ensure the equitable allocation of the net value generated by TFC optimization. The allocation will be validated through multi-scenario simulations and focus group meetings with stakeholders from the representative cases. The research delivers theoretical, methodological, and practical advances by integrating a foundational TFC concept, dynamic TFC optimization under uncertainty, and fair value-allocation mechanisms, connecting measurement and optimization to real-world implementation. These outcomes provide industry practitioners and policymakers with a comprehensive decision-support tool and drive the low-carbon strategies under resource constraints. By bridging the gap between technical potential and collaborative implementation, this research provides a foundational framework for aligning mass housing delivery with carbon neutrality goals in high-density cities. 建築碳排放約佔全球能源相關排放總量的39%，凸顯了加速推動建築脫碳的迫切性。模塊化建造是一項變革性解決方案，能有效應對高密度城市的住房短缺問題，並提升建造生產效率。目前，大灣區正積極推廣此工法，例如香港預計於2028年前建成30,000個臨時住房單元，並於2033/34年前完成超過150,000個公共住房單元；深圳亦將興建300萬平方公尺的模塊化建築。然而，大規模採用模塊化建造也將產生大量碳排放，使得迫切的住房需求與碳中和目標之間形成衝突。然而，傳統碳管理工具往往依賴靜態且單一的「碳排放量」指標，該指標無法反映在現實不確定條件下，碳減排、多重資源與利益相關者之間的重要權衡關係。因此，許多技術面上可行的減碳策略，常因經濟或社會效益而在實踐中難以落實。 為突破此瓶頸，本研究整合動態碳效率優化與模塊化建造供應鏈中利益相關者的公平機制。研究分為三個階段。第一階段，我們將從多層次定義「全要素碳」（TFC）的概念，研究如何從「碳排放量」的唯一指標轉向「碳效率」的綜合指標。「全要素碳」將分別從時間（生命週期階段、使用年限）、空間（建築層級、地理環境）及價值（利益相關者優先序、參與程度）等三個維度來進行評估。第二階段，我們將採用混合式深度生成動態貝葉斯網絡（DG-DBN）以及模特卡洛模型（MCS），來探討全要素碳隨着時間變化的軌跡，找出最小化全要素碳的優化策略，並採用遺傳算法（GA）搜尋適應性策略方案。第三階段，我們將建構合作博弈模型，並採用修正的夏普利值，來確保全要素碳優化所產生的淨值能在利益相關者之間進行公平分配。並透過多情境模擬與焦點訪談進行驗證。 本研究整合全要素碳的新概念、不確定條件下的動態優化，以及公平價值分配機制，在理論、方法與現實層面均有所貢獻。研究成果可為業界從業者與政策制定者提供全面性決策支援工具，並有助於在資源有限條件下推動低碳策略的實現。通過填補技術潛力與現實執行之間的差距，本研究為高密度城市在大量興建住房的同時達成碳中和目標，提供了基礎性架構。

25234726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25234726.value: 現實世界資產的自主權身份認證

25234726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25234726.value: Real-world assets (RWAs) tokenization represents a fundamental shift in decentralized finance (DeFi), fostering a more inclusive, efficient, and transparent financial system. With the advance of blockchain technology, decentralized identity (DID) acts as the fundamental trust layer to enable the compliant, transparent, and secure tokenization of RWAs. The substantial market size of RWA tokenization has spurred the development of numerous DID systems. However, due to the evolving regulatory framework, most existing systems are inadequate for the global RWA landscape, due to limited system compatibility, data integrity, and privacy protection. This project aims to investigate a new paradigm of self-sovereign identity authentication for RWAs within blockchain-native DeFi networks. The core idea is to construct a generic verifiable DID system to efficiently authenticate heterogeneous RWA identities and their associated data with fine-grained privacy protection. The benefits are threefold. First, our identity verification techniques facilitate efficient integrity verification of semantic-rich identities and their associated RWA data. Second, our identity authorization approaches enable users to authorize access to RWA entities and control rights to process identity-related data. Third, our system supports identity-controlled secure audit trails of RWA-oriented activities, promoting responsible data collaboration and compliance with RWA regulations. There are several challenges to the realization of this paradigm. First, data integrity is a fundamental issue in verifying the identities and associated RWA data. Second, it is challenging to achieve data sovereignty for RWAs through two levels of rights control, i.e., access control and processing control. Third, with the evolving legal restraints, there is an increasing need to support efficient audit trails of identity-related activities to enhance accountability in RWA operations. To address these challenges, our research agenda includes: i) design of a new identity verification system to ensure RWA data integrity; ii) development of novel schemes to achieve data sovereignty through identity authorization; iii) investigation of identity-controlled secure retrieval techniques to support efficient audit trials of RWA-oriented activities; and iv) security analysis and performance evaluation of our proposed techniques using both theoretical and empirical studies. Finally, we will collaborate with our industry partners for prototyping and testing in their blockchain-based assets management and financial service platforms. With our rich research experience in blockchain and supply chain finance, we expect the outcome of this project to accelerate the growth and adoption of RWA and DID technologies in the DeFi industry.

25240726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25240726.value: 基於硅光子學的波長-路徑混合交換：邁向可重構穩健量子網絡

25240726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25240726.value: Quantum networks are emerging as transformative infrastructure for secure communications, distributed quantum computing, and advanced sensing. Among the staged development paths toward fully realized quantum networks, entanglement distribution networks represent a crucial milestone that enables device-independent secure protocols without requiring quantum memory, making them achievable with near-term technologies. Current implementations, however, face critical limitations: they operate within a single degree of freedom, either wavelength selectivity or spatial path selectivity. This restricts their ability to dynamically adapt network topology, efficiently allocate quantum resources under varying demands, and maintain robust operation when components fail or channels degrade. This project aims to address these fundamental challenges by developing a novel hybrid spectral-spatial switch (HSS) that simultaneously provides both wavelength and spatial routing control for quantum entanglement distribution. The key innovation lies in integrating this dual-domain reconfigurability onto a compact silicon photonic chip, enabling unprecedented network flexibility while minimizing optical losses and preserving quantum state fidelity. The research approach encompasses three interconnected major objectives. First, we will design and fabricate a 4×4×4λ HSS using a cascaded Banyan-Beneš network architecture with ring-assisted asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometers as switching elements. This design achieves significantly reduced complexity compared to conventional architectures, facilitating simpler control and lower insertion loss. As a feasibility study, we have successfully demonstrated a 4×4×2λ HSS prototype on a silicon photonics platform with a compact 0.38 mm² footprint, validating the viability of the proposed architecture. Second, we will develop comprehensive network management protocols that exploit both spectral and spatial reconfigurability, including rapid topology reconfiguration schemes and failure-tolerant routing strategies leveraging redundant channels. Third, we will experimentally demonstrate the complete entanglement distribution system in a quantum network testbed, implementing entanglement-based quantum key distribution to validate network performance under realistic operating conditions. This project will deliver several concrete outcomes: validated chip-scale architectures for scalable dual-domain reconfigurable quantum switches; practical control algorithms for dynamic resource allocation in small-scale quantum networks; and comprehensive performance benchmarks for flexible quantum networks. The research will provide important training opportunities for postgraduate students in integrated photonics and quantum information technologies. Additionally, the developed silicon photonic devices and network protocols can serve as reference designs for laboratories and research institutions building quantum network testbeds, contributing to Hong Kong's growing expertise in quantum communication technologies. 量子網絡正崛起為用於安全通訊、分佈式量子計算和先進感測的革新性基礎設施。在邁向完全實現量子網絡的分階段發展路徑中，糾纏分發網絡代表了一個關鍵里程碑，它无需量子記憶體即可實現獨立於設備的安全協定，使其能够透過近期技術得以實現。然而，當前的實施方式面臨著關鍵局限：它們僅在單一自由度（波長選擇性或空間路徑選擇性）內運行。這限制了它們動態調整網絡拓撲、在變化的需求下高效分配量子資源，以及在元件故障或通道退化時保持穩健運行的能力。 本項目旨在透過開發一種新型的波長-路徑混合交換開關（HSS），為量子糾纏分發同時提供波長和空間路由控制，從而解決這些根本性挑戰。項目計劃將這種雙域可重構性整合到緊湊的硅光子晶片上，在實現前所未有的網絡靈活性之同時，最大程度地降低光損耗並保持量子態保真度。本研究包含三個相互關聯的主要目標： 首先，我們將設計並製備一個 4×4×4λ 的 HSS，採用級聯的 Banyan-Beneš 網路架構，並以環輔助非對稱馬赫-曾德爾干涉儀（ ring-assisted asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometers）作為交換單元。與傳統架構相比，該設計大幅降低了複雜度，有助於實現更簡化的控制和更低的插損。作為可行性研究，我們已在硅光子平台上成功展示了一個佔用面積僅為 0.38 mm² 的 4×4×2λ HSS 原型，驗證了所提架構的可行性。 其次，我們將開發利用光譜和空間可重構性的全面網絡管理協定，包括快速拓撲重構方案，以及利用冗餘通道的容錯路由策略。 第三，我們将在量子網路測試平台上實驗演示完整的糾纏分發系統，透過實施基於糾纏的量子密鑰分發（QKD），以驗證在真實運行條件下的網絡效能。 本項目将提供多項具體成果：用於可擴展雙域可重構量子交換的晶片級架構；用於小型量子網絡中動態資源分配的實用控制演算法；以及用於可重構量子網絡的全面效能基準。本研究將為集成光子學和量子資訊技術領域的研究生提供重要的培訓機會。此外，所開發的硅光子元件和網絡協定可作為建置量子網絡測試平台的實驗室與研究機構之參考設計，為香港在量子通訊技術領域的發展做出貢獻。

25300126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25300126.value: 次波長各向異性薄片中聲波傳播的數學分析

25300126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25300126.value: This proposal focuses on the mathematical analysis of acoustic wave propagation in presence of subwavelength anisotropic sheets. These sheets are nano-scale inhomogeneities with anisotropic geometry, i.e. where one dimension (thickness) is negligible compared to the other two (in-plane dimensions), and possessing highly-contrasting refraction parameters compared with the background medium. While the mathematical theory for isotropic resonators is relatively well established, a critical gap exists for inherently anisotropic scatterers, such as the ultra-thin sheets and flakes. This project will build up a systematic and comprehensive mathematical framework to fill this gap by pursuing the following two key goals: (a) At the microscopic level, we will characterize the leading-order term of the scattered acoustic wave fields (a Foldy-Lax type approximation) generated by a cluster of subwavelength anisotropic sheets, accounting for their scales, orientations and complex interaction effects; (b) At the macroscopic level, we will derive the effective properties of metamaterials or metasurfaces that emerge from a dense array of these sheets. This involves performing a continuum limit on the discrete Foldy-Lax system to obtain analytic formulas for effective material parameters or transmission conditions. The novelty of the research lies in the unification of two distinct asymptotic regimes (namely smallness and thin-thickness asymptotics), which leads to the pioneering analysis of collective interactions with anisotropy. Our analysis will demonstrate a fundamental transition in the scattering response from monopole-dominated (for isotropic resonators) to dipole-dominated (for anisotropic resonators) regimes. Mathematical challenges arise from the investigation on multi-scale asymptotic analysis involving the highly-contrasting material parameters under subwavelength regime. To address these problems, we shall use layer potential techniques, spectral analysis and asymptotic methods based on our previous relevant studies [12-15] on isotropic models. The success of this research will contribute to new design principles for wave-manipulating devices, moving beyond the current pattern of isotropic constituents to embrace the practical physics of anisotropy, with potential applications to metamaterials, advanced non-destructive evaluation techniques and so on. 本研究計畫聚焦於次波長各向異性薄片下聲波傳播的數學分析。此類薄片可視為具有各向異性幾何結構的納米尺度非均勻體；亦即，其一個空間尺度（厚度）相較於另外兩個方向的尺度可忽略不計，且其折射參數相對於背景介質具有高度對比率。儘管目前針對各向同性共振體的數學理論已相對成熟，對於本質上具有各向異性的散射體，例如超薄薄片與片狀結構，其嚴謹的數學分析尚處於起步階段。本計畫旨在建立一套系統且完整的數學理論框架，以填補此一研究空白，並著重於以下兩項核心目標： (a) 微觀尺度方面，我們將刻畫由一簇次波長各向異性薄片所產生之聲波散射場的主導階漸近項，即建立一類 Foldy–Lax 型近似，並精確考慮薄片的尺度，定向以及其間複雜的多體相互作用效應； (b) 宏觀尺度方面，我們將推導由大量高密度排列之各向異性薄片所形成的超材料或超表面之等效介質。具體而言，我們將對離散的 Foldy–Lax 系統取連續極限，進而獲得等效材料參數或有效傳輸條件的解析表达式。 本研究的創新性在於統一處理兩種不同的漸近尺度，即小尺度漸近與薄厚度漸近，從而首次系統地分析具有各向異性效應之散射體群集的多體相互作用效應。我們預期證明，散射響應將出現一項基本性的機制轉變：由各向同性共振體情形下以單極子（monopole）效應為主導，轉變為各向異性共振體情形下以偶極子（dipole）效應為主導。 主要數學挑戰來自於次波長尺度下，具有高度對比率材料參數所引起的多尺度漸近分析問題。為處理上述困難，我們將結合層勢方法、譜分析及漸近分析技術，並以我們先前在各向同性模型方面的相關研究成果 [12–15] 為基礎，進一步發展適用於各向異性薄片的新分析方法。 本研究若能順利完成，將有助於建立新型波操控裝置的數學設計原理，使相關研究由目前主要依賴各向同性組成單元的模式，進一步拓展至更符合實際物理情境的各向異性結構設計，並可望應用於超材料、先進非破壞性檢測技術以及其他相關領域。

25306226.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25306226.value: 水相動態共價鍵合與超分子作用協同驅動的單組分偶氮苯兩親分子柔性帶狀分子晶體自適應光致機械扭轉調控

25306226.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25306226.value: Movement is one of the essential features in the natural living system for sustaining life, which stems from the collective motions of biological machines. Taking inspiration from natural living systems, chemists have synthesized artificial molecular machines and achieved signiﬁcant accomplishments of amplifying photoinduced molecular motions into mechanical movements across length scale. Among pioneering work in this field, molecular machine-based crystals, with well-defined and highly ordered structures, have demonstrated exceptional efficiency in energy transduction. However, fabricating flexible molecular crystals in aqueous media, without any addition of organic solvents, for adaptive photomechanical movements remains unexplored. Achieving this will be a significant breakthrough in creating next-generation molecular machine-based crystals for future biological and intelligent applications. Based on the state-of-art concept of flexible and adaptive molecular crystals, the PI proposes to fabricate flexible ribbon-like molecular crystals in aqueous media from a single-component azobenzene amphiphile (containing a 1,2-dithiolane motif and an imidazolium cation) via leveraging synergistic dynamic covalent and supramolecular interactions. These interactions include disulfide bonds, π-π interactions, electrostatic repulsive forces, charge-assisted hydrogen bonds, etc. The dual dynamic networks within the resulting molecular crystals facilitates energy dissipation, enabling the amplification of photoinduced molecular motion to adaptive twisting deformation and ultimately controllable disassembly. Notably, this work goes far beyond a traditional azobenzene derivative or a simple hybrid system. It provides a fundamentally new class of adaptive materials relies on ingenious molecular design to dictate a sophisticated collaborative mechanism between dynamic covalent and supramolecular interactions, allowing for hierarchically molecular assembly in aqueous media. This project aims to unravel the underlying mechanisms of synergy and distinct roles of these dynamic covalent and supramolecular interactions during the crystal growth process, as well as the photoinduced adaptive deformations and the ultimate disassembly of the resulting molecular crystals. By exploring this programmable photomechanical movements, we will establish a novel platform of developing advanced intelligent biomimetic crystalline matter with potential applications in microrobotics, controlled release systems, and wearable sensors. 運動是自然生命系統維持生命活動的重要特徵之一，其本質源於生物分子機器的協同運動。受自然生命系統啟發，化學家已經合成了多種人工分子機器，並在將光誘導的微小分子運動跨尺度放大為宏觀機械運動方面取得了重要進展。在該領域的開創性研究中，分子機器晶體因其結構規整且高度有序，表現出優異的能量傳遞效率。然而，如何在不加入任何有機溶劑的水相中製備柔性分子晶體，並使其產生自適應光致機械運動，目前仍缺乏系統研究。若能實現這一目標，將有望推動新一代分子機器智能材料的發展，並為未來生物應用和智能應用提供新的材料基礎。 基於柔性自適應分子晶體的前沿理念，本項目擬以一種單組分偶氮苯兩親分子為構築單元，在水相中製備柔性帶狀分子晶體。該兩親分子含有1,2-二硫雜環戊烷結構單元和咪唑鎓陽離子，能夠通過二硫動態共價鍵，以及π-π堆積、靜電排斥作用和電荷輔助氫鍵等超分子作用實現協同組裝。所得分子晶體內部形成的雙重動態網絡有利於能量耗散，從而能夠將光誘導分子運動有效放大為自適應扭轉形變，並最終實現晶體結構的可控解組裝。值得指出的是，本研究不是傳統偶氮苯衍生物的簡單雜化體系，它將建立一類新型自適應分子晶體材料；這類自適應分子晶體材料的形成需通過精細分子設計以調控動態共價鍵合與超分子作用之間的協同機制，引導分子在水相中形成層級有序組裝。項目將重點闡明動態共價鍵合與超分子作用在晶體生長和光誘導自適應形變過程中的協同機制及兩者各自功能。通過研究這種可編程光致機械運動，本項目將構建智能仿生晶態材料的新平台，並為微型機器人、可控釋放系統和可穿戴傳感器等領域的應用提供基礎。

25309326.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25309326.value: 深度学习中的对称性及其在优化与高效通信分布式学习中的应用

25309326.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25309326.value: Deep learning has revolutionized artificial intelligence, driving breakthroughs in computer vision, natural language processing, and data analytics. However, the rapid scaling of models and data has introduced significant challenges: training large neural networks has become increasingly resource-intensive, with high computational and energy demands. In distributed and edge environments, communication becomes a bottleneck, and optimization can be fragile and inefficient at scale. Addressing these challenges is essential for the sustainable and practical deployment of AI technologies. To tackle these issues, this project focuses on a fundamental yet underexplored property of neural networks: symmetries in their parameter spaces. Many modern architectures—including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNets), and Transformers—admit parameter transformations (such as permutations, rescalings, and sign flips) that leave the network’s input–output behavior unchanged. These symmetries generate multiple equivalent solutions and reshape the optimization landscape, yet they are rarely utilized in current training and communication protocols. The research aims to develop a unified theory and practical framework for leveraging symmetries in deep learning. First, we will systematically characterize symmetry groups across major neural network architectures and construct symmetry-reduced parameter spaces that capture the true degrees of freedom. This approach will enable sharper complexity measures and improved generalization guarantees, providing better understanding and control of model capacity. Next, we will analyze how symmetries affect the geometry of the loss landscape and optimization dynamics, shedding light on phenomena such as mode connectivity and flat minima. These insights will be translated into practical diagnostics and guidelines for model design and training. Finally, we will develop and validate new algorithms that explicitly exploit symmetries to accelerate training, improve model aggregation, reduce communication overhead, and enhance robustness in distributed learning environments. The expected outcomes of this project include a deeper theoretical understanding of the role of symmetries in deep learning, as well as practical methods for more efficient, scalable, and robust model training for network-based AI systems. The resulting framework and algorithms will provide a rigorous foundation for future research and development, supporting the advancement of learning and optimization methods in both academic and applied settings. 深度学习极大地改变了人工智能领域，推动了计算机视觉、自然语言处理和数据分析等方面的突破性进展。然而，模型与数据规模的急剧扩大也带来了重大挑战：训练大型神经网络变得越来越依赖资源，产生了巨大的计算与能源消耗。在分布式与边缘环境中，通信构成了主要瓶颈，且大规模条件下的优化过程可能十分脆弱且低效。解决这些挑战，对于人工智能技术的可持续及实用化部署至关重要。为了应对这些问题，本项目聚焦于神经网络一个基础但尚未被充分探索的性质：参数空间中的对称性。许多现代网络架构，包括卷积神经网络、残差网络和 Transformer，都允许进行特定的参数变换（例如置换、缩放和符号翻转），且这些变换不会改变网络的输入-输出行为。这些对称性产生了多个等价解，并重塑了优化景观，然而在现有的训练和通信协议中却鲜少被加以利用。 本研究旨在建立一个统一的理论与实用框架，用于在深度学习中充分利用对称性。首先，我们将系统性地刻画主要神经网络架构中的对称群，并构建能够捕获真实自由度的对称规约参数空间。该方法将允许更精确的复杂度度量和更优的泛化性保证，从而对模型容量实现更好的理解与控制。其次，我们将分析对称性如何影响损失景观的几何形状及优化动态过程，揭示如模态连接性和平坦极小值等现象。这些理论洞察将被转化为用于模型设计和训练的实用诊断工具与指导准则。最后，我们将开发并验证能显式利用对称性的新算法，以加速训练、改进模型聚合、降低通信开销，并提升分布式学习环境中的鲁棒性。 本项目的预期成果包括对深度学习中对称性作用的更深层次理论理解，以及针对网络化 AI 系统更高效、可扩展且鲁棒的模型训练实用方法。由此产生的框架与算法将为未来的研究与开发奠定坚实的基础，支持学术与应用场景下学习和优化方法的持续进步。

25312726.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25312726.value: 基于前驱体的纳米晶黏结剂增强 3D 打印硫属化合物热电器件

25312726.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25312726.value: Thermoelectric devices can directly convert waste heat into electricity, offering a clean energy technology that supports global net-zero targets. Globally, the thermoelectric device market is expected to grow from USD $1.5 billion in 2024 to $4.2 billion in 2033, with even greater potential if manufacturing costs can be further reduced. Current manufacturing of thermoelectric materials and devices often relies on costly, hard-to-scale processes such as spark plasma sintering and machining, which hinder large-scale deployment. In addition, conventional methods are inefficient and generate significant material waste when producing irregular shapes, limiting applications where shape-conformable pellets are necessary. 3D printing, particularly direct ink writing, offers an efficient route to fabricating shape-conformable thermoelectric materials and addresses the cost and scalability challenges of conventional methods. However, previous attempts have yielded significantly lower performance than bulk ingots, limiting their practical applications. Overcoming this performance gap is therefore critical to enabling low-cost, high-performance thermoelectric devices through scalable manufacturing. Ink formulation and sintering protocol are essential for ensuring the structural and electronic integrity of printed thermoelectric materials. Conventional binders improve rheology but are often insulating or incompatible, leading to poor grain connectivity, impurities and off-stoichiometry. We address this challenge by developing precursor-based nanocrystal binders that transform into the matrix phase during sintering, forming interparticle bridges and continuous conductive networks. Our preliminary results in Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3 confirm this strategy, achieving competitive performance that surpasses many traditional ingot counterparts. Building on this foundation, the project will design and optimize precursor-based nanocrystal binders for mid- and high-temperature chalcogenide thermoelectric materials such as Cu2Se, SnSe, and PbTe, which currently exhibit far lower performance in printed form than in bulk ingots. The project proposes to establish effective ink formulations and sintering methodologies for these material systems and elucidate the physicochemical mechanisms governing binder-to-matrix conversion and interfacial bond formation. Expected outcomes include 3D-printed Cu2Se, SnSe, and PbTe with thermoelectric performance comparable to their ingot counterparts, as well as efficient devices fabricated directly from these printed materials. The understanding of the underlying mechanisms will also contribute to the existing knowledge gap in printed thermoelectric materials. This project will not only advance thermoelectric technology by enabling high-performance, scalable devices but also provide a general framework to advance the field of other 3D-printed semiconducting materials.

25504026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25504026.value: 生成式人工智能、人類及其在線上顧客溝通中的協作：探索語言背景的角色

25504026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25504026.value: Generative AI (GenAI) has attracted widespread attention. While many studies have examined the outcomes of GenAI adoption, most treat this technology as undifferentiated and overlook the great heterogeneity across models. GenAI models differ substantially in many aspects, such as their training data. In particular, language composition of the training corpus frames their linguistic background, which affects their language proficiency and worldview. These variations are particularly important for customer-facing adoptions in industries like tourism, where communication is subjective and sensitive to cultural nuances. Therefore, this project aims to explore the effectiveness of GenAI in online customer communication considering their linguistic backgrounds. More specifically, this project investigates: (1) how GenAI’s linguistic background affects the generated content and subsequently shapes customer feedback; (2) the extent to which GenAI can replace human staff given these linguistic backgrounds; and (3) how tourism staff strategically collaborate with GenAI to overcome sociolinguistic limitations and leverage complementary strengths. Yet this process is not determined by the features of GenAI alone. The linguistic background of tourism staff also matters, as it shapes their capability contrast with GenAI and determines the optimal strategy for human-AI collaborations. To understand how linguistic background affects the competence and collaboration of GenAI and humans, we adopt a multi-method approach that integrates secondary data with human evaluations and further incorporates qualitative interviews. More specifically, we first collect large-scale online complaints and managerial responses from TripAdvisor as secondary data, from which we construct analytical samples. Next, we automate AI responses using leading GenAI models across linguistic backgrounds and combine objective NLP-based proficiency measures with human evaluations to assess content quality and overall feedback. Multilevel regression is applied to investigate hypothesized relationships. Finally, we conduct semi-structured interviews with tourism staff to examine how human and AI capabilities complement or conflict in practice, disclosing underlying mechanisms of human-AI collaborations. This project offers both theoretical and practical implications. Theoretically, it first enriches business literature on GenAI adoption by emphasizing model heterogeneity rather than treating GenAI as a one-size-fits-all technology. Second, it extends theories based on inter-human communication, including communication pragmatics, attribution theory, and knowledge-based view, to the context of human-AI interaction. Practically, it offers actionable insights to industry practitioners on how to select, evaluate, and integrate GenAI in customer communication. Moreover, the findings disclose how AI interaction influences customers’ perceptions and staff’s reflexive attitudes, guiding GenAI implementation policies to ensure consumer and employee wellness. 生成式人工智能（GenAI）已受到廣泛關注，但現有研究多將其視為同質化技術，較少關注不同模型之間的差異。事實上，模型的訓練語料與語言構成會塑造其語言背景，進而影響語言能力與文化理解。這些差異在旅遊業等高度依賴顧客溝通的服務場景中尤為重要。 本項目旨在探討語言背景如何影響 GenAI 在線上顧客溝通中的表現，具體考察：（1）GenAI 的語言背景如何影響生成內容及顧客反饋；（2）在不同語言背景下，GenAI 在多大程度上能夠替代人類員工；以及（3）旅遊從業人員如何與 GenAI 協作，以彌補彼此的局限並發揮互補優勢。同時，員工自身的語言背景亦會影響其與 GenAI 的能力差異及最優協作方式。 本項目採用混合方法研究設計，結合 TripAdvisor 大規模二手數據、GenAI 自動生成回覆、NLP 客觀指標、人工評價及質性分析，檢驗相關關係及探索人機協作機制。 理論上，本項目從模型異質性的角度拓展 GenAI 應用研究，並將溝通語用學、歸因理論及知識基礎觀延伸至人機互動情境。實踐上，研究結果可為旅遊企業選擇、評估及應用 GenAI 提供指導，並為制定兼顧顧客與員工福祉的 GenAI 實施政策提供依據。

25506426.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25506426.value: 企業可持續發展報告的視覺可讀性

25506426.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25506426.value: This study investigates whether firms strategically manipulate the visual presentation of sustainability disclosures. While prior studies focus on what firms disclose, little is known about how information is visually presented. Preliminary evidence from leading firms suggests that unfavorable information is often placed in small fonts, low-contrast layouts, dense tables, or tiny footnotes, while positive achievements are highlighted with larger fonts and graphics. I develop novel measures of “visual readability” (e.g., font size, contrast, layout density, footnote prominence) using computer vision techniques, and examine whether firms with greater exposure to the EU’s Non-Financial Reporting Directive (NFRD)—a mandatory rule requiring large firms to report on their environmental, social, and governance practices—are more likely to use such strategies once disclosure becomes unavoidable. This study contributes to disclosure literature by introducing visual presentation design as a new dimension of reporting strategy, and has practical implications for regulators, investors, and standard setters concerned with the accessibility and credibility of sustainability information. 本研究探討企業是否會策略性地操控可持續發展披露的視覺呈現方式。過去的研究主要關注企業揭露的內容，而對於資訊的視覺呈現方式卻知之甚少。對部分大型企業的初步觀察顯示，不利資訊通常採用小字體、低對比度佈局、密集表格或極小的腳註，而積極的成就則以更大的字體和更醒目的圖表突出顯示。本研究運用電腦視覺技術，建立一系列全新的「視覺可讀性」指標（例如，字體大小、對比度、佈局密度、腳註顯著性），並檢視較受歐盟《非財務報告指令》（NFRD，一項要求大型企業報告其環境、社會和治理實踐的強制性規定）約束較多的企業，在披露變得不可避免後，是否更傾向採用上述視覺呈現策略。本研究透過將視覺呈現設計引入企業披露研究，視之為一個新的報告策略維度，從而拓展現有披露文獻；研究結果亦可為關注可持續發展資訊可及性及可信度的監管機構、投資者及準則制定機構提供實務啟示。

25513026.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25513026.value: 共融設計中的污名？身形標籤與社交媒體參與

25513026.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25513026.value: Body image dissatisfaction is a global concern linked to depression and social withdrawal. Many young women feel unhappy with their bodies even when healthy. Social media is a key driver, as algorithms highlight ultrathin ideals while sidelining creators with more diverse body types. An emerging response is to add body-size labels to search functions, allowing users to filter content by body type. These labels aim to increase visibility for diverse creators, but their effects remain unclear: they may empower users by enhancing representation, or backfire by heightening awareness of body size in ways that reinforce stigma. This project examines the impact of body-size search labels on user engagement. Drawing on stigma management theory, we propose that such labels enhance engagement by redistributing visibility across creators and giving users greater agency in content selection. However, outcomes are likely to depend on stigma intensity and label design. When creators deviate further from the thin ideal, users may adopt avoidance strategies such as distancing, concealment, or disengagement, rather than approach strategies such as solidarity and support. To capture the role of design, the project introduces the concept of stigma diagnosticity—the degree to which labels make weight-stigma associations explicit. We theorize that highly diagnostic labels increase stigma salience and avoidance, whereas less diagnostic framings may preserve utility while reducing harm. We will test these hypotheses through three complementary studies. Study 1 leverages a natural experiment from the staged rollout of body-size labels on a major platform to estimate causal changes in engagement across creators of different body sizes. Study 2 uses a controlled experimental platform to observe user behavior and measure psychological mechanisms such as perceived devaluation. By logging whether users avoid labels, distance themselves from certain body types, or disengage from content, this study will validate approach versus avoidance strategies. Study 3 evaluates alternative designs with varying diagnosticity, comparing highly explicit labels with less direct framings such as garment-fit descriptors. The project will provide the first causal evidence on whether body-size search labels promote inclusion or intensify stigma, explain how stigma intensity shapes user strategies, and advance understanding of how design interacts with stigmatized attributes. Practically, it will deliver guidance for platforms on inclusive design, strategies for creators to enhance discoverability, and insights for policymakers and educators concerned with digital wellbeing and user mental health. 對身體形象感到不滿是全球關注的問題，並與抑鬱和社交退縮有關。許多年輕女性即使身體健康，仍然對自己的身形感到不滿。社交媒體是造成這種現象的重要因素。平台的演算法往往突出極瘦的理想身形，同時降低更多元身形創作者的曝光度。近年出現的一種應對方法，是在搜尋功能中加入身形標籤，讓用戶按體型篩選內容。這些標籤旨在提高不同身形創作者的能見度，但實際效果仍不明確。它們可能透過增加多元身形的呈現來賦予用戶更多自主權，也可能因為提高人們對身形的關注而產生反效果，進一步強化污名。 本項目研究身形搜尋標籤如何影響用戶參與。根據污名管理理論，我們提出，這類標籤可以重新分配不同創作者的曝光度，並讓用戶在選擇內容時擁有更大的自主權，從而提升參與度。然而，其效果可能取決於污名的強度和標籤的設計。當創作者的身形與纖瘦標準差距較大時，用戶可能採取疏遠、隱藏或停止參與等迴避策略，而不會採取表達認同和支持等接近策略。為了理解設計所發揮的作用，本項目提出「污名診斷性」這一概念。它是指標籤在多大程度上明確顯示身形與體重污名之間的關聯。我們推論，診斷性較高的標籤會令污名更加顯著，並增加迴避行為。較不直接的表述方式則可能在保留實用性的同時減少傷害。 我們將透過三項相互補足的研究檢驗這些假設。研究一利用某大型平台分階段推出身形標籤所形成的自然實驗，估算這些標籤對不同身形創作者之用戶參與所造成的因果影響。研究二使用受控的實驗平台觀察用戶行為，並測量感知被貶低等心理機制。研究將記錄用戶是否避開某些標籤、與特定體型保持距離，或停止瀏覽相關內容，以驗證接近策略與迴避策略。研究三評估不同污名診斷性的標籤設計，並比較直接標示身形的標籤與較含蓄的表述方式，例如描述衣物合身程度的詞語。 本項目將首次提供因果證據，說明身形搜尋標籤究竟能促進共融，還是會加劇污名。研究亦會解釋污名強度如何影響用戶採取的策略，並深化我們對設計如何與受污名化特徵產生互動的理解。在實務方面，本項目將為平台的共融設計提供指引，協助創作者提高內容的可搜尋性，並為關注數碼福祉及用戶心理健康的政策制定者和教育工作者提供參考。

25513126.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25513126.value: 創新的最佳工作強度：來自中國高科技企業加班工作的證據

25513126.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25513126.value: This research addresses a critical yet underexplored question facing innovative firms: What is the optimal temporal work intensity for fostering innovation performance? Technology firms worldwide increasingly introduce intensified work practices to accelerate innovation, exemplified by China’s “996” culture and Silicon Valley’s embrace of extended working hours. However, there is surprisingly little rigorous evidence on optimal work intensity decisions beyond anecdotes and self-reported surveys. This practical gap is crucial because suboptimal work intensity can lead to significant productivity losses and employee burnout. This question is also theoretically pivotal as it directly addresses a fundamental question of the resource-based view (RBV): Will knowledge-intensive resources such as innovation capabilities experience time-compression diseconomies as assumed in RBV? This research aims to address these practical and theoretical questions by offering the first large-scale causal evidence on how temporal work intensity affects innovation outcomes and how this relationship varies across technological contexts. We develop a theoretical framework proposing an inverted-U relationship between temporal work intensity and innovation performance, driven by competing mechanisms of immersive learning and cognitive depletion. We further theorize that this relationship is moderated by technological complexity and dynamism, with complexity steepening the inverted-U curve and dynamism shifting its turning point rightward. For causal inferences, our empirical strategy employs novel measurement approaches and comprehensive data from Chinese high-tech firms during 2012-2019. We leverage NASA satellite nighttime light data to objectively measure firm-level overtime work, addressing biases inherent in self-reported surveys. To establish causality, we implement a two-stage instrumental variable approach using local overtime norms and expectations derived from national labor surveys as exogenous instruments. This rigorous identification strategy, combined with extensive robustness checks addressing potential measurement concerns, enables strong causal inferences to inform human resource practices, innovation management, and labor policies. 本研究關注創新型企業面臨的一個重要問題：工作時間達到什麼水準，最有利於提升創新績效？當前，世界各地的科技企業紛紛推行高強度工作模式以加快創新步伐，中國的996文化和矽穀盛行的超長工時便是典型例子。然而，關於如何確定最優工作強度，目前的依據大多停留在個案傳聞和員工自我報告的調查上，嚴謹的實證證據非常稀缺。填補這一實踐空白十分緊迫，因為不當的工作強度安排可能造成嚴重的生產力損失，並引發員工職業倦怠。這一問題在理論層面同樣舉足輕重，因為它直接關係到資源基礎觀（RBV）的一個核心命題：創新能力這類知識密集型資源，是否真的如RBV所假設的那樣存在時間壓縮不經濟？為回應上述實踐與理論問題，本研究旨在首次提供大規模因果證據，揭示工作時間強度如何影響創新成果，以及這種影響在不同技術情境下如何變化。 我們構建的理論框架提出：工作時間強度與創新績效之間呈倒U型關係，其背後是兩種相互抗衡的機制——沉浸式學習帶來的正向效應與認知損耗帶來的負向效應。我們進一步指出，技術複雜性和技術動態性會調節這一關係：技術越複雜，倒U型曲線越陡峭；技術環境越動態，曲線的拐點越向右移動。 在因果識別方面，我們擬採用新穎的測量方法，並基於2012至2019年中國高新技術企業的全面資料展開實證分析。具體而言，我們利用NASA衛星拍攝的夜間燈光資料，客觀測量企業層面的加班情況，從而克服自我報告資料固有的偏差。為確立因果關係，我們採用工具變量法，以全國勞動力調查中提取的地方加班規範與社會預期作為外生工具變量。這一嚴謹的識別策略，加上針對各種潛在測量問題的大量穩健性檢驗，使本研究能夠得出可靠的因果結論，為人力資源管理實踐、創新管理以及勞動政策的制定提供有力參考。

25513526.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25513526.value: 关系调适力：概念界定、前因与后果

25513526.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25513526.value: Organizations increasingly rely on people who connect across teams and functions to solve problems and get work done (Quintane et al., 2024). These "brokers" often face a practical dilemma: sometimes the right move is to keep parties separate (e.g., to protect confidentiality or maintain diverse viewpoints); other times it is to bring people together (e.g., to align and execute).
